local Util = {}
Util.Roles = {Entries = {}, ByName = {}, ById = {}, LoadedAt = 0, Base = nil}
Util.Roles.Fetch = function(base, force)
local R = Util.Roles
if base then R.Base = base end
if not R.Base then return false end
if not force and R.LoadedAt > 0 and os.clock() - R.LoadedAt < 20 then return true end
local okGet, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(R.Base .. "roles.json?t=" .. os.time()) end)
if not okGet or type(body) ~= "string" then return false end
local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, body)
if not (okJson and type(data) == "table" and type(data.entries) == "table") then return false end
local entries, byName, byId = {}, {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(data.entries) do
if type(e) == "table" then
local role = tostring(e.role or ""):lower()
if role == "owner" or role == "co-owner" then
local name = type(e.username) == "string" and e.username or nil
if name and not (#name >= 3 and #name <= 20 and name:match("^[%w_]+$")) then name = nil end
local id = math.floor(tonumber(e.userId) or 0)
if name or id > 0 then
entries[#entries + 1] = {username = name, userId = id > 0 and id or nil, role = role}
if name then byName[name:lower()] = role end
if id > 0 then byId[id] = role end
end
end
end
end
R.Entries, R.ByName, R.ById, R.LoadedAt = entries, byName, byId, os.clock()
return true
end
Util.Roles.Of = function(plr)
local R = Util.Roles
if not plr then return nil end
return R.ById[plr.UserId] or R.ByName[tostring(plr.Name):lower()]
end
Util.Roles.OwnerName = function()
for _, e in ipairs(Util.Roles.Entries) do
if e.role == "owner" and e.username then return e.username end
end
end
Util.RandomString = function(length)
length = length or math.random(32, 256)
local str = ""
for _=1, length do
str ..= string.char(math.random(32, 126))
end
return str
end
Util.DeepcopyTable = function(t)
local c = {}
for k, v in pairs(t) do
if type(v) == "table" then
v = Util.DeepcopyTable(v)
end
c[k] = v
end
return c
end
Util.ParseHex = function(s)
if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
s = s:gsub("%s+", ""):gsub("^#", "")
if #s == 3 then
s = s:sub(1, 1):rep(2) .. s:sub(2, 2):rep(2) .. s:sub(3, 3):rep(2)
end
if not s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end
return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16))
end
-- Official Discord invite for this script. Replace the placeholder below with the real invite link.
Util.DISCORD_INVITE_URL = "https://discord.gg/NASNUKRBVM"
Util.DiscordInvite = function()
local url = Util.DISCORD_INVITE_URL
if type(url) == "string" and (url:find("discord.gg/", 1, true) or url:find("discord.com/invite/", 1, true)) then return url end
return nil
end
Util.OpenDiscord = function()
local url = Util.DiscordInvite()
if not url then
Util.Notify("Discord invite is not configured yet (set DISCORD_INVITE_URL).")
return false
end
local copied = type(setclipboard) == "function" and pcall(setclipboard, url)
Util.Notify(copied and ("Discord invite copied: " .. url) or ("Discord invite: " .. url))
return true
end
Util.Notify = function(text)
local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
if cfg then
if cfg.NotifMode == 4 then return end
if cfg.NotifMode == 2 and Util.UINotify then
if pcall(Util.UINotify, text) then return end
end
end
StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
Title = (cfg and cfg.NotifTitle ~= "" and cfg.NotifTitle) or "Nooby's uh modded reanimation v1.1.1",
Text = text,
Duration = (cfg and cfg.NotifDuration + 1) or 5
})
end
local function ismissing(func)
return not func or type(func) ~= "function"
end
Util.Capabilities = {
request = not ismissing(request),

hiddenproperty = not ismissing(gethiddenproperty),

-- ===== FAST EXECUTION MODE: persistent startup cache =====
-- UhhhhhhReanim/FastExecution.cache is a small self-validating text file (format + build + length + checksum). It only remembers which bundled /
-- copied asset files (theme + intro songs, UI graphics) were already verified, so the next launch skips re-reading them just to check their size.
-- It never stores code, bytecode, player data or tokens. Missing / corrupt / outdated cache = rebuilt on the spot; any failure = normal startup.
-- Setting: Main page > Performance > "Fast Execution Mode" (default ON, saved in SaveData.Custom.FastExec). OFF = cache is neither read nor written.
do
local FE = {Fmt = 1, Rev = "fx1", Dir = "UhhhhhhReanim", Path = "UhhhhhhReanim/FastExecution.cache", Tmp = "UhhhhhhReanim/FastExecution.cache.tmp",
Hits = 0, Misses = 0, Writes = 0, Errors = 0, State = "unloaded"}
Util.FastExec = FE
FE.Build = tostring(UhhhhhhVersion) .. "|" .. tostring(UHMergeBuild) .. "|" .. FE.Rev
local function okKey(k)
return type(k) == "string" and #k > 0 and #k < 200 and not k:find("%c")
end
local function sum(s)
local a, b = 1, 0
for i = 1, #s do
a = (a + s:byte(i)) % 65521
b = (b + a) % 65521
end
return string.format("%04x%04x", b, a)
end
local function num(n)
return string.format("%d", math.floor(n))
end
local function blank()
return {files = {}, gfx = {}}
end
local function encode(d)
local out, keys = {}, {}
for k in pairs(d.files) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
table.sort(keys)
for _, k in ipairs(keys) do out[#out + 1] = "F\t" .. k .. "\t" .. num(d.files[k]) end
keys = {}
for k in pairs(d.gfx) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
table.sort(keys)
for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
local g = d.gfx[k]
out[#out + 1] = "G\t" .. k .. "\t" .. num(g.cdn) .. "\t" .. num(g.size)
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
local function decode(body)
local d = blank()
for line in (body .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
if line ~= "" then
local t = {}
for part in (line .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do t[#t + 1] = part end
local n3, n4 = tonumber(t[3]), tonumber(t[4])
if t[1] == "F" and #t == 3 and okKey(t[2]) and n3 and n3 >= 0 then
d.files[t[2]] = n3
elseif t[1] == "G" and #t == 4 and okKey(t[2]) and n3 and n4 and n4 >= 0 then
d.gfx[t[2]] = {cdn = n3, size = n4}
else
return nil
end
end
end
return d
end
local function pack(d)
local body = encode(d)
return "UHFX" .. FE.Fmt .. "\n" .. FE.Build .. "\n" .. #body .. "\n" .. sum(body) .. "\n" .. body
end
local function parse(raw)
if type(raw) ~= "string" then return nil, "unreadable" end
local fmt, build, len, cs, body = raw:match("^UHFX(%d+)\n([^\n]*)\n(%d+)\n(%x+)\n(.*)$")
if not fmt then return nil, "corrupt" end
if tonumber(fmt) ~= FE.Fmt or build ~= FE.Build then return nil, "outdated" end
if tonumber(len) ~= #body or cs ~= sum(body) then return nil, "corrupt" end
local d = decode(body)
if not d then return nil, "corrupt" end
return d, "hit"
end
FE.Pack, FE.Parse = pack, parse
local function guard(fn, default)
return function(...)
local ok, r = pcall(fn, ...)
if ok then return r end
FE.Errors = FE.Errors + 1
if FE.Errors >= 5 then FE.Broken = true end
return default
end
end
function FE.Bind(save)
if type(save) == "table" then FE.Save = save end
end
function FE.Pref()
local S = FE.Save
local c = type(S) == "table" and S.Custom or nil
if type(c) == "table" and type(c.FastExec) == "boolean" then return c.FastExec end
return true
end
function FE.Fs()
if FE.FsOk == nil then
FE.FsOk = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"
and type(makefolder) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function"
end
return FE.FsOk
end
function FE.On()
return FE.Save ~= nil and FE.Broken ~= true and FE.Fs() and FE.Pref()
end
FE.Load = guard(function()
if FE.Data then return FE.Data end
FE.Data, FE.State, FE.Last = blank(), "missing", nil
local found = false
for _, p in ipairs({FE.Path, FE.Tmp}) do
local okE, ex = pcall(isfile, p)
if okE and ex == true then
found = true
local okR, raw = pcall(readfile, p)
local d, why = parse(okR and raw or nil)
if d then
FE.Data, FE.State = d, "hit"
if p == FE.Path then
FE.Last = raw
else
FE.State, FE.Dirty = "recovered", true
end
return FE.Data
end
FE.State = why
end
end
if found then FE.Dirty = true end
return FE.Data
end)
FE.Flush = guard(function()
if not FE.Dirty or not FE.Data or not FE.On() then return false end
local text = pack(FE.Data)
if text == FE.Last then
FE.Dirty = false
return false
end
if not isfolder(FE.Dir) then makefolder(FE.Dir) end
writefile(FE.Tmp, text)
if readfile(FE.Tmp) ~= text then error("cache tmp verify failed") end
writefile(FE.Path, text)
if type(delfile) == "function" then pcall(delfile, FE.Tmp) end
FE.Last, FE.Dirty = text, false
FE.Writes = FE.Writes + 1
return true
end, false)
function FE.Touch()
FE.Dirty = true
if FE.Pending then return end
FE.Pending = true
task.delay(2, function()
FE.Pending = false
FE.Flush()
end)
end
FE.FileOk = guard(function(path, size)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(path) or type(size) ~= "number" then return false end
FE.Load()
local v = FE.Data.files[path]
if v ~= nil and v == size then
FE.Hits = FE.Hits + 1
return true
end
FE.Misses = FE.Misses + 1
return false
end, false)
FE.FileSet = guard(function(path, size)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(path) or type(size) ~= "number" or size ~= size or size < 0 then return end
FE.Load()
if FE.Data.files[path] ~= size then
FE.Data.files[path] = size
FE.Touch()
end
end)
FE.FileDrop = guard(function(path)
if FE.On() and FE.Data and FE.Data.files[path] ~= nil then
FE.Data.files[path] = nil
FE.Touch()
end
end)
FE.GfxOk = guard(function(name, cdn)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(name) or type(cdn) ~= "number" then return false end
FE.Load()
local g = FE.Data.gfx[name]
if g and g.cdn == cdn then
FE.Hits = FE.Hits + 1
return true
end
FE.Misses = FE.Misses + 1
return false
end, false)
FE.GfxSet = guard(function(name, cdn, size)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(name) or type(cdn) ~= "number" or type(size) ~= "number" or size ~= size or size < 0 then return end
FE.Load()
local g = FE.Data.gfx[name]
if not g or g.cdn ~= cdn or g.size ~= size then
FE.Data.gfx[name] = {cdn = cdn, size = size}
FE.Touch()
end
end)
-- toggled in the UI: ON starts from an empty manifest (nothing recorded while it was OFF is trusted), OFF just stops using it (nothing is deleted)
function FE.Apply(on)
if on == true then
FE.Data, FE.State, FE.Last, FE.Broken, FE.Errors = blank(), "reset", nil, nil, 0
FE.Touch()
end
end
end
if ismissing(sethiddenproperty) and not ismissing(setscriptable) and not ismissing(isscriptable) then
sethiddenproperty = function(inst, prop, value)
local ok, old = pcall(isscriptable, inst, prop)
if ok and old == false then pcall(setscriptable, inst, prop, true) end
local success, err = pcall(function() inst[prop] = value end)
if ok and old == false then pcall(setscriptable, inst, prop, false) end
return success, err
end
end

local _native_xpcall = xpcall
local pcall = function(func, ...)
return _native_pcall(func, ...)
end
local xpcall = function(func, handler, ...)
return _native_xpcall(func, handler, ...)
end

Util.FX = (function()
local FX = {}
local RealTweenService = TweenService
local Lighting = cloneref(game:GetService("Lighting"))
local RawCfg = {}
local RawSettings = {Blur = true, Transitions = true, ExtraSounds = true, Ambient = true}
local LOWEND_SETTINGS = {Blur = false, Transitions = false, ExtraSounds = false, Ambient = false}
local LOWEND_CFG = {
UIParticles = false, UIGradient = false, UITrail = false, UIGlow = false, RbxIconTheme = false, RbxBarTheme = false, ChatStyle = false,
TriNodes = false, TriFaces = true, TriExplode = false, TriMusic = false,
UIAnimSpeed = 3, NotifSpeed = 3, LiquidGlass = false,
}
FX.LowEndTriFPS = 30
FX.LowEndUIFPS = 30
FX.LowEndHooks = {}
local PROF_SETTINGS, PROF_CFG
function FX.SetProfile(s, c) PROF_SETTINGS, PROF_CFG = s, c end
function FX.IsLowEnd()
return RawCfg.LowEnd == true
end
function FX.OnLowEnd(fn)
FX.LowEndHooks[#FX.LowEndHooks + 1] = fn
end
local Gov = {Stride = 1}
FX.Gov = Gov
function FX.Lite()
if RawCfg.LowEnd == true or Gov.Stride > 1 then return true end
local d = FX.Device
if not d then return false end
local t = d.Tier or 4
return t <= 1 or (t == 2 and d.Mobile == true)
end
do
-- Adaptive Performance Engine: 5 profiles, device-seeded start, FPS governor, manual override, VFX scaling
local Perf = {}
FX.Perf = Perf
local floor, max, min, clock = math.floor, math.max, math.min, os.clock
local NAMES = {"Ultra", "High", "Balanced", "Low", "Potato"}
Perf.Names = NAMES
Gov.Level = 1
-- stride: UI/chrome frame skipping | vfx: particle Rate multiplier | trail/beam/shad/spot/bloom/sun/dof: feature kept on
-- gs: GlobalShadows | q: QualityLevel | deco: terrain decoration+water | mesh: cap mesh detail | capM/capD: fps cap mobile/desktop
-- sim: SimulationRadius refresh interval (s) | ray: void-raycast stride in RC loop | uifps: LowEnd UI fps | low: (unused - engine never auto-enables LowEnd UI mode)
local P = {
{stride = 1, vfx = 1, trail = true, beam = true, shad = true, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = true, dof = true, gs = true, deco = true, sim = 0, ray = 1, uifps = 30},
{stride = 1, vfx = 0.75, trail = true, beam = true, shad = true, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = true, dof = false, gs = true, deco = true, sim = 0, ray = 1, uifps = 30},
{stride = 1, vfx = 0.5, trail = true, beam = true, shad = false, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = false, dof = false, gs = false, q = 5, deco = true, sim = 0.25, ray = 1, uifps = 30},
{stride = 1, vfx = 0.25, trail = false, beam = false, shad = false, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = false, dof = false, gs = false, q = 3, deco = false, mesh = true, capM = 60, sim = 0.5, ray = 2, uifps = 30},
{stride = 2, vfx = 0.08, trail = false, beam = false, shad = false, spot = false, bloom = false, sun = false, dof = false, gs = false, q = 1, deco = false, mesh = true, capM = 30, sim = 1, ray = 3, uifps = 30},
}
Perf.Profiles = P
local Cur = P[1]
local level, ceiling, startLv, mode, seeded = nil, 1, 1, "auto", false
local userLow, engineSet = false, false
local listeners = {}
Perf.RayStride = 1
-- ---------- instance scaling (particles / trails / beams / lights / post effects) ----------
local CLS = {ParticleEmitter = 1, Trail = 2, Beam = 3, PointLight = 4, SpotLight = 4, SurfaceLight = 4, BloomEffect = 5, SunRaysEffect = 5, DepthOfFieldEffect = 5}
local POST = {BloomEffect = "bloom", SunRaysEffect = "sun", DepthOfFieldEffect = "dof"}
local Rec = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local Mod = {}
local Q, qh, qt = {}, 1, 0
local active, modI, modPrune, restoring = false, nil, false, false
local scanList, scanI, pruneT = nil, 1, 0
local addedA, addedB, conn
local BUDGET = 0.0012
local function offBool(inst, r, prop, off)
if off then
if inst[prop] == true then inst[prop] = false r[prop] = true end
elseif r[prop] then
if inst[prop] == false then inst[prop] = true end
r[prop] = nil
end
end
local function applyOne(inst, p)
local r = Rec[inst]
if not r then return end
local cn = inst.ClassName
local k = CLS[cn]
if k == 1 then
local cur, a = inst.Rate, r.a
if p.vfx >= 1 then
if a ~= nil then
if cur == a then inst.Rate = r.o end
r.a, r.o = nil, nil
end
else
local base = (a ~= nil and cur == a) and r.o or cur
local want = base * p.vfx
r.o, r.a = base, want
if cur ~= want then inst.Rate = want end
end
elseif k == 2 then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p.trail)
elseif k == 3 then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p.beam)
elseif k == 4 then
offBool(inst, r, "Shadows", not p.shad)
if cn ~= "PointLight" then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p.spot) end
elseif k == 5 then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p[POST[cn]])
end
end
local function track(inst, p)
if Rec[inst] == nil then
Rec[inst] = {}
Mod[#Mod + 1] = inst
end
pcall(applyOne, inst, p)
end
local function onAdded(d)
if CLS[d.ClassName] then
if qt - qh > 3000 then
Perf._rescan = true
return
end
qt = qt + 1
Q[qt] = d
end
end
local function startScan()
local l = {}
pcall(function() l = workspace:GetDescendants() end)
pcall(function()
local b = Lighting:GetDescendants()
for i = 1, #b do l[#l + 1] = b[i] end
end)
scanList, scanI = l, 1
end
local function startAdded()
if not addedA then addedA = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(onAdded) end
if not addedB then addedB = Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(onAdded) end
end
local function stopAdded()
if addedA then addedA:Disconnect() addedA = nil end
if addedB then addedB:Disconnect() addedB = nil end
end
local function work()
local t0 = clock()
local p = restoring and P[1] or Cur
if modI then
local i, n = modI, #Mod
while i <= n do
local inst = Mod[i]
if inst.Parent == nil then
Rec[inst] = nil
Mod[i] = Mod[n]
Mod[n] = nil
n = n - 1
else
if not modPrune then pcall(applyOne, inst, p) end
i = i + 1
end
if i % 32 == 0 and clock() - t0 > BUDGET then modI = i return end
end
modI, modPrune = nil, false
if restoring then
restoring = false
if not active then
Mod = {}
Rec = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
end
end
end
if Perf._rescan and active then Perf._rescan = nil Q, qh, qt = {}, 1, 0 startScan() end
if scanList and active then
local l, i, n = scanList, scanI, #scanList
while i <= n do
local inst = l[i]
i = i + 1
if CLS[inst.ClassName] then track(inst, Cur) end
if i % 64 == 0 and clock() - t0 > BUDGET then scanI = i return end
end
scanList = nil
end
local c = 0
while qh <= qt and active do
local inst = Q[qh]
Q[qh] = nil
qh = qh + 1
if inst.Parent ~= nil then track(inst, Cur) end
c = c + 1
if c % 32 == 0 and clock() - t0 > BUDGET then return end
end
if qh > qt and qt > 0 then Q, qh, qt = {}, 1, 0 end
end
local function retarget()
local on = level ~= nil and level >= 2
if on then
restoring = false
if not active then
active = true
startAdded()
startScan()
end
modI, modPrune = 1, false
elseif active then
active = false
stopAdded()
scanList, Q, qh, qt = nil, {}, 1, 0
modI, modPrune, restoring = 1, false, true
end
end
-- ---------- global rendering knobs (originals saved lazily, restored when no longer overridden) ----------
local G = {}
local function applyGlobals(p)
pcall(function()
if p.gs == false then
if G.gs == nil then G.gs = Lighting.GlobalShadows end
Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
elseif G.gs ~= nil then
Lighting.GlobalShadows = G.gs
G.gs = nil
end
end)
pcall(function()
local R = settings().Rendering
if p.q then
if G.q == nil then G.q = R.QualityLevel end
R.QualityLevel = string.format("Level%02d", p.q)
elseif G.q ~= nil then
R.QualityLevel = G.q
G.q = nil
end
if p.mesh then
if G.m == nil then G.m = R.MeshPartDetailLevel end
R.MeshPartDetailLevel = Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level04
elseif G.m ~= nil then
R.MeshPartDetailLevel = G.m
G.m = nil
end
end)
pcall(function()
local T = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
if not T then return end
if p.deco == false then
if not G.t then G.t = {T.Decoration, T.WaterWaveSize, T.WaterWaveSpeed, T.WaterReflectance} end
T.Decoration, T.WaterWaveSize, T.WaterWaveSpeed, T.WaterReflectance = false, 0, 0, 0
elseif G.t then
local t = G.t
G.t = nil
T.Decoration, T.WaterWaveSize, T.WaterWaveSpeed, T.WaterReflectance = t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4]
end
end)
pcall(function()
if type(setfpscap) ~= "function" then return end
local d = FX.Device
local want = d and d.Mobile == true and p.capM or nil
if want then
if G.cap == nil then G.cap = (type(getfpscap) == "function" and tonumber(getfpscap())) or false end
setfpscap(want)
elseif G.cap ~= nil then
local o = G.cap
G.cap = nil
setfpscap((o and o > 0) and o or ((d and d.Mobile == true) and 120 or 999))
end
end)
end
-- ---------- profile switching ----------
local avg, evalT, badT, goodT = nil, 0, 0, 0
local cap, capAt = 0, -1e9
local lastChange, settleUntil, lastUp, holdLevel, holdUntil, holdDur = 0, 0, -1e9, nil, 0, 300
local function emit()
for i = 1, #listeners do pcall(listeners[i], level, mode) end
end
local function setLevel(n)
n = max(1, min(5, floor(n)))
if n == level then return end
level = n
local p = P[n]
Cur = p
Perf.Level, Perf.RayStride = n, p.ray
Gov.Stride, Gov.Level = p.stride, n
FX.LowEndTriFPS, FX.LowEndUIFPS = p.uifps, p.uifps
FX.SetProfile(nil, nil) -- engine never overrides UI settings (no low-end-style UI from profiles)
local wantLow = userLow -- engine never turns Low End UI Mode on by itself; only the user's own toggle counts
if wantLow ~= true and (RawCfg.LowEnd == true) ~= wantLow then
engineSet = true
pcall(FX.SetLowEnd, wantLow)
engineSet = false
elseif Util and Util.UIPlus and Util.UIPlus.Apply then
pcall(Util.UIPlus.Apply)
end
if FX.Store then FX.Store.AutoLow = false end
applyGlobals(p)
retarget()
avg, badT, goodT, capAt = nil, 0, 0, -1e9
lastChange = clock()
settleUntil = lastChange + 2.5
emit()
end
FX.OnLowEnd(function(on)
if not engineSet then
userLow = on
if FX.Store then FX.Store.AutoLow = false end
end
end)
function Perf.Seed(tier, mobile)
tier = max(1, min(4, floor(tonumber(tier) or 3)))
local c, s
if tier == 1 then c, s = 4, 5
elseif tier == 2 then if mobile then c, s = 3, 4 else c, s = 2, 2 end
elseif tier == 3 then c = mobile and 2 or 1 s = c
else c, s = 1, 1 end
seeded, ceiling = true, c
startLv = level and max(startLv, s) or s
local store = FX.Store
if not level then userLow = RawCfg.LowEnd == true and not (store and store.AutoLow == true) end
if mode == "auto" then
setLevel(level and max(level, s) or s)
elseif level then
applyGlobals(P[level])
end
end
function Perf.Boot()
local v = floor(tonumber(RawCfg.PerfProfile) or 1)
if v >= 2 and v <= 6 then
mode = "manual"
local store = FX.Store
userLow = RawCfg.LowEnd == true and not (store and store.AutoLow == true)
setLevel(v - 1)
else
mode = "auto"
end
end
function Perf.Select(v)
v = floor(tonumber(v) or 1)
if v >= 2 and v <= 6 then
if mode == "manual" and level == v - 1 then return end
mode = "manual"
if level == v - 1 then emit() else setLevel(v - 1) end
else
if mode == "auto" then return end
mode = "auto"
avg, badT, goodT, holdLevel = nil, 0, 0, nil
settleUntil = clock() + 3
if seeded then
if level then setLevel(max(level, startLv)) end
elseif level then
setLevel(1)
end
emit()
end
end
function Perf.Manual() return mode == "manual" end
function Perf.OnChange(fn) listeners[#listeners + 1] = fn end
function Perf.Status()
return {Level = level, Name = level and NAMES[level] or nil, Mode = mode, FPS = avg and 1 / avg or nil, Ceiling = ceiling, Seeded = seeded}
end
local simT = 0
function Perf.SimDue()
local iv = Cur.sim
if iv <= 0 then return true end
local t = clock()
if t - simT >= iv then simT = t return true end
return false
end
FX.SimDue = Perf.SimDue
-- ---------- single Heartbeat: job pump + lightweight FPS governor ----------
local function step(dt)
if modI or scanList or qh <= qt or Perf._rescan then work() end
if active then
pruneT = pruneT + dt
if pruneT > 20 then
pruneT = 0
if not modI then modI, modPrune = 1, true end
end
end
if mode ~= "auto" or not seeded or not level then return end
if dt > 1 then
avg, badT, goodT = nil, 0, 0
settleUntil = clock() + 2
return
end
if dt > 0.25 then dt = 0.25 end
avg = avg and (avg + (dt - avg) * 0.05) or dt
evalT = evalT + dt
if evalT < 0.5 then return end
local el = evalT
evalT = 0
local now = clock()
if now < settleUntil then return end
if now - capAt > 10 then
capAt, cap = now, 0
pcall(function() if type(getfpscap) == "function" then cap = tonumber(getfpscap()) or 0 end end)
end
local T = (cap > 0 and cap < 90) and cap or 60
local fps = 1 / avg
if fps < T * 0.72 then
badT, goodT = badT + el, 0
if badT >= (fps < T * 0.5 and 2.5 or 4) and level < 5 then
local drop = fps < T * 0.35 and 2 or 1
badT, goodT = 0, 0
local prev = level
setLevel(level + drop)
if now - lastUp < 60 and level ~= prev then
holdLevel, holdUntil = level, now + holdDur
holdDur = min(holdDur * 2, 1800)
end
end
elseif fps > T * 0.92 then
goodT, badT = goodT + el, 0
if goodT >= 8 and now - lastChange >= 15 then
local lim = ceiling
if holdLevel and now < holdUntil then lim = max(lim, holdLevel) end
goodT = 0
if level > lim then
lastUp = now
setLevel(level - 1)
end
end
else
badT, goodT = max(0, badT - el), max(0, goodT - el)
end
end
function Perf.Start()
if not conn then conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step) end
end
function Perf.Stop()
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
stopAdded()
active, scanList, modI, Q, qh, qt, Perf._rescan = false, nil, nil, {}, 1, 0, nil
for i = 1, #Mod do pcall(applyOne, Mod[i], P[1]) end
Mod = {}
Rec = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
restoring = false
applyGlobals(P[1])
Gov.Stride, Gov.Level, Cur, Perf.RayStride = 1, 1, P[1], 1
FX.SetProfile(nil, nil)
if level and P[level].low and not userLow and (RawCfg.LowEnd == true) then
engineSet = true
pcall(FX.SetLowEnd, false)
engineSet = false
end
level, seeded, Perf.Level = nil, false, nil
end
do
local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
local old = genv.__UHPerf

function FX.InitCustom(SaveData)
if type(SaveData.Custom) ~= "table" then
SaveData.Custom = {}
end
FX.Store = SaveData.Custom
for k, d in pairs(DEFAULT_CFG) do
local v = FX.Store[k]
if type(v) ~= type(d) then
v = d
end
FX.Cfg[k] = v
end
if not SaveData.GlassSkin1 then
SaveData.GlassSkin1 = true
for k, v in pairs({UIBgTr = 0.28, UIRound = 16, UIGlow = false, UIFont = 2}) do
FX.Cfg[k] = v
FX.Store[k] = v
end
end
if FX.Perf then FX.Perf.Boot() end
end
function FX.SetCfg(key, value)
FX.Cfg[key] = value
if FX.Store then
FX.Store[key] = value
end
if (key == "MusicDance" or key == "MusicColor") and FX.Audio then pcall(FX.Audio.Refresh) end
if key == "PerfProfile" and FX.Perf then FX.Perf.Select(value) end
end
function FX.ResetCfg()
for k, d in pairs(DEFAULT_CFG) do
if k ~= "LowEnd" and k ~= "FastExec" and k ~= "AutoReport" and k ~= "CModOn" and k ~= "CModSay" and k ~= "CModConf" then
FX.SetCfg(k, d)
end
end
end
function FX.SetLowEnd(on)
on = on == true
if RawCfg.LowEnd == on then
return false
end
FX.SetCfg("LowEnd", on)
for _, fn in ipairs(FX.LowEndHooks) do
local ok, err = pcall(fn, on)
if not ok then
warn("[LowEnd] hook failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
return true
end
function FX.TriColor(t)
local C = FX.Cfg
if C.TriColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(C.TriColor) or WHITE
elseif C.TriColorMode == 3 then
return Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.2) % 1, 0.8, 1)
elseif C.TriColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Palette(t).Secondary
end
return FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or Color3.fromHSV((t / 10) % 1, 0.8, 1)
end
function FX.MarqueeText(fallback)
local m = FX.Cfg.IntroMarquee
if type(m) == "string" and m ~= "" then
return (m:gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")) .. string.rep(" ", 24)
end
return fallback
end
local Springs, springConn, springAcc, springFrame = {}, nil, 0, 0
local function springStep(dt)
springFrame = springFrame + 1
springAcc = springAcc + dt
if FX.Gov and FX.Gov.Stride > 1 and springFrame % FX.Gov.Stride ~= 0 then return end
dt = math.min(springAcc, 1 / 30)
springAcc = 0
local any = false
for obj, props in pairs(Springs) do
if obj.Parent == nil then
Springs[obj] = nil
else
local live = false
for prop, st in pairs(props) do
local a = st.k * (st.t - st.x) - st.c * st.v
st.v = st.v + a * dt
st.x = st.x + st.v * dt
if math.abs(st.t - st.x) < 0.0006 and math.abs(st.v) < 0.01 then
pcall(function() obj[prop] = st.t end)
props[prop] = nil
else
pcall(function() obj[prop] = st.x end)
live = true
end
end
if live then any = true else Springs[obj] = nil end
end
end
if not any and springConn then
springConn:Disconnect()
springConn = nil
end
end
function FX.SpringTo(obj, prop, target, k, z, from)
if not obj then return end
if not FX.Settings.Transitions or FX.Lite() then
local props = Springs[obj]
if props then props[prop] = nil end
pcall(function()
if from then obj[prop] = from end
if FX.Settings.Transitions then
RealTweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Quad, EOut), {[prop] = target}):Play()
else
obj[prop] = target
end
end)
return
end
local props = Springs[obj]
if not props then props = {} Springs[obj] = props end
local st = props[prop]
local ok, cur = pcall(function() return obj[prop] end)
if ok and type(cur) == "number" then
local d = math.abs(target - (from or cur))
if prop == "Rotation" then d = d / 20 end
if d > 0.015 and not FX.NoMB then FX.MotionBlur(math.min(3, 1 + d * 5), 0.45) end
if st and st.v and st.v * (target - st.x) < -0.01 then FX.MotionBlur(1.5, 0.45) end
end
if not st then
st = {x = ok and cur or target, v = 0}
props[prop] = st
end
if from then st.x, st.v = from, 0 end
k = k or 260
st.t, st.k, st.c = target, k, 2 * (z or 0.7) * math.sqrt(k)
if not springConn then springConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(springStep) end
end
local function liquidParams(style)
if style == Quad then return 620, 1 end
if style == Back then return 300, 0.68 end
return 250, 0.55
end
local tween = (function()
local cache, speed = {}, nil
return function(obj, time, style, dir, props)
local sp = FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1
if sp ~= speed then cache, speed = {}, sp end
style, dir = style or Quint, dir or EOut
local sprg = Springs[obj]
if sprg then for pk in pairs(props) do sprg[pk] = nil end end
if style == Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic or style == Bounce then style = Back end
local byStyle = cache[style]
if not byStyle then byStyle = {} cache[style] = byStyle end
local byDir = byStyle[dir]
if not byDir then byDir = {} byStyle[dir] = byDir end
local info = byDir[time]
if not info then
info = TweenInfo.new(time / math.max(0.2, sp), style, dir)
byDir[time] = info
end
local t = RealTweenService:Create(obj, info, props)
t:Play()
return t
end
end)()
local function easeOutCubic(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function easeInOut(x)
if x < 0.5 then
return 4 * x * x * x
end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function easeOutBack(x)
local c1 = 1.70158
local c3 = c1 + 1
return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
local function isPress(input)
return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local blurToken = 0
function FX.BlurPulse(peak, inTime, outTime, soft)
if not FX.Settings.Blur then return end
blurToken = blurToken + 1
local my = blurToken
inTime = inTime or 0.15
tween(Blur, inTime, Quad, EOut, {Size = peak})
task.delay(inTime, function()
if my ~= blurToken then return end
tween(Blur, outTime or 0.45, Quad, soft and EOut or EIn, {Size = 0})
end)
task.delay((inTime + (outTime or 0.45)) / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1) + 0.25, function()
if my == blurToken and Blur.Size > 0 then Blur.Size = 0 end
end)
end
local mbLast = 0
function FX.MotionBlur(peak, settle)
if not FX.Settings.Blur or FX.IsLowEnd() or (FX.Gov and FX.Gov.Stride > 1) then return end
local lite = FX.Lite()
local now = os.clock()
if now - mbLast < (lite and 0.16 or 0.08) then return end
peak = math.min(peak or 2, 6) * (lite and 0.5 or 1)
if Blur.Size >= peak then return end
mbLast = now
FX.BlurPulse(peak, 0.09, math.clamp(settle or 0.4, 0.25, 1), true)
end
function FX.mtween(obj, time, style, dir, props)
if props and time >= 0.12 then
if props.Position or props.Size or props.Rotation or props.Scale then
FX.MotionBlur(1.2 + math.min(time, 1) * 2, time)
elseif time >= 0.14 and (props.BackgroundTransparency or props.TextTransparency or props.ImageTransparency or props.GroupTransparency or props.Transparency or props.Thickness or props.Offset) then
FX.MotionBlur(0.9, time)
end
end
return tween(obj, time, style, dir, props)
end
local wheelAt = 0
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then wheelAt = os.clock() end
end)
function FX.SmoothScroll(sf)
if sf:GetAttribute("FXS") then return end
sf:SetAttribute("FXS", true)
local prev, goal, tw, busy, step = sf.CanvasPosition, nil, nil, false, nil
sf:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
if busy then return end
local cur = sf.CanvasPosition
if os.clock() - wheelAt < 0.05 and (cur - prev).Magnitude > 4 and FX.Settings.Transitions and not FX.Lite() then
local d = cur - prev
local active = tw and tw.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
if not active then step = d.Magnitude goal = cur
else goal = goal + d.Unit * (step or 48) end
if tw then tw:Cancel() end
local mx = sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize - sf.AbsoluteWindowSize
goal = Vector2.new(math.clamp(goal.X, 0, math.max(0, mx.X)), math.clamp(goal.Y, 0, math.max(0, mx.Y)))
busy = true
sf.CanvasPosition = prev
busy = false
FX.MotionBlur(1.4 + math.min(1.2, d.Magnitude / 120), 0.6)
tw = RealTweenService:Create(sf, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Quint, EOut), {CanvasPosition = goal})
tw:Play()
return
end
local mv = (cur - prev).Magnitude
if mv > 22 then FX.MotionBlur(math.min(2.2, 0.8 + mv / 60), 0.5) end
prev = cur
end)
end
function FX.SmoothScrollTree(root)
for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then pcall(FX.SmoothScroll, d) end
end
root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then pcall(FX.SmoothScroll, d) end
end)
end
FX.UISound = nil
local presets = {
click = {1.12, 1}, thump = {0.5, 0.55}, tick = {1.9, 0.2}, release = {1.6, 0.42}, open = {0.75, 0.85}, back = {0.62, 0.85},
close = {1.3, 0.8}, boom = {0.42, 1.4}, reform = {1.6, 0.9}, hit = {1.2, 0.9},
}
local function playSnd(kind, pitchMul, volMul, noLayer)
local U = FX.UISound
local base = U and U.Click
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
local p = presets[kind] or presets.click
local pool = FX.SndPool
if not pool then pool = {n = 0} FX.SndPool = pool end
pool.n = pool.n % 6 + 1
local s = pool[pool.n]
if not s or s.Parent ~= base.Parent then
if s then s:Destroy() end
s = base:Clone()
s.Parent = base.Parent
pool[pool.n] = s
elseif s.SoundId ~= base.SoundId then
s.SoundId = base.SoundId
end
s.PlaybackSpeed = p[1] * (pitchMul or 1) * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * p[2] * (volMul or 1)
s.TimePosition = 0
s:Play()
if kind == "click" and not noLayer then playSnd("thump", 1, 1, true) end
end
function FX.Play(kind, pitchMul, volMul)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
playSnd(kind, pitchMul, volMul)
end
local hapSvc, hapType, hapMotor, hapTok = nil, nil, nil, 0
function FX.Haptic(power, dur)
if FX.Cfg.Haptics == false or not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then return end
if hapType == nil then
hapType = false
pcall(function()
hapSvc = cloneref(game:GetService("HapticService"))
for _, it in ipairs({Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.UserInputType.Touch}) do
for _, m in ipairs({Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large}) do
if not hapType and hapSvc:IsVibrationSupported(it) and hapSvc:IsMotorSupported(it, m) then hapType, hapMotor = it, m end
end
end
end)
end
if not hapType then return end
hapTok = hapTok + 1
local my = hapTok
pcall(hapSvc.SetMotor, hapSvc, hapType, hapMotor, math.clamp(power or 0.6, 0, 1))
task.delay(dur or 0.045, function()
if my == hapTok then pcall(hapSvc.SetMotor, hapSvc, hapType, hapMotor, 0) end
end)
end
FX.Click = function(kind, ...)
if kind == "click" or kind == "open" or kind == "close" or kind == "back" then FX.Haptic(0.55, 0.045) end
return playSnd(kind, ...)
end
function FX.Ring(parent, color, size, time, thick, pos)
if FX.Lite() then return end
local r = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
r.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
r.Position = pos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
r.BackgroundTransparency = 1
r.BorderSizePixel = 0
r.ZIndex = 30
r.Interactable = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", r).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local s = Util.Instance("UIStroke", r)
s.Color = color
s.Thickness = thick or 3
s.Transparency = 0.1
tween(r, time, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)})
tween(s, time, Quad, EOut, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5})
Debris:AddItem(r, time + 0.1)
return r
end
function FX.Sparks(parent, color, n, dist, time)
if FX.Lite() then return end
for _ = 1, n do
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
f.BackgroundColor3 = color
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 30
f.Interactable = false
local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
local d = dist * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.55)
tween(f, time, Quint, EOut, {
Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * d, 0.5, math.sin(a) * d),
BackgroundTransparency = 1,
Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
})
Debris:AddItem(f, time + 0.1)
end
end
local TET_E = 2
local TET_R = TET_E / math.sqrt(3)
local TET_H = TET_E * math.sqrt(2 / 3)
local TET = {
Vector3.new(0, TET_H * 0.75, 0),
Vector3.new(TET_R, -TET_H * 0.25, 0),
Vector3.new(TET_R * math.cos(math.rad(120)), -TET_H * 0.25, TET_R * math.sin(math.rad(120))),
Vector3.new(TET_R * math.cos(math.rad(240)), -TET_H * 0.25, TET_R * math.sin(math.rad(240))),
}
local TET_FACES = {{2, 3, 4}, {1, 2, 3}, {1, 3, 4}, {1, 4, 2}}
local TET_EDGES = {{1, 2}, {1, 3}, {1, 4}, {2, 3}, {3, 4}, {4, 2}}
local ACTIONS = {"SPIN", "PULSE", "FLIP", "PRISM", "BLOOM"}
local FAR = CFrame.new(0, 1e4, 0)
local function newPart(class, parent)
local p = Instance.new(class)
p.Name = Util.RandomString(12)
p.Anchored = true
p.CanCollide = false
p.CanQuery = false
p.CanTouch = false
p.CastShadow = false
p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
p.Parent = parent

end
local function rndUnit()
local v = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
if v.Magnitude < 0.05 then v = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
return v.Unit
end
local function rndOut(base)
local d = base.Magnitude > 0.01 and base.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
return (d * 1.4 + rndUnit()).Unit
end
local szCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function setSz(p, v)
local o = szCache[p]
if o then
local d = v - o
if d.X * d.X + d.Y * d.Y + d.Z * d.Z < 1e-6 then return end
end
szCache[p] = v
p.Size = v
end
local function drawTri(a, b, c, w1, w2, th)
local ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
if ac:Cross(ab).Magnitude < 1e-5 then
w1.CFrame = FAR
w2.CFrame = FAR
return
end
local abd, acd, bcd = ab:Dot(ab), ac:Dot(ac), bc:Dot(bc)
if abd > acd and abd > bcd then
c, a = a, c
elseif acd > bcd and acd > abd then
a, b = b, a
end
ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
local right = ac:Cross(ab).Unit
local up = bc:Cross(right).Unit
local back = bc.Unit
local height = math.abs(ab:Dot(up))
setSz(w1, Vector3.new(th, math.max(height, 0.001), math.max(math.abs(ab:Dot(back)), 0.001)))
w1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) / 2, right, up, back)
setSz(w2, Vector3.new(th, math.max(height, 0.001), math.max(math.abs(ac:Dot(back)), 0.001)))
w2.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((a + c) / 2, -right, up, -back)
end
do
-- ═══ UI CACHE (v292) ═══ everything the UI used to rebuild every launch / every frame is written ONCE into
-- UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/Cache UI and reused from disk (v293: own "Cache UI" folder). Graphics/ = the UI's CDN graphics, memoised asset ids, measured text sizes. Triangle3D/ = the 4 double-sided face meshes of the 3D triangle (1 part per
-- face instead of 2 wedges + per-frame wedge maths). VFX/ = ring + spark textures (1 ImageLabel instead of Frame + UICorner +
-- UIStroke). Created by the Uh Admin on start (FX.Cache.Init / Warm). Every consumer falls back to the old live-built look when the
-- executor has no file API or an asset fails to load. Turn off with Custom.UICache = false.
local Cache = {Ver = 2, Root = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/Cache UI", OldRoot = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/cache", Mem = {}, Done = {}, MeshUnit = 2, MeshBad = false,
Text = {}, TextN = 0, Graphics = {"lightinursoul.graphic.png", "letriangul.graphic.png"}}
FX.Cache = Cache
local function fsOk()
return type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"
and type(makefolder) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function" and type(getcustomasset) == "function"
end
function Cache.Enabled() return FX.Cfg.UICache ~= false and fsOk() end
function Cache.Init()
if Cache.Ready ~= nil then return Cache.Ready end
Cache.Ready = false
if not fsOk() then return false end
local ok = pcall(function()
for _, d in ipairs({"UhhhhhhReanim", "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets", Cache.Root, Cache.Root .. "/Triangle3D", Cache.Root .. "/VFX", Cache.Root .. "/Graphics"}) do
if not isfolder(d) then makefolder(d) end
end
local idx = Cache.Root .. "/cache.json"
local okR, raw = pcall(readfile, idx)
if not (okR and type(raw) == "string" and raw:find('"v":' .. Cache.Ver .. ",", 1, true)) then Cache.Fresh = true end
local want = '{"v":' .. Cache.Ver .. ',"note":"Cache UI - Triangle3D meshes + VFX textures + UI graphics, delete this folder to rebuild it"}'
local FE = Util.FastExec
if not (FE and FE.On() and okR and raw == want) then writefile(idx, want) end
pcall(function()
if type(delfolder) == "function" and isfile(Cache.OldRoot .. "/cache.json") then delfolder(Cache.OldRoot) end
end)
end)
Cache.Ready = ok
return ok
end
function Cache.File(rel, gen)
if not Cache.Init() then return nil end
local path = Cache.Root .. "/" .. rel
local ok = pcall(function()
if Cache.Done[rel] or (not Cache.Fresh and isfile(path)) then Cache.Done[rel] = true return end
writefile(path, gen())
Cache.Done[rel] = true
end)
if ok and Cache.Done[rel] then return path end
return nil
end
function Cache.Asset(rel, gen)
local m = Cache.Mem[rel]
if m ~= nil then return m or nil end
local id = false
if Cache.Enabled() then
local path = Cache.File(rel, gen)
if path then
local ok, r = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
if ok and type(r) == "string" and r ~= "" then id = r end
end
end
Cache.Mem[rel] = id
return id or nil
end
-- ---------- UI graphics: CDN pngs copied once into Cache UI/Graphics, asset id memoised (no isfile + getcustomasset per styled object) ----------
function Cache.Graphic(name)
local rel = "Graphics/" .. name
local m = Cache.Mem[rel]
if m then return m end
if not Cache.Enabled() or not Cache.Init() then return nil end
local id
pcall(function()
local src = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. name
if not isfile(src) then return end
local dst = Cache.Root .. "/" .. rel
local FE = Util.FastExec
local cdn = FE and FE.On() and FE.Save and tonumber(FE.Save.CDNVersion) or nil
if cdn and not Cache.Fresh and FE.GfxOk(name, cdn) and isfile(dst) then
local r0 = getcustomasset(dst)
if type(r0) == "string" and r0 ~= "" then id = r0 return end
end
local data = readfile(src)
if type(data) ~= "string" or data == "" then return end
local same = false
if isfile(dst) then
local okD, old = pcall(readfile, dst)
same = okD and type(old) == "string" and #old == #data
end
if not same then writefile(dst, data) end
local r = getcustomasset(dst)
if type(r) == "string" and r ~= "" then
id = r
if cdn then FE.GfxSet(name, cdn, #data) end
end
end)
if id then Cache.Mem[rel] = id end
return id
end
-- ---------- 3D triangle: one double-sided .mesh per face, vertices relative to the face centre ----------
local function meshText(i)
local idx = TET_FACES[i]
local a, b, c = TET[idx[1]], TET[idx[2]], TET[idx[3]]
local ctr = (a + b + c) / 3
local nrm = (b - a):Cross(c - a).Unit
if nrm:Dot(ctr) < 0 then nrm = -nrm end
local k = Cache.MeshUnit -- version 1.00 meshes store coordinates at 2x
local function vtx(p, n)
local d = (p - ctr) * k
return string.format("[%.5f,%.5f,%.5f][%.5f,%.5f,%.5f][0,0,0]", d.X, d.Y, d.Z, n.X, n.Y, n.Z)
end
local m = -nrm
return "version 1.00\n2\n" .. vtx(a, nrm) .. vtx(b, nrm) .. vtx(c, nrm) .. vtx(a, m) .. vtx(c, m) .. vtx(b, m) .. "\n"
end
function Cache.TriFaces()
if Cache.Faces ~= nil then return Cache.Faces or nil end
local ids = {}
for i = 1, #TET_FACES do
local id = Cache.Asset("Triangle3D/face" .. i .. ".mesh", function() return meshText(i) end)
if not id then ids = false break end
ids[i] = id
end
Cache.Faces = ids
return ids or nil
end
function Cache.VerifyMesh(sm, id)
if Cache.Verified then return end
Cache.Verified = true
task.spawn(function()
local CP = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
pcall(function() CP:PreloadAsync({sm}) end)
local ok, st = pcall(function() return CP:GetAssetFetchStatus(id) end)
if ok and st == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure then Cache.MeshBad = true end
end)
end
-- ---------- VFX textures: tiny PNGs built once with a pure-Lua encoder (stored deflate blocks) ----------
local crcT
local function be32(n)
return string.char(bit32.rshift(n, 24) % 256, bit32.rshift(n, 16) % 256, bit32.rshift(n, 8) % 256, n % 256)
end
local function crc32(s)
if not crcT then
crcT = {}
for i = 0, 255 do
local c = i
for _ = 1, 8 do
if c % 2 == 1 then c = bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(c, 1), 0xEDB88320) else c = bit32.rshift(c, 1) end
end
crcT[i] = c
end
end
local c = 0xFFFFFFFF
for i = 1, #s do c = bit32.bxor(crcT[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(c, s:byte(i)), 0xFF)], bit32.rshift(c, 8)) end
return bit32.bxor(c, 0xFFFFFFFF)
end
local function adler32(s)
local a, b = 1, 0
for i = 1, #s do a = (a + s:byte(i)) % 65521 b = (b + a) % 65521 end
return b * 65536 + a
end
local function chunk(kind, data) return be32(#data) .. kind .. data .. be32(crc32(kind .. data)) end
local function png(w, h, alphaAt)
local rows = {}
for y = 0, h - 1 do
local row = {"\0"}
for x = 0, w - 1 do
local a = math.floor(math.clamp(alphaAt(x, y), 0, 1) * 255 + 0.5)
row[#row + 1] = string.char(255, 255, 255, a)
end
rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat(row)
end
local raw = table.concat(rows)
local z, pos, n = {"\120\1"}, 1, #raw
repeat
local len = math.min(65535, n - pos + 1)
local fin = (pos + len > n) and 1 or 0
z[#z + 1] = string.char(fin, len % 256, math.floor(len / 256), (65535 - len) % 256, math.floor((65535 - len) / 256))
z[#z + 1] = raw:sub(pos, pos + len - 1)
pos = pos + len
until pos > n
z[#z + 1] = be32(adler32(raw))
return "\137PNG\r\n\26\n" .. chunk("IHDR", be32(w) .. be32(h) .. "\8\6\0\0\0") .. chunk("IDAT", table.concat(z)) .. chunk("IEND", "")
end
local VFX = {
ring = {n = 128, fn = function(x, y)
local u, v = (x + 0.5) / 64 - 1, (y + 0.5) / 64 - 1
local r = math.sqrt(u * u + v * v)
if r >= 1 then return 0 end
local core = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(r - 0.94) / 0.028, 0, 1)
local glow = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(r - 0.94) / 0.07, 0, 1)
return math.max(core, glow * glow * 0.22)
end},
spark = {n = 32, fn = function(x, y)
local u, v = (x + 0.5) / 16 - 1, (y + 0.5) / 16 - 1
return math.clamp((1 - math.sqrt(u * u + v * v)) * 1.8, 0, 1)
end},
dot = {n = 32, fn = function(x, y)
local u, v = (x + 0.5) / 16 - 1, (y + 0.5) / 16 - 1
return math.clamp((1 - math.sqrt(u * u + v * v)) * 6, 0, 1)
end},
}
function Cache.VFX(name)
local d = VFX[name]
if not d then return nil end
return Cache.Asset("VFX/" .. name .. ".png", function() return png(d.n, d.n, d.fn) end)
end
function Cache.Warm()
if Cache.Warmed or not Cache.Enabled() then return end
Cache.Warmed = true
task.spawn(function()
for _, g in ipairs(Cache.Graphics) do
pcall(Cache.Graphic, g)
task.wait()
end
pcall(Cache.TriFaces)
task.wait()
for name in pairs(VFX) do
pcall(Cache.VFX, name)
task.wait()
end
end)
end
-- ---------- UI customization snapshot: UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/UI ANIMATION CACHE/UI/customization.json ----------
-- every UI customization key (theme, colours, font, scale, particles, trail, glow, intro / triangle / notification options ...) is mirrored to disk
-- (debounced). It is only read back when the save holds NO customization at all (wiped / new save file), so it never overrides a live setting.
Cache.UIRoot = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/UI ANIMATION CACHE"
Cache.UISkip = {LowEnd = true, PerfProfile = true, FastExec = true, AutoReport = true, CModOn = true, CModSay = true, CModConf = true}
function Cache.UIPath() return Cache.UIRoot .. "/UI/customization.json" end
function Cache.UIFolders()
if not fsOk() then return false end
local ok = pcall(function()
for _, d in ipairs({"UhhhhhhReanim", "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets", Cache.UIRoot, Cache.UIRoot .. "/UI"}) do
if not isfolder(d) then makefolder(d) end
end
local meta = Cache.UIRoot .. "/cache.json"
if not isfile(meta) then
writefile(meta, '{"v":1,"note":"UI ANIMATION CACHE - delete this folder to rebuild it"}')
end
end)
return ok
end
function Cache.UILoad()
if not (Cache.Enabled() and Cache.UIFolders()) then return nil end
local out
pcall(function()
local path = Cache.UIPath()
if not isfile(path) then return end
local data = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(path))
if type(data) ~= "table" or data.v ~= 1 or type(data.cfg) ~= "table" then return end
local cfg = {}
local n = 0
for k, d in pairs(FX.CfgDefaults) do
local v = data.cfg[k]
if not Cache.UISkip[k] and type(v) == type(d) then
cfg[k] = v
n += 1
end
end
if n > 0 then out = cfg end
end)
return out
end
function Cache.UISave()
if not (Cache.Enabled() and Cache.UIFolders()) then return end
local store = FX.Store
local cfg = {}
for k, d in pairs(FX.CfgDefaults) do
if not Cache.UISkip[k] then
local v = store and store[k]
if type(v) ~= type(d) then v = d end
cfg[k] = v
end
end
pcall(function()
writefile(Cache.UIPath(), game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({v = 1, note = "UI customization snapshot (restored only when the save has no customization)", cfg = cfg}))
end)
end
function Cache.UISchedule()
if Cache.UIPending or not Cache.UIReady or not Cache.Enabled() then return end
Cache.UIPending = true
task.delay(1.5, function()
Cache.UIPending = false
pcall(Cache.UISave)
end)
end
Cache.InitOld, Cache.SetOld = FX.InitCustom, FX.SetCfg
function FX.InitCustom(SaveData)
if type(SaveData) == "table" and Cache.Enabled() and (type(SaveData.Custom) ~= "table" or next(SaveData.Custom) == nil) then
local snap = Cache.UILoad()
if snap then
SaveData.Custom = snap
SaveData.GlassSkin1 = true
end
end
Cache.InitOld(SaveData)
Cache.UIReady = true
Cache.UISchedule()
end
function FX.SetCfg(key, value)
Cache.SetOld(key, value)
if not Cache.UISkip[key] then Cache.UISchedule() end
end
-- ---------- cached VFX: Ring / Sparks use the PNG textures, old frame versions stay as fallback ----------
local ringOld, sparksOld = FX.Ring, FX.Sparks
function FX.Ring(parent, color, size, time, thick, pos)
if FX.Lite() then return end
local id = Cache.VFX("ring")
if not id then return ringOld(parent, color, size, time, thick, pos) end
local r = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", parent)
r.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
r.Position = pos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
r.BackgroundTransparency = 1
r.BorderSizePixel = 0
r.ZIndex = 30
r.Interactable = false
r.Image = id
r.ImageColor3 = color
r.ImageTransparency = 0.1
tween(r, time, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), ImageTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(r, time + 0.1)
return r
end
function FX.Sparks(parent, color, n, dist, time)
if FX.Lite() then return end
local id = Cache.VFX("spark")
if not id then return sparksOld(parent, color, n, dist, time) end
for _ = 1, n do
local f = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", parent)
f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 30
f.Interactable = false
f.Image = id
f.ImageColor3 = color
local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
local d = dist * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.55)
tween(f, time, Quint, EOut, {
Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * d, 0.5, math.sin(a) * d),
ImageTransparency = 1,
Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
})
Debris:AddItem(f, time + 0.1)
end
end
end
local Audio = {
Mode = "off", running = false, frame = 0,
energy = 0, amp = 0.25, beat = 0, kick = 0, beatN = 0, beatStr = 0,
phase = 0, cyc = 0, sway = 0, bounce = 0, hue = 0, bpm = 120,
}
FX.Audio = Audio
do
local floor, exp, max, min, sin, abs, pi = math.floor, math.exp, math.max, math.min, math.sin, math.abs, math.pi
local snd, sconns, drv = nil, {}, nil
local consumers, order = {}, {}
local peak, slow, fluxAvg, lastOnset, period, mis = 80, 0, 0.02, -1, 0.5, 0
local lastPos, lastPosAt, lastBeatI, song = 0, 0, nil, nil
local curName, curId, acc = nil, nil, 0
local SONGS = {"ThemeSong", "Intro2Song", "Intro3Song", "Intro4Song", "Intro5Song", "Intro6Song", "Intro7Song", "Intro8Song", "Intro9Song", "Intro10Song", "Intro11Song", "Intro12Song", "Intro13Song"}
local function enabled() return FX.Cfg.MusicDance ~= false end
local function findSong(name)
for i = 1, #SONGS do
local S = Util[SONGS[i]]
if type(S) == "table" and S.Title == name and S.Period and S.Offset then return S end
end
end
local function clear(hard)
if hard then peak = 80 end
slow, fluxAvg, lastOnset, period, mis = 0, 0.02, -1, 0.5, 0
lastBeatI = nil
Audio.beat, Audio.kick, Audio.beatStr, Audio.cyc, Audio.phase = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
end
local function callC(name, dt, off)
local fn = consumers[name]
if not fn then return end
local ok, err = pcall(fn, Audio, dt, off)
if not ok then
consumers[name] = nil
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] music consumer " .. name .. " disabled: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
local function stop()
if drv then drv:Disconnect() drv = nil end
local was = Audio.running
Audio.running, Audio.Mode = false, "off"
Audio.energy, Audio.beat, Audio.kick, Audio.bounce, Audio.sway, Audio.hue, Audio.amp = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.25
Audio.frame = Audio.frame + 1
if was then
for i = 1, #order do callC(order[i], 0, true) end
end
end
local function fire(str, strong, lvl)
str = min(1, str * (0.4 + 0.6 * lvl))
Audio.beat = max(Audio.beat, str)
Audio.beatStr = str
Audio.beatN = Audio.beatN + 1
if strong then Audio.kick = max(Audio.kick, str) end
end
local function onFrame(dt)
if not enabled() then stop() return end
if RawCfg.LowEnd == true then
acc = acc + dt
if acc < 1 / FX.LowEndUIFPS then return end
dt, acc = acc, 0
else
acc = 0
end
dt = min(dt, 0.1)
local now = os.clock()
local s = snd
if s and not s.Parent then s = nil snd = nil end
local playing = s ~= nil and s.IsPlaying == true
local loud = 0
if playing then
local n, id = s.Name, s.SoundId
if n ~= curName or id ~= curId then
clear(true)
curName, curId = n, id
song = findSong(n)
end
local pos = s.TimePosition
local d = pos - lastPos
if lastPosAt > 0 and (d < -0.25 or d > 1.2 + (now - lastPosAt) * 1.5) then clear(false) end
if pos ~= lastPos then lastPos, lastPosAt = pos, now end
loud = s.PlaybackLoudness
end
peak = max(60, loud, peak * exp(-dt / 8))
local lvl = min(1, loud / peak)
local e = Audio.energy
e = e + (lvl - e) * (1 - exp(-(lvl > e and 14 or 2.2) * dt))
Audio.energy, Audio.amp = e, 0.25 + 0.75 * e
Audio.beat = Audio.beat * exp(-9 * dt)
Audio.kick = Audio.kick * exp(-5 * dt)
if playing then
if song then
Audio.Mode = "grid"
local n = (lastPos + min(now - lastPosAt, 0.12) - song.Offset) / song.Period
local bi = floor(n)
Audio.cyc = (bi % 2) + (n - bi)
Audio.bpm = 60 / song.Period
if lastBeatI == nil or bi < lastBeatI or bi > lastBeatI + 2 then
lastBeatI = bi
elseif bi ~= lastBeatI then
lastBeatI = bi
local down = bi % 4 == 0
fire(down and 1 or 0.6, down, lvl)
end
else
Audio.Mode = "onset"
local flux = lvl - slow
slow = slow + (lvl - slow) * (1 - exp(-8 * dt))
if flux < 0 then flux = 0 end
fluxAvg = fluxAvg + (flux - fluxAvg) * (1 - exp(-1.2 * dt))
local thr = max(0.05, fluxAvg * 2.2)
if flux > thr and lvl > 0.08 and now - lastOnset > 0.14 then
local strong = flux > max(0.13, fluxAvg * 3.5)
fire(min(1, 0.35 + flux * 3), strong, lvl)
if lastOnset > 0 then
local ioi = now - lastOnset
while ioi < 0.3 do ioi = ioi * 2 end
while ioi > 0.9 do ioi = ioi * 0.5 end
if abs(ioi - period) < period * 0.18 then
period, mis = period + (ioi - period) * 0.12, 0
else
mis = mis + 1
if mis >= 6 then period, mis = ioi, 0 end
end
end
lastOnset = now
if strong then
local ph = Audio.cyc % 1
Audio.cyc = (Audio.cyc + ((ph < 0.5) and -ph or (1 - ph)) * 0.35) % 2
end
end
Audio.cyc = (Audio.cyc + dt / period) % 2
Audio.bpm = 60 / period
end
Audio.phase = Audio.cyc % 1
Audio.sway = sin(Audio.cyc * pi)
Audio.bounce = (1 - Audio.phase) ^ 3
else
local k = exp(-6 * dt)
Audio.sway, Audio.bounce = Audio.sway * k, Audio.bounce * k
if e < 0.01 and Audio.beat < 0.01 and Audio.kick < 0.01 then stop() return end
end
Audio.hue = Audio.hue + (Audio.sway * e - Audio.hue) * (1 - exp(-6 * dt))
Audio.frame = Audio.frame + 1
for i = 1, #order do callC(order[i], dt, false) end
end
local function start()
if drv or not snd or not enabled() then return end
clear(true)
curName, curId = nil, nil
Audio.running = true
drv = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(onFrame)
end
local function bind(s)
for _, c in ipairs(sconns) do c:Disconnect() end
table.clear(sconns)
snd = s
if not s then return end
sconns[#sconns + 1] = s.Played:Connect(start)
sconns[#sconns + 1] = s.Resumed:Connect(start)
sconns[#sconns + 1] = s.Loaded:Connect(function() if drv then clear(true) curName, curId = nil, nil end end)
sconns[#sconns + 1] = s.Destroying:Connect(function() if snd == s then bind(nil) stop() end end)
if s.IsPlaying then start() end
end
function Audio.Bind(s) if s ~= snd then bind(s) end end
function Audio.Refresh()
local s = FX.UISound and FX.UISound.Music
if s ~= snd then bind(s) end
if not enabled() then stop() elseif snd and snd.IsPlaying then start() end
end
function Audio.Add(name, fn)
if not consumers[name] then order[#order + 1] = name end
consumers[name] = fn
end
local tIn, tOut, tFrame
function Audio.Tint(c)
if not Audio.running or FX.Cfg.MusicColor == false then return c end
local e = Audio.energy
if e < 0.02 and Audio.beat < 0.02 then return c end
if tFrame == Audio.frame and tIn == c then return tOut end
local h, sa, v = c:ToHSV()
tIn, tFrame = c, Audio.frame
tOut = Color3.fromHSV((h + Audio.hue * 0.035) % 1, min(1, sa * (1 + 0.1 * e)), min(1, v * (1 + 0.04 * e + 0.08 * Audio.beat + 0.1 * Audio.kick)))
return tOut
end
end
function FX.NewTriangle3D(parent, opts)
opts = opts or {}
local CFG = FX.Cfg
local T = {
scaleBase = 1, chargeVis = 0, baseSpin = 0.9,
yaw = 0.6, pitch = 0.35, yawVel = 3,
flipBase = 0, flipAngle = 0, flipT = nil,
pulse = 0, pulseAmt = 0, prism = 0, bloomT = nil, bloomEnv = 0,
charge = 0, holdT = 0, hot = 0, holding = false, dragging = false,
phase = "idle", phaseT = 0, env = 0, extra = 0,
clickN = 0, active = true, pop = nil, popScale = 1,
pressAmt = 0, hoverAmt = 0, hover = false, trackX = 0, trackY = 0, lastLoud = 0,
color = WHITE,
dBounce = 0, dRoll = 0, dPitch = 0, dScale = 1, lastBeatN = 0,
}
local conns = {}
local layer = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
layer.AnchorPoint = opts.LayerAnchor or Vector2.zero
layer.Position = opts.LayerPos or UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
layer.Size = opts.LayerSize or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
layer.ZIndex = opts.ZIndex or 3
layer.Active = false
T.Layer = layer
local halo = {}
if opts.Halo ~= false then
for i, hd in ipairs({{0.95, 0.955}, {0.68, 0.925}, {0.44, 0.88}}) do
local fr = Util.Instance("Frame", layer)
fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
fr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
fr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hd[1], hd[1])
fr.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
fr.BackgroundTransparency = hd[2]
fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
fr.ZIndex = 0
fr.Interactable = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", fr).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local ar = Util.Instance("UIAspectRatioConstraint", fr)
ar.AspectRatio = 1
ar.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize
halo[i] = {fr = fr, k = hd[1], tr = hd[2]}
end
end
local vp = Util.Instance("ViewportFrame", layer)
vp.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 178)
vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 232)
vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.45, -0.8, -0.55)
local cam = Util.Instance("Camera", vp)
cam.FieldOfView = 35
cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 5.4)
vp.CurrentCamera = cam
local model = Util.Instance("Model", vp)
local faces, edges, nodes = {}, {}, {}
local meshIds = nil
do
local C = FX.Cache
if C and CFG.UICache ~= false and not C.MeshBad then
local okM, ids = pcall(C.TriFaces)
if okM and type(ids) == "table" then meshIds = ids end
end
end
local function toWedges(f)
if not f.mp then return end
pcall(function() f.mp:Destroy() end)
f.mp, f.sm = nil, nil
f.w1, f.w2 = newPart("WedgePart", model), newPart("WedgePart", model)
end
for i, idx in ipairs(TET_FACES) do
local a, b, c = TET[idx[1]], TET[idx[2]], TET[idx[3]]
local nrm = (b - a):Cross(c - a).Unit
if nrm:Dot((a + b + c) / 3) < 0 then nrm = -nrm end
local fc = {v = {a, b, c}, n = nrm, center = (a + b + c) / 3}
faces[i] = fc
if meshIds and meshIds[i] then
local mp = newPart("Part", model)
mp.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
sm.MeshId = meshIds[i]
sm.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
sm.Parent = mp
fc.mp, fc.sm = mp, sm
FX.Cache.VerifyMesh(sm, meshIds[i])
else
fc.w1, fc.w2 = newPart("WedgePart", model), newPart("WedgePart", model)
end
end
for i, pair in ipairs(TET_EDGES) do
local a, b = TET[pair[1]], TET[pair[2]]
local part = newPart("Part", model)
part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
edges[i] = {a = a, b = b, mid = (a + b) / 2, part = part}
end
for i = 1, 4 do
local part = newPart("Part", model)
part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
nodes[i] = {pos = TET[i], part = part}
end
local core = newPart("Part", model)
core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
core.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
local function reseed()
for _, f in ipairs(faces) do
f.dir, f.axis, f.spin = rndOut(f.center), rndUnit(), (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 7
end
for _, e in ipairs(edges) do
e.dir, e.axis, e.spin = rndOut(e.mid), rndUnit(), (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 11
end
for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
n.dir = rndOut(n.pos)
end
end
reseed()
local lowApplied = false
local function applyQuality(low)
if low == lowApplied then return end
lowApplied = low
for _, ed in ipairs(edges) do
ed.part.Parent = (not low) and model or nil
end
for _, nd in ipairs(nodes) do
nd.part.Parent = (not low) and model or nil
end
core.Parent = (not low) and model or nil
end
local RING_N = 40
local ringHost, ringSegs = nil, {}
local ringC, ringT, ringL = {}, {}, {}
local RING_LIT_SZ, RING_OFF_SZ = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2)
if opts.Ring then
ringHost = Util.Instance("Frame", layer)
ringHost.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
ringHost.Position = opts.HitPos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local rs = opts.RingSize or 190
ringHost.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rs, rs)
ringHost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ringHost.BorderSizePixel = 0
ringHost.ZIndex = 4
for i = 1, RING_N do
local a = (i - 1) / RING_N * math.pi * 2 - math.pi / 2
local s = Util.Instance("Frame", ringHost)
s.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
s.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + math.cos(a) * 0.5, 0, 0.5 + math.sin(a) * 0.5, 0)
s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2)
s.Rotation = math.deg(a)
s.BorderSizePixel = 0
s.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
s.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
s.ZIndex = 4
ringSegs[i] = s
end
end
local D = 2.3
local LIGHT = Vector3.new(-0.45, 0.8, 0.55).Unit
local lastLow = nil
local function draw(t, styleDue)
local low = CFG.LowEnd == true
applyQuality(low)
if low ~= lastLow then
lastLow = low
for _, h in ipairs(halo) do
h.fr.Visible = not low
end
end
local e = T.env + T.bloomEnv * 0.28
local ae = math.min(1, math.abs(e))
local S = math.max(0.001, T.scaleBase * T.popScale * (1 + T.pulseAmt) * (1 - 0.08 * T.pressAmt) * (1 + 0.07 * T.hoverAmt) * CFG.TriSize * T.dScale)
local bob = (low and 0 or math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.08 * (1 - ae)) + T.dBounce
local roll = (low and 0 or (0.05 * math.sin(t * 0.9) - T.trackX * 0.07)) + T.dRoll
local M = CFrame.Angles(T.pitch + T.flipAngle + T.dPitch, T.yaw, roll) + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0)
local sh = T.hot * T.hot * 0.07
if sh > 0 and not low then
M = M + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * sh * 2, (math.random() - 0.5) * sh * 2, 0)
end
local spinMul = 1 + 0.5 * T.extra
local th = (0.045 + T.hot * 0.05) * CFG.TriEdge
local base = T.color
local hue = (t * 0.8) % 1
local fadeOut = e > 0 and math.min(1, e) * 0.12 or 0
if not low and styleDue then
local glow = base:Lerp(WHITE, 0.2)
local hs = S * (1 + 0.22 * T.hot + 0.5 * math.max(0, math.min(1, e)))
for _, h in ipairs(halo) do
local sz = math.min(h.k * hs, 1.6)
if h.lsz ~= sz then h.lsz = sz h.fr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz) end
if h.lgc ~= glow then h.lgc = glow h.fr.BackgroundColor3 = glow end
local htr = math.clamp(h.tr - T.hot * 0.08 - T.hoverAmt * 0.02, 0, 1)
if h.ltr ~= htr then h.ltr = htr h.fr.BackgroundTransparency = htr end
end
end
local MRot = M - M.Position
for i, f in ipairs(faces) do
if f.mp and FX.Cache.MeshBad then toWedges(f) end
local rot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(f.axis, f.spin * e * spinMul)
local c = f.center
local off = f.dir * (D * e)
if f.mp then
f.mp.CFrame = CFrame.new(M * ((c + off) * S)) * MRot * rot
if f.ls ~= S then f.ls = S f.sm.Scale = Vector3.new(S, S, S) end
else
local p1 = M * ((c + off + rot * (f.v[1] - c)) * S)
local p2 = M * ((c + off + rot * (f.v[2] - c)) * S)
local p3 = M * ((c + off + rot * (f.v[3] - c)) * S)
drawTri(p1, p2, p3, f.w1, f.w2, 0.03)
end
if styleDue then
local nv = M:VectorToWorldSpace(rot:VectorToWorldSpace(f.n))
local lam = math.max(0, nv:Dot(LIGHT))
local rim = 1 - math.abs(nv.Z)
local col = base
if T.prism > 0 and not low then
col = Color3.fromHSV((hue + i * 0.22) % 1, 0.75, 1):Lerp(base, 1 - T.prism)
end
local k = 0.6 + 0.4 * lam
col = Color3.new(col.R * k, col.G * k, col.B * k):Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, lam * lam * 0.4 + rim * 0.05 + T.hot * 0.5))
local tr = CFG.TriFaces and math.clamp(CFG.TriFaceTr - T.hot * 0.22 + fadeOut - rim * 0.07, 0, 1) or 1
if f.mp then
f.mp.Color = col
f.mp.Transparency = tr
else
f.w1.Color, f.w2.Color = col, col
f.w1.Transparency, f.w2.Transparency = tr, tr
end
end
end
if low then return end
local zr = S * 2.4
local edgeCol = WHITE:Lerp(base, 0.3 * (1 - T.hot))
for _, ed in ipairs(edges) do
local rot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ed.axis, ed.spin * e * spinMul)
local off = ed.dir * (D * e * 1.15)
local a = M * ((ed.mid + off + rot * (ed.a - ed.mid)) * S)
local b = M * ((ed.mid + off + rot * (ed.b - ed.mid)) * S)
local len = (b - a).Magnitude
local part = ed.part
if len < 1e-3 then
part.CFrame = FAR
else
local front = math.clamp(((a.Z + b.Z) * 0.5) / zr + 0.5, 0, 1)
local w = th * (0.7 + 0.6 * front)
setSz(part, Vector3.new(len, w, w))
part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
if styleDue then
part.Color = edgeCol:Lerp(base, (1 - front) * 0.5)
part.Transparency = (1 - front) * 0.3
end
end
end
local nodeSize = 0.15 + T.hot * 0.12 + T.pulse * 0.06
for _, nd in ipairs(nodes) do
if CFG.TriNodes then
local p = M * ((nd.pos + nd.dir * (D * e * 1.3)) * S)
local front = math.clamp(p.Z / zr + 0.5, 0, 1)
local ns = nodeSize * (0.8 + 0.4 * front)
setSz(nd.part, Vector3.new(ns, ns, ns))
nd.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(p)
if styleDue then nd.part.Color = base:Lerp(WHITE, 0.45 + 0.4 * front) end
else
nd.part.CFrame = FAR
end
end
if CFG.TriFaces then
local cs = math.clamp((0.3 + 0.1 * T.pulse + 0.18 * T.hot) * S * (1 - math.min(1, e)), 0.001, 1.5)
setSz(core, Vector3.new(cs, cs, cs))
core.CFrame = CFrame.new(M.Position)
if styleDue then
core.Color = base:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, 0.55 + 0.3 * T.hot))
core.Transparency = math.clamp(0.3 - T.hot * 0.2, 0, 1)
end
else
core.CFrame = FAR
end
end
local function caption(name, n)
if opts.OnAction then opts.OnAction(name, n) end
end
function T:Bloom()
self.bloomT = 0
end
function T:PopIn()
self.pop = 0
self.popScale = 0.001
end
function T:Explode()
if self.phase ~= "idle" then return end
reseed()
self.phase, self.phaseT = "explode", 0
self.holding, self.holdT, self.charge = false, 0, 1
FX.BlurPulse(11, 0.08, 0.9)
FX.Play("boom")
FX.Ring(layer, self.color, 320, 0.8, 4)
FX.Ring(layer, WHITE, 200, 0.55, 2)
FX.Sparks(layer, self.color, 22, 150, 0.9)
caption("OVERLOAD", 0)
end
function T:Reformed()
FX.Play("reform")
FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.06, 0.5)
FX.Ring(layer, self.color, 240, 0.7, 3)
FX.Sparks(layer, WHITE, 14, 110, 0.7)
self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 9
self.pulse = 1
caption("REFORMED", 0)
end
function T:Finale()
self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 18
self.pulse = 1
FX.Ring(layer, self.color, 260, 0.7, 3)
FX.Play("reform", 1.1)
end
function T:Click()
if self.phase ~= "idle" then return end
self.clickN = (self.clickN % 5) + 1
local n = self.clickN
local c = self.color
if n == 1 then
self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 15
FX.Play("click", 1.25)
elseif n == 2 then
self.pulse = 1
FX.Ring(layer, c, 180, 0.6, 3)
FX.Play("click", 0.8)
elseif n == 3 then
self.flipT = 0
FX.Play("hit", 0.9)
elseif n == 4 then
self.prism = 1
FX.Sparks(layer, c, 16, 120, 0.8)
FX.Play("hit", 1.5)
else
self.bloomT = 0
FX.Ring(layer, WHITE, 220, 0.7, 2)
FX.Play("open", 1.2)
end
caption(ACTIONS[n], n)
end
function T:Step(dt, styleDue)
if not self.active then return end
if styleDue == nil then styleDue = true end
local t = os.clock()
if styleDue then self.color = FX.TriColor(t) end
local sd = self.sdt
if sd then sd = sd + (math.min(dt, 0.1) - sd) * 0.25 else sd = math.min(dt, 0.1) end
self.sdt = sd
local explodeHot = 0
if self.phase == "explode" then
self.phaseT = self.phaseT + dt
self.env = easeOutCubic(math.min(1, self.phaseT / 0.85))
self.extra = math.min(1, self.phaseT / 1.2)
explodeHot = math.max(0, 1 - self.phaseT / 1.0) * 0.8
if self.phaseT >= 1.15 then
self.phase, self.phaseT = "reform", 0
end
elseif self.phase == "reform" then
self.phaseT = self.phaseT + dt
local u = math.min(1, self.phaseT / 1.1)
self.env = 1 - easeOutBack(u)
self.extra = 1 - u
if u >= 1 then
self.phase, self.env, self.extra = "idle", 0, 0
self:Reformed()
end
end
if self.holding and self.phase == "idle" and CFG.TriExplode then
self.holdT = self.holdT + dt
self.charge = math.min(1, self.holdT / 5)
if self.holdT >= 5 then
self:Explode()
end
else
self.charge = math.max(0, self.charge - dt * 1.4)
end
if self.flipT then
self.flipT = self.flipT + dt / 0.75
if self.flipT >= 1 then
self.flipBase = (self.flipBase + math.pi) % (math.pi * 2)
self.flipT = nil
end
end
self.flipAngle = self.flipBase + (self.flipT and easeOutBack(self.flipT) * math.pi or 0)
self.pulse = math.max(0, self.pulse - dt * 1.8)
self.pulseAmt = 0.3 * self.pulse * math.cos((1 - self.pulse) * math.pi * 3)
self.prism = math.max(0, self.prism - dt / 2.2)
if self.bloomT then
self.bloomT = self.bloomT + dt / 0.9
if self.bloomT >= 1 then
self.bloomT, self.bloomEnv = nil, 0
else
self.bloomEnv = math.sin(self.bloomT * math.pi)
end
end
if self.pop then
self.pop = self.pop + dt / 0.8
if self.pop >= 1 then
self.pop, self.popScale = nil, 1
else
self.popScale = easeOutBack(self.pop)
end
end
local pTarget = (self.holding and self.phase == "idle") and 1 or 0
self.pressAmt = self.pressAmt + (pTarget - self.pressAmt) * (1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
self.hoverAmt = self.hoverAmt + ((self.hover and 1 or 0) - self.hoverAmt) * (1 - math.exp(-9 * dt))
local RA = FX.Audio
local danceOn = RA.running and CFG.MusicDance ~= false and opts.Dance ~= false and self.phase == "idle"
if opts.Music and CFG.TriMusic and self.phase == "idle" and not danceOn then
local pbl = opts.Music.PlaybackLoudness
if pbl - self.lastLoud > 24 then
self.pulse = math.max(self.pulse, 0.5)
end
self.lastLoud = pbl
end
if danceOn then
if RA.beatN ~= self.lastBeatN then
self.lastBeatN = RA.beatN
self.pulse = math.max(self.pulse, 0.2 + 0.4 * RA.beatStr)
self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 0.4 + 1.8 * RA.beatStr * RA.amp
end
local amp, k = RA.amp, 1 - math.exp(-16 * dt)
self.dBounce = self.dBounce + ((RA.bounce * 0.06 + RA.kick * 0.08) * amp - self.dBounce) * k
self.dRoll = self.dRoll + (RA.sway * (0.08 + 0.3 * RA.energy) - self.dRoll) * k
self.dPitch = self.dPitch + ((RA.sway * 0.06 - RA.bounce * 0.1) * amp - self.dPitch) * k
self.dScale = self.dScale + (1 + 0.1 * RA.kick + 0.05 * RA.beat + 0.03 * RA.energy - self.dScale) * k
else
local k = 1 - math.exp(-10 * dt)
self.dBounce, self.dRoll, self.dPitch = self.dBounce * (1 - k), self.dRoll * (1 - k), self.dPitch * (1 - k)
self.dScale = self.dScale + (1 - self.dScale) * k
end
self.hot = math.max(self.charge, self.chargeVis, self.pulse * 0.5, explodeHot, self.hoverAmt * 0.22)
if opts.Track and self.phase == "idle" then
local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
local ap, as = layer.AbsolutePosition, layer.AbsoluteSize
local tx = math.clamp((m.X - (ap.X + as.X * 0.5)) / 240, -1, 1)
local ty = math.clamp((m.Y - (ap.Y + as.Y * 0.5)) / 160, -1, 1)
self.trackX = self.trackX + (tx - self.trackX) * (1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
self.trackY = self.trackY + (ty - self.trackY) * (1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
end
if not self.dragging then
local spinTarget = self.baseSpin * CFG.TriSpin + self.trackX * 1.1
self.yawVel = spinTarget + (self.yawVel - spinTarget) * math.exp(-1.5 * sd)
self.yaw = self.yaw + self.yawVel * sd * (1 + self.hot * 2)
local basePitch = 0.35 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 1.2) + self.trackY * 0.45
self.pitch = self.pitch + (basePitch - self.pitch) * (1 - math.exp(-1.5 * sd))
end
local lowRing = CFG.LowEnd == true
if ringHost and ringHost.Visible == lowRing then
ringHost.Visible = not lowRing
end
if ringHost and not lowRing then
ringHost.Rotation = (t * (6 + self.hot * 40)) % 360
local lit = math.floor(self.charge * RING_N + 0.5)
if self.phase ~= "idle" then lit = RING_N end
local litCol = self.color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3 + self.hot * 0.4)
local offCol, offTr = self.color, 0.88 - self.hoverAmt * 0.3
for i = 1, RING_N do
local seg = ringSegs[i]
if i <= lit then
if ringC[i] ~= litCol then ringC[i] = litCol seg.BackgroundColor3 = litCol end
if ringT[i] ~= 0 then ringT[i] = 0 seg.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end
if ringL[i] ~= true then ringL[i] = true seg.Size = RING_LIT_SZ end
else
if ringC[i] ~= offCol then ringC[i] = offCol seg.BackgroundColor3 = offCol end
if ringT[i] ~= offTr then ringT[i] = offTr seg.BackgroundTransparency = offTr end
if ringL[i] ~= false then ringL[i] = false seg.Size = RING_OFF_SZ end
end
end
end
draw(t, styleDue)
end
if opts.Interactive then
local hit = Util.Instance("TextButton", layer)
hit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
hit.Position = opts.HitPos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
hit.Size = opts.HitSize or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hit.BorderSizePixel = 0
hit.Text = ""
hit.AutoButtonColor = false
hit.Active = true
hit.Selectable = false
hit.ZIndex = 20
T.Hit = hit
local press = {down = false, t0 = 0, disp = Vector2.zero, moved = false, input = nil}
local DEADZONE = 28
local function samePress(input)
if not press.input then return false end
if input == press.input then return true end
return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and press.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
end
local function endPress(cancel)
if not press.down then return end
press.down = false
local dur = os.clock() - press.t0
local wasHold = T.holdT
T.dragging = false
T.holding, T.holdT = false, 0
FX.TriangleDown = false
FX.TriangleLast = os.clock()
if cancel or T.phase ~= "idle" then return end
if not press.moved and dur < 0.6 then
T:Click()
elseif not press.moved and wasHold > 0.6 then
FX.Play("release", 0.8)
FX.Ring(layer, T.color, 120, 0.4, 2, opts.HitPos)
caption("HOLD LONGER", 0)
end
end
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or press.down then return end
if T.phase ~= "idle" then return end
press.down, press.t0, press.disp, press.moved, press.input = true, os.clock(), Vector2.zero, false, input
T.holding, T.holdT = true, 0
FX.TriangleDown = true
FX.TriangleLast = os.clock()
FX.Play("tick", 0.9)
end)
hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
T.hover = true
T.pulse = math.max(T.pulse, 0.3)
end)
hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
T.hover = false
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if not press.down then return end
local ty = input.UserInputType
if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
if ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= press.input then return end
local d = input.Delta
press.disp = press.disp + Vector2.new(d.X, d.Y)
if not press.moved and press.disp.Magnitude > DEADZONE then
press.moved = true
T.holding, T.holdT = false, 0
end
if press.moved and T.phase == "idle" then
T.dragging = true
T.yaw = T.yaw + d.X * 0.012
T.pitch = math.clamp(T.pitch + d.Y * 0.012, -1.3, 1.3)
T.yawVel = math.clamp(d.X * 0.6, -16, 16)
end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if press.down and samePress(input) then
endPress(false)
end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
endPress(true)
end)
end
function T:SetActive(a)
self.active = a
vp.Visible = a
if ringHost then ringHost.Visible = a end
for _, h in ipairs(halo) do
h.fr.Visible = a and CFG.LowEnd ~= true
end
if not a then
self.holding, self.holdT, self.charge = false, 0, 0
self.hover = false
end
end
function T:Destroy()
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
c:Disconnect()
end
FX.TriangleDown = false
layer:Destroy()
end
local styleAcc = 1
conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if opts.IsVisible and not opts.IsVisible() then
if T.holding then T.holding, T.holdT = false, 0 end
return
end
local styleDue = true
local dev = FX.Device
local lowE = CFG.LowEnd == true
local gs = FX.Gov.Stride
if lowE or gs > 1 or (dev and dev.Mobile and (dev.Tier or 4) <= 2) then
styleAcc = styleAcc + dt
if styleAcc < (lowE and 1 / FX.LowEndTriFPS or (gs > 1 and 1 / 15 or 1 / 24)) then
styleDue = false
else
styleAcc = 0
end
else
styleAcc = 1
end
local ok, err = pcall(T.Step, T, dt, styleDue)
if not ok then
T.active = false
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] triangle disabled: " .. tostring(err))
end
end)
return T
end
local Skin = {corners = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), lips = {}, conn = nil, round = nil, acc = 0}
local function skinTick(dt)
Skin.acc = Skin.acc + dt
if Skin.acc < ((RawCfg.LowEnd == true or Gov.Stride > 1) and 0.4 or 0.15) then return end
Skin.acc = 0
local round = FX.Cfg.UIRound
if round ~= Skin.round then
Skin.round = round
for c, d in pairs(Skin.corners) do
if c.Parent then
c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(0, round + d))
else
Skin.corners[c] = nil
end
end
end
for lip, paint in pairs(Skin.lips) do
if lip.Parent then
if lip.Visible then paint() end
else
Skin.lips[lip] = nil
end
end
end
local function skinStart()
if not Skin.conn then
Skin.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(skinTick)
end
end
function FX.RoundCorner(frame, delta)
delta = delta or 0
local c = Util.Instance("UICorner", frame)
c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound + delta))
Skin.corners[c] = delta
skinStart()
return c
end
local glassHosts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function FX.GlassOn() return FX.Cfg.LiquidGlass ~= false and not FX.Lite() end
function FX.GlassK() return math.clamp(tonumber(FX.Cfg.GlassClarity) or 0.4, 0, 1) end
function FX.ApplyGlass()
local on, k = FX.GlassOn(), FX.GlassK()
for h, fn in pairs(glassHosts) do
if h.Parent then pcall(fn, on, k) else glassHosts[h] = nil end
end
end
local glassGlow = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function FX.GlassTouch(b, input)
if not FX.GlassOn() or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
local g = glassGlow[b]
if not g or not g.host.Parent then
local host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
host.BorderSizePixel, host.ZIndex, host.ClipsDescendants, host.Interactable = 0, 0, true, false
FX.RoundCorner(host)
g = {host = host, rings = {}}
for i, d in ipairs({150, 92, 46}) do
local c = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
c.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
c.BorderSizePixel, c.Interactable = 0, false
Util.Instance("UICorner", c).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
g.rings[i] = c
end
glassGlow[b] = g
end
local mp = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
local rel = mp - g.host.AbsolutePosition
local pos = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(rel.X, 0, g.host.AbsoluteSize.X), math.clamp(rel.Y, 0, g.host.AbsoluteSize.Y))
local k = FX.GlassK()
for i, c in ipairs(g.rings) do
c.Position = pos
tween(c, 0.12, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = ({0.94, 0.91, 0.87})[i] + 0.04 * k})
end
end
function FX.GlassTouchEnd(b)
local g = glassGlow[b]
if not g then return end
for _, c in ipairs(g.rings) do tween(c, 0.45, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end
end
function FX.Bevel(b)
local host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
host.BorderSizePixel = 0
host.ZIndex = 0
host.ClipsDescendants = true
host.Interactable = false
FX.RoundCorner(host)
local gloss = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.52)
gloss.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84
gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
gloss.Interactable = false
local gg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", gloss)

local rim = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
