local rippleHosts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local btnScale = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function ripple(b, input)
local host = rippleHosts[b]
if not host or not host.Parent then
host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
host.BorderSizePixel = 0
host.ZIndex = 0
host.ClipsDescendants = true
host.Interactable = false
FX.RoundCorner(host)
rippleHosts[b] = host
end
local mp
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
mp = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
else
mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end
local rel = mp - host.AbsolutePosition
local pool = FX.RippleDots
if not pool then pool = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) FX.RippleDots = pool end
local c = pool[host]
if not c or not c.Parent then
c = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
c.BorderSizePixel = 0
c.Interactable = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", c).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
pool[host] = c
end
c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(rel.X, 0, host.AbsoluteSize.X), math.clamp(rel.Y, 0, host.AbsoluteSize.Y))
c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
c.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
c.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
local big = math.max(host.AbsoluteSize.X, 60) * 2.2
FX.mtween(c, 0.55, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(big, big), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
end
local sheenFns = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function FX.Sheen(b)
local f = sheenFns[b]
if f then f() end
end
function FX.Cascade(page, onlyVisible)
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
local n = 0
for _, d in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
if d:IsA("TextButton") and d:GetAttribute("FXB") and (not onlyVisible or Util.IsGuiVisible(d)) then
n = n + 1
if n > 14 then break end
local sc = btnScale[d]
if sc and sc.Parent then
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", 0.001, 400, 1, 0.001)
end
local tilt = (n % 2 == 0) and 2.5 or -2.5
task.delay(0.08 + 0.36 * (1 - 0.86 ^ n), function()
if sc and sc.Parent then
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", 1, 190, 0.76)
if not FX.Lite() then
d.Rotation = tilt * 0.35
FX.SpringTo(d, "Rotation", 0, 160, 0.82)
end
end
FX.Sheen(d)
end)
end
end
end
function FX.BtnAnim(b, sc, basePos, stroke, hover)
local kind = tonumber(FX.Cfg.BtnAnim) or 1
if kind <= 1 or kind > 11 or not FX.Settings.Transitions or FX.IsLowEnd() or not b.Parent then return end
local lite = FX.Lite()
local rest = hover and 1.045 or 1
local restPos = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, hover and -1.5 or 0)
local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
if kind == 2 then
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 330, 0.2, 0.84)
elseif kind == 3 then
FX.SpringTo(b, "Rotation", 0, 300, 0.14, 5.5)
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 300, 0.6, rest * 1.05)
elseif kind == 4 then
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 230, 0.42, 1.2)
FX.Ring(b, col, 74, 0.5, 2)
elseif kind == 5 then
b.Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4)
FX.mtween(b, 0.4, Back, EOut, {Position = restPos})
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 420, 0.5, rest * 0.955)
elseif kind == 6 then
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 260, 0.5, rest * 1.1)
FX.Ring(b, col, 96, 0.55, 2)
task.delay(0.09, function() if b.Parent then FX.Ring(b, col, 138, 0.6, 1.5) end end)
elseif kind == 7 then
FX.SpringTo(b, "Rotation", 0, 120, 0.82, -360)
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 200, 0.6, rest * 0.92)
elseif kind == 8 then
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 280, 0.45, rest * 0.93)
elseif kind == 9 then
if stroke then
stroke.Thickness = 4.5
FX.mtween(stroke, 0.6, Quint, EOut, {Thickness = hover and 2 or 1})
end
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 260, 0.55, rest * 1.07)
elseif kind == 10 then
b.Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
FX.mtween(b, 0.55, Back, EOut, {Position = restPos})
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 300, 0.5, rest * 0.94)
elseif kind == 11 then
if not lite then pcall(FX.Sheen, b) end
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", rest, 300, 0.55, rest * 1.05)
end
end
function FX.EnhanceButton(b)
if b:GetAttribute("FXB") then return end
b:SetAttribute("FXB", true)
local container = b.Parent
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", b)
local stroke = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local hover, down = false, false
local echo
local function echoKnock()
if echo or FX.Lite() then return end
echo = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
echo.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
echo.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, -3)
echo.BackgroundTransparency, echo.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
echo.ZIndex, echo.Interactable = b.ZIndex + 3, false
local bc = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
Util.Instance("UICorner", echo).CornerRadius = bc and bc.CornerRadius or UDim.new(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound)
local es = Util.Instance("UIStroke", echo)
es.Color, es.Thickness, es.Transparency = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE, 1.5, 0.25
end
local function echoSnap()
local e = echo
if not e then return end
echo = nil
FX.mtween(e, 0.26, FX.Expo, EOut, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)})
local es = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
if es then FX.mtween(es, 0.3, Quad, EIn, {Transparency = 1}) end
Debris:AddItem(e, 0.4)
end
if b.AnchorPoint == Vector2.zero and b.Size.X.Scale == 1 and b.Position.X.Scale == 0 then
b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
end
local basePos = b.Position
local depth = Util.Instance("UIGradient", b)
depth.Rotation = 90
depth.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205))
local lip, lipSc, lipK = nil, nil, 0.6
if container and container:IsA("GuiObject") then
lip = Util.Instance("Frame", container)
lip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
lip.Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
lip.Size = b.Size + UDim2.fromOffset(-2, 0)
lip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
lip.BorderSizePixel = 0
lip.ZIndex = b.ZIndex - 1
lip.Interactable = false
lip.Visible = b.Visible
FX.RoundCorner(lip)
lipSc = Util.Instance("UIScale", lip)
Util.LinkDestroyI2I(b, lip)
local lastC, lastK
local function paintLip()
local c = stroke and stroke.Color or WHITE
if lastC and lipK == lastK and math.abs(c.R - lastC.R) + math.abs(c.G - lastC.G) + math.abs(c.B - lastC.B) < 0.004 then return end
lastC, lastK = c, lipK
lip.BackgroundColor3 = c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), lipK)
end
paintLip()
Skin.lips[lip] = paintLip
skinStart()
sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
lipSc.Scale = sc.Scale
end)
b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Rotation"):Connect(function()
lip.Rotation = b.Rotation
end)
b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
lip.Visible = b.Visible
end)
end
local gloss, shade = FX.Bevel(b)
local rec = nil
local function getRec()
if rec and rec.host.Parent then return rec end
local host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
host.BorderSizePixel = 0
host.ZIndex = 0
host.ClipsDescendants = true
host.Interactable = false
FX.RoundCorner(host)
local streak = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
streak.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
streak.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
streak.BorderSizePixel = 0
streak.Interactable = false
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", streak)
g.Rotation = 25
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.72),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
local bar = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
bar.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 0)
bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
bar.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
bar.Interactable = false
rec = {host = host, grad = g, bar = bar}
return rec
end
local function sheen()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
local r = getRec()
r.grad.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
FX.mtween(r.grad, 0.85, Quint, EOut, {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
end
sheenFns[b] = function()
pcall(sheen)
end
btnScale[b] = sc
local function refresh(style, time)
local s, rot, lift = 1, 0, 0
if down then
s, rot, lift = 0.93, 0.5, 2.5
elseif hover then
s, rot, lift = 1.045, -0.7, -1.5
end
local fast = FX.Lite()
do local k, z = liquidParams(style) FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", s, k, z) end
do local k, z = liquidParams(style) FX.SpringTo(b, "Rotation", rot, k, z) end
FX.mtween(b, math.max(time, 0.2), Quint, EOut, {Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, lift)})
if lip then
local lp = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3 + ((hover and not down) and 1 or 0))
if fast then lip.Position = lp else FX.mtween(lip, time, style, EOut, {Position = lp}) end
lipK = down and 0.5 or (hover and 0.3 or 0.6)
lip.BackgroundColor3 = (stroke and stroke.Color or WHITE):Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), lipK)
end
local gv, sv = down and 0.93 or (hover and 0.72 or 0.84), down and 0.6 or 0.78
if fast then
gloss.BackgroundTransparency = gv
if shade then shade.BackgroundTransparency = sv end
else
FX.mtween(gloss, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = gv})
if shade then FX.mtween(shade, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = sv}) end
end
end
b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
hover = true
refresh(Back, 0.24)
if stroke then FX.mtween(stroke, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 2}) end
if not FX.Lite() then
local r = getRec()
r.bar.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
FX.mtween(r.bar, 0.28, Back, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -8)})
sheen()
end
FX.Play("tick")
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
if RawCfg.LowEnd == true and not hover and not down then return end
hover, down = false, false
echoSnap()
refresh(Back, 0.32)
if stroke then FX.mtween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 1}) end
if rec then FX.mtween(rec.bar, 0.18, Quad, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 0)}) end
end)
b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
down = true
FX.Click("click", 1.1, 0.75)
refresh(Quad, 0.07)
echoKnock()
ripple(b, input)
pcall(FX.GlassTouch, b, input)
FX.Ring(b, FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE, 52, 0.35, 2)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not FX.Lite() then sheen() end
end)
b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not down then return end
down = false
pcall(FX.GlassTouchEnd, b)
echoSnap()
refresh(FX.Lite() and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, FX.Lite() and 0.1 or 0.55)
FX.Click("release")
FX.BtnAnim(b, sc, basePos, stroke, hover)
end)
b.MouseMoved:Connect(function(x)
if FX.Cfg.BtnAnim ~= 8 or down or not hover or not FX.Settings.Transitions or FX.IsLowEnd() then return end
local w = b.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.5
if w <= 0 then return end
FX.NoMB = true
FX.SpringTo(b, "Rotation", math.clamp((x - (b.AbsolutePosition.X + w)) / w, -1, 1) * 2.4, 170, 0.8)
FX.NoMB = nil
end)
end
function FX.EnhancePop(obj)
if not obj or obj:GetAttribute("FXPop") then return end
obj:SetAttribute("FXPop", true)
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", obj)
local hov, dn, foc = false, false, false
local function settle(style, time)
local k, z = liquidParams(style)
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", dn and 0.965 or ((hov or foc) and 1.03 or 1), k, z)
end
obj.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
hov = true
settle(Back, 0.22)
end)
obj.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
hov, dn = false, false
settle(Back, 0.3)
end)
obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
dn = true
settle(Quad, 0.07)
end)
obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not dn then return end
dn = false
settle(FX.Lite() and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, FX.Lite() and 0.1 or 0.5)
end)
if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
obj.Focused:Connect(function()
foc = true
settle(Back, 0.25)
end)
obj.FocusLost:Connect(function()
foc = false
settle(Back, 0.3)
end)
end
end
function FX.EnhanceSwitch(hit, sw, dot, lever)
if sw:GetAttribute("FXS") then return end
sw:SetAttribute("FXS", true)
sw.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 25)
if sw.AnchorPoint == Vector2.new(1, 0.5) then
sw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
sw.Position = UDim2.new(sw.Position.X.Scale, math.floor(sw.Position.X.Offset - sw.Size.X.Offset / 2), sw.Position.Y.Scale, sw.Position.Y.Offset)
end
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", sw)
local dsc = Util.Instance("UIScale", dot)
sw.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local BW, BH, PAD = 30, 21, 2
local xOff, xOn = PAD + BW / 2, 50 - PAD - BW / 2
local OFFC, ONC = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44), Color3.fromRGB(94, 94, 100)
local C5 = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
local glass = FX.GlassOn
local function pill()
for _, c in ipairs(sw:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("UICorner") and c.CornerRadius ~= UDim.new(0.5, 0) then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) end
end
end
pill()
for _, c in ipairs(sw:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("UICorner") then c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CornerRadius"):Connect(pill) end
end
local function layer(parent, z, ap, pos, size, col, tr, round)
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
f.AnchorPoint, f.Position, f.Size = ap, pos, size
f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency = col, tr
f.BorderSizePixel, f.ZIndex, f.Interactable = 0, z, false
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
return f
end
local function fade(f, a, b)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = 90
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(a, b)
end
local fill = layer(sw, 0, Vector2.zero, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), lever.Value and ONC or OFFC, 0.08, 0.5)
local fg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", fill)
fg.Rotation = 90
fg.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
fade(layer(fill, 1, Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 1), UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.42, 0), WHITE, 0.9, 0.5), 0, 1)
dot.AnchorPoint = C5
dot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local dc = dot:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
if dc then dc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) end
local shd, halo
if not FX.Lite() then
shd = layer(dot, 1, C5, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 2), UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, 0), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.72, 0.5)
halo = layer(dot, 1, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8), WHITE, 0.93, 0.5)
end
local body = layer(dot, 2, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 0.02, 0.44)
local bg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", body)
bg.Rotation = 90
bg.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(240, 241, 244)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(206, 209, 215))})
local rim = Util.Instance("UIStroke", body)
rim.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
rim.Color, rim.Thickness, rim.Transparency = WHITE, 1, 0.5
local rg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", rim)
rg.Rotation = 60
rg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2)})
local bevel = layer(body, 3, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4), WHITE, 1, 0.5)
local bst = Util.Instance("UIStroke", bevel)
bst.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
bst.Color, bst.Thickness, bst.Transparency = WHITE, 1, 1
local bgr = Util.Instance("UIGradient", bst)
bgr.Rotation = 235
bgr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1)})
local streak = layer(body, 3, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.16, 0.7), WHITE, 1, 0.5)
streak.Rotation = 18
local stg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", streak)
stg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
fade(layer(body, 3, Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 1), UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.4, 0), WHITE, 0, 0.5), 0.1, 1)
fade(layer(body, 3, Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1), UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.3, 0), WHITE, 0, 0.5), 1, 0.45)
local pv = Util.Instance("NumberValue", sw)
local gv = Util.Instance("NumberValue", sw)
local function apply()
local p, L, gl = pv.Value, gv.Value, glass()
local s = math.clamp(4 * p * (1 - p), 0, 1)
local w, h = BW + 7 * s + 6 * L, BH - 2 * s + 3 * L
local lo, hi = PAD + w / 2, 50 - PAD - w / 2
dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, lo + (hi - lo) * p, 0.5, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = OFFC:Lerp(ONC, math.clamp(p, 0, 1))
local ck = FX.GlassK()
body.BackgroundTransparency = 0.02 + (0.45 + 0.4 * (1 - ck)) * L
rim.Transparency = 0.5 - 0.35 * L
if shd then shd.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72 + 0.18 * L end
if halo then halo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 - 0.07 * L end
bst.Transparency = gl and 0.7 - 0.45 * L or 1
streak.BackgroundTransparency = gl and 0.84 - 0.3 * L or 1
streak.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.68 - 0.36 * math.clamp(p, 0, 1), 0.5)
end
pv.Changed:Connect(apply)
gv.Changed:Connect(apply)
glassHosts[sw] = apply
pv.Value = lever.Value and 1 or 0
apply()
dot.Visible = true
dot:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if not dot.Visible then dot.Visible = true end
end)
lever.Changed:Connect(function()
local on = lever.Value
FX.SpringTo(pv, "Value", on and 1 or 0, 210, 0.58)
if on and FX.Settings.Transitions then FX.Play("tick", 1.3) end
end)
local hov, dn, held = false, false, false
local function squish(style, time)
local k, z = liquidParams(style)
local down, gl = dn or held, glass()
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", down and 0.97 or (hov and 1.04 or 1), k, z)
FX.SpringTo(dsc, "Scale", down and not gl and 1.14 or 1, k, z)
FX.NoMB = true
FX.SpringTo(gv, "Value", down and gl and 1 or 0, 360, 0.7)
FX.NoMB = nil
end
hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
hov = true
squish(Back, 0.22)
end)
hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
if not hov and not dn then return end
hov, dn = false, false
squish(Back, 0.3)
end)
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
dn = true
squish(Quad, 0.07)
end)
hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not dn then return end
dn = false
squish(FX.Lite() and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, FX.Lite() and 0.1 or 0.5)
end)
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) then return end
FX.Haptic(0.55, 0.045)
held = true
local x0, p0, moving, c1, c2 = input.Position.X, pv.Value, false, nil, nil
local side = p0 > 0.5
local travel = math.max(1, (50 - 2 * PAD - BW - (glass() and 6 or 0)) * sw.AbsoluteSize.X / 50)
c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if i ~= input and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
if not moving then
if math.abs(i.Position.X - x0) < 4 then return end
moving = true
sw:SetAttribute("FXDrag", true)
end
local np = math.clamp(p0 + (i.Position.X - x0) / travel, -0.06, 1.06)
if (np > 0.5) ~= side then side = np > 0.5 FX.Haptic(0.4, 0.03) end
FX.NoMB = true
FX.SpringTo(pv, "Value", np, 900, 1)
FX.NoMB = nil
end)
c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i ~= input and not (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType == input.UserInputType) then return end
c1:Disconnect()
c2:Disconnect()
dn, held = false, false
squish(Back, 0.3)
if not moving then return end
local on = pv.Value > 0.5
if lever.Value ~= on then lever.Value = on else FX.SpringTo(pv, "Value", on and 1 or 0, 210, 0.58) end
task.delay(0.25, function() sw:SetAttribute("FXDrag", nil) end)
end)
end)
end
function FX.EnhanceKnob(track, knob)
if knob:GetAttribute("FXK") then return end
knob:SetAttribute("FXK", true)
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", knob)
local bead = Util.Instance("UIGradient", knob)
bead.Rotation = 90
bead.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(195, 195, 195))
local glint = Util.Instance("Frame", knob)
glint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
glint.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.3)
glint.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.24)
glint.Rotation = -25
glint.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
glint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
glint.BorderSizePixel = 0
glint.Interactable = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", glint).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local halo, hsc
local hp = knob.Parent
if hp and hp:IsA("GuiObject") then
halo = Util.Instance("Frame", hp)
halo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
halo.Position = knob.Position
halo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34)
halo.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
halo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
halo.BorderSizePixel, halo.Interactable = 0, false
halo.ZIndex = math.max(0, knob.ZIndex - 1)
Util.Instance("UICorner", halo).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
hsc = Util.Instance("UIScale", halo)
hsc.Scale = 0.4
knob:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function() halo.Position = knob.Position end)
knob.Destroying:Once(function() halo:Destroy() end)
end
local gv = Util.Instance("NumberValue", knob)
local edge = Util.Instance("Frame", knob)
edge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
edge.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
edge.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4)
edge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
edge.BorderSizePixel, edge.Interactable = 0, false
Util.Instance("UICorner", edge).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local es = Util.Instance("UIStroke", edge)
es.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
es.Color, es.Thickness, es.Transparency = WHITE, 1, 1
local eg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", es)
eg.Rotation = 235
eg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1)})
local function lens()
local L, on, ck = gv.Value, FX.GlassOn(), FX.GlassK()
local c = on and (1 - 0.55 * ck) or 0
knob.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + (on and (0.25 + 0.3 * (1 - ck)) * L or 0)
knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18 + (on and 10 * L or 0), 18)
es.Transparency = 1 - (0.35 + 0.5 * L) * c
end
gv.Changed:Connect(lens)
glassHosts[knob] = lens
lens()
local hov, dn = false, false
local function grow(style, time)
local k, z = liquidParams(style)
FX.NoMB = true
FX.SpringTo(gv, "Value", dn and FX.GlassOn() and 1 or 0, 360, 0.7)
FX.NoMB = nil
FX.SpringTo(sc, "Scale", dn and 1.28 or (hov and 1.14 or 1), k, z)
if halo and not FX.Lite() then
halo.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
FX.SpringTo(hsc, "Scale", dn and 1 or (hov and 0.72 or 0.4), 240, 0.7)
tween(halo, 0.25, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = dn and 0.78 or (hov and 0.88 or 1)})
end
end
track.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
hov = true
grow(Back, 0.2)
end)
track.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
if not hov then return end
hov = false
if not dn then grow(Back, 0.25) end
end)
track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
dn = true
grow(Back, 0.15)
end)
local conn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if not dn or not isPress(input) then return end
dn = false
grow(FX.Lite() and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, FX.Lite() and 0.1 or 0.5)
end)
knob.Destroying:Once(function()
conn:Disconnect()
end)
end
function FX.EnhanceField(box, tb)
if box:GetAttribute("FXF") then return end
box:SetAttribute("FXF", true)
local stroke = box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local gloss = FX.Bevel(box)
gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
local line = Util.Instance("Frame", box)
line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
line.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1)
line.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
line.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
line.BorderSizePixel, line.Interactable = 0, false
line.ZIndex = box.ZIndex + 2
Util.Instance("UICorner", line).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
tb.Focused:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
line.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
tween(line, 0.42, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 2)})
if stroke then FX.mtween(stroke, 0.3, Quint, EOut, {Thickness = math.max(2, FX.Cfg.UIBorder + 1)}) end
FX.mtween(gloss, 0.3, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.8})
end)
tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
tween(line, 0.3, Quint, EIn, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)})
if stroke then FX.mtween(stroke, 0.36, Quint, EOut, {Thickness = FX.Cfg.UIBorder}) end
FX.mtween(gloss, 0.36, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.92})
end)
end
function FX.EnhanceItem(item)
if item:GetAttribute("FXI") then return end
item:SetAttribute("FXI", true)
local hl = Util.Instance("Frame", item)
hl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
hl.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hl.BorderSizePixel = 0
hl.Interactable = false
local bar = Util.Instance("Frame", item)
bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0.5, 0)
bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0)
bar.BorderSizePixel, bar.Interactable = 0, false
Util.Instance("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local hover = false
item.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
hover = true
bar.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
tween(bar, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.62, 0)})
FX.mtween(hl, 0.22, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.87})
FX.Play("tick", 1.2)
end)
item.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
hover = false
tween(bar, 0.2, Quad, EIn, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0)})
FX.mtween(hl, 0.34, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
end)
item.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
FX.mtween(hl, 0.06, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.78})
end)
item.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) then return end
FX.mtween(hl, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = hover and 0.88 or 1})
end)
local list = item.Parent
if list then
list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if not list.Visible then
hover = false
hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0)
elseif FX.Settings.Transitions and not FX.Lite() then
task.delay(math.min(item.LayoutOrder, 12) * 0.028, function()
if list.Visible and not hover then
hl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
tween(hl, 0.5, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
end
end)
end
end)
end
end
function FX.EnhanceLite(b)
if b:GetAttribute("FXL") then return end
b:SetAttribute("FXL", true)
local depth = Util.Instance("UIGradient", b)
depth.Rotation = 90
depth.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205))
local gloss, shade = FX.Bevel(b)
local basePos = b.Position
local hover, down = false, false
local function refresh(style, time)
local rot, lift = 0, 0
if down then
rot, lift = 0.4, 1.5
elseif hover then
rot, lift = -0.7, -1
end
do local k, z = liquidParams(style) FX.SpringTo(b, "Rotation", rot, k, z) end
FX.mtween(b, math.max(time, 0.2), Quint, EOut, {Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, lift)})
FX.mtween(gloss, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = down and 0.93 or (hover and 0.72 or 0.84)})
if shade then FX.mtween(shade, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = down and 0.6 or 0.78}) end
end
b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
hover = true
refresh(Back, 0.22)
FX.Play("tick", 1.1)
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
if not hover and not down then return end
hover, down = false, false
refresh(Back, 0.3)
end)
b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
down = true
FX.Click("click", 1.1, 0.75)
refresh(Quad, 0.07)
end)
b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if not isPress(input) or not down then return end
down = false
refresh(FX.Lite() and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, FX.Lite() and 0.1 or 0.5)
end)
end
local CENTER = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
local PageStyle = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local Rigs = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local Active = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local styleCount = 0
local veil, veilToken = nil, 0
local function assignStyle(page, forced)
if forced then
PageStyle[page] = forced
return forced
end
PageStyle[page] = 16
return 16
end
local function getRig(page)
local r = Rigs[page]
if r and r.scale.Parent then return r end
r = {scale = Util.Instance("UIScale", page)}
r.scale.Scale = 1
Rigs[page] = r
return r
end
local function resetVeilGeometry()
if not veil then return end
veil.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
veil.Position = CENTER
veil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
end
local function getVeil()
if not veil or not veil.Parent then
veil = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
veil.BackgroundTransparency = 1
veil.BorderSizePixel = 0
veil.ZIndex = 100
veil.Interactable = false
veil.Active = false
FX.VeilInstance = veil
resetVeilGeometry()
end
veil.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetBG and FX.GetBG() or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
return veil
end

local function bgColor()
return FX.GetBG and FX.GetBG() or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
local function accentColor()
return FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
end
local function dropCells(cells)
for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
tween(c, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(c, 0.3)
end
end
local function makeGrid(cols, rows, startTransparency)
local cells = {}
local bg = bgColor()
for y = 0, rows - 1 do
for x = 0, cols - 1 do
local c = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
c.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x / cols, y / rows)
c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / cols + 0.003, 1 / rows + 0.003)
c.BackgroundColor3 = bg
c.BackgroundTransparency = startTransparency
c.BorderSizePixel = 0
c.ZIndex = 100
c.Interactable = false
cells[#cells + 1] = c
Debris:AddItem(c, 2)
end
end
return cells
end
Styles[7] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
local N = 8
local full = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 / N + 0.004, 0)
local none = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
local slats = {}
local bg = bgColor()
for i = 1, N do
local s = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
s.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, (i - 1) / N)
s.Size = entering and full or none
s.BackgroundColor3 = bg
s.BackgroundTransparency = 0
s.BorderSizePixel = 0
s.ZIndex = 100
s.Interactable = false
slats[i] = s
Debris:AddItem(s, 2)
end
if entering then
page.Position = goal
for i, s in ipairs(slats) do
task.delay((i - 1) * 0.04, function()
tween(s, 0.3, Quad, EOut, {Size = none})
end)
end
task.wait(0.3 + N * 0.04)
else
for i, s in ipairs(slats) do
task.delay((i - 1) * 0.03, function()
tween(s, 0.22, Quad, EIn, {Size = full})
end)
end
task.wait(0.22 + N * 0.03)
if not R.alive() then
dropCells(slats)
return
end
page.Position = goal
dropCells(slats)
task.wait(0.15)
end
end

local cycleN, cycleAt = 0, -1
local function pickStyle(page)
local st = PageStyle[page] or assignStyle(page)
if st ~= 16 then return st end
local sel = tonumber(FX.Cfg.PageTrans) or 1
if sel >= 2 and sel <= 11 then return 15 + sel end
if sel == 12 then
local now = os.clock()
if now - cycleAt > 0.3 then cycleN = cycleN % 10 + 1 end
cycleAt = now
return 16 + cycleN
end
return 16
end
local function pageTween(page, props)
local goal = props.Position
local entering = goal.X.Offset == 0 and goal.Y.Offset == 0
local styleId = pickStyle(page)
local handle = {PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Begin}
local done = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
handle.Completed = done.Event
local started, cancelled = false, false
local function run()
local token = (Active[page] or 0) + 1
Active[page] = token
local rig = getRig(page)
local R = {scale = rig.scale, veil = getVeil()}
R.alive = function()
return Active[page] == token and not cancelled
end
veilToken = veilToken + 1
local myVeil = veilToken
resetVeilGeometry()
R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FX.BlurPulse((entering and 5 or 4) * (FX.Lite() and 0.5 or 1), 0.18, 0.82, true)
FX.Play(entering and "open" or "back")
if entering then pcall(FX.Cascade, page) end
local ok, err = pcall(Styles[styleId] or Styles[1], page, entering, goal, R)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] transition error: " .. tostring(err)) end
if not R.alive() then return false end
page.Position = goal
page.Rotation = 0
R.scale.Scale = 1
task.delay(0.3, function()
if veilToken == myVeil then
resetVeilGeometry()
end
end)
return true
end
function handle:Play()
if started then return end
started = true
self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
task.defer(function()
local completed = run()
if completed and not cancelled then
self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
done:Fire(Enum.PlaybackState.Completed)
end
end)
end
function handle:Cancel()
cancelled = true
self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled
end
function handle:Pause() end
function handle:Destroy()
cancelled = true
end
return handle
end
local Proxy = setmetatable({}, {
__index = function(_, k)
local v = RealTweenService[k]
if type(v) == "function" then
return function(_, ...)
return v(RealTweenService, ...)
end
end
return v
end,
})
function Proxy.Create(_, obj, info, props)
if props and typeof(obj) == "Instance" then
if FX.Settings.Transitions and FX.Content and props.Position and next(props, (next(props))) == nil
and obj.Parent == FX.Content and obj ~= FX.VeilInstance then
return pageTween(obj, props)
end
if obj == FX.Window then
FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.15, 0.85, true)
local small = props.Size and props.Size.X.Offset < 200
FX.Play(small and "close" or "open")
elseif FX.Window and typeof(info) == "TweenInfo" and info.RepeatCount == 0 and info.Time >= 0.15 and not FX.IntroActive
and obj:IsDescendantOf(FX.Window) then
if props.Position or props.Size or props.Rotation or props.Scale or props.CanvasPosition then
FX.MotionBlur(1.2 + math.min(info.Time, 1) * 2, info.Time)
elseif info.Time >= 0.2 and (props.BackgroundTransparency or props.TextTransparency or props.ImageTransparency or props.GroupTransparency or props.Transparency) then
FX.MotionBlur(0.9, info.Time)
end
end
end
return RealTweenService:Create(obj, info, props)
end
TweenService = Proxy

if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function accent(speed)
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return Util.DiscoColor(os.clock() * (speed or 0.12) * 4)
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {

BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextColor3 = WHITE,
TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "",
TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function spaced(s)
return (s:gsub("(.)", "%1 "):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
local ch = s:sub(i, i)
if ch == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function loudness()
local ok, v = pcall(function()
return Music.PlaybackLoudness
end)
if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
return 0
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
if ok and type(s) == "string" then return s end
return ""
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end

local worldZoom = Util.Instance("UIScale", world)
local cam = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1, r = 0}
local punch, rollKick, flashK = 0, 0, 0
local X = {
seed = 13.37 + math.random() * 50, cut = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, r = 0}, prev = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1, r = 0}, cutHit = false,
sp = 0, sd = 1, vk = 0, ready = false, crash = 0, crashR = 0, crashAt = -10, dd = 0, bx = 0, by = 0, sdd = 0, sbx = 0, sby = 0, pdd = 0, pbx = 0, pby = 0, hitch = 0, hitchAt = 10, leak = 0, leakAt = 8.2, leakDir = 1, leakRot = 0, lastW = 0,
}
local XI = math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1.5)
X.n = function(a, b) return math.noise(a, X.seed + b, 0.31) * 2 end
X.follow = function(st, target, w, z, dt)
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
X.spring = function(x, y, z, r, dd, bx, by, dt, scene)
local S = X.spr
if not S then
S = {{x, 0}, {y, 0}, {z, 0}, {r, 0}, {dd, 0}, {bx, 0}, {by, 0}}
X.spr = S
end
local m, k = scene == 5 and 1.3 or 1, math.min(1, XI)
return lerp(x, X.follow(S[1], x, 15 * m, 0.58, dt), k), lerp(y, X.follow(S[2], y, 15 * m, 0.58, dt), k),
lerp(z, X.follow(S[3], z, 10 * m, 0.62, dt), k), lerp(r, X.follow(S[4], r, 11 * m, 0.42, dt), k),
lerp(dd, X.follow(S[5], dd, 9 * m, 0.7, dt), k),
lerp(bx, X.follow(S[6], bx, 8 * m, 0.66, dt), k), lerp(by, X.follow(S[7], by, 8 * m, 0.66, dt), k)
end
X.ramp = function(u)
if u < 0.28 then
local a = u / 0.28
return 0.06 * a * a
end
return 0.06 + 0.94 * (1 - (1 - (u - 0.28) / 0.72) ^ 5)
end
X.hsk = {0.5, 0.85, 1.15, 1.0, 1.9, 1.4}
X.plane = function(f, sc, d, ox, oy, dz, fx, fy)
local k = 1 / d - 1
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox * k + (fx or 0), 0.5, oy * k + (fy or 0))
sc.Scale = math.clamp(d / math.max(0.22, 1 + dz * (d - 1)), 0.4, 2.4)

local flash = mk("Frame", stage, {
Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false,
})
local pulse, beatN, lastBeat, avgL, lastLoudAt = 0, 0, -1, 40, 0
local shake, glitch = 0, 0
local invert, edgeFlash = 0, 0
local lastScene = 0
local grid, lastGrid = nil, -1
local fxTokens = 3
local function spend(n)
if INTENSITY <= 0 or fxTokens < n then return false end
fxTokens = fxTokens - n
return true
end
local function jolt(k)
shake = math.max(shake, 5 + 9 * k)
punch = math.max(punch, 0.02 + 0.03 * k)
rollKick = rollKick + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.8 + 1.6 * k)
X.spawn(k)
end
local function impact(k, col)
jolt(k)
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.12 + 0.2 * k)
glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.4 + 0.3 * k)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(world, col, 300 + 220 * k, 0.6, 2 + k) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(world, col, math.floor(6 + 6 * k), 130 + 90 * k, 0.6) end
end
local function beatNow(t, strength, bp)
beatN = beatN + 1
lastBeat = t
pulse = 1
local bpos = bp or (beatN % 4)
edgeFlash = math.max(edgeFlash, 0.4 + 0.45 * (strength or 1))
if bpos == 0 then invert = 1 end
tri.pulse = math.max(tri.pulse or 0, 0.55)
if t < 1.5 then return end
if grid and (bpos == 1 or bpos == 3) and lastScene >= 2 then
punch = math.max(punch, bpos == 1 and 0.03 or 0.02)
edgeFlash = math.max(edgeFlash, 0.9)
end
if lastScene == 5 then
jolt(bpos == 0 and 1 or 0.35)
glitch = math.max(glitch, bpos == 0 and 0.6 or 0.3)
elseif bpos == 0 and lastScene >= 2 then
local k = (beatN // 4) % 4
if k == 0 then
impact(0.7, accent())
elseif k == 1 then
jolt(0.8)
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.16)
elseif k == 2 then
glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.7)
jolt(0.4)
elseif spend(1) then
FX.Sparks(world, accent(), 8, 150, 0.7)
end
end
if XI > 0 and bpos == 0 and lastScene >= 3 and t - X.crashAt > 2.2 and math.random() < (lastScene == 5 and 0.55 or 0.4) then
X.crashAt = t
X.crash = (lastScene == 5 and 0.17 or 0.1) + 0.07 * math.random()
X.crashR = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (2 + 3 * math.random())
end
end
local function pollBeat(dt, t)
if grid then
if t >= grid.Offset then
local n = math.floor((t - grid.Offset) / grid.Period)
if n ~= lastGrid then
lastGrid = n
local bp = n % 4
beatNow(t, (bp == 0 and 1.5) or (bp == 1 and 1.2) or (bp == 3 and 1.0) or 0.6, bp)
end
end
return
end
local l = loudness()
if l > 1 then lastLoudAt = t end
avgL = avgL + (l - avgL) * math.min(1, dt * 2.5)
if t - lastLoudAt < 1.5 and l > 1 then
if l > math.max(avgL * 1.28, 45) and t - lastBeat > 0.2 then
beatNow(t, math.min(1.5, l / math.max(avgL, 1) - 0.6))
end
elseif t > 1.5 and t - lastBeat > 0.469 then
beatNow(t, 0.8)
end
end

local sy = sw.Y

lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
end
local function placeBig(cyScale, hPx, wScale)
box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * cyScale)
box.Size = UDim2.new(wScale or 0.92, 0, 0, hPx)
end
local function bigAlpha(a, extra)
lblM.TextTransparency = a
lblR.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 0.35 + a * 0.65 + (extra or 0))
lblB.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 0.35 + a * 0.65 + (extra or 0))
end
local function chroma(off)
off = off + X.vk
local ly = X.n(os.clock() * 0.9, 11) * 3.5 * XI
lblR.Position, lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -off, 0.5, ly), UDim2.new(0.5, off, 0.5, -ly)
lblR.Rotation, lblB.Rotation = ly * 0.12, -ly * 0.12
end
local function layoutTri(k)
pcall(function()
local L = tri.Layer
local sm = sy * 0.4
L.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sw.X, sm, k), lerp(sw.Y, sm, k))
L.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -cam.x * 0.18, lerp(0.5, 0.27, k), -cam.y * 0.18)
end)
end
local function hideCardStuff()
plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
roleL.TextTransparency = 1
detL.TextTransparency = 1
ul.Visible = false
end
local function hideRows()
for _, r in ipairs(E.rows) do
r.role.TextTransparency = 1
r.name.TextTransparency = 1
end
hdr.TextTransparency = 1
end
local function showCard(card, lt, len, col)
local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.3))
local ex = clamp01((lt - (len - 0.2)) / 0.2)
local a = math.max(1 - e, ex)
local bigH = math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 92)
local cy = sy * 0.66
placeBig(0.66, bigH, 0.94)
box.Visible = true
local s = scr(card.name, lt / 0.35)
setBig(s)
bigAlpha(a)
chroma((1 - e) * 16 + pulse * 5 + (math.random() < 0.05 and 7 or 0))
boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.7 + pulse * 0.04 + ex * 0.35
plate.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy)
plate.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bigH * 1.55)
plate.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(0.45, a)
roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy - bigH * 0.5 - 16)
roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 20))
roleL.Text = spaced(scr(card.role, lt / 0.3))
roleL.TextColor3 = col
roleL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01(lt / 0.2), ex)
detL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy + bigH * 0.5 + 18)
detL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 17))
detL.Text = scr(card.detail, (lt - 0.25) / 0.5)
detL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 225)
detL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01((lt - 0.2) / 0.25), ex)
ul.Visible = true
ul.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy + bigH * 0.8)
ul.Size = UDim2.new(0.5 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.5)) * (1 - ex), 0, 0, 2)
ul.BackgroundColor3 = col
end
local function showPage(page, lt, len, col)
local ex = clamp01((lt - (len - 0.25)) / 0.25)
local rowH = math.clamp(sy * 0.075, 17, 34)
local step = rowH * 1.3
local y0 = sy * 0.52 + 22
hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.52)
hdr.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
hdr.Text = spaced("THE CREW")
hdr.TextColor3 = col
hdr.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01(lt / 0.25), ex)
for i, r in ipairs(E.rows) do
local data = page[i]
if data then
local st = 0.12 + (i - 1) * 0.33
local k = clamp01((lt - st) / 0.3)
local e = easeOutCubic(k)
local a = math.max(1 - e, ex)
local y = y0 + (i - 1) * step
local slide = (1 - e) * sw.X * 0.25
r.role.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -10 - slide, 0, y)
r.name.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 10 + slide, 0, y)
r.role.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, rowH * 0.8)
r.name.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, rowH)
r.role.Text = scr(data[1], k)
r.name.Text = scr(data[2], k)
r.name.TextColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or col
r.role.TextTransparency = math.min(1, a + 0.1 * (1 - e))
r.name.TextTransparency = a
else
r.role.TextTransparency = 1
r.name.TextTransparency = 1
end
end
end
local function shot(kind, u, dir)
u = clamp01(u)
local e = easeInOut(u)
local k = math.clamp(sy / 450, 0.55, 1.6)
if kind == "push" then return 0, 0, 1 + 0.16 * e, dir * 1.5 * e
elseif kind == "pull" then return 0, 0, 1.2 - 0.2 * e, dir * 2 * (1 - e)
elseif kind == "sweep" then return dir * (-1 + 2 * e) * 110 * k, 0, 1.08, dir * (1 - 2 * e) * 4
elseif kind == "track" then return dir * (1 - 2 * u) * 90 * k, 0, 1.06, dir * 3
elseif kind == "crane" then return 0, dir * (1 - 2 * e) * 70 * k, 1.1, dir * 2
elseif kind == "dutch" then return dir * -24 * u * k, 0, 1.06 + 0.1 * e, dir * (10 + 3 * u)
elseif kind == "orbit" then
local a = dir * (-1 + 2 * e)
X.bx = math.sin(a) * 170 * k
return math.sin(a) * 45 * k, (1 - math.cos(a)) * -40 * k, 1.1 + 0.06 * e, -a * 7
elseif kind == "whip" then
local w = 1 - easeOutCubic(math.min(1, u * 1.6))
return dir * 420 * w * k, 0, 1 + 0.1 * w, dir * 6 * w
elseif kind == "arc" then
local r = X.ramp(u)
local a = dir * (-1 + 2 * r)
X.bx, X.by = a * 210 * k, math.sin(a * 1.6) * 40 * k
return 0, 0, 1.06 + 0.1 * r, -a * 6
elseif kind == "vertigo" then
local r = X.ramp(u)
X.dd, X.bx = 0.6 * r, dir * 40 * k * r
return 0, 0, 1.03 + 0.04 * r, dir * 2.5 * r
elseif kind == "jaws" then
local r = X.ramp(u)
X.dd = -0.4 * r
return 0, 0, 1.04 + 0.04 * r, dir * -2 * r
elseif kind == "rise" then
local r = X.ramp(u)
X.by = -140 * k * r
return 0, -(1 - r) * 70 * k, 1.22 - 0.16 * r, dir * 3 * (1 - r)
elseif kind == "slam" then
local w = 1 - easeOutCubic(math.min(1, u * 1.8))
X.dd = 0.5 * w
return dir * 40 * w * k, 0, 1.08 + 0.4 * w, dir * 7 * w
end
return 0, 0, 1, 0
end
local CARD_SHOTS = {"arc", "vertigo", "whip", "rise", "slam", "jaws", "dutch"}
local CUTS = {
{0, 0, 1.0, 0}, {-70, 18, 1.28, -9}, {85, -26, 1.38, 7}, {10, -44, 1.62, -3}, {-95, 36, 1.18, 12}, {40, 12, 1.7, 5},
}

{barT(19) + BAR / 2, barT(20), 0.3},
}

local function songClock()
local t = os.clock() - began
if grid then
local ok, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if ok and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
began = os.clock() - pos
else
began = began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - began
end
end
return t
end
local function run()
do
local w0 = os.clock()
local lim = opts.ReadyWait or 3.2
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not skipped do
local prog = Util.ThemeSong and Util.ThemeSong.Progress
term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.045), 11, 20)
term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.22)
term.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, sy * 0.5)
term.TextColor3 = accent()
term.TextTransparency = 0.3
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
term.Text = ""
began = os.clock()
wall0 = began
if opts.Theme then
local okT, th = pcall(opts.Theme)
if okT and type(th) == "table" and th.Period and th.Offset then grid = th end
end
end
while true do
local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local t = songClock()
fxTokens = math.min(3, fxTokens + dt * 2.5)
if skipped and tEnd == DUR then
tEnd = t + 0.35
flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= tEnd or t > DUR + 8 or os.clock() - wall0 > DUR + 10 then break end
sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
sy = sw.Y
local col = accent()
local maxR = math.sqrt(sw.X * sw.X + sw.Y * sw.Y) * 0.5
pollBeat(dt, t)
while grid and phraseN < #PHRASES and t >= PHRASES[phraseN + 1][1] do
phraseN = phraseN + 1
if t - PHRASES[phraseN][1] < 0.4 then
local k = PHRASES[phraseN][2]
impact(k, col)
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.2 + 0.12 * k)
shake = math.max(shake, 10 + 8 * k)
FX.Ring(world, WHITE, 520 + 120 * k, 0.8, 3 + k)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6 + 3 * k, 0.05, 0.45)
itick(1.25, 0.7)
end
end
pulse = math.max(0, pulse - dt * 7)
invert = math.max(0, invert - dt * 9)
glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 3)
edgeFlash = math.max(0, edgeFlash - dt * 3.2)
do
local hk = 0
for _, h in ipairs(HOLDS) do
if t >= h[1] and t < h[2] then
hk = math.max(hk, h[3] * math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1) * easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - h[1]) / 0.06)))
end
end
if hk > 0 then
holdPeak = math.max(holdPeak, hk)
elseif holdK > 0.1 then
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.3 * holdPeak)
punch = math.max(punch, 0.07 * holdPeak)
holdPeak = 0
else
holdPeak = 0
end
holdK = hk
end
local scene = (t < T1 and 1) or (t < T2 and 2) or (t < T3 and 3) or (t < T4 and 4) or (t < T5 and 5) or 6
if scene ~= lastScene then
lastScene = scene
if scene >= 2 then
X.cutHit = scene ~= 4
shake = math.max(shake, 14)
glitch = 1
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.22)
FX.Ring(world, col, 620, 0.8, 4)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.06, 0.5)
end
if scene ~= 3 then hideCardStuff() end
if scene ~= 4 then hideRows() end
if scene == 5 then tri.yawVel = 22 end
end
if scene == 5 and invert > 0.5 then
stage.BackgroundColor3 = col
else
stage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
local warp = ({0.4, 1.6, 1.0, 0.8, 5.5, 3.0})[scene] + pulse * 2.2 + X.sp * 3
for _, s in ipairs(E.stars) do
s.r = s.r + s.v * dt * (0.5 + warp)
if s.r > 1.05 then
s.r = math.random() * 0.05
s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
end
local d = s.r * maxR

s.f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)

s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, s.r * 3) * (scene == 1 and 0.3 or 0.75)
s.f.BackgroundColor3 = (s.i % 5 == 0) and col or WHITE
end
for _, m in ipairs(E.motes) do

m.y = (m.y + m.vy * dt) % 1

end

if t < REVEAL then

for i, line in ipairs(termLines) do

term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.045), 11, 20)

placeBig(0.78, math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90), 0.94)

roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 20))

bar = 0.1, bm = "thump", tb = 0.06, sig = "bolt", pk = "ember", pn = 20, psz = {8, 22}, pdx = 0.01, pdy = -0.07, wob = 1,
sway = 0.8, drift = 1, dutch = 2.6, punch = 0.08, fire = {{1, 0.8}, {4, 1}, {5, 1}, {6, 0.8}},
caps = function(d, K) return {{0.8, "I / THE DOOR"}, {d[1], "II / THE WALK"}, {d[2], "III / HEARTBEAT"}, {d[3], "IV / THE CREEP"},
{d[4], "V / THRILLER", "THRILLER"}, {d[5], "VI / NIGHT FEVER", "NIGHT FEVER"}, {d[6], "VII / THE ECLIPSE", "ECLIPSE"}, {d[7], "VIII / THE HOUR"}} end},
[7] = {name = "PERFECT FACE", a = C(255, 214, 120), b = C(255, 140, 200), l1 = C(255, 120, 170), l2 = C(255, 200, 90),
bar = 0.065, bm = "drift", tb = 0, sig = "burst", pk = "spark", pn = 24, psz = {8, 24}, pdx = 0.02, pdy = -0.03, wob = 1,

{d[4], "V / FLEX"}, {d[5], "VI / BREATHE"}, {d[6], "VII / ENCORE", "ENCORE"}} end},
