function FX.IntroUpgrade(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local P = FX.IUProfiles[id]
local INT = math.clamp(tonumber(K and K.INT) or 1, 0, 1.5)
if not P or INT <= 0.01 or not stage or type(d) ~= "table" then return nil end
local WHITE, BLACK, V2 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector2.new
local C0 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local INT1 = math.min(INT, 1)
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function ease(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function envl(a, atk, rel)
if a < 0 then return 0 end
if a < atk then return a / atk end
return math.exp(-(a - atk) / rel)
end
local function mk(cl, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(cl, parent)
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
return o
end
local function F(parent, z, ap, pos, size, col, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {AnchorPoint = ap, Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = tr, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
end
local function grad(f, rot, pts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
local ks = {}
for i, p in ipairs(pts) do ks[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], p[2]) end
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(ks)
return g
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function vis(a, life) return 1 - clamp01(a * INT * (life or 1)) end
local root = F(stage, zb or 24, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BLACK, 1)
local lk1 = F(root, 1, V2(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(-0.12, -0.12), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), P.l1, 0.9)
grad(lk1, 45, {{0, 0}, {0.55, 0.55}, {1, 1}})
local lk2 = F(root, 1, V2(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(1.12, 1.12), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), P.l2, 0.9)
grad(lk2, 225, {{0, 0}, {0.55, 0.55}, {1, 1}})
local vg = {}
vg[1] = F(root, 2, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28), BLACK, 0.8) grad(vg[1], 90, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
vg[2] = F(root, 2, V2(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28), BLACK, 0.8) grad(vg[2], 270, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
vg[3] = F(root, 2, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 1), BLACK, 0.8) grad(vg[3], 0, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
vg[4] = F(root, 2, V2(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 1), BLACK, 0.8) grad(vg[4], 180, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
local fr1 = F(root, 3, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 1), P.b, 0.9) grad(fr1, 0, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
local fr2 = F(root, 3, V2(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 1), P.a, 0.9) grad(fr2, 180, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
local st1 = F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), C0, UDim2.new(1.4, 0, 0, 2), P.a, 0.9) grad(st1, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
local st2 = F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), C0, UDim2.new(1.1, 0, 0, 10), P.b, 0.9) grad(st2, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
local parts = {}
for i = 1, math.floor(P.pn * INT1 + 0.5) do
local z = 0.3 + 0.7 * math.random()
local s = lerp(P.psz[1], P.psz[2], math.random()) * (0.45 + 0.55 * z)
local w, h, rot = s, s, 0
if P.pk == "drop" then w, h = math.max(2, s * 0.1), s * 1.8
elseif P.pk == "spark" then w, h, rot = s * 0.55, s * 0.55, 45
elseif P.pk == "ember" then w, h = s * 0.28, s * 0.28 end
local f = F(root, 1 + i % 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), (i % 2 == 0) and P.a or P.b, 1)
f.Rotation = rot
if P.pk == "drop" then Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
elseif P.pk ~= "spark" then round(f) end
parts[i] = {f = f, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), z = z, ph = math.random() * 6.283, w = 0.8 + math.random() * 2.2, rot = rot}
end
local bt = F(root, 6, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), BLACK, 0)
local bb = F(root, 6, V2(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), BLACK, 0)
local ht = F(bt, 1, V2(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), P.a, 0.5) grad(ht, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
local hb = F(bb, 1, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), P.a, 0.5) grad(hb, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
local lbl = mk("TextLabel", root, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = V2(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.035, 0, 1, -10), Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18),
Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = P.a, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Interactable = false})
local tag = mk("TextLabel", root, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = V2(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.965, 0, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18),
Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = P.b, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 9, Interactable = false,
Text = string.format("SCENE %02d  //  %s", id - 1, P.name)})
local kick = mk("TextLabel", root, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.8), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.07),
Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = P.a, TextStrokeColor3 = P.b, TextStrokeTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Interactable = false})
Util.Instance("UITextSizeConstraint", kick).MaxTextSize = 44
local ksc = Util.Instance("UIScale", kick)
local CAPS, FT = {}, {}
for _, c in ipairs(P.caps(d, K)) do if type(c[1]) == "number" then CAPS[#CAPS + 1] = c end end
table.sort(CAPS, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
for _, f in ipairs(P.fire) do if type(d[f[1]]) == "number" then FT[#FT + 1] = {d[f[1]], f[2]} end end
table.sort(FT, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
local GL = "#%&$@*+=<>/|01XZ"
local function scramble(s, k)
local n, o = #s, {}
for i = 1, n do
local c = s:sub(i, i)
if c == " " or i / n <= k then o[i] = c else local r = math.random(1, #GL) o[i] = GL:sub(r, r) end
end
return table.concat(o)
end
local act = {}
local function addRing(t0, col, aspect, dur, mx, th)
local f = round(F(root, 7, V2(0.5, 0.5), C0, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), col, 1))
local s = Util.Instance("UIStroke", f)
s.Color, s.Thickness, s.Transparency = col, th, 1
act[#act + 1] = {t0 = t0, dur = dur, o = {f}, upd = function(k, a, life)
local sz = mx * ease(k)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz * aspect)
s.Transparency = vis(0.9 * (1 - k) ^ 1.4, life)
s.Thickness = math.max(0.5, th * (1 - 0.7 * k))
end}
end
local function addRays(t0, n, dur, H, spin)
local o = {}
for i = 1, n do
local f = F(root, 7, V2(0.5, 0.5), C0, UDim2.fromOffset(4, H * 1.9), (i % 2 == 0) and P.a or P.b, 1)
grad(f, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
o[i] = f
end
act[#act + 1] = {t0 = t0, dur = dur, o = o, upd = function(k, a, life)
for i, f in ipairs(o) do
f.Rotation = (i - 1) * (180 / n) + a * spin
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, 5 * (1 - k) + 1), H * (1.2 + 0.9 * ease(k)))
f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.8 * (1 - k) ^ 1.2, life)
end
end}
end
local function addSlices(t0, dur, str)
local o = {}
for i = 1, 7 do o[i] = F(root, 7, V2(0.5, 0.5), C0, UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 0.03), WHITE, 1) end
local nextR = 0
act[#act + 1] = {t0 = t0, dur = dur, o = o, upd = function(k, a, life)
if a >= nextR then
nextR = a + 0.045
for i, f in ipairs(o) do
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18 * str, math.random())
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 0.012 + math.random() * 0.06)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 3 == 0) and WHITE or ((i % 3 == 1) and P.a or P.b)
end
end
for _, f in ipairs(o) do f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(((math.random() < 0.7) and 0.55 or 0) * (1 - k), life) end
end}
end
local function addBolt(t0, W, H, str)
local o, segs = {}, {}
local x, y, N = 0.22 + 0.56 * math.random(), 0, 7
for i = 1, N do
local nx, ny = math.clamp(x + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.24, 0.04, 0.96), i / N
local dx, dy = (nx - x) * W, (ny - y) * H
local len, ang = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
local pos = UDim2.fromScale((x + nx) / 2, (y + ny) / 2)
local g = F(root, 7, V2(0.5, 0.5), pos, UDim2.fromOffset(len + 8, 12), P.lc or P.a, 1) g.Rotation = ang
local c = F(root, 8, V2(0.5, 0.5), pos, UDim2.fromOffset(len + 4, 3), WHITE, 1) c.Rotation = ang
o[#o + 1], o[#o + 2] = g, c
segs[#segs + 1] = {g, c}
x, y = nx, ny
end
local tint = F(root, 6, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), P.lc or P.a, 1)
o[#o + 1] = tint
act[#act + 1] = {t0 = t0, dur = 0.55, o = o, upd = function(k, a, life)
local f = (a < 0.07 and 1) or (a < 0.12 and 0.12) or (a < 0.2 and 0.95) or (a < 0.27 and 0.2) or (a < 0.34 and 0.6) or math.max(0, 1 - (a - 0.34) / 0.2) * 0.4
for _, s in ipairs(segs) do
s[1].BackgroundTransparency, s[2].BackgroundTransparency = vis(f * 0.6, life), vis(f, life)
end
tint.BackgroundTransparency = vis(f * 0.2 * str, life)
end}
end
local lastT, lastStr, sgn, nf = -10, 0, 1, 1
local function fire(T, str, W, H)
lastT, lastStr, sgn = T, str, -sgn
local big, sk = math.max(W, H), 0.7 + 0.3 * str
if P.sig == "rings" then
for i = 0, 2 do addRing(T + i * 0.09, i == 1 and P.b or P.a, 1, 0.9 + 0.1 * i, big * (0.7 + 0.25 * i) * sk, 3 - i * 0.6) end
elseif P.sig == "ellipse" then
for i = 0, 2 do addRing(T + i * 0.12, i == 1 and P.b or P.a, 0.36, 1.1 + 0.12 * i, big * (0.8 + 0.3 * i) * sk, 3) end
elseif P.sig == "eye" then
addRing(T, P.a, 0.34, 0.8, big * 0.95 * sk, 4)
addRing(T + 0.08, P.b, 0.22, 0.9, big * 0.75 * sk, 2)
addRing(T + 0.02, P.a, 1, 0.7, big * 0.55 * sk, 2)
elseif P.sig == "glitch" then
addSlices(T, 0.42, str)
addRing(T, P.a, 1, 0.55, big * 0.8 * sk, 3)
elseif P.sig == "bolt" then
addBolt(T, W, H, str)
addRing(T + 0.02, P.a, 1, 0.8, big * 0.7 * sk, 3)
else
addRays(T, 9, 0.85, H, 38)
addRing(T, P.a, 1, 0.8, big * 0.8 * sk, 3)
addRing(T + 0.1, P.b, 1, 0.9, big * 0.55 * sk, 2)
end
pcall(FX.Sparks, stage, (math.random() < 0.5) and P.a or P.b, math.floor(14 * str), 300, 0.8)
end
local cam, capI, capT, kT = {}, 0, -10, -10
local function camBase(key, cur, tol)
if cam[key] == nil or math.abs(cur - cam[key]) > tol then cam[key .. "b"] = cur end
return cam[key .. "b"]
end
local function step(t, dt, S)
dt = math.min(dt or 0.016, 0.1)
local te = (S and S.tEnd) or K.DUR
local life = 1 - clamp01((t - (te - 0.9)) / 0.7)
local W, H = stage.AbsoluteSize.X, stage.AbsoluteSize.Y
if W < 10 then W, H = 1280, 720 end
while FT[nf] and t >= FT[nf][1] do
if t - FT[nf][1] < 0.7 then fire(FT[nf][1], FT[nf][2], W, H) end
nf = nf + 1
end
local age = t - lastT
local pe, ge = envl(age, 0.045, 0.32) * lastStr, envl(age, 0.02, 0.25) * lastStr
local tens = 0
if FT[nf] then
local dn = FT[nf][1] - t
if dn > 0 and dn < K.BAR then tens = (1 - dn / K.BAR) ^ 2 * FT[nf][2] end
end
local pulse = math.min((S and S.pulse) or 0, 1.2)
local open = ease((t - 0.15) / (K.BEAT * 3)) * (1 - clamp01((t - (te - 1.5)) / 1.0))
local bh = P.bar + P.tb * tens
if P.bm == "glitch" then bh = bh + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.012 * ge
elseif P.bm == "wave" then bh = bh + math.sin(t * 1.1) * 0.006
elseif P.bm == "thump" then bh = bh + 0.014 * pulse end
bh = math.max(0, bh * (1 - 0.55 * pe)) * open
bt.Size, bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, bh), UDim2.fromScale(1, bh)
local hv = (open > 0.03) and vis(0.25 + 0.5 * pulse + 0.5 * pe + 0.3 * tens, life) or 1
ht.BackgroundTransparency, hb.BackgroundTransparency = hv, hv
local sa = 0.1 + 0.35 * pulse + 0.85 * pe + 0.45 * tens
st1.BackgroundTransparency, st2.BackgroundTransparency = vis(sa, life), vis(sa * 0.5, life)
st1.Size = UDim2.new(1.2 + 0.5 * pe, 0, 0, 2 + 2 * pe)
st2.Size = UDim2.new(1.1 + 0.4 * pe, 0, 0, 8 + 14 * pe)
local la = 0.1 + 0.22 * pulse + 0.45 * pe + 0.18 * tens
lk1.BackgroundTransparency, lk2.BackgroundTransparency = vis(la, life), vis(la * 0.9, life)
lk1.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.12 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 0.3), -0.12 + 0.04 * math.cos(t * 0.27))
lk2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.12 + 0.05 * math.cos(t * 0.26), 1.12 + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 0.31))
local vv = vis(0.3 + 0.38 * tens - 0.15 * pe, life)
for i = 1, 4 do vg[i].BackgroundTransparency = vv end
local fa = 0.1 + 0.55 * pe + 0.18 * pulse + ((P.bm == "glitch") and 0.4 * ge or 0)
fr1.BackgroundTransparency, fr2.BackgroundTransparency = vis(fa, life), vis(fa, life)
local sp = 1 + 1.4 * pulse + 3 * pe
for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
p.x = p.x + (P.pdx + P.wob * math.sin(t * 0.6 + p.ph) * 0.012) * p.z * sp * dt
p.y = p.y + P.pdy * p.z * sp * dt
if p.y < -0.06 then p.y, p.x = 1.06, math.random() elseif p.y > 1.06 then p.y, p.x = -0.06, math.random() end
if p.x < -0.06 then p.x = 1.06 elseif p.x > 1.06 then p.x = -0.06 end
p.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(p.x, p.y)
p.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis((0.12 + 0.38 * p.z) * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * p.w + p.ph)) * (1 + 0.8 * pe + 0.3 * pulse), life)
if p.rot ~= 0 then p.f.Rotation = p.rot + t * 40 * p.z end
end
for i = #act, 1, -1 do
local e = act[i]
local a = t - e.t0
if a >= e.dur then
for _, o in ipairs(e.o) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
table.remove(act, i)
elseif a >= 0 then
e.upd(a / e.dur, a, life)
end
end
local ci = 0
for i, c in ipairs(CAPS) do if t >= c[1] then ci = i else break end end
if ci ~= capI then
capI, capT = ci, t
if ci > 0 and CAPS[ci][3] then
kT = t
kick.Text = (CAPS[ci][3]:gsub(".", function(c) return c == " " and "   " or c .. " " end))
end
end
local barPx = bh * H
local lv = clamp01((barPx - 6) / 22) * life
if capI > 0 then lbl.Text = "// " .. scramble(CAPS[capI][2], clamp01((t - capT) / 0.5)) end
lbl.Position, tag.Position = UDim2.new(0.035, 0, 1, -barPx * 0.5), UDim2.new(0.965, 0, 0, barPx * 0.5)
lbl.TextTransparency, tag.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01(lv * 0.9 * INT1), 1 - clamp01(lv * 0.6 * INT1)
local ka = t - kT
if ka >= 0 and ka < 1.1 then
local k = ka / 1.1
ksc.Scale = lerp(1.35, 1, ease(k * 1.6))
local a = 0.85 * (1 - k) ^ 1.3
kick.TextTransparency, kick.TextStrokeTransparency = vis(a, life), vis(a * 0.7, life)
elseif kick.TextTransparency < 1 then
kick.TextTransparency, kick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1, 1
end
local wd, zo = E and E.world, E and (E.zoom or E.zs)
if wd and zo then
local dz = (P.punch * pe + 0.011 * pulse + 0.035 * tens) * INT1 * life
local dr = (P.dutch * pe * sgn + math.sin(t * 0.37) * 0.32 * P.sway) * INT1 * life
local dx = (math.sin(t * 0.53) * 5 * P.drift + ((P.bm == "glitch") and (math.random() - 0.5) * 14 * ge or 0)) * INT1 * life
local dy = (math.cos(t * 0.41) * 4 * P.drift + 12 * pe) * INT1 * life
local bz = camBase("z", zo.Scale, 1e-4)
local nz = bz * (1 + dz)
zo.Scale = nz cam.z = zo.Scale
local br = camBase("r", wd.Rotation, 1e-3)
wd.Rotation = br + dr cam.r = wd.Rotation
local pos = wd.Position
local bx, by = camBase("x", pos.X.Offset, 0.6), camBase("y", pos.Y.Offset, 0.6)
local ox, oy = math.floor(bx + dx + 0.5), math.floor(by + dy + 0.5)
wd.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, ox, pos.Y.Scale, oy)
cam.x, cam.y = ox, oy
end
end
local alive = true
return function(t, dt, S)
if not alive then return end
local ok, err = pcall(step, t, dt, S)
if not ok then
alive = false
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro upgrade layer error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
end
end
end
FX.IntroRemasterSrc = [==[
local Util, FX = ...
local V2 = Vector2.new
local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function ease(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function back(x) x = clamp01(x) local c = 1.70158 return 1 + (c + 1) * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c * (x - 1) ^ 2 end
local function envl(a, atk, rel)
	if a < 0 then return 0 end
	if a < atk then return a / atk end
	return math.exp(-(a - atk) / rel)
end
local function parse(s)
	local o = {}
	if type(s) == "string" then
		for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
	end
	return o
end
local function windows(s)
	local o = {}
	for a, b in tostring(s or ""):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
	return o
end
local function lvAt(str, t)
	if type(str) ~= "string" or t < 0 then return 0 end
	local x = t * 10
	local i = math.floor(x)
	local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
	local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
	return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end
local function mk(cl, parent, props)
	local o = Util.Instance(cl, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	return o
end
local function F(parent, z, ap, pos, size, col, tr)
	return mk("Frame", parent, {AnchorPoint = ap, Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = tr, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
end
local function TX(parent, z, ap, pos, size, text, col, font, ts)
	return mk("TextLabel", parent, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = ap, Position = pos, Size = size, Font = font or Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = ts or 14,
		TextColor3 = col, Text = text, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
end
local function grad(f, rot, pts)
	local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
	g.Rotation = rot
	local ks = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(pts) do ks[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], p[2]) end
	g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(ks)
	return g
end
local function round(f, r)
	Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 1, 0)
	return f
end
local function stroke(f, col, th)
	local s = Util.Instance("UIStroke", f)
	s.Color, s.Thickness, s.Transparency = col, th, 1
	return s
end

local RIG = {}

-- ═══ 2 MOONLIGHT : the sky writes a constellation to the hats / soft notes, meteors streak on the riff stabs, the silent cuts become an eclipse corona ═══
RIG[2] = function(R)
	local root, D = R.root, R.D
	local A, B = C(176, 200, 255), C(196, 164, 255)
	local NS = 16
	local stars = {}
	for i = 1, NS do
		local g = round(F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), WHITE, 1))
		local h = F(g, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(26, 2), A, 1)
		local v = F(g, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 26), A, 1)
		local ln = F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1), B, 1)
		g.Visible, ln.Visible = false, false
		stars[i] = {g = g, h = h, v = v, ln = ln, seq = 0, born = -99, x = 0.5, y = 0.4, x0 = 0.5, y0 = 0.4, s = 1}
	end
	local seq, ang, lx, ly = 0, math.random() * 6.28, 0.5, 0.4
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.tw)) do
		R.on(e[1], function(t, s)
			seq = seq + 1
			local o = stars[(seq - 1) % NS + 1]
			local x0, y0 = lx, ly
			if seq == 1 then x0, y0 = 0.2 + 0.6 * math.random(), 0.2 + 0.3 * math.random() end
			ang = ang + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4
			local len = 0.07 + 0.08 * math.random()
			local x, y = x0 + math.cos(ang) * len * R.H / R.W, y0 + math.sin(ang) * len
			if x < 0.06 or x > 0.94 or y < 0.15 or y > 0.7 then
				ang = ang + math.pi * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.random())
				x, y = x0 + math.cos(ang) * len * R.H / R.W, y0 + math.sin(ang) * len
			end
			x, y = math.clamp(x, 0.05, 0.95), math.clamp(y, 0.14, 0.72)
			o.seq, o.born, o.x, o.y, o.x0, o.y0, o.s = seq, t, x, y, x0, y0, s
			lx, ly = x, y
		end, e[2])
	end
	local met, mi = {}, 0
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local f = F(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(170, 2), WHITE, 1)
		grad(f, 0, {{0, 1}, {1, 0}})
		f.Visible = false
		met[i] = {f = f, t0 = -99, x = 0, y = 0, dx = 1, dy = 1}
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.acc)) do
		if e[2] >= 2 then
			R.on(e[1], function(t)
				mi = mi % 3 + 1
				local m = met[mi]
				m.t0, m.x, m.y = t, 0.1 + 0.8 * math.random(), 0.04 + 0.3 * math.random()
				m.dx, m.dy = ((math.random() < 0.5) and 1 or -1) * (0.3 + 0.2 * math.random()), 0.22 + 0.14 * math.random()
			end)
		end
	end
	local wins = windows(D.cut)
	local cor = round(F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
	local cs = stroke(cor, A, 3)
	local rb = round(F(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
	local rs = stroke(rb, WHITE, 4)
	local rays = {}
	for i = 1, 20 do
		rays[i] = F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(30, 2), (i % 2 == 0) and A or B, 1)
		rays[i].Visible = false
	end
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, U, vis = R.W, R.H, R.U, R.vis
		local e, rbk = 0, 0
		for _, w in ipairs(wins) do
			if t >= w[1] and t < w[2] then e = math.max(e, ease((t - w[1]) / 0.35)) end
			local a = t - w[2]
			if a >= 0 and a < 0.8 then rbk = math.max(rbk, 1 - a / 0.8) end
		end
		local cd = U * (0.36 + 0.015 * math.sin(t * 3))
		cor.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cd, cd)
		cs.Transparency = vis(0.85 * e)
		cs.Thickness = 2 + 3 * e
		for i, f in ipairs(rays) do
			local th = (i / #rays) * 6.2832 + t * 0.15
			local ln = U * (0.04 + 0.05 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2.1 + i * 1.7))) * (0.3 + e)
			local r = cd * 0.5 + ln * 0.5 + 4
			f.Visible = e > 0.02
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ln, 2)
			f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * 0.5 + math.cos(th) * r, H * 0.5 + math.sin(th) * r)
			f.Rotation = math.deg(th)
			f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.7 * e * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 5 + i)))
		end
		local bd = U * (0.36 + 1.1 * (1 - rbk))
		rb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bd, bd)
		rs.Transparency = vis(0.9 * rbk)
		rs.Thickness = 1 + 7 * rbk
		local dim = 1 - 0.75 * e
		local d1 = R.drop(1)
		local fl = d1 and envl(t - d1, 0.02, 0.7) or 0
		for _, o in ipairs(stars) do
			if o.seq > 0 then
				local base = clamp01(1 - (seq - o.seq) / NS)
				local fa = envl(t - o.born, 0.03, 0.5) * (0.5 + 0.25 * o.s)
				local br = (base * (0.4 + 0.4 * fl) + fa) * dim
				if br < 0.02 then
					o.g.Visible, o.ln.Visible = false, false
				else
					o.g.Visible, o.ln.Visible = true, true
					local sz = 3 + 4 * fa
					o.g.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(o.x * W, o.y * H)
					o.g.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
					o.g.BackgroundTransparency = vis(br)
					o.h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12 + 34 * fa + 8 * fl, 2)
					o.v.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 12 + 34 * fa + 8 * fl)
					o.h.BackgroundTransparency, o.v.BackgroundTransparency = vis(br * 0.8), vis(br * 0.8)
					local dx, dy = (o.x - o.x0) * W, (o.y - o.y0) * H
					local len, gk = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), ease((t - o.born) / 0.25)
					o.ln.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len * gk, 1)
					o.ln.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(o.x0 * W + dx * gk * 0.5, o.y0 * H + dy * gk * 0.5)
					o.ln.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
					o.ln.BackgroundTransparency = vis(br * 0.6)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, m in ipairs(met) do
			local a = (t - m.t0) / 0.6
			if a >= 0 and a < 1 then
				m.f.Visible = true
				m.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((m.x + m.dx * a) * W, (m.y + m.dy * a) * H)
				m.f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(m.dy * H, m.dx * W))
				m.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.9 * math.sin(a * math.pi))
			else
				m.f.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- ═══ 3 JEALOUSY : a surveillance reticle that snaps onto a new target at every vocal phrase (green -> crimson at the possession drop), REC timecode, scan band, whispered words ═══
RIG[3] = function(R)
	local root, D, K = R.root, R.D, R.K
	local G, RD = C(70, 255, 150), C(255, 54, 96)
	local ret = F(root, 5, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(120, 120), WHITE, 1)
	local parts = {}
	for _, c in ipairs({{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = F(ret, 1, V2(c[1], c[2]), UDim2.fromScale(c[1], c[2]), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.04), G, 1)
		parts[#parts + 1] = F(ret, 1, V2(c[1], c[2]), UDim2.fromScale(c[1], c[2]), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.3), G, 1)
	end
	parts[#parts + 1] = F(ret, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.02), G, 1)
	parts[#parts + 1] = F(ret, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.14), G, 1)
	local lab = TX(root, 5, V2(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(260, 18), "", G, Enum.Font.Code, 14)
	lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local ring = round(F(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
	local rst = stroke(ring, G, 2)
	local scan = F(root, 2, V2(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.05), G, 1)
	grad(scan, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
	local dot = round(F(root, 5, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.045, 0.133), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), RD, 1))
	local rec = TX(root, 5, V2(0, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.055, 0.133), UDim2.fromOffset(300, 18), "", RD, Enum.Font.Code, 14)
	rec.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local words = {"MINE", "WHY HER?", "WATCHING", "ENVY", "LOOK AT ME", "STAY", "HER", "NOT ME", "SMILE", "MINE."}
	local wp = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local a1 = TX(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(500, 90), "", G, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 44)
		local a2 = TX(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(500, 90), "", RD, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 44)
		wp[i] = {a = a1, b = a2, t0 = -99, x = 0.5, y = 0.5, rot = 0}
	end
	local tx, ty, px, py, lockT, nLock, wi = 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -99, 0, 0
	local function newTarget(t)
		tx, ty = 0.22 + 0.56 * math.random(), 0.26 + 0.44 * math.random()
		lockT, nLock = t, nLock + 1
		ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tx * R.W, ty * R.H)
		wi = wi % #wp + 1
		local w = wp[wi]
		w.t0, w.y, w.rot = t, 0.22 + 0.5 * math.random(), (math.random() - 0.5) * 14
		w.x = (tx > 0.5) and (0.1 + 0.18 * math.random()) or (0.72 + 0.18 * math.random())
		local txt = words[math.random(1, #words)]
		w.a.Text, w.b.Text = txt, txt
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.voc)) do R.on(e[1], newTarget) end
	for _, i in ipairs({2, 3, 4}) do
		local di = R.drop(i)
		if di then R.on(di, newTarget) end
	end
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, U, vis = R.W, R.H, R.U, R.vis
		local pos = R.drop(2)
		local col = (pos and t >= pos) and RD or G
		local kk = 1 - math.exp(-9 * dt)
		px, py = px + (tx - px) * kk, py + (ty - py) * kk
		local la = t - lockT
		local lk = ease(la / 0.3)
		local sz = U * (0.12 + 0.4 * (1 - lk)) * (1 + 0.04 * R.pulse)
		local jit = (la < 0.3) and 0 or 1
		ret.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
		ret.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px * W + (math.random() - 0.5) * 3 * jit, py * H + (math.random() - 0.5) * 3 * jit)
		ret.Rotation = (1 - lk) * 25
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p.BackgroundColor3, p.BackgroundTransparency = col, vis(0.25 + 0.6 * lk) end
		lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px * W + sz * 0.55, py * H - sz * 0.45)
		lab.TextColor3 = col
		lab.Text = (la < 0.3) and "ACQUIRING..." or string.format("TARGET %02d  LOCK %d%%", nLock, math.floor(70 + 29 * R.lv))
		lab.TextTransparency = vis(0.8)
		local rk = clamp01(la / 0.7)
		ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 0.8 * ease(rk), U * 0.8 * ease(rk))
		rst.Color, rst.Transparency, rst.Thickness = col, vis(0.8 * (1 - rk)), 1 + 3 * (1 - rk)
		scan.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, (t / (K.BAR * 2)) % 1.2 - 0.1)
		scan.BackgroundColor3 = col
		scan.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.28 + 0.3 * R.pulse)
		rec.Text = string.format("REC  %02d:%02d:%02d", math.floor(t / 60), math.floor(t) % 60, math.floor(t * 24) % 24)
		rec.TextTransparency = vis(0.75)
		dot.BackgroundTransparency = (math.floor(t * 2) % 2 == 0) and vis(0.95) or 1
		for _, w in ipairs(wp) do
			local a = t - w.t0
			if a >= 0 and a < 1.0 then
				local k = a / 1.0
				local al = 0.75 * (1 - k) ^ 1.4 * ((k < 0.35 and math.random() < 0.25) and 0.3 or 1)
				local j = (1 - k) * 8
				w.a.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w.x * W - j, w.y * H)
				w.b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w.x * W + j, w.y * H)
				w.a.Rotation, w.b.Rotation = w.rot, w.rot
				w.a.TextTransparency, w.b.TextTransparency = vis(al), vis(al * 0.9)
			else
				w.a.TextTransparency, w.b.TextTransparency = 1, 1
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- ═══ 4 LIL PEEP : an ECG that spikes on the track's real kicks and flatlines through the breakdown, VHS tracking band + tape OSD, datamosh blocks on heavy kicks ═══
RIG[4] = function(R)
	local root, D, K = R.root, R.D, R.K
	local PK, CY = C(255, 46, 150), C(70, 226, 255)
	local N, RATE = 72, 36
	local ys, seg = {}, {}
	for i = 1, N do ys[i] = 0 end
	for i = 1, N - 1 do
		seg[i] = F(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(4, 3), PK, 1)
		seg[i].Visible = false
	end
	local q, qi, amp, lastKick, acc = nil, 0, 1, -99, 0
	local WAVE = {0.1, 0.18, 0.06, 0, -0.2, 1, -0.45, 0.06, 0.12, 0.22, 0.14, 0.05, 0}
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.bass)) do
		R.on(e[1] - 0.14, function(t)
			q, qi, amp, lastKick = WAVE, 0, 0.6 + 0.2 * e[2], t + 0.14
		end)
	end
	local lab = TX(root, 5, V2(1, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(260, 18), "", PK, Enum.Font.Code, 14)
	lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	local osd = TX(root, 5, V2(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.115), UDim2.fromOffset(300, 22), "", WHITE, Enum.Font.Code, 16)
	osd.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local tb = F(root, 3, V2(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.07), WHITE, 1)
	grad(tb, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0.45}, {1, 1}})
	local tc = F(root, 3, V2(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.035), CY, 1)
	grad(tc, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0.5}, {1, 1}})
	local nz = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do nz[i] = F(root, 4, V2(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(40, 2), WHITE, 1) end
	local blk, bi = {}, 0
	for i = 1, 8 do blk[i] = {f = F(root, 4, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(40, 10), PK, 1), t0 = -99, life = 0} end
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.bass)) do
		if e[2] >= 2 then
			R.on(e[1], function(t)
				for k = 1, 2 do
					bi = bi % 8 + 1
					local b = blk[bi]
					b.t0, b.life = t, 0.12 + 0.12 * math.random()
					b.f.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random() < 0.5) and PK or CY
					b.f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.06 + 0.2 * math.random(), 0.012 + 0.05 * math.random())
					b.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random() * 0.9, 0.12 + math.random() * 0.62)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local wins = windows(D.cut)
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, vis = R.W, R.H, R.vis
		local paused = false
		for _, w in ipairs(wins) do
			if t >= w[1] and t < w[2] then paused = true end
		end
		local started = lastKick > 0
		local flat = started and t > (R.drop(1) or 8) + 0.5 and t - lastKick > 1.3
		local dFall = R.drop(5)
		local fall = dFall and t >= dFall
		if not paused then acc = acc + dt * RATE end
		while acc >= 1 do
			acc = acc - 1
			local v = 0
			if q then
				qi = qi + 1
				v = (q[qi] or 0) * amp
				if qi >= #q then q = nil end
			end
			table.remove(ys, 1)
			ys[#ys + 1] = v + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.015
		end
		local x0, x1, yb, ya = W * 0.06, W * 0.94, H * 0.81, H * 0.075
		local sx = (x1 - x0) / (N - 1)
		local lc = flat and WHITE or (fall and CY or PK)
		for i = 1, N - 1 do
			local ax, ay = x0 + (i - 1 - acc) * sx, yb - ys[i] * ya
			local bx, by = x0 + (i - acc) * sx, yb - ys[i + 1] * ya
			local dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
			local s = seg[i]
			s.Visible = true
			s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 1.5, 3)
			s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((ax + bx) * 0.5, (ay + by) * 0.5)
			s.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
			s.BackgroundColor3 = lc
			s.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.85 * clamp01(math.min(i, N - i) / 8))
		end
		local blinkOn = math.floor(t * 3) % 2 == 0
		lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x1, H * 0.71)
		lab.Text = (not started) and "STANDBY" or (flat and "NO PULSE" or string.format("BPM %d", math.floor(60 / K.BEAT + 0.5)))
		lab.TextColor3 = flat and WHITE or PK
		lab.TextTransparency = (flat and not blinkOn) and 1 or vis(0.8)
		local mode = paused and "|| PAUSE" or (flat and "<< REW" or (fall and ">> FF" or "> PLAY"))
		osd.Text = string.format("%s    SP %d:%02d", mode, math.floor(t / 60), math.floor(t) % 60)
		osd.TextTransparency = vis(0.8)
		local by = ((t / K.BAR) % 1) * 1.25 - 0.12
		tb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, by)
		tc.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, by + 0.045)
		tb.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.2 + 0.4 * R.pulse + (paused and 0.3 or 0))
		tc.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.18 + 0.3 * R.pulse)
		for _, n in ipairs(nz) do
			if math.random() < 0.5 then
				n.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), by + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06)
				n.Size = UDim2.new(0.05 + 0.3 * math.random(), 0, 0, 1 + math.random(0, 2))
			end
			n.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.5 * math.random())
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(blk) do
			local a = t - b.t0
			if a >= 0 and a < b.life then
				b.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.6 * (1 - a / b.life))
			else
				b.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- ═══ 5 LIQUID SMOOTH : drifting caustic light that brightens with the level + shimmers, note-triggered ripples (gold after golden hour), a diving depth gauge ═══
RIG[5] = function(R)
	local root, D, K = R.root, R.D, R.K
	local A, B, GOLD = C(90, 226, 240), C(96, 150, 255), C(255, 214, 150)
	local cs = {}
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local f = F(root, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 2.4), (i % 2 == 0) and A or B, 1)
		grad(f, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
		cs[i] = {f = f, ph = math.random() * 6.28, sp = 0.05 + 0.09 * math.random(), w = 0.05 + 0.08 * math.random(), rot = (i % 2 == 0) and (-22 - 10 * math.random()) or (24 + 10 * math.random())}
	end
	local shK = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.shim)) do
		R.on(e[1], function(t, s) shK = math.max(shK, 0.4 + 0.3 * s) end, e[2])
	end
	local goldT = R.drop(6) or 1e9
	local rp, ri = {}, 0
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local f = round(F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), WHITE, 1))
		rp[i] = {f = f, s = stroke(f, A, 2), t0 = -99, x = 0.5, y = 0.5, mx = 0.2}
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.note)) do
		R.on(e[1], function(t, s)
			for k = 0, (s >= 2) and 1 or 0 do
				ri = ri % 10 + 1
				local o = rp[ri]
				o.t0, o.x, o.y = t + k * 0.12, 0.12 + 0.76 * math.random(), 0.22 + 0.56 * math.random()
				o.mx = 0.14 + 0.18 * math.random() + 0.06 * (s - 1)
				o.s.Color = (t >= goldT) and GOLD or ((math.random() < 0.5) and A or B)
			end
		end, e[2])
	end
	local gx = 0.962
	local gl = F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(gx, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 10), A, 1)
	local ticks = {}
	for i = 1, 15 do ticks[i] = F(root, 3, V2(1, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 1), A, 1) end
	local mrk = F(root, 4, V2(1, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(gx, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(26, 3), GOLD, 1)
	local dl = TX(root, 4, V2(1, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(190, 16), "", A, Enum.Font.Code, 13)
	dl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	local dl2 = TX(root, 4, V2(1, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(190, 14), "", B, Enum.Font.Code, 11)
	dl2.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	local function depthAt(t)
		local d1, d6 = R.drop(1) or 12, R.drop(6) or (K.DUR * 0.8)
		if t < d1 then return 0 end
		local dp = 120 * (1 - math.exp(-(t - d1) / 14))
		if t > d6 then dp = dp * (1 - clamp01((t - d6) / math.max(1, R.te - 1 - d6))) end
		return dp
	end
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, U, vis = R.W, R.H, R.U, R.vis
		shK = shK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
		local d1 = R.drop(1) or 12
		local sub = ease((t - d1) / (K.BAR * 2)) * 0.8 + 0.2
		for i, c in ipairs(cs) do
			c.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + 0.62 * math.sin(t * c.sp + c.ph), 0.5)
			c.f.Rotation = c.rot + 6 * math.sin(t * 0.21 + i)
			c.f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(c.w * (1 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + c.ph)), 2.4)
			c.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis((0.03 + 0.16 * R.lv + 0.3 * shK) * sub * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + i * 1.9)))
		end
		for _, o in ipairs(rp) do
			local a = t - o.t0
			if a >= 0 and a < 1.5 then
				local k = a / 1.5
				local sz = U * o.mx * 2 * ease(k)
				o.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(o.x * W, o.y * H)
				o.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz * 0.34)
				o.s.Transparency = vis(0.8 * (1 - k) ^ 1.5)
				o.s.Thickness = math.max(0.5, 2.5 * (1 - k))
			else
				o.s.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		local dp = depthAt(t)
		local ga = ease((t - d1) / 1.5)
		local y0, y1 = H * 0.2, H * 0.8
		gl.Position, gl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W * gx, (y0 + y1) * 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(2, y1 - y0)
		gl.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.5 * ga)
		local span, off = (y1 - y0) / 15, (dp * 0.12) % 1
		for i, tk in ipairs(ticks) do
			local ty = y0 + (((i - 1) + off) % 15) * span
			tk.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * gx - 6, ty)
			tk.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.5 * ga * (1 - math.abs((ty - (y0 + y1) * 0.5) / ((y1 - y0) * 0.5)) ^ 2))
		end
		mrk.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * gx - 2, H * 0.5)
		mrk.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.9 * ga)
		dl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * gx - 34, H * 0.5 - 12)
		dl.Text = string.format("DEPTH %03d M", math.floor(dp))
		dl.TextTransparency = vis(0.85 * ga)
		dl2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * gx - 34, H * 0.5 + 8)
		dl2.Text = string.format("PRESSURE %.1f ATM", 1 + dp / 10)
		dl2.TextTransparency = vis(0.6 * ga)
	end)
end

-- ═══ 6 THRILLER : a damaged 35 mm horror print (gate flicker, scratches, dust, reel cue marks), ground fog that puffs on the six footsteps, a lit dance-floor grid on the groove ═══
RIG[6] = function(R)
	local root, D, K = R.root, R.D, R.K
	local RED = C(230, 34, 44)
	local TILE = {C(230, 34, 44), C(80, 200, 70), C(176, 196, 255), C(255, 150, 40)}
	local flk = F(root, 1, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BLACK, 1)
	local scr = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do scr[i] = {f = F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), WHITE, 1), t1 = -1} end
	local dust, dustA = {}, {}
	for i = 1, 16 do
		dust[i] = round(F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), C(210, 214, 220), 1))
		dustA[i] = 0
	end
	local cue = round(F(root, 6, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.935, 0.165), UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), WHITE, 1))
	local cueS = stroke(cue, WHITE, 3)
	local cueT, flkV, lastF = -99, 0, -1
	for _, i in ipairs({1, 4, 7}) do
		local di = R.drop(i)
		if di then
			R.on(di - 0.62, function(t) cueT = t end)
			R.on(di, function(t) cueT = t end)
		end
	end
	local fog = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local f = round(F(root, 1, V2(0.5, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1.03), UDim2.fromScale(0.75, 0.36), C(168, 184, 214), 1), 0.5)
		grad(f, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.55, 0.55}, {1, 0.1}})
		fog[i] = {f = f, ph = math.random() * 6.28, sp = 0.04 + 0.06 * math.random(), amp = 0.35 + 0.35 * math.random(), w = 0.6 + 0.5 * math.random()}
	end
	local stepK, sT = 0, -99
	local sring = round(F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.93), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4), WHITE, 1))
	local sst = stroke(sring, RED, 3)
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.foot)) do
		R.on(e[1], function(t)
			stepK, sT = 1, t
		end)
	end
	local tiles = {}
	local rowY, rowW = {0.79, 0.855, 0.93}, {0.075, 0.095, 0.12}
	for r = 1, 3 do
		for c = 1, 9 do
			local f = F(root, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (c - 5) * rowW[r], rowY[r]), UDim2.fromScale(rowW[r] * 0.94, 0.05), WHITE, 1)
			tiles[#tiles + 1] = {f = f, s = stroke(f, C(176, 196, 255), 1), t0 = -99, col = RED}
		end
	end
	local gT = R.drop(4) or 1e9
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.bass)) do
		if e[1] >= gT then
			R.on(e[1], function(t)
				for k = 1, 2 do
					local o = tiles[math.random(1, #tiles)]
					o.t0, o.col = t, TILE[math.random(1, #TILE)]
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, U, vis = R.W, R.H, R.U, R.vis
		stepK = stepK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
		local fr = math.floor(t * 24)
		if fr ~= lastF then
			lastF = fr
			flkV = math.random()
			for _, s in ipairs(scr) do
				if s.t1 < t and math.random() < 0.06 then
					s.t1 = t + 0.06 + 0.22 * math.random()
					s.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), 0)
					s.f.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(1, 2), 1, 0)
				end
			end
			for i, f in ipairs(dust) do
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random() * W, math.random() * H)
				local sz = math.random(1, 3)
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
				dustA[i] = 0.3 + 0.5 * math.random()
			end
		end
		for i, f in ipairs(dust) do f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(dustA[i]) end
		for _, s in ipairs(scr) do s.f.BackgroundTransparency = (t < s.t1) and vis(0.55 + 0.25 * flkV) or 1 end
		local white = flkV > 0.97
		flk.BackgroundColor3 = white and WHITE or BLACK
		flk.BackgroundTransparency = vis(white and 0.05 or (0.04 + 0.1 * flkV + 0.35 * stepK))
		local ca = (t >= cueT and t - cueT < 0.14) and 1 or 0
		cue.BackgroundTransparency = vis(ca * 0.5)
		cueS.Transparency = vis(ca * 0.9)
		local fa = 0.07 + 0.2 * R.lv + 0.55 * stepK
		for _, g in ipairs(fog) do
			g.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + g.amp * math.sin(t * g.sp + g.ph), 1.03 - 0.03 * stepK)
			g.f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.75 * g.w, 0.3 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 0.3 + g.ph) + 0.08 * stepK)
			g.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(fa * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 0.5 + g.ph * 2)))
		end
		local sk = clamp01((t - sT) / 0.9)
		sring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 1.1 * ease(sk), U * 0.22 * ease(sk))
		sst.Transparency = vis(0.85 * (1 - sk))
		local ga = ease((t - gT + 0.5) / 1.0)
		for _, o in ipairs(tiles) do
			local k = envl(t - o.t0, 0.03, 0.4)
			o.f.BackgroundColor3 = o.col
			o.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.6 * k)
			o.s.Transparency = vis(0.16 * ga + 0.6 * k)
		end
	end)
end

-- ═══ 7 PERFECT FACE : manga speed lines + comic impact words on the heavy kicks, feather storms and FLEX slams on the drops ═══
RIG[7] = function(R)
	local root, D = R.root, R.D
	local GOLD, PINK = C(255, 214, 120), C(255, 140, 200)
	local NL = 28
	local sl = {}
	for i = 1, NL do
		sl[i] = {f = F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2), (i % 3 == 0) and WHITE or GOLD, 1), a = 0, r0 = 0.15, len = 0.2, th = 2}
		sl[i].f.Visible = false
	end
	local slT, slS = -99, 0
	local WORDS = {"POW!", "WHAM!", "BOOM!", "KRAKOW!", "SWOOSH!", "ZAP!"}
	local po = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local l = TX(root, 6, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(360, 100), "", GOLD, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 56)
		l.TextStrokeColor3 = BLACK
		po[i] = {l = l, sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", l), t0 = -99, x = 0.5, y = 0.5, rot = 0, big = 1}
	end
	local pi, lastB, lastP = 0, -99, -99
	local function burst(t, s)
		slT, slS = t, s
		for i = 1, NL do
			local o = sl[i]
			o.a = math.rad((i - 1) / NL * 360 + math.random() * 9)
			o.r0, o.len, o.th = 0.1 + 0.14 * math.random(), 0.1 + 0.3 * math.random(), 2 + 2.5 * math.random()
		end
	end
	local function pop(t, txt, x, y, big)
		pi = pi % 3 + 1
		local p = po[pi]
		p.t0, p.x, p.y, p.big, p.rot = t, x, y, big, (math.random() - 0.5) * 24
		p.l.Text = txt
		p.l.TextColor3 = (pi == 1) and GOLD or ((pi == 2) and PINK or WHITE)
	end
	local fe = {}
	for i = 1, 14 do
		local f = round(F(root, 3, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 22), WHITE, 1))
		fe[i] = {f = f, x = math.random(), y = math.random() * 1.2 - 0.1, vy = 0.06, ph = math.random() * 6.28, rot = math.random() * 360, rv = (math.random() - 0.5) * 120}
	end
	local function featherBurst(n)
		for k = 1, n do
			local o = fe[math.random(1, #fe)]
			o.y, o.x, o.vy = 0.5 + 0.2 * math.random(), 0.2 + 0.6 * math.random(), -(0.25 + 0.3 * math.random())
		end
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.bass)) do
		if e[2] >= 3 then
			R.on(e[1], function(t)
				if t - lastB >= 0.8 then
					lastB = t
					burst(t, 0.7)
				end
				if t - lastP >= 1.15 then
					lastP = t
					local left = math.random() < 0.5
					pop(t, WORDS[math.random(1, #WORDS)], left and (0.1 + 0.18 * math.random()) or (0.72 + 0.18 * math.random()), 0.2 + 0.4 * math.random(), 1)
				end
			end, e[2])
		end
	end
	local DW = {[3] = "WHAM!", [4] = "FLEX!", [6] = "ENCORE!"}
	for i, w in pairs(DW) do
		local di = R.drop(i)
		if di then
			R.on(di, function(t)
				burst(t, 1)
				pop(t, w, 0.5, 0.26, 1.6)
				featherBurst(9)
				lastP = t
			end)
		end
	end
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, U, vis = R.W, R.H, R.U, R.vis
		local a = t - slT
		for _, o in ipairs(sl) do
			if a >= 0 and a < 0.42 then
				local k = a / 0.42
				local r = U * (o.r0 + 0.7 * ease(k))
				local len = U * o.len * (1 - 0.5 * k)
				o.f.Visible = true
				o.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, o.th * (1 - 0.4 * k))
				o.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * 0.5 + math.cos(o.a) * (r + len * 0.5), H * 0.5 + math.sin(o.a) * (r + len * 0.5))
				o.f.Rotation = math.deg(o.a)
				o.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.85 * slS * (1 - k) ^ 1.2)
			else
				o.f.Visible = false
			end
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(po) do
			local k = (t - p.t0) / 0.7
			if k >= 0 and k < 1 then
				local s = back((t - p.t0) / 0.16) * (1 - 0.12 * k) * (U / 720) * p.big
				local al = (k < 0.6) and 1 or (1 - (k - 0.6) / 0.4)
				p.sc.Scale = math.max(0.01, s)
				p.l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x * W, p.y * H)
				p.l.Rotation = p.rot
				p.l.TextTransparency, p.l.TextStrokeTransparency = vis(al), vis(al)
			else
				p.l.TextTransparency, p.l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1, 1
			end
		end
		for _, o in ipairs(fe) do
			o.vy = lerp(o.vy, 0.05 + 0.06 * R.lv, 1 - math.exp(-1.6 * dt))
			o.y = o.y + o.vy * dt
			o.rot = o.rot + o.rv * dt
			if o.y > 1.08 then o.y, o.x = -0.08, math.random() end
			o.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(o.x + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.4 + o.ph), o.y)
			o.f.Rotation = o.rot
			o.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.5 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 2 + o.ph))
		end
	end)
end

-- ═══ 8 THE AURA FARMER : a counter that really farms aura (every kick, sung word and drop), floating +N popups, an aura meter, gold aura waves and rising gold dust ═══
RIG[8] = function(R)
	local root, D = R.root, R.D
	local GOLD, PINK, CYAN = C(255, 196, 64), C(255, 52, 150), C(40, 220, 255)
	local RC = {GOLD, PINK, CYAN}
	local target, shown = 0, 0
	local function fmt(n)
		local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
		local o = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
		return (o:gsub("^,", ""))
	end
	local lab = TX(root, 5, V2(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.125), UDim2.fromOffset(240, 14), "AURA", GOLD, Enum.Font.Code, 12)
	lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	local num = TX(root, 5, V2(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.145), UDim2.fromOffset(300, 34), "0", WHITE, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 30)
	num.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	num.TextStrokeColor3 = GOLD
	local nsc = Util.Instance("UIScale", num)
	local track = F(root, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.972, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 100), BLACK, 1)
	local fill = F(track, 1, V2(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), GOLD, 1)
	grad(fill, 90, {{0, 0}, {1, 0.35}})
	local maxL = TX(root, 5, V2(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(60, 14), "MAX", GOLD, Enum.Font.Code, 11)
	local fl, fi, lastF = {}, 0, -99
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local l = TX(root, 6, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(180, 30), "", GOLD, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 22)
		l.TextStrokeColor3 = BLACK
		fl[i] = {l = l, t0 = -99, x = 0.5, y = 0.5}
	end
	local function farm(t, n, txt, loud, force)
		target = target + n
		nsc.Scale = 1.18
		if force or t - lastF > 0.12 then
			lastF = t
			fi = fi % 10 + 1
			local o = fl[fi]
			o.t0, o.x, o.y = t, 0.6 + 0.3 * math.random(), 0.28 + 0.42 * math.random()
			o.l.Text = txt or ("+" .. n)
			o.l.TextColor3 = loud and WHITE or GOLD
			o.l.TextStrokeColor3 = loud and PINK or BLACK
		end
	end
	local wv, wi, lastW = {}, 0, -99
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local f = round(F(root, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), WHITE, 1))
		wv[i] = {f = f, s = stroke(f, GOLD, 5), t0 = -99}
	end
	local function wave(t, col)
		wi = wi % 6 + 1
		wv[wi].t0 = t
		wv[wi].s.Color = col
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(parse(D.bass)) do
		R.on(e[1], function(t, s)
			if s >= 2 then
				farm(t, s * 7, nil, false, false)
			else
				target = target + 3
			end
			if s >= 3 and t - lastW > 0.5 then
				lastW = t
				wave(t, RC[(wi % 3) + 1])
			end
		end, e[2])
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(FX.Intro8Lyrics or {}) do
		if type(r) == "table" and type(r[5]) == "string" then
			for x in r[5]:gmatch("%S+") do
				local wt = tonumber(x)
				if wt then R.on(wt, function(t) farm(t, 40, "+40", true, false) end) end
			end
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local di = R.drop(i)
		if di then
			R.on(di, function(t)
				farm(t, 1000, "+1000 AURA", true, true)
				wave(t, GOLD)
				wave(t + 0.1, PINK)
				wave(t + 0.2, CYAN)
			end)
		end
	end
	local mo = {}
	for i = 1, 22 do
		local s = 3 + math.random() * 6
		local f = round(F(root, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(s, s), (i % 3 == 0) and WHITE or GOLD, 1))
		mo[i] = {f = f, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), z = 0.4 + 0.6 * math.random(), ph = math.random() * 6.28}
	end
	R.tick(function(t, dt)
		local W, H, U, vis = R.W, R.H, R.U, R.vis
		local lv, vc = R.lv, lvAt(D.voc, t)
		shown = shown + (target - shown) * (1 - math.exp(-9 * dt))
		nsc.Scale = lerp(nsc.Scale, 1, 1 - math.exp(-10 * dt))
		num.Text = fmt(shown)
		num.TextTransparency = vis(0.95)
		num.TextStrokeTransparency = vis(0.55 + 0.4 * R.pulse)
		lab.Text = string.format("AURA  LV %d", 1 + math.floor(shown / 1000))
		lab.TextTransparency = vis(0.8)
		local mh = H * 0.5
		track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, mh)
		track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * 0.972, H * 0.5)
		track.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.5)
		local fv = clamp01(0.08 + 0.85 * (0.6 * lv + 0.4 * vc) + 0.1 * R.pulse)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, fv)
		fill.BackgroundTransparency = vis(0.95)
		maxL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W * 0.972, H * 0.5 - mh * 0.5 - 4)
		maxL.TextTransparency = (fv > 0.9) and vis((math.floor(t * 6) % 2 == 0) and 0.9 or 0.3) or 1
		for _, o in ipairs(fl) do
			local k = t - o.t0
			if k >= 0 and k < 1 then
				o.l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(o.x * W, (o.y - 0.09 * ease(k)) * H)
				local al = (k < 0.15) and (k / 0.15) or (1 - (k - 0.15) / 0.85)
				o.l.TextTransparency, o.l.TextStrokeTransparency = vis(al), vis(al * 0.8)
			else
				o.l.TextTransparency, o.l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1, 1
			end
		end
		for _, o in ipairs(wv) do
			local a = t - o.t0
			if a >= 0 and a < 1.1 then
				local k = a / 1.1
				local sz = math.max(W, H) * 1.15 * ease(k)
				o.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
				o.s.Transparency = vis(0.75 * (1 - k) ^ 1.3)
				o.s.Thickness = 1 + 7 * (1 - k)
			else
				o.s.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		for _, m in ipairs(mo) do
			m.y = m.y - (0.02 + 0.06 * lv + 0.05 * R.pulse) * m.z * dt * 3
			if m.y < -0.05 then m.y, m.x = 1.05, math.random() end
			m.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(m.x + 0.02 * math.sin(t * 0.9 + m.ph), m.y)
			m.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis((0.25 + 0.5 * lv) * m.z * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 2 + m.ph)))
		end
	end)
end

return function(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
	local build = RIG[id]
	local INT = math.clamp(tonumber(K and K.INT) or 1, 0, 1.5)
	if not build or INT <= 0.01 or not stage or type(d) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local D = FX["Intro" .. id .. "Data"] or {}
	local root = F(stage, zb or 24, V2(0, 0), UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BLACK, 1)
	root.ClipsDescendants = true
	local R = {root = root, K = K, d = d, D = D, INT = INT, life = 1, W = 1280, H = 720, U = 720, pulse = 0, lv = 0, t = 0, te = K.DUR, ev = {}, up = {}}
	function R.on(t, f, s) R.ev[#R.ev + 1] = {t = t, f = f, s = s} end
	function R.tick(f) R.up[#R.up + 1] = f end
	function R.vis(a) return 1 - clamp01(a * INT * R.life) end
	function R.drop(i)
		local v = d[i]
		return type(v) == "number" and v or nil
	end
	local okB, errB = pcall(build, R)
	if not okB then
		warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro remaster build error (continuing): " .. tostring(errB))
		pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
		return nil
	end
	table.sort(R.ev, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
	local ei, alive = 1, true
	local function step(t, dt, S)
		dt = math.min(dt or 0.016, 0.1)
		R.t = t
		R.te = (S and S.tEnd) or K.DUR
		R.life = 1 - clamp01((t - (R.te - 0.9)) / 0.7)
		local W, H = stage.AbsoluteSize.X, stage.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if W < 10 then W, H = 1280, 720 end
		R.W, R.H, R.U = W, H, math.min(W, H)
		R.pulse = math.min((S and (S.pulse or S.kick)) or 0, 1.2)
		R.lv = lerp(R.lv, lvAt(D.level, t), 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
		while R.ev[ei] and t >= R.ev[ei].t do
			local e = R.ev[ei]
			ei = ei + 1
			if t - e.t < 0.25 then e.f(e.t, e.s) end
		end
		for _, u in ipairs(R.up) do u(t, dt, S) end
	end
	return function(t, dt, S)
		if not alive then return end
		local ok, err = pcall(step, t, dt, S)
		if not ok then
			alive = false
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro remaster layer error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
			pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
end
]==]
function FX.MountRemaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if FX.RemasterFn == nil then
FX.RemasterFn = false
local ls = loadstring or load
if ls then
local okC, fn, cerr = pcall(ls, FX.IntroRemasterSrc, "=IntroRemaster")
if okC and type(fn) == "function" then
local okR, rmod = pcall(fn, Util, FX)
if okR and type(rmod) == "function" then FX.RemasterFn = rmod end
else
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro remaster layer unavailable: " .. tostring(cerr or fn))
end
end
end
if not FX.RemasterFn then return nil end
local ok, up = pcall(FX.RemasterFn, stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if ok and type(up) == "function" then return up end
return nil
end
FX.IUBase = FX.IntroUpgrade
function FX.IntroUpgrade(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local base = FX.IUBase(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local rm = FX.MountRemaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if type(base) ~= "function" then return rm end
if type(rm) ~= "function" then return base end
return function(t, dt, S)
base(t, dt, S)
rm(t, dt, S)
end
end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()

end

end

local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end

ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI",
ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
})
E.skipS = mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function()
S.skipped = true
end)
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", E.skip)
E.skip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.07, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.88}) end
end)
E.skip.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end)
end
local function shoot(n)
for _ = 1, n do
for _, s in ipairs(E.shoot) do
if s.age >= s.life then
local dir = math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1
local ang = 0.35 + math.random() * 0.35
local sp = S.sx * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.5)
s.life, s.age = 0.55 + math.random() * 0.3, 0
s.len = S.sy * (0.14 + math.random() * 0.12)
s.x, s.y = (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.9 - dir * S.sx * 0.2, -S.sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.1)
s.vx, s.vy = dir * math.cos(ang) * sp, math.sin(ang) * sp
s.f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(s.vy, s.vx))
s.f.Visible = true
break
end
end
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.modeAt = t
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)
if m == 2 then
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.moonY
local a = (i / #E.orbs) * 6.283 + math.random() * 0.4
b.vx, b.vy = math.cos(a) * w * (0.14 + math.random() * 0.2), -h * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
end
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.8 * I), S.zk - 0.2 * I, 40, 12 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
shoot(3)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.mk = S.mk + 0.22
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.7 * I), S.zk - 0.14 * I, 30, 10 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 16, 260, 0.8)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.04, 0.5)
shoot(2)
itick(0.55, 1)
elseif m == 4 then
S.sp.tsc = {0.35, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.chroma, S.zk, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I), 44, S.zk - 0.2 * I, 14 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 950, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 650, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
shoot(3)
itick(0.5, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.1 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.mk = S.mk + 0.045 * k
S.zk = S.zk - 0.05 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1.2 + k) * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.008 * k * I
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (4 + 4 * k) * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 10 * k
if m == 3 then S.stormK = 1 end
itick(0.55, 0.8)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 460 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.04, 0.35) end
if m == 2 and t - S.modeAt > 0.15 then
for _, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.vy = -h * (0.4 + 0.22 * k) * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.4)
end
end
end
local function snareHit(k, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.75)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.12 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.03 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 2 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, 5 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 8 * k
shoot(k > 1 and 2 or 1)
if m == 1 then
S.step = S.step + 1
S.mk = S.mk + 0.05
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
itick(0.9 + 0.1 * S.step, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 380 + 80 * S.step, 0.7, 3, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY))
else
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 5 + 3 * k, 150, 0.5) end
if m == 2 then
for _, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.vy = -h * (0.3 + 0.25 * math.random())
end
end
end
end
local function accHit(k, m, col, h)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.25 + 0.15 * k)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.01 * k * I
if m == 3 then S.stormK = math.max(S.stormK, 0.35 * k) end
if m == 4 then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.5 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.08 * I)
end
if m == 2 then
E.orbs[math.random(1, #E.orbs)].vy = -h * (0.4 + 0.4 * math.random())
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
local col = accent()
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bar = math.clamp(math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1, 1, 16)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < M3 and 2 or (t < M4 and 3 or 4))
local floorY = sy * 0.27
local R3 = math.min(sy * 0.34, sx * 0.42)
local rm0 = sy * 0.15
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u3 = clamp01((t - M3) / (M4 - M3))
local u4 = clamp01((t - M4) / (K.DUR - M4))
local inCut = false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then inCut = true end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + 18
S.zk = S.zk + 0.05 * K.INT
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.12, 0.6)
end
S.inCut = inCut
S.ecl = lerp(S.ecl, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 9 or 40) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx, sy)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.5 or 1.2, 0.3)
if beatIdx % 4 == 0 and spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 220 + 6 * beatIdx, 0.8, 2, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)) end
if beatIdx >= 28 and beatIdx <= 31 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 28), 0.8) end
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.stormK = S.stormK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.mk = S.mk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.si < #SNARE and t >= SNARE[S.si + 1][1] do
S.si = S.si + 1
if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.3 then snareHit(SNARE[S.si][2], mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.ai < #ACC and t >= ACC[S.ai + 1][1] do
S.ai = S.ai + 1
if t - ACC[S.ai][1] < 0.3 then accHit(ACC[S.ai][2], mode, col, sy) end
end
while S.wi < #TW and t >= TW[S.wi + 1][1] do
S.wi = S.wi + 1
if t - TW[S.wi][1] < 0.3 and #E.dust > 0 then
E.dust[math.random(1, #E.dust)].fl = 1
if mode >= 3 then E.dust[math.random(1, #E.dust)].fl = 1 end
end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, inCut and 0.3 or 1, 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.br = lerp(S.br, mode == 1 and (0.28 + 0.18 * S.step) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
local br = S.br * (1 - 0.88 * S.ecl)
local MYF = -sy * 0.07
local e1 = smooth(u1)
local mscT, myT = 1, MYF
if mode == 1 then
mscT = 0.55 + 0.45 * e1
myT = lerp(floorY + rm0 * mscT * 1.15, MYF, e1)
elseif mode == 3 then
mscT = 0.84
elseif mode == 4 then
mscT = 1 + 0.5 * u4 ^ 3
end
local msc = follow("msc", mscT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0.55)
local myy = follow("my", myT, 9, 0.8, dt, floorY + rm0 * 0.55 * 1.15)
S.moonY = myy
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 1 + 0.05 * u1 + 0.22 * u1 ^ 3
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1)
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
elseif mode == 2 then
tz = 1.03 + 0.05 * S.ecl
tr = ((bar % 2 == 1) and 1 or -1) * 1.2 * K.INT
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
tx = math.sin(u3 * 6.283) * sx * 0.04
tr = math.sin(u3 * 6.283 + 1.2) * 1.8 * K.INT
tz = 1.05 + 0.03 * math.sin(u3 * 12.566) + 0.05 * S.ecl
else
tz = 1.06 + 0.5 * u4 ^ 3
tr = (1 - u4) * -2 * K.INT
end
local hk = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 1.5 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk
local kd = math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(
SKYT:Lerp(BLACK, 0.6 * S.ecl),
SKYB:Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br):Lerp(BLACK, 0.7 * S.ecl)
)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.95 - 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br - (mode > 1 and 0.16 * S.lv or 0), 0.35, 1)
local starsOn = clamp01(t / (M2 * 0.8))
local starCol = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.25)
for _, d in ipairs(E.dust) do
d.x = (d.x + dt * S.ts * (0.004 + 0.01 * S.lv) * d.z) % 1
d.fl = d.fl * math.exp(-5 * dt)
d.f.Position = UDim2.new(d.x * 2.4 - 0.7, -cx * d.z * 0.3, d.y * 1.6 - 0.3, 0)
local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * (1.2 + d.z) + d.ph)
if d.i <= (0.15 + 0.85 * starsOn) * #E.dust then
d.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.35 * tw - 0.8 * d.fl + 0.5 * S.ecl, 0, 1)
else
d.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
end
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = starCol
local sz = d.sz * (1 + 2.2 * d.fl)
d.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
end
for _, c in ipairs(E.clouds) do
c.x = (c.x + dt * S.ts * c.sp * (1 + 2 * S.lv)) % 1
c.f.Position = UDim2.new(c.x * 1.7 - 0.35, -cx * 0.15, 0.5, c.y * sy)
c.f.Size = UDim2.new(c.w, 0, 0, sy * c.h)
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 122, 200):Lerp(col, 0.25)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.92 - 0.04 * S.lv - 0.03 * S.pulse - 0.04 * S.br, 0.8, 1)
end
local md = 2 * rm0 * math.max(0.05, msc) * (1 + 0.035 * S.pulse + S.mk)
local mpos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, myy)
for i, h in ipairs(E.halos) do
h.Position = mpos
local hs = md * (1.2 + 0.4 * (i - 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.1 * S.mk)
h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hs, hs)
h.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.4)
h.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - br * (0.1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.08 * S.pulse) / i, 0.55, 1)
end
E.moon.Position = mpos
E.moon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(md, md)
E.moon.BackgroundColor3 = DIM:Lerp(MOON, S.br)
E.moonS.Color = col:Lerp(MOON, 0.5)
E.moonS.Thickness = 2 + 5 * S.ecl + 2 * S.pulse
E.moonS.Transparency = math.clamp(0.6 - 0.45 * S.ecl - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.05, 1)
E.shade.Position = mpos
E.shade.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(md, md)
E.shade.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.88 * S.ecl
E.sea.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floorY)
E.sea.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.4), 0.6 * S.ecl)
E.hz.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floorY)
E.hz.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.3)
E.hz.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.4 * br - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.1, 1)
local scroll = (bt * 0.5) % 1
for i, l in ipairs(E.lines) do
local u = (i - 1 + scroll) / 9
local w = sy * (0.05 + 0.5 * u) * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 3 + i * 1.7))
l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(t * 2.2 + i * 2.1) * sx * 0.006 * (1 + 3 * u), 0.5, floorY + 3 + u * u * sy * 0.55)
l.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 1 + math.floor(u * 3))
l.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.3)
l.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.9 - 0.55 * br - 0.25 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse * (1 - u) + 0.15 * u, 0.1, 1)
end
local sdt = dt * S.ts
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
local r = sy * b.rk
local bw, bh, vis = 2 * r, 2 * r, mode >= 2
local zi = 10
if mode == 2 then
b.vy = b.vy + sy * 1.5 * sdt
b.vx = b.vx * (1 - 0.3 * sdt)
b.x, b.y = b.x + b.vx * sdt, b.y + b.vy * sdt
if b.y > floorY - r then
b.y = floorY - r
b.vy = -math.max(math.abs(b.vy) * 0.72, sy * 0.28)
end
local hw = sx * 0.5 - r
if b.x > hw then b.x, b.vx = hw, -math.abs(b.vx) * 0.9 elseif b.x < -hw then b.x, b.vx = -hw, math.abs(b.vx) * 0.9 end
local st = math.clamp(math.abs(b.vy) / (sy * 5), 0, 0.18)
bw, bh = bw * (1 - st * 0.35), bh * (1 + st)
elseif mode >= 3 then
local R, rev = R3 * (1 + 0.12 * S.stormK), (t - M3) / K.BAR
if mode == 4 then
R, rev = R3 * (1 - u4 * u4), (t - M4) / (K.BAR * 0.5)
bw, bh = bw * (1 - 0.55 * u4 ^ 3), bh * (1 - 0.55 * u4 ^ 3)
end
local a = b.a + rev * 6.283
local kk = 1 - math.exp(-9 * dt)
local sa = math.sin(a)
b.x, b.y = lerp(b.x, math.cos(a) * R, kk), lerp(b.y, myy + sa * R * 0.55, kk)
b.vx, b.vy = 0, 0
bw, bh = bw * (1 + 0.22 * sa), bh * (1 + 0.22 * sa)
if sa < 0 then zi = 2 end
end
if zi ~= b.zi then
b.zi = zi
b.f.ZIndex = zi
end
b.f.Visible = vis
if vis then
b.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, b.x, 0.5, b.y)
b.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bw, bh)
b.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 * S.ecl
b.gl.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.86 - 0.2 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.5, 1)
end
end
for _, s in ipairs(E.shoot) do
if s.age < s.life then
s.age = s.age + dt
local k = clamp01(s.age / s.life)
s.x, s.y = s.x + s.vx * dt, s.y + s.vy * dt
s.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, s.x, 0.5, s.y)
s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s.len * (0.4 + 0.6 * math.sin(k * 3.1416)), 2)
s.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - math.sin(k * 3.1416) * 0.95, 0.05, 1)
if s.age >= s.life then s.f.Visible = false end
end
end
local td = t - M2
if td >= 0 then
local reveal = clamp01(td / (K.BEAT * 1.5))
if reveal < 1 then
local s = scr(NAME, reveal)
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = s, s, s
elseif not S.titleDone then
S.titleDone = true
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = NAME, NAME, NAME
end
local ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.1, 1
if mode == 3 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.36, 0.4
elseif mode == 4 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.08, 1.15 + 0.2 * u4
end
ts3 = ts3 * (1 - 0.1 * S.ecl)
local tyy = follow("ty", ty3, 9, 0.7, dt)
local tss = follow("tsc", ts3, 9, 0.62, dt, 2.6)
E.tF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy)
E.tS.Scale = math.max(0.05, tss * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse))
S.chroma = S.chroma * math.exp(-5 * dt)
local ch = S.chroma + (mode == 4 and 20 * u4 or 0)
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ch, 0.5, ch * 0.25), UDim2.new(0.5, -ch, 0.5, -ch * 0.25)
local ca = math.clamp(1 - ch / 16, 0.25, 1)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextTransparency = ca, ca, 0.55 * S.ecl
E.tM.TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.18)
E.sub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy + sy * 0.12 * (mode == 3 and 0.5 or 1))
E.sub.TextColor3 = col
if inCut then
E.sub.Text = "-   E C L I P S E   -"
E.sub.TextTransparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 9)
else
E.sub.Text = SUB

end
end

f.Visible = show
if show then
local cw = math.clamp(math.min(sx * 0.62, sy * 1.5), 220, 460)
local side = (i % 2 == 1) and -1 or 1
local uin, uout = clamp01((t - w0) / (K.BEAT * 0.9)), clamp01((t - (w1 - K.BEAT * 0.7)) / (K.BEAT * 0.7))
local ex = side * (sx * 0.5 + cw)
local x = lerp(lerp(ex, side * math.max(0, (sx - cw) * 0.3), easeOutBack(uin)), -ex, uout * uout)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, cw * 0.36)
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, (i - 2) * sy * 0.07 + math.sin(t * 2 + i) * sy * 0.004)
f.Rotation = (1 - uin) * side * 6 + S.rk * 0.5
end
end

E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING: " .. string.upper(SONG.Title or "")
E.ms.Text = modStatus()
E.tc.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 0)) or 1
E.np.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 1)) or 1
E.ms.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 2)) or 1
for _, l in ipairs({E.tc, E.np, E.ms}) do l.TextColor3 = col end
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3 + math.floor(S.pulse * 2))
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.skipS.Color, E.skip.TextColor3 = col, col
E.skipS.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 3)
if mode == 1 then
local L = {"> NIGHT SKY ONLINE", "> LUNAR SYNC  " .. string.format("%d", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 128) + 0.5)) .. " BPM", "> STARS x" .. #E.dust .. "  LOADED", "> MOONRISE  IN PROGRESS", "> " .. modStatus(), "> FULL MOON  CONFIRMED"}
local out = {}
for i, ln in ipairs(L) do
if bt >= (i - 1) * 4 then out[#out + 1] = scr(ln, (bt - (i - 1) * 4) / 1.4) end
end
if bt >= 28 then out[#out + 1] = "> DROP IN " .. (32 - beatIdx) end
E.term.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
E.term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.035), 12, 20)
E.term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.2)
E.term.TextColor3 = col
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.25
elseif E.term.Text ~= "" then
E.term.Text = ""
end
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local fa = clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen)
local flashA = math.max(fa, math.min(0.85, S.flashK))
if mode == 4 then flashA = math.max(flashA, S.pulse * 0.12 * u4 * K.INT) end
local fadeIn = 1 - clamp01(t / (K.BEAT * 3))
if fadeIn > 0.01 and flashA < 0.05 then
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 1 - fadeIn
else
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa)), 1 - flashA
end
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 2 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
end)
return true
end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end
local function blinkMul(tb, t)
local u = (t - tb) / 0.2
if u < 0 or u > 1 then return 1 end
return 1 - 0.92 * math.sin(u * 3.1416)
end

end
end)
