local CARDS = {
{"ORIGINAL CREATOR", CREATOR, EMER},
{"MODDED BY", "NOOBY", CRIM},
{"SOUNDTRACK", ((SONG.Title or "MY JEALOUSY"):gsub("%s*%b()", "")):upper(), LILAC},
}
for i, c in ipairs(CARDS) do
local f = box(E.world, 13, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(300, 108), Color3.fromRGB(14, 6, 10), 0.08)
f.Visible = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 2, Color = c[3], Transparency = 0.1})
box(f, 13, 0, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, 0), c[3], 0)
local role = txt(f, 13, Enum.Font.Code, 0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 22, 0.12, 0), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.22, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
local name = txt(f, 13, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 22, 0.42, 0), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.42, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
role.Text, name.Text = c[1], c[2]
role.TextColor3, role.TextTransparency, name.TextTransparency = c[3], 0, 0
E.cards[i] = f
end
E.vig = {}
for i, v in ipairs({
{0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 1), 0}, {1, 0.5, 1, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 1), 180},
{0.5, 0, 0.5, 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.34), 90}, {0.5, 1, 0.5, 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.34), 270},
}) do
local f = box(stage, 18, v[1], v[2], UDim2.fromScale(v[3], v[4]), v[5], BLACK, 0.4)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = v[6]
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
E.vig[i] = f
end
E.barT = box(stage, 20, 0.5, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.barB = box(stage, 20, 0.5, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.flash = box(stage, 40, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1)
do local ok, up = pcall(FX.IntroUpgrade, stage, E, 3, {M2, M3, M4, TN}, K, 24) if ok and type(up) == "function" then E.up = up end end
local function hud(ax, ay, pos, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = xa, ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
end
E.tc = hud(0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.np = hud(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.ms = hud(1, 1, UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
E.prog = box(stage, 22, 0, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3), WHITE, 0)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {
Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 90), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 16,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI",
ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
})
E.skipS = mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function()
S.skipped = true
end)
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", E.skip)
E.skip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.07, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.88}) end
end)
E.skip.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end)
end
local function drawEye(EW, open, ix, iy, ir, prx, pry, irisCol, rimCol, sclCol, rimT)
local A = EW * 0.5
E.line.Visible = open < 0.09
if E.line.Visible then
E.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(EW * (0.45 + 0.5 * clamp01(open * 11)), 2)
E.line.BackgroundColor3 = rimCol
E.line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.4 * clamp01(open * 11)
end
if open < 0.025 then
for i = 1, NS do
E.rim[i].Visible, E.scl[i].Visible, E.iri[i].Visible, E.pup[i].Visible = false, false, false, false
end
E.hl.Visible, E.hl2.Visible = false, false
return
end
local Bh = math.max(1, EW * 0.21 * open)
local RR = (A * A / Bh + Bh) * 0.5
local dd = (A * A / Bh - Bh) * 0.5
local h = (2 * Bh) / NS
for i = 1, NS do
local y = (i - (NS + 1) / 2) * h
local ay = math.abs(y)
local w2 = RR * RR - (ay + dd) * (ay + dd)
local w = w2 > 0 and math.sqrt(w2) or 0
local rim, sc, iv, pu = E.rim[i], E.scl[i], E.iri[i], E.pup[i]
if w < 0.6 then
rim.Visible, sc.Visible, iv.Visible, pu.Visible = false, false, false, false
else
local k = ay / Bh
rim.Visible = true
rim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
rim.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * w + 8, h + 5)
rim.BackgroundColor3 = rimCol
rim.BackgroundTransparency = rimT
sc.Visible = true
sc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
sc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * w, h + 1.5)
sc.BackgroundColor3 = sclCol:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55 * k * k)
local dy = y - iy
if math.abs(dy) < ir then
local ch = math.sqrt(ir * ir - dy * dy)
local lo, hi = math.max(ix - ch, -w), math.min(ix + ch, w)
if hi - lo > 0.8 then
iv.Visible = true
iv.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((lo + hi) * 0.5, y)
iv.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hi - lo, h + 1.5)
local kk = math.abs(dy) / ir
iv.BackgroundColor3 = irisCol:Lerp(BLACK, 0.12 + 0.62 * kk * kk)
else
iv.Visible = false
end
else
iv.Visible = false
end
if math.abs(dy) < pry then
local pc = prx * math.sqrt(1 - (dy / pry) ^ 2)
local lo, hi = math.max(ix - pc, -w), math.min(ix + pc, w)
if hi - lo > 0.8 then
pu.Visible = true
pu.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((lo + hi) * 0.5, y)
pu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hi - lo, h + 1.5)
else
pu.Visible = false
end
else
pu.Visible = false
end
end
end
local hlOn = open > 0.55
E.hl.Visible, E.hl2.Visible = hlOn, hlOn
if hlOn then
E.hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ix - ir * 0.36, iy - ir * 0.4)
E.hl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ir * 0.3, ir * 0.3)
E.hl2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ix + ir * 0.3, iy + ir * 0.34)
E.hl2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ir * 0.14, ir * 0.14)
end
end
local function crack(n, amt)
for _ = 1, n do
local c = E.cracks[math.random(1, #E.cracks)]
c.tgt = math.min(S.sx * 0.5, c.tgt + S.sx * amt * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8))
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.modeAt = t
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if m == 2 then
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.eyeY
end
S.sp.tsc = {2.6, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.85 * I), S.zk - 0.2 * I, 40, 13 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = w * 0.09 end
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.sp.tsc = {1.9, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.25
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.8 * I), S.zk - 0.16 * I, 36, 12 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 950, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 650, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.35 * I), S.zk + 0.04 * I, 20, 5 * I
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 800, 1.1, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.05, 0.8)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = 0 end
itick(0.7, 0.9)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.1 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.mk = S.mk + 0.05 * k
S.pk, S.vk = 1, 1
S.zk = S.zk - 0.05 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1.1 + k) * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.008 * k * I
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (4 + 4 * k) * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 10 * k
if m == 3 then S.stormK = 1 end
itick(0.55, 0.8)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 460 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.04, 0.35) end
if k > 1 and (m == 2 or m == 3) then crack(1, 0.07) end
end
local function hatHit(m)
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.45)
if m >= 2 and #E.rain > 0 then E.rain[math.random(1, #E.rain)].fl = 1 end
end
local function accHit(k, m, col)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.25 + 0.15 * k)
S.fl, S.gl = 1, 1
S.mk = S.mk + 0.015 * k
S.zk = S.zk - 0.01 * k * I
if m == 1 and spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 260 + 90 * k, 0.8, 2, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if m == 3 then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.2 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.stormK = math.max(S.stormK, 0.35 * k)
end
end
local function vocHit(t, m)
local I = K.INT
S.blinkT, S.capT = t, t
local list = CAPS[m] or CAPS[1]
S.capN = (S.capN % #list) + 1
S.capTxt = list[S.capN]
S.gtx = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.35 + 0.5 * math.random())
S.gty = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.6)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 6
if m == 4 then S.zk = S.zk - 0.02 * I end
itick(1.35, 0.5)
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < M3 and 2 or (t < M4 and 3 or 4))
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u4 = clamp01((t - B(30)) / (K.DUR - B(30)))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(MODEC[mode], ck)
S.ic = S.ic:Lerp(IRISC[mode], 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(SKYT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(SKYB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
local inCut, bigCut = false, false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then
inCut = true
bigCut = (c[2] - c[1]) > 0.5
end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + (bigCut and 24 or 10)
S.zk = S.zk + (bigCut and 0.06 or 0.02) * K.INT
if bigCut then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 7, 0.1, 0.7) end
end
S.inCut, S.bigCut = inCut, bigCut
S.ecl = lerp(S.ecl, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 26 or 12) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx, sy)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.4 or 1.1, 0.25)
if beatIdx >= 28 and beatIdx <= 31 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 28), 0.8) end
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.stormK = S.stormK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.mk = S.mk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.pk = S.pk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.vk = S.vk * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.rainK = S.rainK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.fl = S.fl * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.gl = S.gl * math.exp(-6 * dt)
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.hi < #HAT and t >= HAT[S.hi + 1][1] do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.3 then hatHit(mode) end
end
while S.ai < #ACC and t >= ACC[S.ai + 1][1] do
S.ai = S.ai + 1
if t - ACC[S.ai][1] < 0.3 then accHit(ACC[S.ai][2], mode, col) end
end
while S.vi < #VOC and t >= VOC[S.vi + 1][1] do
S.vi = S.vi + 1
if t - VOC[S.vi][1] < 0.3 then vocHit(t, mode) end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, inCut and (bigCut and 0.3 or 0.6) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.br = lerp(S.br, mode == 1 and (0.3 + 0.45 * u1) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
local br = S.br * (1 - 0.8 * S.ecl)
local EWb = math.min(sx * 0.68, sy * 1.15)
local ewT, eyT, openT, prxT, pryT = 0.9, -sy * 0.08, 1, 0.34, 0.34
if mode == 1 then
local fb = clamp01((t - B(7)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 0.6 + 0.3 * u1
eyT = -sy * 0.03
openT = 0.03 + 0.6 * smooth(clamp01((t - 2.0) / 14.5)) + 0.37 * fb ^ 2 + 0.22 * S.fl
prxT = 0.36 - 0.22 * fb
pryT = prxT
elseif mode == 2 then
local q = clamp01((t - B(15)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 1
eyT = -sy * 0.1
openT = lerp(1, 0.32, smooth(q)) + 0.06 * S.pk
prxT = 0.34 + 0.5 * S.pk
pryT = prxT
elseif mode == 3 then
local q = clamp01((t - B(23)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 0.88
eyT = sy * 0.07
openT = lerp(1.06, 0.7, q) + 0.06 * S.pk
prxT = 0.1 + 0.2 * S.pk
pryT = 0.97
else
ewT = 0.92 + 5.5 * u4 ^ 3
eyT = -sy * 0.06 * (1 - u4)
openT = 0.86 + 0.14 * S.pk + 0.3 * u4
prxT = 0.36 + 0.4 * S.pk + 0.55 * u4
pryT = prxT
end
local blink = blinkMul(S.blinkT, t)
local ew = follow("ew", ewT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0.6) * EWb * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse + S.mk)
local ey = follow("ey", eyT, 8, 0.8, dt, -sy * 0.03)
local open = follow("eo", openT, 16, 0.62, dt, 0) * blink * (1 - S.ecl)
open = math.clamp(open, 0, 1.4)
S.eyeY = ey
local irS = ew * 0.2
S.gtx = S.gtx * math.exp(-(mode == 1 and 0.9 or 3) * dt)
S.gty = S.gty * math.exp(-(mode == 1 and 0.9 or 3) * dt)
local wander = (mode == 1) and 1 or ((mode == 4) and 0.35 or 0.12)
local gx = follow("gx", S.gtx + math.sin(t * 0.45) * 0.35 * wander, 16, 0.55, dt, 0)
local gy = follow("gy", S.gty + math.sin(t * 0.31) * 0.2 * wander, 16, 0.55, dt, 0)
local ix, iy = gx * (ew * 0.5 - irS) * 0.8, gy * ew * 0.05
local prx = follow("prx", prxT, 14, 0.6, dt, 0.34) * irS
local pry = follow("pry", pryT, 14, 0.6, dt, 0.34) * irS
local irisCol = S.ic:Lerp(BLACK, (1 - br) * 0.75 + 0.06):Lerp(WHITE, (mode == 4 and 0.55 * u4 ^ 2 or 0) + 0.12 * S.gl)
local rimCol = (mode == 3) and EMER or col
local sclCol = Color3.fromRGB(10, 16, 14):Lerp(S.ic, 0.1 + 0.14 * S.pulse)
drawEye(ew, open, ix, iy, irS, prx, pry, irisCol, rimCol, sclCol, math.clamp(0.55 - 0.25 * S.pulse - 0.2 * S.lv, 0.1, 0.8))
E.eye.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
local eyeVis = (t > 0.25)
for i, hh in ipairs(E.halo) do
hh.Visible = eyeVis and open > 0.05
local hs = ew * (0.7 + 0.35 * (i - 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.12 * S.mk)
hh.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
hh.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hs, hs * 0.62)
hh.BackgroundColor3 = S.ic:Lerp(col, 0.4)
hh.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - br * (0.08 + 0.07 * S.lv + 0.09 * S.pulse) / i, 0.6, 1)
end
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 1 + 0.04 * u1 + 0.18 * u1 ^ 3
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1)
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
elseif mode == 2 then
tz = 1.03 + 0.05 * S.ecl
tr = ((math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1) * 1.1 * K.INT
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
local u3 = clamp01((t - M3) / (M4 - M3))
tx = math.sin(u3 * 6.283) * sx * 0.04
tr = math.sin(u3 * 6.283 + 1.2) * 1.8 * K.INT
tz = 1.05 + 0.03 * math.sin(u3 * 12.566) + 0.04 * S.ecl
else
tz = 1.02 + 0.04 * clamp01((t - M4) / (K.DUR - M4)) + 0.25 * u4 ^ 3
tr = math.sin((t - M4) * 0.35) * 1.4 * K.INT * (1 - u4)
end
local hk = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 0.7 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk
local kd = math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)

b.zi = zi
b.f.ZIndex = zi
end

b.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 * S.ecl

b.ir.BackgroundColor3 = (mode == 3) and CRIM or b.pc

end

want = scr(NAME, (t - TN) / (K.BEAT * 1.5))
else

end

"> JEALOUSY.EXE  ONLINE", "> TARGET  ACQUIRED", "> HEARTBEAT  " .. string.format("%d", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 106.92) + 0.5)) .. " BPM",
"> ENVY  LEVEL  RISING", "> " .. modStatus(), "> SOMEONE  IS  WATCHING",

end
if bt >= 28 then out[#out + 1] = "> DROP IN " .. (32 - beatIdx) end
E.term.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")

E.term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.2)

else
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa)), 1 - flashA
end
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 3 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()

end)
return true
end

function FX.Intro4(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
FX.IntroCamBusy = true
FX.IntroActive = true
opts = opts or {}
local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro4Data, opts.Song or {}
local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.15, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 124), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 40 * K.BAR
local function B(n)
return K.OFF + n * K.BAR
end
local M2, MB, MR, M3, MF = B(4), B(20), B(24), B(28), B(36)

if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local HERO, CREATOR = "LIL PEEP", "STEVETHEREALONE"
local SUB = (CFG.IntroSub ~= "" and tostring(CFG.IntroSub):gsub("[^\32-\126]", ""):sub(1, 80)) or string.format("LIL PEEP  //  NUTS  //  %d BPM", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 124) + 0.5))
local conns, E = {}, {}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local PINK, ICE, VIO, HOT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 168), Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 214)
local MODEC = {ICE, PINK, VIO, HOT}
local SKYT = {Color3.fromRGB(1, 2, 7), Color3.fromRGB(7, 0, 15), Color3.fromRGB(2, 2, 12), Color3.fromRGB(15, 0, 24)}
local SKYB = {Color3.fromRGB(7, 17, 32), Color3.fromRGB(78, 8, 66), Color3.fromRGB(22, 18, 66), Color3.fromRGB(128, 14, 98)}
local CAPS = {
{"HELLO?", "STATIC", "ANYBODY", "NIGHT"},
{"ECHOES", "DRIFTING", "NIGHT", "FADING", "ALONE"},
{"STILL HERE", "BREATHE", "HOLLOW", "STAY"},
{"LOUDER", "ALIVE", "FOREVER", "NEON", "STAR"},
}
local S = {
began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, tokens = 3, pulse = 0, zk = 0, rk = 0, xk = 0,
flashK = 0, shake = 0, chroma = 0, bi = -1, ei = 0, si = 0, hi = 0, vi = 0, mi = 0, ts = 1, lv = 0, sp = {}, dir = 1, fallback = false,
hk = 0, sk = 0, rainK = 0, starK = 0, capT = -10, capN = 0, capTxt = "", blk = 0, cutK = 0, inCut = false, dubAt = -1, hist = {}, histT = 0,
winOn = false, winT = 0, eyeY = 0, sx = 800, sy = 450, mode = 0, mc = ICE, bgT = SKYT[1], bgB = SKYB[1], hero = "",
}
local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, SNARE, HAT, VOC, CUTS = parse(D.bass), parse(D.snare), parse(D.hat), parse(D.voc), parseCut(D.cut)
local CARDWIN = {{B(29), B(30) + 0.8 * K.BAR}, {B(31), B(32) + 0.8 * K.BAR}, {B(33), B(34) + 0.8 * K.BAR}}
local MIL = {B(12), MR, B(32), MF}
local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {

ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function heart(parent, z, rc, dc)
local function parts(c, zz, col)
local a = {}
a[1] = box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.537), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0)
a[1].Rotation = 45
a[2] = round(box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.3232, 0.3602), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0))
a[3] = round(box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.6768, 0.3602), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0))
return a
end
local rimC = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1)
local darkC = box(parent, z + 1, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.86), WHITE, 1)
return parts(rimC, z, rc), parts(darkC, z + 1, dc)
end

local function crack(n, amt)
for _ = 1, n do
local c = E.cracks[math.random(1, #E.cracks)]
c.tgt = math.min(S.sx * 0.5, c.tgt + S.sx * amt * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8))
end
end
local function paint(list, col, tr)
for _, f in ipairs(list) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w)
local I = K.INT
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if m == 2 then
S.winOn, S.winT = true, t
S.hk = 1.4
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I), S.zk + 0.45 * I, 40, 14 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.winOn = false
S.blk, S.chroma, S.shake, S.zk = 1, 22, 7 * I, S.zk - 0.06 * I
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = 0 end
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 700, 1.2, 3, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.05, 0.9)
itick(0.4, 0.9)
elseif m == 4 then
S.winOn, S.winT = true, t
S.hk = 1.6
S.sp.tsc = {2.4, 0}
for _, b in ipairs(E.minis) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.eyeY
end
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I), S.zk + 0.55 * I, 44, 16 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 30, 340, 1)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 1000, 0.9, 7, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 700, 0.75, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.04, 0.7)
itick(0.5, 1)
end
end
local function milestone(i, col, w)
local I = K.INT
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if i == 1 then
S.flashK, S.xk, S.zk, S.chroma, S.starK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I), S.xk + w * 0.09 * I, S.zk + 0.25 * I, 30, 1
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 560, 0.7, 3, mp)
itick(0.7, 1)
elseif i == 2 then
S.zk, S.chroma, S.starK = S.zk - 0.1 * I, 20, 1
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 900, 1.2, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.05, 0.8)
itick(0.8, 0.9)
elseif i == 3 then
S.flashK, S.xk, S.zk, S.chroma = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I), S.xk - w * 0.09 * I, S.zk + 0.3 * I, 30
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 560, 0.7, 3, mp)
itick(0.7, 1)
else
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.55 * I), S.zk - 0.15 * I, 40, 10 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 1000, 1, 6, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.05, 0.8)
itick(0.6, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w)
local I = K.INT
if m == 1 then S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.5) return end
local dmp = (m == 3 and t < MR) and 0.4 or 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.08 + 0.1 * k) * I * dmp)
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, dmp)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.04 * k * I * dmp
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1 + k) * I * dmp
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.007 * k * I * dmp
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (3 + 4 * k) * I * dmp)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 9 * k * dmp
itick(0.55, 0.8 * dmp)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 420 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.04, 0.35) end
if k > 1 and m ~= 3 then crack(1, 0.07) end
end
local function snareHit(k, m, col)
if m == 1 then return end
S.sk = 1
S.zk = S.zk - 0.025 * K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * K.INT)
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.6)
if k > 1 and spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 8, 220, 0.5) end
end
local function hatHit()
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.4)
S.starK = math.min(1, S.starK + 0.15)
E.rain[math.random(1, #E.rain)].fl = 1
for _ = 1, 2 do
E.win[math.random(1, #E.win)].fl = 1
end
end
local function vocHit(t, m)
local I = K.INT
S.capT = t
local list = CAPS[m] or CAPS[1]
S.capN = (S.capN % #list) + 1
S.capTxt = list[S.capN]
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.6)
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.45)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 7
S.xk = S.xk + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * S.sx * 0.012 * I
itick(1.35, 0.5)
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < MB and 2 or (t < M3 and 3 or 4))
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local fb = clamp01((t - B(3)) / K.BAR)
local u3 = clamp01((t - MB) / (MR - MB))
local ur = clamp01((t - MR) / (M3 - MR))
local u4 = clamp01((t - MF) / (K.DUR - MF))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(MODEC[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(SKYT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(SKYB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
local inCut = false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then inCut = true end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + 14
S.zk = S.zk + 0.03 * K.INT
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.06, 0.4) end
end
S.inCut = inCut
S.cutK = lerp(S.cutK, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 26 or 12) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.4 or 1.1, 0.25)
if beatIdx >= 12 and beatIdx <= 15 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 12), 0.8) end
if beatIdx % 2 == 0 then
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.5 + 0.03 * beatIdx)
S.dubAt = t + K.BEAT * 0.38
end
elseif mode == 3 and t >= B(27) then
S.capT, S.capTxt = t, tostring(112 - beatIdx)
itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 108), 0.8)
end
end
if S.dubAt > 0 and t >= S.dubAt then
S.dubAt = -1
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.4)
end
local ex = math.exp
S.pulse = S.pulse * ex(-5 * dt)
S.hk = S.hk * ex(-7 * dt)
S.sk = S.sk * ex(-9 * dt)
S.rainK = S.rainK * ex(-6 * dt)
while S.mi < #MIL and t >= MIL[S.mi + 1] do
S.mi = S.mi + 1
if t - MIL[S.mi] < 0.3 then milestone(S.mi, col, sx) end
end
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx) end
end
while S.si < #SNARE and t >= SNARE[S.si + 1][1] do
S.si = S.si + 1
if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.3 then snareHit(SNARE[S.si][2], mode, col) end
end
while S.hi < #HAT and t >= HAT[S.hi + 1][1] do

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function eo3(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function eio(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function eob(x)
local c1 = 1.70158
local c3 = c1 + 1
return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 24, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function kick(key, v)
local st = S.sp[key]
if st then st[2] = st[2] + v end
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, NOTE, SHIM = parse(D.bass), parse(D.note), parse(D.shim)
local LEVEL = tostring(D.level)
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 20
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
if not a then return 0 end
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 7)
end

ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function stroke(f, th, col, tr)
return mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = th, Color = col or WHITE, Transparency = tr or 0.5})
end
local function seq(a, b, c)
return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)})
end
local function grad(f, rot, c0, c1, ts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
if c0 then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0) end
if ts then g.Transparency = ts end
return g
end
local function makeRing(parent, z, n, ratio, thick)
local c = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 * ratio), WHITE, 1)
c.Visible = false
local R, segs = 0.46, {}
for i = 1, n do
local th = (i - 0.5) / n * math.pi * 2
local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
local tx, ty = -sn, ratio * cs
local len = math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) * (math.pi * 2 / n) * R * 1.3
local f = box(c, z, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + R * cs, 0.5 + R * sn), UDim2.new(len, 0, 0, thick), WHITE, 0)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ty, tx))
segs[i] = f
end
return {c = c, segs = segs, ratio = ratio, on = false, trl = -1}
end

local ch = TITLE:sub(i, i)
if ch ~= " " then
local l = txt(stage, 24, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(60, 80), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
l.Text = ch
l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
E.letters[#E.letters + 1] = {f = l, us = Util.Instance("UIScale", l), ci = i, x = 0, y = 0}
end
end
E.sub = txt(stage, 24, Enum.Font.Code, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.cap = txt(stage, 23, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.18), UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.name = txt(stage, 25, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, 80), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.name.TextColor3 = C(30, 12, 60)
E.nameSub = txt(stage, 25, Enum.Font.Code, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58), UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.nameSub.TextColor3 = C(60, 30, 100)
E.flash = box(stage, 40, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1)
do local ok, up = pcall(FX.IntroUpgrade, stage, E, 5, {M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9}, K, 24) if ok and type(up) == "function" then E.up = up end end
local function hud(ax, ay, pos, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = xa, ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
end
E.tc = hud(0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.np = hud(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.ms = hud(1, 1, UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
E.prog = box(stage, 22, 0, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3), WHITE, 0)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {
Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 90), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 16,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI",
ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
})
E.skipS = mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function()
S.skipped = true
end)
local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", E.skip)
E.skip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.07, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.88}) end
end)
E.skip.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end)
E.world.Visible = false
end
local function ringSlot(list)
local best = list[1]
for _, r in ipairs(list) do
if not r.on then return r end
if r.t0 < best.t0 then best = r end
end
return best
end
local function ringGo(r, x, y, rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1, follow, rel)
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.rad0, r.rad1, r.rev, r.tilt0, r.tilt1, r.follow, r.rel = true, S.t, life, x, y, rad0, rad1, rev, tilt0 or 0, tilt1 or 0, follow, rel
r.c.Visible = true
r.trl = -1
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
end
end
local function flat(x, y, w, life, col, rel)
ringGo(ringSlot(E.flat), x, y, w * 0.08, w, life, col, false, 0, 0, false, rel)
end
local function orbit(rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1)
if not rev then
if S.t - S.lastRing < 0.3 then return end
S.lastRing = S.t
end
ringGo(ringSlot(E.orbR), 0, 0, rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1, true, false)
end
local function bubble(x, y, r, vy)
for _, b in ipairs(E.bub) do
if not b.on then
b.on, b.x, b.y, b.r, b.vy, b.ph, b.wob = true, x, y, r, vy, math.random() * 6.28, 6 + math.random() * 14
b.f.Visible = true
b.s.Color = accent()
return
end
end
end
local function crown(n, x, y, spd, rel, col)
for _ = 1, n do
for _, c in ipairs(E.crown) do
if not c.on then
local a = -math.pi / 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.9
local v = spd * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.6)
c.on, c.x, c.y, c.vx, c.vy, c.sz, c.rel, c.age = true, x, y, math.cos(a) * v, math.sin(a) * v, 3 + math.random() * 5, rel, 0
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
c.f.Visible = true
break
end
end
end
end
local function drip(x, y)
for _, d in ipairs(E.drip) do
if not d.on then
d.on, d.x, d.y, d.vy = true, x, y, 0
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = accent()
d.f.Visible = true
return
end
end
end
local function glint(x, y)
for _, g in ipairs(E.glint) do
if not g.on then
g.on, g.x, g.y, g.t0, g.w = true, x, y, S.t, 10 + math.random() * 30
g.f.Visible = true
return
end
end
end
local function updRings(list, t)
for _, r in ipairs(list) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.c.Visible = false
else
local e = r.rev and (u * u) or eo3(u)
local rad = r.rad0 + (r.rad1 - r.rad0) * e
local tr = r.rev and (0.85 - 0.75 * u) or (0.1 + 0.9 * u)
local cx, cy = r.x, r.y
if r.follow then
cx, cy = S.ox, S.oy
elseif r.rel then
cy = cy + (S.surfPx - S.sy * 0.64)
end
local W = rad / 0.46
r.c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
r.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, W * r.ratio)
r.c.Rotation = lerp(r.tilt0, r.tilt1, u)
if math.abs(r.trl - tr) > 0.02 then
r.trl = tr
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
end
end
end
end
local function paint(list, col, tr)
for _, f in ipairs(list) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local function curTideTop(t)
if t < M5 then return 1.4 end
local pts = {{M5, 0.8}, {M6, 0.66}, {M7, 0.54}, {M8, 0.4}, {M9, -0.4}}
for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
if t < pts[i + 1][1] then
return lerp(pts[i][2], pts[i + 1][2], smooth(clamp01((t - pts[i][1]) / (pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1]))))
end
end
return -0.4
end
local function onMode(m, t, col)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.95 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.3 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 4 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.shake = S.shake + 14 * I
S.pulse, S.aura, S.vizK = 1, 1, 1
local sxm, sy0 = sx * 0.5, sy * 0.64
flat(sxm, sy0, sx * 1.1, 2.2, WHITE, true)
flat(sxm, sy0, sx * 0.62, 1.6, col, true)
orbit(S.R * 0.6, S.R * 7, 1.8, WHITE, false, 0, 30)
crown(14, sxm, sy0, sy * 1.15, true, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
for i = 1, 12 do
bubble(sxm + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.3, sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.4), 4 + math.random() * 12, sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.25))
end
E.term.Text = ""
itick(0.5, 1.2)
itick(1.6, 0.8)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.04, 0.9) end
elseif m == 3 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.12 * I)
orbit(S.R * 0.8, S.R * 4.5, 1.6, col, false, -10, 20)
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.04 * I
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.34 * I
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.03 * I
S.rk = S.rk - 5 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 16 * I
S.pulse, S.aura, S.vizK, S.ts, S.surge = 1, 1, 1, 1, 1
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 5.5, 1.5, col, false, 0, 40)
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 8.5, 1.9, WHITE, false, 10, -30)
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 3.6, 1.1, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), false, -20, 50)
crown(12, S.ox, S.oy, sy * 0.9, false, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
for i = 1, 10 do
bubble(sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), sy * 1.05, 4 + math.random() * 12, sy * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.4))
end
S.sp.tide = {1.25, 0}
S.sp.rail = {0.2, 0}
itick(0.55, 1.2)
itick(1.2, 0.9)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.8) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 14, 380, 0.9) end
elseif m == 6 or m == 7 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.4 * I)
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * sx * 0.2 * I
S.rk = S.rk - S.dir * 6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.zk = S.zk + 0.12 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * I
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 1, S.R * 6, 1.4, col, false, 0, -35)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.05, 0.7) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 10, 320, 0.8) end
itick(0.7, 1)
elseif m == 8 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.06 * I
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 1.2, S.R * 9, 2.0, WHITE, false, 0, 25)
itick(0.8, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(t, k, mode)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, k == 2 and 0.9 or 0.35)
S.aura = math.max(S.aura, k == 2 and 0.9 or 0.4)
if mode == 1 then
S.hz = math.max(S.hz, k == 2 and 1 or 0.5)
return
end
if mode == 4 then
for _, h in ipairs(REV) do
if math.abs(t - h) < 0.1 then
S.pk = S.pk + 1
kick("sq", 3.4)
S.vizK = 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.14 * I)
S.aura = 1
orbit(S.R * 0.5, S.R * 2.6, 0.9, accent(), false, 15, 35)
itick(1 + 0.16 * S.pk, 0.9)
return
end
end
return
end
kick("sq", k == 2 and 2.2 or 0.9)
S.vizK = math.min(1, S.vizK + (k == 2 and 0.6 or 0.25))
if mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
S.surge = math.min(1, S.surge + (k == 2 and 0.7 or 0.25))
local th = E.thr[math.random(1, #E.thr)]
th.tp, th.ap = t, sy * (k == 2 and 0.09 or 0.04)
end
if k == 2 then
if mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
S.bulgeT = t
S.shake = S.shake + 3 * I
S.zk = S.zk - 0.014 * I
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
if t > TT + 0.4 and t < M8 and #E.letters > 0 then
local L = E.letters[math.random(1, #E.letters)]
drip(L.x, L.y + S.tsz * 0.4)
end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, accent(), 5, 240, 0.5) end
end
if mode ~= 8 then orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * (3.4 + math.random() * 1.8), 1.1, accent(), false, math.random(-35, 35), math.random(-35, 35)) end
end
end
local function noteHit(t, k, mode)
S.noteK = 1
if mode == 2 or mode == 3 then
if k == 2 and spend(1) then
local a = math.random() * 6.283
bubble(S.ox + math.cos(a) * S.R * 0.9, S.oy + math.sin(a) * S.R * 0.9, 4 + math.random() * 10, S.sy * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.14))
end
elseif mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
if k == 2 and spend(1) then
bubble(S.sx * (0.05 + math.random() * 0.9), S.sy * (S.tide + 0.04), 4 + math.random() * 9, S.sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.2))
end
end
end
local function shimHit(t, k, mode)
S.shim = 1
if mode == 1 then
glint(S.sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), S.sy * (0.66 + math.random() * 0.2))
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I = K.INT
local mode = (t < M2 and 1) or (t < M3 and 2) or (t < M4 and 3) or (t < M5 and 4) or (t < M6 and 5) or (t < M7 and 6) or (t < M8 and 7) or 8
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local R = math.min(sy * 0.125, sx * 0.2)
S.R = R
local u8 = clamp01((t - M8) / (M9 - M8))
local u9 = clamp01((t - M9) / (K.DUR - M9))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(PA[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(PB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, mode == 4 and 0.1 or 1, 1 - math.exp(-2.2 * dt))
S.vt = S.vt + dt * S.ts
local vt = S.vt
local lvT = lvAt(t)
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvT, 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
local lv = S.lv
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 0.8 or 0.4)
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.3 or 1.0, 0.22)
local line = TERM[beatIdx]
if line then S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = line end
if beatIdx >= 12 and beatIdx <= 15 then
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = "> " .. tostring(16 - beatIdx)
itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 12), 0.8)
end
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local ev = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then bassHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while NOTE[S.noteI] and NOTE[S.noteI][1] <= t do
local ev = NOTE[S.noteI]
S.noteI = S.noteI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then noteHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while SHIM[S.shimI] and SHIM[S.shimI][1] <= t do
local ev = SHIM[S.shimI]
S.shimI = S.shimI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then shimHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while S.dn <= 11 and K.OFF + S.dn * K.BEAT - 0.5 <= t do
for _, d in ipairs(E.drops) do
if not d.on then
d.on, d.L, d.x, d.big = true, K.OFF + S.dn * K.BEAT, sx * (0.18 + math.random() * 0.64), (S.dn % 4 == 0)
d.f.Visible = true
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
break
end
end
S.dn = S.dn + 1
end
while REV[S.revI] and REV[S.revI] - 1.25 <= t do
if t < REV[S.revI] then
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * (5.4 - 0.4 * S.revI), S.R * 0.55, 1.25, WHITE, true, -30 + 22 * S.revI, 10 * S.revI)
end
S.revI = S.revI + 1
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-4.2 * dt)
S.aura = S.aura * math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.xk = S.xk * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
S.yk = S.yk * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.vizK = S.vizK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.surge = S.surge * math.exp(-3.2 * dt)
S.shim = S.shim * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.noteK = S.noteK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.hz = S.hz * math.exp(-5 * dt)
local pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, 0, 0, 1
if mode == 1 then
pxT, pyT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.4) * sx * 0.012, math.sin(vt * 0.31) * sy * 0.008, 1 + 0.07 * clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
elseif mode == 2 then
pxT, pyT, rollT = math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.012, 0, 0
elseif mode == 3 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.25) * sx * 0.03, math.sin(vt * 0.2) * sy * 0.02, math.sin(vt * 0.22) * 1.6, 1 + 0.02 * math.sin(vt * 0.4)
elseif mode == 4 then
zT = 1.04
elseif mode == 5 then
pxT, pyT, rollT = math.cos(vt * 0.35) * sx * 0.03, math.sin(vt * 0.3) * sy * 0.015, math.sin(vt * 0.3) * 2.5
elseif mode == 6 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.cos(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.05, math.sin(vt * 0.42) * sy * 0.025, math.sin(vt * 0.45) * 4, 1.03
elseif mode == 7 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.045, math.cos(vt * 0.4) * sy * 0.025, math.cos(vt * 0.5) * 3, 1.05
else
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, 0, u8 * 5 * (1 - u9), 1.05 + 0.22 * smooth(u8) - 0.1 * u9
end
local shk = S.shake
local cx = follow("cx", (pxT + S.xk) * I + (math.random() - 0.5) * shk, 5, 0.85, dt, 0)
local cy = follow("cy", (pyT + S.yk) * I + (math.random() - 0.5) * shk, 5, 0.85, dt, 0)
local cr = follow("cr", rollT * I + S.rk, 5, 0.8, dt, 0)
local cz = follow("cz", zT + S.zk, 6, 0.8, dt, 1)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx, 0.5, cy)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = cz
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(S.bgT, S.bgB)
local surf
if mode == 1 then
surf = 0.64 + 0.004 * math.sin(vt * 1.3)
elseif mode == 2 then
surf = lerp(0.64, -0.7, eio(clamp01((t - M2) / 1.5)))
else
surf = -1
end
local surfPx = surf * sy
S.surfPx = surfPx
if surf > -0.55 then
E.sky.Visible, E.hz.Visible, E.hzGlow.Visible, E.sheen.Visible = true, true, true, true
E.sky.Position, E.sky.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, surfPx), UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 1.9, sy * 1.2)
E.hzGlow.Position, E.hzGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, surfPx), UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 1.5, sy * 0.1)
E.hzGlow.BackgroundColor3 = col

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function eo3(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function eio(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 24, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, NOTE, SHIM, FOOT = parse(D.bass), parse(D.note), parse(D.shim), parse(D.foot)
local LEVEL = tostring(D.level)
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 20
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
if not a then return 0 end
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end

ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local sw0 = Util.GetScreenSize()
local U0 = math.min(sw0.X, sw0.Y)
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function stroke(f, th, col, tr)
return mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = th, Color = col or WHITE, Transparency = tr or 0.5})
end
local function grad(f, rot, c0, c1, ts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
if c0 then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0) end
if ts then g.Transparency = ts end
return g
end
local function seq3(a, b, c)
return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)})
end
local function makeRing(parent, z, n, ratio, thick)
local c = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 * ratio), WHITE, 1)
c.Visible = false
local R, segs = 0.46, {}
for i = 1, n do
local th = (i - 0.5) / n * math.pi * 2
local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
local tx, ty = -sn, ratio * cs
local len = math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) * (math.pi * 2 / n) * R * 1.3
local f = box(c, z, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + R * cs, 0.5 + R * sn), UDim2.new(len, 0, 0, thick), WHITE, 0)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ty, tx))
segs[i] = f
end
return {c = c, segs = segs, ratio = ratio, on = false}
end

E.rim = box(stage, 14, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.5), WHITE, 1)
E.rimS = stroke(E.rim, 3, BONE, 0.2)
E.vig = {}
for i, d in ipairs({{0.5, 0, 0.5, 0, 1, 0.3, 90}, {0.5, 1, 0.5, 1, 1, 0.3, 270}, {0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.2, 1, 0}, {1, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.2, 1, 180}}) do
local f = box(stage, 15, d[1], d[2], UDim2.fromScale(d[3], d[4]), UDim2.fromScale(d[5], d[6]), BLACK, 0.5)
grad(f, d[7], nil, nil, NumberSequence.new(0, 1))
E.vig[i] = f
end
E.grain = {}
for i = 1, 22 do E.grain[i] = box(stage, 16, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), math.random()), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), WHITE, 0.82) end
E.scan = box(stage, 16, 0, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0, -0.1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), WHITE, 0.93)
E.dip = box(stage, 19, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BLACK, 1)
E.barT = box(stage, 20, 0.5, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.barB = box(stage, 20, 0.5, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.letters = {}
for i = 1, #TITLE do
local ch = TITLE:sub(i, i)
local function lab(z)
local l = txt(stage, z, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(60, 90), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
l.Text = ch
l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
return l
end
local g1, g2, l = lab(23), lab(23), lab(24)
g1.TextColor3, g2.TextColor3, l.TextColor3 = C(60, 255, 214), C(255, 196, 64), BLOOD
l.TextStrokeColor3 = C(20, 0, 2)
l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
local drip = round(box(stage, 23, 0.5, 0, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BLOOD, 1))
E.letters[i] = {f = l, g1 = g1, g2 = g2, drip = drip, us = Util.Instance("UIScale", l), us1 = Util.Instance("UIScale", g1), us2 = Util.Instance("UIScale", g2),
lt = LT0 + (i - 1) * K.BEAT, fall = M7 + (i - 1) * 0.16, len = 0.05 + math.random() * 0.09, ch = ch}
end
E.sub = txt(stage, 24, Enum.Font.Code, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.cap = txt(stage, 23, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.17), UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, 40), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.name = txt(stage, 25, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, 80), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.nameS = mk("UIStroke", E.name, {Thickness = 2, Color = BLOOD, Transparency = 0.3})
E.nameSub = txt(stage, 25, Enum.Font.Code, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58), UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
E.flashB = box(stage, 39, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), C(196, 222, 255), 1)
E.flash = box(stage, 40, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1)
do local ok, up = pcall(FX.IntroUpgrade, stage, E, 6, {M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8}, K, 24) if ok and type(up) == "function" then E.up = up end end
local function hud(ax, ay, pos, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = xa, ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
end
E.tc = hud(0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.np = hud(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.ms = hud(1, 1, UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
E.prog = box(stage, 22, 0, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3), WHITE, 0)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {
Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 90), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 16,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI",
ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
})
E.skipS = mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function()
S.skipped = true
end)

E.skip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.07, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.88}) end
end)
E.skip.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end

local function ringE(x, y, r0, r1, life, col)
local r = E.ringE[1]
for _, q in ipairs(E.ringE) do
if not q.on then r = q break end
end
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1 = true, S.t, life, x, y, r0, r1
r.c.Visible = true
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
local function ringC(x, y, r0, r1, life, col)
local r = E.ringC[1]
for _, q in ipairs(E.ringC) do
if not q.on then r = q break end
end
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1 = true, S.t, life, x, y, r0, r1
r.f.Visible = true
r.s.Color = col
end
local function eye(x, y, sz, col)
if S.t - S.lastEye < 0.25 then return end
for _, e in ipairs(E.eye) do
if not e.on then
e.on, e.t0, e.life, e.x, e.y, e.sz, e.ph = true, S.t, 2.6 + math.random() * 1.6, x, y, sz, math.random() * 3
e.c.Visible = true
for s = 1, 2 do
e.pair[s].g.BackgroundColor3 = col
e.pair[s].e.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
end
S.lastEye = S.t
return
end
end
end
local function bat(dirn)
if S.t - S.lastBat < 0.12 then return end
for _, b in ipairs(E.bat) do
if not b.on then
b.on, b.t0, b.life, b.dir = true, S.t, 3.6 + math.random() * 1.4, dirn or (math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1)
b.x0 = b.dir > 0 and -S.sx * 0.05 or S.sx * 1.05
b.y0 = S.sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.4)
b.sp = S.sx * (0.2 + math.random() * 0.16)
b.sc = 0.7 + math.random() * 0.9
b.ph = math.random() * 6.28
b.c.Visible = true
S.lastBat = S.t
return
end
end
end
local function seg(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 2, th)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function bolt(xf, power)
local b = E.bolt[1].on and E.bolt[2] or E.bolt[1]
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
local pts, x, y = {}, sx * xf, -sy * 0.05
local step = (sy * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.1)) / 7
for i = 1, 8 do
pts[i] = {x, y}
x = x + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.09
y = y + step
end
local n = 0
for i = 1, 7 do
n = n + 1
seg(b.segs[n], pts[i][1], pts[i][2], pts[i + 1][1], pts[i + 1][2], 3 + 3 * power)
end
local bx, by = pts[4][1], pts[4][2]
for _ = 1, 4 do
local nx, ny = bx + (math.random() - 0.3) * sx * 0.07, by + step * 0.8
n = n + 1
seg(b.segs[n], bx, by, nx, ny, 2)
bx, by = nx, ny
end
b.on, b.t0, b.n = true, S.t, n
end
local function doStrike(st)
local I = K.INT
bolt((st == M5 or st == M7) and 0.5 or (0.15 + math.random() * 0.7), 1)
S.boltK = 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * I
itick(0.35, 1.2)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.03, 0.5) end
end
local HB0, HBP = 17.64, K.BEAT * 2
local function slam(i, col)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.glitch = 1
S.zk = S.zk + 0.09 * K.INT
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.16 * K.INT)
S.pulse = 1
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.48, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.05, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.55, 0.6, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.2))
itick(0.6 + 0.07 * i, 1)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.03, 0.4) end
if i == 4 or i == 8 then
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, BLOOD:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3), 12, 340, 0.8) end
end
end
local function bassHit(t, k, mode)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.kickK = math.max(S.kickK, k == 2 and 1 or 0.5)
if mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.moonK = math.max(S.moonK, 0.6 * k)
for _, tb in ipairs(E.tomb) do tb.bounce = 1 end
if k == 2 then
ringE(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.88, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.08, math.min(sx, sy) * 1.1, 0.9, accent())
itick(0.5, 0.6)
end
end
end
local function noteHit(t, k, mode)
if mode == 4 then
S.noteK = 1
S.ember = 1
if k == 2 then bat() end
elseif mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, k == 2 and 0.8 or 0.3)
S.noteK = 1
end
end
local function shimHit(t, k, mode)
S.shim = 1
if (mode == 5 or mode == 6) and k == 2 and math.random() < 0.3 then bat() end
end
local function footHit(i)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.02 * K.INT
S.rk = S.rk + (i % 2 == 0 and 0.7 or -0.7) * K.INT
ringE(sx * (0.35 + 0.3 * (i % 2)), sy * 0.9, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.03, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.4, 0.8, accent())
itick(0.55, 0.9)
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = TERM[2 + i] or "> STEP"
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = BONE
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local function onMode(m, t, col)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
local U = math.min(sx, sy)
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.26 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 12 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 3 * I
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.5, U * 0.1, U * 1.3, 0.9, BONE)
bat(1)
itick(0.45, 1.2)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9) end
elseif m == 3 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.15 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.05 * I
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.2 * I)
S.rk = S.rk - 2 * I
bat(-1)
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.38 * I
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.03 * I
S.rk = S.rk - 5 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 18 * I
S.pulse, S.moonK, S.ts = 1, 1, 1
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.3, U * 0.2, U * 1.6, 1.2, BLOOD)
ringE(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.88, U * 0.1, U * 1.6, 1.2, BLOOD)
itick(0.5, 1.2)
itick(1.2, 0.9)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.04, 0.9) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, BLOOD:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4), 16, 420, 1.0) end
elseif m == 6 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * sx * 0.22 * I
S.rk = S.rk - S.dir * 6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.zk = S.zk + 0.12 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 9 * I
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.3, U * 0.2, U * 1.4, 1.0, col)
bat(1)
bat(-1)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.05, 0.7) end
elseif m == 7 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.6 * I)
S.shake = S.shake + 14 * I
S.zk = S.zk - 0.1 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I
itick(0.4, 1.2)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.05, 0.9) end
elseif m == 8 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.32, U * 0.2, U * 1.0, 1.4, PA[8])
itick(0.8, 0.8)
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I = K.INT
local mode = (t < M2 and 1) or (t < M3 and 2) or (t < M4 and 3) or (t < M5 and 4) or (t < M6 and 5) or (t < M7 and 6) or (t < M8 and 7) or 8
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local U = math.min(sx, sy)
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(PA[mode], ck)
S.mm = S.mm:Lerp(PM[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(PB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
S.vt = S.vt + dt
local vt = S.vt
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
local lv = S.lv
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
local down = (beatIdx % 4 == 0)
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, down and 0.8 or 0.4)
if mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.zk = S.zk + (down and 0.07 or 0.035) * I
S.shake = S.shake + (down and 4 or 2) * I
if down then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
end
itick(down and 1.4 or 1.0, 0.3)
elseif mode == 1 then
if beatIdx % 4 == 0 and beatIdx > 0 then itick(0.5, 0.25) end
local line = (beatIdx == 1 and TERM[1]) or (beatIdx == 8 and TERM[2]) or nil
if line then
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = line
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
end
end
if t >= HB0 and mode >= 3 and mode <= 4 then
local hb = math.floor((t - HB0) / HBP)
if hb ~= S.hbI then
S.hbI = hb
S.pulse, S.moonK = 1, 1
S.zk = S.zk + 0.035 * I
S.dubT = t + 0.2
itick(0.4, 1.1)
if mode == 3 then
eye(sx * (0.08 + math.random() * 0.84), sy * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.2), U * 0.03, col)
end
end
if S.dubT and t >= S.dubT then
S.dubT = nil
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.7)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.018 * I
itick(0.3, 0.9)
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local ev = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then bassHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while NOTE[S.noteI] and NOTE[S.noteI][1] <= t do
local ev = NOTE[S.noteI]
S.noteI = S.noteI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then noteHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while SHIM[S.shimI] and SHIM[S.shimI][1] <= t do
local ev = SHIM[S.shimI]
S.shimI = S.shimI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then shimHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while FOOT[S.footI] and FOOT[S.footI][1] <= t do
local ev = FOOT[S.footI]
local i = S.footI
S.footI = S.footI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.4 then footHit(i) end
end
while STRIKES[S.strikeI] and STRIKES[S.strikeI] <= t do
local st = STRIKES[S.strikeI]
S.strikeI = S.strikeI + 1
if t - st < 0.3 then doStrike(st) end
end
for i, L in ipairs(E.letters) do
if not L.hit and t >= L.lt and t - L.lt < 0.5 then
L.hit = true
slam(i, col)
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-4.2 * dt)
S.moonK = S.moonK * math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.xk = S.xk * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
S.yk = S.yk * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.boltK = S.boltK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.shim = S.shim * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.noteK = S.noteK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.glitch = S.glitch * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.kickK = S.kickK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.ember = S.ember * math.exp(-8 * dt)
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u4 = clamp01((t - M4) / (M5 - M4))
local u7 = clamp01((t - M7) / (M8 - M7))
local pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, 0, 0, 1
if mode == 1 then
pxT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.004, math.sin(vt * 0.3) * 0.5, 1 + 0.1 * smooth(u1)
elseif mode == 2 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.9) * sx * 0.006, math.sin(vt * 3.1) * sy * 0.004, math.sin(vt * 1.5) * 0.8, 1.1 + 0.08 * clamp01((t - M2) / (M3 - M2))
elseif mode == 3 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.35) * sx * 0.012, math.sin(vt * 0.27) * sy * 0.008, math.sin(vt * 0.3) * 1.2, 1.18
elseif mode == 4 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.6) * sx * 0.02 * (0.3 + u4), math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sy * 0.01, math.sin(vt * 0.9) * (1 + 3 * u4), 1.14 + 0.22 * u4 * u4
S.shake = S.shake + lv * 0.5 * (0.3 + u4)
elseif mode == 5 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.015, 0, math.sin(vt * 1.1) * 1.8, 1.12
elseif mode == 6 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.cos(vt * 0.55) * sx * 0.05, math.sin(vt * 0.4) * sy * 0.02, math.sin(vt * 0.5) * 4.5, 1.1 + 0.04 * math.sin(vt * 0.4)
elseif mode == 7 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, -sy * 0.02 * u7, 7 * smooth(u7), 1.1 - 0.14 * smooth(u7)
else

local function parse(s)
local o = {}
for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
return o
end
local BASS, HAT, VOX, LEVEL = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), {}, D.level

local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE

end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)

for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
end

end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 10.7666
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end

end
end)

local function bar(par, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, o)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
return ell(par, (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + th, th, col, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), z, o)
end
local function space(par, sgn, cx, cy, size, psize, z)
local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + sgn * cx / psize, 0.5 + cy / psize), Size = UDim2.fromScale(size / psize, size / psize), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
return {g = f, s = sgn, z = size}
end
local function sEll(sp, dx, dy, w, h, col, rot, z, o, rad)
return ell(sp.g, 0.5 + sp.s * dx / sp.z, 0.5 + dy / sp.z, w / sp.z, h / sp.z, col, (rot or 0) * sp.s, z, o, rad)
end

end

local function spark(col)
local q = E.sp[1]
for _, r in ipairs(E.sp) do
if not r.on then q = r break end
end
local U = math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
q.on, q.t0, q.life = true, S.t, 0.55 + math.random() * 0.4
q.x, q.y = (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.95, (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sy * 0.9
q.f.Visible = true
q.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
end

end
