local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.45 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.16 * I
ringW(U * 0.2, U * 1.2, 0.8, S.ac)
itick(0.6, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.tk = 0
elseif m == 4 or m == 7 then
S.flashK = I
S.zk = S.zk + 0.32 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 18 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.crk = S.t
S.titleN = 0
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.6, 0.9, WHITE)
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.1, 0.7, S.ac2)
itick(0.4, 1.4)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9)
end
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.2 * I
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.3, 0.8, S.ac2)
itick(0.8, 1)
elseif m == 6 then
S.flashK = 0
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local TL = {{2, "> LOCATING EAGLE ..."}, {6, "> WINGS LOADED"}, {10, "> MIGHTY = TRUE"}}
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then S.began = os.clock() - pos else S.began = S.began - d * 0.2 end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(sx, sy)
local mode = (t < M[1] and 1) or (t < M[2] and 2) or (t < M[3] and 3) or (t < M[4] and 4) or (t < M[5] and 5) or (t < M[6] and 6) or 7
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.ac, S.ac2, S.bgc = S.ac:Lerp(PA[mode], ck), S.ac2:Lerp(PB[mode], ck), S.bgc:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
local acc, acc2 = accent(), S.ac2
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode)
end
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local drop = mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
local down = beatIdx % 4 == 0
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, down and 1 or 0.55)
if drop then
S.zk = S.zk + (down and 0.07 or 0.035) * I
if down then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.8 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
end
end
if beatIdx % 8 == 7 then S.blink = 1 end
if mode == 6 then
S.pulse = 1
itick(1.5 - 0.2 * (3 - math.floor((t - M[5]) / K.BEAT)), 1)
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local h = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - h[1] < 0.25 then
S.kick = 1
if mode ~= 1 and mode ~= 6 then
S.zk = S.zk + (0.025 + 0.02 * h[2]) * I
S.shake = S.shake + h[2] * (drop and 2.4 or 1) * I
if drop and h[2] >= 3 then
S.strobe, S.glitch = 1, 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * I)
if S.tokens >= 1 and mode ~= 5 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
ringW(U * 0.15, U * 0.9, 0.55, acc2)
end
end
itick(drop and 0.7 or 0.5, 0.35)
end
end
end
while HAT[S.hatI] and HAT[S.hatI][1] <= t do
local h = HAT[S.hatI]
S.hatI = S.hatI + 1
if drop and t - h[1] < 0.2 then spark((S.hatI % 2 == 0) and acc or acc2) end
end
while VOX[S.voxI] and VOX[S.voxI] <= t do
local v = VOX[S.voxI]
S.voxI = S.voxI + 1
if t - v < 0.4 then
S.mt, S.ph = v, v
itick(1.6, 0.4)
end
end
if mode == 3 then
local rt = clamp01((t - M[2]) / (M[3] - M[2]))
if t >= S.tk then
S.tk = t + lerp(K.BEAT * 0.5, K.BEAT * 0.12, rt)
itick(1 + rt * 1.2, 0.5)
end
end
if mode == 1 then
local l = TL[S.tlI]
if l and beatIdx >= l[1] then
S.tlI = S.tlI + 1
S.lines[#S.lines + 1] = l[2]
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.lines, "\n")
end
end
local dk = math.exp(-dt)
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.kick = S.kick * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.glitch = S.glitch * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.strobe = S.strobe * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.blink = S.blink * math.exp(-12 * dt)
S.tp = S.tp * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.kal = lerp(S.kal, (mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt))
local rt = (mode == 3) and clamp01((t - M[2]) / (M[3] - M[2])) or 0
local zb = (mode == 1 and 0.12 * clamp01(t / M[1])) or (mode == 2 and 0.1 + 0.04 * S.pulse) or (mode == 3 and 0.1 + rt * 0.5) or 0.02 * S.pulse
E.zs.Scale = 1 + zb + S.zk
local sh = (S.shake + rt * rt * 6) * I
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
E.world.Rotation = S.rk + math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.8 * I * (mode >= 2 and 1 or 0.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
local bgk = S.strobe * 0.5 + (mode == 3 and rt * 0.12 * (math.floor(t * 14) % 2) or 0)
E.world.BackgroundColor3 = S.bgc:Lerp(acc, bgk)
local cy = U * 0.02
local g = (S.glitch * 0.02 + rt * 0.015) * U * I
local draw = clamp01(t / (K.BAR * 2.2))
if not S.egDone then
local rv = draw * 8.6
for _, p in ipairs(E.eg) do p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(rv - (p.o - 1)) end
if draw >= 1 then S.egDone = true end
end
local fxT = ((mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 1) or (mode == 6 and 0.7) or (mode == 3 and 0.3 + 0.35 * rt) or (mode == 2 and 0.18 + 0.1 * clamp01((t - M[1]) / K.BAR)) or 0
S.flex = lerp(S.flex or 0, fxT, 1 - math.exp(-((mode == 4 or mode == 7) and 16 or 4) * dt))
local fx = S.flex
local trem = (mode == 3) and (math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * rt or 0
local dR = lerp(-38, 0, fx) - S.kick * 7 - S.pulse * 2 + trem
local dL = lerp(70, 0, fx) - S.kick * 7 - S.pulse * 2 + trem
local bR = lerp(75, 0, fx) + math.sin(t * 2.6) * 3
local bL = lerp(55, 0, fx) + math.sin(t * 2.6 + 1) * 3
E.arm[1].Rotation, E.arm[2].Rotation = dR, -dL
E.fa[1].Rotation, E.fa[2].Rotation = bR, -bL
local pump = 1 + S.kick * 0.07 + S.pulse * 0.03 + 0.04 * fx
E.aS[1].Scale, E.aS[2].Scale = pump, pump
local es = U * 0.88 * (1 + 0.012 * S.pulse + 0.06 * S.kal)
E.eagle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(es, es)
E.eagle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy + U * 0.04 + math.sin(t * 1.9) * U * 0.006 - S.kick * U * 0.01)
E.eagle.Rotation = math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.8
local ot = t - S.mt
local open = ot < 0.55 and clamp01(1 - ot / 0.55) * (0.45 + 0.55 * math.abs(math.sin(ot * 24))) or 0
E.jaw.Rotation = -open * 30
E.head.Rotation = lerp(12, -5, clamp01(fx * 1.4)) + math.sin(t * 1.3) * 2 + S.pulse * 2.5 - open * 6
E.head.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36 - 0.015 * fx + 0.006 * S.pulse)
local bl = clamp01(S.blink)
E.eye.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.1 * (1 - 0.9 * bl))
E.eye.BackgroundColor3 = E.eyeC:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, rt * 0.9 + S.kick * 0.7))
E.pup.Visible = bl < 0.6
E.pup.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (0.047 + 0.012 * math.sin(t * 1.7) * (1 - S.kick)) / 0.5, 0.27)
local rayK = clamp01((t - 0.8) / 3.5) * (mode == 6 and 0.5 or 1)
local spin = (mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 9 or 3
for i, f in ipairs(E.rays) do
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 3.6, U * 0.06 * (1 + 0.5 * S.pulse + (mode >= 4 and 0.4 or 0)))
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.05)
f.Rotation = (i - 1) * 20 + t * spin
f.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - rayK * (0.16 + 0.22 * S.lv + 0.1 * S.pulse)
end
local gs = U * (0.8 + 0.06 * S.pulse + 0.1 * S.kick)
E.glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gs, gs)
E.glow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.02)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.7)
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - rayK * (0.3 + 0.25 * S.lv + 0.2 * S.kick)
for i, h in ipairs(E.halo) do
local d = U * (0.62 + 0.2 * i) * (1 + 0.03 * S.pulse * i)
h.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
h.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.02)
h.st.Color = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6)
h.st.Transparency = 1 - rayK * (0.45 - 0.08 * i)
h.st.Thickness = 2 + S.kick * 3
end
for i, f in ipairs(E.cl) do
local u = (i * 0.137 + t * (0.006 + 0.003 * (i % 3))) % 1
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3 + 0.05 * (i % 3), 0.1 + 0.02 * (i % 2))
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.15 + u * 1.3, 0.62 + 0.04 * (i % 4))
f.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.75)
end
local ct = t - S.crk
local crOn = (mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and ct < 24
for i, f in ipairs(E.cr) do
f.Visible = crOn
if crOn then
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * (0.25 + 0.5 * ((i * 37) % 10) / 10) * eo3(clamp01(ct / 0.25)), 3)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.7 * clamp01((ct - 1) / 16)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or acc2
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy)
end
end
for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.f.Visible = false
else
local d = lerp(r.r0, r.r1, eo3(u))
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
r.st.Transparency = u
r.st.Thickness = 2 + 8 * (1 - u)
end
end
end
for _, r in ipairs(E.sp) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.f.Visible = false
else
local d = U * 0.025 * (1 - u * 0.5)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
r.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, r.x, 0.5, r.y - u * U * 0.18)
r.f.BackgroundTransparency = u
end
end
end
local eqOn = (mode >= 2) and 1 or 0.3
for i, f in ipairs(E.eq) do
local h = (0.04 + 0.5 * S.lv * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.abs(math.sin(i * 1.9 + t * 7 + S.kick * 3)))) * sy * 0.28 * eqOn
f.Position = UDim2.new((i - 0.5) / 28, 0, 1, 0)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 28, -3, 0, h)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and acc or acc2
end
S.lbv = lerp(S.lbv, (mode == 3 and 0.11) or (mode == 6 and 0.18) or 0, 1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, S.lbv, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, S.lbv, 0)
if mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7 then
local a0 = (mode == 7) and M[6] or M[3]
local n = math.min(#TITLE, math.floor((t - a0) / K.BEAT) + 1)
if n ~= S.titleN then
S.titleN = n
S.tp = 1
itick(1.2, 0.5)
end
local ts = TITLE:sub(1, S.titleN)
local fs = math.floor(U * 0.11 * (1 + S.tp * 0.35))
local gx = g * 1.5 + S.tp * U * 0.01
for _, l in ipairs({E.tR, E.tC, E.tM}) do
l.Text, l.TextSize = ts, fs
end
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position, E.tM.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, gx, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, -gx, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0)
E.tM.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextColor3 = 0, WHITE
E.tR.TextTransparency = gx > 1 and 0.35 or 1
E.tC.TextTransparency = gx > 1 and 0.35 or 1
else
E.tM.TextTransparency, E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 1, 1, 1
end
if mode == 7 and t >= B(26) then
E.name.Text = (NAME:gsub("(.)", "%1 "))
E.name.TextSize = math.floor(U * 0.045 * (1 + (t >= B(30) and 0.4 or 0)))
E.name.TextTransparency = 1 - eo3(clamp01((t - B(26)) / K.BEAT))
E.name.TextColor3 = acc2
else
E.name.TextTransparency = 1
end
if mode == 6 then
local n = 4 - math.floor((t - M[5]) / K.BEAT)
E.big.Text = tostring(math.clamp(n, 1, 4))
E.big.TextSize = math.floor(U * (0.3 + 0.12 * S.pulse))
E.big.TextTransparency = 0
E.big.TextColor3 = acc
else
E.big.TextTransparency = 1
end
local pn = math.floor((t - S.ph) / 0.2) + 1
if pn >= 1 and t - S.ph < 1.5 and mode ~= 3 and mode ~= 6 then
E.cap.Text = table.concat(PHRASE, " ", 1, math.min(#PHRASE, pn))
E.cap.TextSize = math.floor(U * 0.07 * (1 + S.kick * 0.08))
E.cap.TextTransparency = clamp01((t - S.ph - 1.1) / 0.4)
E.cap.TextColor3 = (math.floor(t * 8) % 2 == 0) and WHITE or acc2
else
E.cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, (mode == 7 and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.9 * I) or 0)
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
local hf = clamp01(t / 2)
local hc = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%s  %02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   107 BPM", (math.floor(os.clock() * 2) % 2 == 0) and "* REC" or "  REC", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(32, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  LAYDOWNROT - PERFECT FACE (SLOWED)"
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3, E.term.TextColor3 = hc, hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - hf) * 0.65
E.np.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - hf) * 0.55
E.term.TextTransparency = (mode <= 2) and 0.3 or 1
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = acc
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(loop)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 7 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, PB[7], 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
end)
return true
end

function FX.Intro8(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
FX.IntroCamBusy = true
FX.IntroActive = true
opts = opts or {}
local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro8Data, opts.Song or {}
local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.09, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 122), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end
local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local TITLE = "THE AURA FARMER"
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local GOLD, PINK, CYAN, VIO, ORG = C(255, 196, 64), C(255, 52, 150), C(40, 220, 255), C(150, 70, 255), C(255, 140, 20)
local FUR, FUR2, FURL, MANE = C(96, 58, 42), C(58, 32, 26), C(134, 90, 64), C(26, 14, 12)
local SUIT, SUIT2, LAPEL, SKIN = C(94, 84, 230), C(136, 122, 255), C(224, 78, 52), C(226, 172, 132)
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function parse(s)
local o = {}
for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
return o
end
local BASS, HAT, LEVEL, VOC = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), D.level, D.voc
local function lvAt(str, t)
local x = t * 10
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end
local function Bsec(sec) return (sec - K.OFF) / K.BAR end
local SCH = {{0, 1}, {Bsec(9.88), 2}, {Bsec(27.42), 3}, {Bsec(29.25), 4}, {Bsec(35.92), 3}, {Bsec(49.67), 5}, {29, 6}}
local DROPS = {B(7), B(19), B(26), B(30.4)}
local LY = {}
for _, r in ipairs(FX.Intro8Lyrics or {}) do
local L = {a = r[1], e = r[2], st = r[3], w = {}, wt = {}}
for wd in r[4]:gmatch("%S+") do L.w[#L.w + 1] = wd end
for x in r[5]:gmatch("%S+") do L.wt[#L.wt + 1] = tonumber(x) end
if #L.w >= 1 and #L.w <= 8 and #L.wt == #L.w then LY[#LY + 1] = L end
end
local conns, E = {}, {}
local S = {
began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, tokens = 3, t = 0, kick = 0, hk = 0, zk = 0, rk = 0, shake = 0,
flashK = 0, glitch = 0, dir = 1, bi = 0, hi = 0, di = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0, scene = 0, st = 0, cut = -10, z = 1, r = 0, px = 0, py = 0, cx = 0, cy = 0,
sx = 800, sy = 450, stk = 0, stY = 0.5, fallback = false, ac = C(255, 170, 40), capPop = 0, capLast = "", gt = 0, fi = 1, ri = 1, li = 1, gf = 0,
}
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.ac
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
end
return o
end
local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
end
end)
local function fr(par, x, y, w, h, col, tr, z, rot, rad)
local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = rot or 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
if rad then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rad, 0)}) end
return f
end
local function setLn(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + th * 0.6, th)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function ln(par, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, tr)
local f = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, th, col, tr, z, 0, 0.5)
setLn(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
return f
end
local function grad(f, c1, c2, rot) return mk("UIGradient", f, {Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Rotation = rot or 90}) end
local function txt(z, font, col, ay, ypos)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, ay or 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, ypos or 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 120), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, TextSize = 40, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
end
local function hud(y, z)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, y), Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Text = ""})
end
local function horse(par, z)
local R = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
local H = {R = R, arm = {}, lens = {}, ch = {}}
for i, sg in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
H.arm[i] = {sg = sg, u = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, SUIT, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), l = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, SUIT2, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), h = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.13, 0.13, FUR, 0, z + 2, 0, 0.5)}
end
fr(R, 0.5, 0.97, 1.0, 0.56, SUIT, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
fr(R, 0.24, 0.9, 0.34, 0.3, SUIT2, 0.45, z + 3, -20, 0.5)
fr(R, 0.5, 0.66, 0.3, 0.46, FUR2, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.35)
fr(R, 0.5, 0.64, 0.26, 0.44, FUR, 0, z + 4, 0, 0.35)
fr(R, 0.355, 0.8, 0.13, 0.34, LAPEL, 0, z + 5, 16, 0.2)
fr(R, 0.645, 0.8, 0.13, 0.34, LAPEL, 0, z + 5, -16, 0.2)
for i = 0, 8 do
local u = i / 8
H.ch[i + 1] = fr(R, 0.37 + 0.26 * u, 0.74 + 0.1 * math.sin(math.pi * u), 0.045, 0.028, GOLD, 0, z + 7, (u - 0.5) * 60, 0.5)
end
H.med = fr(R, 0.5, 0.875, 0.1, 0.1, GOLD, 0, z + 8, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", H.med, {Thickness = 2, Color = C(150, 90, 10)})
mk("TextLabel", H.med, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = "A", TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = C(120, 40, 10), ZIndex = z + 9, Interactable = false})
local Hd = mk("Frame", R, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 10, Interactable = false})
H.Hd = Hd
local zz = z + 10
for _, sg in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
fr(Hd, 0.5 + sg * 0.115, 0.1, 0.075, 0.17, FUR, 0, zz, sg * 14, 0.5)
fr(Hd, 0.5 + sg * 0.115, 0.11, 0.035, 0.1, C(40, 18, 18), 0, zz + 1, sg * 14, 0.5)
end
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.07, 0.12, 0.14, MANE, 0, zz, 0, 0.5)
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.28, 0.27, 0.34, FUR, 0, zz + 2, 0, 0.45)
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.44, 0.2, 0.3, FUR, 0, zz + 2, 0, 0.4)
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.17, 0.07, 0.22, MANE, 0, zz + 3, 0, 0.5)
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.41, 0.05, 0.32, FURL, 0.45, zz + 3, 0, 0.5)
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.55, 0.235, 0.15, FURL, 0, zz + 3, 0, 0.5)
fr(Hd, 0.442, 0.535, 0.032, 0.045, FUR2, 0, zz + 4, 25, 0.5)
fr(Hd, 0.558, 0.535, 0.032, 0.045, FUR2, 0, zz + 4, -25, 0.5)
H.mouth = fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.612, 0.17, 0.02, C(48, 10, 16), 0, zz + 3, 0, 0.5)
H.teeth = fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.6, 0.15, 0.02, WHITE, 1, zz + 4, 0, 0.3)
H.jaw = fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.63, 0.2, 0.07, FURL, 0, zz + 5, 0, 0.5)
for i, sg in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
local l = fr(Hd, 0.5 + sg * 0.095, 0.335, 0.15, 0.1, C(60, 38, 22), 0, zz + 8, sg * 8, 0.45)
mk("UIStroke", l, {Thickness = 3, Color = GOLD})
grad(l, C(255, 190, 90), C(40, 20, 10), 90)
H.lens[i] = fr(l, 0.3, 0.4, 0.18, 0.6, WHITE, 0.55, 1, 25, 0.5)
ln(Hd, 0.5 + sg * 0.17, 0.32, 0.5 + sg * 0.2, 0.18, 0.01, GOLD, zz + 8)
end
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.325, 0.05, 0.012, GOLD, 0, zz + 8, 0, 0.5)
return H
end
local function hz(H, x, y, sz, rot, flex, open, glint, nod)
H.R.Position, H.R.Size, H.R.Rotation = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz), rot
H.Hd.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + nod * 0.015)
H.Hd.Rotation = nod * 2.5
H.jaw.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.63 + open * 0.05)
H.mouth.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.17, 0.02 + open * 0.07)
H.mouth.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.612 + open * 0.03)
H.teeth.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, open * 2.2)
local gx, gt = 0.15 + 0.7 * glint, 0.45 + 0.4 * math.abs(glint * 2 - 1)
for i = 1, 2 do
H.lens[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale(gx, 0.4)
H.lens[i].BackgroundTransparency = gt
end
H.med.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD:Lerp(WHITE, clamp01(S.kick * 0.7))
for _, a in ipairs(H.arm) do
local sg = a.sg
local ex, ey = 0.5 + sg * lerp(0.46, 0.6, flex), lerp(1.04, 0.86, flex)
local fx, fy = 0.5 + sg * lerp(0.44, 0.38, flex), lerp(1.2, 0.58, flex)
setLn(a.u, 0.5 + sg * 0.36, 0.9, ex, ey, 0.17)
setLn(a.l, ex, ey, fx, fy, 0.14)
a.h.Position = UDim2.fromScale(fx, fy)
end
end
local function man(par, z)
local R = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
fr(R, 0.5, 0.98, 0.78, 0.5, C(240, 240, 240), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5)
fr(R, 0.5, 0.75, 0.15, 0.2, C(196, 140, 102), 0, z, 0, 0.4)
fr(R, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.42, SKIN, 0, z + 2, 0, 0.45)
fr(R, 0.5, 0.2, 0.31, 0.12, C(34, 24, 20), 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
for _, sg in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
local l = fr(R, 0.5 + sg * 0.085, 0.38, 0.12, 0.09, C(30, 20, 16), 0, z + 4, 0, 0.45)
mk("UIStroke", l, {Thickness = 2, Color = GOLD})
end
fr(R, 0.5, 0.375, 0.04, 0.01, GOLD, 0, z + 4, 0, 0.5)
fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.012, C(130, 62, 52), 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
return {R = R}
end
local function dancer(par, z, shirt, pants, isHorse)
local R = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
local d = {R = R}
d.lL, d.lR = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, pants, 0, z, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, pants, 0, z, 0, 0.5)
d.sL, d.sR = fr(R, 0.4, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05, C(30, 24, 34), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.6, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05, C(30, 24, 34), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5)
d.tor = fr(R, 0.5, 0.42, 0.26, 0.32, shirt, 0, z + 2, 0, 0.3)
d.aL, d.aR = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, shirt, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, shirt, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5)
local hc = isHorse and FURL or SKIN
d.hL, d.hR = fr(R, 0.3, 0.55, 0.07, 0.07, hc, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.7, 0.55, 0.07, 0.07, hc, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
d.hd = mk("Frame", R, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 4, Interactable = false})
if isHorse then
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.95, FUR, 0, 1, 0, 0.45)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.78, 0.42, 0.4, FURL, 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.32, 0.06, 0.14, 0.3, FUR, 0, 1, -10, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.68, 0.06, 0.14, 0.3, FUR, 0, 1, 10, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, MANE, 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.38, 0.62, 0.17, C(60, 36, 18), 0, 3, 0, 0.4)
else
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.8, 0.8, hc, 0, 1, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.18, 0.84, 0.3, C(30, 22, 20), 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.74, 0.16, C(20, 16, 20), 0, 3, 0, 0.4)
end
return d
end
local function dz(d, x, y, sz, ph, kk)
d.R.Position, d.R.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
local s = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(ph * math.pi)
local bx = 0.03 * math.sin(ph * math.pi * 0.5)
local hy = 0.55 - 0.012 * kk
local lxL, lxR = 0.38 + bx * 2 + 0.03 * (1 - s), 0.62 + bx * 2 - 0.03 * (1 - s)
setLn(d.lL, 0.46 + bx, hy, lxL, 0.94, 0.1)
setLn(d.lR, 0.54 + bx, hy, lxR, 0.94 - 0.03 * s, 0.1)
d.sL.Position, d.sR.Position = UDim2.fromScale(lxL - 0.02, 0.955), UDim2.fromScale(lxR + 0.02, 0.955 - 0.03 * s)
d.tor.Position, d.tor.Rotation = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + bx, 0.42 - 0.012 * kk), (s - 0.5) * 12
d.hd.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + bx * 1.2, 0.2 - 0.02 * kk)
local hxR, hyR = 0.74 + 0.04 * s, lerp(0.56, 0.0, s)
local hxL, hyL = 0.26 - 0.04 * (1 - s), lerp(0.0, 0.56, s)
setLn(d.aR, 0.6 + bx, 0.31, hxR + bx, hyR, 0.065)
setLn(d.aL, 0.4 + bx, 0.31, hxL + bx, hyL, 0.065)
d.hR.Position, d.hL.Position = UDim2.fromScale(hxR + bx, hyR), UDim2.fromScale(hxL + bx, hyL)
end
local function wheel(par, z)
local W = {sp = {}, g = {}}
W.ring = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, BLACK, 1, z, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", W.ring, {Thickness = 4, Color = C(238, 232, 236)})
W.ring2 = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.4, 0.4, BLACK, 1, z, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", W.ring2, {Thickness = 2, Color = C(220, 214, 224), Transparency = 0.3})
local pal = {C(255, 70, 70), C(255, 210, 60), C(70, 190, 255), C(255, 255, 255)}
for i = 1, 12 do
W.sp[i] = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.004, C(232, 226, 232), 0.1, z, 0, 0.5)
W.g[i] = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.03, 0.036, pal[i % 4 + 1], 0, z + 1, 0, 0.25)
end
W.hub = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.03, 0.03, C(250, 246, 250), 0, z + 2, 0, 0.5)
return W
end
local function wz(W, x, y, r, a)
W.ring.Position, W.ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(2 * r, 2 * r)
W.ring2.Position, W.ring2.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(1.7 * r, 1.7 * r)
W.hub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
for i = 1, 12 do
local an = a + (i - 1) * math.pi / 6
local px, py = x + r * math.cos(an), y + r * math.sin(an)
setLn(W.sp[i], x, y, px, py, 0.004)
W.g[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale(px, py + 0.02)
end
end
local function spawnRing(r0, r1, life, col)
local q = E.rg[S.ri]
S.ri = S.ri % #E.rg + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.r0, q.r1 = true, S.t, life, r0, r1
q.st.Color = col
q.f.Visible = true
end
local function spawnSL()
local q = E.sl[S.li]
S.li = S.li % #E.sl + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.a = true, S.t, 0.22 + math.random() * 0.12, math.random() * math.pi * 2
q.f.Visible = true
end
local function spawnFlare(x, y, col, sz)
local q = E.fl[S.fi]
S.fi = S.fi % #E.fl + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.sz, q.x, q.y = true, S.t, 0.4, sz, x, y
q.h.BackgroundColor3, q.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
q.c.Visible = true
end
local function onKick(s)
local I = K.INT
S.kick = math.min(1, 0.45 + 0.2 * s)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.01 * s * I
S.shake = S.shake + (1 + 1.6 * s) * I
if s >= 3 then
S.rk = S.rk + 0.7 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
if I > 0 then
spawnSL()
spawnSL()
end
end
end
local function onDrop(i)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (i == 4 and 0.6 or 1) * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.26 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 16 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.glitch = 0.4 * I
S.imp = S.t
spawnRing(U * 0.1, U * 1.5, 0.9, WHITE)
spawnRing(U * 0.1, U * 1.0, 0.7, i % 2 == 0 and CYAN or PINK)
for _ = 1, 6 do
if I > 0 then spawnSL() end
end
spawnFlare(S.sx * 0.5, S.sy * 0.45, WHITE, U * 0.9)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9)
end
end
local function onScene(id, t)
local prev = S.scene
for i, o in pairs(E.sc) do o.s.Visible = (i == id) end
S.scene, S.cut, S.st, S.stk = id, t, t, 0
if prev ~= 0 then
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.55 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.14 * I
S.glitch = 0.3 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 4 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
spawnRing(U * 0.2, U * 1.2, 0.7, id % 2 == 0 and PINK or CYAN)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.04, 0.8)
end
end
end

local PCOL = {C(255, 236, 170), C(255, 100, 220), C(255, 255, 255), C(255, 200, 90), C(255, 214, 90), C(255, 255, 255)}
local function ptUpdate(t, dt, I)
local col, sc = PCOL[S.scene] or WHITE, S.scene
for _, p in ipairs(E.pt) do
p.y = p.y - p.v * dt * ((sc == 2 or sc == 6) and 1.6 or 1)
p.x = p.x + 0.02 * math.sin(t * 0.7 + p.ph) * dt
if p.y < -0.1 then
p.y = 1.1
p.x = -0.4 + math.random() * 1.8
end
local f = p.f
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(p.x - S.cx * p.d, p.y - S.cy * p.d)
local sz = p.s * (1 + S.kick * 0.7) * (0.6 + 0.4 * p.d)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(0.35 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * 2 + p.ph) - S.hk * 0.15)
end
end

local function lyMeasure(s, size)
local ok, v = pcall(function() return TextService:GetTextSize(s, size, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Vector2.new(10000, 1000)) end)
if ok and v then return v.X end
return #s * size * 0.7
end
local function lySpark(x, y, col, n)
for _ = 1, n do
local q = E.sk[S.ski]
S.ski = S.ski % #E.sk + 1
local a, v = math.random() * math.pi * 2, S.sy * (0.25 + math.random() * 0.55)
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.x, q.y = true, S.t, 0.45 + math.random() * 0.4, x, y
q.vx, q.vy, q.g = math.cos(a) * v, math.sin(a) * v - S.sy * 0.2, S.sy * 0.9
q.sz = math.max(3, S.sy * (0.006 + math.random() * 0.008))
q.f.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random() < 0.3) and WHITE or col
q.f.Visible = true
end
end
local function lyOnWord(L, i)
local st, I, U = L.st, K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
local w = LWT[st]
S.lyK = math.max(S.lyK, math.min(1, 0.45 + 0.3 * w))
S.kick = math.max(S.kick, 0.3 + 0.2 * w)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.005 * w * I
S.shake = S.shake + (0.6 + 1.6 * w) * I
if st == 2 or st == 8 then S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, 0.1 * I) end
if I <= 0 then return end
local word = L.w[i]:gsub("[^%w]", "")
local key = LKEY[word]
lySpark(L.bx[i], L.by, LCOL[st], (st == 2 and 14) or (key and 10) or 4)
if key then
spawnRing(U * 0.05, U * (0.5 + 0.4 * key), 0.6, LCOL[st])
spawnFlare(L.bx[i], L.by, WHITE, U * 0.6 * key)
if key >= 0.9 then S.imp = S.t end
end
end
local function lyOnLine(L)
local w, I = LWT[L.st], K.INT
S.zk = S.zk + 0.03 * w * I
S.shake = S.shake + 5 * w * I
S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, 0.12 * w * I)
S.rk = S.rk + 1.4 * w * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * w * I)
end
local function lySetLine(L, U, sx, sy)
local st = L.st
local raw = math.floor(U * LSZ[st])
local size, bs, ws, tot
for _ = 1, 2 do
size = math.min(100, raw)
bs = raw / size
ws, tot = {}, 0
for i, wd in ipairs(L.w) do
ws[i] = lyMeasure(wd, size) * 1.06
tot = tot + ws[i] * bs
end
tot = tot + raw * 0.3 * (#L.w - 1)
if tot > sx * 0.9 then raw = math.max(10, math.floor(raw * sx * 0.9 / tot)) else break end
end
L.size, L.bs, L.bx, L.by = size, bs, {}, sy * LYP[st]
local x = sx * 0.5 - tot * 0.5
for i = 1, #L.w do
L.bx[i] = x + ws[i] * bs * 0.5
x = x + ws[i] * bs + raw * 0.3
end
for i = 1, 8 do
for k = 1, 3 do
local o = E.lw[i][k]
if L.w[i] then
o.l.Text, o.l.TextSize, o.l.Size = L.w[i], size, UDim2.fromOffset(ws[i] + size * 0.2, size * 1.4)
else
o.l.Text, o.l.TextTransparency = "", 1
end
end
end
end
local function lyricUpdate(t, U, dt)
local sx, sy, I = S.sx, S.sy, K.INT
local Im = math.max(I, 0.3)
S.lyK = S.lyK * math.exp(-7 * dt)
local ik = S.t - S.imp
if I > 0 and ik >= 0 and ik < 0.16 then
E.imp.Visible = true
if ik < 0.05 then
E.imp.BackgroundColor3, E.imp.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE, 0.05
elseif ik < 0.09 then
E.imp.BackgroundColor3, E.imp.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 0.2
else
E.imp.BackgroundColor3, E.imp.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE, 0.55 + (ik - 0.09) * 6
end
else
E.imp.Visible = false
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.sk) do
if q.on then
local a = S.t - q.t0
local k = a / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on, q.f.Visible = false, false
else
local sz = q.sz * (1 - k * 0.6)
q.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(q.x + q.vx * a, q.y + q.vy * a + 0.5 * q.g * a * a)
q.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
q.f.BackgroundTransparency = k * k
end
end
end
local cur = 0
for i = math.max(1, S.lyi - 1), #LY do
local L = LY[i]
if t >= L.a - 0.08 and t < L.e then cur = i break end
if t < L.a - 0.08 then break end
end
if cur ~= S.lyi then
S.lyi, S.lyw = cur, 1
if cur > 0 then
lySetLine(LY[cur], U, sx, sy)
lyOnLine(LY[cur])
end
end
local L = LY[cur]
if not L then
if S.lyVis then
S.lyVis = false
for i = 1, 8 do
for k = 1, 3 do E.lw[i][k].l.TextTransparency = 1 end
E.lw[i][3].k.Transparency = 1
end
end
S.lyZ = S.lyZ * math.exp(-6 * dt)
return
end
S.lyVis = true
local st, size = L.st, L.size
local lin = clamp01((t - (L.a - 0.08)) / 0.1)
local lout = clamp01((t - (L.e - 0.22)) / 0.22)
local kd = (st == 1 and 12) or (st == 2 and 6.5) or 9
while L.wt[S.lyw] and L.wt[S.lyw] <= t do
local i = S.lyw
S.lyw = i + 1
if t - L.wt[i] < 0.12 then lyOnWord(L, i) end
end
local off0 = U * (0.0022 + 0.012 * math.max(0, S.glitch) + 0.02 * lout)
local px, py = S.px * U * 0.12 + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake * 0.3, S.py * U * 0.12 + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake * 0.3
for i = 1, #L.w do
local dtw = t - L.wt[i]
local sung = dtw >= 0
local pop = sung and math.exp(-dtw * kd) or 0
local x, y, rot = L.bx[i], L.by, 0
if st == 2 then
rot, y = (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * 6 * pop * Im, y - U * 0.01 * pop
elseif st == 3 then
x, rot = x + (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * U * 0.14 * pop * Im, -4
elseif st == 4 then
y = y + U * 0.07 * (sung and (1 - eo3(clamp01(dtw / 0.4))) or 1)
elseif st == 5 then
y = y + math.sin(t * 43 + i * 1.7) * U * 0.004 * (1 + S.vc * 2) - (sung and U * 0.01 * pop or 0)
elseif st == 6 then
if sung then y = y - U * 0.22 * (1 - clamp01(dtw / 0.22)) ^ 2 - math.abs(math.sin(dtw * 20)) * math.exp(-dtw * 8) * U * 0.02 end
elseif st == 8 then
rot = (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * 3 * pop * Im
elseif st == 1 then
y = y - U * 0.014 * pop
end
local sc = (1 + LHS[st] * pop * Im) * L.bs
local tr = sung and 0 or LPRE[st]
tr = 1 - (1 - tr) * lin
tr = tr + (1 - tr) * lout
local col = (sung and LCOL[st] or WHITE):Lerp(WHITE, 0.85 * pop)
if st == 5 then col = col:Lerp(LHOT, 0.35 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 9 + i)) end
local off = off0 + U * 0.012 * pop * (0.4 + LHS[st]) * Im
local gtr = 1 - clamp01(0.12 + 0.75 * pop + 0.5 * S.lyK + 0.9 * lout + (st == 2 and 0.25 or 0)) * (1 - tr) * 0.75
for k = 1, 3 do
local o = E.lw[i][k]
local dx = (k == 1 and -off) or (k == 2 and off) or 0
o.l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + px + dx, y + py)
o.l.Rotation = rot
o.s.Scale = sc
if k == 3 then
o.l.TextColor3, o.l.TextTransparency = col, tr
o.k.Transparency = clamp01(tr + 0.1)
o.k.Thickness = math.max(2, size * 0.045) * (1 + 0.8 * pop)
o.k.Color = LSTK:Lerp(LCOL[st], 0.5 * pop)
else
o.l.TextTransparency = gtr
end
end
end
S.lyZ = (st == 4 and -0.03 or 0.045) * eo3(clamp01((t - L.a) / math.max(0.4, L.e - L.a)))
end

local w = {}
for li, spec in ipairs({{PINK, 16}, {CYAN, 17}, {WHITE, 18}}) do
local l = mk("TextLabel", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-999, -999), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = "", TextSize = 30, TextColor3 = spec[1], TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = spec[2], Interactable = false})
if lyFace then pcall(function() l.FontFace = lyFace end) end
w[li] = {l = l, s = mk("UIScale", l, {Scale = 1})}
if li == 3 then w[li].k = mk("UIStroke", l, {Thickness = 3, Color = C(70, 6, 0), Transparency = 1}) end
end
E.lw[i] = w
end
E.sk = {}
for i = 1, 28 do
local f = fr(stage, 0.5, 0.5, 0.01, 0.01, GOLD, 0, 20, 0, 0.5)
f.Visible = false
E.sk[i] = {f = f, on = false}
end
E.imp = sf(23, WHITE, 1)
E.imp.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
E.imp.Visible = false
S.lyi, S.lyw, S.lyK, S.lyZ, S.imp, S.ski, S.lyVis, S.lyDead = 0, 1, 0, 0, -10, 1, false, false
E.tR, E.tC, E.tM = txt(17, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, PINK, 0.5, 0.4), txt(18, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, CYAN, 0.5, 0.4), txt(19, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, WHITE, 0.5, 0.4)
mk("UIStroke", E.tM, {Thickness = 3, Color = C(255, 150, 20), Transparency = 0.2})
E.sub = txt(19, Enum.Font.GothamBold, GOLD, 0.5, 0.53)
E.name = txt(19, Enum.Font.GothamBold, WHITE, 0.5, 0.6)
E.gr = {}
for i = 1, 14 do E.gr[i] = sf(20, WHITE, 0.85) end
E.dark = sf(24, BLACK, 0)
E.dark.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
E.flash = sf(22, WHITE, 1)
E.flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
E.tc, E.np = hud(14, 26), hud(34, 26)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 56), Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 26, Interactable = false, Text = ""})
E.prog = sf(26, WHITE, 0.2)
E.prog.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
E.prog.Position, E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3)
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false})
mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
E.world.Visible = false
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
E.rm = FX.MountRemaster and FX.MountRemaster(stage, E, 8, DROPS, K, 13) or nil
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local now = os.clock()
if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
local d = est - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
t = now - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(sx, sy)
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(LEVEL, t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
S.vc = lerp(S.vc, lvAt(VOC, t), 1 - math.exp(-20 * dt))
S.kick = S.kick * math.exp(-8.5 * dt)
S.hk = S.hk * math.exp(-14 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.capPop = S.capPop * math.exp(-9 * dt)
while BASS[S.bi + 1] and BASS[S.bi + 1][1] <= t do
S.bi = S.bi + 1
if t - BASS[S.bi][1] < 0.15 then onKick(BASS[S.bi][2]) end
end
while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
end
while DROPS[S.di + 1] and t >= DROPS[S.di + 1] do
S.di = S.di + 1
if t - DROPS[S.di] < 0.3 then onDrop(S.di) end
end
local sid = 1
for i = #SCH, 1, -1 do
if t >= B(SCH[i][1]) - 0.001 then
sid = SCH[i][2]
break
end
end
if sid ~= S.scene then onScene(sid, t) end
local o = E.sc[S.scene]
o.q.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U, U)
E.pq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U, U)
AN[S.scene](t, dt)
for _, l in ipairs(o.L) do l.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + S.cx * l.d, 0.5 + S.cy * l.d) end
ptUpdate(t, dt, I)
E.zs.Scale = S.z + S.kick * 0.03 * I + S.zk + S.lyZ * I
E.world.Rotation = S.r + S.rk + math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.4 * I
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, S.px * U + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake + math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.004 * U * I, 0.5, S.py * U + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake)
if E.rm then E.rm(t, dt, S) end
local ten = 0
for _, d in ipairs(DROPS) do
local k = d - t
if k > 0 and k < K.BAR then ten = math.max(ten, 1 - k / K.BAR) end
end
local lb = sy * (0.055 + 0.04 * ten * I)
E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, lb), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, lb)
for _, f in ipairs(E.vg) do f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 - 0.2 * S.kick end
local sa = clamp01(S.stk + S.kick * 0.4) * I
E.st.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - sa * 0.9
E.st.Position, E.st.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, S.stY), UDim2.new(1.6, 0, 0, math.max(3, U * 0.012))
E.st.BackgroundColor3 = CYAN:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5 + 0.5 * S.kick)
for i, f in ipairs(E.lk) do
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.3 + i * 2.1), 0.5 + 0.4 * math.cos(t * 0.23 + i * 1.7))
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.9, sx * 0.9)
f.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(0.92 - 0.25 * S.kick - 0.12 * S.lv)
end
S.gf = S.gf + 1
if S.gf % 2 == 0 then
for _, f in ipairs(E.gr) do
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(0, sx), math.random(0, sy))
local g = math.random(1, 3)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(g, g)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random() > 0.5) and WHITE or BLACK
end
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.sl) do
if q.on then
local k = (t - q.t0) / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on = false
q.f.Visible = false
else
local r = U * (0.25 + 0.75 * k)
q.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(q.a) * r * (sx / U) * 0.6, 0.5, math.sin(q.a) * r * 0.6)
q.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 0.35, 2)
q.f.Rotation = math.deg(q.a)
q.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * k
end
end
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.rg) do
if q.on then
local k = (t - q.t0) / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on = false
q.f.Visible = false
else
local d = lerp(q.r0, q.r1, 1 - (1 - k) ^ 3)
q.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d * 2, d * 2)
q.st.Transparency = k
end
end
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.fl) do
if q.on then
local k = (t - q.t0) / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on = false
q.c.Visible = false
else
q.c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(q.x, q.y)
q.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(q.sz * (0.3 + k), q.sz * 0.12)
q.h.BackgroundTransparency = k
q.v.BackgroundTransparency = k
end
end
end
if S.glitch > 0 then
S.glitch = S.glitch - dt
for _, f in ipairs(E.gl) do
if math.random() < 0.4 then
f.Visible = true
f.Position = UDim2.new(math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1, 0, math.random(), 0)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(4, math.max(5, math.floor(U * 0.07))))
f.BackgroundColor3 = ({PINK, CYAN, WHITE})[math.random(1, 3)]
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 + math.random() * 0.3
else
f.Visible = false
end
end
else
for _, f in ipairs(E.gl) do f.Visible = false end
end
local wk = (t - S.cut) / 0.42
for i, f in ipairs(E.wp) do
if S.scene > 1 and wk >= 0 and wk < 1.3 then
local k = clamp01(wk * 1.25 - (i - 1) * 0.12)
f.Visible = k > 0 and k < 1
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(lerp(-0.45, 1.45, k), 0.5)
else
f.Visible = false
end
end
if not S.lyDead and #LY > 0 then
local okL, errL = pcall(lyricUpdate, t + 0.02, U, dt)
if not okL then
S.lyDead = true
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 8 lyrics disabled: " .. tostring(errL))
end
end
local T0 = B(30.4)
if t >= T0 then
local n = math.min(#TITLE, math.floor((t - T0) / 0.06) + 1)
local off = (0.002 + S.kick * 0.004 + math.max(0, S.glitch) * 0.02) * U
local fs = math.floor(U * 0.115)
for _, l in ipairs({E.tR, E.tC, E.tM}) do
l.Text, l.TextSize, l.TextTransparency = TITLE:sub(1, n), fs, 0
end
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -off, 0.4, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, off, 0.4, 0)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 0.35, 0.35
local sa2 = clamp01((t - B(30.9)) / 0.3)
E.sub.Text, E.sub.TextSize, E.sub.TextTransparency = "H O R R O R   S K U N X   -   O F F I C I A L   S O N G", math.floor(U * 0.034), 1 - sa2
E.sub.TextColor3 = accent():Lerp(GOLD, 0.5)
local na = clamp01((t - B(31)) / 0.3)
E.name.Text, E.name.TextSize, E.name.TextTransparency = NAME, math.floor(U * 0.04), 1 - na * 0.15
end
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, (t > B(31)) and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.95 * I or 0)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-9 * dt)
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
E.dark.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(t / 1.0)
local acc = accent()
local hc = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
local hf = clamp01(t / 2)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%s  %02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   122 BPM", (math.floor(os.clock() * 2) % 2 == 0) and "* REC" or "  REC", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(32, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  THE AURA FARMER - HORROR SKUNX (OFFICIAL SONG)"
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3 = hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency, E.np.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - hf) * 0.65, 0.45 + (1 - hf) * 0.55
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = acc
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 8 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, GOLD, 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
end)
return true
end

function FX.Intro9(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
	FX.IntroCamBusy = true
	FX.IntroActive = true
	opts = opts or {}
	local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro9Data, opts.Song or {}
	local RunService, UserInputService, TweenService = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("TweenService")
	local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.132, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 105.12), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
	K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
	K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
	local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end
	local floor, sin, cos, sqrt, max, min, abs, exp, pi = math.floor, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.exp, math.pi
	local DEG, TAU = 180 / pi, pi * 2
	local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
	if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
	local BONE, SAND, SAND2, EMBER = C(238, 230, 214), C(222, 196, 150), C(128, 104, 74), C(255, 84, 46)
	local function cl(x, a, b) return x < a and a or (x > b and b or x) end
	local function clamp01(x) return cl(x, 0, 1) end
	local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
	local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - clamp01(x)) ^ 3 end
	local function eob(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 + 2.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 2 end
	local function ss(a, b, x) local k = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a)) return k * k * (3 - 2 * k) end
	local function parse(s)
		local o = {}
		for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
		return o
	end
	local KICK, HAT, NOTE, WORD = parse(D.kick), parse(D.hat), parse(D.note), parse(D.word)
	local LEVEL, VOC = D.level, D.voc
	local function lvAt(str, t)
		local x = t * 10
		local i = floor(x)
		local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
		local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
		return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
	end
	local conns, E = {}, {}
	local S = {
		began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, fallback = false, t = 0,
		kick = 0, hk = 0, hub = 0, shake = 0, flashK = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0, ki = 0, hi = 0, wi = 0, nl = 1, wc = 0, gd = 1, sc = 1,
		sx = 800, sy = 450, U = 450, cx = 400, cy = 180, R = 120, rot = 0, sq = 0, gi = 0, ri = 0, lastTi = -1, cue = 1,
		dropped = false, dirty = true, ac = EMBER, lit = {}, lastPos = nil, lastPosAt = nil,
	}
	local function mk(class, parent, props)
		local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
		if props then
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		end
		return o
	end
	local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local k = input.KeyCode
			if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
		end
	end)
	local function accent()
		if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
			return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
		elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
			return WHITE
		elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
			return Util.Color.Cur
		end
		return S.ac
	end
	local function box(par, z, col, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = col or BONE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function lab(par, z, font, size, col, xa)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Text = ""})
	end
	local function place(f, x, y, w, h, rot, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		f.Rotation = rot
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local NC, NG, NT, NM, NR = 40, 150, 32, 34, 6
	local HB, HT, LB, LT, NZ = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local gx, gy, gvx, gvy, gsz, gon, gland, gmass, glife, gbig = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local TXT = {{"I", 0.36}, {"N", 0.82}, {" ", 0.4}, {"T", 0.66}, {"H", 0.82}, {"E", 0.66}, {" ", 0.4}, {"E", 0.66}, {"N", 0.82}, {"D", 0.8}}
	local function build()
		E.glow = box(stage, 1, BLACK, 0)
		E.glow.Size, E.glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		mk("UIGradient", E.glow, {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1)})})
		E.mt = {}
		for i = 1, NM do
			local f = box(stage, 2, BONE, 0.8, 0.5)
			local s = 1 + (i % 3)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
			f.Visible = false
			E.mt[i] = {f = f, x0 = math.random(), y0 = math.random(), v = 0.012 + math.random() * 0.03, fq = 0.3 + math.random() * 0.6, p = math.random() * TAU}
		end
		E.world = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false})
		E.ws = mk("UIScale", E.world, {Scale = 1})
		E.col, E.tcol = {}, {}
		for i = 1, NC do
			HB[i], HT[i], LB[i], LT[i], NZ[i] = 0, 0, -1, -1, math.random()
			local b = box(E.world, 3, WHITE, 0)
			b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			mk("UIGradient", b, {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(SAND, SAND2)})
			b.Visible = false
			E.col[i] = b
			local u = box(E.world, 3, WHITE, 0)
			u.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			mk("UIGradient", u, {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(SAND2, SAND)})
			u.Visible = false
			E.tcol[i] = u
		end
		E.tk = {}
		for i = 1, NT do
			local f = box(E.world, 6, BONE, 0)
			f.Visible = false
			E.tk[i] = f
			S.lit[i] = 0
		end
		E.halo = box(E.world, 4, WHITE, 1, 0.5)
		E.haloS = mk("UIStroke", E.halo, {Thickness = 1.5, Color = BONE, Transparency = 1})
		E.halo.Visible = false
		E.hand = box(E.world, 7, EMBER, 0)
		E.hand.Visible = false
		E.hub = box(E.world, 8, BONE, 0, 0.5)
		E.hub.Visible = false
		E.rg = {}
		for i = 1, NR do
			local f = box(E.world, 9, WHITE, 1, 0.5)
			local st = mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 2, Color = BONE, Transparency = 1})
			f.Visible = false
			E.rg[i] = {f = f, st = st}
		end
		E.gr = {}
		for i = 1, NG do
			local f = box(E.world, 10, SAND, 0)
			f.Visible = false
			E.gr[i] = f
			gon[i] = false
		end
		E.st = {}
		for j = 1, 8 do
			local f = box(stage, 14, EMBER, 0)
			f.Visible = false
			E.st[j] = f
		end
		E.let = {}
		local cum, idx = 0, 0
		for _, g in ipairs(TXT) do
			if g[1] ~= " " then
				idx = idx + 1
				local f = lab(stage, 16, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 60, BONE)
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				f.Text = g[1]
				f.Visible = false
				local st = mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 2, Color = EMBER, Transparency = 0.35})
				local us = mk("UIScale", f, {Scale = 1})
				E.let[idx] = {f = f, st = st, us = us, w = g[2], off = cum + g[2] / 2, done = false}
			end
			cum = cum + g[2]
		end
		S.titleW = cum
		E.sub = lab(stage, 17, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14, SAND)
		E.sub.AnchorPoint, E.sub.Size, E.sub.Text = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), "LINKIN PARK"
		E.name = lab(stage, 17, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 16, BONE)
		E.name.AnchorPoint, E.name.Size, E.name.Text = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), NAME
		E.sub.TextTransparency, E.name.TextTransparency = 1, 1
		E.flash = box(stage, 22, WHITE, 1)
		E.flash.Size, E.flash.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.tag = lab(stage, 26, Enum.Font.Code, 13, BONE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.tag.Position, E.tag.Size, E.tag.Text, E.tag.TextTransparency = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18), "IN THE END  //  LINKIN PARK", 0.4
		E.tc = lab(stage, 26, Enum.Font.Code, 13, BONE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.tc.Position, E.tc.Size, E.tc.TextTransparency = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 34), UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18), 0.5
		if CFG.IntroHud == false then
			E.tag.Visible = false
			E.tc.Visible = false
		end
		E.term = lab(stage, 26, Enum.Font.Code, 14, WHITE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.term.Position, E.term.Size, E.term.TextTransparency = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 56), UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 20), 1
		E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false})
		mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
		conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
		-- [chaos layer] speed lines, glitch slices, colour veils, letterbox
		E.sl = {}
		for i = 1, 20 do
			local f = box(stage, 11, (i % 4 == 0) and EMBER or BONE, 1)
			f.Visible = false
			E.sl[i] = {f = f, a = (i / 20) * TAU + math.random() * 0.2, ph = math.random(), sp = 0.9 + math.random() * 1.6, w = (i % 3 == 0) and 3 or 2, hot = (i % 2 == 0)}
		end
		E.gl = {}
		for i = 1, 10 do
			local f = box(stage, 20, BONE, 1)
			f.Visible = false
			E.gl[i] = {f = f, on = false, life = 0, max = 1, tr = 1}
		end
		E.ca1 = box(stage, 19, EMBER, 1)
		E.ca1.Size, E.ca1.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.ca2 = box(stage, 19, C(40, 220, 255), 1)
		E.ca2.Size, E.ca2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.lbT = box(stage, 21, BLACK, 0)
		E.lbT.AnchorPoint, E.lbT.Position, E.lbT.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		E.lbB = box(stage, 21, BLACK, 0)
		E.lbB.AnchorPoint, E.lbB.Position, E.lbB.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		E.world.Visible = false
	end
	local warned = {}
	local function guard(tag, fn, a)
		local ok, e = pcall(fn, a)
		if not ok and not warned[tag] then
			warned[tag] = true
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 9 " .. tag .. " (continuing): " .. tostring(e))
		end
	end
	local function colOf(x) return cl(floor(x / (S.sx / NC)) + 1, 1, NC) end
	local function toW(x, y)
		if S.gd < 0 and S.t > B(24) + 0.9 then return S.sx - x, S.sy - y end
		return x, y
	end
	local function emit(x, y, vx, vy, sz, col, land, mass, life, big)
		for _ = 1, NG do
			S.gi = S.gi % NG + 1
			local i = S.gi
			if not gon[i] then
				gon[i], gx[i], gy[i], gvx[i], gvy[i], gsz[i], gland[i], gmass[i], glife[i], gbig[i] = true, x, y, vx, vy, sz, land, mass or 0.006, life or 4, big == true
				local f = E.gr[i]
				f.BackgroundColor3 = col or SAND
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
				f.Rotation = (i * 37) % 90
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
				f.Visible = true
				return i
			end
		end
	end
	local function ringAt(x, y, r0, r1, dur, col, th)
		S.ri = S.ri % NR + 1
		local r = E.rg[S.ri]
		r.t0, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1, r.dur, r.th = S.t, x, y, r0, r1, dur, th or 3
		r.st.Color = col or BONE
		r.f.Visible = true
	end
	local function onLand(i, x, y)
		if gbig[i] then
			S.hub = 1
			ringAt(x, y, 2, S.U * 0.07, 0.55, BONE, 2)
		end
	end
	local function relax(H, dt)
		local k = 0.3 * min(1, dt * 60)
		for i = 1, NC - 1 do
			local d = H[i] - H[i + 1]
			if d > 0.012 then
				local m = (d - 0.012) * k
				H[i], H[i + 1] = H[i] - m, H[i + 1] + m
			elseif d < -0.012 then
				local m = (-d - 0.012) * k
				H[i], H[i + 1] = H[i] + m, H[i + 1] - m
			end
		end
	end
	local function drawPile(cols, H, last, top)
		local cw = S.sx / NC
		for i = 1, NC do
			local h = H[i]
			if S.dirty or abs(h - last[i]) > 0.0004 then
				last[i] = h
				local f = cols[i]
				local px = max(0, h * S.sy)
				f.Visible = px > 0.5
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw + 1.5, px)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 0.5) * cw, top and 0 or S.sy)
			end
		end
	end
	local function updPiles(dt)
		relax(HB, dt)
		relax(HT, dt)
		local fill = ss(B(30), B(31.7), S.t)
		if fill > 0 then
			for i = 1, NC do HT[i] = max(HT[i], fill * (1.0 + 0.07 * NZ[i])) end
		end
		drawPile(E.col, HB, LB, false)
		drawPile(E.tcol, HT, LT, true)
		S.dirty = false
	end
	local function updGrains(dt)
		local g = 2.2 * S.sy * S.gd
		for i = 1, NG do
			if gon[i] then
				local vy = gvy[i] + g * dt
				local x, y = gx[i] + gvx[i] * dt, gy[i] + vy * dt
				gvy[i], gx[i], gy[i] = vy, x, y
				glife[i] = glife[i] - dt
				local dead = glife[i] <= 0 or x < -20 or x > S.sx + 20 or y < -60 or y > S.sy + 60
				if gland[i] and not dead then
					local ci = colOf(x)
					if S.gd > 0 then
						if vy > 0 and y >= S.sy - HB[ci] * S.sy then
							HB[ci] = HB[ci] + gmass[i]
							dead = true
							onLand(i, x, y)
						end
					elseif vy < 0 and y <= HT[ci] * S.sy then
						HT[ci] = HT[ci] + gmass[i]
						dead = true
						onLand(i, x, y)
					end
				end
				local f = E.gr[i]
				if dead then
					gon[i] = false
					f.Visible = false
				else
					f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
					if gbig[i] then f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gsz[i], gsz[i] * (1 + min(2.5, abs(vy) / (S.sy * 0.5)))) end
				end
			end
		end
		for i = 1, NR do
			local r = E.rg[i]
			if r.t0 then
				local a = (S.t - r.t0) / r.dur
				if a >= 1 then
					r.f.Visible = false
					r.t0 = nil
				else
					local d = lerp(r.r0, r.r1, eo3(a)) * 2
					r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
					r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
					r.st.Transparency = a
					r.st.Thickness = max(0.5, r.th * (1 - a))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function updMotes(t)
		for i = 1, NM do
			local m = E.mt[i]
			local y = (m.y0 - t * m.v) % 1
			local x = m.x0 * S.sx + sin(t * m.fq + m.p) * 14
			m.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y * S.sy)
			m.f.BackgroundTransparency = max(0, 0.84 - 0.6 * S.hk * ((i % 3 == 0) and 1 or 0) - 0.2 * S.lv)
		end
	end
	local function updRing(t)
		local U, cx, cy, R, sq = S.U, S.cx, S.cy, S.R, S.sq
		local age24 = t - B(24)
		local pre = age24 < 0
		local hubS = (t >= B(0.4) and age24 < 1.2) and U * (0.010 + 0.022 * S.hub) or 0
		E.hub.Visible = hubS > 0
		if hubS > 0 then
			E.hub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hubS, hubS)
			E.hub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
			E.hub.BackgroundColor3 = BONE:Lerp(accent(), clamp01(S.hub))
		end
		local ha = ss(B(1), B(3.5), t)
		E.halo.Visible = ha > 0 and pre
		if ha > 0 and pre then
			local hd = R * 1.9
			E.halo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hd, hd)
			E.halo.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
			E.haloS.Transparency = 1 - 0.55 * ha
			E.haloS.Color = BONE:Lerp(accent(), sq)
		end
		local hand = t >= B(8) and pre
		local u = 0
		if hand then
			local r1 = 2 / K.BEAT
			u = r1 * (cl(t - B(8), 0, B(24) - B(8)) + cl(t - B(20), 0, B(24) - B(20)) + 2 * cl(t - B(22), 0, B(24) - B(22)))
			local ti = floor(u)
			if ti ~= S.lastTi then
				S.lastTi = ti
				S.lit[ti % NT + 1] = 1
			end
		end
		local acc = accent()
		for i = 0, NT - 1 do
			local f = E.tk[i + 1]
			local th = S.rot + i / NT * TAU - pi / 2
			if pre then
				local rv = t - (B(4) + (i % 16) * K.BEAT)
				if rv < 0 then
					f.Visible = false
				else
					local lit = S.lit[i + 1]
					local L = U * ((i % 4 == 0) and 0.062 or 0.036) * eob(rv / 0.3) * (1 + 0.45 * S.kick) + U * 0.03 * lit
					place(f, cx + cos(th) * (R + L / 2), cy + sin(th) * (R + L / 2), L, max(2, U * 0.0042), th * DEG, 0.2 - 0.15 * S.lv)
					f.BackgroundColor3 = BONE:Lerp(acc, clamp01(lit + 0.7 * sq))
					f.Visible = true
				end
			else
				local a = age24 / 1.6
				if a >= 1 then
					f.Visible = false
				else
					local sp = 0.55 + 0.9 * (((i * 7) % 11) / 11)
					local d = R + U * sp * eo3(a)
					place(f, cx + cos(th) * d, cy + sin(th) * d, U * 0.05 * (1 + 2 * a), max(2, U * 0.006), th * DEG + age24 * 90 * ((i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1), a)
					f.BackgroundColor3 = BONE:Lerp(acc, 1 - a)
					f.Visible = true
				end
			end
		end
		E.hand.Visible = hand
		if hand then
			local fr = u - floor(u)
			local ang = S.rot + (floor(u) + eob(cl(fr * 3, 0, 1))) / NT * TAU - pi / 2
			local L = R * 0.94
			place(E.hand, cx + cos(ang) * L / 2, cy + sin(ang) * L / 2, L, max(2, U * 0.0045), ang * DEG, 0.05)
			E.hand.BackgroundColor3 = acc
		end
	end
	local function updStrips(t)
		local a0 = t - B(8)
		for j = 1, 8 do
			local f = E.st[j]
			local a = (a0 - (j - 1) * 0.035) / 0.42
			if a0 < -0.1 or a >= 1 or a0 - (j - 1) * 0.035 < 0 then
				f.Visible = false
			else
				local h = S.sy * (1 - eo3(a))
				f.Visible = true
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S.sx / 8 + 2, h + 1)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((j - 0.5) * S.sx / 8, (j % 2 == 0) and (S.sy - h / 2) or (h / 2))
				f.BackgroundColor3 = accent():Lerp(WHITE, 0.4 * (1 - a))
			end
		end
	end
	local function updTitle(t)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local fs = min(96, U * 0.16, sx * 0.86 / S.titleW)
		local ty = sy * 0.47
		local T0 = B(24)
		local fo = 1 - ss(B(30), B(30.8), t)
		local acc = accent()
		for j, L in ipairs(E.let) do
			local a = (t - T0 - (j - 1) * 0.045) / 0.4
			local cr = t - B(30) - (j - 1) * 0.10
			local f = L.f
			if a <= 0 or cr > 0.9 then
				f.Visible = false
			else
				local x, y = sx / 2 + (L.off - S.titleW / 2) * fs, ty
				if cr > 0 and not L.done then
					L.done = true
					for n = 1, 7 do
						local wx, wy = toW(x + (math.random() - 0.5) * fs * 0.5, y + (math.random() - 0.5) * fs * 0.5)
						emit(wx, wy, (math.random() - 0.5) * U * 0.25, -U * 0.05 * math.random(), max(2, U * 0.006), (n % 3 == 0) and acc or BONE, true, 0.006, 3)
					end
				end
				local dy = (cr > 0) and (cr * cr * U * 0.7) or 0
				f.Visible = true
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fs * L.w * 1.15, fs * 1.3)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y + dy - fs * 0.5 * (1 - eo3(a)))
				f.TextSize = floor(fs)
				f.Rotation = (cr > 0) and ((j % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * cr * 40) or 0
				f.TextTransparency = (cr > 0) and clamp01(cr / 0.9) or (1 - clamp01(a * 4))
				L.st.Transparency = (cr > 0) and clamp01(cr / 0.9) or lerp(1, 0.35, clamp01(a * 4))
				L.st.Color = acc
				L.us.Scale = (1 + 1.4 * (1 - eo3(a))) * (1 + 0.06 * S.kick)
			end
		end
		E.sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, ty - fs * 0.92)
		E.sub.TextSize = floor(U * 0.03)
		E.sub.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(B(25), B(26), t) * fo * 0.85
		E.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, ty + fs * 0.88)
		E.name.TextSize = floor(U * 0.036)
		E.name.TextColor3 = BONE:Lerp(acc, 0.35)
		E.name.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(B(26.5), B(27.5), t) * fo * 0.9
	end
	local function glitch(n, wide)
		local acc = accent()
		for _ = 1, n do
			local g
			for i = 1, #E.gl do
				if not E.gl[i].on then g = E.gl[i] break end
			end
			if not g then return end
			g.on, g.life = true, 0.07 + math.random() * 0.12
			g.max, g.tr = g.life, 0.3 + math.random() * 0.4
			g.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S.sx * (0.35 + math.random() * 0.65), S.sy * (0.012 + math.random() * (wide and 0.09 or 0.045)))
			g.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(S.sx * (0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4), S.sy * math.random())
			g.f.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random() < 0.4) and acc or BONE
			g.f.BackgroundTransparency = g.tr
			g.f.Visible = true
		end
	end
	local function chaosHit(p)
		S.tilt = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.8 + math.random()) * p * K.INT
		S.slam = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.6) * min(p, 2)
		S.cv = max(S.cv or 0, min(1, 0.35 * p))
		glitch(floor(1 + p * 2), p >= 2)
		if p >= 1.4 then
			S.whip = 1
			S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.3 * K.INT)
		end
		local acc = accent()
		for _ = 1, floor(3 + p * 4) do
			emit(S.sx * math.random(), S.sy, (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.25, -S.sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.9), max(2, S.U * 0.006), (math.random() < 0.35) and acc or SAND, false, 0.006, 1.4)
		end
	end
	local function updChaos(t)
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = min(now - (S.cl or now), 0.1)
		S.cl = now
		local sc, k = S.sc, S.kick
		local acc = accent()
		local tilt, slam, whip = S.tilt or 0, S.slam or 0, S.whip or 0
		E.world.Rotation = E.world.Rotation + tilt
		E.world.Position = E.world.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(slam * S.U * 0.03, 0)
		E.ws.Scale = E.ws.Scale + 0.09 * whip * whip
		S.tilt, S.slam, S.whip = tilt * exp(-7 * dt), slam * exp(-9 * dt), whip * exp(-5 * dt)
		local lb = (sc == 3 or sc == 4) and (0.055 + 0.04 * ss(B(16), B(24), t) + 0.01 * k) or 0
		S.lbk = lerp(S.lbk or 0, lb, 1 - exp(-7 * dt))
		local h = floor(S.sy * S.lbk)
		E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
		local cv, wp = S.cv or 0, S.wp or 0
		S.cv, S.wp = cv * exp(-12 * dt), wp * exp(-10 * dt)
		E.ca1.BackgroundColor3 = acc
		E.ca1.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(0.30 * cv + ((sc >= 3) and 0.10 * k or 0))
		E.ca2.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(((sc >= 4) and 0.10 * S.hk or 0) + 0.14 * wp)
		for i = 1, #E.gl do
			local g = E.gl[i]
			if g.on then
				g.life = g.life - dt
				if g.life <= 0 then
					g.on = false
					g.f.Visible = false
				else
					g.f.BackgroundTransparency = lerp(1, g.tr, g.life / g.max)
				end
			end
		end
		local age = t - B(24)
		local it = 0
		if age >= 0 then
			it = 0.8 * clamp01(1 - age / 1.2)
		elseif sc >= 4 then
			it = clamp01(0.18 + 0.55 * S.sq + 0.5 * k)
		elseif sc == 3 then
			it = 0.12 * S.hk
		end
		local sl = E.sl
		if it > 0.04 then
			S.slOn = true
			for i = 1, #sl do
				local L = sl[i]
				local pr = (t * L.sp + L.ph) % 1
				local r = S.U * (0.12 + pr * (0.75 + 0.25 * it))
				local len = S.U * (0.04 + 0.30 * it * (0.4 + pr))
				local d = r + len / 2
				L.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(S.cx + cos(L.a) * d, S.cy + sin(L.a) * d)
				L.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, L.w)
				L.f.Rotation = L.a * DEG
				L.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - it * 0.55 * (1 - pr) * (L.hot and 1 or 0.6)
				L.f.Visible = true
			end
		elseif S.slOn then
			S.slOn = false
			for i = 1, #sl do sl[i].f.Visible = false end
		end
	end
	local function onKick(s)
		local sc = S.sc
		local m = (sc <= 2) and 0.35 or 1
		S.kick = max(S.kick, min(1, (0.45 + 0.25 * s) * m))
		S.hub = 1
		if sc < 3 then return end
		S.shake = max(S.shake, ((s >= 3) and 0.8 or 0.25) * K.INT)
		if s >= 3 then chaosHit(1) elseif s >= 2 then chaosHit(0.5) end
		local acc = accent()
		if sc == 3 or sc == 4 then
			for _ = 1, 2 + s * 2 do
				local x = S.sx * (0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5)
				local ci = colOf(x)
				HB[ci] = max(0, HB[ci] - 0.006)
				emit(x, S.sy - HB[ci] * S.sy, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25 * S.sx, -S.sy * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.55), max(2, S.U * 0.007), (math.random() < 0.25) and acc or SAND, true, 0.006, 3)
			end
			if sc == 4 and s >= 2 and S.t > B(20) then ringAt(S.cx, S.cy, S.R, S.R * 1.7, 0.5, acc, 2) end
		elseif S.gd < 0 then
			for _ = 1, 3 + s * 2 do
				local x = S.sx * (0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8)
				local ci = colOf(x)
				HB[ci] = max(0, HB[ci] - 0.006)
				emit(x, S.sy - HB[ci] * S.sy, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.12 * S.sx, -S.sy * 0.05, max(2, S.U * 0.006), (math.random() < 0.2) and acc or SAND, true, 0.006, 3)
			end
			if s >= 2 then ringAt(S.sx / 2, S.sy / 2, S.U * 0.1, S.U * (0.5 + 0.2 * s), 0.6, (s >= 3) and acc or BONE, 3) end
		end
	end
	local function onWord(s)
		local sc = S.sc
		S.wp = 1
		if sc >= 3 and math.random() < 0.6 then glitch(1) end
		if sc == 3 or sc == 4 then
			S.wc = S.wc + 1
			for n = 1, s do
				local idx = (S.wc * 5 + n * 11) % NT
				local a = S.rot + idx / NT * TAU - pi / 2
				S.lit[idx + 1] = 1
				emit(S.cx + cos(a) * S.R, S.cy + sin(a) * S.R, cos(a) * S.U * 0.10, sin(a) * S.U * 0.10 - S.U * 0.05, max(2, S.U * 0.006), (n == 1) and BONE or SAND, true, 0.006, 3.5)
			end
		elseif sc == 5 and S.gd < 0 then
			local x = S.sx * (0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9)
			local ci = colOf(x)
			HB[ci] = max(0, HB[ci] - 0.006)
			emit(x, S.sy - HB[ci] * S.sy, 0, -S.sy * 0.04, max(2, S.U * 0.005), BONE, true, 0.006, 3)
		end
	end
	local function spawnNotes(t)
		local g = 2.2 * S.sy
		while NOTE[S.nl] do
			local e = NOTE[S.nl]
			local x = S.sx * (0.5 + ((((S.nl * 37) % 100) / 100) - 0.5) * 0.34)
			local ci = colOf(x)
			local fl = sqrt(2 * (S.sy - HB[ci] * S.sy + 6) / g)
			if e[1] - fl > t then break end
			if e[1] > t - 0.05 then
				local el = max(0, fl - (e[1] - t))
				emit(x, -6 + 0.5 * g * el * el, 0, g * el, max(3, S.U * 0.013), (e[2] >= 2) and BONE or SAND, true, 0.08 + 0.03 * e[2], 6, true)
			end
			S.nl = S.nl + 1
		end
	end
	local function scene(t) return t < B(4) and 1 or (t < B(8) and 2 or (t < B(16) and 3 or (t < B(24) and 4 or 5))) end
	local CUES = {B(12), B(16), B(20)}
	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.term.Text = ""
			E.world.Visible = true
			for i = 1, NM do E.mt[i].f.Visible = true end
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		while true do
			local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.flashLen = 0.35
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
			S.t = t
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			local sx, sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			if sx ~= S.sx or sy ~= S.sy then S.dirty = true end
			S.sx, S.sy, S.U = sx, sy, min(sx, sy)
			S.cx, S.cy = sx / 2, sy * 0.40
			S.sq = ss(B(20), B(24), t)
			S.R = S.U * (0.27 - 0.06 * S.sq + 0.012 * S.kick + 0.008 * S.vc)
			S.rot = 0.012 * t
			S.sc = scene(t)
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(LEVEL, t), 1 - exp(-14 * dt))
			S.vc = lerp(S.vc, lvAt(VOC, t), 1 - exp(-20 * dt))
			S.kick = S.kick * exp(-8.5 * dt)
			S.hk = S.hk * exp(-14 * dt)
			S.hub = S.hub * exp(-9 * dt)
			S.shake = S.shake * exp(-10 * dt)
			for i = 1, NT do S.lit[i] = S.lit[i] * exp(-4 * dt) end
			local age24 = t - B(24)
			S.gd = (age24 > 0.12) and -1 or 1
			if not S.dropped and age24 >= 0 then
				S.dropped = true
				S.flashK = 1
				S.kick = 1
				S.shake = 1
				local acc0 = accent()
				ringAt(S.cx, S.cy, 10, S.U * 1.2, 0.9, WHITE, 6)
				ringAt(S.cx, S.cy, 10, S.U * 0.8, 0.7, acc0, 4)
				ringAt(S.cx, S.cy, 10, S.U * 0.5, 0.5, BONE, 3)
				chaosHit(3)
				for n = 1, 44 do
					local a = math.random() * TAU
					local v = S.U * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.8)
					emit(S.cx, S.cy, cos(a) * v, sin(a) * v, max(2, S.U * 0.007), (n % 4 == 0) and acc0 or BONE, false, 0.006, 1.3)
				end
			end
			while CUES[S.cue] and t >= CUES[S.cue] do
				if t - CUES[S.cue] < 0.3 then
					ringAt(S.cx, S.cy, S.R * 0.9, S.U * 0.9, 0.8, accent(), 4)
					S.kick = max(S.kick, 0.9)
					S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.5 * K.INT)
					chaosHit(1.6)
				end
				S.cue = S.cue + 1
			end
			if t > B(24) - K.BEAT * 0.5 and age24 < 0 then
				if floor((t - (B(24) - K.BEAT * 0.5)) / (K.BEAT / 8)) % 2 == 0 then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.22 * K.INT) end
			end
			while KICK[S.ki + 1] and KICK[S.ki + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ki = S.ki + 1
				if t - KICK[S.ki][1] < 0.15 then guard("kick", onKick, KICK[S.ki][2]) end
			end
			while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.hi = S.hi + 1
				if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
			end
			while WORD[S.wi + 1] and WORD[S.wi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.wi = S.wi + 1
				if t - WORD[S.wi][1] < 0.15 then guard("word", onWord, WORD[S.wi][2]) end
			end
			if t < B(8) + 1 then guard("notes", spawnNotes, t) end
			local wr = (age24 < 0) and (sin(t * 0.35) * ((S.sc >= 3) and 1.6 or 0.5)) or (180 * eob(age24 / 0.9))
			E.world.Rotation = wr
			local z = 1 + 0.012 * S.kick + 0.05 * ss(B(8), B(24), t)
			if age24 >= 0 then z = 1 + 0.012 * S.kick + 0.22 * (1 - eo3(age24 / 1.1)) end
			E.ws.Scale = z
			local sh = S.shake * S.U * 0.012
			E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
			guard("piles", updPiles, dt)
			guard("grains", updGrains, dt)
			guard("motes", updMotes, t)
			guard("ring", updRing, t)
			guard("strips", updStrips, t)
			guard("chaos", updChaos, t)
			if age24 >= 0 then
				guard("title", updTitle, t)
			end
			local acc = accent()
			local gk = (0.06 + 0.34 * S.lv + 0.5 * S.kick) * ((S.sc >= 3) and 1 or 0.35) + 0.25 * S.sq + ((S.sc == 5) and 0.2 or 0)
			E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(acc, clamp01(gk) * 0.85)
			local fk = max(S.flashK, (t > B(31)) and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.95 * K.INT or 0)
			S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-9 * dt)
			E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
			local rem = max(0, K.DUR - t)
			E.tc.Text = string.format("T-%02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   105 BPM", floor(rem / 60), rem % 60, cl(floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1, 1, 32))
			E.tag.TextColor3, E.tc.TextColor3 = BONE:Lerp(acc, 0.25), BONE:Lerp(acc, 0.25)
		end
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		build()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 9 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	pcall(function()
		local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256})
		TweenService:Create(fl, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(fl, 1.1)
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, SAND, 700, 0.7, 3)
		FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
	end)
	return true
end
