function FX.Intro10(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
	FX.IntroCamBusy = true
	FX.IntroActive = true
	opts = opts or {}
	local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro10Data, opts.Song or {}
	local RunService, UserInputService, TweenService = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("TweenService")
	local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.163, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 115), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
	K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
	K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
	local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end
	local floor, sin, cos, sqrt, max, min, abs, exp, pi, atan2 = math.floor, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.exp, math.pi, math.atan2
	local DEG, TAU = 180 / pi, pi * 2
	local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
	if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
	local NIGHT, INK, AMBER, BLUE, RED, MINT, PINK, PAPER, CREAM = C(8, 10, 26), C(18, 20, 40), C(255, 178, 70), C(88, 150, 255), C(255, 72, 84), C(140, 240, 200), C(255, 130, 184), C(244, 236, 220), C(226, 214, 190)
	local function cl(x, a, b) return x < a and a or (x > b and b or x) end
	local function clamp01(x) return cl(x, 0, 1) end
	local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
	local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - clamp01(x)) ^ 3 end
	local function eob(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 + 2.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 2 end
	local function eio(x) x = clamp01(x) return x < 0.5 and 4 * x * x * x or 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ^ 3 / 2 end
	local function ss(a, b, x) local k = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a)) return k * k * (3 - 2 * k) end
	local function parse(s)
		local o = {}
		for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
		return o
	end
	local KICK, HAT, NOTE, WORD = parse(D.kick), parse(D.hat), parse(D.note), parse(D.word)
	local LEVEL, VOC = D.level, D.voc
	local function lvAt(str, t)
		local x = t * 10
		local i = floor(x)
		local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
		local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
		return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
	end
	local conns, E = {}, {}
	local S = {
		began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, fallback = false, t = 0, b = 0, sc = 1,
		kick = 0, hk = 0, nt = 0, wd = 0, shake = 0, flashK = 0, tflash = 0, chroma = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0,
		ki = 0, hi = 0, ni = 0, wi = 0, sx = 800, sy = 450, U = 450, lastPos = nil, lastPosAt = nil,
		rph = 0, dsc = 0, pn = 0, ri = 0, stc = 0, sn = 0, stT = -9, pers = 1, wc = 0, nameT0 = -9, nameN = 1, rowC = 0, cue = 1,
		f1 = false, f2 = false, f3 = false, bLocked = false, gT = 0, hy = 200, cxr = 400,
	}
	local function mk(class, parent, props)
		local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
		if props then
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		end
		return o
	end
	local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local k = input.KeyCode
			if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
		end
	end)
	local function accent()
		if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
			return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
		elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
			return WHITE
		elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
			return Util.Color.Cur
		end
		return AMBER
	end
	local function box(par, z, col, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function lab(par, z, font, size, col, xa)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Text = ""})
	end
	local function cell(par, z, x, y, w, h, col, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function ctext(par, z, x, y, w, h, font, col, xa, txt)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextColor3 = col, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, TextScaled = true, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h), Text = txt or ""})
	end
	local function grad(f, rot, c1, c2, t1, t2)
		mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = rot, Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(t1 or 0, t2 or 0)})
	end
	local function place(f, x, y, w, h, rot, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		f.Rotation = rot
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local function line(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, tr)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), th)
		f.Rotation = atan2(dy, dx) * DEG
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local function tpos(l, x, y, w, h, ts)
		l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		l.TextSize = ts
	end
	local CH = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789#?<>"
	local function rch() local i = math.random(1, #CH) return CH:sub(i, i) end
	local function scr(s, k)
		local o = {}
		for i = 1, #s do
			local c = s:sub(i, i)
			o[i] = (c == " " or math.random() < k) and c or rch()
		end
		return table.concat(o)
	end
	local NRW, NST, NHZ, NRO, NPUF, NSL, NP, NRG = 14, 36, 26, 7, 22, 16, 64, 6
	local TITLE = "IMPOSTORSYNDROME"
	local DEST = {"ENOUGH", "FRAUD?", "BELONGS", "QUALIFIED", "NOBODY", "REAL ONE", "ME", "LUCKY", "LATE", "HOME", "SOMEONE", "HERE"}
	local STAT = {"BOARDING", "DELAYED", "CANCELLED", "ON TIME", "FINAL CALL", "GATE CHANGE", "UNVERIFIED", "ALLOWED"}
	local NAMES = {NAME, "SOMEONE ELSE", "NOT " .. NAME, "A REAL PERSON", "????", NAME .. " (?)", "THE ONE FROM BEFORE"}
	local NAT = {"INDOORS", "NOWHERE", "ANYWHERE", "THE INTERNET", "HERE?"}
	local STS = {"UNVERIFIED", "AUTHENTIC?", "PROBABLY FINE", "DOUBTFUL", "ALLOWED"}
	local STX = {"IMPOSTOR?", "VOID", "NOT ME", "APPROVED?", "REAL??", "DENIED", "LOL OK"}
	local STC = {RED, BLUE, PINK, MINT, RED, BLUE, AMBER}
	local SKIN = {C(255, 214, 180), C(235, 180, 140), C(190, 130, 100), C(255, 200, 225)}
	local SHLD = {PINK, MINT, AMBER, BLUE}
	local PBG = {C(170, 190, 210), C(200, 170, 210), C(180, 220, 200), C(230, 200, 160)}
	local CAPS = {
		{0.8, "ATTENTION, PASSENGERS."}, {2.0, "THE FLIGHT IS ON TIME. YOU ARE ALSO ON TIME."},
		{4.5, "PASSENGER " .. NAME .. ", PLEASE HAVE YOUR IDENTITY READY."}, {7.2, "IT IS THE SAME ONE AS LAST TIME. MOSTLY."},
		{10.4, "BOARDING GROUP: NONE OF THE ABOVE."}, {14.0, "GATE CHANGED. THE GATE IS NOW ALSO YOU."},
		{18.2, "THIS IS YOUR CAPTAIN. NOBODY CHECKED. KEEP GOING."}, {22.4, "PLEASE FASTEN YOUR DOUBTS. THEY WILL NOT FIT OVERHEAD."},
		{26.3, "WINDOW SEAT. THAT IS A REFLECTION. THAT IS YOU."}, {29.6, "WELCOME. THE REAL ONE HAS ARRIVED."},
	}
	local PT, PTX, PTY, PVX, PVY, PL, PM, PS, PG = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local RG = {}
	local function build()
		E.bg = box(stage, 1, NIGHT, 0)
		E.bg.Size, E.bg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.world = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false})
		E.ws = mk("UIScale", E.world, {Scale = 1})
		local function layer() return mk("Frame", E.world, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false}) end
		E.lt, E.ld, E.lb, E.lf, E.lw, E.lp = layer(), layer(), layer(), layer(), layer(), layer()
		-- [tarmac] sky, ground, runway lights, wet reflections, tower beacon, far aircraft, lone figure + wrong reflection, overhead jet
		E.sky = box(E.lt, 1, WHITE, 0)
		grad(E.sky, 90, C(6, 8, 22), C(150, 84, 96))
		E.gnd = box(E.lt, 1, WHITE, 0)
		grad(E.gnd, 90, C(20, 24, 50), C(3, 4, 10))
		E.sheen = box(E.lt, 2, C(255, 160, 90), 0)

		E.lbT.AnchorPoint, E.lbT.Position, E.lbT.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		E.lbB = box(stage, 22, BLACK, 0)
		E.lbB.AnchorPoint, E.lbB.Position, E.lbB.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		E.flash = box(stage, 28, WHITE, 1)
		E.flash.Size, E.flash.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.tag = lab(stage, 26, Enum.Font.Code, 13, WHITE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.tag.Position, E.tag.Size, E.tag.Text, E.tag.TextTransparency = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18), "IMPOSTOR SYNDROME  //  GATE 00", 0.35
		E.tc = lab(stage, 26, Enum.Font.Code, 13, WHITE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.tc.Position, E.tc.Size, E.tc.TextTransparency = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 34), UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18), 0.5
		if CFG.IntroHud == false then
			E.tag.Visible = false
			E.tc.Visible = false
		end
		E.term = lab(stage, 26, Enum.Font.Code, 14, WHITE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.term.Position, E.term.Size, E.term.TextTransparency = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 56), UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 20), 1
		E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false})
		mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
		conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
		E.world.Visible = false
	end
	local warned = {}
	local function guard(tag, fn, a, b2, c2)
		local ok, e = pcall(fn, a, b2, c2)
		if not ok and not warned[tag] then
			warned[tag] = true
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 10 " .. tag .. " (continuing): " .. tostring(e))
		end
	end
	local function emit(x, y, vx, vy, size, col, life, grav)
		for n = 1, NP do
			local i = (S.pn + n - 1) % NP + 1
			if PL[i] <= 0 then
				S.pn = i
				PTX[i], PTY[i], PVX[i], PVY[i], PL[i], PM[i], PS[i], PG[i] = x, y, vx, vy, life, life, size, grav or 0
				E.pt[i].BackgroundColor3 = col
				E.pt[i].Visible = true
				return
			end
		end
	end
	local function updParts(dt)
		for i = 1, NP do
			if PL[i] > 0 then
				PL[i] = PL[i] - dt
				if PL[i] <= 0 then
					E.pt[i].Visible = false
				else
					PVY[i] = PVY[i] + PG[i] * dt
					PTX[i], PTY[i] = PTX[i] + PVX[i] * dt, PTY[i] + PVY[i] * dt
					local k = PL[i] / PM[i]
					place(E.pt[i], PTX[i], PTY[i], PS[i] * (0.4 + k), PS[i] * (0.4 + k), PTX[i] * 0.3, 1 - k * 0.9)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function ringAt(x, y, r0, r1, dur, col, th)
		S.ri = S.ri % NRG + 1
		local r = RG[S.ri]
		r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1, r.t0, r.d = x, y, r0, r1, S.t, dur
		r.st.Color, r.st.Thickness = col, th
		r.f.Visible = true
	end
	local function updRings(t)
		for i = 1, NRG do
			local r = RG[i]
			if r.d then
				local k = (t - r.t0) / r.d
				if k >= 1 then
					r.f.Visible = false
					r.d = nil
				else
					local rad = lerp(r.r0, r.r1, eo3(k))
					place(r.f, r.x, r.y, rad * 2, rad * 2, 0, 1)
					r.st.Transparency = clamp01(k) ^ 0.7
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function burst(x, y, n, spd, cols, life)
		for i = 1, n do
			local a = math.random() * TAU
			local v = S.U * spd * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.8)
			emit(x, y, cos(a) * v, sin(a) * v, max(3, S.U * 0.012), cols[i % #cols + 1], life or 1.1, S.U * 0.5)
		end
	end
	local function hit(str)
		S.kick = 1
		S.shake = max(S.shake, str * K.INT)
		S.chroma = max(S.chroma, 0.9 * K.INT)
		ringAt(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.46, S.U * 0.05, S.U * 0.8, 0.7, accent(), 3)
	end
	local function slam(t)
		S.stc = S.stc % 3 + 1
		S.sn = S.sn % #STX + 1
		local st = E.stp[S.stc]
		st.t0, st.rot, st.ox, st.oy = t, (math.random() - 0.5) * 40, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45
		st.txt.Text, st.txt.TextColor3, st.str.Color = STX[S.sn], STC[S.sn], STC[S.sn]
		st.f.Visible = true
		S.stT = t
		S.kick = 1
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.75 * K.INT)
		S.chroma = max(S.chroma, 0.5 * K.INT)
		burst(S.sx / 2 + st.ox * S.U * 0.5, S.sy / 2 + st.oy * S.U * 0.4, 10, 0.45, {PAPER, CREAM, STC[S.sn]}, 0.8)
	end
	local function flipRow(n)
		for c = 1, n do
			S.rowC = S.rowC % NRO + 1
			local r = S.rw[S.rowC]
			r.t0 = S.t
			r.hlv = 1
			if S.b >= 17.55 then
				r.tD, r.tS = "HERE", "BOARDING"
			else
				r.tD, r.tS = DEST[math.random(1, #DEST)], STAT[math.random(1, #STAT)]
			end
		end
	end
	local function onKick(str)
		S.kick = max(S.kick, 0.5 + 0.17 * str)
		S.shake = max(S.shake, (0.1 + 0.09 * str) * K.INT * ((S.sc == 4 or S.sc == 5) and 1.6 or 1))
		if str >= 2 then S.chroma = max(S.chroma, 0.3 * K.INT) end
		if S.sc == 2 and str >= 3 and S.t - S.stT > 0.5 then slam(S.t) end
		if (S.sc == 4 or S.sc == 5) and str >= 2 then ringAt(S.cxr, S.hy, S.U * 0.02, S.U * 0.5, 0.5, AMBER, 2) end
	end
	local function onNote(str)
		S.nt = 1
		if S.sc == 3 and S.b < 17.55 then flipRow((S.b >= 15.5 and str >= 2) and 2 or 1) end
	end
	local function onWord(str)
		S.wd = 1
		S.wc = S.wc + 1
		if S.sc == 2 then
			if S.wc % 3 == 0 then S.pers = S.pers % 4 + 1 end
			if S.wc % 4 == 0 then
				S.nameN = S.nameN % #NAMES + 1
				S.nameT0 = S.t
				E.v2.Text, E.v3.Text = NAT[S.nameN % #NAT + 1], STS[S.nameN % #STS + 1]
			end
		end
	end
	local function updTarmac(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local a4 = b >= 17.9
		local sp = a4 and (1 + 1.3 * ss(18, 20.5, b)) or (0.22 + 0.25 * ss(0.5, 4, b))
		S.rph = S.rph + dt / K.BEAT * sp
		local hy = sy * 0.47 - (a4 and (U * 0.05 * ss(18, 22, b)) or (U * 0.03 * ss(0, 4, b))) + sin(t * 0.6) * U * 0.006
		local cxr = sx / 2 + (a4 and sin(t * 1.7) * sx * 0.03 * ss(18, 20, b) or sin(t * 0.8) * sx * 0.012)
		S.hy, S.cxr = hy, cxr
		local H1 = (sy - hy) * 0.62
		local X0 = sx * 0.28
		local sB = (sy - hy) / H1
		place(E.sky, sx / 2, hy / 2, sx + 4, hy + 2, 0, 0)
		place(E.gnd, sx / 2, hy + (sy - hy) / 2, sx + 4, sy - hy + 2, 0, 0)
		place(E.sheen, sx / 2, hy + (sy - hy) * 0.25, sx + 4, (sy - hy) * 0.5, 0, 0)
		E.sheen.BackgroundColor3 = C(255, 160, 90):Lerp(PINK, 0.25 * S.lv)
		line(E.rl1, cxr, hy, cxr - X0 * sB, sy + 4, 2, 0.55)
		line(E.rl2, cxr, hy, cxr + X0 * sB, sy + 4, 2, 0.55)
		local reach = a4 and 8 or lerp(0.5, 7.4, ss(0.2, 3.2, b))
		for i = 1, NRW do
			local o = E.rw[i]
			local zz = 0.6 + ((i - 1 - S.rph) % NRW) * 0.46
			local s = 1 / zz
			local y = hy + H1 * s
			local x = X0 * s
			local fade = clamp01((6.9 - zz) / 1.4) * clamp01((zz - 0.55) / 0.2)
			local lit = clamp01((reach - zz) * 2) * fade
			local sz = max(2, U * 0.024 * s) * (1 + 0.35 * S.kick)
			place(o.L, cxr - x, y, sz, sz, 0, 1 - lit)
			place(o.R, cxr + x, y, sz, sz, 0, 1 - lit)
			place(o.Lg, cxr - x, y, sz * 5, sz * 5, 0, 1 - lit * (0.13 + 0.25 * S.lv))
			place(o.Rg, cxr + x, y, sz * 5, sz * 5, 0, 1 - lit * (0.13 + 0.25 * S.lv))
			local rl = sz * (3 + 5 * s)
			place(o.Lr, cxr - x, y + sz * 0.5 + rl / 2, sz * 0.55, rl, 0, 1 - lit * 0.45)
			place(o.Rr, cxr + x, y + sz * 0.5 + rl / 2, sz * 0.55, rl, 0, 1 - lit * 0.45)
			place(o.C, cxr, y, max(1.5, U * 0.008 * s), max(3, U * 0.035 * s), 0, 1 - lit * ((i % 2 == 0) and 0.8 or 0.5))
		end
		for i = 1, NST do
			local st = E.stars[i]
			place(st.f, st.x * sx, st.y * hy * 0.9, st.s, st.s, 0, clamp01(0.45 + 0.4 * sin(t * 1.9 + st.p) - ((i % 3 == 0) and 0.4 * S.hk or 0)))
		end
		for i = 1, NHZ do
			local h = E.hz[i]
			place(h.f, h.x * sx, hy - 1 - h.o, h.s, h.s, 0, 0.3 + 0.4 * abs(sin(t * h.fq + h.p)))
		end
		local bl = ((t - K.OFF) % K.BAR) < 0.2
		place(E.bcn, sx * 0.14, hy - U * 0.06, 5, 5, 0, bl and 0 or 0.85)
		place(E.bcnG, sx * 0.14, hy - U * 0.06, 26, 26, 0, bl and 0.55 or 1)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local nv = E.nav[i]
			local on = i == 2 and (((t * 1.1 + nv.p) % 1) < 0.12) or (i ~= 2)
			place(nv.f, ((nv.x0 + t * nv.v) % 1.2 - 0.1) * sx, hy * nv.y, 3, 3, 0, on and 0.2 or 0.85)
		end
		if b < 4.1 then
			local fs = 1 / lerp(7.0, 3.6, ss(0.5, 4, b))
			local fy = hy + H1 * fs
			local fh = U * 0.34 * fs
			local mm = sin(t * 2.1) * fh * 0.12
			E.fg.body.Visible, E.fg.head.Visible, E.fr.body.Visible, E.fr.head.Visible = true, true, true, true
			place(E.fg.body, cxr, fy - fh * 0.38, fh * 0.26, fh * 0.55, 0, 1 - ss(0.4, 1.6, b))
			place(E.fg.head, cxr, fy - fh * 0.8, fh * 0.2, fh * 0.2, 0, 1 - ss(0.4, 1.6, b))
			place(E.fr.body, cxr + mm, fy + fh * 0.38, fh * 0.26, fh * 0.55, 0, 0.55 + 0.45 * (1 - ss(0.6, 2, b)))
			place(E.fr.head, cxr + mm, fy + fh * 0.8, fh * 0.2 * (1 + 0.4 * S.wd), fh * 0.2, 0, 0.55 + 0.45 * (1 - ss(0.6, 2, b)))
		else
			E.fg.body.Visible, E.fg.head.Visible, E.fr.body.Visible, E.fr.head.Visible = false, false, false, false
		end
		local p = (b - 18.5) / 3.3
		if a4 and p > 0 and p < 1 then
			E.pl.Visible = true
			E.pls.Scale = max(0.01, U * (0.04 + 1.6 * p ^ 2.6) / 200)
			E.pl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cxr + sin(p * 3) * sx * 0.05, hy - U * 0.02 - (p ^ 1.5) * (hy * 0.9 + U * 0.4))
			E.pl.Rotation = 6 * sin(t * 1.3)
			E.plS.BackgroundTransparency = ((t * 2) % 1 < 0.12) and 0 or 1
			E.plLg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7 + 0.2 * sin(t * 9)
			E.plR.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 + 0.5 * ((t * 1.6) % 1)
		else
			E.pl.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local function updDesk(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		S.dsc = S.dsc + dt * U * 0.55 * (0.6 + 0.8 * S.lv)
		local sp = sx / 18
		for i = 1, 22 do place(E.roll[i], (i * sp - S.dsc) % (22 * sp) - sp, sy / 2, 3, sy * 0.6, 0, 0.55) end
		place(E.rail1, sx / 2, sy * 0.19, sx + 4, 4, 0, 0.3)
		place(E.rail2, sx / 2, sy * 0.81, sx + 4, 4, 0, 0.3)
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local g = E.gh[i]
			local u = (g.o - S.dsc * g.v / (sx * 1.5)) % 1
			local w = U * g.w * 1.4
			place(g.f, u * sx * 1.5 - sx * 0.25, sy * g.y, w, w * 0.64, g.r + 2 * sin(t + i), 0.4)
		end
		local W = min(sx * 0.8, U * 1.28)
		local pk = eob((b - 4) / 0.7)
		local pw = W * (0.8 + 0.2 * pk) * (1 - 0.025 * S.kick)
		local ppx, ppy = sx / 2 + sin(t * 0.9) * U * 0.01, sy * 0.5 + cos(t * 0.7) * U * 0.008
		S.ppx, S.ppy, S.ppw = ppx, ppy, pw
		place(E.pp, ppx, ppy, pw, pw * 0.64, -3 + 2 * sin(t * 0.6), 0)
		local ps = S.pers
		E.photo.BackgroundColor3 = PBG[ps]
		E.head.BackgroundColor3 = SKIN[ps]
		E.shld.BackgroundColor3 = SHLD[ps]
		E.hair.Visible = ps ~= 4
		E.hair.BackgroundColor3 = (ps == 2) and AMBER or ((ps == 3) and PINK or INK)
		E.head.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ps == 2 and 0.46 or 0.52, ps == 3 and 0.34 or 0.38)
		E.head.Position = UDim2.fromScale(ps == 2 and 0.27 or 0.24, 0.16 + 0.02 * S.wd)
		for i = 1, 2 do
			E.pg[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ((S.wd > 0.3) and 0.5 or 0)
			E.pg[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.2 + i * 0.25 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1)
		end
		local nk = (t - S.nameT0) / 0.45
		E.v1.Text = (nk < 1) and scr(NAMES[S.nameN], nk) or NAMES[S.nameN]
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local st = E.stp[i]
			if st.t0 then
				local age = t - st.t0
				if age > 2.1 then
					st.f.Visible = false
					st.t0 = nil
				else
					local sc = 1 + 1.4 * (1 - eo3(age / 0.16))
					local w, h = U * 0.36 * sc, U * 0.12 * sc
					st.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ppx + st.ox * pw * 0.5, ppy + st.oy * pw * 0.5)
					st.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
					st.f.Rotation = st.rot
					st.str.Transparency = (age < 0.04) and 1 or clamp01((age - 1.6) / 0.5)
					st.txt.TextTransparency = (age < 0.04) and 1 or clamp01((age - 1.6) / 0.5)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function updBoard(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local bw = sx * 0.88
		local left = (sx - bw) / 2
		local top = sy * 0.20
		local rh = (sy * 0.62) / NRO
		local ts = floor(rh * 0.5)
		place(E.rod1, left + bw * 0.2, top * 0.4, 3, top * 0.8, 0, 0.2)
		place(E.rod2, left + bw * 0.8, top * 0.4, 3, top * 0.8, 0, 0.2)
		tpos(E.bh, left, top - rh * 0.55, bw * 0.6, rh, floor(rh * 0.85))
		tpos(E.bclk, left + bw, top - rh * 0.55, bw * 0.3, rh, ts)
		E.bclk.Text = string.format("03:%02d", 17 + floor((b - 10) * 0.9))
		local flashAll = (S.bLocked and (t - B(17.6)) < 0.4) and (1 - (t - B(17.6)) / 0.4) or 0
		if b >= 17.6 and not S.bLocked then
			S.bLocked = true
			for i = 1, NRO do
				local r = S.rw[i]
				r.t0, r.tD, r.tS, r.hlv = t + i * 0.03, "HERE", "BOARDING", 1
			end
		end
		for i = 1, NRO do
			local r = S.rw[i]
			local y = top + (i - 0.5) * rh
			place(r.bg, sx / 2, y, bw, rh * 0.92, 0, 0.1)
			place(r.hl2, sx / 2, y, bw, 1.5, 0, 0.35)
			r.hlv = r.hlv * exp(-5 * dt)
			local hv = max(r.hlv, flashAll)
			place(r.hl, sx / 2, y, bw, rh * 0.92, 0, 1 - hv * 0.4)
			place(r.bt, left + bw * 0.09, y, bw * 0.15, rh * 0.78, 0, 0)
			place(r.bd, left + bw * 0.43, y, bw * 0.5, rh * 0.78, 0, 0)
			place(r.bs, left + bw * 0.84, y, bw * 0.28, rh * 0.78, 0, 0)
			tpos(r.tm, left + bw * 0.025, y, bw * 0.14, rh * 0.8, ts)
			tpos(r.ds, left + bw * 0.19, y, bw * 0.48, rh * 0.8, ts)
			tpos(r.st, left + bw * 0.71, y, bw * 0.28, rh * 0.8, ts)
			local age = t - r.t0
			if age >= 0 and age < 0.42 then
				local k = age / 0.42
				r.ds.Text, r.st.Text = scr(r.tD, k), scr(r.tS, k)
				r.ds.TextColor3 = AMBER:Lerp(PAPER, k)
			else
				r.ds.Text, r.st.Text = r.tD, r.tS
				r.ds.TextColor3 = PAPER
			end
			local sc = (r.tS == "BOARDING" or r.tS == "ALLOWED") and MINT or ((r.tS == "CANCELLED" or r.tS == "DELAYED") and RED or AMBER)
			r.st.TextColor3 = sc
		end
		local gx = (((b - 10) * 0.5) % 1) * sx * 1.6 - sx * 0.3
		place(E.glare, gx, sy / 2, U * 0.2, sy * 1.5, 20, 0.88 - 0.07 * S.kick)
		local gh = ss(11.5, 13, b) * (1 - ss(16.5, 17.5, b))
		place(E.gHead, sx * 0.78 + sin(t * 0.5) * U * 0.03, sy * 0.46, U * 0.2, U * 0.2, 0, 1 - gh * 0.07)
		place(E.gBody, sx * 0.78 + sin(t * 0.5) * U * 0.03, sy * 0.46 + U * 0.28, U * 0.46, U * 0.34, 0, 1 - gh * 0.06)
	end
	local function updFly(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local p = clamp01((b - 21.9) / 4.1)
		local cx, cy = sx / 2, sy * 0.46
		place(E.sun, cx, sy * (1.0 - 0.5 * p), U * (0.7 + 0.5 * p), U * (0.7 + 0.5 * p), 0, 0.4 - 0.15 * S.lv)
		for i = 1, NPUF do
			local pf = E.pf[i]
			local u = (t * 0.5 * pf.sp * (1 + p) + pf.ph) % 1
			local d = u ^ 2.2
			local sz = U * pf.sz * (0.2 + 3.2 * u)
			place(pf.f, cx + cos(pf.a) * d * U * 1.2, cy + sin(pf.a) * d * U * 0.9, sz, sz * 0.62, 0, 1 - sin(pi * u) * 0.6)
		end
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local q = E.fq[i]
			local u = (t * 0.32 + q.ph) % 1
			local d = u ^ 1.8
			q.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + cos(q.a) * d * U * 0.95, cy + sin(q.a) * d * U * 0.7)
			q.f.TextSize = floor(U * (0.02 + 0.13 * u))
			q.f.Rotation = sin(t + i) * 14
			q.f.TextTransparency = 1 - sin(pi * u) * 0.9
		end
		for i = 1, NSL do
			local s = E.sl[i]
			local u = (t * 1.4 + s.ph) % 1
			local r1, r0 = u ^ 1.5 * U * 1.3, u ^ 1.5 * U * 1.3 * 0.62
			line(s.f, cx + cos(s.a) * r0, cy + sin(s.a) * r0, cx + cos(s.a) * r1, cy + sin(s.a) * r1, 2, 0.45 + 0.4 * (1 - sin(pi * u)))
		end
	end
	local function updWindow(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local ww = U * 0.58 * (1 + 0.5 * ss(27.6, 28.3, b))
		local hh = ww * 1.4
		local wx, wy = sx / 2 + sin(t * 0.5) * U * 0.01, sy * 0.5 + sin(t * 0.8) * U * 0.008
		place(E.wfr, wx, wy, ww * 1.16, hh * 1.12, 0, 0)
		place(E.wgl, wx, wy, ww, hh, 0, 0)
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local c = E.wc[i]
			c.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.3 - ((t * 0.06 * c.v + c.o) % 1.7), c.y)
		end
		E.wing.Rotation = -7 + 1.5 * sin(t * 0.9)
		E.wingL.BackgroundTransparency = ((t * 1.3) % 1 < 0.15) and 0 or 0.7
		local fk = ss(26.2, 27.2, b)
		E.wHead.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.3 + 0.06 * sin(t * 0.6), 0.2)
		E.wBody.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1 + 0.06 * sin(t * 0.6), 0.5)
		E.wHead.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 - 0.2 * fk - 0.04 * S.vc
		E.wBody.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 - 0.18 * fk
		local bl = ((t * 0.9) % 1.6) < 0.12
		E.wEye1.Size, E.wEye2.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, bl and 0.006 or 0.03), UDim2.fromScale(0.05, bl and 0.006 or 0.03)
		E.wEye1.Position, E.wEye2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.4 + 0.06 * sin(t * 0.6), 0.3), UDim2.fromScale(0.55 + 0.06 * sin(t * 0.6), 0.3)
		local msg = (b < 26.8) and "" or ((b < 27.3) and "WHO IS THAT?" or "OH. ME.")
		E.wTxt.Text = msg
		E.wTxt.TextTransparency = 0.1
		E.shade.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -1.02 + 1.02 * ss(27.45, 27.85, b))
	end
	local function updPass(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local k = clamp01((b - 28.05) / 0.95)
		local W = min(sx * 0.9, U * 1.62)
		local Hh = W * 0.5
		local px, py = sx / 2, sy * 0.5 + (1 - eob(k)) * sy * 0.9 + sin(t * 0.8) * U * 0.006
		place(E.pass, px, py, W, Hh, 0, 0)
		local c = Hh * 0.2
		local tw = c * 0.86
		local pitch = tw * 1.08
		local x0 = px - W / 2 + W * 0.40
		local row1 = py - Hh / 2 + Hh * 0.30
		local on = t >= B(28.5) and k > 0.5
		for i = 1, 16 do
			local tl = E.tl[i]
			tl.f.Visible = on
			if on then
				local col = (i <= 8) and i or i - 8
				local x = x0 + (col - 4.5) * pitch
				local y = (i <= 8) and row1 or (row1 + c * 1.1)
				local age = t - tl.lock
				local hh = c
				if age < 0 then
					if t - tl.ct > 0.06 then
						tl.ct = t
						tl.ch = rch()
					end
					tl.l.Text = tl.ch
					tl.l.TextColor3 = C(150, 160, 200)
					hh = c * (0.3 + 0.7 * abs(cos((t - B(28.5)) * 18 + i)))
					tl.f.BackgroundColor3 = INK
				else
					if not tl.done then
						tl.done = true
						burst(x, y, 4, 0.3, {AMBER, PINK, MINT}, 0.7)
						if i == 16 then
							ringAt(px, py, U * 0.05, U * 0.9, 0.8, accent(), 4)
							S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.35)
						end
					end
					tl.l.Text = TITLE:sub(i, i)
					tl.l.TextColor3 = PAPER
					hh = c * (1 + 0.18 * max(0, 1 - age / 0.2))
					tl.f.BackgroundColor3 = INK:Lerp(AMBER, max(0, 1 - age / 0.3))
				end
				place(tl.f, x, y, tw, hh, 0, 0)
			end
		end
		local nk = clamp01((b - 28.9) / 0.8)
		E.pname.Text = (b < 28.9) and "" or ((nk < 1) and scr(NAME, nk) or NAME)
		for i = 1, 34 do E.bar[i].BackgroundTransparency = (S.hk > 0.5 and i % 5 == 0) and 0.7 or 0 end
		if b >= 29.35 and not S.f1 then
			S.f1 = true
			hit(0.8)
			burst(px + W * 0.17, py, 12, 0.4, {RED, PAPER}, 0.8)
		end
		if b >= 30.35 and not S.f2 then
			S.f2 = true
			hit(1.2)
			S.flashK = 0.8
			burst(px, py, 40, 0.9, {AMBER, PINK, MINT, BLUE, WHITE}, 1.6)
		end
		if S.f1 then
			local age = t - B(29.35)
			local sc = 1 + 1.4 * (1 - eo3(age / 0.16))
			E.ps1.Visible = true
			E.ps1.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px + W * 0.19, py + Hh * 0.1)
			E.ps1.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W * 0.3 * sc, Hh * 0.17 * sc)
			E.ps1.Rotation = -9
			local tr = S.f2 and 0.55 or 0
			E.ps1s.Transparency, E.ps1t.TextTransparency = tr, tr
		end
		if S.f2 then
			local age = t - B(30.35)
			local sc = 1 + 1.6 * (1 - eo3(age / 0.18))
			E.ps2.Visible = true
			E.ps2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px - W * 0.04, py + Hh * 0.14)
			E.ps2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W * 0.38 * sc, Hh * 0.22 * sc)
			E.ps2.Rotation = 7
		end
	end
	local function updTrans(t, b)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local wp = clamp01((b - 3.6) / 0.45)
		local pe = eio(wp)
		E.lt.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((b < 4.1) and -sx * pe or 0, 0)
		E.ld.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((b < 4.1) and sx * (1 - pe) or 0, 0)
		local wi = (wp > 0 and wp < 1) and sin(pi * wp) or 0
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local f = E.wh[i]
			f.Visible = wi > 0
			if wi > 0 then place(f, sx / 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.3, sy * (0.12 + 0.15 * i), sx * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.random()), sy * 0.018, 0, 1 - 0.55 * wi) end
		end
		local kk = (b < 10.0) and eio((b - 9.55) / 0.4) or (1 - eio((b - 10.0) / 0.45))
		kk = (b < 9.55 or b > 10.5) and 0 or kk
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local f = E.blind[i]
			local hh = (sy / 8) * 1.03 * clamp01(kk * 1.5 - (i - 1) * 0.07)
			f.Visible = hh > 0.5
			if f.Visible then place(f, sx / 2, (i - 0.5) * sy / 8, sx + 4, hh, 0, 0) end
		end
		local gl = (b > 17.45 and b < 18.0)
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local f = E.gl[i]
			f.Visible = gl
			if gl then place(f, sx / 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.12, math.random() * sy, sx, sy * (0.01 + math.random() * 0.05), 0, 0.5) end
		end
		if b >= 18.0 and not S.f3 then
			S.f3 = true
			S.flashK = 1
			hit(1.2)
			S.chroma = 1
			burst(sx / 2, sy * 0.46, 42, 1.0, {WHITE, AMBER, PINK, BLUE}, 1.3)
		end
		S.tflash = ss(25.6, 26.0, b) * (1 - ss(26.0, 26.5, b)) * 0.95 + ss(27.85, 28.05, b) * (1 - ss(28.05, 28.4, b)) * 0.9
	end
	local function updCaps(t)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local cur
		for i = 1, #CAPS do
			local c = CAPS[i]
			if t >= B(c[1]) and t < B(c[1]) + K.BAR * 1.85 then
				cur = c
				break
			end
		end
		E.capBg.Visible, E.cap.Visible, E.capTag.Visible, E.chime.Visible = cur ~= nil, cur ~= nil, cur ~= nil, cur ~= nil
		if not cur then return end
		local age = t - B(cur[1])
		local fade = clamp01((K.BAR * 1.85 - age) / 0.3) * clamp01(age / 0.12)
		local bh = max(26, U * 0.07)
		local bw = sx * 0.8
		local y = sy - max(S.lbH or 0, 0) - bh * 0.5 - U * 0.04
		place(E.capBg, sx / 2, y, bw, bh, 0, 1 - 0.6 * fade)
		E.capTag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2 - bw / 2 + bh * 0.55, y)
		E.capTag.TextSize = floor(bh * 0.4)
		E.capTag.TextTransparency = 1 - fade
		local ck = clamp01(age / 0.5)
		place(E.chime, sx / 2 - bw / 2 + bh * 0.55, y, bh * (0.5 + ck * 0.5), bh * (0.5 + ck * 0.5), 0, 1 - (1 - ck) * 0.7 * fade)
		tpos(E.cap, sx / 2 - bw / 2 + bh * 1.1, y, bw - bh * 1.3, bh, floor(bh * 0.5))
		E.cap.Text = cur[2]:sub(1, floor(age * 38) + 1)
		E.cap.TextTransparency = 1 - fade
	end
	local function updHud(t, b, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local thick = sy * (0.17 * (1 - ss(0, 1.5, b)) + ((b >= 28.2) and 0.05 or 0.075))
		S.lbH = thick
		E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thick), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thick)
		for i = 1, 4 do E.vg[i].BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 + 0.3 * S.lv end
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local g = E.gr[i]
			if S.gT ~= floor(t * 14) then place(g, sx / 2, math.random() * sy, sx, 1, 0, 0.9 + 0.08 * math.random()) end
		end
		S.gT = floor(t * 14)
		E.ca1.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.12 * S.chroma
		E.ca2.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.1 * S.chroma
		local rem = max(0, K.DUR - t)
		E.tc.Text = string.format("T-%02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   115 BPM", floor(rem / 60), rem % 60, cl(floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1, 1, 32))
		local acc = accent()
		E.tag.TextColor3, E.tc.TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(acc, 0.35), WHITE:Lerp(acc, 0.35)
	end
	local function updBg(t, b)
		local sc = S.sc
		local col = NIGHT
		if sc == 2 then col = C(16, 18, 30) elseif sc == 3 then col = C(8, 9, 18) elseif sc == 5 then col = C(28, 44, 120) elseif sc >= 6 then col = C(40, 36, 60) end
		E.bg.BackgroundColor3 = col
	end
	local CUES = {4, 10, 18, 22.2, 26, 28.2}
	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.term.Text = "> BOARDING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.term.Text = ""
			E.world.Visible = true
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		while true do
			local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.flashLen = 0.35
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
			S.t = t
			local b = (t - K.OFF) / K.BAR
			S.b = b
			S.sc = (b < 4 and 1) or (b < 10 and 2) or (b < 18 and 3) or (b < 22 and 4) or (b < 26 and 5) or (b < 28.2 and 6) or 7
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			local sx, sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			S.sx, S.sy, S.U = sx, sy, min(sx, sy)
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(LEVEL, t), 1 - exp(-14 * dt))
			S.vc = lerp(S.vc, lvAt(VOC, t), 1 - exp(-20 * dt))
			S.kick = S.kick * exp(-8.5 * dt)
			S.hk = S.hk * exp(-14 * dt)
			S.nt = S.nt * exp(-9 * dt)
			S.wd = S.wd * exp(-7 * dt)
			S.shake = S.shake * exp(-10 * dt)
			S.chroma = S.chroma * exp(-6 * dt)
			while CUES[S.cue] and t >= B(CUES[S.cue]) do
				if t - B(CUES[S.cue]) < 0.3 then hit(0.6) end
				S.cue = S.cue + 1
			end
			while KICK[S.ki + 1] and KICK[S.ki + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ki = S.ki + 1
				if t - KICK[S.ki][1] < 0.15 then guard("kick", onKick, KICK[S.ki][2]) end
			end
			while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.hi = S.hi + 1
				if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
			end
			while NOTE[S.ni + 1] and NOTE[S.ni + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ni = S.ni + 1
				if t - NOTE[S.ni][1] < 0.15 then guard("note", onNote, NOTE[S.ni][2]) end
			end
			while WORD[S.wi + 1] and WORD[S.wi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.wi = S.wi + 1
				if t - WORD[S.wi][1] < 0.15 then guard("word", onWord, WORD[S.wi][2]) end
			end
			E.lt.Visible = b < 4.05 or (b >= 17.95 and b < 22.1)
			E.ld.Visible = b >= 3.6 and b < 10.05
			E.lb.Visible = b >= 9.95 and b < 18.05
			E.lf.Visible = b >= 21.9 and b < 26.2
			E.lw.Visible = b >= 25.9 and b < 28.4
			E.lp.Visible = b >= 28.05
			if E.lt.Visible then guard("tarmac", updTarmac, t, b, dt) end
			if E.ld.Visible then guard("desk", updDesk, t, b, dt) end
			if E.lb.Visible then guard("board", updBoard, t, b, dt) end
			if E.lf.Visible then guard("fly", updFly, t, b, dt) end
			if E.lw.Visible then guard("window", updWindow, t, b, dt) end
			if E.lp.Visible then guard("pass", updPass, t, b, dt) end
			guard("trans", updTrans, t, b)
			guard("parts", updParts, dt)
			guard("rings", updRings, t)
			guard("caps", updCaps, t)
			guard("hud", updHud, t, b, dt)
			guard("bg", updBg, t, b)
			do
				local rot, zoom, ox, oy = 0, 1, 0, 0
				if b < 4 then
					zoom, rot, oy = 1 + 0.06 * ss(0, 4, b), 1.4 * sin(t * 0.7), sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
				elseif b < 10 then
					local k = clamp01((b - 4) / 6)
					rot, zoom, ox = lerp(-9, 4, ss(0, 1, k)) + 1.6 * sin(t * 1.3), 1.02 + 0.14 * k, sin(t * 0.6) * sy * 0.026
				elseif b < 18 then
					ox, rot, zoom = sin((b - 10) * 0.75) * sx * 0.028, 7 * ss(15.5, 17.9, b) * sin(t * 1.9), 1.04 + 0.10 * ss(13, 18, b)
				elseif b < 22 then
					rot, zoom, oy = 8 * sin(b * 1.25) * ss(18, 19.5, b), 1.06 + 0.03 * sin(b * 2), -sy * 0.04 * ss(18.5, 21.5, b)
				elseif b < 26 then
					local p = clamp01((b - 22.2) / 3.2)
					rot, zoom = 360 * eio(p), 1.08 + 0.5 * sin(pi * p)
				elseif b < 28.2 then
					local k = clamp01((b - 26) / 2.2)
					zoom, rot, oy = 1.16 - 0.16 * eo3(k), 2 * sin(t * 0.7), sin(t * 0.8) * sy * 0.02
				else
					local k = clamp01((b - 28.1) / 1.6)
					oy, zoom, rot = -sy * 0.05 * (1 - eo3(k)), 1.08 - 0.08 * eo3(k) + 0.012 * ss(29, 32, b), -1.2 * (1 - eo3(k))
				end
				E.ws.Scale = zoom + 0.012 * S.kick
				E.world.Rotation = rot
				local sh = S.shake * S.U * 0.012
				E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, oy + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
			end
			local fk = max(S.flashK, S.tflash, (t > B(31)) and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.95 * K.INT or 0)
			S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-9 * dt)
			E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
		end
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		build()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 10 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	pcall(function()
		local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256})
		TweenService:Create(fl, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(fl, 1.1)
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, PINK, 700, 0.7, 3)
		FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
	end)
	return true
end

function FX.Intro11(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
	FX.IntroCamBusy = true
	FX.IntroActive = true
	opts = opts or {}
	local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro11Data, opts.Song or {}
	local RunService, UserInputService, TweenService = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("TweenService")
	local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.21, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 115), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
	K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
	K.DUR = 60
	-- master timeline (seconds on the song clock): arrival 0 / surveillance T1 / runway T2 / fame T3 / reveal T4 / final shutter T5 / end 60
	local T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 = 10.12, 22.12, 35.17, 48.0, 57.0
	local TBREAK, TDROP, TSLAM = 39.86, 41.95, 48.21
	local floor, sin, cos, sqrt, max, min, abs, exp, pi, atan2 = math.floor, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.exp, math.pi, math.atan2
	local DEG, TAU = 180 / pi, pi * 2
	local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
	if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
	local GOLD, ROSE, RUBY, STEEL, NIGHT, PLUM, ICE, CHAMP = C(255, 200, 96), C(255, 86, 160), C(176, 16, 38), C(150, 156, 172), C(7, 6, 12), C(34, 14, 40), C(150, 214, 255), C(255, 236, 190)
	local PAL = {GOLD, ROSE, ICE, WHITE}
	local function cl(x, a, b) return x < a and a or (x > b and b or x) end
	local function clamp01(x) return cl(x, 0, 1) end
	local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
	local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - clamp01(x)) ^ 3 end
	local function ei3(x) x = clamp01(x) return x * x * x end
	local function eob(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 + 2.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 2 end
	local function eio(x) x = clamp01(x) return x < 0.5 and 4 * x * x * x or 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ^ 3 / 2 end
	local function ss(a, b, x) local k = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a)) return k * k * (3 - 2 * k) end
	local function mix(a, b, k) return Color3.new(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * k, a.G + (b.G - a.G) * k, a.B + (b.B - a.B) * k) end
	local function parse(s)
		local o = {}
		for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
		return o
	end
	local KICK, HAT, NOTE, WORD = parse(D.kick), parse(D.hat), parse(D.note), parse(D.word)
	local LEVEL, VOC = D.level, D.voc
	local function lvAt(str, t)
		local x = t * 10
		local i = floor(x)
		local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
		local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
		return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
	end
	local conns, E = {}, {}
	local S = {
		began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, fallback = false, t = 0, sc = 1,
		kick = 0, hk = 0, nt = 0, wd = 0, shake = 0, flashK = 0, tflash = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0, amb = 0, pulse = 0,
		ki = 0, hi = 0, ni = 0, wi = 0, sx = 800, sy = 450, U = 450, Rf = 500, lastPos = nil, lastPosAt = nil,
		pn = 0, ri = 0, fi = 0, kc = 0, wc = 0, cueT = -9, revealed = false, lt = {}, nextCap = 1,
	}
	local function mk(class, parent, props)
		local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
		if props then
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		end
		return o
	end
	local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local k = input.KeyCode
			if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
		end
	end)
	local function accent()
		if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
			return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
		elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
			return WHITE
		elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
			return Util.Color.Cur
		end
		return GOLD
	end
	local function box(par, z, col, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function lab(par, z, font, size, col, xa)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Text = ""})
	end
	local function grad(f, rot, c1, c2, t1, t2)
		mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = rot, Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(t1 or 0, t2 or 0)})
	end
	local function place(f, x, y, w, h, rot, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 0.5), max(h, 0.5))
		f.Rotation = rot or 0
		if tr then f.BackgroundTransparency = tr end
	end
	local function line(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, tr)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), 0.5), max(th, 0.5))
		f.Rotation = atan2(dy, dx) * DEG
		if tr then f.BackgroundTransparency = tr end
	end
	local function beam(f, ox, oy, a, len, w, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox + sin(a) * len / 2, oy + cos(a) * len / 2)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 1), max(len, 1))
		f.Rotation = -a * DEG
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local NP, NRG, NF = 56, 6, 14
	local PT, PTX, PTY, PVX, PVY, PL, PM, PS, PG = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local RG, FL = {}, {}
	local NCR, NPH, NPAN, NBM, NPIL, NSTR, NGX, NGY, NRAY, NTK = 18, 9, 7, 4, 7, 22, 8, 5, 16, 36
	local TITLE = "PAPARAZZI"
	local CAPS = {{0, "00:00  //  THE ARRIVAL"}, {T1, "00:10  //  THE SURVEILLANCE"}, {T2, "00:22  //  THE RUNWAY"}, {T3, "00:35  //  THE FAME"}, {T4, "00:48  //  THE REVEAL"}}
	local SF = {"1.4", "2", "2.8", "4", "5.6", "8", "11", "16"}
	local GW = {"FAME", "FLASH", "SHOOT", "SPOTLIGHT", "GLAM", "CLICK", "STAR", "LOOK"}
	local function figure(par, z, col)
		local o = {skirt = {}}
		o.hair = box(par, z, col, 0, 0.5)
		o.head = box(par, z + 1, col, 0, 0.5)
		o.torso = box(par, z, col, 0, 0.3)
		for i = 1, 8 do o.skirt[i] = box(par, z, col, 0, 0.2) end
		o.armL, o.armR = box(par, z, col, 0, 0.5), box(par, z, col, 0, 0.5)
		o.rim = box(par, z - 1, WHITE, 0.82, 0.5)
		return o
	end
	local function placeFigure(o, cx, by, h, tr, sway)
		sway = sway or 0
		local hr = h * 0.062
		local hx, hy = cx + sway * h * 0.01, by - h * 0.9
		place(o.hair, hx - hr * 0.3, hy + hr * 0.3, hr * 3.1, hr * 3.1, 0, tr)
		place(o.head, hx, hy, hr * 2, hr * 2.3, 0, tr)
		place(o.torso, cx, by - h * 0.66, h * 0.12, h * 0.34, 0, tr)
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local k = (i - 1) / 7
			place(o.skirt[i], cx, by - h * 0.5 + (i - 0.5) * h * 0.5 / 8, h * (0.13 + 0.30 * k ^ 1.4) + sin(sway + i) * h * 0.004, h * 0.5 / 8 + 1.5, 0, tr)
		end
		line(o.armL, cx - h * 0.06, by - h * 0.8, cx - h * 0.17, by - h * 0.56, h * 0.032, tr)
		line(o.armR, cx + h * 0.06, by - h * 0.8, cx + h * 0.18, by - h * 0.97 - sway * h * 0.01, h * 0.032, tr)
		place(o.rim, cx, by - h * 0.5, h * 0.5, h * 1.0, 0, 1)
	end
	local function setFig(o, vis)
		o.hair.Visible, o.head.Visible, o.torso.Visible, o.armL.Visible, o.armR.Visible = vis, vis, vis, vis, vis
		for i = 1, 8 do o.skirt[i].Visible = vis end
		o.rim.Visible = false
	end
	local function build()
		E.bg = box(stage, 1, NIGHT, 0)
		E.bg.Size, E.bg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.world = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false})
		E.ws = mk("UIScale", E.world, {Scale = 1})
		local function layer(z) return mk("Frame", E.world, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 3, Interactable = false}) end
		E.lA, E.lB, E.lC, E.lD, E.lE, E.lX = layer(3), layer(3), layer(3), layer(3), layer(4), layer(9)
		-- [A] arrival: hazy far horizon, crowd silhouettes, bokeh
		E.hz = box(E.lA, 1, C(255, 170, 90), 0.5)
		grad(E.hz, 90, WHITE, C(255, 120, 150), 1, 0.15)
		E.hl = box(E.lA, 2, CHAMP, 0.6)
		E.sil = {}
		for i = 1, 18 do E.sil[i] = {b = box(E.lA, 3, BLACK, 0, 0.35), h = box(E.lA, 3, BLACK, 0, 0.5), c = box(E.lA, 3, BLACK, 0, 0.1), x = (i - 0.5) / 18 + (((i * 37) % 7) - 3) * 0.004, s = 0.8 + ((i * 53) % 5) * 0.1, arm = (i * 29) % 3 == 0} end
		E.bk = {}
		for i = 1, 22 do E.bk[i] = {f = box(E.lA, 2, (i % 3 == 0) and ICE or ((i % 3 == 1) and GOLD or ROSE), 0.6, 0.5), x = math.random(), y = 0.35 + math.random() * 0.3, s = 0.01 + math.random() * 0.03, p = math.random() * TAU, q = 0.6 + math.random() * 2} end
		-- [B] boutique: wall, mirror panels, sign, chandelier, beams, photographers
		E.bw = box(E.lB, 1, WHITE, 0)
		grad(E.bw, 90, C(46, 20, 54), C(10, 8, 16))
		E.fl = box(E.lB, 2, WHITE, 0)
		grad(E.fl, 90, C(30, 18, 40), C(4, 3, 8))
		E.pan = {}
		for i = 1, NPAN do
			local p = mk("Frame", E.lB, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, ClipsDescendants = true, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)})
			grad(p, 90, C(86, 64, 100), C(16, 12, 26))
			mk("UIStroke", p, {Thickness = 2, Color = GOLD, Transparency = 0.35})
			local st = mk("Frame", p, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.75, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.28, 1.8), Rotation = 24})

	local warned = {}
	local function guard(tag, fn, a, b2, c2)
		local ok, e = pcall(fn, a, b2, c2)
		if not ok and not warned[tag] then
			warned[tag] = true
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 11 " .. tag .. " (continuing): " .. tostring(e))
		end
	end
	local function emit(x, y, vx, vy, size, col, life, grav)
		for n = 1, NP do
			local i = (S.pn + n - 1) % NP + 1
			if PL[i] <= 0 then
				S.pn = i
				PTX[i], PTY[i], PVX[i], PVY[i], PL[i], PM[i], PS[i], PG[i] = x, y, vx, vy, life, life, size, grav or 0
				E.pt[i].BackgroundColor3 = col
				E.pt[i].Visible = true
				return
			end
		end
	end
	local function updParts(dt)
		for i = 1, NP do
			if PL[i] > 0 then
				PL[i] = PL[i] - dt
				if PL[i] <= 0 then
					E.pt[i].Visible = false
				else
					PVY[i] = PVY[i] + PG[i] * dt
					PTX[i], PTY[i] = PTX[i] + PVX[i] * dt, PTY[i] + PVY[i] * dt
					local k = PL[i] / PM[i]
					place(E.pt[i], PTX[i], PTY[i], PS[i] * (0.4 + k), PS[i] * (0.4 + k), 0, 1 - k * 0.9)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function ringAt(x, y, r0, r1, dur, col, th)
		S.ri = S.ri % NRG + 1
		local r = RG[S.ri]
		r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1, r.t0, r.d = x, y, r0, r1, S.t, dur
		r.st.Color, r.st.Thickness = col, th
		r.f.Visible = true
	end
	local function updRings(t)
		for i = 1, NRG do
			local r = RG[i]
			if r.d then
				local k = (t - r.t0) / r.d
				if k >= 1 then
					r.f.Visible = false
					r.d = nil
				else
					local rad = lerp(r.r0, r.r1, eo3(k))
					place(r.f, r.x, r.y, rad * 2, rad * 2, 0, 1)
					r.st.Transparency = clamp01(k) ^ 0.7
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function flashAt(x, y, size, col)
		S.fi = S.fi % NF + 1
		local f = FL[S.fi]
		f.t0, f.sz, f.x, f.y = S.t, size, x, y
		local o = E.fx[S.fi]
		o.c.BackgroundColor3, o.h.BackgroundColor3, o.v.BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, col or WHITE, col or WHITE
		o.c.Visible, o.h.Visible, o.v.Visible = true, true, true
		S.amb = max(S.amb, 0.35)
	end
	local function updFlashes(t)
		for i = 1, NF do
			local f = FL[i]
			if f.t0 > -5 then
				local k = (t - f.t0) / 0.34
				local o = E.fx[i]
				if k >= 1 or k < 0 then
					o.c.Visible, o.h.Visible, o.v.Visible = false, false, false
					f.t0 = -9
				else
					local a = (1 - k) ^ 1.5
					local s = f.sz * (0.5 + 0.9 * (1 - a))
					place(o.c, f.x, f.y, s * 0.55, s * 0.55, 0, 1 - a)
					place(o.h, f.x, f.y, s * 3.2 * (0.4 + a), max(2, s * 0.05), 0, 1 - a * 0.9)
					place(o.v, f.x, f.y, max(2, s * 0.05), s * 1.8 * (0.4 + a), 0, 1 - a * 0.9)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function burst(x, y, n, spd, cols, life)
		for i = 1, n do
			local a = math.random() * TAU
			local v = S.U * spd * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.8)
			emit(x, y, cos(a) * v, sin(a) * v, max(3, S.U * 0.012), cols[i % #cols + 1], life or 1, S.U * 0.45)
		end
	end
	local function hit(str)
		S.kick = 1
		S.shake = max(S.shake, str * K.INT)
		S.pulse = 1
		ringAt(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.5, S.U * 0.05, S.U * 0.75, 0.7, accent(), 3)
	end
	local function snapPhotog(i, big)
		local P = E.ph[i]
		if not P then return end
		P.f = 1
		flashAt(P.cx or S.sx * P.x, P.cy or S.sy * 0.72, S.U * (big and 0.34 or 0.2), WHITE)
	end
	local function onKick(str)
		S.kc = S.kc + 1
		local sc = S.sc
		S.amb = max(S.amb, 0.2 + 0.1 * str)
		if sc == 1 then
			if S.t > 3 and (S.kc % 3 == 0 or str >= 3) and math.random() < 0.55 then
				local i = math.random(1, 18)
				flashAt(S.sx * E.sil[i].x, S.sy * 0.66, S.U * 0.16, WHITE)
			end
			if str >= 3 and S.t > 5 then S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.2 * K.INT) end
		elseif sc == 2 then
			local ramp = ss(T1, T2, S.t)
			local n = 1 + floor(ramp * 3 + math.random() * 1.2)
			for _ = 1, n do snapPhotog(math.random(1, 3 + floor(6 * ramp)), str >= 3) end
			if str >= 3 then S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.3 * K.INT) end
		elseif sc == 3 then
			S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.28 * K.INT)
			for _ = 1, 1 + floor(str / 2) do
				local sd = (math.random() < 0.5) and 0.08 or 0.92
				flashAt(S.sx * sd + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.06, S.sy * (0.55 + math.random() * 0.3), S.U * 0.26, WHITE)
			end
			if str >= 3 then ringAt(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.55, S.U * 0.05, S.U * 0.55, 0.6, GOLD, 2) end
		elseif sc == 4 then
			local dark = S.t >= TBREAK and S.t < TDROP
			if not dark then
				hit(0.5 + 0.2 * str)
				for _ = 1, 5 do
					local g = E.dg[math.random(1, #E.dg)]
					g.v = 1
				end
				if str >= 3 then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.22 * K.INT) end
				burst(S.sx / 2, S.sy / 2, 4, 0.6, {GOLD, WHITE, ROSE}, 0.8)
			else
				S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.1 * K.INT)
			end
		else
			if S.t >= TSLAM then
				S.kick = 1
				S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.15 * K.INT)
				burst(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.3, 3, 0.5, {GOLD, WHITE}, 0.8)
				if S.kc % 2 == 0 then flashAt(S.sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), S.sy * (0.2 + math.random() * 0.5), S.U * 0.22, WHITE) end
			end
		end
	end
	local function onWord(str)
		S.wd = 1
		S.wc = S.wc + 1
		if S.sc == 4 and not (S.t >= TBREAK and S.t < TDROP) then
			E.gw.Text = GW[S.wc % #GW + 1]
			E.gw.Rotation = (math.random() - 0.5) * 8
		end
	end
	local function onCue(t)
		if abs(t - S.cueT) < 0.2 then return end
		S.cueT = t
		S.tflash = max(S.tflash, 0.9 * K.INT)
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.6 * K.INT)
		ringAt(S.sx / 2, S.sy / 2, S.U * 0.05, S.U * 1.1, 0.9, accent(), 4)
		for _ = 1, 3 do flashAt(S.sx * (0.15 + math.random() * 0.7), S.sy * (0.25 + math.random() * 0.45), S.U * 0.3, WHITE) end
	end
	-- aperture radius over the master timeline
	local function apertureR(t)
		local Rf, U = S.Rf, S.U
		if t < 8.56 then
			return lerp(0.04 * U, 0.34 * U, ss(1.4, 8.4, t) ^ 1.25) * (1 + 0.015 * sin(t * 1.7))
		elseif t < T1 + 0.3 then
			return lerp(0.34 * U, Rf, eio((t - 8.56) / (T1 + 0.3 - 8.56)))
		elseif t < TBREAK then
			return Rf
		elseif t < TDROP then
			return lerp(Rf, 0.26 * U, eio((t - TBREAK) / (TDROP - TBREAK)))
		elseif t < TDROP + 0.4 then
			return lerp(0.26 * U, Rf, eo3((t - TDROP) / 0.4))
		elseif t < T5 then
			return Rf
		elseif t < 58.75 then
			return lerp(Rf, 0, eio((t - T5) / (58.75 - T5)))
		elseif t < 58.95 then
			return 0
		end
		return lerp(0, Rf, eo3((t - 58.95) / 1.05))
	end
	local function updBlades(t, dt)
		local Rf, U, sx, sy = S.Rf, S.U, S.sx, S.sy
		local vis = (t < 1.2) and 0 or ss(1.2, 2.6, t)
		local R = apertureR(t)
		local phi = t * 0.045 + ((t >= T5) and (t - T5) * 0.35 or 0) + ((t >= TBREAK and t < TDROP + 0.4) and ss(TBREAK, TDROP, t) * 0.6 or 0)
		local open = R >= Rf * 0.998 or vis <= 0
		for i = 1, 8 do E.bl[i].Visible = not open end
		E.hg.Visible = (not open) and t < 8.9
		for i = 1, 3 do E.lr[i].Visible = (not open) and R < U * 0.9 end
		for i = 1, 8 do E.sf[i].Visible = (not open) and R < U * 0.5 end
		if open then return end
		local cx, cy = sx / 2, sy / 2
		local lit = clamp01(0.1 + S.amb * 0.9 + S.kick * 0.25)
		local col = mix(C(104, 108, 122), C(255, 250, 235), lit)
		local H = Rf * 1.25
		local W = (R + H) * 1.12
		local d = R + H / 2
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local th = phi + (i - 1) * pi / 4
			local f = E.bl[i]
			f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + cos(th) * d, cy + sin(th) * d)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
			f.Rotation = th * DEG + 90
			f.BackgroundColor3 = col
			f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vis
			E.bls[i].Transparency = 1 - vis * (0.5 + 0.4 * lit)
			local l = E.sf[i]
			local ta = phi + (i - 1) * pi / 4 + pi / 8
			local rr = R + U * 0.07
			l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + cos(ta) * rr, cy + sin(ta) * rr)
			l.Rotation = ta * DEG + 90
			l.TextTransparency = 1 - vis * (0.25 + 0.5 * lit)
		end
		place(E.hg, cx, cy, R * 1.96, R * 1.96, 0, 0.45 - 0.35 * clamp01(S.amb + S.kick * 0.3))
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local rr = R * (1 + 0.12 * (i - 1)) + U * 0.01 * (i - 1)
			place(E.lr[i], cx, cy, rr * 2, rr * 2, 0, 1)
			E.lrs[i].Transparency = 1 - vis * 0.55
		end
	end
	local function updA(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local a = clamp01(0.06 + S.amb * 0.9 + S.lv * 0.25)
		place(E.hz, sx / 2, sy * 0.66, sx * 1.1, sy * 0.4, 0, 1 - a * 0.75)
		place(E.hl, sx / 2, sy * 0.74, sx * 1.1, max(2, U * 0.004), 0, 1 - a * 0.9)
		for i = 1, 18 do
			local o = E.sil[i]
			local x, s = sx * o.x, U * 0.085 * o.s
			local by = sy * 0.78 + (i % 2) * U * 0.02
			local bob = sin(t * 2 + i) * s * 0.02
			place(o.b, x, by - s * 0.9 + bob, s * 0.55, s * 1.3, 0, 0)
			place(o.h, x, by - s * 1.72 + bob, s * 0.42, s * 0.46, 0, 0)
			place(o.c, x + s * 0.12, by - s * (o.arm and 1.82 or 1.5) + bob, s * 0.3, s * 0.2, 0, 0)
		end
		for i = 1, 22 do
			local o = E.bk[i]
			local tw = 0.35 + 0.65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * o.q + o.p))
			place(o.f, sx * o.x, sy * o.y, U * o.s * 2, U * o.s * 2, 0, 1 - 0.55 * tw * (0.3 + a))
		end
	end
	local function updB(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local ramp = ss(T1 - 1, T2, t)
		place(E.bw, sx / 2, sy * 0.4, sx * 1.1, sy * 0.85, 0, 0)
		place(E.fl, sx / 2, sy * 0.88, sx * 1.1, sy * 0.3, 0, 0)
		local pw = sx * 0.12
		for i = 1, NPAN do
			local o = E.pan[i]
			local x = sx * (0.08 + 0.84 * (i - 1) / (NPAN - 1))
			o.f.Position, o.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, sy * 0.44), UDim2.fromOffset(pw, sy * 0.56)
			o.st.Position = UDim2.fromScale(((t * 0.22 + i * 0.19) % 1.6) - 0.3, 0.5)
			o.st.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 - 0.3 * clamp01(S.amb + S.hk * 0.4)
		end
		E.sign.TextSize = max(10, U * 0.04)
		E.sign.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, sy * 0.1)
		E.sign.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, U * 0.06)
		E.sign.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(T1 - 0.5, T1 + 1.2, t) * 0.9
		place(E.signL, sx / 2, sy * 0.145, sx * 0.5 * ss(T1, T1 + 1.5, t), 2, 0, 0.4)
		for i = 1, 11 do
			local o = E.chd[i]
			local x = sx * (0.04 + 0.92 * (i - 1) / 10)
			local y = sy * (0.2 + 0.03 * sin(i * 1.3) + 0.008 * sin(t * 2 + o.p))
			local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 3 + o.p) * 0.4 + S.hk * 0.3
			place(E.chd[i].f, x, y, U * 0.02, U * 0.02, 0, 0.5 - 0.4 * tw)
			place(E.chd[i].g, x, y, U * 0.09, U * 0.09, 0, 0.9 - 0.25 * tw - 0.25 * S.amb)
		end
		for i = 1, NBM do
			local a = sin(t * (0.5 + i * 0.17) + i * 1.9) * 0.55 + (i - 2.5) * 0.12
			beam(E.bm[i], sx * (0.15 + 0.23 * (i - 1)), -U * 0.02, a, sy * 1.2, U * (0.07 + 0.04 * ramp), 0.72 - 0.25 * ramp - 0.2 * S.lv)
		end
		local act = 3 + floor(6 * ramp)
		for i = 1, NPH do
			local P = E.ph[i]
			P.f = P.f * exp(-9 * dt)
			local on = i <= act
			P.b.Visible, P.h.Visible, P.c.Visible, P.l.Visible = on, on, on, on
			if on then
				local x, s = sx * P.x, U * 0.24 * P.s
				local by = sy * 1.02
				local bob = sin(t * 3 + i * 1.7) * s * 0.03 + P.f * s * 0.03
				P.cx, P.cy = x + s * 0.16, by - s * 1.34 + bob
				place(P.b, x, by - s * 0.5 + bob, s * 0.9, s * 1.2, 0, 0)
				place(P.h, x, by - s * 1.3 + bob, s * 0.5, s * 0.56, 0, 0)
				place(P.c, P.cx, P.cy, s * 0.5, s * 0.3, 0, 0)
				place(P.l, P.cx + s * 0.08, P.cy, s * 0.16, s * 0.16, 0, 0.5 - P.f * 0.5)
			end
		end
		if S.pn >= 0 and ramp > 0.1 and math.random() < dt * 5 * ramp then
			emit(sx * math.random(), sy * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.5), 0, -U * 0.04, max(2, U * 0.006), CHAMP, 1.6, 0)
		end
	end
	local function pz(z) return z * z end
	local function updC(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local hy = sy * 0.4
		local cx = sx / 2
		place(E.rb, sx / 2, hy / 2 + sy * 0.05, sx * 1.1, hy + sy * 0.1, 0, 0)
		place(E.rg, sx / 2, hy + (sy - hy) / 2 + 2, sx * 1.1, sy - hy + 4, 0, 0)
		local function ch(p) return sx * (0.012 + 0.40 * p) end
		local sc, fl = t * 1.5, floor(t * 1.5)
		local fr = sc - fl
		for i = 1, NSTR do
			local z0, z1 = (i - 1 + fr) / NSTR, (i + fr) / NSTR
			local p0, p1 = pz(z0), pz(z1)
			local y0, y1 = hy + (sy - hy) * p0, hy + (sy - hy) * p1
			local f = E.rs[i]
			local par = (i + fl) % 2
			f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(par == 0 and C(150, 12, 32) or C(112, 8, 26), C(255, 80, 90), clamp01(S.amb * 0.35 + S.kick * 0.2) * (0.3 + p1))
			place(f, cx, (y0 + y1) / 2, ch(p1) * 2, max(1, y1 - y0 + 1), 0, 0)
		end
		line(E.re[1], cx - ch(0), hy, cx - ch(1), sy + 4, max(2, U * 0.008), 0.1)
		line(E.re[2], cx + ch(0), hy, cx + ch(1), sy + 4, max(2, U * 0.008), 0.1)
		local scr = (t * 0.33) % 1
		for i = 1, NPIL do
			local z = ((i - 1) + scr) / NPIL
			local p = pz(z)
			local by = hy + (sy - hy) * p
			local ph, pw2 = sy * (0.05 + 0.62 * p), sx * (0.004 + 0.028 * p)
			for s = 1, 2 do
				local sg = (s == 1) and -1 or 1
				local x = cx + sg * ch(p) * 1.55
				local o = E.rp[i][s]
				place(o.p, x, by - ph / 2, pw2, ph, 0, 0.05)
				place(o.g, x, by - ph, pw2 * 5, pw2 * 5, 0, 0.7 - 0.3 * S.amb - 0.15 * S.lv)
				place(o.r, x, by + ph * 0.25, pw2 * 1.3, ph * 0.5, 0, 0.55)
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local a = sin(t * (0.9 + i * 0.3) + i * 2.1) * 0.5 + (i - 2) * 0.25
			local ox = sx * (0.2 + 0.3 * (i - 1))
			beam(E.rbm[i], ox, -U * 0.03, a, sy * 1.1, U * 0.1, 0.7 - 0.22 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse)
			local ex, ey = ox + sin(a) * sy * 1.05, sy * 0.05 + cos(a) * sy * 1.05
			place(E.rsp[i], cl(ex, sx * 0.1, sx * 0.9), hy + (sy - hy) * (0.55 + 0.3 * i / 3), U * 0.5, U * 0.1, 0, 0.82 - 0.2 * S.lv)
		end
		local k = ss(T2, T3 - 0.4, t)
		local z = 0.04 + 0.6 * k
		local p = pz(z)
		local by = hy + (sy - hy) * p
		local h = sy * (0.05 + 0.55 * p)
		setFig(E.my, true)
		placeFigure(E.my, cx, by, h, 0, t * 4 * (1 + 2 * z))
		place(E.myH, cx, by - h * 0.55, h * 0.9, h * 1.3, 0, 0.74 - 0.15 * S.amb)
		if math.random() < dt * 14 then
			emit(sx * (0.15 + 0.7 * math.random()), sy * (0.7 + 0.28 * math.random()), (math.random() - 0.5) * U * 0.05, -U * (0.05 + math.random() * 0.1), max(2, U * 0.008), (math.random() < 0.5) and GOLD or CHAMP, 2.2, 0)
		end
	end
	local function updD(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local cx, cy = sx / 2, sy / 2
		local dark = t >= TBREAK and t < TDROP
		local post = t >= TDROP
		local ph = ss(TBREAK, TDROP, t)
		local pal = PAL[floor(max(0, t - T3) / K.BAR) % #PAL + 1]
		local intensity = dark and (0.15 - 0.1 * ph) or (0.5 + 0.5 * S.lv + 0.5 * S.kick)
		local rot = t * (post and 0.5 or 0.25) + (post and S.kick * 0.05 or 0)
		for i = 1, NRAY do
			local a = rot + (i - 1) * TAU / NRAY
			local L = max(sx, sy) * 1.2
			local f = E.dr[i]
			f.BackgroundColor3 = pal
			f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + cos(a) * L / 2, cy + sin(a) * L / 2)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(L, U * (0.05 + 0.03 * (i % 3)) * (0.7 + 0.5 * S.kick))
			f.Rotation = a * DEG
			f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(intensity * 0.45)
		end
		for _, g in ipairs(E.dg) do
			g.v = g.v * exp(-7 * dt)
			local w, h = sx / NGX, sy / NGY
			place(g.f, (g.x - 0.5) * w, (g.y - 0.5) * h, w * 0.94, h * 0.94, 0, 1 - g.v * 0.5 * (dark and 0.1 or 1))
			g.f.BackgroundColor3 = pal
		end
		local R = U * (0.30 + 0.02 * S.kick) * (dark and (1 - 0.55 * ph) or 1)
		local r2 = R * 1.22
		for i = 1, NTK do
			local a = -rot * 1.3 + (i - 1) * TAU / NTK
			local len = (i % 3 == 0) and U * 0.05 or U * 0.025
			place(E.tk[i], cx + cos(a) * r2, cy + sin(a) * r2, len, max(2, U * 0.006), a * DEG, 0.1)
		end
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local a = rot * 1.7 + (i - 1) * pi / 4
			line(E.sp[i], cx + cos(a) * R * 0.25, cy + sin(a) * R * 0.25, cx + cos(a) * R, cy + sin(a) * R, max(2, U * 0.01), 0.35)
		end
		place(E.hub[1], cx, cy, R * 0.9, R * 0.9, 0, 0)
		place(E.hub[2], cx, cy, R * 0.55, R * 0.55, 0, 0.4 - 0.3 * S.kick)
		place(E.hub[3], cx, cy, R * 0.2 * (1 + S.kick), R * 0.2 * (1 + S.kick), 0, 0.1)
		E.hubS.Color = pal
		E.gw.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
		E.gw.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy * 0.4)
		E.gw.TextSize = max(24, U * 0.3)
		E.gw.TextTransparency = (dark or t >= T4 - 0.1) and 1 or (1 - S.wd * 0.55)
		E.gw.TextColor3 = pal
		if post and math.random() < dt * 12 then
			emit(sx * math.random(), sy * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.2), (math.random() - 0.5) * U * 0.1, -U * (0.2 + math.random() * 0.4), max(2, U * 0.009), pal, 1.6, 0)
		end
		if dark and math.random() < dt * 6 then
			local a = math.random() * TAU
			emit(cx + cos(a) * U * 0.9, cy + sin(a) * U * 0.9, -cos(a) * U * 0.8, -sin(a) * U * 0.8, max(2, U * 0.008), WHITE, 1.0, 0)
		end
	end
	local function updE(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local cx = sx / 2
		local lit = t >= TSLAM
		local pre = ss(T4, TSLAM, t)
		local by = sy * 0.98
		local fh = sy * 0.78
		place(E.cone, cx, sy * 0.5, U * 0.9 * (0.4 + 0.6 * pre), sy * 1.05, 0, lit and (0.55 - 0.15 * S.kick) or (0.9 - 0.3 * pre))
		place(E.fg, cx, by - sy * 0.01, U * 1.1, U * 0.16, 0, lit and 0.45 or 0.9)
		setFig(E.star, lit)
		if lit then
			placeFigure(E.star, cx, by, fh * (1 + 0.012 * S.kick) * (1 + 0.05 * ss(TSLAM, T5, t)), 0, sin(t * 1.4) * 2)
		end
		local lw = min(sx * 0.098, U * 0.27)
		local ts = lw * 1.55
		local n = #TITLE
		local ty = sy * 0.27
		for i = 1, n do
			local l = E.tl[i]
			local tk = TSLAM + (i - 1) * K.BEAT / 2
			local a = t - tk
			if a < 0 then
				l.Visible = false
			else
				if not S.lt[i] then
					S.lt[i] = true
					local x = cx + (i - (n + 1) / 2) * lw
					flashAt(x, ty, U * 0.3, WHITE)
					ringAt(x, ty, U * 0.02, U * 0.22, 0.45, GOLD, 2)
					burst(x, ty, 5, 0.45, {GOLD, WHITE, CHAMP}, 0.8)
					S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.35 * K.INT)
					if i == 1 then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.9 * K.INT) end
				end
				local k = clamp01(a / 0.24)
				local sc = lerp(2.6, 1, eob(k))
				l.Visible = true
				l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + (i - (n + 1) / 2) * lw, ty + (1 - eo3(k)) * -sy * 0.12)
				l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lw * 1.1, ts * 1.2)
				l.TextSize = ts * sc
				l.Rotation = (1 - eo3(k)) * ((i % 2 == 0) and 9 or -9)
				l.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(0, 0.1, a)
				E.tls[i].Transparency = 0.15 + (1 - k) * 0.5
			end
		end
		local tw = lw * n
		E.tt.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, ty)
		E.tt.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tw, ts * 1.25)
		local sp = ((t - (TSLAM + 1.9)) % K.BAR) / K.BAR
		E.shine.Visible = t >= TSLAM + 1.9
		E.shine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(-tw * 0.2, tw * 1.2, sp), ts * 0.62)
		E.shine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tw * 0.14, ts * 2)
		local ua = ss(TSLAM + 2.0, TSLAM + 2.8, t)
		place(E.ul, cx, ty + ts * 0.72, tw * 0.95 * ua, max(2, U * 0.006), 0, 0.15)
		E.by.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, ty + ts * 0.98)
		E.by.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, U * 0.05)
		E.by.TextSize = max(11, U * 0.034)
		E.by.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(TSLAM + 2.6, TSLAM + 3.4, t) * (1 - 0.3 * 0)
		place(E.ea, cx, ty, tw * 1.25, ts * 1.6, 0, 1)
	end
	local function updHud(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local h = sy * 0.075 * ss(0.3, 2.2, t) * (1 - 0.35 * ss(TBREAK, TDROP - 0.1, t) * (t < TDROP and 1 or 0))
		E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
		local fk = max(S.flashK, S.tflash)
		S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-9 * dt)
		S.tflash = S.tflash * exp(-8 * dt)
		E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
		E.tag.Text = string.format("PAPARAZZI  //  %d BPM  //  %s", floor((SONG.Bpm or 115) + 0.5), (floor(t * 2) % 2 == 0) and "REC ●" or "REC  ")
		E.tc.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", floor(t / 60), floor(t) % 60, floor((t % 1) * 30))
		for i = 1, 8 do
			E.gr[i].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random() * sx, math.random() * sy)
			E.gr[i].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(1, 3), math.random(1, 3))
			E.gr[i].BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 + math.random() * 0.09
		end
		local capIdx
		for i = #CAPS, 1, -1 do
			if t >= CAPS[i][1] + 0.25 then capIdx = i break end
		end
		if capIdx and t < T5 then
			local c0 = CAPS[capIdx][1] + 0.25
			E.cap.Text = CAPS[capIdx][2]
			E.cap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, sy - h - 16)
			E.cap.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.6, 18)
			E.cap.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(c0, c0 + 0.5, t) * (1 - ss(c0 + 2.4, c0 + 3.2, t)) * 0.9
		else
			E.cap.TextTransparency = 1
		end
	end
	local CUES = {T1, T2, T3, TDROP, TSLAM, T5}
	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.term.Text = ""
			E.world.Visible = true
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		while true do
			local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.flashLen = 0.35
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
			S.t = t
			S.sc = (t < T1 and 1) or (t < T2 and 2) or (t < T3 and 3) or (t < T4 and 4) or 5
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			local sx, sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			S.sx, S.sy, S.U = sx, sy, min(sx, sy)
			S.Rf = 0.5 * sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) * 1.08
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(LEVEL, t), 1 - exp(-14 * dt))
			S.vc = lerp(S.vc, lvAt(VOC, t), 1 - exp(-20 * dt))
			S.kick = S.kick * exp(-8.5 * dt)
			S.hk = S.hk * exp(-14 * dt)
			S.nt = S.nt * exp(-9 * dt)
			S.wd = S.wd * exp(-6 * dt)
			S.shake = S.shake * exp(-10 * dt)
			S.pulse = S.pulse * exp(-6 * dt)
			S.amb = S.amb * exp(-5 * dt)
			while CUES[S.nextCap] and t >= CUES[S.nextCap] do
				if t - CUES[S.nextCap] < 0.3 and S.nextCap ~= 6 then guard("cue", onCue, CUES[S.nextCap]) end
				S.nextCap = S.nextCap + 1
			end
			while KICK[S.ki + 1] and KICK[S.ki + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ki = S.ki + 1
				if t - KICK[S.ki][1] < 0.15 then guard("kick", onKick, KICK[S.ki][2]) end
			end
			while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.hi = S.hi + 1
				if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
			end
			while NOTE[S.ni + 1] and NOTE[S.ni + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ni = S.ni + 1
				if t - NOTE[S.ni][1] < 0.15 then S.nt = 1 end
			end
			while WORD[S.wi + 1] and WORD[S.wi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.wi = S.wi + 1
				if t - WORD[S.wi][1] < 0.15 then guard("word", onWord, WORD[S.wi][2]) end
			end
			local final = t >= 58.9
			if final and not S.revealed then
				S.revealed = true
				stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				E.world.Visible, E.bg.Visible = false, false
				for i = 1, #E.vg do E.vg[i].Visible = false end
				for i = 1, 8 do E.gr[i].Visible = false end
				E.lbT.Visible, E.lbB.Visible, E.flash.Visible, E.cap.Visible, E.tag.Visible, E.tc.Visible, E.skip.Visible, E.hg.Visible = false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false
			end
			if not final then
				E.lA.Visible = t < T1 + 0.45
				E.lB.Visible = t >= 8.3 and t < T2
				E.lC.Visible = t >= T2 and t < T3
				E.lD.Visible = t >= T3 and t < T5 + 0.1
				E.lE.Visible = t >= T4 - 0.1
				if E.lA.Visible then guard("arrival", updA, t, dt) end
				if E.lB.Visible then guard("boutique", updB, t, dt) end
				if E.lC.Visible then guard("runway", updC, t, dt) end
				if E.lD.Visible then guard("fame", updD, t, dt) end
				if E.lE.Visible then guard("reveal", updE, t, dt) end
				E.bg.BackgroundColor3 = (t >= T3 and t < T4) and mix(NIGHT, PAL[floor(max(0, t - T3) / K.BAR) % #PAL + 1], 0.16 * (0.4 + S.lv + S.kick * 0.5) * ((t >= TBREAK and t < TDROP) and 0.2 or 1)) or NIGHT
				E.lbT.Visible, E.lbB.Visible = true, true
				guard("parts", updParts, dt)
				guard("rings", updRings, t)
				guard("flashes", updFlashes, t)
				guard("hud", updHud, t, dt)
			end
			guard("blades", updBlades, t, dt)
			if not final then
				local rot, zoom, ox, oy = 0, 1, 0, 0
				if t < T1 then
					local k = t / T1
					zoom, rot, oy = 1 + 0.12 * ss(0, 1, k), 1.2 * sin(t * 0.6), sin(t * 0.8) * sy * 0.012
				elseif t < T2 then
					local k = (t - T1) / (T2 - T1)
					ox, rot, zoom = sin((t - T1) * 0.45) * sx * 0.03, lerp(-3, 3, ss(0, 1, k)) + 1.2 * sin(t * 1.1), 1.02 + 0.10 * k
				elseif t < T3 then
					local k = (t - T2) / (T3 - T2)
					zoom, rot, oy, ox = 1.0 + 0.2 * eio(k), 2.4 * sin(t * 0.7) + 4 * ss(0.7, 1, k) * sin(t * 6), -sy * 0.03 * k, sin(t * 0.5) * sx * 0.012
				elseif t < T4 then
					local k = (t - T3) / (T4 - T3)
					local dark = t >= TBREAK and t < TDROP
					zoom = 1.05 + 0.16 * ss(0.3, 0.55, k) * (dark and 0.5 or 1) + 0.06 * S.kick
					rot = (t < TBREAK and 5 * sin(t * 1.3) or (dark and -6 * ss(TBREAK, TDROP, t) or 360 * eio((t - TDROP) / 2.4) * 0 + 4 * sin(t * 2.2)))
				elseif t < T5 then
					local k = (t - T4) / (T5 - T4)
					zoom, rot, oy = 1.12 - 0.12 * eo3(k * 1.6) + 0.04 * S.kick, 1.6 * sin(t * 0.8), sin(t * 0.6) * sy * 0.012
				else
					zoom, rot = 1.0 + 0.1 * ss(T5, 58.75, t), 3 * ss(T5, 58.75, t)
				end
				E.ws.Scale = zoom
				E.world.Rotation = rot
				local sh = S.shake * S.U * 0.012
				E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, oy + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
				-- camera click at the closing shutter
				if t >= 58.7 and t < 58.9 then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.9 * K.INT * (1 - (t - 58.7) / 0.2)) end
			end
		end
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		build()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 11 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	pcall(function()
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 900, 0.8, 4)
		FX.BlurPulse(10, 0.04, 0.8)
	end)
	return true
end
