function FX.Intro12(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
	FX.IntroCamBusy = true
	FX.IntroActive = true
	opts = opts or {}
	local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro12Data, opts.Song or {}
	local RunService, UserInputService = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.055, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 92.93), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
	K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
	K.DUR = K.OFF + 25 * K.BAR - 0.04
	local function BS(n) return K.OFF + (n - 1) * K.BAR end
	-- master timeline on the song clock (bar numbers measured from the audio): hallway 0 / lockers T1 (bar 5) / surge T9 (bar 9) / long walk T2 (bar 13) / gym T3 (bar 17) / neon TSUN (bar 19) / title TT (bar 21) / finale TF (bar 25)
	local T = {T1 = BS(5), T9 = BS(9), T2 = BS(13), T3 = BS(17), TSUN = BS(19), TT = BS(21), TF = BS(25)}
	T.TD0 = T.T3 - 1.9
	local floor, sin, cos, sqrt, max, min, abs, exp, pi, atan2 = math.floor, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.exp, math.pi, math.atan2
	local DEG = 180 / pi
	local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
	if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
	local PINK, HOT, RED, DEEP, VIO, VIOD, CHR, NIGHT, CREAM = C(255, 64, 150), C(255, 120, 196), C(214, 18, 52), C(96, 4, 26), C(138, 76, 255), C(44, 14, 84), C(214, 224, 242), C(6, 4, 10), C(255, 240, 226)
	local PAL = {PINK, RED, VIO}
	local function cl(x, a, b) return x < a and a or (x > b and b or x) end
	local function clamp01(x) return cl(x, 0, 1) end
	local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
	local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - clamp01(x)) ^ 3 end
	local function eob(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 + 2.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 2 end
	local function eio(x) x = clamp01(x) return x < 0.5 and 4 * x * x * x or 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ^ 3 / 2 end
	local function ss(a, b, x) local k = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a)) return k * k * (3 - 2 * k) end
	local function mix(a, b, k) return Color3.new(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * k, a.G + (b.G - a.G) * k, a.B + (b.B - a.B) * k) end
	local function parse(s)
		local o = {}
		for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
		return o
	end
	local KICK, HAT, NOTE = parse(D.kick), parse(D.hat), parse(D.note)
	local LEVEL = D.level
	local function lvAt(str, t)
		local x = t * 10
		local i = floor(x)
		local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
		local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
		return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
	end
	local NS, NP, NPA, ZD = 12, 34, 16, 44
	local function sc(d) return 1 / (d * 0.5 + 0.25) end
	local conns, E = {}, {G = {}}
	local S = {
		began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, skipped = false, skipT = nil, fallback = false, t = 0,
		kick = 0, hk = 0, nt = 0, shake = 0, flashK = 0, lv = 0, kc = 0, ki = 0, hi = 0, ni = 0, nl = 0, nextCue = 1, bi = -1,
		sx = 800, sy = 450, U = 450, vx = 400, vy = 207, cz = 0, amb = 0, gym = false, surge = nil, ri = 0,
		lastPos = nil, lastPosAt = nil, warned = {}, pd = {},
	}
	local function guard(name, fn, ...)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
		if not ok and not S.warned[name] then
			S.warned[name] = true
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 12 " .. name .. " (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	local function mk(class, parent, props)
		local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
		if props then
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		end
		return o
	end
	local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local k = input.KeyCode
			if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
		end
	end)
	local function box(par, z, col, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function lab(par, z, font, size, col, xa)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 20), Text = ""})
	end
	local function grad(f, rot, c1, c2, t1, t2)
		return mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = rot, Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(t1 or 0, t2 or 0)})
	end
	local function place(f, x, y, w, h, rot, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 0.5), max(h, 0.5))
		f.Rotation = rot or 0
		if tr then f.BackgroundTransparency = tr end
	end
	local function line(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, tr)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), 0.5), max(th, 0.5))
		f.Rotation = atan2(dy, dx) * DEG
		if tr then f.BackgroundTransparency = tr end
	end
	local function beam(f, ox, oy, a, len, w, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox + sin(a) * len / 2, oy + cos(a) * len / 2)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 1), max(len, 1))
		f.Rotation = -a * DEG
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local CAPS = {{0, "00:00  //  AFTER THE LAST BELL"}, {T.T1, "LOCKER ROW  //  LIGHTS UP"}, {T.T2, "THE LONG WALK"}, {T.T3, "FRIDAY NIGHT  //  THE GYM"}, {T.TSUN, "FULL VOLUME"}, {T.TT, "...BABY ONE MORE TIME"}}
	local LINES = {"BABY ONE", "MORE TIME"}
	local LWD = {I = 38, M = 98, Y = 78}

	local function build()
		E.bg = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = NIGHT, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Interactable = false})
		E.world = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Visible = false, Interactable = false})
		E.ws = mk("UIScale", E.world, {Scale = 1})
		E.lA = mk("Frame", E.world, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Interactable = false})
		E.lG = mk("Frame", E.world, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Visible = false, Interactable = false})
		E.part = mk("Frame", E.world, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Interactable = false})
		local A = E.lA
		-- hallway shell
		E.ceil = box(A, 1, NIGHT, 0)
		grad(E.ceil, 90, C(36, 36, 36), WHITE)
		E.floor = box(A, 1, NIGHT, 0)
		grad(E.floor, 90, WHITE, C(28, 28, 28))
		E.rl = {}

			total = total - 4
			for ci = 1, #txt do
				local c = xs[ci]

					local idx = #E.letters + 1
					local g = mk("Frame", E.tl, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx, ly), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(c.w, 112), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Visible = false, Interactable = false})

					if li == 2 then
						L.rf = box(E.tl, 2, mix(PINK, WHITE, 0.35), 1, 0.2)
						place(L.rf, lx, ly + 74, c.w * 0.9, 46, 0)
						grad(L.rf, 90, WHITE, WHITE, 0.45, 1)
					end
					E.letters[idx] = L
				end

		end
		E.lastTI = E.letters[#E.letters].tI
		E.tm = box(E.tl, 2, HOT, 1, 0)
		place(E.tm, 360, 238, 680, 2, 0)
		mk("UIGradient", E.tm, {Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
		E.ttag = lab(E.tl, 12, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 22, CHR)
		E.ttag.Text = NAME .. "     |     1999"
		E.ttag.TextTransparency = 1
		place(E.ttag, 360, 258, 680, 24)
		E.ttag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(680, 24)
		-- HUD
		E.vg = {}
		local vgd = {{0, 0, 1, 0.2, 90, 0.3, 1, 0, 0}, {0, 0.8, 1, 0.2, 90, 1, 0.3, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 0.18, 1, 0, 0.3, 1, 0, 0}, {0.82, 0, 0.18, 1, 0, 1, 0.3, 0, 0}}
		for i, v in ipairs(vgd) do
			local f = mk("Frame", stage, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(v[1], v[2]), Size = UDim2.fromScale(v[3], v[4]), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 30, Interactable = false})
			grad(f, v[5], BLACK, BLACK, v[6], v[7])
			E.vg[i] = f
		end
		E.lbT = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false})
		E.lbB = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false})
		E.cap = lab(stage, 45, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 13, CHR, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.tc = lab(stage, 45, Enum.Font.Code, 13, WHITE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.term = lab(stage, 60, Enum.Font.Code, 14, WHITE)
		place(E.term, 0, 0, 10, 10)
		E.term.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.term.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 20)
		E.flash = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = mix(WHITE, HOT, 0.22), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 200, Interactable = false})
		E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 220, AutoButtonColor = false})
		mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})

	local function onKick(str)
		local k = (str == 3 and 1) or (str == 2 and 0.8) or 0.55
		S.kick = max(S.kick, k * min(K.INT, 1.2))
		S.kc = S.kc + 1
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.12 * k)
		if S.gym then
			local G = E.G
			G.fl[math.random(1, 15)] = 1
			G.fl[math.random(1, 15)] = 1
			S.ri = S.ri % 6 + 1
			G.rs[S.ri] = S.t
		end
	end
	local function onCue(i, recent)
		if i == 1 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.35) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.3) end
		elseif i == 2 then
			S.surge = S.t
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.55) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.55) end
		elseif i == 3 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.5) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.5) end
		elseif i == 4 then
			S.gym = true
			E.lA.Visible, E.lG.Visible = false, true
			for k2 = 1, NPA do E.pp[k2].BackgroundColor3 = k2 % 4 == 0 and CHR or PAL[k2 % 3 + 1] end
			if recent then
				S.flashK, S.shake = 1, 1
				pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9)
			end
		elseif i == 5 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.9) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.7) end
		elseif i == 6 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.65) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.5) end
		elseif i == 7 then
			S.flashK, S.shake = 1, 1
			for r = 1, 6 do E.G.rs[r] = S.t + (r - 1) * 0.07 end
			pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 18, 0.04, 1.1)
		end
	end
	local CUES = {T.T1, T.T9, T.T2, T.T3, T.TSUN, T.TT, T.TF}

	local function updHall(t, dt)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local u = clamp01(t / T.T3)
		local cz = 43.1 * (0.25 * u + 0.75 * u * u * u)
		S.cz = cz
		local vx = sx * 0.5 + sin(t * 0.37) * sx * 0.014 + sin(t * 1.3) * sx * 0.008 * ss(T.T2, T.T3, t)
		local vy = sy * 0.46 + sin(t * 0.5) * sy * 0.006
		S.vx, S.vy = vx, vy
		local Wd, Hd = sx * 0.22, sy * 0.30
		local lv, kk = S.lv, S.kick
		local ceilZ = 2 + 44 * ss(0.8, 13, t)
		local lockZ = 2 + 46 * ss(T.T1 - 0.4, T.T2 + 1, t)
		local amb = clamp01(0.5 * ss(1, 11, t) + 0.35 * ss(T.T1, T.T2, t) + 0.15 * ss(T.T2, T.T3, t) + 0.1 * kk * ss(1, 6, t))
		S.amb = amb
		local rayK = ss(T.T1, T.T3, t) * 0.5 + 0.5 * ss(T.TD0 - 1, T.T3, t)
		place(E.ceil, sx * 0.5, vy * 0.5, sx * 1.2, vy + 2, 0, 0)
		E.ceil.BackgroundColor3 = mix(NIGHT, C(70, 24, 100), amb * 0.55)
		place(E.floor, sx * 0.5, vy + (sy - vy) * 0.5, sx * 1.2, sy - vy + 2, 0, 0)
		E.floor.BackgroundColor3 = mix(NIGHT, C(120, 34, 120), amb * 0.65 + 0.1 * kk)
		local dd = max(ZD - cz, 0.06)
		local scd = sc(dd)
		local wx, wy = scd * Wd, scd * Hd
		local scN = 3.8
		local ri = 0
		for sdi = 1, 2 do
			local sd = sdi == 1 and -1 or 1
			for yi = 1, 3 do
				ri = ri + 1
				local yy = yi == 1 and -0.985 or (yi == 2 and -0.08 or 0.985)
				local f = E.rl[ri]
				f.BackgroundColor3 = yi == 1 and PINK or (yi == 2 and VIO or RED)
				line(f, vx + sd * Wd * scd, vy + yy * Hd * scd, vx + sd * Wd * scN, vy + yy * Hd * scN, 2 + 2 * kk, 1 - clamp01(amb * (0.25 + 0.55 * ss(T.T1 - 1, T.T2, t)) * (yi == 2 and 0.6 or 1)))
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 12 do
			local a = i * (pi * 2 / 12) + t * 0.06 * (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1)
			beam(E.ray[i], vx, vy, a, max(sx, sy) * 1.3, 6 + 22 * rayK + 40 * kk * rayK, 1 - clamp01(rayK * (0.22 + 0.2 * lv + 0.3 * kk) * (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or 0.7)))
		end
		-- gym doors at the end of the hall
		local op = eio((t - T.TD0) / (T.T3 - 0.1 - T.TD0))
		local lfw, lfh = wx * 0.62, wy * 1.5
		local cy = vy + wy * 0.985 - lfh * 0.5
		local off = (0.015 + op * 0.98) * lfw
		place(E.dw, vx, vy, wx * 2, wy * 2, 0, 0)
		E.dw.BackgroundColor3 = mix(NIGHT, C(60, 40, 80), amb * 0.5)
		local ltr = 1 - clamp01(0.15 + amb)
		place(E.dl, vx - lfw * 0.5 - off, cy, lfw, lfh, 0, ltr)
		place(E.dr, vx + lfw * 0.5 + off, cy, lfw, lfh, 0, ltr)
		place(E.dsp, vx, cy, lfw * 2, lfh, 0, 1 - clamp01(0.12 * ss(T.T1, T.T3, t) + 0.05 + op * 0.95))
		place(E.dtrim, vx, cy - lfh * 0.5 - wy * 0.03, lfw * 2 + wx * 0.12, max(2, wy * 0.05), 0, 1 - clamp01(0.2 + amb))
		place(E.dsign, vx, cy - lfh * 0.5 - wy * 0.13, wx * 1.2, wy * 0.2, 0)
		E.dsign.TextSize = floor(cl(wy * 0.2, 6, 100))
		E.dsign.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01(amb * (sin(t * 40 + 1) > -0.3 and 1 or 0.55) + 0.05 * ss(0, 4, t))
		local bl = clamp01(op * 0.9 + kk * 0.15 * op) + 0.05 * ss(T.T1, T.T3, t)
		place(E.eg[1], vx, cy, lfw * 3.4, lfh * 1.3, 0, 1 - clamp01(bl * 0.2))
		place(E.eg[2], vx, cy, lfw * 2.3, lfh * 1.1, 0, 1 - clamp01(bl * 0.3))
		place(E.eg[3], vx, cy, lfw * 1.3, lfh * 0.9, 0, 1 - clamp01(bl * 0.55))
		-- slices
		local kmin = floor(cz) + 1
		local ph0 = S.kc
		for idx = 1, NS do
			local s = E.sl[idx]
			local k = kmin + ((idx - kmin) % NS)
			local d = k - cz
			if d < 0.1 or k >= ZD then
				if s.vis then
					s.vis = false
					s.cl.Visible, s.rf.Visible = false, false
					for j = 1, 2 do s.sd[j].body.Visible, s.sd[j].strip.Visible, s.sd[j].vent.Visible = false, false, false end
				end
			else
				if not s.vis then
					s.vis = true
					s.cl.Visible, s.rf.Visible = true, true
					for j = 1, 2 do s.sd[j].body.Visible, s.sd[j].strip.Visible, s.sd[j].vent.Visible = true, true, true end
				end
				if s.k ~= k then
					s.k = k
					local zb = 1000 - k * 6
					s.rf.ZIndex, s.cl.ZIndex = zb + 1, zb + 3
					for j = 1, 2 do s.sd[j].body.ZIndex, s.sd[j].strip.ZIndex, s.sd[j].vent.ZIndex = zb, zb + 2, zb + 2 end
				end
				local sn, sf, sm = sc(d), sc(d + 1), sc(d + 0.5)
				local fog = 1 - clamp01((d - 5) / 8)
				local onC = clamp01((ceilZ - k) / 2)
				local fl = (ceilZ - k < 3.5) and (0.55 + 0.45 * ((sin(t * 61 + k * 7.3) + sin(t * 23 + k)) > 0 and 1 or 0)) or 1
				local bC = onC * fl * fog * (0.85 + 0.3 * S.hk)
				local onL = clamp01((lockZ - k) / 2.5)
				local ph = (k + ph0) % 4
				local chase = (ph == 0 and 1) or (ph == 1 and 0.45) or 0.12
				local bL = onL * fog * (0.3 + 0.55 * lv + chase * kk * 0.9)
				place(s.cl, vx, vy - sm * Hd * 0.99, sm * Wd * 0.5, max(2, sm * Hd * 0.045), 0, 1 - clamp01(bC) * 0.95)
				s.cl.BackgroundColor3 = mix(CHR, HOT, 0.25 * onL)
				place(s.rf, vx, vy + sm * Hd * 1.16, sm * Wd * 0.5, sm * Hd * 0.34, 0, 1 - clamp01(bC) * 0.35)
				local col = PAL[(k + floor(S.kc / 2)) % 3 + 1]
				col = mix(col, WHITE, 0.35 * kk * chase)
				for j = 1, 2 do
					local sd = j == 1 and -1 or 1
					local xn, xf = vx + sd * sn * Wd, vx + sd * sf * Wd
					local px, pw, ph2 = (xn + xf) / 2, abs(xn - xf), 2 * sn * Hd * 0.98
					local o = s.sd[j]
					place(o.body, px, vy, pw + 1, ph2, 0, 0.2 + 0.6 * (1 - fog))
					o.body.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(14, 14, 24), C(88, 96, 124), amb * fog * 0.8), col, clamp01(bL) * 0.22)
					place(o.strip, xn, vy, max(1.5, sn * Wd * 0.02), ph2 * 0.94, 0, 1 - clamp01(bL))
					o.strip.BackgroundColor3 = col
					place(o.vent, px, vy - ph2 * 0.22, pw * 0.6, max(1, ph2 * 0.035), 0, 1 - clamp01(bL * 0.9))
					o.vent.BackgroundColor3 = col
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function updGym(t, dt)
		local G = E.G
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local g = t - T.T3
		local nk = ss(T.TSUN - 0.1, T.TSUN + 0.9, t)
		local lv, kk = S.lv, S.kick
		local vx, hy = sx * 0.5 + sin(t * 0.6) * sx * 0.012, sy * 0.5
		S.vx, S.vy = vx, hy
		S.cz = 43.1 + g * 2
		S.amb = 1
		place(G.wall, sx * 0.5, hy * 0.5, sx * 1.2, hy + 2, 0, 0)
		G.wall.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(110, 44, 120), C(70, 20, 140), nk), PINK, kk * 0.2)
		local r = U * 0.27
		local yc = hy - r * 0.62
		place(G.sun, vx, yc, r * 2, r * 2, 0, 1 - nk * 0.95)
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local q = (i - 1 + (t * 0.3) % 1) / 5
			local dy = r * (0.05 + q * 0.57)
			local w = 2 * sqrt(max(r * r - dy * dy, 0))
			place(G.bars[i], vx, yc + dy, w, r * (0.025 + 0.06 * q), 0, 1 - nk * 0.95)
		end
		for i = 1, 14 do
			local f = G.bn[i]
			local x = sx * (i - 0.5) / 14
			local y = sy * 0.05 + sin((i - 0.5) / 14 * pi) * sy * 0.05
			local z = sy * 0.03
			place(f, x, y + sy * 0.015, z, z, 45 + sin(t * 2 + i) * 8, 0)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = PAL[(i + floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)) % 3 + 1]
		end
		local tint = mix(C(16, 10, 28), C(70, 28, 100), clamp01(lv + kk * 0.5))
		for _, b in ipairs(G.bl) do
			local w = sx * (0.34 - 0.06 * b.j)
			place(b.f, vx + b.sd * (sx * 0.5 - w / 2), hy - sy * 0.03 - (b.j - 1) * sy * 0.055 + sy * 0.0275, w, sy * 0.055, 0, 0)
			b.f.BackgroundColor3 = tint
		end
		place(G.bb, vx, hy - sy * 0.25, sx * 0.075, sy * 0.08, 0, 0.2)
		place(G.rim, vx, hy - sy * 0.25 + sy * 0.05, sx * 0.03, 3, 0, 0)
		place(G.sb, vx, hy - sy * 0.35, sx * 0.3, sy * 0.06, 0, 0.15)
		G.sb.TextSize = floor(cl(sy * 0.034, 8, 100))
		G.sb.TextTransparency = 0.1 + (sin(t * 5) > 0.9 and 0.4 or 0)
		place(G.floor, sx * 0.5, hy + (sy - hy) * 0.5, sx * 1.2, sy - hy + 2, 0, 0)
		G.floor.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(190, 110, 70), C(90, 24, 140), nk), PINK, kk * 0.15)
		local lc = mix(C(255, 214, 160), PINK, nk)
		for i = 1, 9 do
			local f = G.rl[i]
			f.BackgroundColor3 = lc
			line(f, vx, hy, vx + (i - 5) * sx * 0.30, sy * 1.05, 1.5 + nk * 2.5 + kk * 1.5, 1 - (0.25 + 0.55 * nk))
		end
		for j = 1, 12 do
			local d = (j - 1 - g * 1.1) % 12 + 0.12
			local s = sc(d)
			local f = G.hl[j]
			f.BackgroundColor3 = lc
			place(f, vx, hy + s * sy * 0.30, sx * 1.3, 1 + s * (1.2 + nk * 2.2), 0, 1 - (0.2 + 0.6 * nk) * (1 - clamp01((d - 5) / 7)))
		end
		local gc = hy + (sy - hy) * 0.45
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local age = t - G.rs[i]
			local f = G.rg[i]
			if age >= 0 and age < 1.4 then
				f.Visible = true
				local w = sx * (0.1 + 0.9 * eo3(age / 1.4))
				place(f, vx, gc, w, w * 0.16, 0, 1)
				local st = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if st then st.Transparency = clamp01(age / 1.4) * 0.9 + 0.1 end
			else
				f.Visible = false
			end
		end
		local bar = floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR)
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local a = sin(t * 0.9 + i * 0.8) * 0.5 + (i - 4.5) * 0.06
			local ox = sx * (i - 0.5) / 8
			local col = PAL[(i + bar) % 3 + 1]
			local b = G.bm[i]
			b.BackgroundColor3 = col
			beam(b, ox, -sy * 0.02, a, sy * 1.3, sx * 0.06 + kk * sx * 0.03, 0.5 - 0.25 * lv - 0.2 * kk)
			local fy = hy + (sy - hy) * 0.55
			local lx = ox + sin(a) * (fy / max(cos(a), 0.3))
			local p = G.pl[i]
			p.BackgroundColor3 = col
			place(p, lx, fy, sx * 0.09, sy * 0.03, 0, 0.62 - 0.35 * (lv + kk * 0.5))
		end
		for i = 1, 15 do
			G.fl[i] = G.fl[i] * exp(-9 * dt)
			local cx, cy2 = ((i - 1) % 5 + 0.5) / 5 * sx, (floor((i - 1) / 5) + 0.5) / 3 * sy
			place(G.fg[i], cx, cy2, sx / 5, sy / 3, 0, 1 - G.fl[i] * 0.5)
		end
		place(G.st, vx, hy, sx * (0.25 + 1.0 * kk + 0.3 * lv), 2 + kk * 6, 0, 1 - (0.2 + 0.7 * kk) * (0.4 + 0.6 * lv))
	end

	local function updParts(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local vx, vy, cz, amb = S.vx, S.vy, S.cz, S.amb
		local Wd, Hd = sx * 0.22, sy * 0.30
		local wide = S.gym and 1.9 or 1
		for i = 1, NP + NPA do
			local p = S.pd[i]
			local isP = i <= NP
			local f = isP and E.pt[i] or E.pp[i - NP]
			local d = (p.z - cz) % 14 + 0.12
			local s = sc(d)
			local yy = ((p.y + 1 - t * (isP and -p.sp or p.sp * 2.4)) % 2) - 1
			local x = vx + (p.x + sin(t * 0.7 + p.ph) * 0.06) * Wd * s * wide
			local y = vy + yy * Hd * s
			local fade = ss(0.1, 0.8, d) * (1 - ss(7, 14, d))
			if isP then
				local size = max(1.5, s * U * 0.010 * p.sz)
				place(f, x, y, size, size, 0, 1 - clamp01(fade * (0.2 + amb) * (0.55 + 0.45 * sin(t * 3 + p.ph))))
			else
				local size = max(2, s * U * 0.022 * p.sz)
				place(f, x, y, size * 1.3 * max(0.15, abs(cos(t * 3 + p.ph))), size * 0.8, (t * (80 + 200 * p.sp) + p.ph * 50) % 360, 1 - clamp01(fade * (0.15 + amb) * 0.9))
			end
		end
	end

	local function updTitle(t)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local fk = t >= T.TF and clamp01((t - T.TF) / 0.8) or 0
		local base = min(sx * 0.84 / 720, sy * 0.46 / 215)
		E.tl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * S.shake * 5, 0.47, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * S.shake * 5)
		E.tls.Scale = base * (1.05 - 0.05 * eo3((t - T.TT) / 7) + 0.014 * S.kick) * (1 + 0.5 * eo3(fk))
		for i, L in ipairs(E.letters) do
			local k = clamp01((t - L.tI) / 0.5)
			if k <= 0 then
				L.g.Visible = false
			else
				L.g.Visible = true
				L.gs.Scale = lerp(2.8, 1, eob(k)) * (1 + 0.05 * S.kick) * (1 + 1.2 * eo3(fk))
				L.g.Rotation = (1 - eo3(k)) * L.dir * 16 + sin(t * 1.4 + i) * 0.8 + L.dir * 30 * eo3(fk)
				local bx, by = L.lx, L.ly
				if fk > 0 then
					bx = bx + (L.lx - 360) * 1.6 * eo3(fk)
					by = by + ((L.ly - 115) * 1.8 + L.dir * 40) * eo3(fk)
				end
				L.g.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bx, by)
				local a = ss(0, 0.35, k) * (1 - ss(0.2, 1, fk))
				L.main.TextTransparency = 1 - a
				L.glow.TextTransparency = 1 - a * 0.35
				L.gst.Transparency = 1 - a * (0.45 + 0.25 * S.kick + 0.1 * sin(t * 3 + i))
				if k < 1 or fk > 0 or not L.done then
					for j = 1, 6 do L.ext[j].TextTransparency = 1 - a * 0.95 end
					L.done = k >= 1 and fk <= 0
				end
				L.gr.Offset = Vector2.new(0, sin(t * 1.2 + i * 0.4) * 0.05 + 0.04 * S.kick)
				if L.rf then L.rf.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - a * 0.5 * (0.7 + 0.3 * S.kick) end
			end
		end
		local la = clamp01((t - (E.lastTI + 0.3)) / 0.6) * (1 - fk)
		E.tm.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - la * 0.8
		E.ttag.TextTransparency = 1 - la * 0.9
	end

	local function updHud(t, dt)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local lbh = sy * (0.12 - 0.05 * ss(0, 7, t) + (S.gym and 0 or 0.025 * ss(T.T3 - 0.6, T.T3, t)) - 0.04 * ss(T.TT - 0.5, T.TT + 1.5, t)) * (1 - ss(T.TF, T.TF + 0.9, t)) + S.kick * sy * 0.004
		E.lbT.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(lbh))
		E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(lbh))
		local fl = S.flashK
		if S.skipT then fl = max(fl, clamp01((t - S.skipT) / 0.35)) end
		if t >= T.TF then
			local up = ss(T.TF + 1.0, T.TF + 1.9, t)
			local dn = ss(T.TF + 1.95, K.DUR - 0.02, t)
			fl = max(fl, up * (1 - dn))
		end
		E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fl) * 0.98
		local ci = 1
		for i = 1, #CAPS do
			if t >= CAPS[i][1] then ci = i end
		end
		local c0 = CAPS[ci][1]
		E.cap.Text = CAPS[ci][2]
		E.cap.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(c0 + 0.1, c0 + 0.7, t) * (1 - ss(c0 + 3.2, c0 + 4, t)) * 0.85 * (1 - ss(T.TF - 0.2, T.TF, t))
		place(E.cap, 24 + sx * 0.3, sy - lbh - 18, sx * 0.6, 18)
		E.tc.Text = string.format("REC %s  //  %02d:%02d", (floor(t * 2) % 2 == 0) and "●" or " ", floor(t / 60), floor(t) % 60)
		E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.25 + 0.7 * ss(T.TF - 0.2, T.TF, t)
		place(E.tc, 24 + 80, lbh + 18, 200, 18)
		for i = 1, #E.vg do E.vg[i].BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 - 0.2 * S.kick end
	end

	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.term.Text = ""
			E.world.Visible = true
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		while true do
			local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.skipT = t
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
			S.t = t
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			local sx, sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			S.sx, S.sy, S.U = sx, sy, min(sx, sy)
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(LEVEL, t), 1 - exp(-14 * dt))
			S.kick = S.kick * exp(-8.5 * dt)
			S.hk = S.hk * exp(-14 * dt)
			S.nt = S.nt * exp(-9 * dt)
			S.shake = S.shake * exp(-10 * dt)
			S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-7 * dt)
			while CUES[S.nextCue] and t >= CUES[S.nextCue] do
				guard("cue", onCue, S.nextCue, t - CUES[S.nextCue] < 0.3)
				S.nextCue = S.nextCue + 1
			end
			while KICK[S.ki + 1] and KICK[S.ki + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ki = S.ki + 1
				if t - KICK[S.ki][1] < 0.15 then guard("kick", onKick, KICK[S.ki][2]) end
			end
			while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.hi = S.hi + 1
				if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
			end
			while NOTE[S.ni + 1] and NOTE[S.ni + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ni = S.ni + 1
				if t - NOTE[S.ni][1] < 0.15 then S.nt = 1 end
			end
			while E.letters[S.nl + 1] and t >= E.letters[S.nl + 1].tI do
				S.nl = S.nl + 1
				if t - E.letters[S.nl].tI < 0.25 then
					S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.2)
					S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.18)
				end
			end
			local bi = floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR)
			if bi > S.bi then
				S.bi = bi
				if S.gym and t - (K.OFF + bi * K.BAR) < 0.2 then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.22) end
			end
			local over = t >= T.TF + 1.9
			if over and not S.over then
				S.over = true
				stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				E.world.Visible, E.bg.Visible, E.tl.Visible = false, false, false
				for i = 1, #E.vg do E.vg[i].Visible = false end
				E.lbT.Visible, E.lbB.Visible, E.cap.Visible, E.tc.Visible, E.skip.Visible = false, false, false, false, false
			end
			if not over then
				E.lA.Visible = not S.gym
				E.lG.Visible = S.gym
				if S.gym then guard("gym", updGym, t, dt) else guard("hall", updHall, t, dt) end
				guard("parts", updParts, t, dt)
				if t >= T.TT - 0.1 then
					E.tl.Visible = true
					guard("title", updTitle, t)
				end
				local sx2, sy2 = sx, sy
				local rot, zoom, ox, oy = 0, 1, 0, 0
				if t < T.T3 then
					zoom = 1 + 0.05 * ss(0, T.T1, t) + 0.10 * ss(T.T2, T.T3, t) ^ 1.5 + 0.05 * S.kick * ss(T.T1, T.T2, t)
					rot = (1.0 + 2.2 * ss(T.T1, T.T2, t) + 3 * ss(T.T2, T.T3, t)) * sin(t * 0.8)
					oy = sin(t * 0.55) * sy2 * 0.008
					if S.surge then
						local k = clamp01((t - S.surge) / 1.4)
						zoom = zoom + 0.09 * (1 - eo3(k))
						rot = rot + 4 * (1 - eo3(k))
					end
				elseif t < T.TT then
					local k = clamp01((t - T.T3) / 1.2)
					zoom = 1.0 + 0.4 * (1 - eo3(k)) + 0.015 * S.kick + 0.03 * ss(T.TSUN, T.TT, t)
					rot = 3.5 * sin(t * 1.1) * ss(0.2, 1.5, t - T.T3) + ((t >= T.TSUN) and 6 * (1 - eo3((t - T.TSUN) / 0.6)) or 0)
					ox = sin(t * 0.9) * sx2 * 0.012
				else
					zoom = 1.04 - 0.04 * eo3((t - T.TT) / 6) + 0.008 * S.kick
					rot = 1.2 * sin(t * 0.6)
				end
				if t >= T.TF then
					local k = clamp01((t - T.TF) / 1.2)
					zoom = zoom + 0.7 * eo3(k)
					rot = rot + 8 * k
				end
				E.ws.Scale = zoom
				E.world.Rotation = rot
				local sh = S.shake * S.U * 0.012
				E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, oy + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
				guard("hud", updHud, t, dt)
			else
				guard("hud", updHud, t, dt)
			end
		end
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		build()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 12 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	pcall(function()
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, PINK, 1000, 0.9, 5)
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, VIO, 700, 0.7, 3)
		FX.BlurPulse(10, 0.04, 0.8)
	end)
	return true
end

level = "",
voc = "",

return function(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
	FX.IntroCamBusy = true
	FX.IntroActive = true
	opts = opts or {}
	local CFG, SONG = FX.Cfg, opts.Song or {}
	local RunService, UserInputService = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.088, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 128), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
	K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
	K.DUR = 60
	local function BS(n) return K.OFF + (n - 1) * K.BAR end
	-- master timeline on the song clock (bars measured from the audio, 128 BPM): awakening 0 / transformation T1 (drums in) / survivor T2 (bar 12) / curtain burst TL (bar 14) / explosion T3 (bar 20) / ascension T4 (bar 28) / blackout TD / title slam TI (bar 31)
	local T = {T1 = 10.0, T2 = BS(12), TL = BS(14), T3 = BS(20), T4 = BS(28), TI = BS(31)}
	T.TD = T.TI - 0.17
	local floor, sin, cos, sqrt, max, min, abs, exp, pi, atan2 = math.floor, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.exp, math.pi, math.atan2
	local TAU, DEG = pi * 2, 180 / pi
	local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
	if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
	local GOLD, GOLD2, SIL, RED, WINE, PUR, PURD, NIGHT, CHAMP, HOT = C(255, 204, 98), C(196, 132, 30), C(208, 216, 232), C(214, 22, 52), C(84, 6, 28), C(140, 54, 230), C(30, 10, 56), C(6, 4, 10), C(255, 240, 200), C(255, 72, 124)
	local PAL = {GOLD, RED, PUR, SIL}
	local function cl(x, a, b) return x < a and a or (x > b and b or x) end
	local function clamp01(x) return cl(x, 0, 1) end
	local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
	local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - clamp01(x)) ^ 3 end
	local function eob(x) x = clamp01(x) return 1 + 2.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (x - 1) ^ 2 end
	local function eio(x) x = clamp01(x) return x < 0.5 and 4 * x * x * x or 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ^ 3 / 2 end
	local function ss(a, b, x) local k = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a)) return k * k * (3 - 2 * k) end
	local function mix(a, b, k) return Color3.new(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * k, a.G + (b.G - a.G) * k, a.B + (b.B - a.B) * k) end
	local function parse(s)
		local o = {}
		for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
		return o
	end
	local KICK, SNARE, HAT, NOTE = parse(D.kick), parse(D.snare), parse(D.hat), parse(D.note)
	local function lvAt(str, t)
		local x = t * 10
		local i = floor(x)
		local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
		local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
		return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
	end
	local CUES = {T.T1, T.T2, T.TL, T.T3, BS(24), T.T4, T.TD, T.TI}
	local NLAT, NLON, NB, NR, NC, NRY, NP, NRG = 6, 14, 10, 7, 13, 14, 46, 8
	local conns, E = {}, {}
	local S = {
		began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, skipped = false, skipT = nil, fallback = false, t = 0,
		kick = 0, sn = 0, nt = 0, hk = 0, shake = 0, flashK = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0, pw = 0, punch = 0, ki = 0, si = 0, hi = 0, ni = 0, nl = 0, nextCue = 1, bi = -1,
		sx = 800, sy = 450, U = 450, brot = 0, bm = 0, rr = 0, fs = 0, bcx = 400, bcy = 150, nr = 0, kc = 0,
		lastPos = nil, lastPosAt = nil, warned = {}, pd = {}, bs = {}, ff = {}, wp = {},
	}
	local function guard(name, fn, ...)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
		if not ok and not S.warned[name] then
			S.warned[name] = true
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 13 " .. name .. " (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	local function mk(class, parent, props)
		local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
		if props then
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		end
		return o
	end
	local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local k = input.KeyCode
			if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
		end
	end)
	local function box(par, z, col, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function lab(par, z, font, size, col, xa)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Text = ""})
	end
	local function grad(f, rot, c1, c2, t1, t2)
		return mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = rot, Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(t1 or 0, t2 or 0)})
	end
	local function layer(z, vis)
		return mk("Frame", E.world, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Visible = vis ~= false})
	end
	local function place(f, x, y, w, h, rot, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 0.5), max(h, 0.5))
		f.Rotation = rot or 0
		if tr then f.BackgroundTransparency = tr end
	end
	local function beam(f, ox, oy, a, len, w, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox + sin(a) * len / 2, oy + cos(a) * len / 2)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 1), max(len, 1))
		f.Rotation = -a * DEG
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local function ray(f, ox, oy, a, len, w, tr)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox, oy)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(len, 1), max(w, 1))
		f.Rotation = a * DEG
		f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
	end
	local CAPS = {{0, "00:00  //  THE AWAKENING"}, {T.T1, "THE TRANSFORMATION"}, {T.T2, "THE SURVIVOR"}, {T.T3, "THE EXPLOSION"}, {T.T4, "THE FINAL ASCENSION"}, {T.TI, "SURVIVOR"}}
	local LET = {{"S", 74}, {"U", 80}, {"R", 78}, {"V", 78}, {"I", 36}, {"V", 78}, {"O", 88}, {"R", 78}}
	local function act(t) return (t < T.T1 and 1) or (t < T.T2 and 2) or (t < T.T3 and 3) or (t < T.T4 and 4) or 5 end

	local function build()
		E.bg = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Interactable = false})
		E.bgg = grad(E.bg, 90, NIGHT, PURD)
		E.world = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Visible = false, Interactable = false})
		E.ws = mk("UIScale", E.world, {Scale = 1})
		E.lGl, E.lBm, E.lFl, E.lRy, E.lBl, E.lRg, E.lPt, E.lCu, E.lPn = layer(2), layer(3), layer(4), layer(5), layer(6), layer(8), layer(9), layer(10), layer(11)
		-- halo glow
		E.gl = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do E.gl[i] = box(E.lGl, 2, i == 1 and GOLD or (i == 2 and HOT or PUR), 1, 0.5) end
		-- volumetric beams + top spotlight
		E.bm = {}
		for i = 1, NB do
			E.bm[i] = mk("Frame", E.lBm, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = PAL[(i - 1) % 4 + 1], BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
			grad(E.bm[i], 90, WHITE, WHITE, 0, 1)
		end
		E.sp = mk("Frame", E.lBm, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = CHAMP, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
		grad(E.sp, 90, WHITE, WHITE, 0, 1)
		-- dance floor
		E.fl = {}
		for r = 1, NR do
			E.fl[r] = {}
			S.ff[r] = {}
			for c = 1, NC do
				E.fl[r][c] = box(E.lFl, 4, NIGHT, 1, 0)
				S.ff[r][c] = 0
			end
		end
		E.pool = box(E.lFl, 4, GOLD, 1, 0.5)
		-- gold rays + anamorphic flare
		E.ry = {}
		for i = 1, NRY do
			E.ry[i] = box(E.lRy, 5, GOLD, 1, 0)
			mk("UIGradient", E.ry[i], {Rotation = 0, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
		end
		E.fz = box(E.lRy, 5, CHAMP, 1, 0)
		mk("UIGradient", E.fz, {Rotation = 0, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
		-- mirror ball
		E.thr = box(E.lBl, 6, GOLD2, 0, 0)
		E.bt = {}
		for i = 1, NLAT do
			E.bt[i] = {}
			S.bs[i] = {}
			for j = 1, NLON do
				E.bt[i][j] = box(E.lBl, 6, SIL, 0, 0)
				S.bs[i][j] = 0
			end
		end
		E.core = box(E.lBl, 7, WHITE, 1, 0.5)
		-- shock rings
		E.rg = {}
		for i = 1, NRG do
			local f = mk("Frame", E.lRg, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Interactable = false, Visible = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)})
			mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)})
			E.rg[i] = {f = f, st = mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 3, Color = GOLD, Transparency = 0}), t0 = -9, x = 0, y = 0, life = 1, R = 100, th = 4}
		end
		-- particles
		E.pt = {}
		for i = 1, NP do
			E.pt[i] = box(E.lPt, 9, i % 3 == 0 and WHITE or GOLD, 1, 0)
			S.pd[i] = {x = math.random(), y = math.random(), vx = 0, vy = -(0.02 + math.random() * 0.05), sz = 0.7 + math.random() * 1.2, ph = math.random() * 6.28, mode = 1, t0 = 0, life = 2}
		end
		-- velvet curtains
		local function curtain(side)
			local f = mk("Frame", E.lCu, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(side == 1 and 0 or 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(side == 1 and 0 or 1, 0), Visible = false})
			mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = 0, Color = side == 1 and ColorSequence.new(WINE, RED) or ColorSequence.new(RED, WINE)})
			local tr = mk("Frame", f, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(side == 1 and 1 or 0, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(side == 1 and 1 or 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = GOLD, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11, Interactable = false})
			return f
		end
		E.cl, E.cr = curtain(1), curtain(2)
		E.leak = box(E.lCu, 9, CHAMP, 1, 0)
		mk("UIGradient", E.leak, {Rotation = 0, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
		-- wipe panels
		E.pn = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			E.pn[i] = box(E.lPn, 11, i == 2 and RED or GOLD, 0, 0)
			E.pn[i].Visible = false
			grad(E.pn[i], 0, WHITE, mix(WHITE, GOLD2, 0.5), 0, 0)
		end
		-- title
		E.tl = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.47), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(720, 230), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 20, Visible = false, Interactable = false})
		E.tls = mk("UIScale", E.tl, {Scale = 1})
		E.letters = {}
		local metal = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C(255, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.34, C(255, 226, 130)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, C(150, 96, 20)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.56, C(255, 244, 205)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, C(214, 218, 232)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C(150, 156, 176))})
		local total = 0
		for _, l in ipairs(LET) do total = total + l[2] + 4 end
		total = total - 4
		local cx = 360 - total / 2
		for idx, l in ipairs(LET) do
			local w = l[2]
			local lx, ly = cx + w / 2, 104
			cx = cx + w + 4
			local g = mk("Frame", E.tl, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx, ly), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 112), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Visible = false, Interactable = false})
			local gs = mk("UIScale", g, {Scale = 1})
			local function tx(z, col, ox, oy)
				return mk("TextLabel", g, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox or 0, 0.5, oy or 0), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = l[1], TextSize = 100, TextColor3 = col, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
			end
			local glow = tx(1, GOLD)
			local gst = mk("UIStroke", glow, {Thickness = 10, Color = RED, Transparency = 1})
			local ext = {}
			for j = 5, 1, -1 do ext[j] = tx(2 + (5 - j), mix(GOLD2, WINE, j / 5), j * 1.2, j * 1.5) end
			local main = tx(10, WHITE)
			local gr = mk("UIGradient", main, {Rotation = 90, Color = metal})
			mk("UIStroke", main, {Thickness = 1.5, Color = CHAMP, Transparency = 0.4})
			E.letters[idx] = {g = g, gs = gs, glow = glow, gst = gst, ext = ext, main = main, gr = gr, lx = lx, ly = ly, dir = (idx % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1, tI = T.TI + (idx - 1) * 0.055}
		end
		E.tm = box(E.tl, 2, GOLD, 1, 0)
		place(E.tm, 360, 188, 640, 2, 0)
		mk("UIGradient", E.tm, {Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
		E.ttag = lab(E.tl, 12, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 22, CHAMP)
		E.ttag.Text = NAME
		E.ttag.TextTransparency = 1
		place(E.ttag, 360, 212, 640, 24)
		E.ttag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 24)
		-- HUD
		E.vg = {}
		local vgd = {{0, 0, 1, 0.2, 90, 0.3, 1, 0, 0}, {0, 0.8, 1, 0.2, 90, 1, 0.3, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 0.18, 1, 0, 0.3, 1, 0, 0}, {0.82, 0, 0.18, 1, 0, 1, 0.3, 0, 0}}
		for i, v in ipairs(vgd) do
			local f = mk("Frame", stage, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(v[1], v[2]), Size = UDim2.fromScale(v[3], v[4]), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 30, Interactable = false})
			grad(f, v[5], BLACK, BLACK, v[6], v[7])
			E.vg[i] = f
		end
		E.lbT = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false})
		E.lbB = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false})
		E.cap = lab(stage, 45, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 13, CHAMP, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.tc = lab(stage, 45, Enum.Font.Code, 13, WHITE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.term = lab(stage, 60, Enum.Font.Code, 14, WHITE)
		place(E.term, 0, 0, 10, 10)
		E.term.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.term.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 20)
		E.dip = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 150, Interactable = false})
		E.flash = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = mix(WHITE, GOLD, 0.25), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 200, Interactable = false})
		E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 220, AutoButtonColor = false})
		mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
		conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, col, life, maxR, th)
		S.nr = S.nr % NRG + 1
		local r = E.rg[S.nr]
		r.t0, r.x, r.y, r.life, r.R, r.th = S.t, x, y, life, maxR, th
		r.st.Color = col
		r.f.Visible = true
	end
	local function sparkle(n, v)
		for _ = 1, n do
			local i, j = math.random(1, NLAT), math.random(1, NLON)
			S.bs[i][j] = max(S.bs[i][j], v or 1)
		end
	end
	local function wipe(t0) S.wp[#S.wp + 1] = t0 end

	local function onKick(str)
		local k = (str == 3 and 1) or (str == 2 and 0.8) or 0.55
		S.kick = max(S.kick, k * min(K.INT, 1.2))
		S.kc = S.kc + 1
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.1 * k)
		if S.t >= T.T1 then
			for _ = 1, 3 do S.ff[math.random(1, NR)][math.random(1, NC)] = 1 end
			if str == 3 and S.t < T.TD then ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, PAL[S.kc % 4 + 1], 0.9, S.U * 0.55, 3) end
		end
	end
	local function onSnare(str)
		S.sn = max(S.sn, (str == 3 and 1) or 0.7)
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.14)
		sparkle(5, 1)
		if S.t >= T.T2 and S.t < T.TD and str >= 2 then ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, GOLD, 0.7, S.U * 0.9, 2) end
	end
	local function onNote(str)
		S.nt = 1
		if S.t < T.T1 then
			sparkle(str == 3 and 4 or 2, 1)
			if str == 3 then ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, GOLD, 1.8, S.U * 0.4, 2) end
		end
	end
	local function onCue(i, recent)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		if i == 1 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.6) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.5) S.punch = 0.12 end
			ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, GOLD, 1.4, U * 1.1, 6)
		elseif i == 2 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.3) S.punch = 0.06 end
		elseif i == 3 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.85) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.7) S.punch = 0.2 end
			ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, WHITE, 1.2, U * 1.4, 8)
			ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, GOLD, 1.6, U * 2, 5)
			sparkle(24, 1)
		elseif i == 4 then
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.7) S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.6) S.punch = 0.16 end
			wipe(S.t)
			for k = 1, NP do
				local p = S.pd[k]
				p.mode, p.x, p.y, p.vx, p.vy = 2, math.random(), -math.random() * 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.12, 0.12 + math.random() * 0.3
			end
			ring(S.bcx, S.bcy, HOT, 1.4, U * 1.6, 6)
		elseif i == 5 then
			wipe(S.t)
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.45) S.punch = 0.1 end
		elseif i == 6 then
			wipe(S.t)
			for k = 1, NP do S.pd[k].mode = 3 end
			if recent then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.5) S.punch = 0.1 end
		elseif i == 7 then
			for k = 1, NP do S.pd[k].mode = 0 end
		elseif i == 8 then
			if recent then S.flashK = 1 S.shake = 1 S.punch = 0.3 end
			ring(sx / 2, sy * 0.47, WHITE, 1.4, U * 1.3, 12)
			ring(sx / 2, sy * 0.47, GOLD, 2, U * 2, 7)
			ring(sx / 2, sy * 0.47, RED, 2.6, U * 2.8, 4)
			for k = 1, NP do
				local p = S.pd[k]
				local a, sp = math.random() * TAU, 0.25 + math.random() * 0.9
				p.mode, p.x, p.y, p.vx, p.vy, p.t0, p.life, p.sz = 4, 0.5, 0.47, cos(a) * sp * 0.8, sin(a) * sp * 0.8, S.t, 1.8 + math.random() * 1.8, 1 + math.random() * 1.6
			end
		end
	end

	local function updBG(t)
		local top, bot = NIGHT, mix(NIGHT, PURD, 0.75)
		bot = mix(bot, PURD, 0.25 * S.vc)
		local k = ss(T.T1, T.T1 + 1.2, t)
		top = mix(top, PURD, k * 0.7)
		bot = mix(bot, WINE, k)
		k = ss(T.T2, T.TL, t)
		bot = mix(bot, RED, k * 0.5)
		k = ss(T.T3, T.T3 + 1, t)
		top = mix(top, C(70, 10, 120), k)
		bot = mix(bot, C(160, 20, 70), k)
		bot = mix(bot, GOLD, S.kick * 0.18 * k)
		k = ss(T.T4, T.TD, t)
		top = mix(top, C(120, 60, 20), k * 0.7)
		bot = mix(bot, GOLD2, k * 0.85)
		if t >= T.TI then
			local d = ss(T.TI, T.TI + 3, t)
			top = mix(C(150, 100, 30), NIGHT, d * 0.92)
			bot = mix(C(255, 190, 80), WINE, d)
		end
		E.bgg.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bot)
	end

	local function updBall(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local ac = act(t)
		S.brot = S.brot + dt * ((ac == 1 and 0.35) or (ac == 2 and 0.9) or (ac == 3 and 1.2) or (ac == 4 and 1.8) or 2.4)
		local kd = eio(clamp01(t / 9.2))
		local bx, by = sx * 0.5, lerp(-0.26 * sy, 0.35 * sy, kd)
		local R = U * lerp(0.085, 0.125, kd) * (1 + 0.35 * ss(T.T1, T.T1 + 1.5, t) + 0.28 * ss(T.T2, T.TL, t) + 0.22 * ss(T.T3, T.T3 + 1.5, t))
		by = by + sin(t * 1.3) * 0.012 * sy * ss(T.T1, T.T2, t)
		if t >= T.T4 then
			local k = ss(T.T4, T.TD, t)
			R = lerp(R, U * 0.8, k ^ 2.2)
			by = lerp(by, sy * 0.47, k)
		end
		R = R * (1 + 0.05 * S.kick)
		S.bcx, S.bcy = bx, by
		local vis = t < T.TD
		E.lBl.Visible = vis
		if not vis then
			local gk2 = (t >= T.TI) and (1 - ss(T.TI + 0.3, T.TI + 3.5, t)) or 0
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local g = E.gl[i]
				g.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, sy * 0.47)
				local s2 = U * (1.6 + i * 1.1 + 0.3 * S.kick)
				g.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s2, s2)
				g.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(gk2 * (0.32 - i * 0.07))
			end
			return
		end
		local bright = 0.3 + 0.7 * ss(T.T1, T.T1 + 1, t)
		bright = clamp01(bright * (0.7 + 0.3 * S.pw) + S.sn * 0.2)
		local decay = exp(-9 * dt)
		for i = 1, NLAT do
			local phi = ((i - 0.5) / NLAT) * pi - pi / 2
			local cr, sr = cos(phi), sin(phi)
			local ty = by - R * sr
			local th = pi * R / NLAT * 0.94 + 0.5
			for j = 1, NLON do
				local f = E.bt[i][j]
				local th0 = (j - 1) / NLON * TAU + S.brot + (i % 2) * (pi / NLON)
				local z = cos(th0)
				local sp = S.bs[i][j] * decay
				S.bs[i][j] = sp
				if z > 0.06 then
					local w = (TAU * R * cr / NLON) * z * 0.92 + 0.5
					local lum = 0.5 + 0.5 * (-0.55 * sin(th0) * cr + 0.6 * sr + 0.45 * z * cr)
					local col = mix(C(34, 24, 62), SIL, clamp01(lum * bright))
					if t >= T.T1 then col = mix(col, PAL[(i + j + S.kc) % 4 + 1], 0.22 * S.kick) end
					col = mix(col, WHITE, clamp01(sp))
					f.Visible = true
					f.BackgroundColor3 = col
					place(f, bx + R * cr * sin(th0), ty, w, th, 0, 0)
				else
					f.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
		local gp = clamp01(0.25 + 0.75 * S.pw)
		local gk = bright * gp * (t < T.T1 and 0.7 or 1)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local g = E.gl[i]
			g.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bx, by)
			local s2 = R * (1.9 + i * 1.5 + 0.4 * S.kick)
			g.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s2, s2)
			g.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(gk * (0.2 - i * 0.045))
		end
		place(E.thr, bx, by / 2 - R * 0.5, 2, max(by - R, 1), 0, 0.2)
		E.thr.Visible = by - R > 4
		E.core.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bx, by)
		local cs = R * 1.1
		E.core.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs, cs)
		E.core.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(S.kick * 0.18 + S.sn * 0.15 + (t >= T.T4 and 0.35 * ss(T.T4 + 2, T.TD, t) or 0))
	end

	local function updBeams(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local ac = act(t)
		local post = t >= T.TI
		local nb = (ac == 1 and 3) or (ac == 2 and 6) or (ac == 3 and 8) or 10
		S.bm = S.bm + dt * ((ac == 1 and 0.05) or (ac == 2 and 0.2) or (ac == 3 and 0.32) or (ac == 4 and 0.55) or 0.9)
		local ox, oy = S.bcx, S.bcy
		if post then ox, oy = sx / 2, sy * 0.47 end
		local len = max(sx, sy) * 1.2
		for i = 1, NB do
			local f = E.bm[i]
			local on = (i <= nb and t < T.TD) or (post and t < T.TI + 3.4)
			f.Visible = on
			if on then
				local a
				if post or ac >= 3 then
					a = i / NB * TAU + S.bm * ((i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1)
				else
					a = ((i - 0.5) / nb - 0.5) * 2.4 + sin(S.bm * 5 + i * 1.3) * 0.3
				end
				local w = U * (0.035 + 0.07 * S.pw) * (ac >= 3 and 1.3 or 1)
				local tr = 0.84 - 0.42 * S.pw
				if ac == 1 then tr = tr + 0.08 end
				if post then tr = 0.5 + 0.5 * ss(T.TI + 0.3, T.TI + 3.3, t) w = w * 1.6 end
				f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(PAL[(i - 1) % 4 + 1], WHITE, S.kick * 0.3)
				beam(f, ox, oy, a, len, w, clamp01(tr))
			end
		end
		-- top spotlight on the ball (awakening)
		local sk = 1 - ss(T.T1, T.T1 + 2.5, t)
		E.sp.Visible = sk > 0.01
		if E.sp.Visible then
			beam(E.sp, S.bcx, 0, 0, max(S.bcy, 8), U * (0.2 + 0.05 * S.vc), clamp01(0.76 - 0.1 * S.vc + (1 - sk) * 0.24 - 0.2 * ss(0, 3, t) * sk))
		end
	end

	local function updFloor(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local on = ss(T.T1, T.T1 + 1.4, t) * (t < T.TD and 1 or 0)
		E.lFl.Visible = on > 0.001
		if on <= 0.001 then return end
		local ac = act(t)
		local hy = sy * 0.60
		local ext = sy * 1.02 - hy
		S.fs = S.fs + dt / (K.BEAT * 4) * ((ac <= 2 and 0.6) or (ac == 3 and 0.9) or 1.3)
		local fr = S.fs % 1
		local base = floor(S.fs)
		local lvl = (ac == 2 and 0.45) or (ac == 3 and 0.7) or 1
		local ph = ((t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT) % 1
		local pulse = (1 - ph) ^ 2
		local bi = floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
		local decay = exp(-7 * dt)
		for r = 1, NR do
			local u0, u1 = max((r - 1 - fr) / NR, 0), (r - fr) / NR
			local y0, y1 = hy + ext * u0 ^ 1.8, hy + ext * u1 ^ 1.8
			local um = (u0 + u1) / 2
			local s = 0.02 + 0.2 * um ^ 1.5
			local rowId = r + base
			local fade = 0.25 + 0.75 * ss(0, 0.35, um)
			for c = 1, NC do
				local f = E.fl[r][c]
				local fv = S.ff[r][c] * decay
				S.ff[r][c] = fv
				local hsh = (rowId * 7 + c * 13 + bi * 5) % 11
				local lit = hsh < (2 + 3 * lvl)
				local b = lit and (0.25 + 0.75 * pulse) or 0.04
				local col = mix(NIGHT, PAL[hsh % 4 + 1], clamp01(b * (0.55 + 0.45 * lvl) + fv * 0.8))
				f.BackgroundColor3 = col
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2 + (c - (NC + 1) / 2) * s * sx, (y0 + y1) / 2)
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(s * sx * 0.93, 1), max((y1 - y0) * 0.9, 1))
				f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - on * clamp01((0.2 + b * 0.8 + fv) * fade)
			end
		end
		place(E.pool, S.bcx, hy + ext * 0.18, U * (1.0 + 0.4 * S.kick), U * 0.2, 0, 1 - on * clamp01(0.05 + 0.2 * S.pw))
	end

	local function updRays(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local post = t >= T.TI
		local pwr = 0.2 * ss(T.T2, T.TL, t) + 0.25 * ss(T.TL, T.TL + 0.5, t) + 0.35 * ss(T.T3, T.T3 + 1, t) + 0.2 * ss(T.T4, T.TD, t)
		if t >= T.TD and not post then pwr = 0 end
		local ox, oy = S.bcx, S.bcy
		local th = U * (0.004 + 0.012 * S.pw)
		if post then
			pwr = 1.1 * (1 - ss(T.TI + 0.2, T.TI + 3.4, t))
			ox, oy = sx / 2, sy * 0.47
			th = U * (0.012 + 0.03 * (1 - ss(T.TI, T.TI + 3, t)))
		end
		S.rr = S.rr + dt * (0.1 + 0.5 * ss(T.T3, T.T4, t) + (post and 0.25 or 0))
		local len = max(sx, sy) * (post and 2.4 or 1.8)
		for i = 1, NRY do
			local f = E.ry[i]
			f.Visible = pwr > 0.01
			if f.Visible then
				f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 3 == 0) and WHITE or ((i % 3 == 1) and GOLD or CHAMP)
				ray(f, ox, oy, i / NRY * pi + S.rr, len, th * (1 + 0.5 * ((i % 2 == 0) and S.sn or S.kick)), 1 - clamp01(pwr * (0.35 + 0.65 * S.pw)))
			end
		end
		local fk = max(S.sn * 0.9, S.kick * 0.55) * (t >= T.T1 and t < T.TD and 1 or 0)
		if post then fk = 1 - ss(T.TI, T.TI + 2.2, t) end
		E.fz.Visible = fk > 0.02
		if E.fz.Visible then
			place(E.fz, ox, oy, sx * (0.5 + 0.9 * fk), U * 0.014 * (1 + fk), 0, 1 - clamp01(fk))
		end
	end

	local function updRings(t)
		for i = 1, NRG do
			local r = E.rg[i]
			if r.f.Visible then
				local k = (t - r.t0) / r.life
				if k >= 1 or k < 0 then
					r.f.Visible = false
				else
					local rad = r.R * eo3(k)
					r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
					r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rad * 2, rad * 2)
					r.st.Transparency = clamp01(k ^ 0.8)
					r.st.Thickness = max(r.th * (1 - k), 0.5)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function updParts(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local amb = ss(1.5, 5, t)
		for i = 1, NP do
			local p, f = S.pd[i], E.pt[i]
			local m = p.mode
			if m == 0 then
				f.Visible = false
			else
				f.Visible = true
				if m == 1 then
					p.y = p.y + p.vy * dt
					p.x = p.x + sin(t * 0.6 + p.ph) * 0.012 * dt
					if p.y < -0.05 then p.y = 1.05 p.x = math.random() end
					local sz = U * 0.006 * p.sz + 1
					place(f, p.x * sx, p.y * sy, sz, sz, 0, 1 - clamp01(amb * (0.3 + 0.35 * sin(t * 2.2 + p.ph)) * (0.5 + 0.8 * S.pw)))
				elseif m == 2 then
					p.y = p.y + p.vy * dt
					p.x = p.x + (p.vx + sin(t * 2 + p.ph) * 0.05) * dt
					if p.y > 1.06 then
						p.y, p.x, p.vy, p.vx = -0.06, math.random(), 0.12 + math.random() * 0.3, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.12
					end
					f.BackgroundColor3 = PAL[i % 4 + 1]
					place(f, p.x * sx, p.y * sy, U * 0.017 * p.sz * max(0.2, abs(cos(t * 4 + p.ph))), U * 0.011 * p.sz, (t * 140 + p.ph * 57) % 360, 1 - 0.9 * ss(T.T3 - 0.01, T.T3 + 0.3, t))
				elseif m == 3 then
					local k = ss(T.T4, T.TD, t)
					p.x = p.x + (0.5 - p.x) * (0.8 + 4 * k) * dt
					p.y = p.y + (S.bcy / sy - p.y) * (0.8 + 4 * k) * dt
					f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or GOLD
					local sz = U * 0.008 * p.sz + 1
					place(f, p.x * sx, p.y * sy, sz, sz, 0, 1 - 0.9 * clamp01(0.4 + k))
				else
					local age = t - p.t0
					p.x = p.x + p.vx * dt
					p.y = p.y + p.vy * dt
					local dr = exp(-1.1 * dt)
					p.vx, p.vy = p.vx * dr, p.vy * dr
					f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 3 == 0) and WHITE or ((i % 3 == 1) and GOLD or CHAMP)
					local sz = U * 0.009 * p.sz + 1
					place(f, p.x * sx, p.y * sy, sz, sz, (age * 200 + i * 20) % 360, 1 - clamp01(1 - ss(0.5, p.life, age)))
					if age > p.life then p.mode, p.vy = 1, -(0.02 + math.random() * 0.05) end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function updCurtains(t)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local w = 0
		if t >= T.T2 then w = 0.48 * ss(T.T2, T.TL - 0.25, t) ^ 1.4 end
		if t >= T.TL - 0.25 then w = lerp(0.48, 0.07, eo3((t - (T.TL - 0.25)) / 0.55)) end
		if t >= T.T3 then w = lerp(0.07, 0, ss(T.T3, T.T3 + 1.5, t)) end
		local vis = w > 0.002 and t < T.T4
		E.cl.Visible, E.cr.Visible = vis, vis
		if vis then
			local sw = sin(t * 1.1) * 0.004
			E.cl.Size = UDim2.new(w + sw, 0, 1, 0)
			E.cr.Size = UDim2.new(w - sw, 0, 1, 0)
		end
		local lk = ss(T.T2 + 0.5, T.TL - 0.3, t) * (t < T.TL - 0.25 and 1 or 0)
		E.leak.Visible = lk > 0.01
		if E.leak.Visible then
			place(E.leak, sx / 2, sy / 2, sx * (0.03 + 0.06 * lk) * (1 + S.kick), sy, 0, 1 - clamp01(lk * (0.5 + 0.5 * S.kick)))
		end
	end

	local function updWipes(t)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local act0 = false
		local alive = {}
		for _, t0 in ipairs(S.wp) do
			local k = (t - t0) / 0.7
			if k >= 0 and k < 1 then alive[#alive + 1] = k end
		end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local k = alive[1]
			local f = E.pn[i]
			if k then
				local p = lerp(-0.5 * sx, 1.5 * sx, eio(k)) - (i - 1) * sx * 0.09
				f.Visible = true
				place(f, p, sy / 2, sx * (0.12 - (i - 1) * 0.02), sy * 1.8, 18, 0)
			else
				f.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	local function updTitle(t)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local base = min(sx * 0.84 / 720, sy * 0.4 / 230)
		local fade = 1 - ss(58.2, 59.5, t)
		E.tl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * S.shake * 6, 0.47, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * S.shake * 6)
		E.tls.Scale = base * (1.06 - 0.06 * eo3((t - T.TI) / 6) + 0.014 * S.kick)
		for i, L in ipairs(E.letters) do
			local k = clamp01((t - L.tI) / 0.5)
			if k <= 0 then
				L.g.Visible = false
			else
				L.g.Visible = true
				L.gs.Scale = lerp(3.2, 1, eob(k)) * (1 + 0.05 * S.kick)
				L.g.Rotation = (1 - eo3(k)) * L.dir * 16 + sin(t * 1.4 + i) * 0.8
				L.g.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(L.lx, L.ly + sin(t * 1.8 + i * 0.7) * 2)
				local a = ss(0, 0.3, k) * fade
				L.main.TextTransparency = 1 - a
				L.glow.TextTransparency = 1 - a * (0.4 + 0.3 * S.kick)
				L.gst.Transparency = 1 - a * (0.5 + 0.3 * S.kick)
				for j = 1, 5 do L.ext[j].TextTransparency = 1 - a * 0.95 end
				L.gr.Offset = Vector2.new(0, sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.5) * 0.1)
			end
		end
		local la = clamp01((t - (E.letters[#E.letters].tI + 0.3)) / 0.6) * fade
		E.tm.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - la * 0.85
		E.ttag.TextTransparency = 1 - la * 0.92
	end

	local function updHud(t, dt)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local lbh = sy * (0.12 - 0.055 * ss(0, T.T1, t) - 0.01 * ss(T.T3, T.T3 + 1, t) - 0.02 * ss(T.T4, T.TD, t)) + S.kick * sy * 0.004
		E.lbT.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(lbh))
		E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(lbh))
		local fl = S.flashK
		if S.skipT then fl = max(fl, clamp01((t - S.skipT) / 0.35)) end
		fl = max(fl, 0.55 * ss(T.T4 + 2.2, T.TD, t) ^ 2)
		if t >= T.TD and t < T.TI then fl = 0 end
		E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fl) * 0.98
		E.dip.BackgroundTransparency = (t >= T.TD and t < T.TI) and 0.04 or 1
		local ci = 1
		for i = 1, #CAPS do
			if t >= CAPS[i][1] then ci = i end
		end
		local c0 = CAPS[ci][1]
		E.cap.Text = CAPS[ci][2]
		E.cap.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(c0 + 0.1, c0 + 0.7, t) * (1 - ss(c0 + 3.2, c0 + 4, t)) * 0.85 * (1 - ss(T.TD - 0.2, T.TD, t))
		place(E.cap, 24 + sx * 0.3, sy - lbh - 18, sx * 0.6, 18)
		E.tc.Text = string.format("REC %s  //  %02d:%02d  //  128 BPM", (floor(t * 2) % 2 == 0) and "●" or " ", floor(t / 60), floor(t) % 60)
		E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.25 + 0.7 * ss(T.TI - 0.2, T.TI, t)
		place(E.tc, 24 + 110, lbh + 18, 260, 18)
		for i = 1, #E.vg do E.vg[i].BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 - 0.2 * S.kick end
	end

	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.term.Text = ""
			E.world.Visible = true
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		while true do
			local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.skipT = t
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
			S.t = t
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			local sx, sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			S.sx, S.sy, S.U = sx, sy, min(sx, sy)
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(D.level, t), 1 - exp(-14 * dt))
			S.vc = lerp(S.vc, lvAt(D.voc, t), 1 - exp(-10 * dt))
			S.kick = S.kick * exp(-8.5 * dt)
			S.sn = S.sn * exp(-10 * dt)
			S.hk = S.hk * exp(-14 * dt)
			S.nt = S.nt * exp(-9 * dt)
			S.shake = S.shake * exp(-10 * dt)
			S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-7 * dt)
			S.punch = S.punch * exp(-6 * dt)
			S.pw = clamp01(0.2 + 0.7 * S.lv + 0.6 * S.kick + 0.3 * S.vc * (t < T.T1 and 1 or 0))
			while CUES[S.nextCue] and t >= CUES[S.nextCue] do
				guard("cue", onCue, S.nextCue, t - CUES[S.nextCue] < 0.3)
				S.nextCue = S.nextCue + 1
			end
			while KICK[S.ki + 1] and KICK[S.ki + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ki = S.ki + 1
				if t - KICK[S.ki][1] < 0.15 then guard("kick", onKick, KICK[S.ki][2]) end
			end
			while SNARE[S.si + 1] and SNARE[S.si + 1][1] <= t do
				S.si = S.si + 1
				if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.15 and t >= T.T1 then guard("snare", onSnare, SNARE[S.si][2]) end
			end
			while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
				S.hi = S.hi + 1
				if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
			end
			while NOTE[S.ni + 1] and NOTE[S.ni + 1][1] <= t do
				S.ni = S.ni + 1
				if t - NOTE[S.ni][1] < 0.15 then guard("note", onNote, NOTE[S.ni][2]) end
			end
			while E.letters[S.nl + 1] and t >= E.letters[S.nl + 1].tI do
				S.nl = S.nl + 1
				if t - E.letters[S.nl].tI < 0.25 then
					S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.2)
					S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.2)
				end
			end
			local bi = floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR)
			if bi > S.bi then
				S.bi = bi
				if t >= T.T3 and t < T.TD and t - (K.OFF + bi * K.BAR) < 0.2 then S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.2) end
			end
			local over = t >= 59.35
			if over and not S.over then
				S.over = true
				E.world.Visible, E.tl.Visible = false, false
				for i = 1, #E.vg do E.vg[i].Visible = false end
				E.lbT.Visible, E.lbB.Visible, E.cap.Visible, E.tc.Visible, E.skip.Visible = false, false, false, false, false
			end
			if over then
				local k = ss(59.35, 59.97, t)
				stage.BackgroundTransparency = k
				E.bg.BackgroundTransparency = k
				E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				E.dip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			else
				guard("bg", updBG, t)
				guard("floor", updFloor, t, dt)
				guard("ball", updBall, t, dt)
				guard("beams", updBeams, t, dt)
				guard("rays", updRays, t, dt)
				guard("rings", updRings, t)
				guard("parts", updParts, t, dt)
				guard("curtains", updCurtains, t)
				guard("wipes", updWipes, t)
				local sx2, sy2 = sx, sy
				if t >= T.TI - 0.05 then
					E.tl.Visible = true
					guard("title", updTitle, t)
				end
				local rot, zoom, ox, oy = 0, 1, 0, 0
				if t < T.T1 then
					zoom = 1 + 0.07 * ss(0, T.T1, t)
					rot = 1.4 * sin(t * 0.35) * ss(1, 5, t)
					oy = -sy2 * 0.01 * (1 - ss(0, 9, t))
				elseif t < T.T2 then
					zoom = 1.07 + 0.05 * ss(T.T1, T.T2, t) + 0.025 * S.kick
					rot = 2.2 * sin(t * 0.6)
				elseif t < T.T3 then
					zoom = 1.12 + 0.1 * ss(T.T2, T.TL, t) + 0.03 * S.kick
					rot = 3.2 * sin(t * 0.8)
					if t >= T.TL then zoom = zoom + 0.2 * (1 - eo3((t - T.TL) / 0.9)) end
				elseif t < T.T4 then
					zoom = 1.08 + 0.12 * sin(t * 0.5) ^ 2 + 0.05 * S.kick
					rot = 6 * sin(t * 0.5)
					ox = sin(t * 0.8) * sx2 * 0.02
				elseif t < T.TD then
					local k = ss(T.T4, T.TD, t)
					zoom = 1.1 + 0.9 * k ^ 2 + 0.03 * S.kick
					rot = 6 * sin(t * 0.5) * (1 - k) + 10 * k ^ 2
				elseif t < T.TI then
					zoom = 2
					rot = 10
				else
					zoom = 1 + 0.04 * (1 - eo3((t - T.TI) / 6))
				end
				E.ws.Scale = zoom + S.punch
				E.world.Rotation = rot
				local sh = S.shake * S.U * 0.012
				E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, oy + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
				guard("hud", updHud, t, dt)
			end
		end
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		build()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 13 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	pcall(function()
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, GOLD, 1000, 0.9, 5)
		FX.Ring(MainFrame, RED, 700, 0.7, 3)
		FX.BlurPulse(10, 0.04, 0.8)
	end)
	return true
end
]==]
function FX.Intro13(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.Intro13Fn == nil then
		FX.Intro13Fn = false
		local ls = loadstring or load
		if ls then
			local okC, fn, cerr = pcall(ls, FX.Intro13Src, "=Intro13")
			if okC and type(fn) == "function" then
				local okR, f2 = pcall(fn, Util, FX)
				if okR and type(f2) == "function" then FX.Intro13Fn = f2 end
			else
				warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 13 unavailable: " .. tostring(cerr or fn))
			end
		end
	end
	if not FX.Intro13Fn then return "fallback" end
	return FX.Intro13Fn(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
end
function FX.BuildLoader(host, env)
local L = {Visible = false, p = 0, target = 0}
local showToken = 0
local capT = 0
local root = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
root.BorderSizePixel = 0
root.Visible = false
root.ZIndex = 40
root.ClipsDescendants = true
local function label(size, ax, ay, pos, sz)
local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", root)
l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
l.Position = pos
l.Size = sz
l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
l.TextSize = size
l.TextColor3 = env.UITextColor and env.UITextColor.Value or WHITE
l.ZIndex = 5
l.Text = ""
return l
end
local hint = label(12, 0.5, 0, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14))
hint.Text = "tap anywhere to open the UI now  ·  triangle: drag / tap / hold 5s"
hint.TextTransparency = 0.55
local cap = label(14, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -104), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
local status = label(13, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -30), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
status.Text = "Loading modules..."
local pctLabel = label(26, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -66), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30))
pctLabel.Text = "0%"
local detail = label(12, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -48), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14))
detail.TextTransparency = 0.25
detail.Text = ""
if env.UITextColor then
env.UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
hint.TextColor3, cap.TextColor3, status.TextColor3, pctLabel.TextColor3, detail.TextColor3 = v, v, v, v, v
end)
end
local chargeTrack = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
chargeTrack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
chargeTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -98)
chargeTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 2)
chargeTrack.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 1

chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
chargeFill.ZIndex = 6
local track = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)

Util.Instance("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
Util.Instance("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local shimmer = Util.Instance("Frame", fill)

NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
local knob = Util.Instance("Frame", track)
knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
knob.ZIndex = 8
Util.Instance("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(root, {
Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, RingSize = 176,
HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
IsVisible = function() return root.Visible end,
OnAction = function(name, n)
cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
capT = 1.4
cap.TextTransparency = 0
end,
})
tri:SetActive(false)
L.Triangle = tri
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not L.Visible and root.BackgroundTransparency >= 0.999 then return end
local t = env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock()
if env.GetUIBGColor then root.BackgroundColor3 = env.GetUIBGColor(t) end
local c = env.GetUIColor and env.GetUIColor(t) or WHITE
fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = c
local MP = Util.ModuleProgress
local real = (type(MP) == "table" and (MP.Total or 0) > 0) and math.clamp((MP.Done or 0) / MP.Total, 0, 1) or 0
local goal = math.max(L.target, math.min(real, 0.98))
L.p = L.p + (goal - L.p) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
local sdt = math.min(dt, 1 / 30)
L.bv = (L.bv or 0) + ((L.p - (L.bp or 0)) * 140 - (L.bv or 0) * 13) * sdt
L.bp = math.clamp((L.bp or 0) + L.bv * sdt, 0, 1)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(L.bp, 0, 1, 0)
shimmer.Position = UDim2.new(((t * 0.9) % 1.5) - 0.4, 0, 0, 0)
local kn = 14 + 3 * math.sin(t * 7) + math.clamp(math.abs(L.bv) * 14, 0, 9)
knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(kn, kn)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(L.bp, 0, 0.5, 0)
knob.BackgroundColor3 = c
local pct = math.floor(L.p * 100 + 0.5)
if pct ~= L.lastPct then
L.lastPct = pct
L.pulse = 1
pctLabel.Text = pct .. "%"
end
L.pulse = math.max(0, (L.pulse or 0) - dt * 3.2)
pctLabel.TextSize = math.floor(26 + 8 * L.pulse * L.pulse + 1.5 * math.sin(t * 5))
L.detT = (L.detT or 0) - dt
if L.detT <= 0 then
L.detT = 0.1
local okD, st = pcall(Util.GetModuleStatus)
if okD and type(st) == "string" then detail.Text = st end
end
local ch = tri.charge
chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(ch, 0, 1, 0)
chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0 or 1
chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0.8 or 1
if ch > 0.03 and tri.phase == "idle" then
cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(ch * 100))
capT = 0.4
end
capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
end)
function L.Show()
if L.Visible then return end
L.Visible = true
showToken = showToken + 1
L.p, L.target = 0, 0
L.bp, L.bv, L.lastPct, L.pulse = 0, 0, nil, 1
root.Visible = true
tri:SetActive(true)
tri.scaleBase = 1
tri:PopIn()
tween(root, 0.35, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08})
FX.BlurPulse(6, 0.12, 0.4)
FX.Play("open", 1, 0.8)
end
function L.Hide()
if not L.Visible then return end
L.Visible = false
showToken = showToken + 1
local my = showToken
L.target = 1
tri:Finale()
FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.1, 0.5)
task.delay(0.45, function()
if my ~= showToken then return end
tween(root, 0.45, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
task.delay(0.5, function()
if my ~= showToken then return end
root.Visible = false
tri:SetActive(false)
end)
end)
end
function L.SetStatus(text, prog)
if typeof(text) == "string" then status.Text = text end
if type(prog) == "number" then
L.target = math.clamp(prog, 0, 1)
end
end
return L
end
function FX.LoaderStatus(text, prog)
if FX.Loader and FX.Loader.Visible then
FX.Loader.SetStatus(text, prog)
end
end
