local fps, fpsT = 60, 0
local capT, used = 0, false
local hero
hero = FX.NewTriangle3D(frame, {
Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, Music = music,
RingSize = 176,
HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
IsVisible = function()
return Util.IsGuiVisible(frame)
end,
OnAction = function(name, n)
used = true
cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
capT = 1.6
end,
})
local stuck = 0
local lastBracketAcc
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not frame.Parent then return end
if frame.Visible and not frame.Interactable and frame.Position == UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) then
stuck = stuck + dt
if stuck > 0.9 then
frame.Interactable = true
stuck = 0
end
else
stuck = 0
end
if not Util.IsGuiVisible(frame) then return end
fps = fps + (1 / math.max(dt, 1e-3) - fps) * 0.08
fpsT = fpsT + dt
if fpsT > 0.25 then
fpsT = 0
stat.Text = string.format("%d FPS", math.floor(fps + 0.5))
end
local accent = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
if accent ~= lastBracketAcc then
lastBracketAcc = accent
for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = accent
end
end
if hero.charge > 0.03 and hero.phase == "idle" then
cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(hero.charge * 100))
capT = 0.4
end
capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
if capT > 0 then
cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
elseif not used then
cap.Text = "tap  ·  drag  ·  hold 5s"
cap.TextTransparency = 0.55 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.12
else
cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
end)
hero:PopIn()
FX.Hero = hero
return hero
end
function FX.PreBoot(win)
FX.BootFull = win.Size
win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 30)
task.spawn(function()
while FX.IntroActive do task.wait(0.25) end
task.wait(12)
if win.Parent and win.Size.X.Offset == 44 and win.Size.Y.Offset == 30 then
win.Size = FX.BootFull
end
end)
end
function FX.Plate(win, color, thick, tr, size, pos)
local p = Util.Instance("Frame", win.Parent)
p.AnchorPoint, p.Position, p.Size = win.AnchorPoint, pos or win.Position, size or win.Size
p.BackgroundTransparency, p.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
p.ZIndex, p.Interactable = 90, false
Util.Instance("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound)
local s = Util.Instance("UIStroke", p)
s.Color, s.Thickness, s.Transparency = color, thick, tr
Debris:AddItem(p, 6)
return p, s
end
function FX.WindowFold(win, content, closing, pos, full)
if not FX.Settings.Transitions or not win.Parent then return nil end
local Expo = FX.Expo
local k = 1 / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1)
local lite = FX.Lite()
local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
local pill = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 30)
local dest = pos or win.Position
local fx, fy = full.X.Offset, full.Y.Offset
local function after(t, fn) task.delay(t * k, fn) end
local function glass(size, tr)
local p, st = FX.Plate(win, WHITE, 1.5, tr, size, dest)
p.BackgroundColor3, p.BackgroundTransparency = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), 0.9
return p, st
end
local function melt(p, st, t)
tween(st, t, Quint, EOut, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5})
tween(p, t, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(p, t * k + 0.25)
end
if closing then
local from = win.Size
local g, gs = glass(from, 0.4)
FX.Play("close", 0.9)
FX.BlurPulse(lite and 3 or 6, 0.12, 0.88)
tween(win, 1, Quint, EInOut, {Position = dest})
tween(win, 0.45, Quint, EInOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(from.X.Offset, 30)})
after(0.2, function() tween(win, 0.8, Quint, EInOut, {Size = pill}) end)
after(0.05, function() tween(g, 0.95, Quint, EInOut, {Size = pill, Position = dest}) end)
after(0.6, function() melt(g, gs, 0.4) end)
return 1 * k
end
local g, gs = glass(pill, 0.3)
FX.Play("open", 0.85)
FX.BlurPulse(lite and 5 or 10, 0.1, 0.9)
tween(win, 0.6, Quint, EOut, {Position = dest})
tween(g, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + 24, 34)})
after(0.08, function() tween(win, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx, 30)}) end)
after(0.3, function()
tween(win, 0.7, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
tween(g, 0.65, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
FX.Play("hit", 0.85)
pcall(FX.Cascade, content, true)
end)
after(0.55, function()
if not lite then FX.Ring(win.Parent, col, math.max(fx, fy) * 1.1, 0.5, 1.5, dest) end
melt(g, gs, 0.45)
end)
return 1 * k
end
function FX.RegisterLock(win, full, content)
local Expo, parent = FX.Expo, win.Parent
local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
local fx, fy = full.X.Offset, full.Y.Offset
local lite = FX.Lite()
local k = 1 / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1)
local g, gs = FX.Plate(win, WHITE, 1.5, 0.25, UDim2.fromOffset(44, 30))
g.BackgroundColor3, g.BackgroundTransparency = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), 0.88
FX.BlurPulse(lite and 5 or 10, 0.1, 0.9)
task.wait(0.08 * k)
FX.Play("open", 0.8)
tween(g, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + 40, 34)})
task.wait(0.08 * k)
tween(win, 0.36, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx, 30)})
task.wait(0.2 * k)
FX.Cascade(content, true)
tween(win, 0.64, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
tween(g, 0.58, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
FX.Play("hit", 0.85)
task.wait(0.3 * k)
if not lite then FX.Ring(parent, col, math.max(fx, fy) * 1.15, 0.5, 1.5, win.Position) end
tween(gs, 0.34, Quint, EOut, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5})
tween(g, 0.34, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(g, 0.5 * k)
task.wait(0.34 * k)
end
do
local orig = FX.EnhanceButton
function FX.EnhanceButton(b)
orig(b)
pcall(function()
local bc = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
local function corner(f)
local c = Util.Instance("UICorner", f)
c.CornerRadius = bc and bc.CornerRadius or UDim.new(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound)
return c
end
local halo = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
halo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
halo.BorderSizePixel = 0
halo.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
halo.ZIndex = 8
halo.Interactable = false
local hc = corner(halo)
local hs = Util.Instance("UIStroke", halo)
hs.Thickness = 1.5
hs.Transparency = 1
hs.Color = WHITE
hs.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
local flash = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
flash.ZIndex = 9
flash.Interactable = false
local fc = corner(flash)
if bc then
bc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CornerRadius"):Connect(function()
hc.CornerRadius = bc.CornerRadius
fc.CornerRadius = bc.CornerRadius
end)
end
local function live()
return FX.Settings.Transitions and not FX.IsLowEnd()
end
b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not live() then return end
hs.Color = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
tween(hs, 0.22, Quad, EOut, {Transparency = 0.4})
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
tween(hs, 0.35, Quad, EOut, {Transparency = 1})
end)
b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
if not live() then return end
flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
tween(flash, 0.3, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
tween(hs, 0.08, Quad, EOut, {Transparency = 0.1})
end)
end)
end
end
function FX.Polish(env, win, content, topBar)
local S = FX.Settings
local NSK = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
local function on()
return S.Transitions and S.Ambient and not FX.IsLowEnd() and win.Parent and win.Visible
end
local function accent()
local ok, c = pcall(FX.GetColor)
return ok and c or WHITE
end
local function mkf(parent, z)
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
f.ZIndex = z
f.Interactable = false
return f
end
local rim = mkf(win, 60)
rim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
pcall(FX.RoundCorner, rim)
local rs = Util.Instance("UIStroke", rim)
rs.Thickness = 1.5
rs.Color = WHITE
rs.Transparency = 0.15
rs.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
local rg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", rs)
rg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 1), NSK(0.4, 1), NSK(0.5, 0), NSK(0.6, 1), NSK(1, 1)})
local aur = mkf(content, 49)
aur.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
aur.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
local ag = Util.Instance("UIGradient", aur)
ag.Rotation = 35
ag.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0), NSK(0.5, 1), NSK(1, 0.35)})
local sp = mkf(content, 48)
sp.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
sp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
local spL, spB = {}, {0.965, 0.95, 0.93}
for i, dia in ipairs({210, 124, 58}) do
local c = mkf(sp, 48)
c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
c.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dia, dia)
Util.Instance("UICorner", c).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
spL[i] = c
end
local sweep = mkf(content, 52)
sweep.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 2)
sweep.Position = UDim2.new(-0.4, 0, 0, 0)
Util.Instance("UIGradient", sweep).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 1), NSK(0.5, 0), NSK(1, 1)})
local veil = mkf(content, 51)
veil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
local bloom = mkf(win, 5)
bloom.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
bloom.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1)
bloom.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0, 2)
Util.Instance("UIGradient", bloom).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 1), NSK(0.5, 0), NSK(1, 1)})
local tl
if topBar then
tl = mkf(topBar, 6)
tl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
tl.Size = UDim2.new(0.22, 0, 0, 1)
tl.Position = UDim2.new(-0.3, 0, 1, 0)
tl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
Util.Instance("UIGradient", tl).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 1), NSK(0.5, 0), NSK(1, 1)})
end
local function flare(th)
rs.Thickness = th
rs.Transparency = 0
tween(rs, 0.7, Quint, EOut, {Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.15})
end
local lastPage = 0
local function pageFx()
if not on() or FX.IntroActive then return end
local n = os.clock()
if n - lastPage < 0.3 then return end
lastPage = n
local col = accent()
sweep.BackgroundColor3 = col
sweep.Position = UDim2.new(-0.4, 0, 0, 0)
sweep.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
tween(sweep, 0.55, Quint, EOut, {Position = UDim2.new(1.05, 0, 0, 0)})
task.delay(0.35, function() tween(sweep, 0.25, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end)
veil.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetBG()
veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
tween(veil, 0.34, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
bloom.BackgroundColor3 = col
bloom.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0, 2)
bloom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
tween(bloom, 0.5, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0.96, 0, 0, 2)})
task.delay(0.28, function() tween(bloom, 0.3, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end)
end
local seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function watch(c)
if seen[c] or not c:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return end
seen[c] = true
c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if c.Visible then pageFx() end
end)
end
for _, c in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do watch(c) end
content.ChildAdded:Connect(watch)
win:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if win.Visible and on() and not FX.IntroActive then
flare(4)
local col = accent()
bloom.BackgroundColor3 = col
bloom.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0, 2)
bloom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
tween(bloom, 0.6, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0.96, 0, 0, 2)})
task.delay(0.35, function() tween(bloom, 0.3, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end)
end
end)
local dragging
if topBar then
topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
local ty = i.UserInputType
if (ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and on() then
dragging = true
tween(rs, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 3, Transparency = 0})
end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
local ty = i.UserInputType
if dragging and (ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
dragging = nil
tween(rs, 0.45, Quint, EOut, {Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.15})
end
end)
end
local acc, lastCol = 0, nil
local spA, spx, spy = 0, 0, 0
local mouseOK = UserInputService.MouseEnabled and not UserInputService.TouchEnabled
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not win.Parent then return end
acc = acc + dt
local gap = 1 / 30
if FX.Gov and FX.Gov.Stride and FX.Gov.Stride > 1 then gap = gap * FX.Gov.Stride end
if acc < gap then return end
dt, acc = acc, 0
local live = on()
rim.Visible, aur.Visible = live, live
if tl then tl.Visible = live end
if not live then
sp.Visible = false
return
end
local t = os.clock()
local col = accent()
if col ~= lastCol then
lastCol = col
rs.Color = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.35)
ag.Color = ColorSequence.new(col)
for _, c in ipairs(spL) do c.BackgroundColor3 = col end
if tl then tl.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
rg.Rotation = (t * 45) % 360
ag.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(t * 0.25) * 0.35, math.cos(t * 0.2) * 0.2)
if tl then
tl.Position = UDim2.new((t * 0.18) % 1.5 - 0.3, 0, 1, 0)
end
local inside = false
local ap, as = content.AbsolutePosition, content.AbsoluteSize
if mouseOK then
local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
inside = m.X >= ap.X and m.Y >= ap.Y and m.X <= ap.X + as.X and m.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
if inside then
local k = math.min(1, dt * 10)
if spA < 0.05 then spx, spy = m.X, m.Y end
spx, spy = spx + (m.X - spx) * k, spy + (m.Y - spy) * k
end
end
spA = spA + ((inside and 1 or 0) - spA) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
if spA < 0.02 then
sp.Visible = false
else
sp.Visible = true
sp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(spx - ap.X, spy - ap.Y)
for i, c in ipairs(spL) do
c.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - spB[i]) * spA
end
end
end)
end
function FX.Chrome(env)
local win, content = env.UIMainWindow, env.WindowContent
local music = env.UISound and env.UISound.Music
if not win or not content then return end
local S = FX.Settings
local function guard(name, f)
local ok, e = pcall(f)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(e)) end
end
local topBar
for _, c in ipairs(win:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("Frame") and c.Size.Y.Offset == 30 and c.Size.X.Scale == 1 then
topBar = c
break
end
end
task.spawn(function()
guard("boot", function()
while FX.IntroActive do task.wait(0.1) end
local full = FX.BootFull or win.Size
if win.Size.X.Offset > 60 then return end
if not S.Transitions then
win.Size = full
return
end
if not pcall(FX.RegisterLock, win, full, content) then
win.Size = full
end
end)
end)
guard("topbar", function()
if not topBar then return end
local label
for _, c in ipairs(topBar:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("TextLabel") then
label = c
break
end
end
if label then
label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0.5, 0)
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 1, 0)
end
local logo = FX.NewTriangle3D(topBar, {
ZIndex = 5, LayerSize = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 30),
IsVisible = function()
return Util.IsGuiVisible(topBar)
end,
})
logo.baseSpin = 1.6
logo.scaleBase = 1.25
FX.Logo = logo
local shim = Util.Instance("Frame", topBar)
shim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
shim.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
shim.BorderSizePixel = 0
shim.ZIndex = 0
shim.Interactable = false
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", shim)
g.Rotation = 20
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.86),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
task.spawn(function()
while shim.Parent do
task.wait(5 + math.random() * 3)
if S.Ambient and S.Transitions and Util.IsGuiVisible(topBar) then
g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
tween(g, 0.9, Quad, EInOut, {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
end
end
end)
end)
local glow, glowGrad
guard("underglow", function()
glow = Util.Instance("Frame", win)
glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
glow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1)
glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 2)
glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
glow.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
glow.ZIndex = 4
glow.Interactable = false
glowGrad = Util.Instance("UIGradient", glow)
glowGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.15),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.15),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
end)
local vig = {}
guard("vignette", function()
for _, top in ipairs({true, false}) do
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", content)
f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, top and 0 or 1)
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, top and 0 or 1)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
f.ZIndex = 50
f.Interactable = false
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = top and 90 or -90
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
vig[#vig + 1] = f
end
end)
local stroke = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local last, pulse = 0, 0
local lastThemeBeat = -1
local chromeAcc = 0
local chromeDt, lastVigBG, lastVigAmb = 0, nil, nil
local function chromeStep()
local dt = chromeDt
local t = env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock()
local bg, col = FX.GetBG(), FX.GetColor()
if bg ~= lastVigBG or S.Ambient ~= lastVigAmb then
lastVigBG, lastVigAmb = bg, S.Ambient
for _, f in ipairs(vig) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = bg
f.Visible = S.Ambient
end
end
local RA = FX.Audio
if S.Ambient and RA.running then
pulse = math.max(pulse, RA.beat * 0.85, RA.kick)
elseif S.Ambient and music then
local pbl = music.PlaybackLoudness
if pbl - last > 20 then pulse = 1 end
last = pbl
local TS = Util.ThemeSong
if TS and TS.IsPlaying(music) then
local bi = TS.Beat(music.TimePosition)
if bi ~= lastThemeBeat then
lastThemeBeat = bi
pulse = math.max(pulse, (bi % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.55)
end
end
end
pulse = math.max(0, pulse - dt * 3.2)
if stroke then
stroke.Thickness = S.Ambient and (1 + pulse * 1.8) or 1
end
if glow then
glow.Visible = S.Ambient
glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 - pulse * 0.3
local RAon = RA.running and S.Ambient
glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, RAon and (2 + math.floor(pulse * 2.5 + 0.5)) or 2)
glowGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.45 + (RAon and RA.sway * 0.3 * RA.energy or 0), 0)
end
end
local chromeN = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not win.Parent then return end
if RawCfg.LowEnd == true then
chromeAcc = chromeAcc + dt
if chromeAcc < 0.2 then return end
dt, chromeAcc = chromeAcc, 0
else
local gs = FX.Gov.Stride
if gs > 1 then
chromeAcc = chromeAcc + dt
chromeN = chromeN + 1
if chromeN < gs then return end
dt, chromeAcc, chromeN = chromeAcc, 0, 0
else
chromeAcc, chromeN = 0, 0
end
end
chromeDt = dt
pcall(chromeStep)
end)
guard("shockwave", function()
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not S.Ambient or not win.Visible then return end
local ty = input.UserInputType
if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
local m
if ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
m = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
else
m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end
local ap, as = win.AbsolutePosition, win.AbsoluteSize
if m.X < ap.X or m.Y < ap.Y or m.X > ap.X + as.X or m.Y > ap.Y + as.Y then return end
FX.Ring(win, FX.GetColor(), 64, 0.45, 2, UDim2.fromOffset(m.X - ap.X, m.Y - ap.Y))
end)
end)
guard("polish", function() FX.Polish(env, win, content, topBar) end)
end
local breath, breathTok = nil, 0
function FX.ThemePulse()
if RawCfg.LowEnd == true or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
local win = FX.Window
if not win or not win.Parent or not win.Visible then return end
local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
FX.Ring(win, col, math.max(win.AbsoluteSize.X, win.AbsoluteSize.Y) * 1.15, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.1, 0.4)
if not breath or not breath.Parent then
breath = Util.Instance("UIScale", win)
breath.Scale = 1
end
breathTok = breathTok + 1
local my = breathTok
tween(breath, 0.12, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 1.012})
task.delay(0.12 / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1), function()
if my == breathTok and breath and breath.Parent then
tween(breath, 0.55, Quint, EOut, {Scale = 1})
end
end)
end
function FX.Bind(env)
local SaveData = env.SaveData
FX.UISound = env.UISound
pcall(FX.Audio.Bind, env.UISound and env.UISound.Music)
FX.Window = env.UIMainWindow
FX.Content = env.WindowContent
if FX.Window then pcall(FX.SmoothScrollTree, FX.Window) end
FX.GetColor = function()
return env.GetUIColor(env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock())
end
FX.GetBG = function()
return env.GetUIBGColor(env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock())
end
if SaveData then
FX.Settings.Blur = SaveData.FXBlur ~= false
FX.Settings.Transitions = SaveData.FXTransitions ~= false
FX.Settings.ExtraSounds = SaveData.FXSounds ~= false
FX.Settings.Ambient = SaveData.FXAmbient ~= false
end
if env.CracktroFrame then
assignStyle(env.CracktroFrame, 2)
end
task.defer(function()
local ok, e = pcall(FX.Chrome, env)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] chrome: " .. tostring(e)) end
end)
local UI = env.UI
if UI then
local origPage, origButton = UI.CreatePage, UI.CreateButton
UI.CreatePage = function(...)
local p = origPage(...)
if p then assignStyle(p) end
return p
end
UI.CreateButton = function(...)
local b, txt = origButton(...)
if b then pcall(FX.EnhanceButton, b) end
return b, txt
end
local origTextbox = UI.CreateTextbox
if origTextbox then
UI.CreateTextbox = function(parent, ...)
local r = table.pack(origTextbox(parent, ...))
pcall(function()
local kids = parent:GetChildren()
local cont = kids[#kids]
if cont then
for _, v in ipairs(cont:GetDescendants()) do
if v:IsA("TextBox") then FX.EnhancePop(v) end
end
end
end)
return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
end
end
end
local oldNotify = Util.UINotify
if oldNotify then
Util.UINotify = function(text, prog)
pcall(FX.LoaderStatus, text, prog)
return oldNotify(text, prog)
end
end
if env.CracktroFrame and env.IsLoaded then
FX.Loader = FX.BuildLoader(env.CracktroFrame, env)
task.spawn(function()
while true do
local ok, loaded = pcall(env.IsLoaded)
if ok then
if not loaded and not FX.Loader.Visible then
FX.Loader.Show()
elseif loaded and FX.Loader.Visible then
FX.Loader.Hide()
end
end
task.wait(0.1)
end
end)
end
end
-- ===== JARVIS shared core: ONE module set + ONE conversation state, mounted into the main UI or the Delta tab =====
Util.Jarvis = (function()
local REPO = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elliot12-wq/Offline-Ai-system/main/"
local DIR = "NoobyAI" -- storage folder kept so existing JARVIS memory/cache persist
local FILES = {"AI_Config", "AI_NLP", "AI_Memory", "AI_Knowledge", "AI_Retrieval", "AI_Personality", "AI_Neural", "AI_Generator", "AI_UI"}
-- script-awareness layer: Mind needs Script, so both load or neither does (older repo copies / failed downloads just run without it); AI_Data is loaded lazily by Script through ctx.Load
local OPTIONAL = {"AI_Script", "AI_Mind"}
local UI_PATCH = {
{[====[function UI.init(c) ctx, Config = c, c.Config end]====], [====[function UI.init(c) ctx, Config = c, c.Config end
-- embed mode: the window fills a host frame (main UI overlay or Delta tab) and can be moved between hosts
local host, hostConn

		hostConn = f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function() if UI.relayout then UI.relayout() end end)
		if UI.relayout then UI.relayout() end
	end
end]====]},
{[====[	local W = math.clamp(vp.X - 20, 300, 900)

	local Hh = math.clamp(vp.Y - 20, 320, 620)
	if host then local hs = host.AbsoluteSize; W, Hh = math.max(280, hs.X), math.max(260, hs.Y) end
	if UI._close then local cl = host == nil or host:GetAttribute("AIClose") == true; UI._close.Visible = cl; if statusRow then statusRow.Position = UDim2.new(1, cl and -44 or -12, 0.5, 0) end end
]====]},
{[====[	win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, Hh)

	ensureGui()

	if not host then ensureGui() end
]====]},
{[====[BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, ClipsDescendants = true }, gui)
	round(win, 14)]====], [====[BackgroundColor3 = T.bg, ClipsDescendants = true }, host or gui)
	if host then win.AnchorPoint, win.Position, win.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) end
	round(win, 14)]====]},
{[====[	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(]====], [====[	UI._close = closeBtn
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(]====]},
{[====[	conn(topbar.InputBegan, function(i)
		if i.UserInputType]====], [====[	conn(topbar.InputBegan, function(i)
		if host then return end
		if i.UserInputType]====]},
{[====[	if cam then conn(cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), layout) end
]====], [====[	if cam then conn(cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), layout) end
	if host then hostConn = host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout) end
]====]},

}
local Core = {M = nil, H = nil, building = false, built = false, waiters = {}, pendingHost = nil, closeFn = nil, reval = {}}
local function genv()
local ok, g = pcall(function() return getgenv and getgenv() end)
return (ok and type(g) == "table") and g or _G
end
local function fnv(name)
local v = rawget(genv(), name)
if type(v) ~= "function" then v = rawget(_G, name) end
return type(v) == "function" and v or nil
end
local function fsOk()
return fnv("readfile") and fnv("writefile") and fnv("isfile") and true or false
end
local function ensureDirs()
local mf, isf = fnv("makefolder"), fnv("isfolder")
if not (mf and isf) then return end
pcall(function()
if not isf(DIR) then mf(DIR) end
if not isf(DIR .. "/cache") then mf(DIR .. "/cache") end
end)
end
local function download(name)
local url = REPO .. name .. ".lua"
local body
local ok, r = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
if ok and type(r) == "string" and #r > 40 and not r:find("^404: Not Found") then body = r end
if not body then
local rq = fnv("request") or fnv("http_request") or (syn and syn.request)
if rq then
local ok2, res = pcall(rq, {Url = url, Method = "GET"})
if ok2 and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode or res.Status) == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string" and #res.Body > 40 then body = res.Body end
end
end
if not body then
local ok3, r3 = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):GetAsync(url) end)
if ok3 and type(r3) == "string" and #r3 > 40 then body = r3 end
end
if body and fsOk() then
ensureDirs()
local cpath = DIR .. "/cache/" .. name .. ".lua"
local okOld, old = pcall(function() if fnv("isfile")(cpath) then return fnv("readfile")(cpath) end end)
if not (okOld and old == body) then pcall(fnv("writefile"), cpath, body) end
end
return body
end
local function source(name)
if fsOk() then
local path = DIR .. "/cache/" .. name .. ".lua"
local okc, c = pcall(function() if fnv("isfile")(path) then return fnv("readfile")(path) end end)
if okc and type(c) == "string" and #c > 40 then
if not Core.reval[name] then Core.reval[name] = true task.spawn(download, name) end
return c
end
end
return download(name)
end
local function compile(name, text)
local ld = fnv("loadstring") or (type(loadstring) == "function" and loadstring) or (type(load) == "function" and load) or nil
if not ld then return nil, "this executor has no loadstring" end
local fn, err = ld(text, "=" .. name)
if not fn then return nil, tostring(err) end
local ok, mod = pcall(fn)
if not ok then return nil, tostring(mod) end
return mod
end
local function loadModules()
local M = {}
for _, name in ipairs(FILES) do
local text = source(name)
if not text then return nil, "Could not download " .. name .. ".lua from Elliot12-wq/Offline-Ai-system and no cached copy exists." end
if name == "AI_UI" and not text:find("UI.relayout", 1, true) then
if text:find("UI.setHost", 1, true) then
return nil, "AI_UI.lua in the repo is an older embed build - replace it with the updated AI_UI.lua."
end
for _, p in ipairs(UI_PATCH) do
local i, j = text:find(p[1], 1, true)
if i then text = text:sub(1, i - 1) .. p[2] .. text:sub(j + 1) end
end
end
for _, p in ipairs({{"Nooby Neural AI", "JARVIS"}, {"NOOBY NEURAL AI", "JARVIS"}, {"Nooby AI", "JARVIS"}}) do
text = text:gsub(p[1]:gsub("%p", "%%%0"), (p[2]:gsub("%%", "%%%%")))
end
local mod, err = compile(name, text)
if type(mod) ~= "table" then return nil, name .. ": " .. tostring(err) end
M[name:sub(4)] = mod
end
local extra = {}
for _, name in ipairs(OPTIONAL) do
local text = source(name)
local mod
if text then
for _, p in ipairs({{"Nooby Neural AI", "JARVIS"}, {"NOOBY NEURAL AI", "JARVIS"}, {"Nooby AI", "JARVIS"}}) do
text = text:gsub(p[1]:gsub("%p", "%%%0"), (p[2]:gsub("%%", "%%%%")))
end
mod = compile(name, text)
end
if type(mod) ~= "table" then extra = nil break end
extra[name:sub(4)] = mod
end
if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do M[k] = v end end
local ctx = {}
for k, v in pairs(M) do ctx[k] = v end
ctx.Load = function(name)
local text = source(name)
if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil end
return (compile(name, text))
end
M.Config.init()
M.Memory.init(ctx)
M.Knowledge.init(ctx)
M.Retrieval.init(ctx)
M.Personality.init(ctx)
M.Neural.init(ctx)
M.Generator.init(ctx)
M.UI.init(ctx)
if M.Script and M.Mind then
local okI = pcall(function() M.Script.init(ctx) M.Mind.init(ctx) end)
if not okI then M.Script, M.Mind, ctx.Script, ctx.Mind = nil, nil, nil, nil end
end
return M
end
local function respond(M, raw)
local Mem, K, NLP, Gen, Ret, Neu, Cfg = M.Memory, M.Knowledge, M.NLP, M.Generator, M.Retrieval, M.Neural, M.Config
local Mind = M.Mind
Cfg.adapt()
if Mind and not Mem.temp.awaitFix then
local okP, pre = pcall(Mind.pre, raw)
if okP and type(pre) == "table" and type(pre.text) == "string" then
if pre.turn or not raw:find("^/") then
Mem.addTurn("u", raw)
Mem.addTurn("a", pre.text)
end
return {text = pre.text}
end
end
local cmd, arg = raw:match("^/(%a+)%s*(.-)%s*$")
if cmd then
cmd = cmd:lower()
if cmd == "new" then
Mem.newConvo()
return {render = {}}
elseif cmd == "status" then
local ms, ks, ns = Mem.stats(), K.stats(), Neu.status()
return {text = string.format("**Status**\n- Chats: %d\n- Memories: %d facts, %d learned\n- Verified entries: %d\n- Neural: %s\n- Storage: %s\n- Memory pressure: %d", ms.convos, ms.facts, ks.learned, ks.verified, ns.state, ms.persist and "saved on this device" or "session only", Cfg.pressure)}
elseif cmd == "neural" then
local on = arg:lower() == "on"
local _, msg = Neu.setEnabled(on)
return {text = msg or (on and "Neural on." or "Neural off.")}
elseif cmd == "forget" then
return {text = M.Personality.ack({kind = "forgot", key = arg, n = Mem.forget(arg) + K.forget(arg)})}
elseif cmd == "reset" then
if arg:lower() == "confirm" then
Mem.clearAll()
K.clearLearned()
Ret.invalidate()
return {render = {}, text = "Everything I stored has been cleared."}
end
return {text = "This wipes all chats, facts and learned notes. Send `/reset confirm` to continue."}
end
end
local prev = Mem.temp.prev
local ev
if Mem.temp.awaitFix then
local aw = Mem.temp.awaitFix
Mem.temp.awaitFix = nil
if raw:lower():find("^never ?mind") or raw:lower():find("^cancel") then
Mem.addTurn("u", raw)
Mem.addTurn("a", "Okay, no problem.")
return {text = "Okay, no problem."}
end
ev = {kind = "corrected", status = (K.learn("correction", raw, {q = aw.q}))}
Ret.invalidate()
end
local a = Neu.apply(NLP.analyze(raw, {prev = prev}))
local i = a.intent
if not ev then
if i == "teach" and a.slots.teach then
local t = a.slots.teach
if t.personal then
ev = {kind = "taught", status = Mem.remember(t.key, t.value, not t.temp), personal = true, temp = t.temp}
else
ev = {kind = "taught", status = (K.learn("note", t.value, {key = t.key, temp = t.temp})), temp = t.temp}
Ret.invalidate()
end
elseif i == "forget" then
local q = a.slots.forget or ""
ev = {kind = "forgot", key = q, n = Mem.forget(q) + K.forget(q)}
Ret.invalidate()
elseif i == "correction" then
if a.slots.fix and a.slots.fix ~= "" then
ev = {kind = "corrected", status = (K.learn("correction", a.slots.fix, {q = prev and prev.q}))}
if prev and prev.ids then
for _, id in ipairs(prev.ids) do pcall(K.reinforce, prev.terms, id, -1) end
end
Ret.invalidate()
elseif prev then
Mem.temp.awaitFix = {q = prev.q}
ev = {kind = "needfix"}
else
ev = {kind = "nothing"}
end
elseif i == "setting" then
if a.slots.level then
Mem.setPref("level", a.slots.level)
ev = {kind = "level", level = a.slots.level}
elseif a.slots.verbosity then
Mem.setPref("verbosity", a.slots.verbosity)
ev = {kind = "verbosity", v = a.slots.verbosity}
end
end
end
local r
local simple = {greeting = 1, thanks = 1, bye = 1, identity = 1, capabilities = 1, smalltalk = 1, memory_query = 1, teach = 1, setting = 1, forget = 1, correction = 1}
if not ev and not simple[i] then r = Ret.search(a, prev) end
if Mind then local okA, r2 = pcall(Mind.arbitrate, a, r, prev) if okA then r = r2 end end
local res = Gen.reply(a, r, ev)
local meta = res.meta or {}
if not ev then Mem.temp.prev = {topic = meta.topic or a.topic, terms = a.terms, ids = meta.ids or {}, q = raw} end
if Mind then
local okO, t2 = pcall(Mind.observe, raw, a, res, ev, prev)
if okO and type(t2) == "string" then res.text = t2 end
end
Mem.addTurn("u", raw, a.topic)
Mem.addTurn("a", res.text, meta.topic or a.topic)
return {text = res.text}
end
local function makeHandlers(M)
local Mem, K = M.Memory, M.Knowledge
return {
status = function()
local ms, ks = Mem.stats(), K.stats()
return {persist = ms.persist, convos = ms.convos, facts = ms.facts, learned = ks.learned, pressure = M.Config.pressure, neural = M.Neural.state == "loaded" and "loaded" or "off"}
end,
list = function() return Mem.list() end,
new = function() Mem.newConvo() return {} end,
open = function(id) return Mem.open(id) end,
delete = function(id) return Mem.delete(id) end,
ask = function(text, cb)
task.delay(0.2, function()
local ok, res = pcall(respond, M, text)
if not ok then res = {text = "Something went wrong: " .. tostring(res):match("^[^\n]*")} end
cb(res)
end)
end,
close = function() if Core.closeFn then pcall(Core.closeFn) end end,
toggle = function() end,
}
end
function Core.IsReady() return Core.built end
function Core.Flush()
if Core.M then pcall(Core.M.Memory.flush) end
end
-- Mount(host, {onClose = fn}, cb(ok, err)): moves the single AI window into `host`
function Core.Mount(host, opts, cb)
Core.closeFn = opts and opts.onClose or nil
Core.pendingHost = host
if Core.built then
local ok, e = pcall(function()
Core.M.UI.setHost(host)
if Core.M.Script then Core.M.Script.setHost(host) end
Core.M.UI.show(Core.H)
end)
if cb then cb(ok, not ok and tostring(e) or nil) end
return
end
if cb then Core.waiters[#Core.waiters + 1] = cb end
if Core.building then return end
Core.building = true
task.spawn(function()
local M, err = loadModules()
local ok = M ~= nil
if ok then
task.wait()
Core.H = makeHandlers(M)
ok, err = pcall(function()
M.UI.setHost(Core.pendingHost)
if M.Script then M.Script.setHost(Core.pendingHost) task.spawn(function() pcall(M.Script.ready) end) end
M.UI.show(Core.H)
local msgs = M.Memory.current()
if msgs and #msgs > 0 then M.UI.render(msgs) end
end)
if ok then Core.M, Core.built = M, true else pcall(M.UI.destroyWindow) end
end
Core.building = false
local w = Core.waiters
Core.waiters = {}
for _, f in ipairs(w) do pcall(f, ok, not ok and tostring(err) or nil) end
end)
end
-- ===== JARVIS butler: greeting + alerts (AI_Butler.lua), with a plain greeting fallback if the module cannot load =====
Core.Repo, Core.Dir, Core.butler = REPO, DIR, nil
function Core.StartButler(api)
api.repo, api.dir = REPO, DIR
task.spawn(function()
local okT, text = pcall(source, "AI_Butler")
if okT and type(text) == "string" then
local mod = compile("AI_Butler", text)
if type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.start) == "function" then
local ok, inst = pcall(mod.start, api)
if ok and type(inst) == "table" then Core.butler = inst return end
end
end
local t0 = os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < 150 and api.introRunning() do task.wait(0.25) end
t0 = os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < 60 and not api.uiReady() do task.wait(0.25) end
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local name = lp and ((lp.DisplayName ~= "" and lp.DisplayName) or lp.Name) or "friend"
local h = tonumber(os.date("%H")) or 12
local per = (h >= 5 and h < 12) and "morning" or (h >= 12 and h < 17) and "afternoon" or "evening"
pcall(api.notify, "JARVIS", ("Good %s, %s. All systems are standing by."):format(per, name))
end)
end
pcall(function() local g = genv(); g.JarvisAI = Core; g.NoobyNeuralAI = Core end)
return Core
end)()

FX.Delta = (function()
local D = {Detected = false, Active = false, Executor = "", Status = "idle"}
local CG = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
local logoConns, motionConns, sweepTok = {}, {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local PAGES = {Executor = true, Home = true, Scripthub = true, Settings = true, Console = true, Music = true}
local SOURCES = {
"UhhhhhhReanim/Plugins/DeltaCustomization.lua",
"UhhhhhhReanim/DeltaCustomization.lua",
"DeltaCustom/DeltaCustomization.lua",
}
local function cfg(k) return FX.Cfg[k] end
local function disc(list)
for i = #list, 1, -1 do
pcall(function() list[i]:Disconnect() end)
list[i] = nil
end
end
local function accent()
local ok, c = pcall(FX.TriColor, os.clock())
return (ok and typeof(c) == "Color3") and c or WHITE
end
local function speed() return math.clamp(tonumber(cfg("DeltaSpeed")) or 1, 0.4, 2.5) end
local function motionOn()
return D.Active and cfg("DeltaMotion") == true and FX.Settings.Transitions ~= false and not FX.IsLowEnd()
end
local function tw(obj, t, style, dir, props)
return tween(obj, t / speed(), style, dir, props)
end
function D.Detect()
local ok, n = pcall(function() return identifyexecutor() end)
if not (ok and type(n) == "string" and n ~= "") then
ok, n = pcall(function() return getexecutorname() end)
end
local name = ""
if ok and type(n) == "string" then
name = (n:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end
D.Executor = name
D.Detected = name == "delta" or name:find("^delta") ~= nil
return D.Detected
end
function D.Env()
local reg
if type(getreg) == "function" then pcall(function() reg = getreg() end) end
if type(reg) ~= "table" and type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.getregistry) == "function" then
pcall(function() reg = debug.getregistry() end)
end
local root = type(reg) == "table" and rawget(reg, "__nameless_admin_private") or nil
local env = type(root) == "table" and rawget(root, "delta_customization") or nil
if type(env) ~= "table" then
local okG, g = pcall(function() return rawget((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G, "__UhDeltaCustomEnv") end)
env = okG and type(g) == "table" and g or nil
end
return type(env) == "table" and env or nil
end
function D.ReadSource()
local function try(path)
if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return nil end
if path:match("^https?://") then
local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(path) end)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body, path end
elseif type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
local okE, ex = pcall(isfile, path)
if okE and ex then
local ok, body = pcall(readfile, path)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body, path end
end
end
end
local body, from = try(cfg("DeltaSource"))
if body then return body, from end
if type(D.Embedded) == "string" and D.Embedded ~= "" then return D.Embedded, "built-in Delta customizer" end
for _, p in ipairs(SOURCES) do
body, from = try(p)
if body then return body, from end
end
end
function D.Boot()
local e = D.Env()
if e and (rawget(e, "DeltaIcon") ~= nil or rawget(e, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime") ~= nil) then
return true
end
local src = D.ReadSource()
if not src then
D.Status = "Delta customization source not found (put it at " .. SOURCES[1] .. " or set a path / URL in the Customization page)"
return false
end
if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
D.Status = "loadstring unavailable"
return false
end
local fn, err = D.Exec.Compile(src, "@DeltaCustomization", {nocache = true})
if type(fn) ~= "function" then
D.Status = "Delta customization compile failed: " .. tostring(err)
return false
end
task.spawn(function()
local ok, er = xpcall(fn, function(e)
local okT, tb = pcall(debug.traceback, tostring(e), 2)
return okT and tb or tostring(e)
end)
if not ok then
D.Status = "Delta customization error: " .. (tostring(er):match("^[^\n]*") or "")
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta customization error (continuing): " .. tostring(er))
end
end)
return true
end
function D.WaitIcon(timeout)
local t0 = os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
local e = D.Env()
local api = e and rawget(e, "DeltaIcon")
if type(api) == "table" and type(api.getButton) == "function" then
local ok, btn = pcall(api.getButton)
if ok and typeof(btn) == "Instance" and btn.Parent then return btn, api end
end
task.wait(0.25)
end
end
local iconRot0 = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
FX.Audio.Add("DeltaIcon", function(A, dt, off)
local btn = D.Button
if not (D.Active and btn and btn.Parent) then return end
local r0 = iconRot0[btn]
if r0 == nil then r0 = btn.Rotation iconRot0[btn] = r0 end
local r = off and r0 or (r0 + A.sway * (1.5 + 7 * A.energy))
if btn.Rotation ~= r then btn.Rotation = r end
local ps = D.PressScale
if ps and ps.Parent and os.clock() > (D.PressHold or 0) and motionOn() then
local sc = off and 1 or (1 + 0.07 * A.kick + 0.035 * A.beat + 0.02 * A.energy)
if ps.Scale ~= sc then ps.Scale = sc end
end
end)
function D.SyncLogo()
local host, btn = D.LogoHost, D.Button
if host and host.Parent and btn and btn.Parent then
host.Visible = btn.Visible and btn.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5 and not D.IntroHold
end
end
function D.ApplyLogo()
disc(logoConns)
if D.Logo then pcall(function() D.Logo:Destroy() end) D.Logo = nil end
if D.LogoHost then pcall(function() D.LogoHost:Destroy() end) D.LogoHost = nil end
local btn = D.Button
if not (btn and btn.Parent) and D.Api then
local ok, b = pcall(D.Api.getButton)
btn = ok and b or nil
D.Button = btn
end
if not (btn and btn.Parent and btn:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
local pressScale = btn:FindFirstChild("LT_NoobyPress")
if not (D.Active and cfg("DeltaLogo") == true) then
if pressScale then pressScale:Destroy() end
D.PressScale = nil
pcall(function() btn.ImageTransparency = btn.BackgroundTransparency end)
return
end
local busy = false
local function hideImg()
if busy then return end
busy = true
pcall(function() btn.ImageTransparency = 1 end)
busy = false
end
hideImg()
logoConns[#logoConns + 1] = btn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageTransparency"):Connect(function()
if btn.ImageTransparency < 1 then hideImg() end
end)
local host = Instance.new("Frame")
host.Name = "LT_NoobyLogo"
host.BackgroundTransparency = 1

end

end

end)

if not motionOn() then pressScale.Scale = 1 return end

local M = {Run = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), Press = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
local function lite() local ok, v = pcall(FX.Lite) return ok and v == true end
local function touchOnly() return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled end
local function managed(o)
for _, k in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("UIListLayout") or k:IsA("UIGridLayout") or k:IsA("UITableLayout") or k:IsA("UIPageLayout") then return true end
end
return false
end
local function restore(st)
for _, t in ipairs(st.tw) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
if st.sc and st.sc.Parent then st.sc.Scale = 1 end
for obj, p in pairs(st.pos) do if obj.Parent then obj.Position = p end end
end
local function clearRun(owner)
local run = M.Run[owner]
if not run then return end
M.Run[owner] = nil
for i = 1, #run do pcall(restore, run[i]) end
end
local function targets(page)
local best, bestN, seen = nil, 0, 0
local function scan(o, depth)
if seen > 220 then return end
local n, kids = 0, o:GetChildren()
for _, k in ipairs(kids) do
seen = seen + 1
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k.Visible and not k.Name:find("^LT_") then n = n + 1 end
end
if n > bestN and (o == page or o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or managed(o)) then best, bestN = o, n end
if depth < 3 then
for _, k in ipairs(kids) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k.Visible and not k:IsA("GuiButton") and not k:IsA("TextBox") then scan(k, depth + 1) end
end
end
end
scan(page, 0)
return best
end
local function cascade(list, owner, tok)
if not (list and list.Parent) then return end
local light = lite()
local cap, gap = light and 4 or 10, light and 0.03 or 0.045
local rows, lay = {}, managed(list)
for _, r in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
if r:IsA("GuiObject") and r.Visible and not r.Name:find("^LT_") then rows[#rows + 1] = r end
end
table.sort(rows, function(a, c)
local ay, cy = a.AbsolutePosition.Y, c.AbsolutePosition.Y
if math.abs(ay - cy) > 4 then return ay < cy end
return a.AbsolutePosition.X < c.AbsolutePosition.X
end)
local run = {}
M.Run[owner] = run
for i = 1, math.min(#rows, cap) do
local row = rows[i]
local st = {pos = {}, tw = {}}
local dist = math.clamp(row.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.2, 26, 84)
local movers = {}
if lay then
for _, c in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("GuiObject") and #movers < 4 and not c.Name:find("^LT_") then movers[#movers + 1] = c end
end
else
movers[1] = row
end
for _, m in ipairs(movers) do
st.pos[m] = m.Position
m.Position = m.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(dist, 0)
end
if lay and not light then
local ex = row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
if not ex then ex = Instance.new("UIScale") ex.Name = "LT_NoobyRow" ex.Parent = row end
if ex.Name == "LT_NoobyRow" then st.sc = ex ex.Scale = 0.95 end
end
run[#run + 1] = st
task.delay((i - 1) * gap / speed(), function()
if sweepTok[owner] ~= tok or M.Run[owner] ~= run then return end
for m, p in pairs(st.pos) do
if m.Parent then st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(m, 0.55, FX.Expo, EOut, {Position = p}) end
end
if st.sc and st.sc.Parent then st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(st.sc, 0.5, Quint, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end)
end
end
local function spring(o)
local s = M.Press[o]
if s ~= nil then return s or nil end
local ex = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
if ex and ex.Name ~= "LT_NoobyPress" then M.Press[o] = false return nil end
if not ex then ex = Instance.new("UIScale") ex.Name = "LT_NoobyPress" ex.Parent = o end
M.Press[o] = ex
return ex
end
local function feel(o, kind)
if not motionOn() then return end
local s = spring(o)
if not s then return end
if kind == "down" then tw(s, 0.08, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.95})
elseif kind == "hover" then tw(s, 0.16, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 1.025})
else tw(s, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end
function D.PageIn(fr)
if not (motionOn() and fr and fr.Parent) then return end
local tok = (sweepTok[fr] or 0) + 1
sweepTok[fr] = tok
clearRun(fr)
local c, light = accent(), lite()
local settle = fr:FindFirstChild("LT_NoobySettle")
if not settle then
settle = Instance.new("UIScale")
settle.Name = "LT_NoobySettle"
settle.Parent = fr
end
settle.Scale = light and 0.99 or 0.97
tw(settle, 0.6, FX.Expo, EOut, {Scale = 1})
for _, n in ipairs({"LT_NoobySweep", "LT_NoobyEdge"}) do
local old = fr:FindFirstChild(n)
if old then old:Destroy() end
end
local ln = Instance.new("Frame")
ln.Name = "LT_NoobyEdge"
ln.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
ln.BackgroundColor3 = c
ln.BorderSizePixel = 0
ln.Active = false
ln.ZIndex = 101
ln.Parent = fr
tw(ln, 0.6, FX.Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)})
task.delay(0.55 / speed(), function()
if ln.Parent and sweepTok[fr] == tok then tw(ln, 0.45, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end
end)
task.delay(1.1 / speed(), function()
if sweepTok[fr] == tok then pcall(function() ln:Destroy() end) end
end)
pcall(cascade, targets(fr), fr, tok)
if not light and cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 4, 0.08, 0.45 / speed()) end
pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.4)
end
function D.BindMotion()
disc(motionConns)
local main = D.Main
if not (main and main.Parent) then return end
local function hook(fr)
if hooked[fr] or not (fr:IsA("GuiObject") and PAGES[fr.Name]) then return end
hooked[fr] = true
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if fr.Visible then
D.LastPage = fr
if D.Closing and D.Closing ~= fr then D.Closing = nil D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1 D.Busy = false end
if not (D.Holding and os.clock() < D.Holding) then
if D.Closing == fr then D.Closing = nil D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1 D.Busy = false end
pcall(D.PageIn, fr)
end
elseif D.Closing == fr then
fr.Visible = true
end
end)
end
for _, c in ipairs(main:GetChildren()) do hook(c) if c.Name and PAGES[c.Name] and c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible then D.LastPage = c end end
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = main.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(hook, c) end)
local snd = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function hookBtn(o)
if snd[o] or o == D.Button or not o:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
snd[o] = true
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() pcall(FX.Click, "click", 1, 0.9) pcall(feel, o, "down") end)
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() pcall(FX.Click, "release", 1, 1) pcall(feel, o, touchOnly() and "up" or "hover") end)
if not touchOnly() then
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseEnter:Connect(function() pcall(feel, o, "hover") end)
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseLeave:Connect(function() pcall(feel, o, "up") end)
end
end
for _, o in ipairs(main:GetDescendants()) do pcall(hookBtn, o) end
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = main.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o) task.defer(pcall, hookBtn, o) end)
local sidebar = main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
if sidebar and sidebar:IsA("GuiObject") then
local CLOSED, OPEN = UDim2.new(1.08, 0, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
local prevX = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
local function settleOf(fr)
local sc = fr:FindFirstChild("LT_NoobySettle")
if not sc then
sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
sc.Name = "LT_NoobySettle"
sc.Parent = fr
end
return sc
end
local function animateClose()
D.Busy = true
D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1
local tok, pg = D.CloseTok, D.LastPage
D.Holding = os.clock() + 0.6
sidebar.Position = OPEN
prevX = OPEN.X.Scale
local sc
if pg then
D.Closing = pg
pg.Visible = true
sc = settleOf(pg)
sc.Scale = 1
tw(sc, 0.3, Quad, EIn, {Scale = 0.92})
end
tw(sidebar, 0.34, Quint, EIn, {Position = CLOSED})
pcall(FX.Click, "close", 1, 1)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 5, 0.1, 0.4 / speed()) end
task.delay(0.36 / speed(), function()
if tok ~= D.CloseTok then return end
D.Closing = nil
if pg then pg.Visible = false end
if sc then sc.Scale = 1 end
sidebar.Position = CLOSED
prevX = CLOSED.X.Scale
D.Busy = false
end)
end
local function animateOpen()
D.Busy = true
D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1
local tok = D.CloseTok
sidebar.Position = CLOSED
prevX = CLOSED.X.Scale
tw(sidebar, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, EOut, {Position = OPEN})
local stok = (sweepTok[sidebar] or 0) + 1
sweepTok[sidebar] = stok
clearRun(sidebar)
pcall(cascade, sidebar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame") or sidebar, sidebar, stok)
pcall(FX.Click, "open", 1.05, 1)
task.delay(0.52 / speed(), function()
if tok ~= D.CloseTok then return end
prevX = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
D.Busy = false
end)
end
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
local x = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
local px = prevX
prevX = x
if D.Busy or not motionOn() then return end
if px <= 1.001 and x >= 1.079 then
animateClose()
elseif px >= 1.079 and x < 1.079 and D.LastPage and D.LastPage.Visible then
animateOpen()
end
end)
end
end
D.IntroLength = 5
function D.RunIntro()
local DUR = D.IntroLength
local TH = DUR - 0.75
local PERIOD = 60 / 126.02
local inten = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg("IntroIntensity")) or 1, 0.2, 3)
local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
sg.Name = Util.RandomString and Util.RandomString(14) or "LT_NoobyDeltaIntro"
sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
sg.DisplayOrder = 2147483646
sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function() sg.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end)
local okP = pcall(function() sg.Parent = gethiddengui and gethiddengui() or CG end)
if not okP then sg.Parent = CG end
D.IntroHold = true
D.SyncLogo()
local conns, T, tx, ty, tsz = {}, nil, 0, 0, 40
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local GL = "01#%&$@?/\\<>"
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eOut(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function eIn(x) return x * x * x end
local function eInOut(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function eBack(x)
local c1 = 1.70158
local c3 = c1 + 1
return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
local ch = s:sub(i, i)
if ch == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GL)
out = out .. GL:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function iaccent()
local m, c = cfg("IntroColorMode"), nil
if m == 2 then
c = Util.ParseHex and Util.ParseHex(cfg("IntroColor"))
elseif m == 3 then
c = WHITE
elseif m == 4 and Util.Color then
c = Util.Color.Cur
elseif Util.DiscoColor then
c = Util.DiscoColor(os.clock() * 0.48)
end
return typeof(c) == "Color3" and c or WHITE
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Instance.new(class)
o.Name = Util.RandomString and Util.RandomString(10) or class
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end

TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
})
local skipStroke = mk("UIStroke", skipBtn, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 1})
local skipScale = mk("UIScale", skipBtn, {})
local flash = mk("Frame", stage, {
Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false,
})
local pulse, flashK, punch, glitch, shake, lastBeat = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1
local lsx, lsy, U, CY = 0, 0, 1, 0
local titleDone, subDone, bootDone, lastN, ev = false, false, false, 0, 1
local t0
local function layout(sx, sy)
U = math.clamp(sy / 720, 0.55, 1.2)
CY = sy * 0.36
local th = 56 * U
local ty0 = CY + 158 * U
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, ty0)
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(sx * 0.86, 820), th)
local subY = ty0 + th * 0.5 + 16
sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY)
sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(sx * 0.9, 640), 20)
boot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY + 20)
boot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 54)
end
local function impact(k, c)
punch = math.max(punch, 0.03 + 0.03 * k)
shake = math.max(shake, 5 + 6 * k)
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.12 + 0.2 * k)
glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.4 + 0.3 * k)
pulse = 1
if T then T.pulse = 1 end
pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 300 + 200 * k, 0.6, 2 + k)
pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, math.floor(6 + 5 * k), 130 + 80 * k, 0.6)
end
local function bootTick() pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.5) end
local EV = {
{0.04, function()
flashK = 0.5
pcall(FX.Play, "open", 1.1)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12 * inten, 0.12, 1.8) end
end},
{0.35, function()
local c = iaccent()
pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 420, 0.7, 3)
pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, 10, 200, 0.7)
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 1)
end},
{1.05, function() glitch = 0.8 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end},
{1.45, function() glitch = 0.6 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.9) end},
{1.95, function()
impact(1, iaccent())
pcall(function() T.yawVel = T.yawVel + 10 end)
pcall(FX.Play, "hit", 1)
end},
{bootAt[1], bootTick}, {bootAt[2], bootTick}, {bootAt[3], bootTick},
{3.95, function() impact(0.6, iaccent()) pcall(FX.Play, "reform", 1) end},
{TH, function()
local s = sg.AbsoluteSize
tx, ty, tsz = s.X * 0.5, math.min(46, s.Y * 0.1), 40
local b = D.Button
if b and b.Parent then
local p, bs = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
tx, ty, tsz = p.X + bs.X / 2, p.Y + bs.Y / 2, math.max(bs.X, bs.Y)
end
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 0.9)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.1, 0.6) end
end},
}
local function step(t, dt, sx, sy)
while ev <= #EV and t >= EV[ev][1] do
if t - EV[ev][1] < 0.4 then pcall(EV[ev][2]) end
ev = ev + 1
end
if sx ~= lsx or sy ~= lsy then
lsx, lsy = sx, sy
layout(sx, sy)
end
local u, col = U, iaccent()
local outK = clamp01((t - TH) / (DUR - TH))
local inK = clamp01(t / 0.35)
local vis = inK * (1 - eIn(outK))
local fo = 1 - clamp01(outK * 3)
pulse = pulse * math.exp(-7 * dt)
punch = punch * math.exp(-8 * dt)
shake = shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
flashK = math.max(0, flashK - dt * 3.2)
glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 2.4)
local beat = math.floor(t / PERIOD)
if beat ~= lastBeat then
lastBeat = beat
pulse = 1
if T then T.pulse = math.max(T.pulse or 0, 0.55) end
end
stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.94 * vis
if inK < 1 or outK > 0 then
for i = 1, #vign do vign[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vis end
end
local R = math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) * 0.5
local sp = (0.35 + 3.2 * math.exp(-((t - 0.9) / 0.55) ^ 2)) * (1 - outK * 0.8)
local ex = 0.8 * vis
for i = 1, #stars do
local s = stars[i]
s.r = s.r + s.v * sp * dt * 0.6
if s.r > 1 then
s.r = math.random() * 0.08
s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
end
local rr = s.r * s.r
local f = s.f
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5 + math.cos(s.a) * rr * R, sy * 0.5 + math.sin(s.a) * rr * R)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + sp * rr * 46, 2)
f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, rr * 2.5) * ex
if s.hot then f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
local k = eInOut(outK)
mark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sx * 0.5, tx, k), lerp(CY + math.sin(t * 2.2) * 4 * u * (1 - outK), ty, k))
ms.Scale = math.max(0.01, eBack(clamp01((t - 0.12) / 0.8)) * lerp(u, tsz / 240 * 1.1, k) * (1 + pulse * 0.035 * (1 - outK)))
local tIn = clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.75)
local lockK = eOut(clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.9))
if not titleDone and t >= 1.0 then
local n = math.floor(#name * tIn)
if n ~= lastN then
lastN = n
if n > 0 and n % 2 == 0 then pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end
end
local s = scr(name, tIn)
lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
titleDone = tIn >= 1
end
local c = (1 - lockK) * 22 * u + pulse * 3
lblR.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -c, 0.5, 0)
lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, c, 0.5, 0)
local ta = clamp01((t - 1.0) / 0.12) * fo
lblM.TextTransparency = 1 - ta
lblR.TextTransparency = 1 - ta * (0.12 + 0.43 * (1 - lockK))
lblB.TextTransparency = lblR.TextTransparency
if not subDone and t >= 2.0 then
sub.Text = scr(subText, (t - 2.05) / 0.6)
subDone = t >= 2.65
end
local blink = (t > 3.95 and t < TH) and (math.floor(t * 4) % 2 == 0 and 1 or 0.55) or 1
sub.TextColor3 = col
sub.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - 2.05) / 0.2) * fo * blink
if not bootDone and t >= bootAt[1] then
local parts = {}
for i = 1, #bootLines do
local f = clamp01((t - bootAt[i]) / 0.3)
if f > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = scr(bootLines[i], f) end
end
boot.Text = table.concat(parts, "\n")
bootDone = t >= bootAt[#bootAt] + 0.3
end
boot.TextColor3 = col
boot.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - bootAt[1]) / 0.15) * fo * 0.9
if t >= 1.0 and t < 1.95 then
scan.Visible = true
scan.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * ((t - 1.0) / 0.95) - 60)
scan.BackgroundColor3, scanLine.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
elseif scan.Visible then
scan.Visible = false
end
for i = 1, #tears do
local f = tears[i]
if glitch > 0.05 and math.random() < glitch * 0.8 then
f.Visible = true
f.Position = UDim2.new(0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 40 * glitch, 0, math.random() * sy)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2, 10))
f.BackgroundColor3 = math.random() < 0.5 and col or WHITE
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.45
elseif f.Visible then
f.Visible = false
end
end
local bh = sy * 0.085 * eOut(clamp01(t / 0.6)) * (1 - eIn(outK))
barTop.Size, barBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh)
local hin = eOut(clamp01((t - 0.1) / 0.7))
local inset = (22 + (1 - hin) * 80) * u
for i = 1, #hud do
local b = hud[i]
b.host.Position = UDim2.new(b.ax, b.ax == 0 and inset or -inset, b.ay, b.ay == 0 and inset or -inset)
local tr = 1 - hin * (1 - outK)
if math.random() < 0.04 then tr = math.min(1, tr + 0.5) end
b.h.BackgroundTransparency, b.v.BackgroundTransparency = tr, tr
b.h.BackgroundColor3, b.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
end
tcL.Text = string.format("DELTA // BOOT  %04.2f / %04.2f", math.min(t, DUR), DUR)
modL.Text = D.Api and "CUSTOMIZER LINKED" or "CUSTOMIZER WAITING"
ctrL.Text = string.format("SYS.INIT  %03d%%", math.floor(clamp01(t / TH) * 100))
local hudA = math.min(1, 1 - hin * 0.85 * fo + (1 - fo))
for _, l in ipairs({tcL, nowL, modL, ctrL}) do
l.TextColor3 = col
l.TextTransparency = hudA
end
progFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / TH), 0, 1, 0)
progFill.BackgroundColor3, progDot.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
local pf = clamp01(outK * 1.5)
progFill.BackgroundTransparency = pf
progDot.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(pf, math.clamp(0.15 - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1))
progDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6 + pulse * 5, 6 + pulse * 5)
progBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.1 * vis
local sv = fo * vis
skipBtn.TextColor3, skipStroke.Color = col, col
skipBtn.TextTransparency = 1 - sv
skipBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.7 * sv
skipStroke.Transparency = math.min(1, 0.2 + 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3) + (1 - sv))
local endF = clamp01((t - (DUR - 0.3)) / 0.3) * 0.25
flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35)
flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.max(math.min(0.8, flashK * math.clamp(inten, 0, 1.2)), endF * math.clamp(inten, 0.4, 1))
worldZoom.Scale = 1 + punch * inten
if shake > 0.1 then
world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten)
elseif shake ~= 0 then
shake = 0
world.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
end
end
local function doSkip()
if t0 and os.clock() - t0 < TH then t0 = os.clock() - TH end
end
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not t0 or os.clock() - t0 < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local kc = input.KeyCode
if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Space or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Return or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then doSkip() end
end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.Activated:Connect(doSkip)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.2, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1.12}) end)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end)
t0 = os.clock()
local last = t0
while sg.Parent do
local now = os.clock()
local t = now - t0
if t >= DUR then break end
local dt = math.min(0.1, now - last)
last = now
local sz = sg.AbsoluteSize
if sz.X >= 2 and sz.Y >= 2 then step(t, dt, sz.X, sz.Y) end
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
if D.Logo then pcall(D.Logo.Bloom, D.Logo) end
if D.LogoHost then pcall(FX.Ring, D.LogoHost, iaccent(), math.max(tsz * 1.8, 90), 0.7, 2) end
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 5, 0.06, 0.5) end
end)
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
if T then pcall(function() T:Destroy() end) end
pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
if not ok then error(err, 0) end
end
function D.PlayIntro(force)
if D.IntroBusy or not (D.Detected and D.Active) then return end
if not force and (D.IntroPlayed or cfg("DeltaIntro") ~= true or FX.IsLowEnd()) then return end
D.IntroBusy, D.IntroPlayed = true, true
task.spawn(function()
local t0 = os.clock()
while FX.IntroActive and not force and os.clock() - t0 < 120 do task.wait(0.1) end
local ok, err = pcall(D.RunIntro)
if not ok then
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta intro error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
D.IntroBusy = false
end)
end
function D.Apply()
pcall(D.Exec.Sync)
if D.Detected and D.Active then pcall(D.ApplyLogo) return end
if D.Detected and not D.Starting and cfg("DeltaEnabled") ~= false then
D.Started = false
task.spawn(D.Start)
end
end
function D.Start()
if D.Started or D.Starting then return end
D.Started, D.Starting = true, true
pcall(D.Exec.Sync)
if not D.Detected then
D.Status = "skipped (executor: " .. (D.Executor ~= "" and D.Executor or "unknown") .. ")"
D.Starting = false
return
end
if cfg("DeltaEnabled") == false then
D.Status = "turned off on the Customization page (applies on the next start)"
D.Starting = false
return
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if not D.Boot() then error(D.Status, 0) end
local btn, api = D.WaitIcon(75)
if not btn then error("Delta icon not found", 0) end
D.Button, D.Api = btn, api
D.Main = btn:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
D.Active = true
D.Status = "active"
D.ApplyLogo()
D.BindMotion()
D.PlayIntro(false)
end)
if not ok then
D.Active = false
D.Status = tostring(err)
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta bridge off (script unaffected): " .. tostring(err))
end
D.Starting = false
end
D.Exec = (function()
local X = {Version = "1.0"}
local RS = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local stats = {hits = 0, misses = 0, compiled = 0, failed = 0, runs = 0, errors = 0, jobs = 0, compileMs = 0, savedMs = 0, netHits = 0}
local net, netCount, netBytes = {}, 0, 0
local NET_TTL = 90
local cache, entries, bytes, stamp = {}, {}, 0, 0
local jobs, head, tail, conn = {}, 1, 0, nil
local once = {}
local function tier()
local prof = type(_G) == "table" and _G.UHDevProfile
return type(prof) == "table" and tonumber(prof.Tier) or 3
end
local function limits()
local t = tier()
if t <= 1 then return 8, 1048576 end
if t == 2 then return 16, 2097152 end
return 32, 4194304
end
local function frameBudget()
local t = tier()
if t <= 1 or FX.IsLowEnd() then return 0.002 end
return t == 2 and 0.003 or 0.005
end
local function evict()
local maxN, maxB = limits()
while #entries > maxN or bytes > maxB do
local oi, ot = 1, math.huge
for i, e in ipairs(entries) do
if e.t < ot then oi, ot = i, e.t end
end
local e = table.remove(entries, oi)
if not e then break end
local bc = cache[e.chunk]
if bc then
bc[e.src] = nil
if next(bc) == nil then cache[e.chunk] = nil end
end
bytes -= e.size
end
end
local function tb(e)
local ok, t = pcall(debug.traceback, tostring(e), 2)
return ok and t or tostring(e)
end
function X.Compile(src, chunk, opts)
if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then return nil, "empty source" end
chunk = chunk or "=UhDelta"
local ls = loadstring or load
if type(ls) ~= "function" then return nil, "loadstring unavailable" end
local bc = cache[chunk]
local e = bc and bc[src]
if e then
stats.hits += 1
stats.savedMs += e.ms
stamp += 1
e.t = stamp
return e.fn
end
local t0 = os.clock()
local fn, err = ls(src, chunk)
local ms = (os.clock() - t0) * 1000
stats.misses += 1
if type(fn) ~= "function" then
stats.failed += 1
return nil, err
end
stats.compiled += 1
stats.compileMs += ms
local _, maxB = limits()
if not (type(opts) == "table" and opts.nocache) and #src <= maxB // 2 then
stamp += 1
local ent = {chunk = chunk, src = src, fn = fn, size = #src, ms = ms, t = stamp}
if not bc then bc = {} cache[chunk] = bc end
bc[src] = ent
entries[#entries + 1] = ent
bytes += ent.size
evict()
end
return fn
end
function X.Run(src, chunk, ...)
local fn, err = X.Compile(src, chunk)
if not fn then
stats.errors += 1
return false, err
end
stats.runs += 1
local res = table.pack(xpcall(fn, tb, ...))
if not res[1] then stats.errors += 1 end
return table.unpack(res, 1, res.n)
end
function X.RunAsync(src, chunk, ...)
return task.spawn(function(...)
local ok, err = X.Run(src, chunk, ...)
if not ok then warn("[UhDelta] " .. tostring(err)) end
end, ...)
end
function X.ReadFile(path)
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return nil, "readfile unavailable" end
local ok, body = pcall(readfile, path)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body end
if ok then return nil, "unreadable or empty file: " .. tostring(path) end
return nil, "file not found: " .. tostring(path)
end
function X.RunFile(path, ...)
local body, err = X.ReadFile(path)
if not body then return false, err end
return X.Run(body, "@" .. tostring(path), ...)
end
local function stop()
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
end
local function runJob(j)
local ok, err = pcall(j.fn, table.unpack(j.args, 1, j.n))
if not ok then
stats.errors += 1
warn("[UhDelta] queued job failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
local function pump()
local t0, budget = os.clock(), frameBudget()
while head <= tail do
local j = jobs[head]
jobs[head] = nil
head += 1
if j and not j.cancelled then
stats.jobs += 1
task.spawn(runJob, j)
end
if os.clock() - t0 >= budget then break end
end
if head > tail then
head, tail = 1, 0
stop()
end
end
local function cancelJob(j) j.cancelled = true end
function X.Queue(fn, ...)
if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end
local j = {fn = fn, args = {...}, n = select("#", ...), Cancel = cancelJob}
tail += 1
jobs[tail] = j
if not conn then conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(pump) end
return j
end
function X.Batch(list, onDone)
if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
local total = #list
local left = total
for i = 1, total do
local item = list[i]
X.Queue(function()
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if type(item) == "function" then
item()
elseif type(item) == "table" then
local okR, errR
if item.File then okR, errR = X.RunFile(item.File) else okR, errR = X.Run(item.Source, item.Name) end
if not okR then error(errR, 0) end
end
end)
if not ok then warn("[UhDelta] batch item " .. i .. " failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
left -= 1
if left == 0 and type(onDone) == "function" then onDone() end
end)
end
return total
end
function X.Preload(list)
if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
for _, item in ipairs(list) do
if type(item) == "table" then X.Queue(X.Compile, item.Source, item.Name) end
end
return #list
end
function X.Once(key, fn, ...)
if once[key] then return false end
once[key] = true
return true, fn(...)
end
function X.Debounce(fn, wait)
local token = 0
return function(...)
token += 1
local my, n, args = token, select("#", ...), {...}
task.delay(wait or 0.25, function()
if my == token then fn(table.unpack(args, 1, n)) end
end)
end
end
function X.Throttle(fn, interval)
local last = -math.huge
return function(...)
local now = os.clock()
if now - last >= (interval or 0.25) then
last = now
return fn(...)
end
end
end
function X.Memo(fn, max)
local store, count = {}, 0
max = max or 256
return function(k)
if k == nil then return fn(k) end
local v = store[k]
if v == nil then
v = fn(k)
if v ~= nil then
if count >= max then table.clear(store) count = 0 end
store[k] = v
count += 1
end
end
return v
end
end
local function netDrop(k)
local e = net[k]
if e then
net[k] = nil
netCount -= 1
netBytes -= e.size
end
end
local function netClear()
table.clear(net)
netCount, netBytes = 0, 0
end
function X.NetGet(key)
local e = type(key) == "string" and net[key] or nil
if not e then return nil end
if os.time() - e.t > NET_TTL then
netDrop(key)
return nil
end
stats.netHits += 1
return e.body
end
function X.NetSet(key, body)
if type(key) ~= "string" or type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then return end
local maxN, maxB = limits()
local size = #body
if size > maxB // 2 then return end
netDrop(key)
while netCount > 0 and (netCount >= maxN or netBytes + size > maxB) do
local oldK, oldT = nil, math.huge
for k, e in pairs(net) do
if e.t < oldT then oldK, oldT = k, e.t end
end
if not oldK then break end
netDrop(oldK)
end
net[key] = {body = body, size = size, t = os.time()}
netCount += 1
netBytes += size
end
X.Fast = {
Compile = function(src, chunk) return X.Compile(src, chunk) end,
NetGet = X.NetGet,
NetSet = X.NetSet,
}
function X.Stats()
return {
Hits = stats.hits, Misses = stats.misses, Compiled = stats.compiled, Failed = stats.failed,
Runs = stats.runs, Errors = stats.errors, JobsRun = stats.jobs,
Cached = #entries, CachedBytes = bytes, Queued = math.max(0, tail - head + 1),
CompileMs = math.floor(stats.compileMs + 0.5),
NetHits = stats.netHits, NetCached = netCount,
EstimatedSavedMs = math.floor(stats.savedMs + 0.5),
}
end
function X.Clear()
table.clear(cache)
table.clear(entries)
bytes = 0
netClear()
for i = head, tail do
local j = jobs[i]
if j then j.cancelled = true end
jobs[i] = nil
end
head, tail = 1, 0
stop()
end
function X.Sync()
local on = D.Detected and FX.Cfg.DeltaExecHelpers ~= false
local fastOn = D.Detected and FX.Cfg.DeltaFastExec ~= false
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
pcall(function()
local cur = rawget(genv, "UhDeltaAPI")
if on then
if cur ~= X then
if type(cur) == "table" and type(cur.Clear) == "function" then pcall(cur.Clear) end
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaAPI", X)
end
elseif cur == X then
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaAPI", nil)
end
local curF = rawget(genv, "UhDeltaFast")
if fastOn then
if curF ~= X.Fast then rawset(genv, "UhDeltaFast", X.Fast) end
elseif curF == X.Fast then
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaFast", nil)
end
end)
if not fastOn then netClear() end
if not on and not fastOn then X.Clear() end
end
return X
end)()
pcall(D.Detect)
FX.OnLowEnd(function() pcall(D.Apply) end)
return D
end)()
return FX
end)()
Util.LoopedHSV = function(h, s, v)
h %= 1
s = math.clamp(s, 0, 1)
v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
end
Util.DiscoPalette = {
Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 160), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 48), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90),
Color3.fromRGB(70, 222, 255), Color3.fromRGB(160, 110, 255),
}
Util.DiscoColor = function(step)
local p = Util.DiscoPalette
local n = #p
step = step % n
local i = math.floor(step)
return p[i + 1]:Lerp(p[(i + 1) % n + 1], step - i)
end

end

Util.IsGuiVisible = function(guiObject)
if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
while guiObject do
if not guiObject.Visible then
return false
end
guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
end
return true
end
do
local scratch = {}
-- same answer as Util.IsGuiVisible; ancestor results are shared through `memo` (valid only for one sweep in which no Visible changes)
Util.IsGuiVisibleM = function(guiObject, memo)
if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
local n, cur, res = 0, guiObject, true
while cur do
local m = memo[cur]
if m ~= nil then res = m break end
n = n + 1
scratch[n] = cur
if not cur.Visible then res = false break end
cur = cur:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
end
for i = 1, n do memo[scratch[i]] = res scratch[i] = nil end
return res
end
end
Util.GetTouchJump = function()
local c = Util.TouchCache
if not c then c = {next = 0} Util.TouchCache = c end
local tg = c.tg
if not tg or not tg.Parent then
tg, c.tg, c.jb = nil, nil, nil
local now = os.clock()
if now >= c.next then
c.next = now + 0.5
local pl = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local pg = pl and pl:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
tg = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
c.tg = tg
end
end
if not tg then return nil, nil end
local jb = c.jb
if not jb or not jb:IsDescendantOf(tg) then
local tf = tg:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
jb = tf and tf:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
c.jb = jb
end
return tg, jb
end

Util.QueryPlayerSelector = function(query, excludespeaker)
if #query == 0 then return end
query = query:lower()
local t = {}
for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
if player ~= Player or not excludespeaker then
local a = player.DisplayName:lower():find(query)
local b = player.Name:lower():find(query)
if a then table.insert(t, {player, 1, a}) end
if b then table.insert(t, {player, 0, b}) end
end
end
table.sort(t, function(a, b)
if a[2] == b[2] then
return a[3] < b[3]
end
return a[2] < b[2]
end)
if t[1] then
return t[1][1]
end
return nil
end

Util.TeleportAutoExec = (function()
local AE = {}
local TOKEN = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
local queued, cleared, told = false, false, {}
local LB, RB = "[" .. string.rep("=", 12) .. "[", "]" .. string.rep("=", 12) .. "]"
local function once(key, msg)
if told[key] then return end
told[key] = true
pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
end
local function getQueue()
local f = queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or queueteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport) or (fluxus and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
return type(f) == "function" and f or nil
end
function AE.Check()
if getQueue() then return true end
once("unsupported", "Your executor has no teleport-queue support (queue_on_teleport), so UH Admin cannot auto execute after teleporting. Re-execute it manually.")
return false
end
function AE.QueueRaw(code)
local q = getQueue()
if not q then AE.Check() return false end
local ok, err = pcall(q, code)
if not ok then
once("queuefail", "Teleport queue failed: " .. tostring(err))
return false
end
return true
end
local function payload(src)
return table.concat({
[=[local g=(getgenv and getgenv()) or _G if g.UhhhhhhTpToken==]=], ("%q"):format(TOKEN),
[=[ then return end g.UhhhhhhTpToken=]=], ("%q"):format(TOKEN),
[=[ local ok,d=pcall(readfile,"UhhhhhhReanim/tree.ehehetilde") if ok and type(d)=="string" and d:find('"ServerHopAutoExec":false',1,true) then return end ]=],
[=[if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end local P=game:GetService("Players") local lp=P.LocalPlayer while not lp do P:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait() lp=P.LocalPlayer end lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui",15) local t=os.clock() while not lp.Character and os.clock()-t<10 do task.wait() end local S=]=],
LB, "\n", src, RB,
[=[ g.UhhhhhhSource=S local f,e=loadstring(S) if f then f() else warn("UH Admin auto execute failed: "..tostring(e)) end]=],
})
end
function AE.Enabled()
return SaveData.ServerHopAutoExec ~= false
end
function AE.Arm()
if not AE.Enabled() then return true end
if not getQueue() then AE.Check() return false end
if not queued then
local okg, g = pcall(function() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G end)
local src = okg and g and g.UhhhhhhSource
if type(src) ~= "string" or #src == 0 then
once("nosource", "Auto Execute could not read this script's source, nothing was queued.")
return false
end
if not AE.QueueRaw(payload(src)) then return false end
queued = true
once("armed", "Auto Execute armed: UH Admin will run again after teleporting.")
end
if _G.UhhhhhhLoaded ~= nil then
cleared = true
_G.UhhhhhhLoaded = nil
end
return true
end
function AE.Abort()
if cleared then
cleared = false
_G.UhhhhhhLoaded = UhhhhhhVersion
end
end
pcall(function()
Players.LocalPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(state)
if state == Enum.TeleportState.Failed then
AE.Abort()
elseif state == Enum.TeleportState.Started or state == Enum.TeleportState.RequestedFromServer then
AE.Arm()
end
end)
end)
return AE
end)()
