Util.CDNMemo = {}
Util.GetCDNAsset = function(filename)
local FXc = Util.FX
local on = FXc and FXc.Cache and FXc.Cfg.UICache ~= false
if on then
local m = Util.CDNMemo[filename]
if m then return m end
local okG, gid = pcall(FXc.Cache.Graphic, filename)
if okG and gid then
Util.CDNMemo[filename] = gid
return gid
end
end
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. filename
local s, id = pcall(isfile, path)
if s and id then
s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
if s then
if on and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then Util.CDNMemo[filename] = id end
return id
end
end
return ""
end
-- Per-frame write cache: Util.Dirty(slot, key, value) is true only when value differs from what was last written for slot[key]
-- (colours: summed RGB tolerance 0.004 = under 1/255, numbers: 0.002), so unchanged theme colours / transparencies are not pushed
-- to the engine every frame. Every 90th call per key writes anyway so a property touched by another script never stays stale.
-- With "UI Cache" off it is always true (the old write-every-frame behaviour).
Util.Dirty = function(slot, key, v)
local FXc = Util.FX
if not (FXc and FXc.Cfg.UICache ~= false) then return true end
local cnt = slot.__n
if not cnt then cnt = {} slot.__n = cnt end
local k = (cnt[key] or 0) + 1
cnt[key] = k
local old = slot[key]
if old ~= nil and k % 90 ~= 0 then
local tv = typeof(v)
if tv == "Color3" then
if typeof(old) == "Color3" and math.abs(old.R - v.R) + math.abs(old.G - v.G) + math.abs(old.B - v.B) <= 0.004 then return false end
elseif tv == "number" then
if type(old) == "number" and math.abs(old - v) <= 0.002 then return false end
elseif old == v then
return false
end
end
slot[key] = v
return true
end
-- UI text measurement cache: same (text, size, font, bounds) -> same size, so layout rebuilds skip the engine call
Util.TextSize = function(text, size, font, bounds)
local FXc = Util.FX
local C = FXc and FXc.Cache
if not (C and FXc.Cfg.UICache ~= false and type(text) == "string" and typeof(font) == "EnumItem" and typeof(bounds) == "Vector2") then
return TextService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, bounds)
end
local key = text .. "\0" .. tostring(size) .. "\0" .. font.Name .. "\0" .. tostring(bounds.X) .. "\0" .. tostring(bounds.Y)
local memo = C.Text
local v = memo[key]
if v then return v end
v = TextService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, bounds)
if C.TextN >= 3000 then memo = {} C.Text = memo C.TextN = 0 end
memo[key] = v
C.TextN += 1
return v
end
Util.MakeTriforce = function(tris, color, dur)
dur = dur or 8
local function CreateTriangle(parent, radius, width, rotation, color)
local height = (math.sqrt(3) / 2) * width
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
pivot.Rotation = rotation
local tri = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", pivot)
tri.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
tri.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 - radius, 0)
tri.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, height, 0)
tri.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tri.BorderSizePixel = 0
tri.Image = Util.GetCDNAsset("letriangul.graphic.png")
local grey = math.max(color.R, color.G, color.B) * 0.5
tri.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(grey, grey, grey)
TweenService:Create(tri, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
ImageColor3 = color
}):Play()
end
local radius = 0.1
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
local width = 2 * radius * math.sin(math.pi / tris) * 2
for i=1, tris do
CreateTriangle(pivot, radius, width, (i / tris) * 360, color)
end
return pivot
end
Util.MakeText = function(text)
text = text:upper()
local ls = "BCDEIKOPQRSTUVYZ\\_`N^MJ"
local lt = ""
lt ..= "DDDDD@DFF@@@@@FSFSFSF@@@@@@@@@@@@@@EMMUKKTDD@@@@@DEEEEEDDBBBBBD@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@DE@@@G@@@@@@@@@DABBDEEI"
lt ..= "GJJJJJGDVDDDDSGJAGIISRAAGAARWJJSAAASIIRAARGIIRJJGSAABBDDGJJGJJGGJJHAAG"
lt ..= "@DD@DD@@DD@DE@@BDEDB@@@G@G@@@EDBDE@GJABD@D@@@@@@@"
lt ..= "DFJSJJJRJJRJJRGJIIIJGRJJJJJRSIIRIISSIIRIIIHIILJJHJJJSJJJGDDDDDGAAAAAJHJKMOMKJIIIIIISJQNJJJJJJPNLJJGJJJJJGRJJRIIIGJJJNGCRJJRMKJGJIGAJGSDDDDDDJJJJJJGJJJJJFDJJJNQJJJJFDFJJJJFDDDDSABDEIS"
local pixs = {}
local totalsize = 0
for i=0, 6 do
local row = {}
for j=1, text:len() do
local c = text:byte(j, j)
local w = 0
if c ~= 0x20 then
local k = (c - 33) * 7 + i
w = lt:byte(k + 1, k + 1)
if w ~= nil and w > 64 then
w = ls:byte(w - 64, w - 64) - 65
else
w = 0
end
end
for k=0, 5 do
local h = (j - 1) * 6 + (4 - k)
totalsize = math.max(totalsize, h + 1)
local p = (w // math.pow(2, k)) % 2
if p > 0 then
row[h] = true
end
end
end
pixs[i] = row
end
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.Size = UDim2.new(0, totalsize, 0, 7)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
for i=0, 6 do
local row = pixs[i]
local olde = nil
local olds = 0
for j=0, totalsize - 1 do
local pix = row[j]
if pix == true then
if olde ~= nil then
olds += 1
olde.Size = UDim2.new(olds / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
else
olde = Util.Instance("Frame", pivot)
olde.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
olde.Position = UDim2.new(j / totalsize, 0, i / 7, 0)
olde.Size = UDim2.new(1 / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
olde.BackgroundTransparency = 1
olde.BorderSizePixel = 0
olds = 1
end
else
olde = nil
olds = 0
end
end
end
return pivot
end
Util.SetTextColor = function(text, color, tran)
for _,v in text:GetChildren() do
v.BackgroundColor3 = color
v.BackgroundTransparency = tran
end
end
local THEME_SONG_URL = ""
-- GitHub song repo: songs are no longer embedded in this script, they are downloaded once and cached in UhhhhhhReanim/Assets
Util.SongRepo = {User = "Elliot12-wq", Repo = "Intro-theme-songs.-", Branch = "main", Listing = nil, Busy = false}
Util.SongRepo.Raw = function(name)
local R = Util.SongRepo
local enc = tostring(name):gsub("[^%w%-%._~]", function(c) return string.format("%%%02X", c:byte()) end)
return "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. R.User .. "/" .. R.Repo .. "/" .. R.Branch .. "/" .. enc
end
Util.SongRepo.List = function(fetchFn)
local R = Util.SongRepo
local t0 = os.clock()
while R.Busy and os.clock() - t0 < 15 do task.wait(0.1) end
if R.Listing ~= nil then return R.Listing or nil end
R.Busy = true
local names = false
pcall(function()
local body = fetchFn("https://api.github.com/repos/" .. R.User .. "/" .. R.Repo .. "/contents?ref=" .. R.Branch)
local data = body and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body)
if type(data) == "table" then
local list = {}
for _, e in ipairs(data) do
if type(e) == "table" and e.type == "file" and type(e.name) == "string" then list[#list + 1] = e.name end
end
names = list
end
end)
R.Listing = names
R.Busy = false
return names or nil
end
Util.SongRepo.Find = function(names, match)
if type(names) ~= "table" or type(match) ~= "table" then return nil end
for _, n in ipairs(names) do
local low = n:lower()
if low:sub(-4) == ".mp3" then
local all = true
for _, key in ipairs(match) do
if not low:find(key, 1, true) then all = false break end
end
if all then return n end
end
end
return nil
end
Util.SongLoader = function(X)
local TS = {
Title = "Modjo - Lady (Hear Me Tonight)",
File = "modjo_lady_theme.mp3",
Bpm = 126.02, Offset = 0.18,
MinBytes = 100000,
Remote = {Name = "modjo_lady_theme.mp3", Match = {"modjo"}},
}
if X then TS = X end
local function THEME_SONG_DATA()
return {
}
end
TS.Samples = TS.Samples or {
{1, "49443303000000000023545353450000"},
{442671, "cc51c2d7d88da30c7b2196cd3bd05929"},
{885342, "2484f49152a9422f203594b14832391a"},
{1327998, "55555555555555555555555555555555"},
}
TS.Progress = 0
TS.Why = nil
local B64, La, Lb, Lc, Ld = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
do
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
for i = 1, 64 do
local v, ch = i - 1, alphabet:byte(i)
B64[ch] = v
La[ch] = v * 4
Lb[ch] = v // 16 + (v % 16) * 4096
Lc[ch] = (v // 4) * 256 + (v % 4) * 4194304
Ld[ch] = v * 65536
end
B64[61], La[61], Lb[61], Lc[61], Ld[61] = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
end
local function hex(s)
return (s:gsub(".", function(ch) return string.format("%02x", ch:byte()) end))
end
local function verify(body)
if type(body) ~= "string" or #body ~= TS.Bytes or body:sub(1, 3) ~= "ID3" then return false end
for _, sm in ipairs(TS.Samples) do
if hex(body:sub(sm[1], sm[1] + 15)) ~= sm[2] then return false end
end
return true
end
local function decodeNative(chunks)
local joined = table.concat(chunks)
local getters = {
function() return crypt.base64decode end,
function() return crypt.base64_decode end,
function() return crypt.base64.decode end,
function() return syn.crypt.base64.decode end,
function() return base64_decode end,
function() return base64decode end,
function() return base64.decode end,
}
for _, get in ipairs(getters) do
local okG, fn = pcall(get)
if okG and type(fn) == "function" then
local okD, res = pcall(fn, joined)
if okD and verify(res) then return res end
end
end
return nil
end
local function decodeLua(chunks)
local sbyte, schar, concat = string.byte, string.char, table.concat
local nchars = 0
for _, s in ipairs(chunks) do nchars = nchars + #s end
local lastChunk = chunks[#chunks]
local pad = (lastChunk:sub(-2) == "==") and 2 or ((lastChunk:sub(-1) == "=") and 1 or 0)
local size = nchars // 4 * 3 - pad
local t0 = os.clock()
local total = #chunks
if type(buffer) == "table" and buffer.create and buffer.writeu32 and buffer.readstring then
local buf = buffer.create(size + 8)
local writeu32 = buffer.writeu32
local pos = 0
for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
for i = 1, #s, 4 do
local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
writeu32(buf, pos, La[a] + Lb[b] + Lc[c] + Ld[d])
pos = pos + 3
end
TS.Progress = ci / total
if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
task.wait()
t0 = os.clock()
end
end
return buffer.readstring(buf, 0, size)
end
local out = {}
for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
local parts, pn = {}, 0
for i = 1, #s, 4 do
local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
local v = (B64[a] or 0) * 262144 + (B64[b] or 0) * 4096 + (B64[c] or 0) * 64 + (B64[d] or 0)
pn = pn + 1
parts[pn] = schar(v // 65536, (v // 256) % 256, v % 256)
end
out[ci] = concat(parts)
TS.Progress = ci / total
if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
task.wait()
t0 = os.clock()
end
end
local body = concat(out)
if pad > 0 then body = body:sub(1, #body - pad) end
return body
end
local function unpack64(chunks)
local okN, res = pcall(decodeNative, chunks)
if okN and res then return res end
local okL, body = pcall(decodeLua, chunks)
if okL and verify(body) then return body end
TS.Why = okL and "bundled data failed verification (script text damaged?)" or ("decode error: " .. tostring(body))
return nil
end
TS.Path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. TS.File
TS.Period = 60 / TS.Bpm
local busy, failed = false, false
local function url()
if X then return nil end
local u = _G.UhhhhhhThemeSongUrl
if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then u = THEME_SONG_URL end
u = tostring(u):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if u:match("^https?://%S+$") then return u end
return nil
end
local verified = false
function TS.Cached()
if verified then return true end
local ok, v = pcall(isfile, TS.Path)
if not (ok and v == true) then return false end
local FE = Util.FastExec
local fast = FE and FE.On()
if fast and FE.FileOk(TS.Path, TS.Bytes) then
verified = true
return true
end
if type(readfile) == "function" then
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
if okR and type(data) == "string" and (#data < TS.MinBytes or (TS.Bytes ~= nil and #data ~= TS.Bytes)) then
pcall(function() if type(delfile) == "function" then delfile(TS.Path) end end)
if fast then FE.FileDrop(TS.Path) end
return false
end
if fast and okR and type(data) == "string" then FE.FileSet(TS.Path, #data) end
end
verified = true
return true
end
local function fetch(u)
local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, u)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then return body end
if type(request) == "function" then
local ok2, res = pcall(request, {Url = u, Method = "GET"})
if ok2 and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or res.Success == true) and type(res.Body) == "string" then
return res.Body
end
end
return nil
end
local function looksLikeMp3(b)
if #b < TS.MinBytes then return false end
if b:sub(1, 3) == "ID3" then return true end
local b1, b2 = b:byte(1, 2)
return b1 == 0xFF and b2 ~= nil and b2 >= 0xE0
end
function TS.Ensure(wait)
if TS.Cached() then return true end
local u = url()
local chunks = (X and X.Data or THEME_SONG_DATA)()
local bundled = type(chunks) == "table" and #chunks > 0
if failed or not (u or bundled or TS.Remote) then return false end
if not busy then
busy = true
task.spawn(function()
local function sizeOk()
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return true end
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
return okR and type(data) == "string" and ((TS.Bytes ~= nil and #data == TS.Bytes) or (TS.Bytes == nil and #data >= TS.MinBytes))
end
local function save(body)
pcall(function()
if not isfolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") then makefolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") end
end)
local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, TS.Path, body)
if okW and sizeOk() then return true end
if type(appendfile) == "function" then
local okP = pcall(function()
for i = 1, #body, 262144 do
local piece = body:sub(i, i + 262143)
if i == 1 then writefile(TS.Path, piece) else appendfile(TS.Path, piece) end
end
end)
if okP and sizeOk() then return true end
end
TS.Why = "could not write " .. TS.Path .. (okW and " (file came out the wrong size)" or (": " .. tostring(errW)))
return false
end
local ok = pcall(function()
if bundled then
local body = unpack64(chunks)
if body and save(body) then return end
end
if u then
for attempt = 1, 2 do
local body = fetch(u)
if body and looksLikeMp3(body) and save(body) then return end
if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.5) end
end
end
if TS.Remote then
local R = Util.SongRepo
local tried = {}
local function try(name)
if not name or tried[name] then return false end
tried[name] = true
for attempt = 1, 2 do
local body = fetch(R.Raw(name))
if body and looksLikeMp3(body) and save(body) then return true end
if body and not looksLikeMp3(body) then break end
if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.5) end
end
return false
end
if try(TS.Remote.Name) then return end
if try(R.Find(R.List(fetch), TS.Remote.Match)) then return end
TS.Why = TS.Why or ("could not download " .. tostring(TS.Remote.Name or TS.Title) .. " from the GitHub song repo")
end
end)
if not (ok and TS.Cached()) then
failed = true
local why = TS.Why or "no bundled data and no valid THEME_SONG_URL"
warn("[Uhhhhhh] " .. (X and "Intro 2 song" or "theme song") .. " unavailable - " .. why .. (X and ". Using the original intro." or ". Using the old default track."))
pcall(function() Util.UINotify((X and "Intro 2 song" or "Theme song") .. " unavailable: " .. why) end)
end
busy = false
end)
end
local t0 = os.clock()
while busy and os.clock() - t0 < (wait or 0) do task.wait(0.1) end
return TS.Cached()
end
function TS.IsPlaying(snd)
local ok, r = pcall(function() return snd.Name == TS.Title and snd.IsPlaying end)
return ok and r == true
end
function TS.Beat(pos)
local n = (pos - TS.Offset) / TS.Period
local i = math.floor(n)
return i, n - i
end
return TS
end

local UISound = {}

UISound.Music.Looped = false
UISound.Music.PlaybackRegionsEnabled = false
UISound.Music.Volume = 1
UISound.Music.PlaybackSpeed = 1
local MusicPlayer = {}
MusicPlayer.Database = {
}
pcall(function()
local future = table.clone(MusicPlayer.Database)
if isfile("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik/nobuiltin") then
table.clear(future)
end
for _,file in listfiles("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik") do
if isfile(file) and file:sub(-4, -1) == ".mp3" then
table.insert(future, {file, file:sub(21, -5)})
end
end
if #future > 0 then
MusicPlayer.Database = future
end
end)
table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {Util.ThemeSong.Path, Util.ThemeSong.Title, Theme = true})
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
MusicPlayer.UserPicked = false
MusicPlayer.Last = 1
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic = function(i)
if MusicPlayer.Switching then return end
MusicPlayer.Switching = true
local last = MusicPlayer.LastMusic
if not i and MusicPlayer.Sequential and last then i = last % #MusicPlayer.Database + 1 end
if not i then
i = last
while #MusicPlayer.Database > 1 and (i == last or (MusicPlayer.Database[i].Theme and not Util.ThemeSong.Cached())) do
i = math.random(1, #MusicPlayer.Database)
task.wait()
end
i = i or 1
end
MusicPlayer.LastMusic = i
local hi = MusicPlayer.Database[i]
local soundid, soundname = hi[1], hi[2]
if hi.Theme then pcall(Util.ThemeSong.Ensure, 40) end
local s, id = pcall(isfile, soundid)
if s and id then
s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, soundid)
if s then
soundid = id
else
soundid = ""
end
else
soundid = ""
end
if #soundid == 0 then
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
if #MusicPlayer.Database <= 1 then return end
return MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
end
UISound.Music:Stop()
UISound.Music.SoundId = soundid
UISound.Music.Name = soundname
UISound.Music.Looped = hi.Loop == true
local lw = os.clock()
repeat game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait() until UISound.Music.IsLoaded or os.clock() - lw > 8
UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
UISound.Music:Play()
task.wait()
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
end
MusicPlayer.PlayDefault = function()
if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end
local ok = Util.ThemeSong.Ensure(40)
if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end
local IS = (SaveData.IntroStyle == 13 and Util.Intro13Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 12 and Util.Intro12Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 11 and Util.Intro11Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 10 and Util.Intro10Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 9 and Util.Intro9Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 8 and Util.Intro8Song) or nil
if IS then
local okS, idxS = pcall(function()
if not IS.Ensure(60) then return nil end
for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
if entry[1] == IS.Path then return i end
end
table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, {IS.Path, IS.Title, Intro2 = true})
return #MusicPlayer.Database
end)
if okS and idxS and not MusicPlayer.UserPicked then
MusicPlayer.Database[idxS].Loop = true
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(idxS)
return
end
end
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(ok and 1 or nil)
end

Util.Color = (function()
local C = {}
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
C.Modes = {"Theme (follow UI theme)", "Picked color", "Rainbow", "Harmony cycle", "Aurora", "Music reactive", "Day / Night"}
C.Harmonies = {"Analogous", "Complementary", "Triadic", "Split complementary", "Monochrome"}
C.Cur = WHITE
C.ThemeCol = WHITE
local function cfg() return (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {} end
local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
local function hueLerp(a, b, k)
local d = ((b - a + 0.5) % 1) - 0.5
return (a + d * k) % 1
end
function C.Init()
local st = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
if st and st.AccentMode == nil and type(st.UIAccent) == "string" and st.UIAccent ~= "" then
Util.FX.SetCfg("AccentMode", 2)
end
end
function C.Base()
local c = cfg()
local hx = c.UIAccent or ""
if c.UICache == false then return Util.ParseHex(hx) or C.ThemeCol end
if hx ~= C._hx then C._hx = hx C._hxc = Util.ParseHex(hx) or false end
return C._hxc or C.ThemeCol
end
function C.HarmonyHues(h)
local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
if m == 2 then return {h, (h + 0.5) % 1}
elseif m == 3 then return {h, (h + 1 / 3) % 1, (h + 2 / 3) % 1}
elseif m == 4 then return {h, (h + 0.42) % 1, (h + 0.58) % 1}
elseif m == 5 then return {h}
end
return {h, (h + 0.08) % 1, (h - 0.08) % 1}
end
local function music()
local ok, v = pcall(function()
local s = Util.FX and Util.FX.UISound and Util.FX.UISound.Music
if s and s.IsPlaying ~= false then return s.PlaybackLoudness end
return 0
end)
return ok and v or 0
end
function C.Resolve(t, theme)
local c = cfg()
C.ThemeCol = theme or C.ThemeCol
local mode = c.AccentMode or 1
local sp = c.ColorSpeed or 1
local out = C.ThemeCol
local base = C.Base()
local bh, bs, bv
if c.UICache ~= false and C._hb == base then
bh, bs, bv = C._h1, C._h2, C._h3
else
bh, bs, bv = base:ToHSV()
C._hb, C._h1, C._h2, C._h3 = base, bh, bs, bv
end
if mode == 2 then
out = base
elseif mode == 3 then
out = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.1 * sp) % 1, 0.8, 1)
elseif mode == 4 then
local hues = C.HarmonyHues(bh)
local pos = (t * 0.12 * sp) % #hues
local i = math.floor(pos)
local k = pos - i
k = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
local h = hueLerp(hues[i + 1], hues[(i + 1) % #hues + 1], k)
out = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(bs, 0.55), math.max(bv, 0.85))
elseif mode == 5 then
local h = bh + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.5 * sp) + 0.07 * math.sin(t * 0.31 * sp + 1.7)
out = Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.9 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 0.8 * sp))
elseif mode == 6 then
local l = clamp(music() / 700, 0, 1)
C._ml = (C._ml or 0) + (l - (C._ml or 0)) * 0.25
out = Color3.fromHSV((bh + C._ml * 0.28) % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.7 + 0.3 * C._ml)
elseif mode == 7 then
local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) + tonumber(os.date("%M")) / 60
local stops = {{0, 0.64, 0.7}, {5, 0.62, 0.8}, {7, 0.06, 1}, {12, 0.53, 1}, {17, 0.08, 1}, {19.5, 0.92, 0.9}, {22, 0.7, 0.75}, {24, 0.64, 0.7}}
local a, b = stops[1], stops[2]
for i = 1, #stops - 1 do if hr >= stops[i][1] and hr <= stops[i + 1][1] then a, b = stops[i], stops[i + 1] end end
local k = (hr - a[1]) / math.max(0.001, b[1] - a[1])
out = Color3.fromHSV(hueLerp(a[2], b[2], k), 0.75, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k)
end
local FA = Util.FX and Util.FX.Audio
if FA and mode ~= 6 then out = FA.Tint(out) end
if (c.ColorSat or 1) == 1 and (c.ColorBright or 1) == 1 then C.Cur = out return out end
local h, s, v = out:ToHSV()
out = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * (c.ColorSat or 1), 0, 1), clamp(v * (c.ColorBright or 1), 0, 1))
C.Cur = out
return out
end
function C.Palette(t)
local a = C.Cur
local on = cfg().UICache ~= false
if on and C._pc and C._pa == a and C._pm == (cfg().HarmonyMode or 1) then return C._pc end
local h, s, v = a:ToHSV()
local hues = C.HarmonyHues(h)
local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
local sec, ter
if m == 5 then
sec = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, math.max(0.35, v * 0.7))
ter = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.4, 1)
else
sec = Color3.fromHSV(hues[2] or h, s, v)
ter = Color3.fromHSV(hues[3] or ((h + 0.25) % 1), s * 0.85, v)
end
local res = {Accent = a, Secondary = sec, Tertiary = ter, Bg = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * 0.55, 0, 0.6), 0.07), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(a, 0.12)}
if on then C._pc, C._pa, C._pm = res, a, (cfg().HarmonyMode or 1) end
return res
end
return C
end)()

local FX = Util.FX
local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if genv.NA_AUTO_PERF == false or _G.NA_AUTO_PERF == false then return end
local function try(f, ...)
local ok, r = pcall(f, ...)
if ok then return r end
end
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local pn = tostring(try(function() return UIS:GetPlatform() end) or "")
local mobile
if pn:find("IOS") or pn:find("Android") then
mobile = true
elseif pn:find("Windows") or pn:find("OSX") or pn:find("Linux") or pn:find("SteamOS") then
mobile = false
else
mobile = try(function() return UIS.TouchEnabled and not (UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled) end) == true
end
local function toGB(v)
v = tonumber(v)
if not v or v ~= v or v <= 0 then return nil end
local g
if v < 256 then g = v
elseif v < 131072 then g = v / 1024
elseif v < 2e8 then g = v / 1048576
else g = v / 2 ^ 30 end
if g < 0.5 or g > 256 then return nil end
return g
end
local BAD = {"avail", "free", "used", "usage", "limit", "process", "heap", "swap", "virtual", "cache"}
local function badKey(k)
for _, w in ipairs(BAD) do if k:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end
return false
end
local function fromTable(t, depth)
if type(t) ~= "table" or depth > 2 then return nil, 0 end
local best, bestRank = nil, 0
for k, v in pairs(t) do
local ks = type(k) == "string" and k:lower() or ""
local g, rank = nil, 0
if type(v) == "table" then
g, rank = fromTable(v, depth + 1)
elseif ks ~= "" and not badKey(ks) then
local mem = ks:find("memory", 1, true) or ks:find("^ram") or ks:find("[^a-z]ram") or ks:find("ram$")
if mem and (ks:find("total", 1, true) or ks:find("physical", 1, true) or ks:find("install", 1, true)) then
rank = 2
elseif ks == "ram" or ks == "memory" or ks == "ramgb" or ks == "ram_gb" or ks == "memorygb" then
rank = 1
end
if rank > 0 then g = toGB(v) end
end
if g and rank > bestRank then best, bestRank = g, rank end
end
return best, bestRank
end
local function procMB() return tonumber(try(function() return game:GetService("Stats"):GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)) end
local gb, src, conf
gb = toGB(genv.NA_RAM_GB or _G.NA_RAM_GB)
if gb then src, conf = "manual", "exact" end
if not gb then
for _, n in ipairs({"getdeviceram", "getdevicememory", "gettotalram", "getsystemram", "getsystemmemory", "getramsize", "getphysicalmemory", "gettotalmemory", "getdeviceinfo", "getsysteminfo"}) do
local fn = genv[n] or _G[n]
if type(fn) == "function" then
local r = try(fn)
local g, rank
if type(r) == "table" then g, rank = fromTable(r, 0) else g, rank = toGB(r), 2 end
if g then
gb, src, conf = g, n, (rank >= 2) and "high" or "medium"
break
end
end
end
end
local manualTier = tonumber(genv.NA_PERF_TIER or _G.NA_PERF_TIER)
local tier = manualTier
if tier then
src, conf = src or "manual-tier", conf or "exact"
elseif gb then
tier = (gb < 2.5 and 1) or (gb < 5 and 2) or (gb < 9 and 3) or 4
if mobile and conf == "medium" then
for _, bd in ipairs({2.5, 5, 9}) do
if gb >= bd and gb < bd + 0.4 then tier = math.max(1, tier - 1) break end
end
end
else
tier = mobile and 2 or 4
src, conf = "fallback", "none"
end
tier = math.clamp(math.floor(tier), 1, 4)
local prof = {Mobile = mobile, RAM = gb, PhysicalGB = gb, RAMSource = src, Confidence = conf, ProcessMB = procMB(), Pressure = false}
FX.Device = prof
_G.UHDevProfile = prof
pcall(function() genv.UHDevProfile = prof end)
local function apply(t)
prof.Tier, prof.Class = t, ({"low", "low", "mid", "high"})[t]
prof.LowEnd, prof.AntiLag, prof.AssetMode = t == 1, t == 1, ({"Batch", "Medium", "Medium"})[t]
if FX.Perf then FX.Perf.Seed(t, mobile) end
end
apply(tier)
if mobile and gb and not manualTier then
task.delay(20, function()
pcall(function()
local used = procMB()
if not used then return end
prof.ProcessMB = used
if used / 1024 > gb * 0.6 and prof.Tier > 1 then
prof.Pressure = true
apply(prof.Tier - 1)
end
end)
end)
end
if SaveData.ModuleLoadMode == nil and tier <= 2 then
SaveData.ModuleLoadMode = tier == 1 and 4 or 2
end
end)
end

if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
else
TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0}):Play()
task.delay(0.37, function()
if S.applied == true then
root.Visible = false
if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
end
end)
end
else
root.Visible = true
S.shown = true
if tri then
tri:SetActive(true)
tri:PopIn()
end
TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
pcall(FX.Ring, btn, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 90, 0.6, 2)
flashLabel(3)
end
end
local themeT = 0
local function applyTheme(t)
if t - themeT < 0.05 then return end
themeT = t
local cfg = FX.Cfg
local a, b, c
if U.GetTheme then
local ok, x, y, z = pcall(U.GetTheme, t)
if ok and x then a, b, c = x, y, z end
end
a = a or Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1)
b = b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
c = c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
if cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then a = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or a end
for _, o in ipairs(accents) do
if o:IsA("UIStroke") then o.Color = a else o.BackgroundColor3 = a end
end
for _, o in ipairs(bgs) do o.BackgroundColor3 = b end
for _, o in ipairs(texts) do o.TextColor3 = c end
end
local drvAcc, drvN = 0, 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if FX.IsLowEnd() then
drvAcc = drvAcc + dt
if drvAcc < 1 / FX.LowEndUIFPS then return end
dt, drvAcc = drvAcc, 0
else
local gs = FX.Gov and FX.Gov.Stride or 1
if gs > 1 then
drvAcc = drvAcc + dt
drvN = drvN + 1
if drvN < gs then return end
dt, drvAcc, drvN = drvAcc, 0, 0
else
drvAcc, drvN = 0, 0
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local t = os.clock()
applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
local showTab = S.applied == true and FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
tab.Visible = showTab
if showTab then
tab.Position = UDim2.new(root.Position.X.Scale, 0, 0, 0)
tab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.15
end
applyTheme(t)
S.boost = math.max(0, S.boost - dt * 1.6)
S.flash = math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.2)
S.shake = math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 3)
local want = 0.9 + (S.hover and 1.1 or 0) + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 2.5 + S.flash * 3
for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
local T = e.tri
if T and T.active then
T.baseSpin = T.baseSpin + (want * e.mult - T.baseSpin) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
T.scaleBase = e.scale * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 2.3) + 0.12 * S.flash)
end
end
if S.shown then
local speed = 1.4 + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 3 + S.flash * 5 + (Util.FX.Audio.running and Util.FX.Audio.kick * 4 or 0)
U.orbitA = (U.orbitA or 0) + dt * speed
local R = (SIZE + 8) / 2
for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
local a = U.orbitA + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 3)
d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * R, 0.5, math.sin(a) * R)
end
U.btnGrad = ((U.btnGrad or 0) + dt * (90 + S.boost * 220 + (S.open and 120 or 0))) % 360
grad.Rotation = U.btnGrad
local pulse = SIZE + 14 + math.sin(t * 2) * 4 + S.flash * 18 + (Util.FX.Audio.running and Util.FX.Audio.kick * 10 or 0)
aura.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pulse, pulse)
aura.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 - S.flash * 0.35 - (S.open and 0.07 or 0)
btn.Rotation = S.shake > 0 and math.sin(t * 55) * 7 * S.shake or 0
if glyph.Visible then glyph.Rotation = (t * 80 * want) % 360 end
end
local g, bs = U.BarGrad, U.BarStroke
if g and g.Parent then
U.barGradA = ((U.barGradA or 0) + dt * (70 + (S.open and 90 or 0) + S.boost * 260)) % 360
g.Rotation = U.barGradA
bs.Thickness = 1.4 + S.boost * 1.2 + S.flash * 1.4
end
local sc = U.BarScan
if sc and sc.Parent and S.open then
U.scanT = ((U.scanT or 0) + dt / 1.5) % 1
sc.Position = UDim2.new(0, -70 + U.scanT * 320, 1, 0)
end
end)
if not ok and not U.tickWarned then
U.tickWarned = true
warn("[UhAdmin] driver error: " .. tostring(err))
end
end)
applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
end)
if not okL then
warn("[UhAdmin] triangle launcher failed: " .. tostring(errL))
end
end
Util.UhAdmin.Stage = "core: starting"
task.spawn(function()
local okCore, errCore = xpcall(function()
local Notification = {}
Notification.Notify = function(t)
t = t or {}
local desc = tostring(t.Description or "")
local title = tostring(t.Title or "")
local msg = desc
if title ~= "" and title ~= "Nameless Admin" then
msg = title .. ": " .. desc
end
pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
end
local Notify = Notification.Notify
Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
Tris = {},
State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
}
Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds = {punch = true}
Util.UhAdmin.Theme = function(t)
local th = Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme
if th then
local ok, a, b, c = pcall(th, t)
if ok and a then return a, b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
end
return Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end
Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked = function(aliases)
local allowed = {walkfling = true, wfling = true, unwalkfling = true, unwfling = true}
for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do
local l = tostring(n):lower()
if Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds[l] then return true end
if l:find("fling", 1, true) and not allowed[l] then return true end
end
return false
end
Util.UhAdmin.RegisterTri = function(tri, mult, scale)
if tri then
table.insert(Util.UhAdmin.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = mult or 1, scale = scale or 1})
end
end
Util.UhAdmin.Fire = function(ev)
local U = Util.UhAdmin
local S = U.State
local function each(f)
for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
if e.tri and e.tri.active then pcall(f, e.tri) end
end
end
if ev == "open" then
S.open = true
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 8 t.pulse = math.max(t.pulse, 0.7) end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "open", 1.2)
elseif ev == "close" then
S.open = false
elseif ev == "type" then
S.boost = math.min(1, S.boost + 0.3)
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 2.2 end)
elseif ev == "run" then
S.flash = 1
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 16 t.pulse = 1 t.prism = 1 end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "hit", 1.3)
elseif ev == "unknown" then
S.shake = 1
each(function(t)
t.yawVel = t.yawVel - 12
if not t.flipT then t.flipT = 0 end
end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "release", 0.8)
end
end
local UhCollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UH_TAG_ACCENT = "UhAdmin_Accent"
local UH_TAG_BG = "UhAdmin_BG"
local UH_TAG_TEXT = "UhAdmin_Text"
local function uhTag(obj, kind)
local tagName = (kind == "accent" and UH_TAG_ACCENT) or (kind == "bg" and UH_TAG_BG) or UH_TAG_TEXT
UhCollectionService:AddTag(obj, tagName)
end
do
local uhThemeLast, uhLastA, uhLastB, uhLastT, uhLastN, uhFullAt = 0, nil, nil, nil, -1, 0
local uhTagLists, uhIsStroke = {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function uhQualAccent(o)
if o:IsA("UIStroke") then uhIsStroke[o] = true return true end
return o:IsA("GuiObject")
end
local function uhQualGui(o) return o:IsA("GuiObject") end
local function uhQualText(o) return o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") end
local function uhTagList(tag, qualifies)
local c = uhTagLists[tag]
if c then return c end
c = {n = 0, arr = {}, idx = {}}
uhTagLists[tag] = c
local function add(o)
if c.idx[o] or not qualifies(o) then return end
local n = c.n + 1
c.n, c.arr[n], c.idx[o] = n, o, n
end
UhCollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(add)
UhCollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(function(o)
local at = c.idx[o]
if not at then return end
local n = c.n
local last = c.arr[n]
c.arr[at], c.idx[last] = last, at
c.arr[n], c.idx[o], c.n = nil, nil, n - 1
end)
for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do add(o) end
return c
end
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local now = os.clock()
if now - uhThemeLast < 0.1 then return end
uhThemeLast = now
local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
local accent, bg, textCol = Util.UhAdmin.Theme(now)
if cfg and cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then
accent = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or accent
end
local uhSig = uhTagList(UH_TAG_ACCENT, uhQualAccent).n + uhTagList(UH_TAG_BG, uhQualGui).n + uhTagList(UH_TAG_TEXT, uhQualText).n
if accent == uhLastA and bg == uhLastB and textCol == uhLastT and uhSig == uhLastN and now - uhFullAt < 0.4 then return end
uhLastA, uhLastB, uhLastT, uhLastN, uhFullAt = accent, bg, textCol, uhSig, now
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_ACCENT, uhQualAccent)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do
local o = arr[n]
if uhIsStroke[o] then o.Color = accent else o.BackgroundColor3 = accent end
end
end
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_BG, uhQualGui)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do arr[n].BackgroundColor3 = bg end
end
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_TEXT, uhQualText)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do arr[n].TextColor3 = textCol end
end
end)
end
local function uhNew(class, props, parent)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end

local function fade(show, t)
local info = ti(t or 0.3)
for k, it in ipairs(items) do
local function go() if dc.Parent then TS:Create(it[1], info, show and it[2] or it[3]):Play() end end
if show then task.delay((k - 1) * 0.05, go) else go() end
end
end
local function slideFade(i, show, base, t)
local info = ti(t or 0.35)
for k, it in ipairs(slides[i]) do
local function go()
if closed and show then return end
if not dc.Parent then return end
if show and it[4] then
it[1].Position = it[4] + UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0)
TS:Create(it[1], ti(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint), {Position = it[4]}):Play()
end
TS:Create(it[1], info, show and it[2] or it[3]):Play()
end
if show then task.delay(base + (k - 1) * 0.07, go) else go() end
end
end
local function fillRun(i, dur)
local tw = TS:Create(pills[i][2], TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
tweens[#tweens + 1] = tw
tw:Play()
end
local function goTo(i)
if closed or i == cur then return end
local prev = cur
cur = i
slideFade(prev, false, 0, 0.25)
TS:Create(track, ti(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-(i - 1) * VW, 0)}):Play()
slideFade(i, true, 0.3)
for k, p in ipairs(pills) do
TS:Create(p[1], ti(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(k == i and 34 or 14, 6)}):Play()
end
fillRun(i, 20)
end
local function dcHide()
if closed or not dc.Parent then return end
closed = true
local me = coroutine.running()
if mainT and mainT ~= me then pcall(task.cancel, mainT) end
if slideT and slideT ~= me then pcall(task.cancel, slideT) end
if artT and artT ~= me then pcall(task.cancel, artT) end
for _, tw in ipairs(tweens) do pcall(function() tw:Cancel() end) end
fade(false, 0.15)
slideFade(cur, false, 0, 0.15)
task.wait(0.12)
TS:Create(dc, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 126, 0, 34)}):Play()

task.wait(0.4)
dc:Destroy()
end

local bringc = {}
commandcount = 0
cmd = {}
cmd._lastError = nil
cmd._conflicts = {}
cmd._rejected = {}
cmd._lastAdd = 0
cmd._pending = false
cmd._refresh = function()
cmd._lastAdd = os.clock()
if cmd._pending then return end
local okG, G = pcall(function() return gui end)
if not okG or type(G) ~= "table" or type(G.loadCommands) ~= "function" then return end
cmd._pending = true
task.spawn(function()
while os.clock() - cmd._lastAdd < 0.5 do task.wait(0.25) end
cmd._pending = false
local okH, H = pcall(function() return gui end)
if okH and type(H) == "table" and type(H.loadCommands) == "function" then pcall(H.loadCommands) end
end)
end
cmd.add = function(...)
local vars = {...}
local aliases, info, func = vars[1], vars[2], vars[3]
if type(aliases) ~= "table" or type(func) ~= "function" then
cmd._rejected[#cmd._rejected + 1] = tostring(type(aliases) == "table" and aliases[1] or aliases)
return false
end
local primary = aliases[1]
if type(primary) ~= "string" or primary == "" then return false end
if Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked(aliases) then
cmd._blocked = cmd._blocked or {}
for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do cmd._blocked[tostring(n):lower()] = true end
return false
end
local meta = {}
if type(info) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(info) do meta[k] = v end end
meta[1] = tostring(meta[1] or primary)
meta[2] = tostring(meta[2] or "")
primary = primary:lower()
local old = Commands[primary]
local registration = {func, meta, aliases = {}}
local claim = {}
for i = 2, #aliases do
local a = aliases[i]
if type(a) == "string" and a ~= "" then claim[a:lower()] = true end
end
local carry = {}
if old then
for _, a in ipairs(old.aliases or {}) do
if Aliases[a] == old then
if claim[a] then Aliases[a] = nil
elseif old.proxy then carry[#carry + 1] = a
else Aliases[a] = nil end
end
end
else
commandcount = commandcount + 1
end
Commands[primary] = registration
local shadowed = Aliases[primary]
if shadowed and shadowed ~= registration then
Aliases[primary] = nil
if shadowed.aliases then
for i = #shadowed.aliases, 1, -1 do
if shadowed.aliases[i] == primary then table.remove(shadowed.aliases, i) end
end
end
end
local function take(alias)
if alias == primary then return false end
if Commands[alias] and Commands[alias] ~= registration then
cmd._conflicts[alias] = primary
return false
end
local holder = Aliases[alias]
if holder and holder ~= registration then
if not holder.proxy and holder ~= old then
cmd._conflicts[alias] = primary
return false
end
if holder.aliases then
for i = #holder.aliases, 1, -1 do
if holder.aliases[i] == alias then table.remove(holder.aliases, i) end
end
end
end
Aliases[alias] = registration
registration.aliases[#registration.aliases + 1] = alias
return true
end
for i = 2, #aliases do
local alias = aliases[i]
if type(alias) == "string" and alias ~= "" then take(alias:lower()) end
end
for _, a in ipairs(carry) do take(a) end
cmd._refresh()
return true
end
cmd.has = function(name)
name = tostring(name or ""):lower()
return Commands[name] ~= nil or Aliases[name] ~= nil
end
cmd.list = function()
local names = {}
for name in pairs(Commands) do names[#names + 1] = name end
table.sort(names)
local out = {}
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
local reg = Commands[name]
out[#out + 1] = {name = name, usage = reg[2][1], description = reg[2][2], aliases = reg.aliases or {}, proxy = reg.proxy == true}
end
return out
end
cmd.run = function(args)
cmd._lastError = nil
if type(args) ~= "table" then cmd._lastError = "Invalid command arguments"; return false, cmd._lastError end
local caller = type(args[1]) == "string" and args[1]:lower() or nil
if not caller or caller == "" then cmd._lastError = "No command specified"; return false, cmd._lastError end
local registration = Commands[caller] or Aliases[caller]
if not registration then
local na = Util.UhAdmin and Util.UhAdmin.NA
local blocked = cmd._blocked and cmd._blocked[caller]
if na and not blocked and type(na.Has) == "function" and type(na.Run) == "function" and not Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked({caller}) and na.Has(caller) then
local rest = {}
for i = 2, #args do rest[#rest + 1] = args[i] end
na.Run((type(na.Resolve) == "function" and na.Resolve(caller)) or caller, rest)
return true
end
cmd._lastError = blocked and ("Command is disabled: " .. tostring(args[1])) or ("Unknown command: " .. tostring(args[1]))
return false, cmd._lastError
end
if type(registration[1]) ~= "function" then cmd._lastError = "Command has no handler: " .. tostring(args[1]); return false, cmd._lastError end
local arguments = {}
for i = 2, #args do arguments[#arguments + 1] = args[i] end
local success, err = _native_pcall(function() registration[1](table.unpack(arguments)) end)
if not success then cmd._lastError = tostring(err); return false, cmd._lastError end
return true
end
Util.UhCmd = {cmds = Commands, aliases = Aliases, run = cmd.run, list = cmd.list, has = cmd.has}

local wait = function(int)
if not int then int = 0 end
local t = tick()
repeat
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(0)
until (tick() - t) >= int
return (tick() - t), t
end

local getPlr = function(Name)
if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
local query = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
local players = Players:GetPlayers()
if query == "random" then if #players == 0 then return nil end; return players[math.random(1, #players)] end
if query == "" then return nil end
local prefixMatch, containsMatch
for _, x in ipairs(players) do
local user = x.Name:lower()
local display = x.DisplayName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
if user == query or display == query then return x end
if not prefixMatch and (user:sub(1, #query) == query or display:sub(1, #query) == query) then prefixMatch = x end
if not containsMatch and user:find(query, 1, true) then containsMatch = x end
end
return prefixMatch or containsMatch
end

local function apply(root, hum)
local bg = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyGyro") or Instance.new("BodyGyro")
bg.Name = "UHAdminFlyGyro"
bg.P = 100000
bg.D = 1000
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
bg.Parent = root
local bv = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyVelocity") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.Name = "UHAdminFlyVelocity"
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
bv.P = 10000
bv.Parent = root
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local cf = camera and camera.CFrame or root.CFrame
local move = Vector3.zero
move = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then move = move.Unit else move = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
if right.Magnitude > 0.001 then right = right.Unit else right = Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
move = move * (keyboardControl.F + keyboardControl.B)
+ right * (keyboardControl.R + keyboardControl.L)
+ Vector3.new(0, keyboardControl.Q + keyboardControl.E, 0)
if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
bv.Velocity = move.Unit * activeSpeed
else
bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
end
local flatLook = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
flatLook = flatLook.Unit
else
flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
end
bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook, Vector3.yAxis)
hum.AutoRotate = false
if not vfly then
hum.PlatformStand = true
else
hum.PlatformStand = false
end
end

local char, hum, root = getChar()
if char and hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
apply(root, hum)
end
end)

if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
if root then apply(root, hum) end
return true
end

lib.find = function(t, v)
for i, e in pairs(t) do
if i == v or e == v then
return i
end
end
return nil
end
lib.parseText = function(text, watch)
local parsed = {}
if type(text) ~= "string" then return parsed end
local delimiter = tostring(watch or " ")
if delimiter == "" then return {text} end
local token, quote, escape = {}, nil, false
local function push() if #token > 0 then parsed[#parsed + 1] = table.concat(token); token = {} end end
for i=1,#text do
local ch=text:sub(i,i)
if escape then token[#token+1]=ch; escape=false
elseif ch=="\\" and quote then escape=true
elseif quote then if ch==quote then quote=nil else token[#token+1]=ch end
elseif ch=="'" or ch=='"' then quote=ch
elseif delimiter==opt.prefix and ch==delimiter then push()
elseif delimiter==opt.tupleSeparator and ch==delimiter then push()
elseif delimiter==" " and ch:match("%s") then push()
else token[#token+1]=ch end
end
push(); return parsed
end
lib.parseCommand = function(text, requirePrefix)
if type(text) ~= "string" then return false end
local prefix=tostring(opt.prefix or ".")
if prefix == "" then prefix = "." end
local source=text
if requirePrefix and source:sub(1,#prefix) ~= prefix then return false end
while source:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix do source=source:sub(#prefix+1) end
if source:match("^%s*$") then return false end
local segments,current,quote={}, {}, nil
for i=1,#source do
local ch=source:sub(i,i)
if ch=="'" or ch=='"' then if quote==ch then quote=nil elseif not quote then quote=ch end; current[#current+1]=ch
elseif ch==";" and not quote then segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current); current={}
else current[#current+1]=ch end
end
segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current)
local ran=false
for _,segment in ipairs(segments) do
local args=lib.parseText(segment," ")
if #args>0 then local ok,err=cmd.run(args); if ok then ran=true else Util.Notify("Command failed: "..tostring(err)) end end
end
return ran
end

end
lib.disconnect = function(name)
for title, connection in pairs(connections) do

connection:Disconnect()
end
end
end

argument = {}
argument.getPlayers = function(str)
local playerNames, players = lib.parseText(str, opt.tupleSeparator), {}
for _, arg in pairs(playerNames or {"me"}) do
arg = arg:lower()
local playerList = Players:GetPlayers()
if arg == "me" or arg == nil then
table.insert(players, localPlayer)
elseif arg == "all" then
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
table.insert(players, plr)
end
elseif arg == "others" then
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
if plr ~= localPlayer then
table.insert(players, plr)
end
end
elseif arg == "random" then
if #playerList > 0 then table.insert(players, playerList[math.random(1,#playerList)]) end
elseif arg:find("%%") == 1 then
local teamName = arg:sub(2)
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
local team=plr.Team
if team and tostring(team.Name):lower():find(teamName,1,true)==1 then
table.insert(players, plr)
end
end
else
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
if plr.Name:lower():find(arg) == 1 or (plr.DisplayName and plr.DisplayName:lower():find(arg) == 1) or (tostring(plr.UserId):lower():find(arg) == 1) then
table.insert(players, plr)
end
end
end
end
return players
end

local function SaveAdminPrefix(value)
local PrefixChange = tostring(value or "")
PrefixChange = PrefixChange:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if PrefixChange == "" or PrefixChange == "p" or PrefixChange == "[" or PrefixChange == "P" then return false end
opt.prefix = PrefixChange
if FileSupport then
pcall(function()
if isfile(NA_PREFIX_FILE) and delfile then delfile(NA_PREFIX_FILE) end
writefile(NA_PREFIX_FILE, PrefixChange)
end)
end
return true
end

bodyGyro.P = Power
bodyGyro.D = Damping
local x = math.sin(Rotation + angle * (i-1)) * Offset
local z = math.cos(Rotation + angle * (i-1)) * Offset
bodyPosition.Position = TargetPos + Vector3.new(x, Height, z)
end
end
local function myCoroutine()
while task.wait() do
Rotation = Rotation + (Speed / 20)
if Rotation >= math.pi * 2 then
Rotation = 0
end
for i, hat in ipairs(hats) do
local handle = hat.Handle
local x = math.sin(Rotation + angle * (i-1)) * Offset
local z = math.cos(Rotation + angle * (i-1)) * Offset
handle.BodyPosition.P = Power
handle.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
handle.Massless = true
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
handle.BodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(handle.Position + Vector3.new(0, handle.Position.Y, 0), Root.Position)
if NormalSpin == true then
handle.BodyPosition.Position = TargetPos + Vector3.new(x + Target.Humanoid.MoveDirection.X, Height, z + Target.Humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
end
if EditingPos == false then
TargetPos = Target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position
end
end
end
end
local myWrappedCoroutine = coroutine.wrap(myCoroutine)
myWrappedCoroutine()
end
function Mode2()

local Angle = math.pi * 2 / #hats
function Loop()
if Mode == 2 then
local RootOrientation = Target.Humanoid.RootPart.CFrame - Target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position
local RootRotation = RootOrientation
for i, Hat in ipairs(hats) do
local HatRotation = RootRotation.Y + Angle * (i - 1) + Speed * tick()
local x = math.sin(HatRotation) * Offset
local z = math.cos(HatRotation) * Offset
local HatPos = TargetPos + RootOrientation * Vector3.new(x, z, -Height)
Hat.Handle.BodyPosition.Position = HatPos
end

Loop()
end
end
Loop()
for i, Hat in ipairs(hats) do
local Handle = Hat.Handle
Hat.Handle.BodyPosition.Position = TargetPos
end
end

function Mode5 ()
local spiralPitch = 0
local spiralAngle = 0
function Loop ()
if Mode == 5 then
spiralAngle = spiralAngle + Speed / 300
if spiralAngle >= math.pi * 10 then
spiralAngle = 0
end
for i, hat in ipairs(hats) do
local handle = hat.Handle
if handle then
local x = math.sin(spiralAngle + i * spiralPitch) * (i * Offset / 8)
local y = i * (Height / 3)
local z = math.cos(spiralAngle + i * spiralPitch) * (i * Offset / 8)
handle.BodyPosition.Position = TargetPos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0) + Vector3.new(x, y, z)
end
end
end
spiralPitch += Speed / 70
task.wait()
Loop()
end
Loop()
end

local SkidFling = function(TargetPlayer)
local Character = Player.Character
local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local RootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart
local TCharacter = TargetPlayer.Character
local THumanoid
local TRootPart
local THead
local Accessory
local Handle
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
THumanoid = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
if THumanoid and THumanoid.RootPart then
TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") then
THead = TCharacter.Head
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory") then
Accessory = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
end
if Accessoy and Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
Handle = Accessory.Handle
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
if RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
getgenv().OldPos = RootPart.CFrame
end
if THumanoid and THumanoid.Sit and not AllBool then
end
if THead then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THead
elseif not THead and Handle then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Handle
elseif THumanoid and TRootPart then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THumanoid
end
if not TCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
return
end
local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
end
local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
local TimeToWait = 2
local Time = tick()
local Angle = 0
repeat
if RootPart and THumanoid then
if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
Angle = Angle + 100

local WalkFling = {Enabled = false, Running = false}
Util.UhAdmin.WalkFling = WalkFling
local function setWalkFling(enabled)
WalkFling.Enabled = enabled and true or false
if not WalkFling.Enabled or WalkFling.Running then return end
WalkFling.Running = true
task.spawn(function()
local movel = 0.1
while WalkFling.Enabled do
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
if not WalkFling.Enabled then break end
local c = Player.Character
local hrp = c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
local vel = hrp.Velocity
hrp.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
if WalkFling.Enabled and c.Parent and hrp.Parent then
hrp.Velocity = vel
end
RunService.Stepped:Wait()
if WalkFling.Enabled and c.Parent and hrp.Parent then
hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
movel = movel * -1
end
end
end
WalkFling.Running = false
end)
end

cf = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame

local abort = 0
local function getTools(amt)
if not amt then amt = 1 end
local toolAmount, grabbed = 0, {}
local lastCF = character.PrimaryPart.CFrame
local ab = abort
for i, v in pairs(localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):GetChildren()) do
if v:IsA("BackpackItem") then
toolAmount = toolAmount + 1
end
end
if toolAmount >= amt then return localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):GetChildren() end
if not localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BackpackItem") then return end
repeat
repeat wait() until localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack") or ab ~= abort
backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
wrap(function()
repeat wait() until backpack:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BackpackItem")
for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
if #grabbed >= amt or ab ~= abort then break end
if tool:IsA("BackpackItem") then
tool.Parent = localPlayer
table.insert(grabbed, tool)
end
end
end)
respawn()
wait(.1)
until
#grabbed >= amt or ab ~= abort
repeat wait() until localPlayer.Character and tostring(localPlayer.Character) ~= "respawn_" and localPlayer.Character == character
wait(.2)
repeat wait() until localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack") or ab ~= abort
local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
for _, tool in pairs(grabbed) do
if tool:IsA("BackpackItem") then
tool.Parent = backpack
end
end
wrap(function()
repeat wait() until character.PrimaryPart
wait(.2)
character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(lastCF)
end)
wait(.2)
return grabbed
end

local decalsyeeted = true
local g = game
local w = g.Workspace
local l = g.Lighting
local t = w.Terrain
sethiddenproperty(l,"Technology",2)
sethiddenproperty(t,"Decoration",false)
t.WaterWaveSize = 0
t.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
t.WaterReflectance = 0
t.WaterTransparency = 0
l.GlobalShadows = 0
l.FogEnd = 9e9
l.Brightness = 0
settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = "Level01"
for i, v in pairs(w:GetDescendants()) do
if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:IsA("MeshPart") then
v.Material = "Plastic"
v.Reflectance = 0
elseif (v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture")) and decalsyeeted then
v.Transparency = 1
elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") then
v.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
elseif v:IsA("Explosion") then
v.BlastPressure = 1
v.BlastRadius = 1
elseif v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("SpotLight") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then
v.Enabled = false
elseif v:IsA("MeshPart") and decalsyeeted then
v.Material = "Plastic"
v.Reflectance = 0
v.TextureID = 10385902758728957
elseif v:IsA("SpecialMesh") and decalsyeeted then
v.TextureId=0
elseif v:IsA("ShirtGraphic") and decalsyeeted then
v.Graphic=0
elseif (v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants")) and decalsyeeted then
v[v.ClassName.."Template"]=0
end
end
for i = 1,#l:GetChildren() do
e=l:GetChildren()[i]
if e:IsA("BlurEffect") or e:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or e:IsA("BloomEffect") or e:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
e.Enabled = false
end
end

end

cmd.add({"cartornado", "ctornado"}, {"cartornado (ctornado)", "Tornados a car just sit in the car"}, function(...)
local SPart = Instance.new("Part");
local Player = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer;
repeat game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped:Wait() until Player.Character;
local Character = Player.Character;
SPart.Anchored, SPart.CanCollide = true, true;
SPart.Parent = workspace;
SPart.Size = Vector3.new(1, 100, 1)
SPart.Transparency = 0.4
game:GetService('RunService').Stepped:Connect(function()
local Ray = Ray.new(Character.PrimaryPart.Position + Character.PrimaryPart.CFrame.LookVector * 6, Vector3.new(0,-1,0) * 4);
local FPOR = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(Ray, {Character});
if (FPOR) then
SPart.CFrame = Character.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Character.PrimaryPart.CFrame.LookVector * 6;
end
if SPart == nil then
Ray:destroy()
FPOR:destroy()
end
end)
SPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
if hit:IsA("Seat") then
local IsFlying = false
local flyv
local flyg
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Speed = 50
local LastSpeed = Speed
local maxspeed = 100
local IsRunning = false
local f = 0
IsFlying = true
flyv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
flyv.Parent = Player.Character:FindFirstChild('Torso') or Player.Character:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso')
flyv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge)
flyg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
flyg.Parent = Player.Character:FindFirstChild('Torso') or Player.Character:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso')
flyg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
flyg.P = 1000
flyg.D = 50
Player.Character:WaitForChild('Humanoid').PlatformStand = true
Player.Character.Humanoid.Changed:Connect(function(Prop)
if Player.Character.Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0,0,0) then
IsRunning = false
else
IsRunning = true
end
end)
spawn(function()
while true do
wait()
if IsFlying then
flyg.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CoordinateFrame * CFrame.Angles(-math.rad((f+0)*50*Speed/maxspeed),0,0)
flyv.Velocity = workspace.CurrentCamera.CoordinateFrame.LookVector * Speed
wait(0.1)
if Speed < 0 then
Speed = 0
f = 0
end
end
if IsRunning then
Speed = LastSpeed
else
if not Speed == 0 then
LastSpeed = Speed
end
Speed = 0
end
end
end)
Speed = 0.1
wait(0.3)
hit:Sit(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid)

end
end

cmd.add({"hamster"}, {"hamster <speed>", "Hamster ball"}, function(...)
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local SPEED_MULTIPLIER = (...)
local JUMP_POWER = 60
local JUMP_GAP = 0.3
if (...) == nil then
SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 30
end
local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
for i,v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
v.CanCollide = false
end
end
local ball = character.HumanoidRootPart
ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
ball.Size = Vector3.new(5,5,5)
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
local tc = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
ball.CanCollide = true
humanoid.PlatformStand = true
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("W") then
ball.RotVelocity -= Camera.CFrame.RightVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("A") then
ball.RotVelocity -= Camera.CFrame.LookVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("S") then
ball.RotVelocity += Camera.CFrame.RightVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("D") then
ball.RotVelocity += Camera.CFrame.LookVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
end)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
local result = workspace:Raycast(
ball.Position,
Vector3.new(
0,
-((ball.Size.Y/2)+JUMP_GAP),
0
),
params
)
if result then
ball.Velocity = ball.Velocity + Vector3.new(0,JUMP_POWER,0)
end
end)
Camera.CameraSubject = ball
humanoid.Died:Connect(function() tc:Disconnect() end)
end)

local function uhKillHumanoids(list)

pcall(function() lp.MaximumSimulationRadius = 1e9 end)

local t0 = os.clock()
repeat
for _, hum in ipairs(list) do
if hum.Parent then
pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true) end)
pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end)
pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) end)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, hum, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead.Value)
end
end
rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
until os.clock() - t0 > 5
end)
end

end

end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
ismobile = uis.TouchEnabled
local MAX_LENGTH = 900000
local active = false
local ENABLED_OFFSET = CFrame.new(1.7, 0, 0)
local DISABLED_OFFSET = CFrame.new(-1.7, 0, 0)
local function UpdateAutoRotate(BOOL)
humanoid.AutoRotate = BOOL
end
local function GetUpdatedCameraCFrame(ROOT, CAMERA)
return CFrame.new(root.Position, Vector3.new(CAMERA.CFrame.LookVector.X * MAX_LENGTH, root.Position.Y, CAMERA.CFrame.LookVector.Z * MAX_LENGTH))
end
local function EnableShiftlock()
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
UpdateAutoRotate(false)
root.CFrame = GetUpdatedCameraCFrame(root, camera)
camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * ENABLED_OFFSET
end
local function DisableShiftlock()
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
UpdateAutoRotate(true)
camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * DISABLED_OFFSET
pcall(function()
active:Disconnect()
active = nil
end)
end
active = false
function ShiftLock()
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
if not active then
active = runservice.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
EnableShiftlock()
end)
else
DisableShiftlock()
end
end

end

end

currentInfo = nil

elseif type(k) == "nil" then

elseif type(k) == "number" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
else
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()

end

end

end

end)

end

local function KVVJTK_fake_script()
local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', FakeTitle)
local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local frame = script.Parent.Parent
local dragToggle = nil
local dragSpeed = 0.25
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil
local function updateInput(input)
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
end
table.insert(_G.functionspy.connections, frame.Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
dragToggle = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = frame.Position
input.Changed:Connect(function()
if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
dragToggle = false
end
end)
end
end))
table.insert(_G.functionspy.connections, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragToggle then
updateInput(input)
end
end
end))
end

cmd.add({"freecam", "fc", "fcam"}, {"freecam [speed] (fc, fcam)", "Enable free camera"}, function(speed)
if not speed then speed = 5 end
if connections["freecam"] then lib.disconnect("freecam") camera.CameraSubject = character wrap(function() character.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false end) end
local dir = {w = false, a = false, s = false, d = false}
local cf = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
local camPart = Instance.new("Part")
camPart.Transparency = 1
camPart.Anchored = true
camPart.CFrame = camera.CFrame
wrap(function()
character.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
end)
lib.connect("freecam", RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local primaryPart = camPart
camera.CameraSubject = primaryPart
local x, y, z = 0, 0, 0
if dir.w then z = -1 * speed end
if dir.a then x = -1 * speed end
if dir.s then z = 1 * speed end
if dir.d then x = 1 * speed end
if dir.q then y = 1 * speed end
if dir.e then y = -1 * speed end
primaryPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(
primaryPart.CFrame.p,
(camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -100)).p
)
local moveDir = CFrame.new(x,y,z)
cf.Value = cf.Value:lerp(moveDir, 0.2)
primaryPart.CFrame = primaryPart.CFrame:lerp(primaryPart.CFrame * cf.Value, 0.2)
end))

if event then return end

if code == codes.W then
dir.w = true
elseif code == codes.A then
dir.a = true
elseif code == codes.S then
dir.s = true
elseif code == codes.D then
dir.d = true
elseif code == codes.Q then
dir.q = true
elseif code == codes.E then
dir.e = true
elseif code == codes.Space then
dir.q = true
end
end))

if event then return end
local code, codes = input.KeyCode, Enum.KeyCode
if code == codes.W then
dir.w = false
elseif code == codes.A then
dir.a = false
elseif code == codes.S then
dir.s = false
elseif code == codes.D then
dir.d = false
elseif code == codes.Q then
dir.q = false
elseif code == codes.E then
dir.e = false
elseif code == codes.Space then
dir.q = false
end
end))

local function getAllTools()
local tools = {}
local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
if backpack then
for i, v in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
if v:IsA("Tool") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
for i, v in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if v:IsA("Tool") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
return tools
end

lib.disconnect("cm")
if backpack and character.Parent then
local tools = getAllTools()
for i, tool in pairs(tools) do
local cpos, g = (math.pi*2)*(i/#tools), CFrame.new()
local tcon = {}
tool.Parent = backpack
if mode == "a" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(0, 0, size)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos)
)
elseif mode == "b" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(i - #tools/2, 0, 0)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, 0)
)
elseif mode == "c" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(cpos/3, 0, 0)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos*2)
)
elseif mode == "d" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(clamp(tan(cpos), -3, 3), 0, 0)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos)
)
elseif mode == "e" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(0, 0, clamp(tan(cpos), -5, 5))*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos)
)
end
tool.Grip = g
tool.Parent = character
tcon[#tcon] = lib.connect("cm", mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
tool:Activate()
end))
tcon[#tcon] = lib.connect("cm", tool.Changed:Connect(function(p)
if p == "Grip" and tool.Grip ~= g then
tool.Grip = g
end
end))
lib.connect("cm", tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
for i = 1, #tcon do
tcon[i]:Disconnect()
end
end))
end
end
end)

AgentHeight = 5,
AgentCanJump = true
})

for i, waypoint in pairs(waypoints) do
if i > 2 then break end

hum.Jump = true

hum:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)

break
end
end
end
end
end
debounce = false
end))

cmd.add({"loopfling"}, {"loopfling <player>", "Loop voids a player"}, function(plr)
local Targets = {plr}
Loopvoid = true
repeat wait()
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local AllBool = false
local GetPlayer = function(Name)
Name = Name:lower()
if Name == "all" or Name == "others" then
AllBool = true
return
elseif Name == "random" then
local GetPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
if table.find(GetPlayers,Player) then table.remove(GetPlayers,table.find(GetPlayers,Player)) end
return GetPlayers[math.random(#GetPlayers)]
elseif Name ~= "random" and Name ~= "all" and Name ~= "others" then
for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
if x ~= Player then
if x.Name:lower():match("^"..Name) then
return x;
elseif x.DisplayName:lower():match("^"..Name) then
return x;
end
end
end
else
return
end
end
local Message = function(_Title, _Text, Time)
end
local SkidFling = function(TargetPlayer)
local Character = Player.Character
local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local RootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart
local TCharacter = TargetPlayer.Character
local THumanoid
local TRootPart
local THead
local Accessory
local Handle
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
THumanoid = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
if THumanoid and THumanoid.RootPart then
TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") then
THead = TCharacter.Head
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory") then
Accessory = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
end
if Accessoy and Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
Handle = Accessory.Handle
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
if RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
getgenv().OldPos = RootPart.CFrame
end
if THumanoid and THumanoid.Sit and not AllBool then
return Message("Error Occurred", "Targeting is sitting", 5)
end
if THead then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THead
elseif not THead and Handle then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Handle
elseif THumanoid and TRootPart then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THumanoid
end
if not TCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
return
end
local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
end
local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
local TimeToWait = 2
local Time = tick()
local Angle = 0
repeat
if RootPart and THumanoid then
if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
Angle = Angle + 100
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle),0 ,0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
else
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5 ,0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
end
else
break
end
until BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 or BasePart.Parent ~= TargetPlayer.Character or TargetPlayer.Parent ~= Players or not TargetPlayer.Character == TCharacter or THumanoid.Sit or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or tick() > Time + TimeToWait
end
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
BV.Name = "EpixVel"
BV.Parent = RootPart
BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
if TRootPart and THead then
if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - THead.CFrame.p).Magnitude > 5 then
SFBasePart(THead)
else
SFBasePart(TRootPart)
end
elseif TRootPart and not THead then
SFBasePart(TRootPart)
elseif not TRootPart and THead then
SFBasePart(THead)
elseif not TRootPart and not THead and Accessory and Handle then
SFBasePart(Handle)
else
return Message("Error Occurred", "Target is missing everything", 5)
end
BV:Destroy()
Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Humanoid
repeat
RootPart.CFrame = getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, .5, 0)
Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, .5, 0))
Humanoid:ChangeState("GettingUp")
table.foreach(Character:GetChildren(), function(_, x)
if x:IsA("BasePart") then
x.Velocity, x.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(), Vector3.new()
end
end)
task.wait()
until (RootPart.Position - getgenv().OldPos.p).Magnitude < 25
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = getgenv().FPDH
else
return Message("Error Occurred", "Random error", 5)
end
end
if not Welcome then Message("Script by AnthonyIsntHere", "Enjoy!", 5) end
getgenv().Welcome = true
if Targets[1] then for _,x in next, Targets do GetPlayer(x) end else return end
if AllBool then
for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
SkidFling(x)
end
end
for _,x in next, Targets do
if GetPlayer(x) and GetPlayer(x) ~= Player then
if GetPlayer(x).UserId ~= 1414978355 then
local TPlayer = GetPlayer(x)
if TPlayer then
SkidFling(TPlayer)
end
else
Message("Error Occurred", "This user is whitelisted! (Owner)", 5)
end
elseif not GetPlayer(x) and not AllBool then
Message("Error Occurred", "Username Invalid", 5)
end
end
until Loopvoid == false
end)

local mt = getrawmetatable(game);
local old = mt.__namecall
local readonly = setreadonly or make_writeable
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService");
readonly(mt, false);
mt.__namecall = function(self, ...)
local args = {...}
local method = table.remove(args)
if (self == MarketplaceService and method:find("UserOwnsGamePassAsync")) then
return true and 1
end
return old(self, ...)
end

cmd.add({"antivoid"}, {"antivoid", "Anti void."}, function()
getgenv().AntiVoid = true
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local function toolMatch(Handle)
local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
for i = 1, #allPlayers do
local Player = allPlayers[i]
if (Player == LocalPlayer) then continue end
local Character = Player.Character
local RightArm = Character:WaitForChild("Right Arm")
local RightGrip = RightArm:FindFirstChild("RightGrip")
if (RightGrip and RightGrip.Part1 == Handle) then
return Player
end
end
end
local function onCharacter(Character)
local RightArm = Character:WaitForChild("Right Arm")
RightArm.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
if (child:IsA("Weld") and child.Name == "RightGrip" and getgenv().AntiVoid) then
local ConnectedHandle = child.Part1
local matched = toolMatch(ConnectedHandle)
if (matched) then
ConnectedHandle.Parent:Destroy()
print(matched, "just tried to void you lol!")
end
end
end)
end
onCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
end)

local function Kill()
if not getPlr(Target) then
end
repeat game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait() until getPlr(Target).Character and getPlr(Target).Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and getPlr(Target).Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0
local Character
local Humanoid
local RootPart
local Tool
local Handle
local TPlayer = getPlr(Target)
local TCharacter = TPlayer.Character
local THumanoid
local TRootPart
if Player.Character and Player.Character and Player.Character.Name == Player.Name then
Character = Player.Character
else
end
if Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
else
end
if Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart then
RootPart = Humanoid.RootPart
else
end
if Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
Tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
elseif Player.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") and Humanoid then
Tool = Player.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
Humanoid:EquipTool(Player.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool"))
else
end
if Tool and Tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
Handle = Tool.Handle
else
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
THumanoid = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
else
return Message("Error",">   Missing Target Humanoid")
end
if THumanoid.RootPart then
TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
else
return Message("Error",">   Missing Target RootPart")
end
if THumanoid.Sit then
return Message("Error",">   Target is seated")
end
local OldCFrame = RootPart.CFrame
Humanoid:Destroy()
local NewHumanoid = Humanoid:Clone()
NewHumanoid.Parent = Character
NewHumanoid:UnequipTools()
NewHumanoid:EquipTool(Tool)
Tool.Parent = workspace
local Timer = os.time()
repeat
if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - RootPart.CFrame.p).Magnitude < 500 then
Tool.Grip = CFrame.new()
Tool.Grip = Handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(TRootPart.CFrame):Inverse()
end
firetouchinterest(Handle,TRootPart,0)
firetouchinterest(Handle,TRootPart,1)
game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
until Tool.Parent ~= Character or not TPlayer or not TRootPart or THumanoid.Health <= 0 or os.time() > Timer + .20
Player.Character = nil
NewHumanoid.Health = 0
player.CharacterAdded:wait(1)
repeat game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait() until Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = OldCFrame
end
if not LoopKill then
Kill()
else
while LoopKill do
Kill()
end
end
end
until loopkill == false
end)

local hiddenGUIS = {}
cmd.add({"hideguis"}, {"hideguis", "Hides guis"}, function()
function FindInTable(tbl,val)
if tbl == nil then return false end
for _,v in pairs(tbl) do
if v == val then return true end
end
return false
end
for i,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("PlayerGui"):GetDescendants()) do
if (v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ImageLabel") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) and v.Visible then
v.Visible = false
if not FindInTable(hiddenGUIS,v) then
table.insert(hiddenGUIS,v)
end
end
end
end)

v.Visible = true
end

end)

local function ForcePart(v)
if v:IsA("Part") and v.Anchored == false and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") == nil and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") == nil and v.Name ~= "Handle" then
Mouse.TargetFilter = v
for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") then
x:Destroy()
end
end
if v:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
v:FindFirstChild("Attachment"):Destroy()
end
if v:FindFirstChild("AlignPosition") then
v:FindFirstChild("AlignPosition"):Destroy()
end
if v:FindFirstChild("Torque") then
v:FindFirstChild("Torque"):Destroy()
end
v.CanCollide = false
local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9999999999999999
AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = math.huge
AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 200
AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
end
end
for _, v in next, game:GetService("Workspace"):GetDescendants() do
ForcePart(v)
end
game:GetService("Workspace").DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
ForcePart(v)
end)

end
