local function tweenMusic(toPos, show, hideAfter)
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	if musicState.tween then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.tween:Cancel()
		end)
		musicState.tween = nil
	end
	if show then
		musicState.frame.Visible = true
	end
	if TS then
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.frame.Position
		musicState.tween =
			TS:Create(musicState.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = toPos,
			})
		if hideAfter then
			con(musicState.tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if musicState.frame then
					musicState.frame.Visible = false
				end
			end))
		end
		musicState.tween:Play()
	else
		musicState.frame.Position = toPos
		if hideAfter then
			musicState.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function openMusic()
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	musicState.activeTab = "Music"
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p ~= musicState.frame then
			p.Visible = false
		end
	end
	musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
	tweenMusic(musicState.openPos, true, false)
	task.defer(function()
		syncTabColors("Music")
	end)
end

local function closeMusic(anim)
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	if not musicState.frame.Visible then
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
		return
	end
	if anim then
		tweenMusic(musicState.closedPos, false, true)
	else
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
		musicState.frame.Visible = false
	end
end

local function hideAll(exn)
	if exn == "Music" then
		musicState.activeTab = "Music"
		openMusic()
		return
	end
	musicState.activeTab = exn
	closeMusic(true)
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and n ~= "Music" then
			p.Visible = n == exn
		end
	end
	task.defer(function()
		syncTabColors(exn)
	end)
end

	end)

		return palette.card

end

local function applyBtnState(btn, on)
	if not btn then
		return
	end
	local targetBg = on and bgOn() or bgOff()
	local themePalette = __dcm_env.__DeltaThemePalette()
	local targetImg = on and onImg or (themePalette and themePalette.icon or offImg)
	local img = imgOf(btn)
	if TS then
		pcall(function()
			TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundColor3 = targetBg,
			}):Play()
		end)
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				TS:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					ImageColor3 = targetImg,
				}):Play()
			end)
		end
	else
		pcall(function()
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = targetBg
		end)
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				img.ImageColor3 = targetImg
			end)
		end
	end
end

function syncTabColors(forceTab)
	local curTab = forceTab or visibleTab()
	local map = {
		Home = sidebarRefs.home,
		Executor = sidebarRefs.executor,
		Scripthub = sidebarRefs.scripthub,
		Settings = sidebarRefs.settings,
		Console = sidebarRefs.console,
		Music = musicState.button,
		JarvisAI = musicState.aiButton,
	}
	for n, b in map do
		applyBtnState(b, curTab == n)
	end
end

	if syncTabColors then
		syncTabColors()
	end
end

local function muteObj(d)
	if not (d and d:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		return
	end
	local keep = false
	if d == sh then
		keep = true
	elseif d:FindFirstAncestor("LT_ScriptHub") then
		keep = true
	end
	if keep then
		return
	end
	if st.muted[d] == nil then
		st.muted[d] = d.Visible
	end
	local master = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime")
	if type(master) == "table" and type(master.setTracked) == "function" then
		master.setTracked(d, "Visible", false)
	else
		pcall(function()
			d.Visible = false
		end)
	end
	if d.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
		con(d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if d.Parent and not d:FindFirstAncestor("LT_ScriptHub") then
				pcall(function()
					d.Visible = false
				end)
			end
		end))
	end
end

local function muteSh()
	for _, d in sh:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
		muteObj(d)
	end
end

local function mk(class, props, kids)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in props or {} do
		o[k] = v
	end
	for _, c in kids or {} do
		c.Parent = o
	end
	return o
end

local function req(u)
	local body
	local status = 0
	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local ok, r = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = {
				["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
				["Accept"] = "application/json",
			},
		})
		if ok and r then
			body = r.Body or r.body
			status = r.StatusCode or r.Status or r.status_code or 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		local ok2, r2 = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(u)
		end)
		if ok2 and type(r2) == "string" and r2 ~= "" then
			body = r2
			status = 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return nil, status
	end
	local ok3, dec = pcall(function()
		return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", body)
	end)
	if ok3 then
		return dec, status
	end
	return nil, status
end

local SCRIPTBLOX_BASE = "https://scriptblox.com"
local RSCRIPTS_BASE = "https://rscripts.net"
local HAXHELL_BASE = "https://haxhell.com"
local IMAGE_CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustom/ScriptHubImages"
local MUSIC_CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic"
local MUSIC_CFG_PATH = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/_config.json"
local MUSIC_EXTS = {
	mp3 = true,
	ogg = true,
	flac = true,
	wav = true,
}
local musicCfg = {}

local function sanitizeFileName(str)
	return tostring(str or ""):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
end

local function hashString(str)
	local h = 0
	for i = 1, #str do
		h = (h * 31 + string.byte(str, i)) % 4294967296
	end
	return string.format("%08x", h)
end

local function clearImageCache()
	if
		type(isfolder) ~= "function"
		or type(listfiles) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or type(delfile) ~= "function"
	then
		return false
	end
	local okExists, exists = pcall(isfolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okExists or not exists then
		return false
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" and path ~= "" then
			pcall(delfile, path)
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ensureImageFolder()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if ok and ex then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(makefolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR) == true
end

local function ensureMusicFolder()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if ok and ex then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(makefolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR) == true
end

local function getAudioExt(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local clean = path:match("([^?#]+)") or path
	local ext = clean:match("%.([%w]+)$")
	if not ext then
		return nil
	end
	ext = ext:lower()
	return MUSIC_EXTS[ext] and ext or nil
end

local function normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	t = t:gsub(
		"^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$",
		"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%1/%2/%3/%4"
	)
	return t
end

local function deriveAudioFileName(url, ext)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "track"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", ""))
	base = base ~= "" and base or "track"
	return string.format("%s_%s.%s", base, hashString(url), ext)
end

local function resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if type(full) ~= "string" or full == "" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		return nil
	end
	local okAsset, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okAsset and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadMusicCfg()
	if HS and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH) then
		local ok, data = pcall(readfile, MUSIC_CFG_PATH)
		if ok and type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
			local okDec, dec = pcall(function()
				return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", data)
			end)
			if okDec and type(dec) == "table" then
				musicCfg = dec
				return
			end
		end
	end
	musicCfg = {}
end

local function saveMusicCfg()
	if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function" and ensureMusicFolder()) then
		return false
	end
	return writeJsonFile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH, musicCfg)
end

local function scanMusicFiles()
	local list = {}
	if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not ensureMusicFolder() then
		return list
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return list
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" then
			local ext = getAudioExt(path)
			if ext then
				local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)$") or path
				list[#list + 1] = {
					path = path,
					name = name,
					asset = resolveMusicAsset(path),
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return (a.name or ""):lower() < (b.name or ""):lower()
	end)
	return list
end

local function makeMusicFolderDropdown(par, y, z, onPick, onToggle)
	local state = {
		open = false,
		menuHeight = 0,
	}

	local hoverBg = mk("Frame", {

		if state.open == open then
			return
		end

				}):Play()

		end
	end

	end

	local function rebuild()
		for _, child in menuList:GetChildren() do
			if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local items = scanMusicFiles()
		if #items == 0 then
			mk("TextLabel", {
				Name = "Empty",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),

					Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,

					ZIndex = z + 5,

						PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
						PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),

						CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8),
					}),

				end))
				con(row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 47, 58)
				end))
				con(row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					setValueText(item.name)
					setMenuOpen(false)
					if onPick then
						onPick(item)
					end
				end))
			end
		end
		local count = math.max(#items, 1)
		local fullHeight = count * 30 + math.max(count - 1, 0) * 6 + 16
		local visibleHeight = math.min(fullHeight, 172)
		state.menuHeight = visibleHeight
		menu.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, visibleHeight)
		menuList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, fullHeight)
		if state.open and onToggle then
			onToggle(true, state.menuHeight)
		end
	end

	con(btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not state.open then
			rebuild()
		end

	end))

	con(btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		setHover(true)
	end))

	con(btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		setHover(false)
	end))

	return {
		button = btn,
		menu = menu,
		rebuild = rebuild,
		close = function()
			setMenuOpen(false)
		end,
		setText = setValueText,
	}
end

local function findLocalMusicEntry(query)
	query = trim(query)
	if query == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local lower = query:lower()
	for _, item in scanMusicFiles() do
		local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
		local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
		if lower == nm or lower == base then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local httpGetBinary
local function downloadMusicAsset(url)
	if
		type(getcustomasset) ~= "function"
		or type(writefile) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or not ensureMusicFolder()
	then
		return nil, "Custom music requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local norm = normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	local ext = getAudioExt(norm)
	if not norm or not ext then
		return nil, "Unsupported audio format. Use mp3, ogg, flac, or wav."
	end
	local full = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveAudioFileName(norm, ext)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local data = httpGetBinary(norm)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil, "Failed to download audio."
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil, "Failed to save audio."
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return nil, "Failed to load audio asset."
	end
	return {
		asset = asset,
		name = full:match("([^/\\]+)$") or full,
		path = full,
	}, nil
end

ensureMusicFolder()
loadMusicCfg()

local function deriveImageFileName(url)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "image"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:match("(.+)%.") or name)
	return string.format("%s_%s.bin", base ~= "" and base or "image", hashString(url))
end

clearImageCache()

local function normalizeImageUrl(url, base)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^rbxassetid://") or t:match("^rbxthumb://") then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^https?://") then
		return t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 2) == "//" then
		return "https:" .. t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return (base or "") .. t
	end
	return base and (base .. "/" .. t) or t
end

local function isMeaningfulImageUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not url:lower():find("no%-script")
end

function httpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end

local function downloadImageAsset(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	if not ensureImageFolder() then
		return nil
	end
	local full = IMAGE_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveImageFileName(url)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local host = url:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
		local hdr
		if host:find("rscripts%.net") then
			hdr = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
		elseif host:find("robloxscripts%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
		elseif host:find("haxhell%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
		elseif host:find("rbxcdn%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://www.roblox.com/" }
		end
		local data = httpGetBinary(url, hdr)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil
		end
	end
	local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, SCRIPTBLOX_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.coverImage,
		d.icon,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.coverImage,
		d.game and d.game.icon,
	})
end

local function resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, RSCRIPTS_BASE)
			if n then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.cover,
		d.banner,
		d.img,
		d.game and d.game.imgurl,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.cover,
		d.game and d.game.banner,
		d.game and d.game.gameLogo,
	})
end

local function resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local media = type(d.media) == "table" and d.media or {}
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or {}
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, HAXHELL_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		media.thumbnailUrl,
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		gameData.thumbnailUrl,
		gameData.iconUrl,
		gameData.imageUrl,
		gameData.image,
	})
end

local function buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	local id = tostring(placeId or "")
	if id == "" or id == "0" then
		return nil
	end
	return "https://www.roblox.com/Thumbs/PlaceThumbnail.ashx?width=420&height=270&format=png&placeId=" .. id
end

local function toast(a, b)
	if type(env.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(env.Notify, {
			Title = a,
			Description = b,
			Duration = 4,
		})
		return
	end
	if type(env.nt) == "function" then
		pcall(env.nt, {
			Title = a,
			Description = b,
			Duration = 4,
		})
	end
end

local eng = "RScripts"
local flt = "all"
local cur = 1
local maxp = 1
local q = ""
local tr = false
local busy = false
local data = {}

local function pass(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	if flt == "all" then
		return true
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		return not k
	else
		return k
	end
end

		}),
	})
end

local function getRw(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", true
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		local source = d.script or ""
		if source ~= "" then
			return source, false
		end
		local url = d.rawScriptUrl or d.scriptLink or d.raw or ""
		return url, url ~= ""
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local links = type(d.links) == "table" and d.links or {}
		local sourceData = type(d.source) == "table" and d.source or {}
		local source = links.raw or sourceData.rawUrl or sourceData.code or d.rawScriptUrl or d.script or ""
		return source, type(source) == "string" and source:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	end
	return d.script or d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", false
end

local function getTi(d)
	return d.title or d.name or "Untitled Script"
end

local function getGa(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.game and d.game.title or "Unknown Game"
	end
	return d.game and d.game.name or "Unknown Game"
end

local function keyReq(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	return k
end

local function getInfo(d)
	local stats = type(d.stats) == "table" and d.stats or {}
	local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
	local v = tostring(d.views or d.viewCount or stats.views or 0)
	local l = tostring(d.likes or d.likeCount or stats.likes or 0)
	local k = keyReq(d) and "Key" or "Keyless"
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		local access = d.accessType:lower()
		if access == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		elseif access == "free" then
			k = "Free"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and flags.isPaid == true then
		k = "Paid"
	end
	local s = eng == "RobloxScripts" and "Published" or (d.isPatched == true or flags.patched == true) and "Patched" or "Working"
	local info = string.format("%s | Views %s | Likes %s | %s", k, v, l, s)
	if eng == "RScripts" and d.discord and d.discord ~= "" then
		info = info .. " | Discord"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and d.author and d.author.verified == true then
		info = info .. " | Verified"
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local verified = flags.verified == true or type(d.author) == "table" and d.author.isScripterVerified == true
		if verified then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if flags.mobileSupported == true then
			info = info .. " | Mobile"
		end
	end
	return info
end

local function mkRow()
	return mk("Frame", {
		Name = "Row",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 124),
		Parent = list,
		ZIndex = 51,
	}, {
		mk("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 10),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		}),
	})
end

local function mkCard(par, i, d)
	local rw, rwIsUrl = getRw(d)
	local placeId
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.gameId
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		placeId = d.game and (d.game.placeId or d.game.gameLink and d.game.gameLink:match("/games/(%d+)"))
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.placeId or d.placeId
	end
	placeId = tonumber(placeId)

	local bgUrl
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		bgUrl = resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		bgUrl = resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		bgUrl = resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	else
		local candidates = {
			d.image,
			d.imageUrl,
			d.thumbnail,
			d.game and d.game.iconUrl,
			d.game and d.game.image,
		}
		for _, value in candidates do
			local normalized = normalizeImageUrl(value, "https://robloxscripts.com")
			if normalized and isMeaningfulImageUrl(normalized) then
				bgUrl = normalized
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not bgUrl and placeId then
		bgUrl = buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	end
	local bgAsset = bgUrl and downloadImageAsset(bgUrl) or nil
	local bgImg = bgAsset or bgUrl

	local cd = mk("Frame", {
		Name = "Card" .. tostring(i),
		BackgroundColor3 = col.cd,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.333333343, -7, 1, 0),
		LayoutOrder = i,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Parent = par,
	}, {
		mk("UICorner", {
			CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}),
		mk("UIStroke", {
			Color = col.st,
			Transparency = 0.35,
		}),
	})

	if bgImg then
		mk("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "Cover",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Image = bgImg,
			ImageTransparency = 0.1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 0,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
		})
		mk("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 1,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
			mk("UIGradient", {
				Rotation = 90,
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.45),
				}),
			}),
		})
	end

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = col.tx,
		Text = getTi(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 30),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = col.ac,
		Text = getGa(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 50),
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = col.td,
		Text = getInfo(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	local row = mk("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -36),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	}, {
		mk("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		}),
	})

	local run = mkb(row, "Run", col.su)
	run.ZIndex = 3
	local cp = setclipboard and mkb(row, "Copy", Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75)) or nil
	if cp then
		cp.ZIndex = 3
	end
	local dc = eng == "RScripts"
			and d.discord
			and d.discord ~= ""
			and setclipboard
			and mkb(row, "Discord", Color3.fromRGB(28, 116, 224))
		or nil
	if dc then
		dc.ZIndex = 3
	end


	local running = false
	con(run.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if running then
			return
		end
		local P = __dcm_env.__DeltaPipeline
		if not P then
			toast("ScriptHub", "Execution pipeline unavailable.")
			return
		end
		running = true
		local function state(text, enabled)
			if run.Parent then
				run.Text = text
				run.Active = enabled
				run.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or 0.4
			end
		end
		local function finish(text, hold)
			state(text, false)
			task.delay(hold, function()
				running = false
				state("Run", true)
			end)
		end
		local headers
		if eng == "RScripts" then
			headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
		elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
			headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
		elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
			headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
		end
		local input = { chunk = "@ScriptHubEntry/" .. tostring(d.title or d.name or "Script"), headers = headers }
		if rwIsUrl then
			input.url = rw
		else
			input.text = rw
		end
		P.execute(input, function(stage, where, detail, ms)
			if stage == "Failed" then
				local msg = tostring(detail or "unknown error")
				warn("[ScriptHub] " .. tostring(where) .. " failed: " .. msg)
				toast("ScriptHub", tostring(where) .. " failed: " .. (msg:match("^[^\n]*") or msg))
				finish("Failed", 1.6)
			elseif stage == "Done" then
				toast("ScriptHub", string.format("Executed script (compiled in %d ms).", math.floor((ms or 0) + 0.5)))
				finish("Done", 1.2)
			else
				state(stage, false)
			end
		end)
	end))

	if cp then
		con(cp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				local src = rw
				if rwIsUrl then
					local headers
					if eng == "RScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
					elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
					elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
						headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
					end
					src = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				end
				if type(src) == "string" and src ~= "" then
					setclipboard(src)
				end
			end)
			cp.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if cp and cp.Parent then
					cp.Text = "Copy"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end

	if dc then
		con(dc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				setclipboard(d.discord)
			end)
			dc.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if dc and dc.Parent then
					dc.Text = "Discord"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end
end

local function ren()
	shClr()
	pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
	if not data or #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	local row
	local coln = 0
	for _, d in data do
		if pass(d) then
			if not row or coln >= 3 then
				row = mkRow()
				coln = 0
			end
			n += 1
			coln += 1
			mkCard(row, n, d)
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then
		if flt == "keyless" then
			shMsg("No keyless scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		elseif flt == "key" then
			shMsg("No key-required scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		else
			shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		end
	end
end

local function setBusy(v)
	busy = v and true or false
	gob.Active = not busy
	prev.Active = not busy
	nextb.Active = not busy
	gob.Text = busy and "Loading" or "Search"
end

local function fetch(q2, tr2, p2)
	if busy then
		return
	end
	clearImageCache()
	q2 = trim(q2 or "")
	tr2 = eng == "ScriptBlox" and tr2 == true or false
	p2 = math.max(tonumber(p2) or 1, 1)
	q = q2
	tr = tr2
	cur = p2
	maxp = 1
	data = {}
	setBusy(true)
	shClr()
	shMsg("Loading...", col.td)
	local requestQuery = q2
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and #requestQuery > 100 then
		requestQuery = requestQuery:sub(1, 100)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and requestQuery ~= "" and #requestQuery < 2 then
		shClr()
		shMsg("HaxHell search requires at least 2 characters", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local enc = __lt.cm("HttpService", "UrlEncode", requestQuery)
	local u
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		u = string.format("https://rscripts.net/api/v2/scripts?page=%d&orderBy=date&sort=desc", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		p2 = math.min(p2, 200)
		cur = p2
		u = string.format("https://robloxscripts.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=newest", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/search/scripts?q=%s&page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif tr2 then
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/fetch?page=%d", p2)
	else
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/search?q=%s&page=%d", enc, p2)
	end
	local dec, status = req(u)
	shClr()
	if status == 429 then
		shMsg("Rate limit reached. Try again shortly", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status == 503 then
		shMsg("API temporarily unavailable", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status ~= 0 and (status < 200 or status >= 300) then
		shMsg("Request failed (" .. tostring(status) .. ")", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif not dec then
		shMsg("Request failed", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local arr
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		arr = dec.scripts
		maxp = math.max(dec.info and dec.info.maxPages or 1, 1)
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		maxp = math.min(math.max(pages or 1, 1), 200)
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
		if not pages then
			pages = pg.hasMore == true and (cur + 1) or cur
		end
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
	else
		local r = dec.result or {}
		arr = r.scripts
		maxp = math.max(r.totalPages or 1, 1)
	end
	data = arr or {}
	if #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	ren()
	setBusy(false)
end

con(engb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		eng = "RScripts"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 58)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (rscripts.net)"
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		eng = "RobloxScripts"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 52, 68)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (robloxscripts.com)"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		eng = "HaxHell"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 42, 74)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (haxhell.com)"
	else
		eng = "ScriptBlox"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = col.bg
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (scriptblox.com)"
	end
	engb.Text = "Engine: " .. eng
	toast("ScriptHub", "Switched to " .. eng)
	data = {}
	cur = 1
	maxp = 1
	pgt.Text = "Page 1 / 1"
	shClr()
	shMsg("Press Search to load scripts", col.td)
end))

con(fltb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if flt == "all" then
		flt = "keyless"
		fltb.Text = "Keyless"
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		flt = "key"
		fltb.Text = "Key"
	else
		flt = "all"
		fltb.Text = "All"
	end
	ren()
end))

con(gob.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local t = trim(sbox.Text)
	if t ~= "" then
		fetch(t, false, 1)
	else
		if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
			fetch("", true, 1)
		else
			fetch("", false, 1)
		end
	end
end))

	if ent then
		local t = trim(sbox.Text)
		if t ~= "" then
			fetch(t, false, 1)
		else
			if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
				fetch("", true, 1)
			else
				fetch("", false, 1)
			end
		end
	end
end))

	if busy then
		return
	end
	if cur > 1 then
		fetch(q, tr, cur - 1)
	end
end))

	if busy then
		return
	end
	if cur < maxp then
		fetch(q, tr, cur + 1)
	end
end))

shMsg("Press Search to load scripts", col.td)
con(sh.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	muteObj(d)
end))

local function buildMusicTab()
	musicState.frame = gui:FindFirstChild("Music")
	if musicState.frame then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.frame:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	local tpl = sh or hm or se or ex or co
	if tpl and tpl:IsA("GuiObject") then
		musicState.frame = tpl:Clone()
		musicState.frame.Name = "Music"
		musicState.frame.Visible = false
		musicState.frame.Parent = gui
		pcall(function()
			musicState.frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
			musicState.frame.Size = sh.Size
			musicState.frame.ZIndex = sh.ZIndex
		end)
		for _, d in musicState.frame:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
			if d:IsA("LocalScript") then
				d:Destroy()
			elseif d:IsA("GuiObject") and d ~= musicState.frame then
				pcall(function()
					d.Visible = false
				end)
			end
		end
	else
		musicState.frame = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Music",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = musicState.closedPos,
			Size = sh and sh.Size or UDim2.new(0.848344803, 0, 0.892481446, 0),
			Visible = false,
			Parent = gui,
			ZIndex = sh and sh.ZIndex or 100,
		})
	end

	st.pg.music = musicState.frame

	local mr = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "LT_Music",
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 590),
		ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
		HorizontalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = col.st,
		ScrollBarThickness = 4,
		TopImage = "",
		MidImage = "",
		BottomImage = "",
		VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.88, 0),
		Visible = true,
		ZIndex = 50,
		Parent = musicState.frame,
	})

	local function mkPanel(name, pos, size, fill, stroke, z)
		return mk("Frame", {
			Name = name,
			BackgroundColor3 = fill or col.bg2,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = pos,
			Size = size,
			Parent = mr,
			ZIndex = z or 51,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12),
			}),
			mk("UIStroke", {
				Color = stroke or col.st,
				Transparency = 0.28,
			}),
		})
	end

	local function mkCtl(par, name, text, width, bg, strokeCol)
		return mk("TextButton", {
			Name = name,
			BackgroundColor3 = bg,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 34),
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = col.tx,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 13,
			Parent = par,
			ZIndex = 54,

	local localPicker
	local function relayoutMusic(extra)
		extra = math.max(0, tonumber(extra) or 0)
		inputCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, inputBaseHeight + extra)
		controlCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, controlBaseY + extra)
		mixCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, mixBaseY + extra)
		mr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, canvasBaseHeight + extra)
	end

	local function syncLocalPicker(raw)
		if not localPicker then
			return
		end
		local entry = raw and findLocalMusicEntry(raw) or nil
		if entry and entry.name then
			localPicker.setText(entry.name)
		else
			localPicker.setText("")
		end
	end

	local savedVol = tonumber(musicCfg.volume)
	if savedVol and savedVol >= 0 and savedVol <= 1 then
		savedVol *= 10
	end
	local vl = math.clamp(savedVol or 1, 0, 10)
	local spd = math.clamp(tonumber(musicCfg.playbackSpeed) or 1, 0.5, 2)
	local mixSaveStamp = 0
	local mixReady = false
	local function queueMixSave()
		if not mixReady then
			return
		end
		mixSaveStamp += 1
		local cur = mixSaveStamp
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if cur ~= mixSaveStamp then
				return
			end
			musicCfg.volume = vl
			musicCfg.playbackSpeed = spd
			saveMusicCfg()
		end)
	end
	local function formatTime(sec)
		sec = tonumber(sec) or 0
		if sec < 0 or sec ~= sec or sec == math.huge then
			sec = 0
		end
		local total = math.floor(sec + 0.5)
		local m = math.floor(total / 60)
		local s = total % 60
		return string.format("%02d:%02d", m, s)
	end

	local function setStatusText(text, accent)
		stat.Text = text
		heroStatus.Text = string.upper(text)
		if accent then
			heroStatus.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			heroStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 250)
		else
			heroStatus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 42)
			heroStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(199, 208, 221)
		end
	end

	local function setProgress(alpha, pos, len)
		alpha = math.clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
		pfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		pkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		progressInfo.Text = string.format("%s / %s", formatTime(pos or 0), formatTime(len or 0))
	end

	local function syncLoopButton()
		local on = st.snd and st.snd.Looped
		loopb.Text = on and "Loop On" or "Loop Off"
		loopb.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(45, 93, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 61)
	end
	local function syncPauseButtons()
		local paused = st.musicPaused and st.snd ~= nil
		pauseb.Visible = not paused
		resumeb.Visible = paused
	end
	local function syncCycleButton()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode == "order" then
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Order"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 93, 73)
		elseif mode == "random" then
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Random"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 74, 112)
		else
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Off"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 61)
		end
	end
	local function getNextCycleTrack()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode ~= "order" and mode ~= "random" then
			return nil
		end
		local items = scanMusicFiles()
		if #items == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local currentRaw = trim(st.musicRaw or "")
		if currentRaw == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local currentLower = currentRaw:lower()
		local currentIndex
		for i, item in items do
			local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
			local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
			if currentLower == nm or currentLower == base then
				currentIndex = i
				break
			end
		end
		if not currentIndex then
			return nil
		end
		if mode == "random" then
			if #items == 1 then
				return items[1]
			end
			local idx = currentIndex
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				idx = math.random(1, #items)
				if idx ~= currentIndex then
					break
				end
			end
			if idx == currentIndex then
				idx = (currentIndex % #items) + 1
			end
			return items[idx]
		end
		return items[(currentIndex % #items) + 1]
	end

	local function apVol(v)
		vl = math.clamp(v, 0, 10)
		local alpha = vl / 10
		vfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		vkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		vt.Text = string.format("Volume  %.2f", vl)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.Volume = vl
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	local function apSpeed(v)
		spd = math.clamp(v, 0.5, 2)
		local alpha = (spd - 0.5) / 1.5
		sfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		skn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		spLabel.Text = string.format("Playback speed  %.2fx", spd)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	apVol(vl)
	apSpeed(spd)
	st.musicPaused = false
	st.musicCycleMode = st.musicCycleMode or "off"
	mixReady = true
	setStatusText("Stopped")
	setProgress(0, 0, 0)
	relayoutMusic(0)
	syncPauseButtons()
	syncCycleButton()

	local dragging = false
	local speedDragging = false
	local progressDragging = false

	local function setBar(inp)
		local x = (inp.Position.X - vbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(vbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		apVol(math.clamp(x, 0, 1) * 10)
	end

	local function setSpeedBar(inp)
		local x = (inp.Position.X - sbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(sbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		apSpeed(0.5 + math.clamp(x, 0, 1) * 1.5)
	end

	local function setProgressBar(inp)
		if not (st.snd and st.snd.TimeLength and st.snd.TimeLength > 0) then
			return
		end
		local x = (inp.Position.X - pbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(pbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
		local len = st.snd.TimeLength
		local pos = len * x
		pcall(function()
			st.snd.TimePosition = pos
		end)
		setProgress(x, pos, len)
	end

	con(vbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			setBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(sbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			speedDragging = true
			setSpeedBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(pbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			progressDragging = true
			setProgressBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if
			dragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setBar(inp)
		end
		if
			speedDragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setSpeedBar(inp)
		end
		if
			progressDragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setProgressBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
			speedDragging = false
			progressDragging = false
		end
	end))

	if RS then
		con(RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local snd = st.snd
			if not snd then
				return
			end
			local len = snd.TimeLength or 0
			local pos = snd.TimePosition or 0
			local alpha = 0
			if len > 0 then
				alpha = math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1)
			end
			if not progressDragging then
				setProgress(alpha, pos, len)
			end
		end))
	end

	local function getId(t)
		t = trim(t)
		if t == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local n = t:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or t:match("id=(%d+)") or t:match("^(%d+)$")
		if n then
			return "rbxassetid://" .. n, n
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function mkSnd(id, raw)
		if st.snd then
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.Name = "LT_MusicSound"
		s.SoundId = id
		s.Volume = vl
		s.Looped = false
		s.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		s.Parent = gui
		local function clearSoundGroup()
			if not (s and s.Parent) then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if s.SoundGroup ~= nil then
					s.SoundGroup = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		clearSoundGroup()
		st.snd = s
		st.musicPaused = false
		st.musicRaw = tostring(raw)
		now.Text = tostring(raw)
		assetChip.Text = tostring(raw)
		setStatusText("Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(53, 83, 125))
		setProgress(0, 0, 0)
		syncLoopButton()
		syncPauseButtons()
		con(s.Loaded:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(53, 83, 125))
			setProgress(0, s.TimePosition or 0, s.TimeLength or 0)
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Ended:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Ended", Color3.fromRGB(88, 64, 48))
			syncPauseButtons()
			local nextTrack = getNextCycleTrack()
			if nextTrack and nextTrack.asset then
				task.defer(function()
					if st.snd ~= s then
						return
					end
					mb.Text = nextTrack.name or ""
					mkSnd(nextTrack.asset, nextTrack.name)
					syncLocalPicker(nextTrack.name)
					if st.snd then
						pcall(function()
							st.snd:Play()
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
		end))
		con(s.Played:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Playing", Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153))
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Paused:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = true
			setStatusText("Paused", Color3.fromRGB(92, 105, 123))
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Stopped:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Stopped")
			setProgress(0, 0, s.TimeLength or 0)
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundGroup"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(clearSoundGroup)
		end))
	end

	local function resolveTrackInput(text)
		local q = trim(text)
		if q == "" then
			return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
		end
		local localEntry = findLocalMusicEntry(q)
		if localEntry and localEntry.asset then
			return localEntry.asset, localEntry.name
		end
		local sid, raw = getId(q)
		if sid then
			return sid, raw
		end
		if q:match("^https?://") or q:match("^www%.") then
			local entry, err = downloadMusicAsset(q:match("^www%.") and ("https://" .. q) or q)
			if not entry then
				return nil, nil, err or "Failed to download audio."
			end
			return entry.asset, entry.name
		end
		if getAudioExt(q) then
			return nil, nil, "Local track not found in DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic."
		end
		return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
	end

	local loadCurrentTrack
	localPicker = makeMusicFolderDropdown(inputCard, 74, 53, function(item)
		mb.Text = item.name or ""
		task.defer(function()
			if loadCurrentTrack then
				loadCurrentTrack()
			end
		end)
	end, function(open, menuHeight)
		relayoutMusic(open and (menuHeight + 10) or 0)
	end)

	function loadCurrentTrack()
		if localPicker then
			localPicker.close()
		end
		local sid, raw, err = resolveTrackInput(mb.Text)
		if not sid then
			toast("Music", err or "Enter a valid track.")
			return false
		end
		mkSnd(sid, raw)
		syncLocalPicker(raw)
		toast("Music", "Loaded audio.")
		return true
	end

	con(loadb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(loadCurrentTrack))

	con(mb.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		if enter then
			loadCurrentTrack()
		end
	end))

	con(playb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Play()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(pauseb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = true
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Pause()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(resumeb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				st.snd:Resume()
			end)
			if not ok then
				pcall(function()
					st.snd:Play()
				end)
			end
		end
	end))

	con(stopb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Stop()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(loopb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not st.snd then
			return
		end
		st.snd.Looped = not st.snd.Looped
		syncLoopButton()
	end))
	con(cycleb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode == "off" then
			st.musicCycleMode = "order"
		elseif mode == "order" then
			st.musicCycleMode = "random"
		else
			st.musicCycleMode = "off"
		end
		syncCycleButton()
	end))
end

buildMusicTab()

musicState.setupSidebar = function()
	musicState.icon.sheetAsset = downloadImageAsset(musicState.icon.sheetUrl)

	musicState.button = gbtn("Music")
	if musicState.button then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.button:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	musicState.sourceButton = sidebarRefs.console
		or sidebarRefs.scripthub
		or sidebarRefs.home
		or sidebarRefs.settings
		or sidebarRefs.executor
	if musicState.sourceButton then
		musicState.button = musicState.sourceButton:Clone()
		musicState.button.Name = "Music"
		musicState.button.Parent = musicState.sourceButton.Parent
		st.pg.musicButton = musicState.button
		musicState.textLabel = txtOf(musicState.button)
		if musicState.textLabel then
			musicState.textLabel.Text = "Music"
		end
		pcall(function()
			if sidebarRefs.toggle and sidebarRefs.toggle:IsA("GuiButton") then
				local to = sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 999
				for _, d in sb:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= musicState.button and d.LayoutOrder and d.LayoutOrder >= to then
						d.LayoutOrder += 1
					end
				end
				musicState.button.LayoutOrder = to
			else
				local lo = 0
				for _, d in sb:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= musicState.button then
						lo = math.max(lo, d.LayoutOrder or 0)
					end
				end
				musicState.button.LayoutOrder = lo + 1
			end
		end)
		musicState.imageLabel = imgOf(musicState.button)
		if musicState.imageLabel then
			pcall(function()
				if musicState.icon.sheetAsset then
					musicState.imageLabel.Image = musicState.icon.sheetAsset
					musicState.imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = musicState.icon.rectOffset
					musicState.imageLabel.ImageRectSize = musicState.icon.rectSize
					musicState.imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
				end
				musicState.imageLabel.ImageColor3 = offImg
			end)
			if not musicState.icon.sheetAsset then
				pcall(function()
					local il = musicState.imageLabel
					il.Image = ""
					il.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
					il.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
					for _, d in il:GetChildren() do
						if d.Name == "LT_MusicGlyph" then
							d:Destroy()
						end
					end
					local g = Instance.new("Frame")
					g.Name = "LT_MusicGlyph"
					g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					g.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
					g.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
					g.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
					g.ZIndex = il.ZIndex + 1
					g.Parent = il
					local ar = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
					ar.AspectRatio = 1
					ar.Parent = g
					local parts = {}
					local function part(anchor, pos, size, rot, round)
						local f = Instance.new("Frame")
						f.AnchorPoint = anchor
						f.Position = pos
						f.Size = size
						f.Rotation = rot
						f.BorderSizePixel = 0
						f.ZIndex = g.ZIndex
						f.Parent = g
						local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
						c.CornerRadius = round and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, 2)
						c.Parent = f
						table.insert(parts, f)
					end
					part(Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.13), UDim2.fromScale(0.11, 0.58), 0, false)
					part(Vector2.new(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.13), UDim2.fromScale(0.43, 0.1), -8, false)
					part(Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 0.75), UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.28), -12, true)
					local function recolor()
						for _, f in parts do
							f.BackgroundColor3 = il.ImageColor3
						end
					end
					recolor()
					il:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(recolor)
				end)
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			musicState.button.BackgroundColor3 = bgOff()
		end)
	end

	musicState.placeButton = function()
		if not (musicState.button and sidebarRefs.toggle and musicState.button.Parent == sidebarRefs.toggle.Parent) then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			if sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS") == nil then
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Scale)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYS", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Scale)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Offset)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigLay", sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end
			local op = UDim2.new(
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Scale,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYS") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Scale,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYO") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Offset
			)
			sidebarRefs.toggle.Position = op
			local togLo = sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigLay") or sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 0
			sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder = togLo
			local above
			local ay = -math.huge
			local ty = op.Y.Scale + op.Y.Offset / 100000
			for _, d in sidebarRefs.toggle.Parent:GetChildren() do
				if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= sidebarRefs.toggle and d ~= musicState.button then
					local py = d.Position.Y.Scale + d.Position.Y.Offset / 100000
					if py < ty and py > ay then
						ay = py
						above = d
					end
				end
			end
			local gapS = 0.11
			local gapO = 0
			if above then
				gapS = op.Y.Scale - above.Position.Y.Scale
				gapO = op.Y.Offset - above.Position.Y.Offset
			end
			musicState.button.Position = op
			musicState.button.LayoutOrder = togLo - 1
			sidebarRefs.toggle.Position = UDim2.new(op.X.Scale, op.X.Offset, op.Y.Scale + gapS, op.Y.Offset + gapO)
			sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder = togLo + 1
		end)
	end

	musicState.placeButton()

	musicState.bindHide = function(b, nm)
		improveSidebarTouch(b)
		if b and b:IsA("GuiButton") then
			con(b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				closeMusic(true)
				if musicState.aiClose then
					musicState.aiClose(true)
				end
				task.defer(function()
					syncTabColors(nm or b.Name)
				end)
			end))
		end
	end

	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.home, "Home")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.scripthub, "Scripthub")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.settings, "Settings")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.executor, "Executor")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.console, "Console")

	improveSidebarTouch(musicState.button)
	if musicState.button and musicState.button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		con(musicState.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			openMusic()
			task.defer(function()
				syncTabColors("Music")
			end)
		end))
	end

	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			con(p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(syncTabColors)
			end))
		end
	end

	if sidebarRefs.activeColor and sidebarRefs.activeColor.Changed then
		con(sidebarRefs.activeColor.Changed:Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncTabColors)
		end))
	end

	if sidebarRefs.inactiveColor and sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Changed then
		con(sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Changed:Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncTabColors)
		end))
	end

	task.defer(syncTabColors)
end

musicState.setupSidebar()

-- ===== JARVIS tab (Delta): mounts the shared main-script AI core (Util.Jarvis) into this page =====
do
	local ai = { tween = nil }
	local function getCore()
		local env = __dcm_boot and __dcm_boot.hostEnv
		local c = type(env) == "table" and (rawget(env, "JarvisAI") or rawget(env, "NoobyNeuralAI")) or nil
		if type(c) ~= "table" then
			local okg, g = pcall(function()
				return getgenv and getgenv()
			end)
			c = okg and type(g) == "table" and (rawget(g, "JarvisAI") or rawget(g, "NoobyNeuralAI")) or (rawget(_G, "JarvisAI") or rawget(_G, "NoobyNeuralAI"))
		end
		return type(c) == "table" and c or nil
	end
	local base = sh or hm or se or ex or co
	local aiPage = mk("Frame", {
		Name = "JarvisAI",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = musicState.closedPos,
		Size = base and base.Size or UDim2.new(0.848344803, 0, 0.892481446, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = base and base.BackgroundColor3 or col.bg,
		BackgroundTransparency = base and base.BackgroundTransparency or 0,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = base and base.ZIndex or 100,
		Parent = gui,
	})
	if base then
		for _, ch in base:GetChildren() do
			if ch:IsA("UICorner") or ch:IsA("UIStroke") or ch:IsA("UIGradient") then
				pcall(function()
					ch:Clone().Parent = aiPage
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	local aiHost = mk("Frame", {
		Name = "LT_JarvisAI",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 50,
		Parent = aiPage,
	})
	local aiStatus = mk("TextLabel", {
		Name = "LT_AIStatus",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 70),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextColor3 = col.td,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 14,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 60,
		Parent = aiHost,
	})
	st.pg.ai = aiPage

	local function setStatus(text)
		aiStatus.Text = text or ""
		aiStatus.Visible = text ~= nil
	end
	musicState.aiEnsure = function()
		local core = getCore()
		if not core then
			setStatus("JARVIS core is unavailable. Run the main script so the shared AI core is loaded.")
			return
		end
		if not core.IsReady() then
			setStatus("Loading JARVIS…")
		end
		core.Mount(aiHost, {
			onClose = function()
				hideAll("Home")
			end,
		}, function(ok, err)
			if ok then
				setStatus(nil)
			else
				setStatus(tostring(err) .. "\n(open the tab again to retry)")
			end
		end)
	end

	local function aiTween(toPos, show, hideAfter)
		if ai.tween then
			pcall(function()
				ai.tween:Cancel()
			end)
			ai.tween = nil
		end
		if show then
			aiPage.Visible = true
		end
		if TS then
			local tw = TS:Create(aiPage, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = toPos })
			ai.tween = tw
			if hideAfter then
				con(tw.Completed:Connect(function(state)
					if ai.tween == tw and state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
						aiPage.Visible = false
					end
				end))
			end
			tw:Play()
		else
			aiPage.Position = toPos
			if hideAfter then
				aiPage.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
	local function aiOpen()
		closeMusic(false)
		for _, n in sec do
			local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
			if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p ~= aiPage then
				p.Visible = false
			end
		end
		aiPage.Position = musicState.closedPos
		aiTween(musicState.openPos, true, false)
		musicState.aiEnsure()
		task.defer(function()
			syncTabColors("JarvisAI")
		end)
	end
	musicState.aiClose = function(anim)
		if not aiPage.Visible then
			return
		end
		local core = getCore()
		if core then
			pcall(core.Flush)
		end
		if anim then
			aiTween(musicState.closedPos, false, true)
		else
			aiTween(musicState.closedPos, false, false)
			aiPage.Visible = false
		end
	end

	-- ---------- sidebar button ----------
	local srcBtn = musicState.sourceButton or sidebarRefs.console or musicState.button or sidebarRefs.scripthub
	if srcBtn then
		local btn = srcBtn:Clone()
		btn.Name = "JarvisAI"
		btn.Parent = srcBtn.Parent
		musicState.aiButton = btn
		st.pg.aiButton = btn
		local lbl = txtOf(btn)
		if lbl then
			lbl.Text = "JARVIS"
			pcall(function()
				lbl.TextWrapped = true
				lbl.TextScaled = true
			end)
		end
		local il = imgOf(btn)
		if il then
			pcall(function()
				il.Image = ""
				il.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
				il.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
				for _, d in il:GetChildren() do
					d:Destroy()
				end
				local g = mk("TextLabel", {
					Name = "LT_AIGlyph",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					Text = "AI",
					TextScaled = true,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
					TextColor3 = offImg,
					ZIndex = il.ZIndex + 1,
					Parent = il,
				})
				local function recolor()
					g.TextColor3 = il.ImageColor3
				end
				il.ImageColor3 = offImg
				recolor()
				con(il:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(recolor))
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = bgOff()
		end)
		pcall(function()
			local tog, mb = sidebarRefs.toggle, musicState.button
			if tog and mb and btn.Parent == tog.Parent and mb.Parent == tog.Parent then
				local tp, mp = tog.Position, mb.Position
				btn.Position = tp
				btn.LayoutOrder = (tog.LayoutOrder or 0)
				tog.Position = UDim2.new(tp.X.Scale, tp.X.Offset, tp.Y.Scale + (tp.Y.Scale - mp.Y.Scale), tp.Y.Offset + (tp.Y.Offset - mp.Y.Offset))
				tog.LayoutOrder = (tog.LayoutOrder or 0) + 1
			end
		end)
		improveSidebarTouch(btn)
		if btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
			con(btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(aiOpen))
		end
		if musicState.button and musicState.button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			con(musicState.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				musicState.aiClose(false)
			end))
		end
	end
	con(aiPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		task.defer(syncTabColors)
	end))
	st.pg.aiUnload = function()
		local core = getCore()
		if core then
			pcall(core.Flush)
		end
	end

	-- ---------- responsive sidebar: keeps every tab button inside the viewport (compact sizing, scroll when still too tall) ----------
	do
		local sbLayout = sb:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
		local fitting, token, wrap, compacted = false, 0, nil, false
		local function sbList()
			local list = {}
			local function take(p)
				for _, d in p:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") then
						list[#list + 1] = d
					end
				end
			end
			take(sb)
			if wrap then
				take(wrap)
			end
			local h = math.max(sb.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
			table.sort(list, function(a, b)
				if sbLayout and a.LayoutOrder ~= b.LayoutOrder then
					return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder
				end
				return a.Position.Y.Scale * h + a.Position.Y.Offset < b.Position.Y.Scale * h + b.Position.Y.Offset
			end)
			return list
		end
		local function fit()
			if fitting or not sb.Parent then
				return
			end
			local sg = sb:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local vp = (sg and sg.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 and sg.AbsoluteSize) or (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(800, 600)
			local top = math.max(sb.AbsolutePosition.Y, 0)
			local off = top - sb.AbsolutePosition.Y
				local availH = math.min(sb.AbsoluteSize.Y - off, vp.Y - top - 4)
			if availH <= 40 then
				return
			end
			local list = sbList()
			local n = #list
			if n == 0 then
				return
			end
			local needs = compacted
			if not needs then
				for _, b in list do
					if b.AbsolutePosition.Y + b.AbsoluteSize.Y > top + availH + 1 then
						needs = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if not needs then
				return
			end
			local pad, gap = 6, 4
			local minH = UIS.TouchEnabled and 36 or 30
			local bh = math.floor((availH - pad * 2 - gap * (n - 1)) / n)
			local scroll = false
			if bh < minH then
				bh = minH
				scroll = true
			end
			bh = math.min(bh, 64)
			local total = pad * 2 + n * bh + (n - 1) * gap
			fitting = true
			compacted = true
			local parent = sb
			if scroll then
				wrap = wrap
					or mk("ScrollingFrame", {
						Name = "LT_SidebarScroll",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
						ScrollBarThickness = 3,
						Active = true,
						ScrollingEnabled = true,
						ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
						ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
						ZIndex = sb.ZIndex,
						Parent = sb,
					})
				wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, availH)
				wrap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, off)
				wrap.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, total)
				wrap.Visible = true
				parent = wrap
			elseif wrap then
				wrap.Visible = false
			end
			if sbLayout then
				sbLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, gap)
				sbLayout.Parent = parent
			end
			for i, b in list do
				for _, c in b:GetChildren() do
					if c:IsA("UIAspectRatioConstraint") then
						pcall(function()
							c.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
				b.Size = UDim2.new(b.Size.X.Scale, b.Size.X.Offset, 0, bh)
				if b.Parent ~= parent then
					b.Parent = parent
				end
				if not sbLayout then
					b.Position = UDim2.new(b.Position.X.Scale, b.Position.X.Offset, 0, pad + (i - 1) * (bh + gap) + math.floor(bh * b.AnchorPoint.Y))
				end
			end
			task.defer(function()
				fitting = false
			end)
		end
		local function schedule()
			token += 1
			local t = token
			task.delay(0.12, function()
				if t == token then
					fit()
				end
			end)
		end
		con(sb:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(schedule))
		con(sb.ChildAdded:Connect(schedule))
		local sg = sb:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if sg then
			con(sg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(schedule))
		end
		for _, b in sbList() do
			con(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(schedule))
		end
		schedule()
		task.delay(0.6, fit)
	end
	task.defer(syncTabColors)
end
end

st.fn.setupHubMusic();
end

do
	local previousThemeRuntime = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime")
	if type(previousThemeRuntime) == "table" and type(previousThemeRuntime.stop) == "function" then
		pcall(previousThemeRuntime.stop)
	end
	if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower():find("^delta") then
		task.defer(function()
			local themeRuntime = {
				alive = true,
				connections = {},
				baseBackground = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseText = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseStroke = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseImage = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			}
			__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeRuntime = themeRuntime
			themeRuntime.current = "Default"
			local function connectTheme(signal, callback)
				if not signal then
					return
				end
				local ok, connection = pcall(function()
					return signal:Connect(callback)
				end)
				if ok and connection then
					table.insert(themeRuntime.connections, connection)
				end
			end
			local function getThemeRoot()
				local service = cloneref and cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui")) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
				return gethui and gethui() or service
			end
			local function findMainGui()
				local rootGui = getThemeRoot()
				for _, gui in rootGui:GetChildren() do
					if
						gui:IsA("ScreenGui")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Settings")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
					then
						return gui
					end
				end
			end
			local mainGui = findMainGui()
			local attempts = 0
			while themeRuntime.alive and not mainGui and attempts < 100 do
				attempts += 1
				task.wait(0.1)
				mainGui = findMainGui()
			end
			if not (themeRuntime.alive and mainGui) then
				return
			end
			local settingsPath = "DeltaCustom/Settings.json"
			local function readThemeConfig()
				if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(settingsPath) then
					return {}
				end
				local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
				if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then
					return {}
				end
				local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
				end)
				return decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded or {}
			end
			local function saveTheme(name)
				local config = readThemeConfig()
				config.DeltaTheme = { name = name }
				writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
			end
			local function capture(object)
				if not object then
					return
				end
				if
					object:IsA("Frame")
					or object:IsA("ImageLabel")
					or object:IsA("ImageButton")
					or object:IsA("TextButton")
					or object:IsA("TextBox")
					or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
				then
					if themeRuntime.baseBackground[object] == nil then
						themeRuntime.baseBackground[object] = object.BackgroundColor3
					end
				end
				if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
					if themeRuntime.baseText[object] == nil then
						themeRuntime.baseText[object] = object.TextColor3
					end
				end
				if object:IsA("UIStroke") and themeRuntime.baseStroke[object] == nil then
					themeRuntime.baseStroke[object] = object.Color
				end
				if (object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton")) and themeRuntime.baseImage[object] == nil then
					themeRuntime.baseImage[object] = object.ImageColor3
				end
			end
			capture(mainGui)
			for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
				capture(object)
			end
			local palettes = {
				Light = {
					root = Color3.fromRGB(242, 244, 248),
					panel = Color3.fromRGB(229, 232, 239),
					card = Color3.fromRGB(216, 221, 230),
					card2 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 211, 221),
					text = Color3.fromRGB(27, 33, 44),
					muted = Color3.fromRGB(91, 101, 118),
					stroke = Color3.fromRGB(178, 188, 204),
					icon = Color3.fromRGB(69, 79, 96),
					accent = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				},
				Amoled = {
					root = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
					panel = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 7),
					card = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 13),
					card2 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19),
					text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 247, 250),
					muted = Color3.fromRGB(143, 150, 162),
					stroke = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 36),
					icon = Color3.fromRGB(224, 229, 236),
					accent = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				},
			}
			themeRuntime.palettes = palettes
			local function isAccent(color)
				local hue, saturation, value = Color3.toHSV(color)
				return saturation >= 0.34 and value >= 0.28 and hue >= 0.48 and hue <= 0.72
			end
			local function isControlColorPart(object)
				local current = object
				while current and current ~= mainGui do
					local name = current.Name
					if
						name == "Hue"
						or name == "Sat"
						or name == "Val"
						or name == "Knob"
						or name == "ColorSlider"
						or name == "ColorValue"
					then
						return true
					end
					current = current.Parent
				end
				return false
			end
			local function backgroundRole(object, palette)
				local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
				if name == "darkoverlay" then
					return Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				if
					name:find("overlay")
					or name == "settings"
					or name == "executor"
					or name == "home"
					or name == "scripthub"
					or name == "console"
					or name == "music"
				then
					return palette.root
				end
				if
					name:find("button")
					or name:find("tab")
					or name:find("card")
					or name:find("script")
					or name:find("network")
					or name:find("search")
					or name:find("dropdown")
					or name:find("setting")
				then
					return palette.card
				end
				if object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
					return palette.card2
				end
				return palette.panel
			end
			local function restoreObject(object)
				local background = themeRuntime.baseBackground[object]
				if background ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.BackgroundColor3 = background
					end)
				end
				local textColor = themeRuntime.baseText[object]
				if textColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.TextColor3 = textColor
					end)
				end
				local strokeColor = themeRuntime.baseStroke[object]
				if strokeColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = strokeColor
					end)
				end
				local imageColor = themeRuntime.baseImage[object]
				if imageColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.ImageColor3 = imageColor
					end)
				end
			end
			local function immersiveOwned(object)
				local current = object
				while current and current ~= mainGui do
					local name = current.Name
					if name == "LT_ImmersiveCustomizer" or name == "LT_ImmersiveTransition" or string.sub(name, 1, 6) == "LT_IUI" or string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "LT_FX" then
						return true
					end
					current = current.Parent
				end
				return false
			end
			local function applyObject(object, themeName)
				if object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay") or immersiveOwned(object) then
					return
				end
				capture(object)
				if themeName == "Default" then
					restoreObject(object)
					return
				end
				local palette = palettes[themeName]
				if not palette or isControlColorPart(object) then
					return
				end
				local background = themeRuntime.baseBackground[object]
				if background ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						if isAccent(object.BackgroundColor3) then
							return
						end
						object.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundRole(object, palette)
					end)
				end
				local textColor = themeRuntime.baseText[object]
				if textColor ~= nil then
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					pcall(function()
						object.TextColor3 = isAccent(textColor) and textColor
							or ((name == "desc" or name:find("description") or name:find("placeholder")) and palette.muted or palette.text)
					end)
				end
				local strokeColor = themeRuntime.baseStroke[object]
				if strokeColor ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = isAccent(strokeColor) and strokeColor or palette.stroke
					end)
				end
				local imageColor = themeRuntime.baseImage[object]
				if imageColor ~= nil then
					local _, saturation = Color3.toHSV(imageColor)
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					if saturation <= 0.28 or name == "checked" or name:find("icon") or name == "imagebutton" then
						pcall(function()
							object.ImageColor3 = isAccent(imageColor) and imageColor or (name == "checked" and palette.accent or palette.icon)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			local function getThemeDropdown()
				local executor = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
				local image = executor and executor:FindFirstChild("Executor")
				local overlay = image and image:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
				local menu = overlay and overlay:FindFirstChild("Menu", true)
				return menu and menu:FindFirstChild("Dropdown")
			end
			local themeMap = { Option1 = "Default", Option2 = "Light", Option3 = "Amoled" }
			local function syncChecks(themeName)
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				for optionName, name in themeMap do
					local option = dropdown and dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName)
					local checked = option and option:FindFirstChild("Checked", true)
					if checked and checked:IsA("GuiObject") then
						checked.Visible = name == themeName
					end
				end
			end
			local currentTheme = "Default"
			local applying = false
			local function applyTheme(themeName, persist)
				if applying or not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				themeName = themeName == "Light" and "Light" or themeName == "Amoled" and "Amoled" or "Default"
				applying = true
				currentTheme = themeName
				themeRuntime.current = themeName
				applyObject(mainGui, themeName)
				for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
					applyObject(object, themeName)
				end
				syncChecks(themeName)
				if persist then
					saveTheme(themeName)
				end
				applying = false
				if type(themeRuntime.fxRefresh) == "function" then
					pcall(themeRuntime.fxRefresh)
				end
				local iui = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime")
				if type(iui) == "table" and type(iui.onThemeChanged) == "function" then
					pcall(iui.onThemeChanged, themeName)
				end
				local sync = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaSyncTabColors")
				if type(sync) == "function" then
					pcall(sync)
				end
			end
			themeRuntime.applyTheme = applyTheme
			themeRuntime.stop = function()
				if not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				if currentTheme ~= "Default" then
					applyTheme("Default", false)
				end
				themeRuntime.alive = false
				for i = #themeRuntime.connections, 1, -1 do
					pcall(function()
						themeRuntime.connections[i]:Disconnect()
					end)
				end
				table.clear(themeRuntime.connections)
				if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime") == themeRuntime then
					__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeRuntime = nil
				end
			end
			local boundOptions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local function bindOption(option, themeName)
				if not (option and option:IsA("GuiButton")) or boundOptions[option] then
					return
				end
				boundOptions[option] = true
				local locked = false
				local function choose()
					if locked then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					task.defer(applyTheme, themeName, true)
					task.delay(0.12, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connectTheme(option.MouseButton1Click, choose)
				connectTheme(option.Activated, choose)
				connectTheme(option.TouchTap, choose)
			end
			local function bindThemeOptions()
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				if not dropdown then
					return
				end
				for optionName, themeName in themeMap do
					bindOption(dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName), themeName)
				end
			end
			bindThemeOptions()
			connectTheme(mainGui.DescendantAdded, function(object)
				task.defer(function()
					if not (themeRuntime.alive and object and object.Parent) then
						return
					end
					capture(object)
					if object:IsA("GuiObject") or object:IsA("UIStroke") then
						applyObject(object, currentTheme)
					end
					if object:IsA("GuiButton") and themeMap[object.Name] and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "Dropdown" then
						bindOption(object, themeMap[object.Name])
					end
				end)
			end)
			local fx = {
				acc = 0,
				state = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				selected = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				watch = {},
				accentColor = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(58, 64, 80),
				pressInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				releaseInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			}
			themeRuntime.fx = fx
			local fxTweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
			local fxRunService = game:GetService("RunService")
			local fxInput = game:GetService("UserInputService")
			local fxTouchOnly = fxInput.TouchEnabled and not fxInput.MouseEnabled

			function fx.tween(object, info, props)
				if not (object and object.Parent) then
					return nil
				end
				local ok, tween = pcall(function()
					local t = fxTweenService:Create(object, info, props)
					t:Play()
					return t
				end)
				return ok and tween or nil
			end

			function fx.apply(object, info, props, instant)
				if instant then
					for property, value in props do
						pcall(function()
							object[property] = value
						end)
					end
					return nil
				end
