	local function createToggleSetting(name, titleText, descText, initial, onChanged)
		local enabled = initial
		local row
		local button
		local shown = false
		local function refresh()
			if button and button.Parent then
				local activeColor = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
				local sidebar = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
				local activeValue = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild("ActiveColor")
				if activeValue and activeValue:IsA("Color3Value") then
					activeColor = activeValue.Value
				end
				local target = enabled and activeColor or __dcm_env.__DeltaOffColor()
				local fxr = __dcm_env.__DeltaRowFx
				if shown and fxr then
					fxr.play(button, fxr.colorInfo, { BackgroundColor3 = target })
					fxr.bump(button)
				else
					button.BackgroundColor3 = target
				end
				shown = true
				setButtonTitle(button, enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
			end
		end
		row, button = createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, "", function()
			enabled = not enabled
			refresh()
			onChanged(enabled)
		end)
		refresh()
		return row
	end

	local staleBlur = game:GetService("Lighting"):FindFirstChild("LT_DeltaBlur")
	if staleBlur then
		staleBlur:Destroy()
	end
	local oldSettings = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
	local oldHolder = oldSettings and oldSettings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
	if oldHolder then
		for _, name in { "LT_BackgroundBlur", "LT_BlurStrength" } do
			local row = oldHolder:FindFirstChild(name)
			if row then
				row:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	local editorSideMenu = executorRoot:FindFirstChild("Sidemenu")
	local originalEditorSize = executorImage.Size
	local originalEditorPosition = executorImage.Position
	local originalEditorAnchor = executorImage.AnchorPoint
	local originalSideVisible = editorSideMenu and editorSideMenu.Visible
	local originalTabSizes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local originalEditorText = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function applyWideEditor()
		if not (executorImage and executorImage.Parent) then
			return
		end
		if wideEditorEnabled then
			if editorSideMenu then
				editorSideMenu.Visible = false
			end
			executorImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, originalEditorAnchor.Y)
			executorImage.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, originalEditorPosition.Y.Scale, originalEditorPosition.Y.Offset)
			executorImage.Size = UDim2.new(0.995, 0, originalEditorSize.Y.Scale, originalEditorSize.Y.Offset)
		else
			if editorSideMenu then
				editorSideMenu.Visible = originalSideVisible
			end
			executorImage.AnchorPoint = originalEditorAnchor
			executorImage.Position = originalEditorPosition
			executorImage.Size = originalEditorSize
		end
		task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
	end
	local function applyTabStyle(tab)
		if not (tab and tab:IsA("ImageButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$")) then
			return
		end
		if originalTabSizes[tab] == nil then
			originalTabSizes[tab] = tab.Size
		end
		if compactTabsEnabled then
			tab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 126, originalTabSizes[tab].Y.Scale, originalTabSizes[tab].Y.Offset)
		else
			tab.Size = originalTabSizes[tab]
		end
		local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextSize = compactTabsEnabled and 11 or 14
		end
	end
	local function applyCompactTabs()
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			applyTabStyle(tab)
		end
	end
	local function applyEditorStyle(box)
		if not (box and box:IsA("TextBox") and box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$")) then
			return
		end
		if originalEditorText[box] == nil then
			originalEditorText[box] = { TextSize = box.TextSize, TextWrapped = box.TextWrapped }
		end
		box.TextSize = editorFontSize
		box.TextWrapped = editorWordWrapEnabled
		editorCanvas.resize(box)
		syntaxHighlighter.sync(box)
	end
	local function applyEditorPreferences()
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			applyEditorStyle(box)
		end
	end
	addRestorer(function()
		if executorImage and executorImage.Parent then
			executorImage.AnchorPoint = originalEditorAnchor
			executorImage.Position = originalEditorPosition
			executorImage.Size = originalEditorSize
		end
		if editorSideMenu and editorSideMenu.Parent then
			editorSideMenu.Visible = originalSideVisible
		end
		for tab, size in originalTabSizes do
			if tab and tab.Parent then
				tab.Size = size
			end
		end
		for box, values in originalEditorText do
			if box and box.Parent then
				box.TextSize = values.TextSize
				box.TextWrapped = values.TextWrapped
			end
		end
		syntaxHighlighter.restore()
		editorCanvas.restore()
	end)
	connect(tabsFrame.ChildAdded, function(tab)
		task.defer(applyTabStyle, tab)
		task.defer(bindManagedSelect, tab)
	end)
	local function createCycleSetting(name, titleText, descText, values, getValue, setValue, formatValue)
		local row
		local button
		local function refresh()
			if button and button.Parent then
				setButtonTitle(button, formatValue(getValue()))
			end
		end
		row, button = createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, "", function()
			local current = getValue()
			local index = table.find(values, current) or 0
			local nextValue = values[(index % #values) + 1]
			setValue(nextValue)
			refresh()
		end)
		refresh()
		return row
	end


	local kbInset = 0
	local kbBaseSize, kbBasePos
	local kbCursorConn
	local kbRevealToken = 0
	local function kbScale()
		local scale = 1
		local current = executorRoot
		while current do
			for _, child in current:GetChildren() do
				if child:IsA("UIScale") then
					scale *= child.Scale
				end
			end
			if current:IsA("LayerCollector") then
				break
			end
			current = current.Parent
		end
		return math.max(scale, 0.05)
	end
	local function revealCaret(box)
		if not (runtime.alive and box and box.Parent and box:IsA("TextBox") and box:IsDescendantOf(codeFrame)) then
			return
		end
		kbRevealToken += 1
		local token = kbRevealToken
		task.delay(0.12, function()
			if not (runtime.alive and token == kbRevealToken and box.Parent and box:IsFocused()) then
				return
			end
			local cursor = tonumber(box.CursorPosition) or -1
			if cursor < 1 then
				return
			end
			local scale = kbScale()
			local prefix = (box.Text or ""):sub(1, cursor - 1)
			local lineHeight = math.max(1, box.LineHeight) * box.TextSize
			local bounds
			if #prefix <= 40000 then
				local params = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				params.Text = prefix .. "|"
				params.Width = box.TextWrapped and math.max(120, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / scale) - 20)
					or 1000000
				params.Font = box.FontFace
				params.Size = box.TextSize
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextBoundsAsync(params)
				end)
				params:Destroy()
				if ok then
					bounds = result
				end
			end
			if not bounds then
				local _, breaks = prefix:gsub("\n", "\n")
				bounds = Vector2.new(0, (breaks + 1) * lineHeight)
			end
			if not (runtime.alive and token == kbRevealToken and box.Parent and box:IsFocused()) then
				return
			end
			local caretBottom = box.Position.Y.Offset + bounds.Y
			local caretTop = caretBottom - lineHeight
			local windowHeight = codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / scale
			local current = codeFrame.CanvasPosition
			local nextY = current.Y
			if caretTop - lineHeight < current.Y then
				nextY = caretTop - lineHeight
			elseif caretBottom + lineHeight > current.Y + windowHeight then
				nextY = caretBottom + lineHeight - windowHeight
			end
			nextY = math.max(0, nextY)
			if math.abs(nextY - current.Y) > 0.5 then
				codeFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(current.X, nextY)
			end
		end)
	end
	local kbBaseBottom, kbBaseHeight, kbLastTop, kbKnownRatio
	local kbExpectUntil = 0
	local function kbVisible()
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			return UIS.OnScreenKeyboardVisible
		end)
		return ok and v == true
	end
	local function kbViewportHeight()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		return cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y or 0
	end
	local function kbOffsetY()
		local gui = executorRoot:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
		if gui and gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and not gui.IgnoreGuiInset then
			return game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y
		end
		return 0
	end
	local function captureKbBaseline()
		if kbInset > 0 or kbVisible() or not (executorImage and executorImage.Parent) then
			return
		end
		if executorImage.AbsoluteSize.Y < 50 then
			return
		end
		kbBaseBottom = executorImage.AbsolutePosition.Y + executorImage.AbsoluteSize.Y + kbOffsetY()
		kbBaseHeight = executorImage.AbsoluteSize.Y
	end
	local function computeKeyboardInset()
		if not (executorImage and executorImage.Parent) then
			return 0
		end
		local box = UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
		local focusedCode = box and box:IsDescendantOf(codeFrame)
		if not (focusedCode or kbInset > 0) then
			return 0
		end
		local visible = kbVisible()
		if not visible and not (focusedCode and os.clock() < kbExpectUntil) then
			return 0
		end
		captureKbBaseline()
		if not kbBaseBottom then
			return kbInset
		end
		local viewport = kbViewportHeight()
		local keyboardTop
		if visible then
			local pos, size = UIS.OnScreenKeyboardPosition, UIS.OnScreenKeyboardSize
			if pos.Y > 0 and size.Y > 0 then
				keyboardTop = pos.Y
				if viewport > 0 then
					kbKnownRatio = keyboardTop / viewport
				end
				if kbLastTop and kbInset > 0 and math.abs(keyboardTop - kbLastTop) < 24 then
					return kbInset
				end
				kbLastTop = keyboardTop
			end
		end
		if not keyboardTop then
			if viewport <= 0 then
				return kbInset
			end
			keyboardTop = viewport * (kbKnownRatio or 0.42)
		end
		local overlap = kbBaseBottom - keyboardTop
		if overlap <= 0 then
			return 0
		end
		return math.floor(math.min(overlap, kbBaseHeight * 0.62) / kbScale())
	end
	local function applyKeyboardInset(inset)
		if inset == kbInset then
			return
		end
		if inset > 0 and kbInset > 0 then
			local diff = inset - kbInset
			if (diff > 0 and diff < 4) or (diff < 0 and -diff < 24) then
				return
			end
		end
		local previous = kbInset
		kbInset = inset
		if inset == 0 then
			kbLastTop = nil
		end
		if not (executorImage and executorImage.Parent) then
			return
		end
		if previous == 0 or not kbBaseSize then
			kbBaseSize, kbBasePos = executorImage.Size, executorImage.Position
		end
		if inset == 0 then
			executorImage.Size = kbBaseSize
			executorImage.Position = kbBasePos
			kbBaseSize, kbBasePos = nil, nil
		else
			local b, p = kbBaseSize, kbBasePos
			executorImage.Size = UDim2.new(b.X.Scale, b.X.Offset, b.Y.Scale, b.Y.Offset - inset)
			executorImage.Position =
				UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset - executorImage.AnchorPoint.Y * inset)
		end
	end
	local function updateKeyboardLayout()
		if not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		applyKeyboardInset(computeKeyboardInset())
		local box = UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
		if box and box:IsDescendantOf(codeFrame) then
			revealCaret(box)
		end
	end
	local function releaseKbCursor()
		if kbCursorConn then
			kbCursorConn:Disconnect()
			kbCursorConn = nil
		end
	end
	local kbPending = false
	local function scheduleKeyboardLayout()
		if kbPending then
			return
		end
		kbPending = true
		task.delay(0.08, function()
			kbPending = false
			updateKeyboardLayout()
		end)
	end
	connect(executorImage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), captureKbBaseline)
	connect(executorImage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"), captureKbBaseline)
	task.delay(1, captureKbBaseline)
	connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardVisible"), function()
		scheduleKeyboardLayout()
		task.delay(0.4, scheduleKeyboardLayout)
	end)
	connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardSize"), scheduleKeyboardLayout)
	connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardPosition"), scheduleKeyboardLayout)
	connect(UIS.TextBoxFocused, function(box)
		if not (box and box:IsDescendantOf(codeFrame)) then
			return
		end
		releaseKbCursor()
		kbCursorConn = box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CursorPosition"):Connect(function()
			revealCaret(box)
		end)
		if UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled then
			kbExpectUntil = os.clock() + 1.2
		end
		captureKbBaseline()
		updateKeyboardLayout()
		task.delay(0.5, scheduleKeyboardLayout)
		task.delay(1.3, scheduleKeyboardLayout)
	end)
	connect(UIS.TextBoxFocusReleased, function()
		releaseKbCursor()
		task.delay(0.3, scheduleKeyboardLayout)
	end)
	addRestorer(function()
		releaseKbCursor()
		if kbBaseSize and executorImage and executorImage.Parent then
			executorImage.Size = kbBaseSize
			executorImage.Position = kbBasePos
		end
		kbBaseSize, kbBasePos = nil, nil
		kbInset = 0
	end)

	connect(codeFrame.DescendantAdded, function(object)

	local addTabButton = tabsFrame:FindFirstChild("AddTab")

					createFallbackTab(nextAvailableTabName())

	connect(codeFrame.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
		queueStatusUpdate()
		task.delay(0.12, normalizeTabSequence)
		if not object:IsA("TextBox") or not object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
			return
		end
		local name = object.Name
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			if
				not runtime.alive
				or not v2Main.Parent
				or not tabsFrame.Parent
				or not codeFrame.Parent
			then
				return
			end
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				if box.Name == name then
					return
				end
			end
			if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
				local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. name
				if isfile(path) then
					pcall(delfile, path)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)

			object:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
			runtime.originalButtons[object] = true
			object.Visible = true
			task.defer(function()
				if runtime.alive and object.Parent == buttonsFrame then
					buildToolbar()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	task.wait(0.7)

	if autoRestoreEnabled then

	end

	-- [v100 custom editor] replaces Delta's editor: own tabs, multiline editing, highlighting, reader/compiler/executor via the shared pipeline
	xpcall(function()
		local P = __dcm_env.__DeltaPipeline
		if not (P and executorOverlay and executorOverlay.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local DIR, FILE = "DeltaCustom", "DeltaCustom/CustomEditor.json"
		local BG, PANEL, LINE = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26), Color3.fromRGB(26, 29, 38), Color3.fromRGB(48, 53, 68)
		local TXT, DIM = Color3.fromRGB(222, 228, 240), Color3.fromRGB(124, 132, 152)
		local GREEN, RED, ACTIVE = Color3.fromRGB(92, 214, 140), Color3.fromRGB(255, 104, 104), Color3.fromRGB(40, 46, 64)
		local E = { tabs = {}, active = 1, lines = 1, msgUntil = 0 }
		local enabled = readBool("CustomEditor", false)

		local function accent()
			local R = __dcm_env.__DeltaRowFx
			return R and R.accent() or Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
		end
		local function mk(class, parent, props)
			local o = Instance.new(class)
			for k, v in pairs(props) do
				o[k] = v
			end
			o.Parent = parent
			return o
		end
		local function corner(o, r)
			mk("UICorner", o, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6) })
		end

		-- persistence (debounced autosave; first run imports Delta's own tabs)
		local function loadSaved()
			if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
				return false
			end
			local okF, ex = pcall(isfile, FILE)
			if not (okF and ex) then
				return false
			end
			local okR, raw = pcall(readfile, FILE)
			if not (okR and type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "") then
				return false
			end
			local okD, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, raw)
			if not (okD and type(data) == "table" and type(data.tabs) == "table" and #data.tabs > 0) then
				return false
			end
			for i, t in ipairs(data.tabs) do
				E.tabs[i] = { name = tostring(t.name or ("script" .. i .. ".lua")), text = type(t.text) == "string" and t.text or "" }
			end
			E.active = math.clamp(tonumber(data.active) or 1, 1, #E.tabs)
			return true
		end
		local function flush()
			if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder(DIR) then
					makefolder(DIR)
				end
				writefile(FILE, HS:JSONEncode({ active = E.active, tabs = E.tabs }))
			end)
		end
		local saveToken = 0
		local function save()
			saveToken += 1
			local my = saveToken
			task.delay(1.2, function()
				if my == saveToken and runtime.alive then
					flush()
				end
			end)
		end
		if not loadSaved() then
			task.wait(1)
			for _, native in ipairs(getCodeBoxes()) do
				E.tabs[#E.tabs + 1] = { name = native.Name, text = native.Text or "" }
			end
			if #E.tabs == 0 then
				E.tabs[1] = { name = "script1.lua", text = "" }
			end
		end
		if not runtime.alive then
			return
		end

		-- UI
		local root = mk("Frame", executorOverlay, {
			Name = "LT_CustomEditor", BackgroundColor3 = BG, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 40, ClipsDescendants = true, Visible = enabled,
		})
		track(root)
		corner(root, 8)
		local tabBar = mk("ScrollingFrame", root, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28),
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
			ScrollBarThickness = 0, ZIndex = 41,
		})
		mk("UIListLayout", tabBar, { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center })
		local toolbar = mk("Frame", root, { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 42), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28), ZIndex = 41 })
		local tools = mk("ScrollingFrame", toolbar, { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 1, 0), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X, ScrollBarThickness = 0, ZIndex = 41 })
		mk("UIListLayout", tools, { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center })
		local statusLabel = mk("TextLabel", toolbar, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 1, 0),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = DIM, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 41, Text = "",
		})
		local GUT = 46
		local gutter = mk("Frame", root, { BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 76), Size = UDim2.new(0, GUT, 1, -84), ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 41 })
		corner(gutter, 6)
		local gutterLabel = mk("TextLabel", gutter, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = DIM, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Text = "1", ZIndex = 42,
		})
		local scroller = mk("ScrollingFrame", root, {
			BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8 + GUT + 4, 76), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(16 + GUT + 4), 1, -84),
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.XY, ScrollBarThickness = 6, ScrollBarImageColor3 = LINE,
			ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never, ZIndex = 41,
		})
		corner(scroller, 6)
		mk("UIStroke", scroller, { Color = LINE, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4 })
		local function textProps(extra)
			local t = { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300) }
			for k, v in pairs(extra) do
				t[k] = v
			end
			return t
		end
		local overlay = mk("TextLabel", scroller, textProps({ RichText = true, TextColor3 = TXT, Text = "", ZIndex = 41, Interactable = false }))
		mk("UIPadding", overlay, { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		local box = mk("TextBox", scroller, textProps({ MultiLine = true, ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextColor3 = TXT, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "-- write or paste a script here", PlaceholderColor3 = DIM, ZIndex = 42 }))
		mk("UIPadding", box, { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6) })

		local function setStatus(text, color, hold)
			statusLabel.Text = text
			statusLabel.TextColor3 = color or DIM
			E.msgUntil = os.clock() + (hold or 0)
		end
		local function layout()
			local tb, win = box.TextBounds, scroller.AbsoluteWindowSize
			local w, h = math.max(win.X - 8, tb.X + 48), math.max(win.Y - 8, tb.Y + 36)
			box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
			overlay.Size = box.Size
			scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		end
		local function refresh()
			local text = box.Text
			local n, pos = 1, 0
			while true do
				pos = string.find(text, "\n", pos + 1, true)
				if not pos then
					break
				end
				n += 1
			end
			if n ~= E.lines then
				E.lines = n
				local nums = table.create(math.min(n, 50000))
				for i = 1, math.min(n, 50000) do
					nums[i] = i
				end
				gutterLabel.Text = table.concat(nums, "\n")
			end
			local shown = false
			if syntaxHighlightEnabled and text ~= "" and #text <= 70000 and syntaxHighlighter.rich then
				local rich, col = syntaxHighlighter.rich(text)
				if rich and #rich <= 190000 then
					overlay.Text = rich
					overlay.TextColor3 = col or TXT
					shown = true
				end
			end
			overlay.Visible = shown
			box.TextTransparency = shown and 1 or 0
			layout()
			if os.clock() >= E.msgUntil then
				local base = string.format("%s   •   %d lines   •   %d chars", E.tabs[E.active].name, n, #text)
				local syn = E.syn
				if syn and syn.text == text then
					statusLabel.Text = base .. "   •   " .. syn.msg
					statusLabel.TextColor3 = syn.ok and GREEN or RED
				else
					statusLabel.Text = base
					statusLabel.TextColor3 = DIM
				end
			end
		end
		local token = 0
		local function schedule()
			token += 1
			local my = token
			local delay = math.max(#box.Text > 60000 and 0.08 or 0.025, __dcm_env.__DeltaFastExec.remaining())
			task.delay(delay, function()
				if my == token and runtime.alive and root.Parent then
					refresh()
				end
			end)
		end
		local function followCursor()
			local cp = box.CursorPosition
			if cp < 1 then
				return
			end
			local text = box.Text
			local line, pos = 1, 0
			while true do
				local nl = string.find(text, "\n", pos + 1, true)
				if not nl or nl >= cp then
					break
				end
				line += 1
				pos = nl
			end
			local lineH = (text ~= "" and box.TextBounds.Y > 0) and (box.TextBounds.Y / math.max(E.lines, 1)) or (box.TextSize + 2)
			local y = 6 + (line - 1) * lineH
			local cur, winH = scroller.CanvasPosition, scroller.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y
			if y < cur.Y then
				scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(cur.X, y)
			elseif y + lineH + 6 > cur.Y + winH then
				scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(cur.X, y + lineH + 6 - winH)
			end
		end
		local precompile
		local preToken = 0
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
			E.tabs[E.active].text = box.Text
			schedule()
			save()
			if precompile then
				precompile()
			end
		end)
		local curQueued = false
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CursorPosition"), function()
			if curQueued then
				return
			end
			curQueued = true
			task.defer(function()
				curQueued = false
				followCursor()
			end)
		end)
		connect(scroller:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"), function()
			gutterLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6 - scroller.CanvasPosition.Y)
		end)
		connect(scroller:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"), layout)

		-- tabs
		local renderTabs
		local function switchTo(i)
			if not E.tabs[i] then
				return
			end
			E.active = i
			box.Text = E.tabs[i].text
			scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			renderTabs()
			refresh()
			save()
		end
		local function addTab(name, text)
			local nextN = 0
			for _, t in ipairs(E.tabs) do
				nextN = math.max(nextN, tonumber(t.name:match("^script(%d+)%.lua$")) or 0)
			end
			E.tabs[#E.tabs + 1] = { name = name or ("script" .. (nextN + 1) .. ".lua"), text = text or "" }
			switchTo(#E.tabs)
		end
		local function closeTab(i)
			if #E.tabs <= 1 then
				return
			end
			table.remove(E.tabs, i)
			switchTo(math.clamp(E.active > i and E.active - 1 or E.active, 1, #E.tabs))
		end
		renderTabs = function()
			for _, c in ipairs(tabBar:GetChildren()) do
				if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then
					c:Destroy()
				end
			end
			for i, t in ipairs(E.tabs) do
				local on = i == E.active
				local item = mk("Frame", tabBar, { AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = on and ACTIVE or PANEL, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 41 })
				corner(item, 6)
				if on then
					mk("UIStroke", item, { Color = accent(), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.35 })
				end
				mk("UIListLayout", item, { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
				local nameBtn = mk("TextButton", item, {
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t.name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
					TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = on and TXT or DIM, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 42,
				})
				mk("UIPadding", nameBtn, { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, #E.tabs > 1 and 4 or 10) })
				nameBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					local now = os.clock()
					if E.active == i and E.tapped == i and now - (E.tapAt or 0) < 0.45 then
						E.tapped = nil
						local field = mk("TextBox", item, {
							Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(nameBtn.AbsoluteSize.X, 96), 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = BG, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = t.name,
							Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = TXT, ClearTextOnFocus = false, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 43,
						})
						nameBtn.Visible = false
						field:CaptureFocus()
						field.FocusLost:Once(function()
							local clean = string.sub((string.gsub(field.Text, "[^%w%._%- ]", "")), 1, 40)
							if clean ~= "" and E.tabs[i] then
								E.tabs[i].name = clean
							end
							renderTabs()
							refresh()
							save()
						end)
						return
					end
					E.tapped, E.tapAt = i, now
					if E.active ~= i then
						switchTo(i)
					end
				end)
				if #E.tabs > 1 then
					local x = mk("TextButton", item, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "×", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = DIM, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 42 })
					x.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						closeTab(i)
					end)
				end
			end
			local plus = mk("TextButton", tabBar, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "+", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = accent(), LayoutOrder = 9999, ZIndex = 42 })
			corner(plus, 6)
			plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				addTab()
			end)
		end

		-- toolbar: Execute goes reader -> compiler -> executor through the shared pipeline
		local function toolButton(text, width, color, order, callback)
			local b = mk("TextButton", tools, {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), AutoButtonColor = true, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 42,
			})
			corner(b, 6)
			connect(b.MouseButton1Click, callback)
			return b
		end
		local running = false
		local execButton
		local function runSource(src, name)
			if running then
				return
			end
			if src:find("%S") == nil then
				setStatus("Nothing to execute", DIM, 2)
				return
			end
			running = true
			P.execute({ text = src, chunk = "=" .. name }, function(stage, where, detail, ms)
				if stage == "Failed" then
					running = false
					local msg = tostring(detail or "unknown error")
					warn("[DeltaCustomEditor] " .. tostring(where) .. " error in " .. name .. ":\n" .. msg)
					setStatus(tostring(where) .. " error: " .. (msg:match("^[^\n]*") or msg), RED, 8)
					notify({ Title = "Delta " .. tostring(where) .. " error", Description = __dcm_boot.clip(msg), Duration = 7 })
					execButton.Text = "FAILED"
				elseif stage == "Done" then
					running = false
					setStatus(string.format("Executed %s   •   compiled in %d ms", name, math.floor((ms or 0) + 0.5)), GREEN, 4)
					execButton.Text = "DONE"
				else
					setStatus(stage .. "…", accent(), 30)
					execButton.Text = stage:upper()
					return
				end
				task.delay(1.1, function()
					if execButton.Parent then
						execButton.Text = "EXECUTE"
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
		local function execute()
			runSource(box.Text, E.tabs[E.active].name)
		end
		-- idle precompile: the open tab is compiled into the shared cache after a pause, so EXECUTE is a cache hit and the status shows the syntax state
		precompile = function()
			if not P.cached() then
				return
			end
			preToken = preToken + 1
			local my = preToken
			task.delay(1.3, function()
				if my ~= preToken or running or not runtime.alive or not root.Parent then
					return
				end
				local text = box.Text
				if #text > 150000 or text:find("%S") == nil then
					E.syn = nil
					return
				end
				local name = E.tabs[E.active].name
				local fn, err = P.compile(text, "=" .. name)
				if fn then
					E.syn = { text = text, ok = true, msg = "ready" }
				else
					local line = P.errorLine(err)
					E.syn = { text = text, ok = false, msg = line and ("syntax error, line " .. line) or "syntax error" }
				end
				if box.Text == text and os.clock() >= E.msgUntil then
					statusLabel.Text = string.format("%s   •   %d lines   •   %d chars   •   %s", name, E.lines, #text, E.syn.msg)
					statusLabel.TextColor3 = E.syn.ok and GREEN or RED
				end
			end)
		end
		execButton = toolButton("EXECUTE", 84, Color3.fromRGB(45, 125, 88), 1, execute)
		connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F5 and enabled and box:IsFocused() then
				execute()
			end
		end)
		toolButton("CLEAR", 58, Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75), 2, function()
			box.Text = ""
			setStatus("Cleared " .. E.tabs[E.active].name, DIM, 2)
		end)
		toolButton("COPY", 54, Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75), 3, function()
			local text = box.Text
			local a, b = box.SelectionStart, box.CursorPosition
			if a ~= -1 and b ~= -1 and a ~= b then
				text = text:sub(math.min(a, b), math.max(a, b) - 1)
			end
			writeClipboard(text)
			setStatus("Copied " .. #text .. " chars", DIM, 2)
		end)
		toolButton("PASTE", 58, Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75), 4, function()
			local value = readClipboard()
			if type(value) ~= "string" then
				setStatus("Clipboard access unavailable - use the keyboard paste", RED, 4)
				return
			end
			local text, cp = box.Text, box.CursorPosition
			if cp < 1 then
				cp = #text + 1
			end
			box.Text = text:sub(1, cp - 1) .. value .. text:sub(cp)
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(function()
					box:CaptureFocus()
					box.CursorPosition = cp + #value
					box.SelectionStart = -1
				end)
			end)
		end)
		toolButton("RUN CLIP", 74, Color3.fromRGB(56, 103, 154), 5, function()
			executeClipboardCode()
		end)
		toolButton("CHECK", 58, Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75), 6, function()
			local text = box.Text
			if text:find("%S") == nil then
				setStatus("Nothing to check", DIM, 2)
				return
			end
			local fn, err, ms = P.load({ text = text, chunk = "=" .. E.tabs[E.active].name })
			if fn then
				E.syn = { text = text, ok = true, msg = "ready" }
				setStatus(string.format("Compiled OK   •   %d ms", math.floor((ms or 0) + 0.5)), GREEN, 4)
			else
				local line = P.errorLine(err)
				E.syn = { text = text, ok = false, msg = line and ("syntax error, line " .. line) or "syntax error" }
				setStatus("Compile error: " .. (tostring(err):match("^[^\n]*") or tostring(err)), RED, 8)
			end
		end)
		toolButton("RUN SEL", 70, Color3.fromRGB(56, 103, 154), 7, function()
			local a, b = box.SelectionStart, box.CursorPosition
			if a == -1 or b == -1 or a == b then
				setStatus("Select some code first", DIM, 2)
				return
			end
			runSource(box.Text:sub(math.min(a, b), math.max(a, b) - 1), E.tabs[E.active].name .. " (selection)")
		end)

		-- native editor handling: Delta's editor frames stay hidden while the custom editor is active, and Delta's own Execute / Execute Clipboard
		-- connections are switched off through getconnections (re-enabled when the custom editor is turned off)
		local hidden, guarded, silenced = {}, {}, setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local function silenceNative(on)
			if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then
				return 0
			end
			local count = 0
			for _, bname in ipairs({ "Execute", "ExecuteClipboard" }) do
				local b = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(bname)
				if b and b:IsA("GuiButton") then
					for _, sname in ipairs({ "MouseButton1Click", "Activated", "TouchTap" }) do
						local okC, list = pcall(getconnections, b[sname])
						if okC and type(list) == "table" then
							for _, c in ipairs(list) do
								if on then
									if not silenced[c] and pcall(function()
										c:Disable()
									end) then
										silenced[c] = true
										count += 1
									end
								elseif silenced[c] then
									pcall(function()
										c:Enable()
									end)
									silenced[c] = nil
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return count
		end
		local function guard(o)
			if o and not guarded[o] then
				guarded[o] = true
				connect(o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
					if enabled and o.Visible then
						hidden[o] = true
						o.Visible = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		local function applyMode()
			root.Visible = enabled
			for _, o in ipairs({ tabsFrame, codeFrame, buttonsFrame }) do
				if enabled then
					if hidden[o] == nil then
						hidden[o] = o.Visible
					end
					o.Visible = false
					guard(o)
				elseif hidden[o] ~= nil then
					o.Visible = hidden[o]
				end
			end
			if statusFrame then
				if enabled then
					statusFrame.Visible = false
					guard(statusFrame)
				else
					queueStatusUpdate()
				end
			end
			local n = silenceNative(enabled)
			E.silenced = enabled and ((E.silenced or 0) + n) or 0
		end
		addRestorer(function()
			flush()
			enabled = false
			applyMode()
		end)
		createToggleSetting(
			"LT_CustomEditor",
			"Custom editor",
			"Replaces Delta's editor with the customizer's own editor, reader, compiler and executor (off brings Delta's editor back)",
			enabled,
			function(v)
				enabled = v
				saveBool("CustomEditor", v)
				applyMode()
			end
		)
		__dcm_env.__DeltaEditor = {
			open = function(name, text)
				addTab(name, text)
			end,
			execute = execute,
			isActive = function()
				return enabled
			end,
			info = function()
				return { active = enabled, nativeConnectionsSilenced = E.silenced or 0, pipeline = P.caps(), stats = P.stats() }
			end,
		}
		box.Text = E.tabs[E.active].text
		renderTabs()
		applyMode()
		if enabled then
			warn("[DeltaCustomEditor] active; Delta's own Execute connections silenced: " .. tostring(E.silenced or 0) .. (type(getconnections) == "function" and "" or " (getconnections unavailable - native editor only hidden)"))
		end
		task.defer(function()
			refresh()
		end)
	end, function(e)
		warn("[DeltaCustomEditor] init failed: " .. tostring(e))
	end)
end

--[[
    Delta Customizer - Immersive UI Upgrade
    Adds:
      * 10 ambient UI animations
      * 10 transition styles
      * transition-only depth blur
      * 5 visual style presets
      * persistent customization controls
      * lightweight runtime + cleanup hooks
]]
do
    local __iuiParent = mainGui or root
    if not __iuiParent then
        return
    end

    local __oldIUI = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime")
    if type(__oldIUI) == "table" and type(__oldIUI.stop) == "function" then
        pcall(__oldIUI.stop)
    end

    local __iui = {
        alive = true,
        objects = {},
        connections = {},
        pageConnections = {},
        styled = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
        original = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
        scales = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
        currentPage = nil,
        transitionBusy = false,
        transitionToken = 0,
        animationTime = 0,
        parallax = Vector2.zero,
        defaultsCaptured = false,
    }

    __dcm_env.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = __iui
    __dcm_shared.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = __iui

    local function track(obj)
        if obj then
            __iui.objects[obj] = true
            if __dcm_masterRuntime and type(__dcm_masterRuntime.registerCustom) == "function" then
                pcall(__dcm_masterRuntime.registerCustom, obj)
            end
        end
        return obj
    end

    local function connect(signal, callback)
        if not signal then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, c = pcall(function()
            return signal:Connect(callback)
        end)
        if ok and c then
            table.insert(__iui.connections, c)
            return c
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function disconnect(c)
        if c then
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
    end

    local function hasParent(obj)
        return obj and obj.Parent ~= nil
    end

    local function isUiObject(obj)
        return obj and typeof(obj) == "Instance" and obj:IsA("GuiObject")
    end

    local function clamp01(v)
        return math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
    end

    local function lerpColor(a, b, alpha)
        alpha = clamp01(alpha)
        return Color3.new(
            a.R + (b.R - a.R) * alpha,
            a.G + (b.G - a.G) * alpha,
            a.B + (b.B - a.B) * alpha
        )
    end

    local function readImmersiveConfig()
        local config = {}
        if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile("DeltaCustom/ImmersiveUI.json") then
            local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, "DeltaCustom/ImmersiveUI.json")
            if ok and type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
                local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
                    if HS and HS.JSONDecode then
                        return HS:JSONDecode(raw)
                    end
                    return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
                end)
                if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" then
                    config = decoded
                end
            end
        end
        return config
    end

    local function saveImmersiveConfig(config)
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            ensureDir("DeltaCustom")
            local encoded = HS and HS.JSONEncode and HS:JSONEncode(config) or __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONEncode", config)
            writefile("DeltaCustom/ImmersiveUI.json", encoded)
        end)
    end

    local __iuiConfig = readImmersiveConfig()

    -- [PRISM] device profile: touch layout + low-end mode (static gradients/rails off, slower effect loop)
    __iui.touch = (UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled) and true or false
    do
        local okQ, q = pcall(function()
            return UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").SavedQualityLevel.Value
        end)
        __iui.lowEnd = __iuiConfig.lowEnd == true
    end

    local styles = {
        Obsidian = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(8, 9, 13),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 25),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 38),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(31, 35, 49),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(104, 136, 255),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(171, 112, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 253),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(148, 157, 179),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(60, 67, 90),
            corner = 16,
            transparency = 0.03,
        },
        Aurora = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(7, 13, 23),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(14, 24, 38),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 36, 55),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(26, 42, 63),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(64, 224, 208),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(246, 251, 255),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(152, 177, 204),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(58, 98, 134),
            corner = 18,
            transparency = 0.05,
        },
        Glass = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(26, 33, 45),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 47, 62),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(50, 60, 77),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(150, 212, 255),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 176, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(251, 253, 255),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(184, 196, 213),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(140, 162, 192),
            corner = 20,
            transparency = 0.18,
        },
        Crimson = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(13, 7, 10),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 19),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 19, 26),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(52, 23, 31),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 84, 110),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 84),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 250),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(204, 163, 172),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(124, 62, 76),
            corner = 15,
            transparency = 0.04,
        },
        Neon = {
            bg = Color3.fromRGB(3, 8, 11),
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(7, 16, 20),
            panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 24, 29),
            button = Color3.fromRGB(12, 31, 37),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 214),
            accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 146, 255),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(236, 255, 252),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(132, 190, 182),
            stroke = Color3.fromRGB(26, 126, 112),
            corner = 12,
            transparency = 0.02,
        },
    }

    local styleNames = { "Obsidian", "Aurora", "Glass", "Crimson", "Neon" }
    local animationNames = {
        "Breathing",
        "Floating",
        "Pulse",
        "Aurora Sweep",
        "Shimmer",
        "Icon Drift",
        "Orbit Glow",
        "Scanline",
        "Parallax",
        "Cinematic",
    }
    local transitionNames = {
        "Fade Through",
        "Slide Left",
        "Slide Right",
        "Slide Up",
        "Slide Down",
        "Zoom In",
        "Zoom Out",
        "Flip",
        "Wipe",
        "Pulse Burst",
    }

    local function findIndex(list, value, fallback)
        local n = table.find(list, value)
        return n or fallback or 1
    end

    local styleIndex = findIndex(styleNames, __iuiConfig.style, 1)
    local animationIndex = findIndex(animationNames, __iuiConfig.animation, 1)
    local transitionIndex = findIndex(transitionNames, __iuiConfig.transition, 1)
    local transitionBlurEnabled = __iuiConfig.transitionBlur ~= false
    local animationIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(__iuiConfig.intensity) or 1, 0.25, 1.25)
    local uiEnabled = __iuiConfig.enabled ~= false

    __iui.themedStyle = function(base)
        local palette = __dcm_env.__DeltaThemePalette()
        local rt = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime")
        __iui.themeName = type(rt) == "table" and rt.current or "Default"
        if not palette then
            return base
        end
        local merged = table.clone(base)
        merged.__base = base
        merged.bg = palette.root
        merged.panel = palette.panel
        merged.panel2 = palette.card
        merged.button = palette.card
        merged.text = palette.text
        merged.muted = palette.muted
        merged.stroke = palette.stroke
        merged.icon = palette.icon
        return merged
    end

    local style = __iui.themedStyle(styles[styleNames[styleIndex]])

    local function saveState()
        saveImmersiveConfig({
            enabled = uiEnabled,
            style = styleNames[styleIndex],
            animation = animationNames[animationIndex],
            transition = transitionNames[transitionIndex],
            transitionBlur = transitionBlurEnabled,
            intensity = animationIntensity,
        })
    end

    local function findDescendant(name)
        if __iuiParent and __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
            return __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function capture(object, property)
        if not object then
            return
        end
        local values = __iui.original[object]
        if not values then
            values = {}
            __iui.original[object] = values
        end
        if values[property] ~= nil then
            return
        end
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return object[property]
        end)
        if ok then
            values[property] = value
        end
    end

    local function setTracked(object, property, value)
        if not object then
            return
        end
        capture(object, property)
        pcall(function()
            object[property] = value
        end)
    end

    local function ensureCorner(object, radius)
        if not isUiObject(object) then
            return nil
        end
        local corner = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUICorner")
        if not corner then
            corner = track(Instance.new("UICorner"))
            corner.Name = "LT_IUICorner"
            corner.Parent = object
        end
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
        return corner
    end

    local function ensureStroke(object, color, thickness)
        if not isUiObject(object) then
            return nil
        end
        local stroke = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
        if not stroke then
            stroke = track(Instance.new("UIStroke"))
            stroke.Name = "LT_IUIStroke"
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Parent = object
        end
        stroke.Color = color
        stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
        stroke.Transparency = 0.42
        return stroke
    end

    local function ensureGradient(object, c1, c2)
        if not isUiObject(object) then
            return nil
        end
        if __iui.lowEnd then
            local old = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIGradient")
            if old then
                old:Destroy()
            end
            return nil
        end
        local gradient = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIGradient")
        if not gradient then
            gradient = track(Instance.new("UIGradient"))
            gradient.Name = "LT_IUIGradient"
            gradient.Parent = object
        end
        gradient.Rotation = 135
        gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, lerpColor(c1, c2, 0.45)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c2),
        })
        gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.16),
        })
        return gradient
    end

    local function isCodeObject(object)
        if not object then
            return false
        end
        local n = string.lower(object.Name or "")
        return n == "code"
            or n:find("editor", 1, true) ~= nil
            or n:find("syntax", 1, true) ~= nil
            or n:match("^script%d+%.lua$") ~= nil
    end

    local function shouldStyle(object)
        if not isUiObject(object) or isCodeObject(object) then
            return false
        end
        if object:GetAttribute("LT_NoImmersiveStyle") then
            return false
        end
        return object:IsA("Frame")
            or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
            or object:IsA("TextButton")
            or object:IsA("ImageButton")
            or object:IsA("TextLabel")
            or object:IsA("ImageLabel")
            or (object:IsA("TextBox") and object.Name == "ValueBox")
    end

    __iui.isColoredState = function(color)
        local _, s, v = Color3.toHSV(color)
        return s >= 0.45 and v >= 0.35
    end

    local function textOn(color)
        local lum = 0.299 * color.R + 0.587 * color.G + 0.114 * color.B
        return lum > 0.6 and Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 20) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end

    local function inSection(object)
        local p = object.Parent
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            if not p or p == __iuiParent then
                return false
            end
            if p.Name:sub(1, 8) == "Section_" then
                return true
            end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function styleNativeStroke(object, color, transparency)
        local native = object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
        if native then
            setTracked(native, "Color", color)
            setTracked(native, "Transparency", transparency)
            setTracked(native, "Thickness", 1)
        else
            local s = ensureStroke(object, color, 1)
            if s then
                s.Transparency = transparency
            end
        end
    end

    local function ensureRail(object, strong)
        local rail = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIRail")
        if __iui.lowEnd or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout") or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridLayout") then
            if rail then
                rail:Destroy()
            end
            return
        end
        if not rail then
            rail = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
            rail.Name = "LT_IUIRail"
            rail.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            rail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
            rail.BorderSizePixel = 0
            rail.ZIndex = object.ZIndex + 1
            rail.Parent = object
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            c.Parent = rail
        end
        rail.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, strong and 0.64 or 0.4, 0)
        rail.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
        rail.BackgroundTransparency = strong and 0 or 0.4
    end

    local function styleObject(object)
        if not shouldStyle(object) then
            return
        end
        __iui.styled[object] = true
        local lname = string.lower(object.Name or "")
        local parent = object.Parent
        local pname = parent and parent.Name or ""

        if object:IsA("TextLabel") then
            if lname == "title" then
                setTracked(object, "Font", Enum.Font.GothamBold)
                setTracked(object, "TextColor3", inSection(object) and style.accent or style.text)
            elseif lname == "desc" then
                setTracked(object, "Font", Enum.Font.Gotham)
                setTracked(object, "TextColor3", style.muted)
            else
                setTracked(object, "TextColor3", style.text)
            end
        elseif object:IsA("TextBox") then
            setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", lerpColor(style.panel, style.bg, 0.5))
            setTracked(object, "TextColor3", style.text)
            setTracked(object, "Font", Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
            ensureCorner(object, 8)
            local s = ensureStroke(object, style.stroke, 1)
            if s then
                s.Transparency = 0.6
            end
        elseif object:IsA("TextButton") then
            setTracked(object, "AutoButtonColor", false)
            local colored = __iui.isColoredState(object.BackgroundColor3)
            if colored then
                setTracked(object, "TextColor3", textOn(object.BackgroundColor3))
            else
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.button)
                setTracked(object, "TextColor3", style.text)
            end
            setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", style.transparency + 0.01)
            local inRow = object.Name == "Button"
            if inRow then
                setTracked(object, "Font", Enum.Font.GothamBold)
            end
            ensureCorner(object, inRow and 999 or math.max(8, style.corner - 4))
            local s = ensureStroke(object, colored and style.accent or style.stroke, 1)
            if s then
                s.Transparency = colored and 0.35 or 0.6
            end
            if __iui.touch and inRow then
                local min = object:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIMin")
                if not min then
                    min = track(Instance.new("UISizeConstraint"))
                    min.Name = "LT_IUIMin"
                    min.Parent = object
                end
                min.MinSize = Vector2.new(0, 30)
            end
        elseif object:IsA("ImageButton") then
            if not __iui.isColoredState(object.BackgroundColor3) then
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.button)
            end
            setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", style.transparency + 0.01)
            ensureCorner(object, math.max(8, style.corner - 4))
            local s = ensureStroke(object, style.stroke, 1)
            if s then
                s.Transparency = 0.6
            end
        elseif object:IsA("Frame") or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            local isSection = lname:sub(1, 8) == "section_"
            local isRow = isSection
                or (pname == "Holder" and object:IsA("Frame") and object:FindFirstChild("Title", true) ~= nil)
            local isPanel = lname == "sidebar"
                or lname == "executor"
                or lname == "scripthub"
                or lname == "settings"
                or lname == "home"
                or lname == "console"
                or lname == "music"
                or lname:find("overlay", 1, true) ~= nil
                or lname:find("panel", 1, true) ~= nil
                or lname:find("card", 1, true) ~= nil
                or lname:find("holder", 1, true) ~= nil
            if isRow then
                local fill = isSection and lerpColor(style.panel, style.accent, 0.14) or style.panel2
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", fill)
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", math.clamp(style.transparency + 0.03, 0, 0.5))
                ensureCorner(object, math.max(10, style.corner - 2))
                styleNativeStroke(object, isSection and style.accent or style.stroke, isSection and 0.55 or 0.68)
                local native = object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient")
                if native and native.Name ~= "LT_IUIGradient" then
                    setTracked(native, "Color", ColorSequence.new(fill, style.panel))
                else
                    ensureGradient(object, fill, style.panel)
                end
                ensureRail(object, isSection)
            elseif pname == "Slider" and lname == "bar" then
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", lerpColor(style.panel, style.stroke, 0.55))
                ensureCorner(object, 99)
            elseif pname == "Slider" and lname == "fill" then
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.accent)
                ensureCorner(object, 99)
                ensureGradient(object, style.accent, style.accent2)
            elseif pname == "Slider" and lname == "knob" then
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                ensureCorner(object, 99)
                local s = ensureStroke(object, style.accent, 2)
                if s then
                    s.Transparency = 0.1
                end
            elseif isPanel then
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundColor3", style.panel)
                setTracked(object, "BackgroundTransparency", style.transparency)
                ensureCorner(object, style.corner)
                local stroke = ensureStroke(object, style.stroke, 1)
                if stroke then
                    stroke.Transparency = (style.__base or style) == styles.Neon and 0.22 or 0.5
                end
                ensureGradient(object, style.panel, style.panel2)
            end
        end

        if object:IsA("ImageLabel") and object.Name ~= "Code" then
            pcall(function()
                object.ImageColor3 = lerpColor(style.icon or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), style.accent, 0.22)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function collectStyleTargets()
        local targets = {}
        local importantNames = {
            Sidebar = true,
            Executor = true,
            Home = true,
            Scripthub = true,
            Settings = true,
            Console = true,
            Music = true,
        }
        for name in importantNames do
            local target = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if target then
                table.insert(targets, target)
                for _, descendant in target:GetDescendants() do
                    table.insert(targets, descendant)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, object in __iuiParent:GetDescendants() do
            if object.Name:sub(1, 4) == "LT_" then
                continue
            end
            if object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
                table.insert(targets, object)
            end
        end
        return targets
    end

    local function applyStyle()
        style = __iui.themedStyle(styles[styleNames[styleIndex]])
        for _, object in collectStyleTargets() do
            pcall(styleObject, object)
        end
        local rootStroke = ensureStroke(__iuiParent, style.stroke, 1)
        if rootStroke then
            rootStroke.Transparency = 0.86
        end
    end

    local function getAnimationTargets()
        local current = {}
        local sidebar = findDescendant("Sidebar")
        local executor = findDescendant("Executor")
        local currentPage
        for _, name in { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music", "JarvisAI" } do
            local p = findDescendant(name)
            if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.Visible then
                currentPage = p
                break
            end
        end
        if sidebar then
            table.insert(current, sidebar)
        end
        if currentPage and currentPage ~= sidebar then
            table.insert(current, currentPage)
        elseif executor then
            table.insert(current, executor)
        end
        return current
    end

    local function ensureScale(target)
        if not isUiObject(target) then
            return nil
        end
        local scale = target:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIScale")
        if not scale then
            scale = track(Instance.new("UIScale"))
            scale.Name = "LT_IUIScale"
            scale.Scale = 1
            scale.Parent = target
        end
        return scale
    end

    local function getAnimatedStroke(target)
        return target and target:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
    end

    __iui.descCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    __iui.isGradient = function(d)
        return d:IsA("UIGradient") and d.Name == "LT_IUIGradient"
    end
    __iui.isImage = function(d)
        return d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton")
    end
    -- descendant lists are cached (refreshed every 1.5 s) so the per-frame effects never allocate a GetDescendants() table
    __iui.cachedDescendants = function(target, key, predicate)
        local perTarget = __iui.descCache[target]
        if not perTarget then
            perTarget = {}
            __iui.descCache[target] = perTarget
        end
        local entry = perTarget[key]
        local now = os.clock()
        if not entry or now - entry.at > 1.5 then
            local list = {}
            for _, d in target:GetDescendants() do
                if predicate(d) then
                    list[#list + 1] = d
                end
            end
            entry = { at = now, list = list }
            perTarget[key] = entry
        end
        return entry.list
    end

    local function updateAnimation(dt)
        if not __iui.alive or not uiEnabled or __iui.animDisabled then
            return
        end
        -- ~45 updates per second is plenty for these subtle effects and halves the cost on 90/120 Hz devices
        __iui.animAcc = (__iui.animAcc or 0) + dt
        if __iui.animAcc < (__iui.lowEnd and 0.066 or 0.022) then
            return
        end
        dt = __iui.animAcc
        __iui.animAcc = 0
        __iui.animationTime += dt
        local t = __iui.animationTime * animationIntensity
        local now = os.clock()
        local targets = __iui.animTargets
        if not targets or now - (__iui.animTargetsAt or 0) > 0.25 then
            targets = getAnimationTargets()
            __iui.animTargets = targets
            __iui.animTargetsAt = now
        end
        local name = animationNames[animationIndex]
        if __iui.lowEnd and (name == "Aurora Sweep" or name == "Icon Drift" or name == "Scanline") then
            name = "Breathing"
        end

        for index, target in targets do
            if hasParent(target) then
                local scale = ensureScale(target)
                local stroke = getAnimatedStroke(target)
                local phase = t * (1 + index * 0.08)
                local s = 1
                local offsetY = 0
                local rotation = 0

                if name == "Breathing" then
                    s = 1 + math.sin(phase * 1.5) * 0.009
                elseif name == "Floating" then
                    offsetY = math.sin(phase * 1.2 + index) * 2.6
                elseif name == "Pulse" then
                    local wave = (math.sin(phase * 3.0) + 1) * 0.5
                    s = 1 + wave * 0.012
                    if stroke then
                        stroke.Thickness = 1 + wave * 1.3
                        stroke.Transparency = 0.58 - wave * 0.27
                    end
                elseif name == "Aurora Sweep" then
                    local gradients = __iui.cachedDescendants(target, "grad", __iui.isGradient)
                    for _, g in gradients do
                        g.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(phase * 0.55) * 0.3, 0)
                        g.Rotation = 125 + math.sin(phase * 0.3) * 12
                    end
                elseif name == "Shimmer" then
                    if stroke then
                        local q = (math.sin(phase * 2.1) + 1) * 0.5
                        stroke.Color = lerpColor(style.stroke, style.accent, q * 0.72)
                    end
                elseif name == "Icon Drift" then
                    for _, d in __iui.cachedDescendants(target, "img", __iui.isImage) do
                        if d.Parent then
                            d.Rotation = math.sin(phase + d.AbsolutePosition.X * 0.003) * 1.7
                        end
                    end
                elseif name == "Orbit Glow" then
                    if stroke then
                        stroke.Rotation = math.sin(phase * 0.8) * 12
                        stroke.Thickness = 1.15 + ((math.sin(phase * 2) + 1) * 0.5) * 1.55
                    end
                elseif name == "Scanline" then
                    for _, d in __iui.cachedDescendants(target, "grad", __iui.isGradient) do
                        if d.Parent then
                            d.Offset = Vector2.new(0, math.sin(phase * 1.3) * 0.18)
                        end
                    end
                elseif name == "Parallax" then
                    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera then
                        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
                        local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                        local nx = viewport.X > 0 and (mouse.X / viewport.X - 0.5) or 0
                        local ny = viewport.Y > 0 and (mouse.Y / viewport.Y - 0.5) or 0
                        __iui.parallax = Vector2.new(nx, ny)
                        offsetY = ny * 2.6
                    end
                    rotation = __iui.parallax.X * (index == 1 and 1.2 or -1.0)
                elseif name == "Cinematic" then
                    local wave = (math.sin(phase * 0.8) + 1) * 0.5
                    s = 1 + wave * 0.006
                    offsetY = math.sin(phase * 0.7) * 1.35
                    rotation = math.sin(phase * 0.9) * 0.42
                    if stroke then
                        stroke.Transparency = 0.54 - wave * 0.18
                    end
                end

                if scale then
                    scale.Scale = s
                end

                local base = __iui.original[target]
                if base and base.Position then
                    local basePos = base.Position
                    target.Position = UDim2.new(
                        basePos.X.Scale,
                        basePos.X.Offset,
                        basePos.Y.Scale,
                        basePos.Y.Offset + offsetY
                    )
                end
                target.Rotation = ((base and base.Rotation) or 0) + rotation
            end
        end
    end

    local function getTransitionBlur()
        local lighting = Svc("Lighting") or game:GetService("Lighting")
        if not lighting then
            return nil
        end
        local blur = lighting:FindFirstChild("LT_DeltaTransitionBlur")
        if not blur then
            blur = track(Instance.new("BlurEffect"))
            blur.Name = "LT_DeltaTransitionBlur"
            blur.Size = 0
            blur.Enabled = false
            blur.Parent = lighting
        end
        return blur
    end

    local blurEffect = getTransitionBlur()

    local transitionOverlay = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
    transitionOverlay.Name = "LT_ImmersiveTransition"
    transitionOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = style.bg
    transitionOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
    transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
    transitionOverlay.Visible = false
    transitionOverlay.ZIndex = 30000
    transitionOverlay.Parent = __iuiParent
    ensureGradient(transitionOverlay, style.panel, style.accent2)

    local transitionGlow = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
    transitionGlow.Name = "Glow"
    transitionGlow.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
    transitionGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
    transitionGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    transitionGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 1.3)
    transitionGlow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.25, -0.15)
    transitionGlow.Rotation = 12
    transitionGlow.ZIndex = 30001
    transitionGlow.Parent = transitionOverlay
    ensureCorner(transitionGlow, 999)

    local function cancelTransition()
        __iui.transitionToken += 1
        __iui.transitionBusy = false
        pcall(function()
            transitionOverlay.Visible = false
        end)
        if blurEffect then
            pcall(function()
                blurEffect.Size = 0
                blurEffect.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
    end

    local function playTransition(kind)
        if not uiEnabled or not transitionOverlay or not hasParent(transitionOverlay) then
            return
        end
        cancelTransition()
        __iui.transitionBusy = true
        __iui.transitionToken += 1
        local token = __iui.transitionToken
        local name = kind or transitionNames[transitionIndex]
        local duration = 0.36
        transitionOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = style.bg
        transitionGlow.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
        transitionOverlay.Visible = true
        transitionGlow.Visible = true
        transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)

        if blurEffect and transitionBlurEnabled then
            pcall(function()
                blurEffect.Enabled = true
                blurEffect.Size = 6
            end)
        end

        local function makeTween(object, ti, props)
            if not TS then
                for k, v in props do
                    pcall(function()
                        object[k] = v
                    end)
                end
                return nil
            end
            local ok, tw = pcall(function()
                return TS:Create(object, ti, props)
            end)
            if ok and tw then
                tw:Play()
                return tw
            end
            return nil
        end

        transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
        transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        transitionOverlay.Rotation = 0
        transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        transitionGlow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.25, -0.15)
        transitionGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.45, 1.3)

        local easeOut = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local easeIn = TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.82, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

        if name == "Fade Through" then
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 })
            task.delay(duration * 0.46, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Left" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 0)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(-1.08, 0) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Right" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-1.08, 0)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 0) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Up" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1.08)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -1.08) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Slide Down" then
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -1.08)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1.08) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Zoom In" then
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.68)
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 1.05),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
            })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
            end)
        elseif name == "Zoom Out" then
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2)
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
            })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, 0.74),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
            end)
        elseif name == "Flip" then
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Rotation = 0
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Rotation = 180, BackgroundTransparency = 0.18 })
            task.delay(duration * 0.52, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Rotation = 360, BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            end)
        elseif name == "Wipe" then
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-1.08, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 1.24)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5) })
            task.delay(duration * 0.5, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.08, 0.5) })
            end)
        elseif name == "Pulse Burst" then
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.04)
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeOut, {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.35, 1.35),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
            })
            task.delay(duration * 0.48, function()
                if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then return end
                makeTween(transitionOverlay, easeIn, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 1.5),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
            end)
        end

        task.delay(duration + 0.12, function()
            if token ~= __iui.transitionToken then
                return
            end
            __iui.transitionBusy = false
            transitionOverlay.Visible = false
            transitionOverlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            transitionOverlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
            transitionOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            if blurEffect then
                pcall(function()
                    blurEffect.Size = 0
                    blurEffect.Enabled = false
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function currentVisiblePage()
        for _, name in { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music", "JarvisAI" } do
            local p = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.Visible then
                return p
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- [MOTION] one coordinated motion layer: a single easing language, 13 effects, all gated by IMMERSION + intensity + low-end mode
    --  1 panel materialize (dock-in)   2 control cascade   3 prism bar wipe + sweep   4 title decode   5 sidebar spotlight spring
    --  6 page content cascade   7 ink ripple   8 hover sheen   9 text roll-in   10 colour morph + squash
    --  11 menu reveal (scale + scrim + depth blur)   12 theme wave   13 row edge / stagger / press squish (see __DeltaRowFx)
    do
        local M = { weak = function() return setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) end }
        __iui.motion = M
        M.I = {
            fast = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            soft = TweenInfo.new(0.36, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            pop = TweenInfo.new(0.46, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            slow = TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            away = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            glide = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
            spread = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            dim = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            wave = TweenInfo.new(0.95, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        }
        M.rest = M.weak()
        M.tok = M.weak()
        M.dtok = M.weak()
        M.bound = M.weak()
        M.tb = M.weak()
        M.rv = M.weak()
        M.tcol = M.weak()
        M.tat = M.weak()
        M.sheenAt = M.weak()

        -- [UI ANIMATION CACHE] UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/UI ANIMATION CACHE: title-decode frames (disk + memory), page cascade order (memory), ripple dot pool (memory).
        -- Off with Main page > Performance > "UI Cache" (or without a file API) -> everything below falls back to the live behaviour.
        M.AC = {
            Ver = 1,
            Root = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/UI ANIMATION CACHE",
            Steps = 14,
            Max = 96,
            Count = 0,
            Pool = {},
            Pages = M.weak(),
        }
        function M.AC.fs()
            if M.AC._fs == nil then
                M.AC._fs = type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"
                    and type(makefolder) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function"
            end
            return M.AC._fs
        end
        function M.AC.enabled()
            local u = Util
            local fx = u and u.FX
            if fx and fx.Cfg and fx.Cfg.UICache == false then
                return false
            end
            return M.AC.fs()
        end
        function M.AC.http()
            if not M.AC._hs then
                M.AC._hs = game:GetService("HttpService")
            end
            return M.AC._hs
        end
        function M.AC.load()
            local AC = M.AC
            if AC.Loaded then
                return
            end
            AC.Loaded = true
            AC.Data = { decode = {} }
            if not AC.fs() then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in { "UhhhhhhReanim", "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets", AC.Root } do
                    if not isfolder(d) then
                        makefolder(d)
                    end
                end
                local meta = AC.Root .. "/cache.json"
                if not isfile(meta) then
                    writefile(meta, '{"v":' .. AC.Ver .. ',"note":"UI ANIMATION CACHE - decode frames for the Delta immersive UI, delete this folder to rebuild it"}')
                end
                local path = AC.Root .. "/animations.json"
                if isfile(path) then
                    local okD, data = pcall(function()
