                        return AC.http():JSONDecode(readfile(path))
                    end)
                    if okD and type(data) == "table" and data.v == AC.Ver and type(data.decode) == "table" then
                        for text, frames in data.decode do
                            if type(text) == "string" and type(frames) == "table" and #frames == AC.Steps and AC.Count < AC.Max then
                                local good = true
                                for i = 1, AC.Steps do
                                    if type(frames[i]) ~= "string" then
                                        good = false
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                if good then
                                    AC.Data.decode[text] = frames
                                    AC.Count += 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        function M.AC.flush()
            local AC = M.AC
            if not (AC.Dirty and AC.Data and AC.fs()) then
                return
            end
            AC.Dirty = false
            pcall(function()
                writefile(AC.Root .. "/animations.json", AC.http():JSONEncode({ v = AC.Ver, decode = AC.Data.decode }))
            end)
        end
        function M.AC.save()
            local AC = M.AC
            AC.Dirty = true
            if AC.SavePending then
                return
            end
            AC.SavePending = true
            task.delay(2, function()
                AC.SavePending = false
                AC.flush()
            end)
        end
        -- title decode: the 14 scramble frames of a text are built once (random glyphs fixed per text) and replayed
        function M.AC.frames(final)
            local AC = M.AC
            if type(final) ~= "string" or final == "" or #final > 48 or not AC.enabled() then
                return nil
            end
            AC.load()
            if not AC.Data then
                return nil
            end
            local hit = AC.Data.decode[final]
            if hit then
                return hit
            end
            local frames
            local ok = pcall(function()
                local glyphs = "01#%&/<>[]+=*?"
                local chars = {}
                for _, cp in utf8.codes(final) do
                    chars[#chars + 1] = utf8.char(cp)
                end
                local total = #chars
                frames = table.create(AC.Steps)
                for step = 1, AC.Steps do
                    local lock = math.floor(total * step / AC.Steps)
                    local out = table.create(total)
                    for i = 1, total do
                        local ch = chars[i]
                        if i <= lock or ch == " " then
                            out[i] = ch
                        else
                            local g = math.random(1, #glyphs)
                            out[i] = glyphs:sub(g, g)
                        end
                    end
                    frames[step] = table.concat(out)
                end
            end)
            if not (ok and frames) then
                return nil
            end
            if AC.Count < AC.Max then
                AC.Data.decode[final] = frames
                AC.Count += 1
                AC.save()
            end
            return frames
        end
        -- page cascade: rows in top-to-bottom order; the sorted order is kept per page while its child count is unchanged
        function M.AC.cascadeList(box, top, bottom)
            local AC = M.AC
            local kids = box:GetChildren()
            local on = AC.enabled()
            local memo = on and AC.Pages[box] or nil
            local function inView(c)
                if not (c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible and c.AbsoluteSize.Y > 6) then
                    return false
                end
                local y = c.AbsolutePosition.Y
                return y < bottom and y + c.AbsoluteSize.Y > top
            end
            local list = {}
            if memo and memo.n == #kids then
                for _, c in memo.order do
                    if c.Parent == box and inView(c) then
                        list[#list + 1] = c
                    end
                end
                return list
            end
            for _, c in kids do
                if inView(c) then
                    list[#list + 1] = c
                end
            end
            table.sort(list, function(a, b)
                return a.AbsolutePosition.Y < b.AbsolutePosition.Y
            end)
            if on and #list > 1 and list[1].AbsolutePosition.Y ~= list[#list].AbsolutePosition.Y then
                local order = {}
                for _, c in kids do
                    if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        order[#order + 1] = c
                    end
                end
                table.sort(order, function(a, b)
                    return a.AbsolutePosition.Y < b.AbsolutePosition.Y
                end)
                AC.Pages[box] = { n = #kids, order = order }
            end
            return list
        end
        -- ripple dots: reused instead of Instance.new + Destroy on every press
        function M.AC.takeDot()
            local AC = M.AC
            local dot = AC.enabled() and table.remove(AC.Pool) or nil
            if dot then
                return dot
            end
            dot = Instance.new("Frame")
            dot.Name = "LT_Ripple"
            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            dot.Active = false
            local rc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            rc.Name = "LT_FxCorner"
            rc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            rc.Parent = dot
            return dot
        end
        function M.AC.giveDot(dot)
            local AC = M.AC
            local ok = pcall(function()
                dot.Parent = nil
            end)
            if ok and #AC.Pool < 8 and AC.enabled() then
                AC.Pool[#AC.Pool + 1] = dot
            else
                pcall(function()
                    dot:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        function M.AC.clear()
            local AC = M.AC
            for _, dot in AC.Pool do
                pcall(function()
                    dot:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            table.clear(AC.Pool)
            AC.Pages = M.weak()
            AC.flush()
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if M.AC.enabled() then
                pcall(M.AC.load)
            end
        end)

        function M.ok()
            return __iui.alive and uiEnabled and TS ~= nil
        end
        function M.lite()
            return __iui.lowEnd == true
        end
        function M.amp()
            return math.clamp(animationIntensity, 0.4, 1.25)
        end
        function M.play(obj, info, props)
            if not (obj and obj.Parent) then
                return nil
            end
            local ok, tw = pcall(function()
                return TS:Create(obj, info, props)
            end)
            if ok and tw then
                tw:Play()
                return tw
            end
            return nil
        end
        -- one UIScale per object, shared with the press / row systems so scales never fight
        function M.scaleOf(obj)
            local s = obj:FindFirstChild("LT_RowScale") or obj:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIPress") or obj:FindFirstChild("LT_MotionScale")
            if not s then
                s = track(Instance.new("UIScale"))
                s.Name = obj:IsA("GuiButton") and "LT_IUIPress" or "LT_MotionScale"
                s.Scale = 1
                s.Parent = obj
            end
            return s
        end
        -- screen position -> coordinates of the immersive parent (handles the topbar inset)
        function M.origin()
            local ok, v = pcall(function()
                if __iuiParent:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    return __iuiParent.AbsolutePosition
                end
                if __iuiParent:IsA("ScreenGui") and not __iuiParent.IgnoreGuiInset then
                    return game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
                end
                return Vector2.zero
            end)
            return ok and v or Vector2.zero
        end
        function M.stop()
            pcall(M.AC.clear)
            for obj, r in M.rest do
                pcall(function()
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = r.bt
                    if r.tt < 0.99 then
                        obj.TextTransparency = r.tt
                    end
                end)
            end
            table.clear(M.rest)
        end

        -- [fade + scale rise] shared by the panel cascade, page cascade and menu rows
        function M.rise(obj, delay, from)
            if not (M.ok() and obj and obj.Parent and obj:IsA("GuiObject")) then
                return
            end
            local hasText = obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")
            local r = M.rest[obj]
            if not r then
                r = { bt = obj.BackgroundTransparency, tt = hasText and obj.TextTransparency or 1 }
                M.rest[obj] = r
            end
            if r.bt >= 0.99 and r.tt >= 0.99 then
                M.rest[obj] = nil
                return
            end
            local tok = (M.tok[obj] or 0) + 1
            M.tok[obj] = tok
            local sc = (not M.lite()) and M.scaleOf(obj) or nil
            if r.bt < 0.99 then
                obj.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            end
            if r.tt < 0.99 then
                obj.TextTransparency = 1
            end
            if sc then
                sc.Scale = from or 0.93
            end
            task.delay(delay or 0, function()
                if M.tok[obj] ~= tok then
                    return
                end
                if not obj.Parent then
                    M.rest[obj] = nil
                    return
                end
                local props = {}
                if r.bt < 0.99 then
                    props.BackgroundTransparency = r.bt
                end
                if r.tt < 0.99 then
                    props.TextTransparency = r.tt
                end
                M.play(obj, M.I.soft, props)
                if sc then
                    M.play(sc, M.I.pop, { Scale = 1 })
                end
                task.delay(0.55, function()
                    if M.tok[obj] == tok then
                        M.rest[obj] = nil
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end

        -- [3] prism bar: wipes in, then a light pass slides through (replayed on every setting change)
        function M.sweep(bar)
            local g = bar and bar:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIGradient")
            if not g or not M.ok() or M.lite() then
                return
            end
            g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
            M.play(g, M.I.slow, { Offset = Vector2.zero })
        end
        function M.wipe(bar)
            if not (bar and bar.Parent) or M.lite() then
                return
            end
            local full = bar.Size
            bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, full.Y.Scale, full.Y.Offset)
            M.play(bar, M.I.slow, { Size = full })
            M.sweep(bar)
        end

        -- [4] title decode: glyphs resolve left to right
        function M.decode(label, final)
            if not (label and label.Parent) or M.lite() or not M.ok() then
                return
            end
            final = final or label.Text
            local tok = (M.dtok[label] or 0) + 1
            M.dtok[label] = tok
            local cached = M.AC.frames(final)
            if cached then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        for step = 1, #cached do
                            if M.dtok[label] ~= tok or not label.Parent then
                                return
                            end
                            label.Text = cached[step]
                            task.wait(0.03)
                        end
                    end)
                    if M.dtok[label] == tok and label.Parent then
                        label.Text = final
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local glyphs = "01#%&/<>[]+=*?"
                local ok = pcall(function()
                    local chars = {}
                    for _, cp in utf8.codes(final) do
                        chars[#chars + 1] = utf8.char(cp)
                    end
                    local total = #chars
                    local steps = 14
                    for step = 1, steps do
                        if M.dtok[label] ~= tok or not label.Parent then
                            return
                        end
                        local lock = math.floor(total * step / steps)
                        local out = table.create(total)
                        for i = 1, total do
                            local ch = chars[i]
                            if i <= lock or ch == " " then
                                out[i] = ch
                            else
                                local g = math.random(1, #glyphs)
                                out[i] = glyphs:sub(g, g)
                            end
                        end
                        label.Text = table.concat(out)
                        task.wait(0.03)
                    end
                end)
                if M.dtok[label] == tok and label.Parent then
                    label.Text = final
                end
                if not ok then
                    label.Text = final
                end
            end)
        end

        -- [1][2] control panel: dock-in, accent ignite on the border, children rise in sequence
        function M.materialize(panel, title, subtitle, bar, hint)
            if not (M.ok() and panel and panel.Parent) then
                return
            end
            M.bar = bar
            M.title = title
            M.titleText = title and title.Text or nil
            local amp = M.amp()
            local rest = panel.Position
            local bt = panel.BackgroundTransparency
            local stroke = panel:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
            local sT = stroke and stroke.Transparency or 0.42
            local sC = stroke and stroke.Color or style.stroke
            panel.Position = rest + UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.floor(28 * amp))
            panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            local sc = M.scaleOf(panel)
            sc.Scale = 1 - 0.07 * amp
            M.play(panel, M.I.slow, { Position = rest })
            M.play(panel, M.I.soft, { BackgroundTransparency = bt })
            M.play(sc, M.I.pop, { Scale = 1 })
            if stroke and not M.lite() then
                stroke.Color = style.accent
                stroke.Thickness = 3
                stroke.Transparency = 0.05
                M.play(stroke, M.I.slow, { Color = sC, Thickness = 1, Transparency = sT })
            end
            local kids = {}
            for _, c in panel:GetChildren() do
                if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    kids[#kids + 1] = c
                end
            end
            table.sort(kids, function(a, b)
                return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder
            end)
            for i, c in kids do
                if c ~= bar then
                    M.rise(c, 0.08 + (i - 1) * 0.04, 0.9)
                end
            end
            M.wipe(bar)
            M.decode(title, M.titleText)
        end

        -- [7][8] shared clipped layer inside a button (rounded like the button) for ripple + sheen
        function M.clipOf(button)
            local clip = button:FindFirstChild("LT_FxClip")
            if clip then
                return clip
            end
            if button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout") or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridLayout") then
                return nil
            end
            clip = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
            clip.Name = "LT_FxClip"
            clip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            clip.BorderSizePixel = 0
            clip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            clip.ClipsDescendants = true
            clip.Active = false
            clip.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
            local cr = button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner")
            if cr then
                local c2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c2.Name = "LT_FxCorner"
                c2.CornerRadius = cr.CornerRadius
                c2.Parent = clip
            end
            clip.Parent = button
            return clip
        end
        function M.ripple(button, input)
            if not M.ok() or not button.Parent then
                return
            end
            local size = button.AbsoluteSize
            if size.X < 14 or size.Y < 14 then
                return
            end
            local clip = M.clipOf(button)
            if not clip then
                return
            end
            local ap = button.AbsolutePosition
            local inset = Vector2.zero
            pcall(function()
                inset = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
            end)
            local raw = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
            local cand = {}
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local okm, mouse = pcall(function()
                    return UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                end)
                if okm and mouse then
                    cand[#cand + 1] = mouse - ap
                end
            end
            cand[#cand + 1] = raw + inset - ap
            cand[#cand + 1] = raw - ap
            local px, py = size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5
            for _, v in cand do
                if v.X >= 0 and v.Y >= 0 and v.X <= size.X and v.Y <= size.Y then
                    px, py = v.X, v.Y
                    break
                end
            end
            local d = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.3
            local dot = M.AC.takeDot()
            dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)
            dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            dot.BackgroundColor3 = lerpColor(style.accent, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4)
            dot.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.8 - 0.12 * M.amp(), 0.6, 0.78)
            dot.ZIndex = clip.ZIndex
            dot.Parent = clip
            M.play(dot, M.I.spread, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d) })
            M.play(dot, M.I.dim, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            task.delay(0.62, function()
                M.AC.giveDot(dot)
            end)
        end
        function M.sheen(button)
            if not M.ok() or M.lite() or not button.Parent then
                return
            end
            local size = button.AbsoluteSize
            if size.X < 56 or size.Y < 24 then
                return
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - (M.sheenAt[button] or 0) < 0.7 then
                return
            end
            M.sheenAt[button] = now
            local clip = M.clipOf(button)
            if not clip then
                return
            end
            local bar = clip:FindFirstChild("LT_Sheen")
            if not bar then
                bar = Instance.new("Frame")
                bar.Name = "LT_Sheen"
                bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                bar.Size = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 2.2, 0)
                bar.Rotation = 18
                bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
                bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
                bar.Active = false
                bar.ZIndex = clip.ZIndex
                local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                g.Name = "LT_FxGrad"
                g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                })
                g.Parent = bar
                bar.Parent = clip
            end
            bar.Position = UDim2.new(-0.25, 0, 0.5, 0)
            M.play(bar, M.I.glide, { Position = UDim2.new(1.25, 0, 0.5, 0) })
        end
        function M.bindButton(button)
            if M.bound[button] or not button:IsA("GuiButton") then
                return
            end
            M.bound[button] = true
            connect(button.InputBegan, function(input)
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    M.ripple(button, input)
                end
            end)
            if not __iui.touch then
                connect(button.MouseEnter, function()
                    M.sheen(button)
                end)
            end
        end

        -- [9] text roll-in: new text rises into place
        function M.roll(b)
            if not M.ok() or M.lite() or not b.Parent then
                return
            end
            local pad = b:FindFirstChild("LT_RollPad")
            if not pad then
                pad = track(Instance.new("UIPadding"))
                pad.Name = "LT_RollPad"
                pad.Parent = b
            end
            pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 9)
            pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0)
            b.TextTransparency = 0.8
            M.play(pad, M.I.pop, { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 0) })
            M.play(b, M.I.soft, { TextTransparency = 0 })
        end
        function M.watchText(b)
            if M.tb[b] ~= nil then
                return
            end
            M.tb[b] = b.Text
            connect(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
                if b.Text == M.tb[b] then
                    return
                end
                M.tb[b] = b.Text
                M.roll(b)
            end)
        end

        -- [10] colour morph + squash (replaces the instant colour snap on the control panel)
        function M.squash(btn)
            if M.lite() then
                return
            end
            local sc = M.scaleOf(btn)
            sc.Scale = 0.93
            M.play(sc, M.I.pop, { Scale = 1 })
        end
        function M.setColor(obj, color)
            if not (obj and obj.Parent) then
                return
            end
            if M.tcol[obj] == color and os.clock() - (M.tat[obj] or 0) < 0.45 then
                return
            end
            M.tcol[obj] = color
            M.tat[obj] = os.clock()
            if obj.BackgroundColor3 == color then
                return
            end
            if not M.ok() or M.lite() then
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = color
                return
            end
            M.play(obj, M.I.soft, { BackgroundColor3 = color })
            if obj:IsA("GuiButton") then
                M.squash(obj)
            end
        end
        function M.bindPanelButton(b)
            M.watchText(b)
            connect(b.Activated, function()
                M.sweep(M.bar)
            end)
        end

        -- [5] sidebar spotlight: an outline that springs between sidebar buttons and stretches with its velocity
        function M.spotFrame()
            if M.spot and M.spot.Parent then
                return M.spot
            end
            local f = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
            f.Name = "LT_SidebarSpot"
            f.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
            f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.Active = false
            f.Visible = false
            f.ZIndex = 24000
            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.Name = "LT_FxCorner"
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
            c.Parent = f
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Name = "LT_SpotStroke"
            s.Color = style.accent
            s.Thickness = 1.5
            s.Transparency = 0.3
            s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            s.Parent = f
            f.Parent = __iuiParent
            M.spot = f
            M.sp = nil
            return f
        end
        function M.tint()
            local f = M.spot
            if f and f.Parent then
                M.play(f, M.I.soft, { BackgroundColor3 = style.accent })
                local s = f:FindFirstChild("LT_SpotStroke")
                if s then
                    M.play(s, M.I.soft, { Color = style.accent })
                end
            end
        end
        function M.loop(dt)
            local f, target = M.spot, M.target
            if not (f and f.Parent) then
                return
            end
            M.acc = (M.acc or 0) + dt
            if M.acc < (M.lite() and 0.05 or (M.idle and 0.12 or 0.015)) then
                return
            end
            local h = math.min(M.acc, 0.05)
            M.acc = 0
            if not (M.ok() and target and target.Parent) then
                f.Visible = false
                M.sp = nil
                return
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - (M.visAt or 0) > 0.25 then
                M.visAt = now
                local seen = target.AbsoluteSize.X > 1
                local p = target
                while seen and p and p ~= game do
                    if p:IsA("GuiObject") and not p.Visible then
                        seen = false
                    elseif p:IsA("ScreenGui") and not p.Enabled then
                        seen = false
                    end
                    p = p.Parent
                end
                M.seen = seen
            end
            if not M.seen then
                f.Visible = false
                M.sp = nil
                return
            end
            local o = M.origin()
            local ap, sz = target.AbsolutePosition - o, target.AbsoluteSize
            local tx, ty = ap.X + sz.X * 0.5, ap.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
            local sp = M.sp
            if not sp then
                sp = { x = tx, y = ty, w = sz.X, h = sz.Y, vx = 0, vy = 0, vw = 0, vh = 0 }
                M.sp = sp
                M.idle = false
                f.Visible = true
            end
            local err = math.abs(tx - sp.x) + math.abs(ty - sp.y) + math.abs(sz.X - sp.w) + math.abs(sz.Y - sp.h)
            local vel = math.abs(sp.vx) + math.abs(sp.vy) + math.abs(sp.vw) + math.abs(sp.vh)
            if err < 0.25 and vel < 1 then
                sp.x, sp.y, sp.w, sp.h = tx, ty, sz.X, sz.Y
                sp.vx, sp.vy, sp.vw, sp.vh = 0, 0, 0, 0
                if not M.idle then
                    M.idle = true
                    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz.X, sz.Y)
                    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tx - sz.X * 0.5, ty - sz.Y * 0.5)
                end
                return
            end
            M.idle = false
            local k, c = 320, 25
            sp.vx += ((tx - sp.x) * k - sp.vx * c) * h
            sp.x += sp.vx * h
            sp.vy += ((ty - sp.y) * k - sp.vy * c) * h
            sp.y += sp.vy * h
            sp.vw += ((sz.X - sp.w) * k - sp.vw * c) * h
            sp.w += sp.vw * h
            sp.vh += ((sz.Y - sp.h) * k - sp.vh * c) * h
            sp.h += sp.vh * h
            local w = math.max(sp.w + math.min(math.abs(sp.vx) * 0.03, 18), 4)
            local hh = math.max(sp.h + math.min(math.abs(sp.vy) * 0.03, 18), 4)
            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(w + 0.5), math.floor(hh + 0.5))
            f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(sp.x - w * 0.5 + 0.5), math.floor(sp.y - hh * 0.5 + 0.5))
        end
        function M.ensureLoop()
            if M.loopOn then
                return
            end
            M.loopOn = true
            connect(RS and RS.RenderStepped or nil, function(dt)
                if (M.fails or 0) >= 5 then
                    return
                end
                local ok = pcall(M.loop, dt)
                if not ok then
                    M.fails = (M.fails or 0) + 1
                end
            end)
        end

        -- [6] page content cascade: visible rows rise in sequence as the transition curtain lifts
        function M.cascade(page)
            if not (M.ok() and page and page.Parent) then
                return
            end
            task.delay(0.17, function()
                if not (M.ok() and page.Parent and page.Visible) then
                    return
                end
                local box = page:FindFirstChild("Holder") or page:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame") or page
                local top = page.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local bottom = top + page.AbsoluteSize.Y
                local list = M.AC.cascadeList(box, top, bottom)
                for i = 1, math.min(#list, M.lite() and 5 or 11) do
                    M.rise(list[i], (i - 1) * 0.035, 0.95)
                end
            end)
        end
        function M.onPage(page, snap)
            if not (M.ok() and page) then
                return
            end
            local sidebar = findDescendant("Sidebar")
            local btn = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild(page.Name)
            if btn and btn:IsA("GuiObject") then
                M.target = btn
                M.spotFrame()
                M.tint()
                M.ensureLoop()
                M.idle = false
            end
            if not snap then
                M.cascade(page)
            end
        end

        -- [11] menu reveal: scale pop, border ignite, scrim and depth blur, rows rise in sequence
        function M.scrimOf(menu)
            local parent = menu.Parent
            if not parent then
                return nil
            end
            local s = parent:FindFirstChild("LT_MenuScrim")
            if not s then
                s = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
                s.Name = "LT_MenuScrim"
                s.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                s.BorderSizePixel = 0
                s.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                s.Active = false
                s.Visible = false
                s.ZIndex = math.max(menu.ZIndex - 1, 1)
                s.Parent = parent
            end
            return s
        end
        function M.reveal(menu)
            if not M.ok() then
                return
            end
            local scrim = M.scrimOf(menu)
            if scrim then
                scrim.Visible = true
                M.play(scrim, M.I.soft, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 })
            end
            local sc = M.scaleOf(menu)
            sc.Scale = 0.88
            M.play(sc, M.I.pop, { Scale = 1 })
            local st = menu:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
            if st and not M.lite() then
                local c0, t0, k0 = st.Color, st.Transparency, st.Thickness
                st.Color = style.accent
                st.Thickness = 3
                st.Transparency = 0.1
                M.play(st, M.I.slow, { Color = c0, Transparency = t0, Thickness = k0 })
            end
            if blurEffect and transitionBlurEnabled and not M.lite() and not __iui.transitionBusy then
                pcall(function()
                    blurEffect.Enabled = true
                end)
                M.play(blurEffect, M.I.soft, { Size = 8 })
            end
            local list = menu:FindFirstChild("List")
            if list then
                local i = 0
                for _, row in list:GetChildren() do
                    if row:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        i += 1
                        M.rise(row, 0.06 + i * 0.03, 0.94)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        function M.dismiss(menu)
            local scrim = menu.Parent and menu.Parent:FindFirstChild("LT_MenuScrim")
            if scrim then
                M.play(scrim, M.I.away, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                task.delay(0.24, function()
                    if scrim.Parent and not menu.Visible then
                        scrim.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end
            if blurEffect and blurEffect.Parent and not __iui.transitionBusy and M.ok() then
                M.play(blurEffect, M.I.away, { Size = 0 })
                task.delay(0.26, function()
                    if not __iui.transitionBusy and not menu.Visible then
                        pcall(function()
                            blurEffect.Enabled = false
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        function M.watchReveal(menu)
            if M.rv[menu] then
                return
            end
            M.rv[menu] = true
            connect(menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
                if menu.Visible then
                    M.reveal(menu)
                else
                    M.dismiss(menu)
                end
            end)
            if menu.Visible then
                M.reveal(menu)
            end
        end

        -- [12] theme wave: a ring expands from the control panel when the style / theme changes
        function M.themeWave()
            if not M.ok() or M.lite() then
                return
            end
            M.tint()
            M.decode(M.title, M.titleText)
            local panel = __iui.controlPanel
            local o = M.origin()
            local cx, cy
            if panel and panel.Parent then
                local ap, sz = panel.AbsolutePosition - o, panel.AbsoluteSize
                cx, cy = ap.X + sz.X * 0.5, ap.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
            else
                local sz = __iuiParent.AbsoluteSize
                cx, cy = sz.X * 0.5, sz.Y * 0.5
            end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
            local d = math.max(vp.X, vp.Y) * 2.8
            local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
            ring.Name = "LT_ThemeWave"
            ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
            ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
            ring.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
            ring.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
            ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ring.Active = false
            ring.ZIndex = 26000
            local rc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            rc.Name = "LT_FxCorner"
            rc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            rc.Parent = ring
            local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            rs.Name = "LT_FxStroke"
            rs.Color = style.accent2
            rs.Thickness = 3
            rs.Transparency = 0.15
            rs.Parent = ring
            ring.Parent = __iuiParent
            M.play(ring, M.I.wave, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            M.play(rs, M.I.wave, { Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5 })
            task.delay(1.05, function()
                pcall(function()
                    ring:Destroy()
                end)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function watchPages()
        local pageNames = { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music", "JarvisAI" }
        for _, name in pageNames do
            local page = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if page and page:IsA("GuiObject") then
                local c = connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
                    if not __iui.alive or not uiEnabled then
                        return
                    end
                    task.defer(function()
                        local visible = currentVisiblePage()
                        if visible and visible ~= __iui.currentPage then
                            __iui.currentPage = visible
                            __iui.refreshButtons()
                            playTransition()
                            pcall(__iui.motion.onPage, visible)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                if c then
                    table.insert(__iui.pageConnections, c)
                end
            end
        end
        __iui.currentPage = currentVisiblePage()
        pcall(__iui.motion.onPage, __iui.currentPage, true)
    end

    __iui.getColors = function()
        return style.accent, style.stroke
    end

    __iui.refreshButtons = function()
        local rt = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime")
        if type(rt) == "table" and type(rt.fxRefresh) == "function" then
            pcall(rt.fxRefresh)
        end
    end

    __iui.bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function bindStyleHover(button)
        if not button or __iui.bound[button] or __iui.lowEnd or not TS then
            return
        end
        if not (button:IsA("TextButton") or button:IsA("ImageButton")) then
            return
        end
        __iui.bound[button] = true
        pcall(__iui.motion.bindButton, button)
        local info = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local function press(v)
            if not __iui.alive or not uiEnabled or __iui.lowEnd then
                return
            end
            local s = button:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIPress")
            if not s then
                s = track(Instance.new("UIScale"))
                s.Name = "LT_IUIPress"
                s.Scale = 1
                s.Parent = button
            end
            pcall(function()
                TS:Create(s, info, { Scale = v }):Play()
            end)
        end
        local function isPointer(input)
            local t = input.UserInputType
            return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        end
        connect(button.InputBegan, function(input)
            if isPointer(input) then
                press(0.965)
            end
        end)
        connect(button.InputEnded, function(input)
            if isPointer(input) then
                press(1)
            end
        end)
        if not __iui.touch then
            connect(button.MouseEnter, function()
                local st = button:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
                if st and uiEnabled then
                    if st:GetAttribute("LT_base") == nil then
                        st:SetAttribute("LT_base", st.Transparency)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        TS:Create(st, info, { Transparency = 0.15, Color = style.accent }):Play()
                    end)
                end
            end)
            connect(button.MouseLeave, function()
                press(1)
                local st = button:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke")
                local base = st and st:GetAttribute("LT_base")
                if st and base then
                    pcall(function()
                        TS:Create(st, info, { Transparency = base, Color = style.stroke }):Play()
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function buildControlPanel()
        local old = __iuiParent:FindFirstChild("LT_ImmersiveCustomizer")
        if old then
            old:Destroy()
        end

        local panel = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
        panel.Name = "LT_ImmersiveCustomizer"
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local compact = __iui.touch or vp.X < 760
        panel.AnchorPoint = compact and Vector2.new(0.5, 1) or Vector2.new(1, 1)
        panel.Position = compact and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12) or UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20)
        panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(vp.X - 24, 240, compact and 360 or 300), 0)
        panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        panel.BackgroundColor3 = style.panel
        panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(style.transparency + 0.02, 0.32)
        panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        panel.ZIndex = 25000
        panel.Parent = __iuiParent
        ensureCorner(panel, style.corner + 2)
        ensureStroke(panel, style.stroke, 1)
        ensureGradient(panel, style.panel, style.panel2)
        uiLib.draggerV2(panel, panel)

        local padding = track(Instance.new("UIPadding"))
        padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
        padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
        padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 13)
        padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 13)
        padding.Parent = panel

        local list = track(Instance.new("UIListLayout"))
        list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
        list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        list.Parent = panel

        local title = track(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
        title.Name = "Title"
        title.LayoutOrder = 1
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.Text = "PRISM  ·  DESIGN"
        title.TextColor3 = style.text
        title.TextSize = 15
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.ZIndex = 25001
        title.Parent = panel

        local subtitle = track(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
        subtitle.LayoutOrder = 2
        subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
        subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        subtitle.Text = "Theme, motion and transitions"
        subtitle.TextColor3 = style.muted
        subtitle.TextSize = 10
        subtitle.TextWrapped = true
        subtitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        subtitle.ZIndex = 25001
        subtitle.Parent = panel

        local prismBar = track(Instance.new("Frame"))
        prismBar.Name = "LT_PrismBar"
        prismBar.LayoutOrder = 0
        prismBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
        prismBar.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
        prismBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
        prismBar.ZIndex = 25001
        prismBar.Parent = panel
        ensureCorner(prismBar, 2)
        ensureGradient(prismBar, style.accent, style.accent2)
        local function makeButton(name, text, order, callback)
            local b = track(Instance.new("TextButton"))
            b.Name = name
            b.LayoutOrder = order
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, __iui.touch and 42 or 34)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = style.button
            b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.Text = text
            b.TextColor3 = style.text
            b.TextSize = __iui.touch and 12 or 11
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.ZIndex = 25002
            b.Parent = panel
            ensureCorner(b, 11)
            ensureStroke(b, style.stroke, 1)
            bindStyleHover(b)
            pcall(__iui.motion.bindPanelButton, b)
            connect(b.Activated, callback)
            return b
        end

        local styleButton = makeButton("Style", "STYLE: " .. styleNames[styleIndex], 3, function()
            styleIndex = (styleIndex % #styleNames) + 1
            applyStyle()
            pcall(__iui.motion.themeWave)
            if __iui.refreshPanel then
                __iui.refreshPanel()
            end
            __iui.refreshButtons()
            saveState()
        end)

        local animationButton = makeButton("Animation", "ANIMATION: " .. animationNames[animationIndex], 4, function()
            animationIndex = (animationIndex % #animationNames) + 1
            animationButton.Text = "ANIMATION: " .. animationNames[animationIndex]
            __iui.animationTime = 0
            saveState()
        end)

        local transitionButton = makeButton("Transition", "TRANSITION: " .. transitionNames[transitionIndex], 5, function()
            transitionIndex = (transitionIndex % #transitionNames) + 1
            transitionButton.Text = "TRANSITION: " .. transitionNames[transitionIndex]
            saveState()
            playTransition()
        end)

        local blurButton = makeButton("Blur", "TRANSITION BLUR: " .. (transitionBlurEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"), 6, function()
            transitionBlurEnabled = not transitionBlurEnabled
            blurButton.Text = "TRANSITION BLUR: " .. (transitionBlurEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
            __iui.motion.setColor(blurButton, transitionBlurEnabled and style.accent or style.button)
            saveState()
        end)
        blurButton.BackgroundColor3 = transitionBlurEnabled and style.accent or style.button

        local intensityButton = makeButton("Intensity", string.format("ANIMATION INTENSITY: %d%%", math.floor(animationIntensity * 100 + 0.5)), 7, function()
            local values = { 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.15, 1.25 }
            local idx = 1
            for i, v in values do
                if math.abs(v - animationIntensity) < 0.02 then
                    idx = i
                    break
                end
            end
            idx = (idx % #values) + 1
            animationIntensity = values[idx]
            intensityButton.Text = string.format("ANIMATION INTENSITY: %d%%", math.floor(animationIntensity * 100 + 0.5))
            saveState()
        end)

        local preview = makeButton("Preview", "PREVIEW TRANSITION", 8, function()
            playTransition()
        end)

        local toggle = makeButton("Toggle", "IMMERSION: " .. (uiEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"), 9, function()
            uiEnabled = not uiEnabled
            toggle.Text = "IMMERSION: " .. (uiEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
            if not uiEnabled then
                cancelTransition()
            end
            if __iui.refreshPanel then
                __iui.refreshPanel()
            end
            __iui.refreshButtons()
            saveState()
        end)
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = uiEnabled and style.accent or style.button

        local hint = track(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
        hint.Name = "Hint"
        hint.LayoutOrder = 10
        hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
        hint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        hint.Text = "Tap to cycle  ·  drag to move"
        hint.TextColor3 = style.muted
        hint.TextSize = 9
        hint.TextWrapped = true
        hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        hint.ZIndex = 25001
        hint.Parent = panel

        __iui.refreshPanel = function()
            if not (panel and panel.Parent) then
                return
            end
            __iui.motion.setColor(panel, style.panel)
            ensureStroke(panel, style.stroke, 1)
            ensureGradient(panel, style.panel, style.panel2)
            if prismBar and prismBar.Parent then
                prismBar.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
                ensureGradient(prismBar, style.accent, style.accent2)
            end
            title.TextColor3 = style.text
            subtitle.TextColor3 = style.muted
            hint.TextColor3 = style.muted
            styleButton.Text = "STYLE: " .. styleNames[styleIndex]
            for _, b in { styleButton, animationButton, transitionButton, blurButton, intensityButton, preview, toggle } do
                if b ~= blurButton and b ~= toggle then
                    __iui.motion.setColor(b, style.button)
                end
                b.TextColor3 = style.text
            end
            __iui.motion.setColor(blurButton, transitionBlurEnabled and style.accent or style.button)
            __iui.motion.setColor(toggle, uiEnabled and style.accent or style.button)
        end

        pcall(__iui.motion.materialize, panel, title, subtitle, prismBar, hint)
        __iui.controlPanel = panel
        return panel
    end

    local function patchStyleOnNewObjects()
        connect(__iuiParent.DescendantAdded, function(object)
            if not __iui.alive then
                return
            end
            if object.Name == "LT_SidebarSortMenu" then
                pcall(__iui.motion.watchReveal, object)
            end
            if object.Name:sub(1, 4) == "LT_" then
                return
            end
            task.defer(function()
                if hasParent(object) then
                    styleObject(object)
                    if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
                        bindStyleHover(object)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function addCleanupHook()
        local oldStop = __dcm_masterRuntime.stop
        if type(oldStop) == "function" and not __dcm_masterRuntime.__iuiWrapped then
            __dcm_masterRuntime.__iuiWrapped = true
            __dcm_masterRuntime.stop = function(...)
                if __iui.alive then
                    pcall(function()
                        __iui.stop()
                    end)
                end
                return oldStop(...)
            end
        end
    end

    __iui.stop = function()
        if not __iui.alive then
            return
        end
        __iui.alive = false
        cancelTransition()
        for _, c in __iui.connections do
            disconnect(c)
        end
        for _, c in __iui.pageConnections do
            disconnect(c)
        end
        table.clear(__iui.connections)
        table.clear(__iui.pageConnections)
        if blurEffect and blurEffect.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                blurEffect.Size = 0
                blurEffect.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
        pcall(__iui.motion.stop)
        for object in __iui.objects do
            if object and object.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    if object.Name:sub(1, 4) == "LT_" then
                        object:Destroy()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        for object, values in __iui.original do
            if object and object.Parent then
                for property, value in values do
                    pcall(function()
                        object[property] = value
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        __dcm_env.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = nil
        __dcm_shared.__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime = nil
    end

    __iui.onThemeChanged = function()
        if not __iui.alive then
            return
        end
        applyStyle()
        if transitionOverlay and transitionOverlay.Parent then
            transitionOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = style.bg
            ensureGradient(transitionOverlay, style.panel, style.accent2)
            transitionGlow.BackgroundColor3 = style.accent
        end
        if __iui.refreshPanel then
            __iui.refreshPanel()
        end
        __iui.refreshButtons()
        pcall(__iui.motion.themeWave)
    end

    __iui.applyStyle = applyStyle
    __iui.playTransition = playTransition
    __iui.styles = styleNames
    __iui.animations = animationNames
    __iui.transitions = transitionNames

    applyStyle()
    if uiEnabled then
        buildControlPanel()
        watchPages()
        patchStyleOnNewObjects()
        for _, object in __iuiParent:GetDescendants() do
            if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
                bindStyleHover(object)
            end
        end
        connect(RS and RS.RenderStepped or nil, function(dt)
            __iui.ema = (__iui.ema or dt) * 0.95 + dt * 0.05
            __iui.slowFor = 0
            local ok, err = pcall(updateAnimation, dt)
            if ok then
                __iui.animFails = 0
            else
                __iui.animFails = (__iui.animFails or 0) + 1
                if __iui.animFails >= 5 then
                    __iui.animDisabled = true
                    warn("[DeltaCustomization] animation loop disabled after repeated errors: " .. tostring(err))
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    addCleanupHook()
    saveState()
end

Cor = Cor,
Out = Out,
Glos = Glos,
options = options,
})
end
local ForceUIColor = nil
local ForceUIBGColor = nil
local function GetUIColor(t)
local m = Util.UIColMemo
if m and m.t == t and m.f == ForceUIColor then return m.c end
local r
if ForceUIColor then
local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
local h, s, v = ForceUIColor:ToHSV()
if s < 0.2 then
v *= 0.8 + si * 0.2
else
h += si * 0.01
end
r = Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
else
r = Util.DiscoColor(t / 2)
end
if not m then m = {} Util.UIColMemo = m end
m.t, m.f, m.c = t, ForceUIColor, r
return r
end
local function GetUIBGColor(t)
local m = Util.UIBgMemo
if m and m.t == t and m.f == ForceUIBGColor then return m.c end
local r
if ForceUIBGColor then
local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
local h, s, v = ForceUIBGColor:ToHSV()
if s < 0.2 then
if v > 0.5 then
v *= 0.95 + si * 0.05
else
v *= 1.05 + si * 0.05
end
else
h += si * 0.01
end
r = Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
else
r = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
if not m then m = {} Util.UIBgMemo = m end
m.t, m.f, m.c = t, ForceUIBGColor, r
return r
end
local UITextColor = Util.Instance("Color3Value")
UITextColor.Value = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
if Util.UhAdmin then Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme = function(t) return GetUIColor(t), GetUIBGColor(t), UITextColor.Value end end
local function RegisterTextLabel(obj)
if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
obj.TextColor3 = val
end))
end
if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
local h, s, v = UITextColor.Value:ToHSV()
obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
h, s, v = val:ToHSV()
obj.TextColor3 = val
obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
end))
end
end
local function UpdateGrads(t, all)
local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
local c = Util.Color.Resolve(t, GetUIColor(t))
local bgc = GetUIBGColor(t)
local h, s, v = bgc:ToHSV()
local bgcd = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v * 0.9)
local h2, s2, v2 = c:ToHSV()
local glc = c
if v > v2 then
glc = bgc
end
local outc = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55)
local list = StylizedObjs
local n = #list
if not all and n > 0 then
local dtG = t - (Util.GradT or t)
Util.GradT = t
local cur = Util.GradCursor or 0
local vmemo = Util.GradVisMemo
if vmemo then table.clear(vmemo) else vmemo = {} Util.GradVisMemo = vmemo end
for _ = 1, math.min(n, math.max(24, math.ceil(n * math.clamp(dtG, 0, 0.25) / 0.3))) do
cur = cur + 1
if cur > n then cur = 1 end
local g = list[cur]
local o = g.obj
if o.Parent == nil and not pcall(Util.GradProbe, o) then
list[cur] = list[n]
list[n] = nil
n = n - 1
cur = cur - 1
if n == 0 then break end
else
g.vis = o.Parent ~= nil and (not o:IsA("GuiObject") or Util.IsGuiVisibleM(o, vmemo))
g.force = true
end
end
Util.GradCursor = cur
end
for gi = 1, n do
local grad = list[gi]
if all or grad.vis ~= false or grad.force then
grad.force = nil
local obj, Out, Glos, options = grad.obj, grad.Out, grad.Glos, grad.options
if Util.Dirty(grad, "oc", outc) or all then Out.Color = outc end
if grad.thick ~= CFG.UIBorder then
grad.thick = CFG.UIBorder
Out.Thickness = CFG.UIBorder
end
if grad.Cor and grad.round ~= CFG.UIRound then
grad.round = CFG.UIRound
grad.Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, CFG.UIRound)
end
if options.BgTr and grad.btr ~= CFG.UIBgTr then
grad.btr = CFG.UIBgTr
obj.BackgroundTransparency = CFG.UIBgTr
end
local wantBg = options.Depthed and bgcd or bgc
if Util.Dirty(grad, "bc", wantBg) or all then obj.BackgroundColor3 = wantBg end
local gl = grad.glc
if Glos[1] and (all or not gl or grad.glv ~= CFG.UIGlow or math.abs(gl.R - glc.R) + math.abs(gl.G - glc.G) + math.abs(gl.B - glc.B) > 0.004) then
grad.glc, grad.glv = glc, CFG.UIGlow
for _,v in Glos do
v.ImageColor3 = glc
v.Visible = CFG.UIGlow
end
end
end
end
end
Util.GradProbe = function(o) o.Parent = o.Parent end

local pos = ch + offset
local dowsize = Util.UDim2ToVector2Offset(UIMainWindow.Size)
local imjollx = (dowsize.X * 0.5 - 100) / screen.X
local imjolly = dowsize.Y * -0.5 / screen.Y
local boxy = 31 / screen.Y
pos = Vector2.new(
math.clamp(pos.X, -imjollx, 1 + imjollx),
math.clamp(pos.Y, -imjolly, 1 - imjolly - boxy)
)
UIMainWindow.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Scale(pos)
end
end
end)

local same = dragref and (dragref == input or (dragref.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1))
if same then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
dragref = nil
end
end
end)
UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
if dragref then
dragref = nil
WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
end

local _funcrefreshes = {}
local function AddToRenderStep(func, linkto)
table.insert(_funcrefreshes, func)
if linkto then
linkto.Destroying:Connect(function()
local i = table.find(_funcrefreshes, func)
if i then
table.remove(_funcrefreshes, i)
end
end)
end
return func
end
Util.DecoHooks = {}
Util.AddDecoStep = function(func, linkto)
local list = Util.DecoHooks
list[#list + 1] = func
if linkto then
linkto.Destroying:Connect(function()
local i = table.find(list, func)
if i then
table.remove(list, i)
end
end)
end
return func
end
local _totalrendertime = 0
local _lowAcc = 0
do
local decoList = Util.DecoHooks
local warned = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local govAcc, govN = 0, 0
local Gov = Util.FX.Gov
RunService:BindToRenderStep("Uhhhhhh_Render" .. Util.RandomString(), Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value - 69, function(dt)
_totalrendertime += dt
local vis = UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset > 35
if WindowContent.Visible ~= vis then WindowContent.Visible = vis end
local decoDt, runDeco = dt, true
if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then
govAcc, govN = 0, 0
_lowAcc += dt
if _lowAcc < 1 / Util.FX.LowEndUIFPS then
return
end
dt, _lowAcc = _lowAcc, 0
decoDt = dt
else
_lowAcc = 0
local gs = Gov and Gov.Stride or 1
if gs > 1 then
govAcc += dt
govN += 1
if govN >= gs then
decoDt, govAcc, govN = govAcc, 0, 0
else
runDeco = false
end
else
govAcc, govN = 0, 0
end
end
if runDeco then UpdateGrads(_totalrendertime) end
for _, func in _funcrefreshes do
local s, e = pcall(func, _totalrendertime, dt)
if not s and not warned[func] then warned[func] = true warn(e) end
end
if runDeco then
for _, func in decoList do
local s, e = pcall(func, _totalrendertime, decoDt)
if not s and not warned[func] then warned[func] = true warn(e) end
end
end
end)
end

Util.AdminTheme = (function()
local AT = {}
local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local roots = Util.AdminThemeRoots or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Util.AdminThemeRoots = roots
local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local tracked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local queue, qh, qt = {}, 1, 0
local SKIP = {ColorPreview = true, CPBackground = true, MainCP = true, ColorSlider = true}
local th = {accent = WHITE, bg = BLACK, text = WHITE, h = 0, light = false}
local last, F = {}, {}
local PS_STROKE, PS_GRAD, PS_TEXT, PS_SCROLL, PS_GUI = {"Color"}, {"Color"}, {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"}, {"BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3"}, {"BackgroundColor3"}
local function near(a, b, tol)
return math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B) < (tol or 0.02)
end
local function isAcc(c, fresh)
if near(c, th.accent, 0.06) then return true end
local nu = NAUISTROKER
if typeof(nu) == "Color3" and near(c, nu, 0.06) then return true end
local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
return s >= 0.4 and v >= 0.45 and h >= 0.46 and h <= 0.86 and (fresh or math.abs(h - th.h) > 0.03)
end
local function classify(p, c, fresh)
if isAcc(c, fresh) then return "accent" end
local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
if s >= 0.4 and v >= 0.45 then return nil end
if p == "TextColor3" then
if s < 0.35 then
if v > 0.6 then return "text" end
if v > 0.3 then return "mute" end
end
return nil
end
if v >= 0.04 and v <= 0.5 and (s <= 0.4 or (h >= 0.46 and h <= 0.86)) then return "surf" end
return nil
end
local function gradHasAcc(seq, fresh)
for _, kp in seq.Keypoints do
if isAcc(kp.Value, fresh) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function colorFor(kind, orig)
if kind == "accent" then return th.accent end
if kind == "text" then return th.text end
if kind == "mute" then return th.text:Lerp(th.bg, 0.45) end
local _, _, v = orig:ToHSV()
local d = math.max(v - 0.078, 0)
if th.light then return th.bg:Lerp(BLACK, d * 0.8) end
return th.bg:Lerp(WHITE, d * 1.2)
end
local function skipped(o)
local p = o
while p do
if SKIP[p.Name] then return true end
p = p.Parent
end
return false
end
local function track(o)
local ps
if o:IsA("UIStroke") then ps = PS_STROKE
elseif o:IsA("UIGradient") then ps = PS_GRAD
elseif o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then ps = PS_TEXT
elseif o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then ps = PS_SCROLL
elseif o:IsA("GuiObject") then ps = PS_GUI
else return end
if skipped(o) then return end
local isG = ps == PS_GRAD
local recs = {}
for _, p in ps do
local c = o[p]
local r = {orig = c}
if isG then
r.grad = true
r.kind = gradHasAcc(c, true)
else
r.kind = classify(p, c, true) or false
end
if r.kind then r.dirty = true end
recs[p] = r
end
tracked[o] = recs
end
local function doObj(o, recs, slow)
for p, r in recs do
if r.kind or slow or F.force then
if r.grad then
local cur = o.Color
local ck, rk = cur.Keypoints, (r.wrote or r.orig).Keypoints
if #ck ~= #rk or not near(ck[1].Value, rk[1].Value) or not near(ck[#ck].Value, rk[#rk].Value) then
r.orig, r.wrote = cur, nil
r.kind = gradHasAcc(cur, false)
if r.kind then r.dirty = true end
end
if r.kind and (r.dirty or F.a) then
local out = {}
for i, kp in r.orig.Keypoints do
out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, isAcc(kp.Value, true) and th.accent or kp.Value)
end
local seq = ColorSequence.new(out)
r.wrote, r.dirty = seq, nil
o.Color = seq
end
else
local cur = o[p]
if not near(cur, r.wrote or r.orig) then
r.orig, r.wrote = cur, nil
r.kind = classify(p, cur, false) or false
if r.kind then r.dirty = true end
end
local k = r.kind
if k and (r.dirty or F.force or (k == "accent" and F.a) or ((k == "surf" or k == "mute") and F.b) or ((k == "text" or k == "mute") and F.x)) then
local nv = colorFor(k, r.orig)
r.wrote, r.dirty = nv, nil
if not near(cur, nv, 0.004) then o[p] = nv end
end
end
end
end
end
local function hook(g)
if hooked[g] or typeof(g) ~= "Instance" then return end
hooked[g] = true
g.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
qt += 1
queue[qt] = d
end)
for _, d in g:GetDescendants() do
qt += 1
queue[qt] = d
end
end
local SKIPGUI = {RobloxGui = true, TopBarApp = true, ThemeProvider = true, PurchasePromptApp = true, InGameMenu = true, RobloxNetworkPauseNotification = true, UhAdmin = true}
local checked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function isExecUI(g)
local hasBox, hasEx, hasUp, n = false, false, false, 0
for _, d in g:GetDescendants() do
n += 1
if n > 4000 then break end
if d:IsA("TextBox") then
if string.find(string.lower(d.PlaceholderText), "^search for scripts") then hasBox = true end
elseif d:IsA("TextButton") then
local t = string.upper(d.Text)
if t == "EXECUTE" then hasEx = true elseif t == "UPLOAD" then hasUp = true end
end
if hasBox or (hasEx and hasUp) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function findExecUIs(now)
local hosts = {}
local okH, hui = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
if okH and typeof(hui) == "Instance" then hosts[#hosts + 1] = hui end
local okC, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if okC and cg then hosts[#hosts + 1] = cg end
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if pg then hosts[#hosts + 1] = pg end
for _, h in hosts do
for _, g in h:GetChildren() do
if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and not roots[g] and not SKIPGUI[g.Name] and now - (checked[g] or -100) >= 10 then
checked[g] = now
local ok, hit = pcall(isExecUI, g)
if ok and hit then roots[g] = true end
end
end
end
end
local scanAt = 0
local lastAt, lastSlow, lastTab = 0, 0, nil
function AT.Tick(force)
local now = os.clock()
local fxm = Util.FX
local stressed = fxm and ((fxm.Gov and fxm.Gov.Stride or 1) > 1 or (fxm.IsLowEnd and fxm.IsLowEnd()))
if not force and now - lastAt < (stressed and 0.3 or 0.1) then return end
lastAt = now
local acc = (Util.Color and Util.Color.Cur) or GetUIColor(_totalrendertime)
local bg = GetUIBGColor(_totalrendertime)
local tx = UITextColor.Value
F.force = force or false
F.a = F.force or not last.a or not near(acc, last.a, 0.004)
F.b = F.force or not last.b or not near(bg, last.b, 0.006)
F.x = F.force or not last.x or not near(tx, last.x, 0.006)
if F.a then
last.a, th.accent = acc, acc
th.h = acc:ToHSV()
end
if F.b then
last.b, th.bg = bg, bg
local _, _, bv = bg:ToHSV()
th.light = bv > 0.5
end
if F.x then last.x, th.text = tx, tx end
NAUISTROKER = acc
if F.a then
if NAgui then
if NAgui.applyMainColorToRegisteredStrokes then pcall(NAgui.applyMainColorToRegisteredStrokes, acc) end
if NAgui.applyMainColorToAccentSurfaces then pcall(NAgui.applyMainColorToAccentSurfaces, acc) end
if NAgui.scheduleMainColorTabRefresh and (F.force or not lastTab or not near(acc, lastTab, 0.02)) then
lastTab = acc
pcall(NAgui.scheduleMainColorTabRefresh, acc)
end
end
if NAmanage and NAmanage.SideSwipe_UpdateHandleColors then pcall(NAmanage.SideSwipe_UpdateHandleColors, acc) end
end
if NAStuff and typeof(NAStuff.NASCREENGUI) == "Instance" then roots[NAStuff.NASCREENGUI] = true end
if now - scanAt >= 5 then
scanAt = now
pcall(findExecUIs, now)
end
for g in roots do hook(g) end
local slow = now - lastSlow >= (stressed and 3 or 1)
if slow then lastSlow = now end
for o, recs in tracked do
if o.Parent then pcall(doObj, o, recs, slow) end
end
end
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local n, t0 = 0, os.clock()
while qh <= qt and n < 120 do
local d = queue[qh]
queue[qh] = nil
qh += 1
n += 1
if d and not tracked[d] and d.Parent then pcall(track, d) end
if n >= 8 and os.clock() - t0 > 0.002 then break end
end
if qh > qt then qh, qt = 1, 0 end
pcall(AT.Tick, false)
end)
return AT
end)()

local ta = (nEnter or iw.x > 0.2 or ih.x > 0.2) and 1 or 0

local PositionProcessor = {
function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local d = pos.Magnitude
if d > 0 then
local r = math.atan2(pos.X / d, pos.Y / d)
local a = math.pi * 0.375
local out = Vector2.new(math.sin(r + a), math.cos(r + a))
local tp = out * (40 + pbl / 12)
local tv = (tp - pos) * 2
vel = tv:Lerp(vel, math.exp(-2 * dt))
if math.random() < 0.01 then
vel += Vector2.new(math.random(-64, 64), math.random(-64, 64))
end
if spike > 64 then
vel += out * 64 * math.random()
end
pos += vel * dt
else
pos += Vector2.new(0, 10)
end
v[2], v[3] = pos, vel
return Vector3.new(zind * pos.Magnitude / 6, pos.Y, pos.X)
end,
function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local a = i / ps
local s = (a * 6) % 1
local r = (a + s / 8) * 2 * math.pi + os.clock() * 2 + zind * math.pi * 0.125 * (pbl / 200) * (1 - s)
pos = Vector2.new(math.sin(r), math.cos(r)) * s * (100 + pbl / 15)
v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
end,
function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local a = i / ps
local b = 1 / 3
local c = math.sqrt(3) / 2
local d = {
{Vector2.new(0, b + c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(-1, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(-1, b - c), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(1, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(1, b - c), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b + c)},
}
local t = a * #d
local i = math.floor(t) + 1
local u = t % 1
if i > #d then
i = #d
u = 1
end
pos = d[i][1]:Lerp(d[i][2], u) * 150
local r = os.clock() * 2
pos = Vector2.new(
pos.X * math.cos(r) - pos.Y * math.sin(r),
pos.X * math.sin(r) + pos.Y * math.cos(r)
)
v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
end,
}
local currentprocessor = 1
local lastLowScene = false
local NOPARTICLES = {}
local glowD = {}
Util.AddDecoStep(function(t, dt)
if Util.IsGuiVisible(CracktroFrame) then
local pp = PositionProcessor[currentprocessor]
local CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize = CracktroFrame.AbsoluteSize
local glc, glt = UITextColor.Value, 0.75 + math.sin(((os.clock() / 10) % 2) * math.pi) * 0.05
if Util.Dirty(glowD, "c", glc) then Glowy.ImageColor3 = glc end
if Util.Dirty(glowD, "t", glt) then Glowy.ImageTransparency = glt end
local pbl = UISound.Music.PlaybackLoudness
local spike = math.max(0, (pbl - oldpbl) - 16)
oldpbl = pbl
local trivelt = pbl * 2 * dt
trivel = trivelt + (trivel - trivelt) * math.exp(-8 * dt)
Triforce.Rotation = (Triforce.Rotation + trivel) % 360
local ring = CFrame.Angles(
0,
math.cos(((t / 5) % 2) * math.pi) * math.pi * 0.5,
(1 - math.cos(((t / 7) % 2) * math.pi)) * math.pi * 0.5
)
local fov = 220
local lowScene = Util.FX.IsLowEnd()
if lowScene ~= lastLowScene then
lastLowScene = lowScene
if lowScene then
for _, pv in particles do
pv[1].Visible = false
pv[5] = false
end
end
end
for i,v in (lowScene and NOPARTICLES or particles) do
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local sp = ring:VectorToWorldSpace(pp(i, v, dt, pbl, spike))
local z = sp.Z
local sc = fov / (z + fov)
sp = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) * sc
local nvis, nzind = lvis, lzind
if z > 1 - fov then
inst.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset(sp + CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize / 2)
inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sc * 2.5, sc * 2.5)
nvis = true
if z > 0 then
nzind = -1
else
nzind = 1
end
else
nvis = false
end
if lvis ~= nvis then
inst.Visible = nvis
v[5] = nvis
end
if lzind ~= nzind then
inst.ZIndex = nzind
v[6] = nzind
end
end
local textsel = t % 9
if IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded then
textsel = t % 12
end
textsel //= 3
if text3mustchange ~= (textsel == 3) then
text3mustchange = (textsel == 3)
if text3mustchange then changequote() end
end
if textsel == 0 then
text0.Visible = true
text1.Visible = false
text2.Visible = false
text3.Visible = false
elseif textsel == 1 then
text0.Visible = false
text1.Visible = true
text2.Visible = false
text3.Visible = false
elseif textsel == 2 then
text0.Visible = false
text1.Visible = false
text2.Visible = false
text3.Visible = true
else
text0.Visible = false
text1.Visible = false
text2.Visible = true
text3.Visible = false
end
else
currentprocessor = math.random(1, #PositionProcessor)
end
end, CracktroFrame)
end
task.wait()

function UI.CreateText(parent, text, size, alignment)
local margin = 5
local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65536)
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 1, -margin + 1)
Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Text.RichText = true
Text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
Text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Text.TextTransparency = 0
Text.TextXAlignment = alignment
Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
Text.TextWrapped = true
Text.TextSize = size
RegisterTextLabel(Text)
local lastCT, lastTS, lastFont, lastX
local function update()
local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
local ct, ts, fnt = Text.ContentText, Text.TextSize, Text.Font
if ct == lastCT and ts == lastTS and fnt == lastFont and x == lastX then return end
lastCT, lastTS, lastFont, lastX = ct, ts, fnt, x
local size = Util.TextSize(ct, ts, fnt, Vector2.new(x - margin * 2, math.huge))
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size.Y + margin)
end
Text.Text = text
update()
Text.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
if prop == "TextColor3" or prop == "TextTransparency" or prop == "TextBounds" or prop == "TextFits" or prop == "AbsolutePosition" or prop == "AbsoluteRotation" then return end
update()
end)
return Text
end

SliderR.BorderSizePixel = 0
local SliderB = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderR)
SliderB.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
SliderB.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
SliderB.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
SliderB.BackgroundTransparency = 0
SliderB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
SliderB.BorderSizePixel = 0
SliderB.ZIndex = 2
Stylize(SliderR, {
Depthed = true,
})
Stylize(SliderB)
pcall(Util.FX.EnhanceKnob, SliderC, SliderB)
local range = max - min
if step > 0 then
if range / step < 20 then
local i = min + step
while i < max do
local snaps = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderR)
snaps.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
snaps.Position = UDim2.new((i - min) / range, 0, 0, 1)
snaps.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 3)
snaps.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
snaps.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
snaps.BorderSizePixel = 0
i += step
end
end
end
local Select = Util.Instance("NumberValue")
local function update()
local str = string.format("%.3f", Select.Value)
if str:find("%.") then
while str:sub(-1) == "0" do
str = str:sub(1, -2)
if str:sub(-1) == "." then
str = str:sub(1, -2)
break
end
end
end
BoxText.Text = str
SliderB.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp((Select.Value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
if math.random(4) == 1 then
if str:find("67") or str:find("6.7") then
Util.UINotify("SIX SEVENNNN 67 67 67 67 OMG")
end
end
end
Select.Value = value
Select.Changed:Connect(update)
update()
BoxText.FocusLost:Connect(function()
Select.Value = tonumber(BoxText.Text) or Select.Value
update()
end)
local function ondrag(x)
local val = range * math.clamp((x - SliderR.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderR.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
if step > 0 then
val = math.round(val / step) * step
end
val += min
Select.Value = val
end
local dragref = nil
local start = nil
SliderC.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragref = input
start = input.Position
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragref then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and dragref == input) then
if start then
local delta = input.Position - start
if delta.Magnitude > 10 then
start = nil
if math.abs(delta.X) < math.abs(delta.Y) then
dragref = nil
end
end
else
ondrag(input.Position.X)
end
end
end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if dragref and dragref == input then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
ondrag(input.Position.X)
dragref = nil
end
end
end)
return Select
end
function UI.CreateDropdown(parent, text, array, value)
value = value and math.clamp(value, 1, #array) or 1
local margin = 5
local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)

Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
Text.TextWrapped = true
Text.TextSize = 20
RegisterTextLabel(Text)

Dropdown.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -margin)
Dropdown.BackgroundTransparency = 0
Dropdown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Dropdown.BorderSizePixel = 0
Dropdown.Text = ""
Dropdown.AutoButtonColor = true
local DropdownText = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Dropdown)
DropdownText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
DropdownText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
DropdownText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -margin * 2, 1, -margin)
DropdownText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
DropdownText.RichText = true
DropdownText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
DropdownText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
