		local stroke = new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = WHITE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, card)
		local strokeGrad = new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(a, a)}, stroke)
		-- depth / lighting: top sheen, bottom shade, 1px top highlight
		local sheen = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.55, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, card)
		new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.9, 1)}, sheen)
		local shade = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, card)
		new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0.78)}, shade)
		local hi = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, card)
		new("UIGradient", {Transparency = fade(1, 0.5, 1)}, hi)
		local img = new("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44), BackgroundColor3 = c2:Lerp(WHITE, 0.12),
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = o.image, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 3}, card)
		round(img, UDim.new(1, 0))
		new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = a}, img)
		local ring = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3}, card)
		round(ring, UDim.new(1, 0))
		local ringStroke = new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = a}, ring)
		-- 3D triangle medallion right beside the PFP (real FX.NewTriangle3D viewport; pseudo-3D fallback only if the host has no engine hook)
		local plate = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 15), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, card)
		round(plate, UDim.new(1, 0))
		local big = role and role.logo
		local plateStroke = new("UIStroke", {Thickness = big and 1.8 or 1.2, Color = a, Transparency = big and 0.15 or 0.45}, plate)
		local slot = new("Frame", {Name = "Tri", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(big and 32 or 28, big and 32 or 28),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4}, plate)
		if Env.NewTriangle then
			local okT, T = pcall(Env.NewTriangle, slot, {ZIndex = 5, Halo = false, Dance = false,
				Tint = function() return self.CurA end, IsVisible = function() return self.Alive and gui.Enabled end})
			if okT and T then self.Tri = T end
		end
		if not self.Tri then self.Logo = makeLogo(slot); logoStep(self.Logo, 0.4, a) end
		local rightPad = (role and role.tag) and 128 or 14
		local title = new("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 11), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(98 + rightPad), 0, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = o.title,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(a, 0.12), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.82, TextStrokeColor3 = BLACK, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4}, card)
		local sub = new("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 34), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(98 + 14), 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = o.subtitle,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = a, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4}, card)
		local bar = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = a, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4}, card)
		round(bar, UDim.new(1, 0))
		local barGrad = new("UIGradient", {Transparency = fade(1, 0, 1)}, bar)
		local shine = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-70, -10), Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 1, 20), Rotation = 18, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6}, card)
		new("UIGradient", {Transparency = fade(1, 0.82, 1)}, shine)
		if role then -- verified check on the avatar (+ rank chip for owners)
			local vb = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(49, 49), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 140, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6}, card)
			round(vb, UDim.new(1, 0))
			new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = c2}, vb)
			checkmark(vb, 7)
			if role.tag then
				local chip = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = a, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4}, card)
				round(chip, UDim.new(0, 7))
				new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5, Color = a}, chip)
				new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)}, chip)
				new("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)}, chip)
				new("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = role.tag,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = a:Lerp(WHITE, 0.35), ZIndex = 5, LayoutOrder = 2}, chip)
			end
		end
		if acts then -- moderator buttons beside the card (clicks are handled by the receiver via Banner:HitAction)
			self.ActBtn = {}
			for i, ac in ipairs(acts) do
				local col, row = (i - 1) % ACOLS, math.floor((i - 1) / ACOLS)
				local pill = new("Frame", {Name = "Act_" .. tostring(ac.key), Position = UDim2.new(1, AX + col * (AW + AG), 0, AY + row * (AH + AG)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(AW, AH),
					BackgroundColor3 = ac.color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, holder)
				round(pill, UDim.new(0, 9))
				new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5, Color = a}, pill)
				local lbl = new("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = tostring(ac.label), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 4}, pill)
				self.ActBtn[ac.key] = {Frame = pill, Label = lbl, Color = ac.color, Text = tostring(ac.label), Col = col, Row = row}
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local s = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundColor3 = a, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5}, holder)
			round(s, UDim.new(1, 0))
			self.Spark[i] = s
			table.insert(self.G.spark, s)
		end
		table.insert(self.G.glow, glow); table.insert(self.G.shine, shine); table.insert(self.G.ring, ring)
		for _, f in ipairs({shadow, sheen, shade, hi}) do table.insert(self.G.depth, f) end
		self.Gui, self.Holder, self.Scale, self.Glow, self.Pointer, self.Card, self.CardGrad = gui, holder, scale, glow, pointer, card, cardGrad
		self.Stroke, self.StrokeGrad, self.Ring, self.RingStroke, self.Bar, self.BarGrad, self.Shine = stroke, strokeGrad, ring, ringStroke, bar, barGrad, shine
		self.Title, self.Sub, self.Img, self.Plate = title, sub, img, plateStroke
		self.CardC, self.GlowC, self.ShadowC = cardC, glowC, shadowC
		self:Restyle(o.style)
		Active[self] = true
		if not conn then conn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(step) end
		return self
	end

	function Banner:SetAdornee(part)
		if not self.Alive then return end
		self.Gui.Adornee = part
		self.Gui.Enabled = part ~= nil
		if part and not self.Shown then
			self.Shown = true
			TS:Create(self.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
			TS:Create(self.Title, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
			TS:Create(self.Sub, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
		elseif not part and self.Shown then -- respawn gap: re-pop when the new character appears
			self.Shown = false
			self.Scale.Scale = 0
			self.Title.TextTransparency, self.Sub.TextTransparency = 1, 1
		end
	end

	function Banner:Update(o)
		self.Opts = o
		self.Title.Text, self.Sub.Text, self.Img.Image = o.title, o.subtitle, o.image
		if self.Shown then
			TS:Create(self.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Scale = 1.08}):Play()
			task.delay(0.12, function()
				if self.Alive then TS:Create(self.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play() end
			end)
		end
	end

	function Banner:Destroy(animated)
		if not self.Alive then return end
		self.Alive = false
		Active[self] = nil
		if not next(Active) and conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
		local gui, tri = self.Gui, self.Tri
		self.Tri = nil
		local function kill()
			if tri then pcall(tri.Destroy, tri) end -- stops the triangle's own render loop
			gui:Destroy()
		end
		if animated and gui.Enabled then
			TS:Create(self.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, kill)
		else
			kill()
		end
	end

	function Banner:Contains(p) -- p = point in viewport coordinates
		local cam, part = workspace.CurrentCamera, self.Gui.Adornee
		if not (self.Alive and self.Shown and cam and part and self.Gui.Enabled) then return false end
		if (cam.CFrame.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > self.Gui.MaxDistance then return false end
		local v, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position + cam.CFrame.UpVector * self.Gui.StudsOffset.Y)
		if not on then return false end
		local s = self.Scale.Scale
		return math.abs(p.X - v.X) <= self.W / 2 * s and p.Y >= v.Y - 78 * s and p.Y <= v.Y - 14 * s
	end

	function Banner:HitAction(p) -- p = point in viewport coordinates; returns the key of the inline button under p (or nil)
		if not self.ActBtn then return nil end
		local cam, part = workspace.CurrentCamera, self.Gui.Adornee
		if not (self.Alive and self.Shown and cam and part and self.Gui.Enabled) then return nil end
		if (cam.CFrame.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > self.Gui.MaxDistance then return nil end
		local v, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position + cam.CFrame.UpVector * self.Gui.StudsOffset.Y)
		if not on then return nil end
		local s = self.Scale.Scale
		for key, b in pairs(self.ActBtn) do
			-- holder is anchored bottom-centre on the gui centre (v) and is 78 tall: its right edge is v.X + W/2, its top is v.Y - 78
			local x0 = v.X + (self.W / 2 + AX + b.Col * (AW + AG)) * s
			local y0 = v.Y + (AY + b.Row * (AH + AG) - 78) * s
			if p.X >= x0 - 3 and p.X <= x0 + (AW + 3) * s and p.Y >= y0 - 3 and p.Y <= y0 + (AH + 3) * s then return key end
		end
		return nil
	end

	function Banner:SetAction(key, text, color) -- re-label / recolour one inline button (e.g. "Sure?"); no args = back to normal
		local b = self.ActBtn and self.ActBtn[key]
		if not (self.Alive and b) then return end
		b.Label.Text = text or b.Text
		b.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = color or b.Color
	end

	function Banner:PulseAction(key) -- click feedback
		local b = self.ActBtn and self.ActBtn[key]
		if not (self.Alive and b) then return end
		b.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
		TS:Create(b.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	end

	function Banner:_step(now, a, s2, low)
		if not self.Gui.Enabled then return end
		local st = self.St
		local t = now + self.Seed
		if self.RoleColor then a = self.RoleColor; s2 = st.a2 or sec(a) -- owner / co-owner keep their rank colour
		elseif st.a then a = st.a; s2 = st.a2 or sec(a)
		elseif st.a2 then s2 = st.a2 end
		self.CurA = a
		self.Holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (low or bit32.band(st.fx, FXB.float) == 0) and 0 or math.sin(t * 2.2) * 3)
		self.Pointer.BackgroundColor3, self.Sub.TextColor3, self.Bar.BackgroundColor3 = a, a, a
		self.Title.TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(a, 0.12)
		self.Glow.BackgroundColor3, self.RingStroke.Color, self.Plate.Color = a, a, a
		self.StrokeGrad.Color = (st.bs == 0) and ColorSequence.new(a, a) or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, s2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, a)})
		if now - self.LastBG > 2 then
			self.LastBG = now
			local c1, c2 = bgPair(st)
			self.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2)
		end
		if low then
			if not self.FXOff then self.FXOff = true; self:_flags() end
			return
		end
		if self.FXOff then self.FXOff = false; self:_flags() end
		if st.bs == 2 then self.StrokeGrad.Rotation = (now * 90) % 360 end
		if self.Logo then logoStep(self.Logo, t, a) end
		self.Glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 3)
		local e = (t * 0.65) % 1
		self.Ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44 + 16 * e, 44 + 16 * e)
		self.RingStroke.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * e
		self.Shine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-70 + ((t * 0.3) % 1) * (self.W + 80), -10)
		self.BarGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(((t * 0.5) % 2) - 1, 0)
		for i, s in ipairs(self.Spark) do
			local p = (t * 0.35 + i / #self.Spark) % 1
			s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24 + (i - 1) * ((self.W - 48) / 3) + math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 8, 4 - p * 30)
			s.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.85 * p
			s.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and a or s2
		end
	end

	-- ===== banner style panel (opened from the "Banner Style" pill under the on/off pill) =====
	local PRESETS = {
		{"Aurora", "#5FA5FF", "#9B7BFF", "#1B2340", "#0C0F1C"}, {"Ember", "#FF7A3D", "#FFC14D", "#3A1A12", "#170A08"},
		{"Mint", "#3DFFB0", "#3DC9FF", "#11302B", "#07161A"}, {"Sakura", "#FF7AB8", "#FFB3D9", "#3A1830", "#170A18"},
		{"Gold", "#FFC83D", "#FF9A3D", "#33280F", "#17110A"}, {"Mono", "#E6E6EE", "#8A8A99", "#26262C", "#0E0E12"},
		{"Sunset", "#FF5E7E", "#FFA24D", "#2E1430", "#140A1A"}, {"Void", "#9B6BFF", "#FF4DCF", "#1A0F2E", "#080510"},
	}
	local BSTYLE = {[0] = "Solid", [1] = "Gradient", [2] = "Animated"}
	local EFFECTS = {{"Glow", 1}, {"Shine", 2}, {"Sparks", 4}, {"Ring", 8}, {"Depth", 16}, {"Float", 32}}
	local FIELD = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 44)

	local function customizer(root, btn, api) -- api = {get = function() -> style table | nil, set = function(styleTable | nil)}
		local st, refreshers, order = {}, {}, 0
		local function load()
			for k in pairs(st) do st[k] = nil end
			for k, v in pairs(api.get() or {}) do st[k] = v end
			for k, v in pairs(DEF) do if st[k] == nil then st[k] = v end end
		end
		load()
		local function commit() local out = {}; for k, v in pairs(st) do out[k] = v end; api.set(out) end
		local function refreshAll() for _, f in ipairs(refreshers) do f() end end
		local function z(c, p, par) p.ZIndex = 61; return new(c, p, par) end
		local function nextOrder() order += 1; return order end

		local sb = new("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(118, 26), AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Banner Style",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 50}, root)
		round(sb, UDim.new(1, 0))
		local sbs = new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5}, sb)
		local panel = new("ScrollingFrame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(238, 340), BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3,
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Visible = false, ZIndex = 60}, root)
		round(panel, UDim.new(0, 12))
		local pst = new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5}, panel)
		new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, panel)
		new("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)}, panel)

		local function paint()
			local bg = cardBG()
			panel.BackgroundColor3, sb.BackgroundColor3 = bg, bg
			pst.Color, sbs.Color = accent(), accent()
			panel.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent()
		end
		local function sync()
			local p = btn.Position
			sb.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + 36)
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset + 126, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + 18)
		end
		local function row(h) return z("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder()}, panel) end
		local function text(par, s, x, w, bold)
			return z("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = s,
				Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, par)
		end
		local function mkbtn(par, s, props)
			props.Text, props.AutoButtonColor, props.Font, props.TextSize, props.TextColor3, props.BorderSizePixel = s, false, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 12, WHITE, 0
			props.BackgroundColor3 = props.BackgroundColor3 or FIELD
			local b = z("TextButton", props, par)
			round(b, UDim.new(0, 7))
			return b
		end

		-- header
		local hr = row(24)
		text(hr, "Banner Style", 0, 120, true)
		local reset = mkbtn(hr, "Reset", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 22)})
		reset.Activated:Connect(function() api.set(nil); load(); refreshAll() end)

		-- theme presets
		local pg = z("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder()}, panel)
		new("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 26), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, pg)
		for i, p in ipairs(PRESETS) do
			local b = mkbtn(pg, p[1], {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, LayoutOrder = i, TextSize = 11})
			b.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
			new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(hexc(p[2]), hexc(p[3]))}, b)
			b.Activated:Connect(function() st.a, st.a2, st.b1, st.b2 = p[2], p[3], p[4], p[5]; commit(); refreshAll() end)
		end

		-- colours (hex); empty = follow the host UI theme
		local function colorField(title, key, fallback)
			local r = row(26)
			text(r, title, 0, 82)
			local sw = z("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), BorderSizePixel = 0}, r)
			round(sw, UDim.new(0, 6))
			new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.7}, sw)
			local tb = z("TextBox", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 24), Text = "", PlaceholderText = "theme",
				PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 155), ClearTextOnFocus = false, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE,
				BackgroundColor3 = FIELD, BorderSizePixel = 0}, r)
			round(tb, UDim.new(0, 6))
			local function refresh()
				local c = hexc(st[key])
				tb.Text = c and tohex(c) or ""
				sw.BackgroundColor3 = c or fallback()
			end
			tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local t = tb.Text:gsub("%s", "")
				if t == "" then st[key] = nil; commit()
				elseif hexc(t) then st[key] = tohex(hexc(t)); commit() end
				refresh()
			end)
			table.insert(refreshers, refresh)
			refresh()
		end
		colorField("Accent", "a", accent)
		colorField("Accent 2", "a2", function() return st.a and sec(hexc(st.a)) or sec(accent()) end)
		colorField("Background", "b1", function() return (bgPair({})) end)
		colorField("Background 2", "b2", function() return select(2, bgPair({})) end)

		-- steppers
		local function stepper(title, key, lo, hi, stp, wrap, suffix)
			local r = row(26)
			text(r, title, 0, 100)
			local val = z("TextLabel", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE}, r)
			local function refresh() val.Text = tostring(st[key]) .. (suffix or "") end
			local function bump(d)
				local v = (st[key] or DEF[key]) + d * stp
				if wrap then v = v % (hi + 0) elseif v < lo then v = lo elseif v > hi then v = hi end
				st[key] = v
				commit(); refresh()
			end
			mkbtn(r, "+", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)}).Activated:Connect(function() bump(1) end)
			mkbtn(r, "-", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)}).Activated:Connect(function() bump(-1) end)
			table.insert(refreshers, refresh)
			refresh()
		end
		stepper("Gradient angle", "gr", 0, 360, 45, true, "°")
		stepper("Border width", "bw", 0, 4, 1)
		stepper("Corners", "cr", 4, 24, 2)

		-- border mode
		local bm = mkbtn(row(26), "", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)})
		bm.Parent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
		bm.Activated:Connect(function() st.bs = (st.bs + 1) % 3; commit(); refreshAll() end)
		table.insert(refreshers, function() bm.Text = "Border: " .. BSTYLE[st.bs] end)

		-- effects
		local eg = z("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder()}, panel)
		new("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 0, 26), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, eg)
		for i, e in ipairs(EFFECTS) do
			local b = mkbtn(eg, e[1], {LayoutOrder = i})
			b.Activated:Connect(function() st.fx = bit32.bxor(st.fx, e[2]); commit(); refreshAll() end)
			table.insert(refreshers, function()
				local on = bit32.band(st.fx, e[2]) ~= 0
				b.BackgroundColor3 = on and accent() or FIELD
				b.TextTransparency = on and 0 or 0.4
			end)
		end

		sb.Activated:Connect(function()
			panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
			if panel.Visible then
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(238, math.clamp((cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y or 600) - 80, 220, 380))
				load(); paint(); sync(); refreshAll()
			end
		end)
		paint(); sync(); refreshAll()
		return sync
	end

	-- local-only on/off pill (draggable): hides every banner on THIS client; your own banner keeps broadcasting to everyone else
	-- styleApi (optional) adds the "Banner Style" pill + panel: {get = function() -> style | nil, set = function(style | nil)}
	function UI.Toggle(enabled, onChange, styleApi)
		if not Env.UserInputService then return function() end end
		local par = host().Parent
		pcall(function() if UI.Ctl then UI.Ctl:Destroy() end end)
		for _, c in ipairs(UI.CtlConns or {}) do c:Disconnect() end
		UI.CtlConns = {}
		local root
		if par:IsA("ScreenGui") then root = new("Folder", {Name = HOST .. "Ctl"}, par)
		else root = new("ScreenGui", {Name = HOST .. "Ctl", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 50, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, par) end
		UI.Ctl = root
		local btn = new("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(118, 30),
			AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 50}, root)
		round(btn, UDim.new(1, 0))
		local stroke = new("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1.5}, btn)
		local dot = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 51}, btn)
		round(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
		local lbl = new("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 51}, btn)
		local function paint()
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = cardBG()
			stroke.Color = enabled and accent() or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 125)
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = stroke.Color
			lbl.Text = enabled and "Banners: ON" or "Banners: OFF"
			lbl.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or 0.35
		end
		paint()
		local sync = function() end
		if styleApi then
			local ok, s = pcall(customizer, root, btn, styleApi)
			if ok and s then sync = s else warn("[UhBanner] style panel failed: " .. tostring(s)) end
		end
		local UIS, drag, start, orig, moved = Env.UserInputService
		local function press(t) return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch end
		table.insert(UI.CtlConns, btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if press(i.UserInputType) then drag, start, orig, moved = true, i.Position, btn.Position, false end
		end))
		table.insert(UI.CtlConns, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
			if not drag or not (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return end
			local d = i.Position - start
			if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
			if moved then btn.Position = UDim2.new(orig.X.Scale, orig.X.Offset + d.X, orig.Y.Scale, orig.Y.Offset + d.Y); sync() end
		end))
		table.insert(UI.CtlConns, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if drag and press(i.UserInputType) then
				drag = false
				if not moved then enabled = not enabled; paint(); onChange(enabled) end
			end
		end))
		return function(v) enabled = v and true or false; paint() end
	end

	function UI.Cleanup()
		pcall(function() if UI.Ctl then UI.Ctl:Destroy(); UI.Ctl = nil end end)
		for _, c in ipairs(UI.CtlConns or {}) do c:Disconnect() end
		UI.CtlConns = {}
		for b in pairs(Active) do b:Destroy(false) end
		if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
		if UI.Host then pcall(function() UI.Host:Destroy() end); UI.Host = nil end
	end

	return UI
end
]==],
BannerReceiver = [==[
-- BannerReceiver.lua | polls the backend, sanitises banner data, one banner per player, follows respawns
return function(Env, UI)
	local Players, RS, HS = Env.Players, Env.RunService, Env.HttpService
	local R = {Banners = {}, Running = false, Kicked = false}
	local conns, thumbs = {}, {}

	-- Verified users, matched by userId (resolved once from the username; until then the REAL in-game name is used, never the sent payload).
	-- tag = rank chip text, logo = rotating 3D triangle, color = accent override. An entry of {} = plain verified (check badge only).
	local VERIFIED = {
		-- OWNER / CO-OWNER are not hardcoded: roles.json in the GitHub repo lists them (Env.Roles), applyRoles below adds them here
		-- moderator whitelist (plain "Verified" banner, check badge only; they can kick / kill / deanimate misusing script users).
		-- Whitelisted accounts are Verified straight away, no key needed. One per line, lower-case username:
		-- more verified players are NOT listed here: they live in whitelist.json on GitHub (Env.Base .. "whitelist.json"), fetched at start + every 60s (see applyWhitelist below)
	}
	local roleIds, resolved, nameIds = {}, {}, {}
	local function resolveName(name, r)
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, id = pcall(Players.GetUserIdFromNameAsync, Players, name)
			if ok and id and VERIFIED[name] == r then roleIds[id] = r; resolved[name] = true; nameIds[name] = id end
		end)
	end
	for name, r in pairs(VERIFIED) do resolveName(name, r) end

	-- OWNER / CO-OWNER: identities come from roles.json (Env.Roles); only the look of each rank is defined here.
	local ROLE_STYLE = {
		["owner"] = {tag = "OWNER", logo = true, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 50)},
		["co-owner"] = {tag = "CO-OWNER", color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255)},
	}
	local roleRemote = {names = {}, ids = {}} -- what the last roles.json contributed
	local function applyRoles(entries)
		local names, ids = {}, {}
		for _, e in ipairs(entries or {}) do
			local st = ROLE_STYLE[e.role]
			if st then
				if e.username then names[e.username:lower()] = st end
				if e.userId then ids[e.userId] = st end
			end
		end
		for n in pairs(roleRemote.names) do -- removed from the file (or rank changed) -> the old rank goes away
			if names[n] ~= VERIFIED[n] then
				VERIFIED[n] = nil; resolved[n] = nil
				if nameIds[n] then roleIds[nameIds[n]] = nil; nameIds[n] = nil end
			end
		end
		for id, st in pairs(roleRemote.ids) do
			if ids[id] ~= st and roleIds[id] == st then roleIds[id] = nil end
		end
		for n, st in pairs(names) do
			if VERIFIED[n] ~= st then VERIFIED[n] = st; resolved[n] = nil; resolveName(n, st) end
		end
		for id, st in pairs(ids) do roleIds[id] = st end
		roleRemote.names, roleRemote.ids = names, ids
	end
	local function fetchRoles()
		local RL = Env.Roles
		if not RL then return end
		pcall(RL.Fetch, Env.Base)
		pcall(applyRoles, RL.Entries)
	end
	if Env.Roles then pcall(applyRoles, Env.Roles.Entries) end -- already fetched at startup: tags are there from the first frame

	-- Remote whitelist: whitelist.json on GitHub = {"entries": [{"username": "SomeName"}, {"userId": 123456}]}. Entries only ever become plain "Verified"
	-- (check badge + moderator tools, no key needed): the file can never grant OWNER / CO-OWNER or any rank tag, and can't override the names hardcoded above.
	local remote = {names = {}, ids = {}} -- what the last successful fetch contributed
	local function dropId(id) local r = roleIds[id]; if r and not r.tag then roleIds[id] = nil end end
	local function applyWhitelist(entries)
		local names, ids = {}, {}
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			if type(e) == "table" then
				local n = type(e.username) == "string" and e.username:lower() or nil
				if n and #n >= 3 and #n <= 20 and n:match("^[%w_]+$") and (not VERIFIED[n] or remote.names[n]) and not roleRemote.names[n] then names[n] = true end
				local id = math.floor(tonumber(e.userId) or 0)
				if id > 0 and (not roleIds[id] or remote.ids[id]) then ids[id] = true end
			end
		end
		for n in pairs(remote.names) do -- removed from the file -> no longer whitelisted
			if not names[n] and not roleRemote.names[n] then
				VERIFIED[n] = nil; resolved[n] = nil
				if nameIds[n] then dropId(nameIds[n]); nameIds[n] = nil end
			end
		end
		for id in pairs(remote.ids) do if not ids[id] then dropId(id) end end
		for n in pairs(names) do
			if not VERIFIED[n] then local r = {}; VERIFIED[n] = r; resolveName(n, r) end
		end
		for id in pairs(ids) do if not roleIds[id] then roleIds[id] = {} end end
		remote.names, remote.ids = names, ids
	end
	local function fetchWhitelist()
		if not Env.Base then return end
		local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(Env.Base .. "whitelist.json?t=" .. os.time()) end)
		if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" then return end
		local ok2, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, body)
		if ok2 and type(data) == "table" and type(data.entries) == "table" then pcall(applyWhitelist, data.entries) end
	end
	local function rawRole(uid) -- whitelisted by username (protected from kill / kick / blacklist)
		if roleIds[uid] then return roleIds[uid] end
		local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
		local n = p and p.Name:lower()
		if n and VERIFIED[n] and not resolved[n] then return VERIFIED[n] end
	end
	local function roleOf(uid) -- OWNER / CO-OWNER and plain "Verified" players: whitelisted = verified, no key
		return rawRole(uid)
	end
	function R.IsWhitelisted(uid) return rawRole(uid) ~= nil end

	R.RoleOf = roleOf
	local function clean(s, n) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("%c", "")):sub(1, n) end
	-- per-user banner style: only well-formed hex colours + clamped numbers ever reach the UI (never raw payload data)
	local function hex(v) v = tostring(v or ""); return v:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") and v:upper() or nil end
	local function num(v, lo, hi, d) v = tonumber(v); if not v then return d end; return math.clamp(math.floor(v + 0.5), lo, hi) end
	local function cleanStyle(s)
		if type(s) ~= "table" then return nil end
		local st = {a = hex(s.a), a2 = hex(s.a2), b1 = hex(s.b1), b2 = hex(s.b2), gr = num(s.gr, 0, 360, 90), bw = num(s.bw, 0, 4, 2), bs = num(s.bs, 0, 2, 2), cr = num(s.cr, 4, 24, 14), fx = num(s.fx, 0, 63, 63)}
		st.key = table.concat({st.a or "", st.a2 or "", st.b1 or "", st.b2 or "", st.gr, st.bw, st.bs, st.cr, st.fx}, ",")
		return st
	end
	local function headshot(uid)
		if thumbs[uid] == nil then
			local ok, url = pcall(Players.GetUserThumbnailAsync, Players, uid, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
			thumbs[uid] = ok and url or ""
		end
		return thumbs[uid]
	end
	-- Inline moderation buttons drawn beside a banner (order = grid order in BannerUI). `mod` = verified moderators + owner / co-owner (kill / deanimate / kick,
	-- relayed through ModTools); `ban` = owner / co-owner only (blacklist). Same rights as the tap-a-banner menu, just one tap closer.
	local ACTS = {
		{key = "kill", label = "Kill", color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 92, 48), mod = true},
		{key = "deanimate", label = "Deanimate", color = Color3.fromRGB(96, 110, 210), mod = true},
		{key = "kick", label = "Kick", color = Color3.fromRGB(196, 146, 38), mod = true},
		{key = "ban", label = "Ban", color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 50, 60), ban = true},
	}
	local function actionsFor(uid) -- the buttons THIS viewer may use on that player's banner; nothing on yourself, and nothing on verified / owner / co-owner (they are immune)
		if uid == Env.Player.UserId or rawRole(uid) then return nil end
		local me = roleOf(Env.Player.UserId)
		if not me then return nil end
		local owner = me.tag == "OWNER" or me.tag == "CO-OWNER" -- owner / co-owner always SEE every button; a tap reports what is missing (module) via R.Block
		local mod = owner or (R.CanModerate and R.CanModerate())
		local bl = owner or (R.CanBlacklist and R.CanBlacklist())
		local list = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(ACTS) do
			if (a.mod and mod) or (a.ban and bl) then list[#list + 1] = a end
		end
		if #list == 0 then return nil end
		return list
	end
	local function sanitize(uid, d)
		local img = tostring(d.image or "")
		if img:match("^%d+$") then img = "rbxassetid://" .. img elseif not img:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then img = "" end
		if img == "" then img = headshot(uid) end
		local name = clean(d.name, 40)
		local title = clean(d.title, 40)
		local acts = actionsFor(uid)
		local keys = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(acts or {}) do keys[#keys + 1] = a.key end
		return {userId = uid, title = title ~= "" and title or name, subtitle = clean(d.subtitle, 40), image = img, role = roleOf(uid),
			acts = acts, actKey = table.concat(keys, ","), style = cleanStyle(d.style)}
	end
	local function sig(o) return o.title .. "|" .. o.subtitle .. "|" .. o.image .. "|" .. (o.role and (o.role.tag or "v") or "") .. "|" .. o.actKey end

	local function targetPart(uid)
		local char
		if uid == Env.Player.UserId then
			char = Env.GetLocalCharacter() -- reanimated character when active, real one otherwise
		else
			local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
			char = p and p.Character
		end
		if not char or not char.Parent then return nil end
		local part = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent then return part end
	end
	local function remove(uid)
		local e = R.Banners[uid]
		if e then R.Banners[uid] = nil; e.UI:Destroy(true) end
	end

	function R.Process(list)
		local seen = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(list) do
			local uid = type(d) == "table" and tonumber(d.userId)
			if uid and not seen[uid] and (uid == Env.Player.UserId or Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)) then
				seen[uid] = true
				local o = sanitize(uid, d)
				local sk = o.style and o.style.key or ""
				local e = R.Banners[uid]
				if not e then
					R.Banners[uid] = {UI = UI.new(o), Sig = sig(o), SKey = sk, Role = o.role, ActKey = o.actKey}
				elseif e.Role ~= o.role or e.ActKey ~= o.actKey then -- rank / moderation rights changed (username just resolved / whitelist updated): rebuild
					R.DisarmKick()
					e.UI:Destroy(false); R.Banners[uid] = {UI = UI.new(o), Sig = sig(o), SKey = sk, Role = o.role, ActKey = o.actKey}
				else
					if e.Sig ~= sig(o) then e.UI:Update(o); e.Sig = sig(o) end
					if e.SKey ~= sk and not (uid == Env.Player.UserId and os.clock() < (R.StyleHold or 0)) then e.UI:Restyle(o.style); e.SKey = sk end
				end
			end
		end
		for uid in pairs(R.Banners) do if not seen[uid] then remove(uid) end end
	end

function R.Fetch()
local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, {Url = Env.Backend .. "/banners?room=" .. HS:UrlEncode(Env.Room), Method = "GET"})
if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return false end
if res.StatusCode ~= 200 then return false, nil, nil, res.StatusCode end
local ok2, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, res.Body)
if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.banners) ~= "table" then return false end
local parts = {}
for _, d in ipairs(data.banners) do
if type(d) == "table" then
local okS, sj = pcall(HS.JSONEncode, HS, d.style or {})
parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(d.userId) .. "|" .. tostring(d.name) .. "|" .. tostring(d.title) .. "|" .. tostring(d.subtitle) .. "|" .. tostring(d.image) .. "|" .. (okS and sj or "")
end
end
table.sort(parts)
local fp = table.concat(parts, "\n")
local same = fp == R.LastFP
R.LastFP = fp
return true, data.banners, same
end

	function R.Poke() R.Kicked = true end

	function R.ApplyLocalStyle(raw) -- instant preview of YOUR style on your own banner (the backend poll then confirms it for everyone)
		local st = cleanStyle(raw)
		R.StyleHold = os.clock() + 3
		local e = R.Banners[Env.Player.UserId]
		if e then e.UI:Restyle(st); e.SKey = st and st.key or "" end
	end

	function R.SetHidden(v) -- local-only: hides/shows every banner on this client
		R.Hidden = v and true or false
		if not R.Hidden then R.Poke() end
	end

	function R.Teleport(uid) -- stand 4 studs in front of the player, facing them
		if os.clock() - (R.LastTP or 0) < 0.6 then return end
		local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
		local tr = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local me = Env.GetLocalCharacter() -- reanimated character when active
		if not (tr and me and me.Parent) then return end
		R.LastTP = os.clock()
		pcall(function()
			local pos = tr.Position + tr.CFrame.LookVector * 4
			me:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(tr.Position.X, pos.Y, tr.Position.Z)))
			local r = me:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if r then r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
		end)
		local e = R.Banners[uid]
		if e then e.UI:Update(e.UI.Opts) end -- pulse feedback
	end


	-- owner / co-owner tools: clicking another script user's banner opens Teleport / Blacklist
	local menu
	function R.CloseMenu() if menu then menu:Destroy(); menu = nil end end
	function R.CanBlacklist()
		local r = roleOf(Env.Player.UserId)
		return r and (r.tag == "OWNER" or r.tag == "CO-OWNER") and Env.Blacklist ~= nil
	end
	local function toast(msg, title)
		pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = title or "Blacklist", Text = msg, Duration = 4}) end)
	end
	function R.CanModerate() return Env.Mod ~= nil and Env.Mod.CanModerate() end -- verified moderators + owner / co-owner
	function R.OnBannerClick(uid, pt)
		local mod, bl = R.CanModerate(), R.CanBlacklist()
		if not (mod or bl) or rawRole(uid) then return R.Teleport(uid) end -- whitelisted / verified / owner banners (and everyone without rights) just teleport
		local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
		if not p then return end
		R.CloseMenu()
		local items = {{"Teleport", Color3.fromRGB(60, 110, 200), function() R.Teleport(uid) end}}
		if mod then table.insert(items, {"Users...", Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 120), function() R.OpenUsers() end}) end
		if mod then -- moderators: kick / kill / deanimate only (relayed to script users, never to verified players)
			for _, a in ipairs({{"Kill", "kill"}, {"Deanimate", "deanimate"}, {"Kick", "kick"}, {"Bring", "bring"}, {"Hallucinate", "hallucinate"}, {"Dizzy", "dizzy"}}) do
				table.insert(items, {a[1], Color3.fromRGB(205, 125, 40), function()
					task.spawn(function()
						local ok, err = Env.Mod.Send(uid, a[2])
						toast(ok and (a[1] .. ": " .. p.Name) or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)), "Moderator")
					end)
				end})
			end
		end
		if bl then -- owner / co-owner only
			table.insert(items, {"Blacklist", Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60), function()
				Env.Blacklist.Confirm(uid, p.Name, function(ok, err)
					toast(ok and (p.Name .. " blacklisted") or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)))
				end)
			end})
		end
		local H = 8 + #items * 34
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = "UhBannerMenu", false, 900, true
		gui.Parent = Env.Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		menu = gui
		local f = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
		f.Size, f.BackgroundColor3, f.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.fromOffset(150, H), Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30), 0
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(pt.X, 0, vp.X - 150), math.clamp(pt.Y, 0, vp.Y - H))
		Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		for i, it in ipairs(items) do
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
			b.Size, b.Position, b.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(134, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8 + (i - 1) * 34), it[1]
			b.BackgroundColor3, b.TextColor3, b.Font, b.TextSize = it[2], Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14
			Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
			b.Activated:Connect(function() R.CloseMenu(); it[3]() end)
		end
	end

	-- active script users: everyone with a live banner who isn't you and isn't verified / owner / co-owner. One tap = Bring / Hallucinate / Dizzy on that user.
	-- Same single permission check as the tap-a-banner menu (R.CanModerate = owner / co-owner / verified); the backend checks the sender again.
	local picker
	function R.CloseUsers() if picker then picker:Destroy(); picker = nil end end
	function R.OpenUsers()
		R.CloseUsers()
		if not R.CanModerate() then return end
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = "UhBannerUsers", false, 901, true
		gui.Parent = Env.Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		picker = gui
		local f = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
		f.Size, f.Position, f.BackgroundColor3, f.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 270), UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -135), Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30), 0
		Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
		t.Size, t.Position, t.BackgroundTransparency, t.Text = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4), 1, "Active script users"
		t.TextColor3, t.Font, t.TextSize, t.TextXAlignment = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		local x = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
		x.Size, x.Position, x.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 24), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 6), "X"
		x.BackgroundColor3, x.TextColor3, x.Font, x.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 13
		Instance.new("UICorner", x).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		x.Activated:Connect(R.CloseUsers)
		local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", f)
		list.Size, list.Position, list.BackgroundTransparency, list.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -44), UDim2.fromOffset(8, 36), 1, 0
		list.ScrollBarThickness, list.AutomaticCanvasSize, list.CanvasSize = 4, Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, UDim2.new()
		Instance.new("UIListLayout", list).Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
		local n = 0
		for uid in pairs(R.Banners) do
			local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
			if p and uid ~= Env.Player.UserId and not rawRole(uid) then
				n += 1
				local row = Instance.new("Frame", list)
				row.Size, row.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 30), 1
				local nm = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
				nm.Size, nm.BackgroundTransparency, nm.Text = UDim2.new(0, 92, 1, 0), 1, p.DisplayName
				nm.TextColor3, nm.Font, nm.TextSize, nm.TextXAlignment, nm.TextTruncate = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
				for i, a in ipairs({{"Bring", "bring"}, {"Hallucinate", "hallucinate"}, {"Dizzy", "dizzy"}}) do
					local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
					b.Size, b.Position, b.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(96 + (i - 1) * 94, 1), a[1]
					b.BackgroundColor3, b.TextColor3, b.Font, b.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(60, 110, 200), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 11
					Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
					b.Activated:Connect(function()
						local why = R.Block("mod")
						if why then return toast(why, "Moderator") end
						task.spawn(function()
							local ok, err = Env.Mod.Send(uid, a[2])
							toast(ok and (a[1] .. ": " .. p.Name) or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)), "Moderator")
						end)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		if n == 0 then
			local e = Instance.new("TextLabel", list)
			e.Size, e.BackgroundTransparency, e.Text = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), 1, "No other script users active"
			e.TextColor3, e.Font, e.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180), Enum.Font.Gotham, 13
		end
	end

	-- inline buttons next to a banner (Kill / Deanimate / Kick / Ban). Permissions are re-checked at click time, so a stale button can never do more than the
	-- viewer is allowed to: Kill / Deanimate / Kick go through ModTools.Send (the backend checks the moderator list again), Ban goes through the Yes/No
	-- blacklist dialog (owner / co-owner only; the blacklisted client kicks itself). Kick needs a second tap ("Sure?") so a stray tap can't remove someone.
	function R.Block(key) -- nil when the button can run, else the reason it can't. Nobody needs a key: owner / co-owner and verified moderators are recognised by userId.
		if not Env.Request then return "executor has no request()" end
		if key == "ban" then
			if not Env.Blacklist then return "Blacklist module failed to load" end
		else
			if not Env.Mod then return "ModTools module failed to load" end
		end
	end
	local kickArm -- {uid, expires} while a Kick button is waiting for its confirming tap
	function R.DisarmKick()
		local a = kickArm
		kickArm = nil
		local e = a and R.Banners[a.uid]
		if e then e.UI:SetAction("kick") end
	end
	function R.OnAction(uid, key)
		local p, e = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid), R.Banners[uid]
		if not (p and e) then return end
		local allowed
		for _, a in ipairs(actionsFor(uid) or {}) do if a.key == key then allowed = a end end
		if not allowed then return end
		R.CloseMenu()
		local why = R.Block(key)
		if why then return toast(why, "Moderator") end
		if key == "ban" then
			e.UI:PulseAction(key)
			return Env.Blacklist.Confirm(uid, p.Name, function(ok, err)
				toast(ok and (p.Name .. " blacklisted") or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)))
			end)
		end
		if key == "kick" and not (kickArm and kickArm.uid == uid and os.clock() < kickArm.expires) then -- first tap: arm the button, don't send anything yet
			R.DisarmKick()
			local arm = {uid = uid, expires = os.clock() + 2.5}
			kickArm = arm
			e.UI:SetAction("kick", "Sure?", Color3.fromRGB(190, 50, 60))
			task.delay(2.6, function() if kickArm == arm then R.DisarmKick() end end)
			return
		end
		if key == "kick" then R.DisarmKick() end -- second tap within 2.5 s: confirmed
		e.UI:PulseAction(key)
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = Env.Mod.Send(uid, key)
			toast(ok and (allowed.label .. ": " .. p.Name) or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)), "Moderator")
		end)
	end

	function R.Start(localOnly)
		if R.Running then return end
		if not localOnly and not Env.Request then return warn("[UhBanner] executor has no request(); live sync unavailable") end
		R.Running = true
		task.spawn(function() -- whitelist.json: read now, then every 60s so edits on GitHub apply without rejoining
			while R.Running do
				fetchRoles()
				fetchWhitelist()
				local waited = 0
				while R.Running and waited < 60 do task.wait(1); waited += 1 end
			end
		end)
		table.insert(conns, RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function() -- re-anchor: a cached part is revalidated with Name + IsDescendantOf; the full lookup only runs for the local player (reanim start/stop) or a stale / unresolved part (respawn)
			local hidden, me = R.Hidden, Env.Player.UserId
			for uid, e in pairs(R.Banners) do
				local part = e.Part
				if hidden then
					part = nil
				elseif uid == me or not part or part.Name ~= "Head" or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					part = targetPart(uid)
				end
				if part ~= e.Part then e.Part = part; e.UI:SetAdornee(part) end
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) remove(p.UserId) end))
		if Env.UserInputService and Env.GuiService then -- tap/click another player's banner -> teleport in front of them
			table.insert(conns, Env.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
				local t = i.UserInputType
				if gp or R.Hidden or (t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return end
				R.CloseMenu()
				local pt = Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y) + Env.GuiService:GetGuiInset()
				for uid, e in pairs(R.Banners) do
					if uid ~= Env.Player.UserId then
						local key = e.ActKey ~= "" and e.UI:HitAction(pt) -- inline moderation buttons beside the banner
						if key then return R.OnAction(uid, key) end
						if e.UI:Contains(pt) then return R.OnBannerClick(uid, pt) end
					end
				end
			end))
		end
		if localOnly then return end
task.spawn(function()
local fails, calm = 0, 0
while R.Running do
if R.Hidden and not R.Kicked then
task.wait(0.5) -- banners hidden locally: no polling until re-enabled (SetHidden pokes)
else
R.Kicked = false
local ok, list, same, st = R.Fetch()
local wait
if ok then
fails = 0
pcall(R.Process, list)
calm = same and math.min(calm + 1, 3) or 0
wait = ({2, 3, 4, 6})[calm + 1] -- unchanged answers stretch the poll: 2 / 3 / 4 / 6 s
else
fails += 1
wait = math.min(2 * 2 ^ fails, 30) -- exponential failure backoff
if st == 429 then wait = math.max(wait, 20) end
end
wait += math.random()
local waited = 0
while R.Running and waited < wait and not R.Kicked do task.wait(0.25); waited += 0.25 end
end
end
end)
	end

	function R.Stop()
		R.Running = false
		R.CloseMenu()
		R.CloseUsers()
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
		conns = {}
		for uid, e in pairs(R.Banners) do e.UI:Destroy(false); R.Banners[uid] = nil end
	end

	return R
end
]==],
BannerSender = [==[
-- BannerSender.lua | publishes the local player's banner to the live-sync backend (+ keep-alive)
return function(Env)
	local S = {Payload = nil, Running = false}
	local function post(path, body)
		if not Env.Request then return false, "executor has no request()" end
		body.room, body.userId, body.token = Env.Room, Env.Player.UserId, Env.Token
		if Env.Sign then Env.Sign(path, body, "") end
		local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, {Url = Env.Backend .. path, Method = "POST",
			Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = Env.HttpService:JSONEncode(body)})
		if not ok then return false, tostring(res) end
		if type(res) ~= "table" or res.StatusCode ~= 200 then return false, "HTTP " .. tostring(type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode) end
		return true
	end
	local function copy(t) local c = {}; for k, v in pairs(t) do c[k] = v end; return c end

function S.Send(title, image, subtitle)
local p = {name = Env.Player.Name, title = tostring(title or ""), image = tostring(image or ""), subtitle = tostring(subtitle or ("@" .. Env.Player.Name)), style = S.Style}
S.Payload = p
local okS, sj = pcall(Env.HttpService.JSONEncode, Env.HttpService, S.Style or {})
local fp = p.title .. "|" .. p.image .. "|" .. p.subtitle .. "|" .. (okS and sj or "")
if fp == S.LastFP and os.clock() - (S.LastOk or 0) < 20 then return true end -- identical payload just accepted: don't resend
local ok, err = post("/banner", copy(p))
if ok then S.LastFP, S.LastOk = fp, os.clock() else S.LastFP = nil; warn("[UhBanner] send failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
return ok, err
end
	function S.SetStyle(st) -- banner style table (or nil = host theme); goes out with the next Send / keep-alive
		S.Style = st
		if S.Payload then S.Payload.style = st end
	end
function S.Start() -- backend TTL is 75s; re-announce every 40s (skipped if a send just happened, retried after 10s on failure)
if S.Running then return end
S.Running = true
task.spawn(function()
local wait = 40
while S.Running do
for _ = 1, wait * 4 do if not S.Running then return end task.wait(0.25) end
wait = 40
if S.Payload and os.clock() - (S.LastOk or 0) >= 15 then
if post("/banner", copy(S.Payload)) then S.LastOk = os.clock() else wait = 10 end
end
end
end)
end
	function S.Stop() S.Running = false end
	function S.Clear() S.Payload = nil; S.LastFP = nil; post("/clear", {}) end
	return S
end
]==],
ModTools = [==[
-- ModTools.lua | moderator actions (kill / deanimate / kick / bring / hallucinate / dizzy) relayed to OTHER SCRIPT USERS.
-- Who may send: verified moderators (whitelist.json) + owner / co-owner, recognised by userId from roles.json on GitHub (no key).
-- Who can be hit: only players running this script, and never verified players / owner / co-owner. The target is always notified.
-- bring / hallucinate / dizzy: implemented in VerifiedPlayerFeatures.lua (Env.Fx): recipient is notified, no prompt, no cooldown, the temporary effects (hallucinate 60 s, dizzy 20 s) clean themselves up.
-- Env needs: Player, Players, RunService, HttpService, Request, Backend, Room, Token, ModActions {Kill, Deanimate, Kick(msg)}, Fx (VerifiedPlayerFeatures.lua)
return function(Env, R)
	local HS, Players, RS = Env.HttpService, Env.Players, Env.RunService
	local M = {Running = false}
	local ACTIONS = {kill = true, deanimate = true, kick = true}
	local FXA = {bring = true, hallucinate = true, dizzy = true} -- handled by Env.Fx (VerifiedPlayerFeatures.lua)

	function M.CanModerate()
		return Env.Request ~= nil and R.RoleOf(Env.Player.UserId) ~= nil -- owner / co-owner / verified players: no key (the backend recognises their userId)
	end

	function M.Send(target, action)
		if FXA[action] then
			if not Env.Fx then return false, "VerifiedPlayerFeatures module failed to load" end
			return Env.Fx.Request(target, action)
		end
		if not ACTIONS[action] then return false, "bad action" end
		if not M.CanModerate() then return false, "moderators only" end
		if R.IsWhitelisted(target) then return false, "verified players are immune" end
		local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, {Url = Env.Backend .. "/mod", Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"},
			Body = HS:JSONEncode(Env.Sign("/mod", {room = Env.Room, userId = Env.Player.UserId, token = Env.Token, target = target, action = action}, tostring(target) .. ":" .. action))})
		if not ok then return false, tostring(res) end
		if type(res) ~= "table" or res.StatusCode ~= 200 then return false, "HTTP " .. tostring(type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode) end
		return true
	end

	local function toast(msg)
		pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "Moderator", Text = msg, Duration = 6}) end)
	end

	local function handle(c)
		if Env.Fx and Env.Fx.Receive(c) then return end -- bring / hallucinate / dizzy
		if type(c) ~= "table" or not ACTIONS[c.action] then return end
		local by = tonumber(c.by)
		if not by or by == Env.Player.UserId or not R.RoleOf(by) then return end -- sender must be a verified moderator / owner / co-owner
		if R.IsWhitelisted(Env.Player.UserId) then return end -- whitelisted / verified players, owner and co-owner are immune
		local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(by)
		local name = p and p.Name or "a moderator"
		local A = Env.ModActions or {}
		if c.action == "kick" then
			toast("Kicked by moderator " .. name)
			if A.Kick then A.Kick("Kicked by moderator " .. name .. " (script misuse)") end
		elseif c.action == "kill" then
			toast(name .. " used Kill on you (script misuse)")
			if A.Kill then A.Kill() end
		else
			toast(name .. " used Deanimate on you (script misuse)")
			if A.Deanimate then A.Deanimate() end
		end
	end

	function M.Start()
		if M.Running or not Env.Request then return end
		M.Running = true
		task.spawn(function()
local fails, idle = 0, 0
while M.Running do
local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, {Url = Env.Backend .. "/commands?room=" .. HS:UrlEncode(Env.Room) .. "&userId=" .. Env.Player.UserId .. "&token=" .. HS:UrlEncode(Env.Token), Method = "GET"})
local wait
if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200 then
fails = 0
local got = false
local ok2, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, res.Body)
if ok2 and type(data) == "table" and type(data.commands) == "table" then
for _, c in ipairs(data.commands) do got = true; pcall(handle, c) end
end
idle = got and 0 or math.min(idle + 1, 3)
wait = 2 + idle -- 2s right after a command, stretching to 5s while nothing arrives
else
fails += 1
wait = math.min(2 * 2 ^ fails, 30)
if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 429 then wait = math.max(wait, 20) end
end
task.wait(wait + math.random())
end
		end)
	end

	function M.Stop() M.Running = false; if Env.Fx then Env.Fx.StopEffects() end end

	return M
end
]==],
VerifiedPlayerFeatures = [==[
-- VerifiedPlayerFeatures.lua | Bring Users / Hallucinate Users / Dizzy
-- ONE permission gate for all three features: OWNER, CO-OWNER and VERIFIED players have identical access. Roles come from roles.json + whitelist.json through
-- BannerReceiver.RoleOf (nothing hardcoded); anyone else gets no controls and cannot send.
-- Targets: only OTHER script users with a live banner (R.Banners), never owner / co-owner / verified. The target is always notified (toast), no prompt.
-- Env.Fx.SetEnabled(false) turns the effects off for a user entirely.
-- Transport: ModTools relays the request through the backend's /mod (the backend re-checks the sender); the recipient's ModTools hands every queued command to F.Receive.
-- Durations are effect lengths, NOT cooldowns (hallucinate 60 s, dizzy 20 s). Every effect registers a stop function: expiry, re-trigger, respawn and unload all clean up.
-- Env needs: Player, Players, RunService, HttpService, Request, Backend, Room, Token (optional: Sign, ModKey, GetLocalCharacter, IsLowEnd)
return function(Env, R)
	local Players, RS, HS = Env.Players, Env.RunService, Env.HttpService
	local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
	local F = {Enabled = genv.UhFxEnabled ~= false}
	local ACT = {bring = true, hallucinate = true, dizzy = true}
	local TIME = {hallucinate = 60, dizzy = 20}
	F.Actions = {{key = "bring", label = "Bring Users"}, {key = "hallucinate", label = "Hallucinate Users"}, {key = "dizzy", label = "Dizzy"}}
	F.Time = TIME

	-- ===== permissions: the single gate =====
	function F.Can(uid) return uid ~= nil and R.RoleOf(uid) ~= nil end -- owner / co-owner / verified
	function F.CanUse() return Env.Request ~= nil and F.Can(Env.Player.UserId) end
	function F.Handles(action) return ACT[action] == true end

	-- ===== sender =====
	function F.Request(target, action)
		if not ACT[action] then return false, "bad action" end
		if not F.CanUse() then return false, "verified players, owner and co-owner only" end
		target = tonumber(target)
		if not target or target == Env.Player.UserId then return false, "bad target" end
		if R.IsWhitelisted(target) then return false, "verified players are immune" end
		if not (R.Banners and R.Banners[target] and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(target)) then return false, "not an active script user" end
		local body = {room = Env.Room, userId = Env.Player.UserId, token = Env.Token, key = Env.ModKey, target = target, action = action}
		if Env.Sign then body = Env.Sign("/mod", body, tostring(target) .. ":" .. action) end
		local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, {Url = Env.Backend .. "/mod", Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = HS:JSONEncode(body)})
		if not ok then return false, tostring(res) end
		if type(res) ~= "table" then return false, "no response" end
		if res.StatusCode ~= 200 then
			local okD, d = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, res.Body or "")
			return false, (okD and type(d) == "table" and d.error) or ("HTTP " .. tostring(res.StatusCode))
		end
		return true
	end

	-- ===== helpers =====
	local function toast(msg)
		pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "Moderator", Text = msg, Duration = 6}) end)
	end
	local function myChar() return (Env.GetLocalCharacter and Env.GetLocalCharacter()) or Env.Player.Character end

	local fx = {}
	local function stopFx(name)
		local f = fx[name]
		fx[name] = nil
		if f then pcall(f) end
	end
	local function expire(name, stop, secs) -- hard stop even if a frame loop stalls
		task.delay(secs, function() if fx[name] == stop then stopFx(name) end end)
	end

	-- ===== Bring Users =====
	-- THIS client teleports to stand 4 studs in front of the moderator, facing them (same move as the banner "Teleport", reversed). A clear spot (no wall between, solid
	-- flat floor at the moderator's level, no hazard under it) is preferred; when none is found the spot straight in front of the moderator is used anyway, so it always happens.
	local BAD = {"kill", "lava", "death", "damage", "acid", "spike", "hurt", "void", "trap", "laser"}
	local function dangerous(hit)
		local inst = hit.Instance
		if hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or hit.Material == Enum.Material.CrackedLava or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Magma then return true end
		if inst:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") then return true end
		local n = (inst.Name .. "." .. (inst.Parent and inst.Parent.Name or "")):lower()
		for _, w in ipairs(BAD) do
			if n:find(w, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function flatLook(sr)
		local v = Vector3.new(sr.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, sr.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
		return v.Magnitude > 0.01 and v.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end

	local function findSpot(sch, sr, me, lift)
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterType, rp.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {sch, me}
		local op = OverlapParams.new()
		op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		op.FilterDescendantsInstances = {sch, me}
		local base, look = sr.Position, flatLook(sr)
		local floorY, voidY = base.Y - lift, workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
		for _, dist in ipairs({4, 5, 7}) do
			for _, ang in ipairs({0, 40, -40, 80, -80}) do
				local at = base + (CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ang), 0) * look) * dist
				if not workspace:Raycast(base, at - base, rp) then
					local g = workspace:Raycast(at + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), rp)
					if g and g.Normal.Y > 0.75 and math.abs(g.Position.Y - floorY) <= 5 and g.Position.Y > voidY + 20 and not dangerous(g) then
						local free = true
						for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(g.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.3, 0)), Vector3.new(2.6, 5.6, 2.6), op)) do
							if p.CanCollide then
								free = false
								break
							end
						end
						if free then
							local pos = g.Position + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
							return CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(base.X, pos.Y, base.Z))
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function bring(sp)
		local sch = sp.Character
		local sr = sch and sch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local me = myChar()
		if not (sr and me and me.Parent) then return toast("Bring failed: " .. sp.Name .. " is not loaded for you") end
		local root = me:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = me:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local cf
		pcall(function()
			local lift = math.max(((hum and hum.HipHeight) or 2) + ((root and root.Size.Y) or 2) / 2, 3)
			cf = findSpot(sch, sr, me, lift)
		end)
		if not cf then -- no clear spot: straight in front of the moderator, stopping short of a wall
			local look, dist = flatLook(sr), 4
			pcall(function()
				local rp = RaycastParams.new()
				rp.FilterType, rp.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
				rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {sch, me}
				local h = workspace:Raycast(sr.Position, look * 4, rp)
				if h then dist = math.max(1, h.Distance - 1.5) end
			end)
			local pos = sr.Position + look * dist
			cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(sr.Position.X, pos.Y, sr.Position.Z))
		end
		pcall(function()
			if hum and hum.SeatPart then hum.Sit = false end
			me:PivotTo(cf)
			if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
		end)
	end

	-- ===== Hallucinate Users =====
	-- a local-only copy of YOUR OWN avatar appears in the distance and creeps toward you for 60 s: a tiny step or two, a stop, then a few more, always facing you.
	-- Root anchored, every part non-colliding / untouchable / unqueryable, no Humanoid (games can't mistake it for a player), parked under the camera; destroyed when
	-- the 60 s are up. Nothing is replicated and your real character is never touched.
	local RIG = {R15 = {walk = "rbxassetid://507777826", idle = "rbxassetid://507766388"}, R6 = {walk = "rbxassetid://180426354", idle = "rbxassetid://180435571"}}
	local function animId(g, folderName, animName, default) -- the avatar's own animation pack (from its Animate script), default Roblox animations otherwise
		local a = g:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		a = a and a:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		a = a and a:FindFirstChild(animName)
		return (a and a:IsA("Animation") and a.AnimationId ~= "") and a.AnimationId or default
	end

	local function hallucinate()
		stopFx("hallucinate")
		local function usable(c) return c and c.Parent and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
		local ch = myChar()
		if not usable(ch) then ch = Env.Player.Character end
		if not usable(ch) then return toast("Hallucination unavailable: no character to copy") end
		local g
		local was = ch.Archivable
		ch.Archivable = true
		pcall(function() g = ch:Clone() end)
		ch.Archivable = was
		local root = g and g:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (root and root:IsA("BasePart") and hum) then
			if g then g:Destroy() end
			return
		end
		local rig = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and "R15" or "R6"
		local walkId, idleId = animId(g, "walk", "WalkAnim", RIG[rig].walk), animId(g, "idle", "Animation1", RIG[rig].idle)
		local lift = math.max(hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2, 3)
		local parts = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
			pcall(function()
				if d:IsA("BaseScript") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("ForceField") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Humanoid") then
					d:Destroy()
				elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
					d.CanCollide, d.CanTouch, d.CanQuery, d.CastShadow, d.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
					d.Anchored = d == root -- only the root is anchored: the limbs follow it through their joints and can still animate
					parts[#parts + 1] = {d, d.Transparency}
					d.Transparency = 1
				elseif d:IsA("Decal") then
					parts[#parts + 1] = {d, d.Transparency}
					d.Transparency = 1
				end
			end)
		end
		local ac = Instance.new("AnimationController")
		ac.Parent = g
		local an = Instance.new("Animator")
		an.Parent = ac
		g.PrimaryPart = root
		g.Name = "UhHauntCopy"
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "UhHaunt"
		g.Parent = folder

		local T = TIME.hallucinate
		local STEP_SPEED, STOP_D, SPAWN_D = 1.6, 5, 42 -- studs/s while stepping, stops this far from you, starts this far away
		local okL, low = pcall(function() return Env.IsLowEnd and Env.IsLowEnd() end)
		local interval = (okL and low) and 1 / 15 or 1 / 30 -- light on low-end devices
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterType, rp.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local last, acc, gy, pos, lastFade = t0, interval, nil, nil, nil
		local walk, idle, conn
		local walking, phaseEnd = false, 1.5 + math.random()
		local function setWalk(on)
			walking = on
			if on then
				if idle then idle:Stop(0.25) end
				if walk then walk:Play(0.25, 1, 0.35) end -- slow, small steps
			else
				if walk then walk:Stop(0.25) end
				if idle then idle:Play(0.25) end
			end
		end
		local function stop()
			if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
			pcall(function()
				if walk then walk:Stop(0) end
				if idle then idle:Stop(0) end
			end)
			folder:Destroy()
		end
		fx.hallucinate = stop
		expire("hallucinate", stop, T) -- hard stop at exactly 60 s even if the frame loop stalls

		local function step()
			local now = os.clock()
			local t, dt = now - t0, math.min(now - last, 0.25)
			last = now
			if t >= T or not folder.Parent then return stopFx("hallucinate") end
			local me = myChar()
			local tr = me and me:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not tr then return end
			local c = tr.Position
			if not pos or Vector3.new(pos.X - c.X, 0, pos.Z - c.Z).Magnitude > 70 then -- first frame, or you ran far off: appear ahead of you again
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local lv = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				lv = Vector3.new(lv.X, 0, lv.Z)
				lv = lv.Magnitude > 0.01 and lv.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				local d = (CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)), 0) * lv) * SPAWN_D
				pos = Vector3.new(c.X + d.X, c.Y, c.Z + d.Z)
			end
			local to = Vector3.new(c.X - pos.X, 0, c.Z - pos.Z)
			local dist = to.Magnitude
			if dist <= STOP_D then -- arrived: stands and watches
				if walking then setWalk(false) end
			elseif t >= phaseEnd then -- step / stop / step ...
				if walking then
					setWalk(false)
					phaseEnd = t + 0.9 + math.random() * 0.9
				else
					setWalk(true)
					phaseEnd = t + 0.8 + math.random() * 0.4
				end
			end
			if walking and dist > STOP_D then pos += to.Unit * (STEP_SPEED * dt) end
			rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {folder, me, Env.Player.Character}
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(pos.X, c.Y + 8, pos.Z), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), rp)
			local y = hit and (hit.Position.Y + lift) or c.Y
			gy = gy and (gy + (y - gy) * 0.25) or y
			local at, here = Vector3.new(c.X, gy, c.Z), Vector3.new(pos.X, gy, pos.Z)
			g:PivotTo(dist > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(here, at) or CFrame.new(here))
			local fade = math.min(1, t / 3, (T - t) / 3) -- fade in 3 s, fade out the last 3 s
			if fade ~= lastFade then
				lastFade = fade
				local amt = fade * 0.9
				for _, pr in ipairs(parts) do
					if pr[1].Parent then pr[1].Transparency = 1 - (1 - pr[2]) * amt end
				end
			end
		end

		folder.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace
		local function load(id, prio)
			local a = Instance.new("Animation")
			a.AnimationId = id
			local ok, tr = pcall(function() return an:LoadAnimation(a) end)
			if ok and tr then
				tr.Looped, tr.Priority = true, prio
				return tr
			end
		end
		walk, idle = load(walkId, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement), load(idleId, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
		if idle then idle:Play(0) end
		step()
		conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			acc += dt
			if acc < interval then return end
			acc = 0
			if not pcall(step) then stopFx("hallucinate") end
		end)
	end

	-- ===== Dizzy =====
	-- camera sway + shake for 20 s, plus a mild walk-speed wobble. The camera offset is applied after the camera update and removed again before the next one, so the real
	-- camera CFrame is never changed permanently; FieldOfView / WalkSpeed are restored on expiry, respawn, re-trigger and unload (only if nobody else changed them meanwhile).
	local function dizzy()
		stopFx("dizzy")
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local DT = TIME.dizzy
		local me = myChar()
		local hum = me and me:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local fov, fovSet, speed, speedSet, applied, conn = cam.FieldOfView, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local function undo()
			if applied then
				if cam.Parent then cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * applied:Inverse() end
				applied = nil
			end
		end
		local function stop()
			pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("UhFxDizzyPost") end)
			pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("UhFxDizzyPre") end)
			pcall(undo)
			pcall(function() if fovSet and math.abs(cam.FieldOfView - fovSet) < 0.01 then cam.FieldOfView = fov end end)
			pcall(function() if hum and speedSet and math.abs(hum.WalkSpeed - speedSet) < 0.01 then hum.WalkSpeed = speed end end)
			if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
		end
		fx.dizzy = stop
		expire("dizzy", stop, DT)
		conn = Env.Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() stopFx("dizzy") end) -- respawn: back to normal at once
		RS:BindToRenderStep("UhFxDizzyPre", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
			if not pcall(undo) then stopFx("dizzy") end
		end)
		RS:BindToRenderStep("UhFxDizzyPost", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				local t = os.clock() - t0
				if t >= DT or workspace.CurrentCamera ~= cam then return stopFx("dizzy") end
				local e = math.min(1, t / 1.5, (DT - t) / 1.5) -- ease in / out
				local nx, ny = math.noise(t * 8, 0.5, 0), math.noise(t * 8, 7.5, 0)
				local off = CFrame.new(0.1 * math.sin(t * 2.3) + 0.05 * nx, 0.08 * math.sin(t * 3.1 + 1) + 0.05 * ny, 0)
					* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0.8) * math.sin(t * 2.1), math.rad(0.7) * math.sin(t * 1.4 + 2), math.rad(2.2) * math.sin(t * 1.7))
				off = CFrame.identity:Lerp(off, e)
				cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * off
				applied = off
				if not fovSet or math.abs(cam.FieldOfView - fovSet) >= 0.01 then fov = cam.FieldOfView end
				fovSet = fov + 1.5 * math.sin(t * 1.3) * e
				cam.FieldOfView = fovSet
				if hum and hum.Parent then
					if not speedSet or math.abs(hum.WalkSpeed - speedSet) >= 0.01 then speed = hum.WalkSpeed end
					speedSet = speed * (1 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 1.7) * e)
					hum.WalkSpeed = speedSet
				end
			end)
			if not ok then stopFx("dizzy") end
		end)
	end

	-- ===== recipient: entry point (called by ModTools for every queued command) =====
	-- returns true when the command was one of the three effects (handled or rejected here), false for everything else
	function F.Receive(c)
		if type(c) ~= "table" or not ACT[c.action] then return false end
		local by, action = tonumber(c.by), c.action
		if not by or by == Env.Player.UserId or not F.Can(by) then return true end -- sender must be owner / co-owner / verified
		if not F.Enabled or R.IsWhitelisted(Env.Player.UserId) then return true end -- switched off, or an immune role
		local sp = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(by)
		if not sp then return true end -- the sender must actually be in this server
		if action == "bring" then
			toast(sp.Name .. " is bringing you to them")
			bring(sp)
		elseif action == "hallucinate" then
			toast(sp.Name .. " made you hallucinate (" .. TIME.hallucinate .. " s)")
			hallucinate()
		else
			toast(sp.Name .. " made you dizzy (" .. TIME.dizzy .. " s)")
			dizzy()
		end
		return true
	end

	function F.StopEffects()
		local names = {}
		for n in pairs(fx) do names[#names + 1] = n end
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do stopFx(n) end
	end
	function F.SetEnabled(on)
		F.Enabled = on ~= false
		genv.UhFxEnabled = F.Enabled
		if not F.Enabled then F.StopEffects() end
	end
	F.Stop = F.StopEffects

	return F
end
