Blacklist = [==[
-- Blacklist.lua | loads the blacklist from the backend (GET /blacklist, falls back to blacklist.json in the repo); lets OWNER / CO-OWNER add + remove entries (Yes/No warning each time)
-- Usage (main script, after Env is built):  local BL = loadstring(game:HttpGet(Base .. "Blacklist.lua"))()(Env)
-- Env needs: Player, Players, HttpService, Request, Base, Backend (owner / co-owner recognised by userId from roles.json on GitHub, no key)
-- A blacklisted client kicks itself: "BLACKLISTED by the owner / co-owner" (checked at startup + every few seconds by B.Watch)
return function(Env)
	local B = {List = {}}
	local function roleOfEntry(e) -- which rank blacklisted them: looked up in roles.json (Env.Roles), nothing hardcoded
		local RL = Env.Roles
		if not (RL and e) then return nil end
		return RL.ById[math.floor(tonumber(e.byId) or 0)] or (e.by and RL.ByName[tostring(e.by):lower()]) or nil
	end

	function B.Fetch()
		if B.Fresh and os.clock() - B.Fresh < 15 then return true end -- keep the list the backend just returned
		local data
		for _, url in ipairs({Env.Backend .. "/blacklist?t=" .. os.time(), Env.Base .. "blacklist.json?t=" .. os.time()}) do -- backend first (no GitHub token involved), repo file as fallback
			local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
			if ok and type(body) == "string" then
				local ok2, d = pcall(Env.HttpService.JSONDecode, Env.HttpService, body)
				if ok2 and type(d) == "table" and type(d.entries) == "table" then data = d; break end
			end
		end
		if not data then return false end
		B.List = data.entries; B.Fresh = os.clock()
		return true
	end

	function B.Is(userId)
		for _, e in ipairs(B.List) do
			if tonumber(e.userId) == userId then return true, e end
		end
		return false
	end

	function B.KickText(e)
		local who = roleOfEntry(e) or "owner/co-owner"
		return "BLACKLISTED by the " .. who
	end

	function B.Enforce() -- kicks the local player when listed
		local hit, e = B.Is(Env.Player.UserId)
		if hit then pcall(function() Env.Player:Kick(B.KickText(e)) end) end
		return hit
	end

	-- call first thing on startup: returns true when the local player may NOT use the script
	function B.CheckSelf()
		B.Fetch()
		local hit, e = B.Is(Env.Player.UserId)
		if hit then warn("[Blacklist] you are blacklisted from this script" .. (e.reason and (": " .. tostring(e.reason)) or "")); B.Enforce() end
		return hit
	end

	function B.Watch() -- live enforcement: blacklisted while already running -> kicked
		if B.Watching then return end
		B.Watching = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while B.Watching do
				for _ = 1, 80 do if not B.Watching then return end task.wait(0.25) end
				if B.Fetch() then B.Enforce() end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function post(path, extra)
		if not Env.Request then return false, "executor has no request()" end
		if not (Env.IsOwner and Env.IsOwner()) then return false, "owner / co-owner only" end
		local body = {room = Env.Room, by = Env.Player.Name, byId = Env.Player.UserId}
		for k, v in pairs(extra) do body[k] = v end
		if Env.Sign then Env.Sign(path, body, tostring(extra.userId)) end
		local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, {
			Url = Env.Backend .. path, Method = "POST",
			Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"},
			Body = Env.HttpService:JSONEncode(body),
		})
		if not ok then return false, tostring(res) end
		local okJ, data = pcall(Env.HttpService.JSONDecode, Env.HttpService, type(res) == "table" and res.Body or "")
		if not okJ or type(data) ~= "table" then data = nil end
		if type(res) ~= "table" or res.StatusCode ~= 200 then return false, "HTTP " .. tostring(type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode) .. ((data and data.error) and (": " .. tostring(data.error)) or "") end
		if data and type(data.entries) == "table" then B.List = data.entries; B.Fresh = os.clock() else B.Fetch() end -- the backend returns the new list: use it
		return true
	end

	function B.Add(userId, username, reason)
		return post("/blacklist", {userId = userId, username = username, reason = reason or ""})
	end

	function B.Remove(userId) -- unblacklist (mistakes)
		return post("/unblacklist", {userId = userId})
	end

	local function toast(msg)
		pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "Blacklist", Text = msg, Duration = 4}) end)
	end

	-- Yes/No warning dialog. cb runs only on "Yes".
	local function dialog(text, cb)
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder = "UhBlacklistConfirm", false, 1000
		gui.Parent = Env.Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		local f = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
		f.Size, f.Position, f.AnchorPoint = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 150), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.BackgroundColor3, f.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30), 0
		Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
		t.Size, t.Position, t.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 84), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8), 1
		t.TextWrapped, t.TextColor3, t.Font, t.TextSize = true, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 14
		t.Text = text
		local function btn(txt, x, col, fn)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
			b.Size, b.Position, b.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 36), UDim2.fromOffset(x, 100), txt
			b.BackgroundColor3, b.TextColor3, b.Font, b.TextSize = col, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 15
			Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			b.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy(); fn() end)
		end
		btn("Yes", 15, Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60), cb)
		btn("No", 155, Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), function() end)
	end

	-- onDone(ok, err) is called after the request finishes (not called on "No").
	function B.Confirm(userId, username, onDone)
		dialog(("WARNING\nBlacklist %s (@%s)?\nThey will be blocked from using this script and kicked from the game."):format(username, username), function()
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, err = B.Add(userId, username)
				if onDone then onDone(ok, err) end
			end)
		end)
	end

	function B.ConfirmRemove(userId, username, onDone)
		dialog(("Unblacklist %s (@%s)?\nThey will be able to use this script again."):format(username, username), function()
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, err = B.Remove(userId)
				if onDone then onDone(ok, err) end
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- list of blacklisted players with an Unblacklist button each (owner / co-owner)
	function B.ClosePanel() if B.Panel then B.Panel:Destroy(); B.Panel = nil end end
	function B.OpenPanel()
		B.ClosePanel()
		task.spawn(function()
			B.Fetch()
			local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder = "UhBlacklistPanel", false, 999
			gui.Parent = Env.Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
			B.Panel = gui
			local f = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
			f.Size, f.Position, f.AnchorPoint = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 300), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.BackgroundColor3, f.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30), 0
			Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
			local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
			t.Size, t.Position, t.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6), 1
			t.Text, t.TextColor3, t.Font, t.TextSize, t.TextXAlignment = ("Blacklist (%d)"):format(#B.List), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 16, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			local x = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
			x.Size, x.Position, x.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 26), UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 8), "X"
			x.BackgroundColor3, x.TextColor3, x.Font, x.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14
			Instance.new("UICorner", x).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
			x.Activated:Connect(B.ClosePanel)
			local sc = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", f)
			sc.Size, sc.Position, sc.BackgroundTransparency, sc.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -50), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 40), 1, 0
			sc.ScrollBarThickness, sc.CanvasSize, sc.AutomaticCanvasSize = 4, UDim2.new(), Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", sc)
			lay.Padding, lay.SortOrder = UDim.new(0, 6), Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			if #B.List == 0 then
				local e = Instance.new("TextLabel", sc)
				e.Size, e.BackgroundTransparency, e.Text, e.TextColor3, e.Font, e.TextSize = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), 1, "Nobody is blacklisted", Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180), Enum.Font.Gotham, 14
			end
			for i, e in ipairs(B.List) do
				local uid, name = tonumber(e.userId), tostring(e.username or e.userId)
				local row = Instance.new("Frame", sc)
				row.Size, row.BackgroundColor3, row.BorderSizePixel, row.LayoutOrder = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 38), Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 42), 0, i
				Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
				local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
				l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Text = UDim2.new(1, -118, 1, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), 1, name
				l.TextColor3, l.Font, l.TextSize, l.TextXAlignment, l.TextTruncate = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
				local u = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
				u.Size, u.Position, u.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 26), UDim2.new(1, -106, 0.5, -13), "Unblacklist"
				u.BackgroundColor3, u.TextColor3, u.Font, u.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 90), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 12
				Instance.new("UICorner", u).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

						toast(ok and (name .. " unblacklisted") or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)))

		end)
	end

	-- small "Blacklist" button (owner / co-owner) that opens the panel
	function B.ShowPill()
		if B.PillGui then return end
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = "UhBlacklistCtl", false, 50, true

		b.Activated:Connect(B.OpenPanel)
	end

	function B.Stop()
		B.Watching = false
		B.ClosePanel()
		if B.PillGui then B.PillGui:Destroy(); B.PillGui = nil end
	end

	return B

AltFling = [==[
-- AltFling.lua | Alt-Fling remake: Served User requests + consent, Alt-Flinger console, relationship viewer
-- Backend: POST /alt and GET /alt on the existing live-sync backend (server.js). Identity = the banner token (Env.Token), same check as /commands.
-- Roles: the REQUESTER is the Alt Flinger (flings with its own current fling method); the TARGET is the Served User (clicks targets, gets the results back).
-- Env needs: Player, Players, HttpService, Request, Backend, Room, Token, GetColor, Notify(msg), MethodId(), MethodName(), RunFling(player) -> ok, reason,
--            GetServedUI() -> {Input, Request, View, Status} (main-tab controls), Expose(api)
return function(Env)
	local HS, Players, Me = Env.HttpService, Env.Players, Env.Player
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local A = {Running = false, Rels = {}, Pending = {}, Out = {}, Log = {}}
	local conns, C, V, P = {}, {}, {}, {Cards = {}}
	local dirty = {log = true, view = true}
	local WINDOW, MOVED, SPEED = 5, 60, 300 -- observation window (s), studs moved / studs per second that count as evidence of a fling
	local COL = {CONFIRMED = "#46f08c", UNCONFIRMED = "#ffbe3c", FAILED = "#ff5a5a", PENDING = "#8a93a6", INFO = "#7aa2ff"}

	local function new(c, p, par) local i = Instance.new(c); for k, v in pairs(p) do i[k] = v end; i.Parent = par; return i end
	local function round(par, r) return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)}, par) end
	local function accent()
		local ok, c = pcall(Env.GetColor)
		return (ok and typeof(c) == "Color3") and c or Color3.fromRGB(95, 165, 255)
	end
	local function stroke(par) return new("UIStroke", {Color = accent(), Thickness = 1.5}, par) end
	local function esc(s) return (tostring(s):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")) end
	local function stamp() return os.date("%H:%M:%S") end
	local function notify(t) pcall(Env.Notify, t) end
	local function setVis(o, v) if o then pcall(function() o.Visible = v end) end end
	local function setText(o, t) if o then pcall(function() o.Text = t end) end end
	local function methodName() local ok, n = pcall(Env.MethodName); return ok and tostring(n) or "unknown" end

	-- ===== backend =====
	local function call(method, path, body)
		if not Env.Request then return false, "executor has no request()" end
		local req = {Url = Env.Backend .. path, Method = method}
		if body then
			body.room, body.userId, body.token = Env.Room, Me.UserId, Env.Token
			req.Headers, req.Body = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, HS:JSONEncode(body)
		end
		local ok, res = pcall(Env.Request, req)
		if not ok then return false, tostring(res) end
		if type(res) ~= "table" then return false, "no response" end
		local okD, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, res.Body or "")
		if res.StatusCode ~= 200 then
			return false, (okD and type(data) == "table" and data.error) or ("HTTP " .. tostring(res.StatusCode)), res.StatusCode
		end
		return true, (okD and type(data) == "table") and data or {}
	end
	local function post(op, target, extra)
		local body = extra or {}
		body.op, body.target = op, tostring(target)
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			local ok, r, code = call("POST", "/alt", body)
			if ok or code ~= 429 then return ok, r end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
		return false, "slow down"
	end

	-- ===== state helpers =====
	local function asFlinger() local t = {}; for _, r in ipairs(A.Rels) do if r.flinger == Me.UserId then t[#t + 1] = r end end; return t end
	local function asServed() local t = {}; for _, r in ipairs(A.Rels) do if r.served == Me.UserId then t[#t + 1] = r end end; return t end
	local function names(list, key) local t = {}; for _, r in ipairs(list) do t[#t + 1] = r[key] end; return table.concat(t, ", ") end
	local function find(name)
		local low, best = name:lower(), nil
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p.Name:lower() == low then return p end
			if not best and (p.DisplayName:lower() == low or p.Name:lower():sub(1, #low) == low) then best = p end
		end
		return best
	end
	local function findExact(name)
		local low = tostring(name):lower()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Name:lower() == low then return p end end
	end

	-- ===== log =====
	local function addLog(e)
		e.time = e.time or stamp()
		A.Log[#A.Log + 1] = e
		if #A.Log > 80 then table.remove(A.Log, 1) end
		dirty.log = true
		return e
	end
	local function lineOf(e)
		if e.text then return ('<font color="#8a93a6">[%s]</font> <font color="%s">*</font> %s'):format(e.time, COL.INFO, esc(e.text)) end
		return ('<font color="#8a93a6">[%s]</font> %s <font color="#8a93a6">|</font> %s <font color="#8a93a6">|</font> <font color="%s"><b>%s</b></font>%s'):format(
			e.time, esc(e.victim), esc(e.method), COL[e.status] or COL.PENDING, e.status, e.detail and (" " .. esc(e.detail)) or "")
	end

	-- ===== ui =====
	local function host()
		if A.Gui and A.Gui.Parent then return A.Gui end
		local parent
		pcall(function() parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
		parent = parent or Me:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		pcall(function() for _, v in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do if v.Name == "UhAltFlingHost" then v:Destroy() end end end)
		A.Gui = new("ScreenGui", {Name = "UhAltFlingHost", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 950, IgnoreGuiInset = true, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, parent)
		return A.Gui
	end
	local function button(par, text, size, pos, cb)
		local b = new("TextButton", {Text = text, Size = size, Position = pos, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 34), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12, BorderSizePixel = 0}, par)
		round(b, 5)
		b.Activated:Connect(cb)
		return b
	end
	local function drag(frame, handle)
		local dragging, start, origin
		conns[#conns + 1] = handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging, start, origin = true, i.Position, frame.Position
			end
		end)
		conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
			if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				local d = i.Position - start
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(origin.X.Scale, origin.X.Offset + d.X, origin.Y.Scale, origin.Y.Offset + d.Y)
			end
		end)
		conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
	local function panel(g, name, size, pos, anchor, title)
		local f = new("Frame", {Name = name, Size = size, Position = pos, AnchorPoint = anchor or Vector2.zero, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 9, 12),
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Active = true}, g)
		round(f, 8); stroke(f)
		local head = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, f)
		round(head, 8)
		new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Text = title, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = accent(), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, head)
		drag(f, head)
		return f, head
	end
	local function list(par, pos, size)
		local s = new("ScrollingFrame", {Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 13, 18), BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3,
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y}, par)
		round(s, 5)
		new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, s)
		return s
	end

	local function buildConsole()
		if C.Frame and C.Frame.Parent then return end
		C.Frame = panel(host(), "Console", UDim2.fromOffset(320, 250), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -125), nil, "ALT-FLINGER CONSOLE")
		C.Info = new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 46), RichText = true, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 224, 235), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Text = ""}, C.Frame)
		C.Scroll = list(C.Frame, UDim2.fromOffset(8, 80), UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -116))
		button(C.Frame, "Users", UDim2.fromOffset(96, 24), UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -30), function() A.ToggleViewer() end)
		button(C.Frame, "Clear log", UDim2.fromOffset(96, 24), UDim2.new(0, 112, 1, -30), function() table.clear(A.Log); dirty.log = true; A.Render() end)
		button(C.Frame, "Stop", UDim2.fromOffset(96, 24), UDim2.new(0, 216, 1, -30), function()
			for _, r in ipairs(asFlinger()) do
				local ok, e = post("end", r.served)
				if not ok then notify("Could not end " .. r.sname .. ": " .. tostring(e)) end
			end
			A.Poll()
		end)
	end
	local function buildViewer()
		if V.Frame and V.Frame.Parent then return end
		local _, head
		V.Frame, head = panel(host(), "Viewer", UDim2.fromOffset(300, 200), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), "ALT FLINGER FOR")
		button(head, "X", UDim2.fromOffset(22, 18), UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 4), function() V.Frame.Visible = false end)
		V.List = list(V.Frame, UDim2.fromOffset(8, 32), UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -40))
	end
	local function buildPrompt(r)
		if not (P.List and P.List.Parent) then
			P.List = new("Frame", {Name = "Prompts", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 64), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, host())
			new("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, P.List)
		end
		local card = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 88), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 9, 12), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = r.ts or 0}, P.List)
		round(card, 8); stroke(card)
		new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 44), RichText = true, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 224, 235), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
			Text = ("<b>%s</b> wants you as their Served User.\nThey would be your Alt Flinger."):format(esc(r.name))}, card)
		button(card, "Accept", UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -34), function() A.Respond(r.from, true) end)
		button(card, "Decline", UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 1, -34), function() A.Respond(r.from, false) end)
		P.Cards[r.from] = card
	end

	local function updateInfo()
		if not (C.Frame and C.Frame.Visible) then return end
		C.Info.Text = ('<font color="#8a93a6">status </font><font color="#46f08c"><b>ACTIVE</b></font>\n<font color="#8a93a6">method </font>%s\n<font color="#8a93a6">served </font>%s'):format(
			esc(methodName()), esc(names(asFlinger(), "sname")))
	end
	local function renderLog()
		if not dirty.log or not (C.Scroll and C.Scroll.Parent) then return end
		dirty.log = false
		for _, c in ipairs(C.Scroll:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextLabel") then c:Destroy() end end
		for i, e in ipairs(A.Log) do
			new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, TextWrapped = true, RichText = true,
				Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 224, 235), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = lineOf(e), LayoutOrder = i}, C.Scroll)
		end
		task.defer(function() if C.Scroll and C.Scroll.Parent then C.Scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1e6) end end)
	end
	local function renderViewer()
		if not dirty.view or not (V.Frame and V.Frame.Parent and V.Frame.Visible) then return end
		dirty.view = false
		for _, c in ipairs(V.List:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end end
		local f = asFlinger()
		if #f == 0 then
			new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 28), Text = "You are not an active Alt Flinger for anyone.", Font = Enum.Font.Code,
				TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 147, 166), TextWrapped = true}, V.List)
		end
		for i, r in ipairs(f) do
			local row = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 28), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i}, V.List)
			round(row, 5)
			new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 11,
				TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Text = r.sname .. "  (since " .. os.date("%H:%M:%S", math.floor((r.ts or 0) / 1000)) .. ")"}, row)
			button(row, "End", UDim2.fromOffset(52, 20), UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 4), function()
				local ok, e = post("end", r.served)
				if not ok then notify("Could not end: " .. tostring(e)) end
				A.Poll()
			end)
		end
	end
	local function syncMain()
		local ui = Env.GetServedUI and Env.GetServedUI()
		if not ui then return end
		local f, s, txt = asFlinger(), asServed(), nil
		if #f > 0 then txt = "Served User: ACTIVE for " .. names(f, "sname") .. " (console open)"
		elseif #s > 0 then txt = "Served User: " .. names(s, "fname") .. " is your Alt Flinger"
		elseif #A.Out > 0 then txt = "Served User: waiting for " .. A.Out[1].name .. " to answer"
		else txt = "Served User: none" end
		setText(ui.Status, txt)
		setVis(ui.Input, #f == 0)
		setVis(ui.Request, #f == 0)
	end
	function A.Render()
		if #asFlinger() > 0 then
			buildConsole()
			C.Frame.Visible = true
		elseif C.Frame then
			C.Frame.Visible = false
		end
		updateInfo(); renderLog(); renderViewer(); syncMain()
		local want = {}
		for _, r in ipairs(A.Pending) do
			want[r.from] = true
			if not P.Cards[r.from] then
				buildPrompt(r)
				notify(r.name .. " wants you as their Served User - Accept or Decline")
			end
		end
		for id, card in pairs(P.Cards) do if not want[id] then card:Destroy(); P.Cards[id] = nil end end
	end

	function A.ToggleViewer()
		if not A.Running then notify("Alt-Fling needs the live-sync backend (not connected)"); return end
		buildViewer()
		V.Frame.Visible = not V.Frame.Visible
		dirty.view = true
		A.Render()
		if V.Frame.Visible then task.spawn(A.Poll) end
	end

	-- ===== flinging (Alt Flinger side) =====
	local function rootOf(p) local c = p.Character; return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c.PrimaryPart), c end
	local function observe(target) -- only reports CONFIRMED on evidence this client actually saw; everything else is UNCONFIRMED
		local r0, c0 = rootOf(target)
		if not r0 then return "UNCONFIRMED", "target had no character to observe" end
		local p0, t0 = r0.Position, os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < WINDOW do
			task.wait(0.1)
			if not target.Parent then return "UNCONFIRMED", "target left the server before a result could be observed" end
			local r, c = rootOf(target)
			if not r or c ~= c0 then return "UNCONFIRMED", "target respawned or died (cause not established)" end
			local moved, speed = (r.Position - p0).Magnitude, r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			if moved >= MOVED then return "CONFIRMED", ("observed locally: moved %d studs"):format(math.floor(moved)) end
			if speed >= SPEED then return "CONFIRMED", ("observed locally: %d studs/s"):format(math.floor(speed)) end
		end
		return "UNCONFIRMED", ("no displacement observed in %ds"):format(WINDOW)
	end
	local function report(ev, e)
		local ok, err = post("result", ev.served, {cid = ev.cid, victim = ev.victim, method = e.method, result = e.status:lower(), detail = e.detail or ""})
		if not ok then
			e.detail = (e.detail or "") .. " (report to Served User failed: " .. tostring(err) .. ")"
			dirty.log = true
			A.Render()
		end
	end
	function A.Execute(ev)
		local e = addLog({victim = ev.victim, method = methodName(), status = "PENDING", detail = "command from " .. tostring(ev.sname)})
		A.Render()
		local function finish(status, detail)
			e.status, e.detail = status, detail
			dirty.log = true
			A.Render()
			report(ev, e)
		end
		local ok = false
		for _, r in ipairs(asFlinger()) do if r.served == ev.served then ok = true end end
		if not ok then return finish("FAILED", "no active relationship on the backend") end
		local target = findExact(ev.victim)
		if not target then return finish("FAILED", "target is not in this server") end
		if target == Me then return finish("FAILED", "target is this account") end
		if target.UserId == ev.served then return finish("FAILED", "target is the Served User") end
		local okM, mid = pcall(Env.MethodId)
		if okM and mid == 8 then return finish("FAILED", "current method is Alt-fling, which never flings (pick a real fling method)") end
		local okR, r1, r2 = pcall(Env.RunFling, target)
		if not okR then return finish("FAILED", tostring(r1):sub(1, 80)) end
		if r1 == false then return finish("FAILED", tostring(r2 or "fling engine rejected the target (dead / already flinging / invalid)")) end
		local status, detail = observe(target)
		if status == "UNCONFIRMED" and r1 == nil then detail = detail .. "; engine returned no result" end
		finish(status, detail)
	end

	-- ===== served side =====
	function A.SendFling(target)
		local r = asServed()[1]
		if not r then return false end
		if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" or not target:IsA("Player") then return false end
		if os.clock() - (A.LastFling or 0) < 0.5 then return false end
		A.LastFling = os.clock()
		local ok, err = post("fling", r.flinger, {victim = target.Name, cid = tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))})
		if not ok then notify("Alt-Fling NOT sent: " .. tostring(err)); return false end
		notify("Fling command sent to " .. r.fname .. " for " .. target.Name .. " (result pending)")
		return true
	end

	-- ===== requests / consent =====
	function A.Request(name)
		if not A.Running then
			local m = "Alt-Fling needs the live-sync backend (not connected)"
			notify(m)
			return false, m
		end
		name = (tostring(name or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
		local function fail(m) notify(m); return false, m end
		if name == "" then return fail("Type a username first") end
		local pl = find(name)
		if not pl then return fail("No player matching '" .. name .. "' in this server") end
		if pl == Me then return fail("You can't request yourself") end
		local ok, err = post("request", pl.UserId)
		if not ok then
			if err == "target is not running the script" then err = pl.Name .. " is not running this script" end
			return fail("Request not sent: " .. tostring(err))
		end
		notify("Request sent to " .. pl.Name .. " - waiting for them to answer")
		A.Poll()
		return true
	end
	function A.Respond(from, accept)
		local ok, err = post("respond", from, {accept = accept and true or false})
		local card = P.Cards[from]
		if card then card:Destroy(); P.Cards[from] = nil end
		if not ok then notify("Could not answer the request: " .. tostring(err)) end
		A.Poll()
		return ok, err
	end

	-- ===== polling =====
	local function handle(ev, ended)
		local t, me = ev.type, Me.UserId
		if t == "accepted" then
			if ev.flinger == me then
				addLog({text = ev.sname .. " accepted - you are now their Alt Flinger"})
				notify(ev.sname .. " accepted. You are now their Alt Flinger.")
			elseif ev.served == me then
				notify("You accepted " .. ev.fname .. ". They are now your Alt Flinger.")
			end
		elseif t == "declined" then
			addLog({text = ev.name .. " declined your Served User request"})
			notify(ev.name .. " declined your Served User request.")
		elseif t == "ended" then
			ended[ev.flinger .. ">" .. ev.served] = true
			if ev.flinger == me then addLog({text = "relationship with " .. ev.sname .. " ended"}) end
			notify("Alt-Fling relationship ended by " .. tostring(ev.name))
		elseif t == "fling" then
			task.spawn(A.Execute, ev)
		elseif t == "result" then
			notify(("%s: %s %s [%s]%s"):format(ev.fname, ev.victim, tostring(ev.result):upper(), ev.method, (ev.detail ~= "" and (" - " .. ev.detail) or "")))
		end
	end
	local function apply(d)
		local old = {}
		for _, r in ipairs(A.Rels) do old[r.flinger .. ">" .. r.served] = r end
		A.Rels, A.Pending, A.Out = d.rels or {}, d.pending or {}, d.out or {}
		local sig = {}
		for _, r in ipairs(A.Rels) do sig[#sig + 1] = r.flinger .. ">" .. r.served end
		sig = table.concat(sig, ",")
		if sig ~= A.Sig then A.Sig = sig; dirty.view = true end
		local ended = {}
		for _, ev in ipairs(d.events or {}) do
			local ok, err = pcall(handle, ev, ended)
			if not ok then warn("[AltFling] event failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
		end
		for _, r in ipairs(A.Rels) do old[r.flinger .. ">" .. r.served] = nil end
		for k, r in pairs(old) do
			if not ended[k] then -- gone from the backend without an ended event (other player left / backend restarted)
				if r.flinger == Me.UserId then addLog({text = "relationship with " .. r.sname .. " is no longer active on the backend"}) end
				notify("Alt-Fling relationship is no longer active on the backend")
			end
		end
		A.Render()
	end
	function A.Poll()
		local ok, d = call("GET", "/alt?room=" .. HS:UrlEncode(Env.Room) .. "&userId=" .. Me.UserId .. "&token=" .. HS:UrlEncode(Env.Token))
		if not ok then return false, d end
		apply(d)
		return true
	end
	function A.Start()
		if A.Running or not Env.Request then return end
		A.Running = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local fails = 0
			while A.Running do
				local ok, res = pcall(A.Poll)
				if ok and res then fails = 0 else fails += 1 end
				local busy = #A.Rels > 0 or #A.Pending > 0 or #A.Out > 0 -- poll slowly while idle (saves backend requests)
				task.wait(math.min((busy and 1.5 or 4) + fails * 1.5, 12))
			end
		end)
		task.spawn(function() while A.Running do task.wait(0.5); pcall(updateInfo) end end)
	end
	function A.Stop()
		A.Running = false
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		table.clear(conns)
		if A.Gui then pcall(function() A.Gui:Destroy() end); A.Gui = nil end
		C, V, P = {}, {}, {Cards = {}}
		A.Rels, A.Pending, A.Out = {}, {}, {}
		pcall(syncMain)
		pcall(Env.Expose, nil)
	end

	Env.Expose({
		Request = A.Request, SendFling = A.SendFling, ToggleViewer = A.ToggleViewer, Poll = A.Poll, Stop = A.Stop,
		HasFlinger = function() return #asServed() > 0 end,
	})
	return A
end
]==],
}

end

end)

local AntiflingHumanoids = {}
local AntiflingBaseParts = {}
local OnStepped = function()
for i,v in AntiflingBaseParts do
if v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
v.AssemblyLinearVelocity, v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
else
table.remove(AntiflingBaseParts, i)
end
end
for i,v in AntiflingHumanoids do
if v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
if v.EvaluateStateMachine then v.EvaluateStateMachine = false end
else
table.remove(AntiflingHumanoids, i)
end
end
end
RunService.PreAnimation:Connect(OnStepped)
RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(OnStepped)
RunService.Stepped:Connect(OnStepped)
local OnBasePart = function(v)
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
v.CanCollide = false
if not table.find(AntiflingBaseParts, v) then
table.insert(AntiflingBaseParts, v)
end
end
if v:IsA("Humanoid") then
v.EvaluateStateMachine = false
if not table.find(AntiflingHumanoids, v) then
table.insert(AntiflingHumanoids, v)
end
end
end
local OnCharacter = function(character)
character.DescendantAdded:Connect(OnBasePart)
for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
OnBasePart(v)
end
end
local OnPlayer = function(player)
if player == Player then return end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnCharacter)
if player.Character then OnCharacter(player.Character) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayer)
for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
OnPlayer(player)
end
end
local HumanoidLASetHookState
if ismissing(hookmetamethod) or ismissing(hookfunction) then
HumanoidLASetHookState = function(hooked) end
else
local LoadAnimation_old = nil
local function LoadAnimation_new(animation)
local char = Instance.new("Model")
char.Parent = workspace
local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
hum.Parent = char
local anim = LoadAnimation_old(hum, animation)
hum.Parent = nil
char:Destroy()
return anim
end
local LoadAnimation_nc = nil
local _HumanoidDummy = Instance.new("Humanoid")
local _HumanoidLA = _HumanoidDummy.LoadAnimation
local newloadanimation = newcclosure(function(self, animation)
if not checkcaller() and typeof(self) == "Instance" and (self:IsA("Humanoid") or self:IsA("Animator")) and typeof(animation) == "Instance" and animation:IsA("Animation") then
return LoadAnimation_new(animation)
end
return LoadAnimation_old(self, animation)
end)
local newnamecall = newcclosure(function(...)
local method = getnamecallmethod()
if not checkcaller() and method and (method == "LoadAnimation" or method == "loadAnimation") then
local self, animation = ...
if typeof(self) == "Instance" and (self:IsA("Humanoid") or self:IsA("Animator")) and typeof(animation) == "Instance" and animation:IsA("Animation") then
return LoadAnimation_new(animation)
end
end
return LoadAnimation_nc(...)
end)
HumanoidLASetHookState = function(hooked)
if hooked then
if not LoadAnimation_old then
LoadAnimation_old = hookfunction(_HumanoidLA, clonefunction(newloadanimation))
end
if not LoadAnimation_nc then
LoadAnimation_nc = hookmetamethod(_HumanoidDummy, "__namecall", clonefunction(newnamecall))
end
else
if LoadAnimation_old then
hookfunction(_HumanoidLA, LoadAnimation_old)
LoadAnimation_old = nil
end
if LoadAnimation_nc then
hookmetamethod(_HumanoidDummy, "__namecall", LoadAnimation_nc)
LoadAnimation_nc = nil
end
end
end

local _shp, _pc, _zyx = sethiddenproperty, pcall, Enum.RotationOrder.ZYX
Util.SetMotor6DTransform = function(motor, transform)
if motor.MaxVelocity ~= 9e9 then motor.MaxVelocity = 9e9 end
local _, _, angle = transform:ToEulerAngles(_zyx)
motor.DesiredAngle = angle
motor:SetDesiredAngle(angle)
local axis, ang = transform:ToAxisAngle()
if _shp then
_pc(_shp, motor, "ReplicateCurrentOffset6D", transform.Position)
_pc(_shp, motor, "ReplicateCurrentAngle6D", axis * ang)
end
end
Util.SetMotor6DOffset = function(motor, offset)
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(motor, motor.C0:Inverse() * offset * motor.C1)
end
end

local RIGHTGRIP_C0 = CFrame.new(0, -1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0)
Util.PredictionFling = function(target)
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if target:IsA("Model") then
target = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end
if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
if not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
return CFrame.identity, true
end
local t = os.clock()
local t2 = math.sin(t * 15) + 1
local cf = target.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(1.57, 0, 0)
if not Util.Fling.UseGlue() then
local tv = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
if tv.Magnitude > 300 or tv.X ~= tv.X or tv.Y ~= tv.Y or tv.Z ~= tv.Z then tv = Vector3.zero end
cf += tv * t2 + Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity * 0.5 * t2 * t2 + math.sin(t * 60), 0)
if cf.Position.Y < target.Position.Y - 1 then
cf = cf.Rotation + Vector3.new(cf.Position.X, target.Position.Y - 1, cf.Position.Z)
end
end
local oldpos = target:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition")
if not oldpos then
oldpos = target.Position
target:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", oldpos)
end
if (target.Position - oldpos).Magnitude > 200 then
target:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", nil)
return cf, true
end
return cf, false
end
end
if typeof(target) == "CFrame" then
return target, false
end
if typeof(target) == "Vector3" then
return CFrame.new(target), false
end
return CFrame.identity, true
end
Util.PredictionFlingPart = function(target)
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if target:IsA("Model") then
target = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end
if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
return target
end
end
end
Util.Fling = {}
Util.Fling.Names = {
"Default Fling",
"Weak Fling (just trips them)",
"Nooby's Method (clip + nullzone)",
"NaN State Fling",
"Fling 1 (Nameless / Source)",
"Fling 2 (Carpet)",
"Fling 3 (Hidden / Flight)",
"Alt-fling (Nameless Admin alt)",
}
Util.Fling.Descriptions = {
"default fling: spins into the target at crazy velocity and sends them flying",
"weak fling: only trips people over, doesn't send them to the void",
"nooby's method: clips inside their HumanoidRootPart, flings them to the nullzone and stays attached until they die",
"NaN state fling: sticks to their root with a NaN humanoid state, falls back to a velocity fling if they only get pushed",
"Fling 1: adapted from Nameless Admin's classic high-velocity multi-position fling sequence",
"Fling 2: adapted from the carpet-animation target-following fling sequence",
"Fling 3: adapted from the hidden-fling target sweep + flight sequence",
"Alt-fling: your Nameless Admin alt does the flinging. Your own character never flings.",
}
Util.Fling.WeakDuration = 0.4
Util.Fling.NaNWindow = 0.6
Util.Fling.NaNEscalateDistance = 60
Util.Fling.NoobyMaxTime = 90
Util.Fling.SourceFling1Duration = 2.0
Util.Fling.SourceFling2Duration = 0.9
Util.Fling.SourceFling3Duration = 1.35
do
local saved = SaveData.FlingMethod
if type(saved) ~= "number" then
saved = (SaveData.Reanimator and SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling) and 4 or 1
end
Util.Fling.Method = math.clamp(math.floor(saved), 1, #Util.Fling.Names)
end
Util.Fling.SetMethod = function(m)
m = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(m) or 1), 1, #Util.Fling.Names)
Util.Fling.Method = m
SaveData.FlingMethod = m
SaveData.Reanimator = SaveData.Reanimator or {}
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling = (m == 4)
Util.Notify("Fling method: " .. Util.Fling.Names[m])
if Util.AltFling then if m == 8 then Util.AltFling.Enable() else Util.AltFling.Disable() end end
end
Util.Fling.GetPart = function(target)
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if target:IsA("Model") then
local hum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
target = (hum and hum.RootPart) or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end
if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
return target
end
end
return nil
end
Util.Fling.TargetAlive = function(target)
if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" then return true end
if not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
if target:IsA("Model") then
local hum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
end
local part = Util.Fling.GetPart(target)
if not part then return false end
local p = part.Position
if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.Z ~= p.Z then return false end
if p.Y < FallenPartsDestroyHeight - 100 then return false end
return true
end
Util.Fling.Debug = true
Util.Fling.GlueState = nil
Util.Fling.UseGlue = function()
if not Reanimate.UsePhysicsRepRootPart then return false end
if Util.Fling.GlueState == nil then
local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not root then return true end
local ok = pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootRef", root)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
Util.Fling.GlueState = ok and true or false
if not ok then
Util.Notify("Physics Glue isn't supported by your executor, using prediction fling instead")
end
end
return Util.Fling.GlueState
end
Util.Fling.ReportStart = function(ft)
if not Util.Fling.Debug then return end
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()
local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local owned = root and root.ReceiveAge == 0
Util.Notify(string.format(
"fling start: method=%s glue=%s rootOwned=%s",
tostring(ft.Mode), tostring(Util.Fling.UseGlue()), tostring(owned)
))
end)
end)
end
Util.Fling.Step = function(queue, t, defaultduration)
local ft = queue[1]
if not ft then return nil, CFrame.identity, false end
local isinstance = typeof(ft.Target) == "Instance"
local part = Util.Fling.GetPart(ft.Target)
if not ft.Time then
ft.Mode = Util.Fling.Method
ft.Start = t
ft.StartPos = part and part.Position or nil
local dur = ft.Duration
if not dur then
if ft.Mode == 2 then
dur = Util.Fling.WeakDuration
elseif ft.Mode == 3 and isinstance then
dur = Util.Fling.NoobyMaxTime
elseif ft.Mode == 4 then
dur = math.max(defaultduration, Util.Fling.NaNWindow + 1)
elseif ft.Mode == 5 then
dur = Util.Fling.SourceFling1Duration
elseif ft.Mode == 6 then
dur = math.max(defaultduration, Util.Fling.SourceFling2Duration, 2.5)
elseif ft.Mode == 7 then
dur = Util.Fling.SourceFling3Duration
else
dur = defaultduration
end
end
ft.Time = t + dur
Util.Fling.ReportStart(ft)
elseif t > ft.Time then
table.remove(queue, 1)
return nil, CFrame.identity, false
end
if isinstance then
if not part or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
table.remove(queue, 1)
return nil, CFrame.identity, false
end
local p = part.Position
if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.Z ~= p.Z then
table.remove(queue, 1)
return nil, CFrame.identity, true
end
if ft.Mode == 3 and not Util.Fling.TargetAlive(ft.Target) then
table.remove(queue, 1)
return nil, CFrame.identity, true
end
if ft.Mode == 3 and t - ft.Start < Util.Fling.NoobyMaxTime then
ft.Time = math.max(ft.Time, t + 1)
end
if ft.Mode == 6 and ft.StartPos and t - ft.Start > 0.15 and (p - ft.StartPos).Magnitude > 150 then
table.remove(queue, 1)
return nil, CFrame.identity, true
end
if ft.Mode == 4 and not ft.Escalated and t - ft.Start > Util.Fling.NaNWindow then
local moved = ft.StartPos and (p - ft.StartPos).Magnitude or math.huge
if moved < Util.Fling.NaNEscalateDistance then
ft.Escalated = true
ft.Mode = 1
ft.Time = math.max(ft.Time, t + 1)
end
end
end
local flingcf, flinged
if isinstance and (ft.Mode == 2 or ft.Mode == 3 or ft.Mode == 4 or ft.Mode == 5 or ft.Mode == 6 or ft.Mode == 7) then
if ft.Mode == 2 then
local wv = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
if wv.Magnitude > 60 then wv = wv.Unit * 60 end
flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position + wv * 0.08 + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
elseif ft.Mode == 6 then
local speed = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
if speed <= 28 then
flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position + part.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.5)
else
flingcf = part.CFrame
end
if speed > 1e4 then flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position) end
elseif ft.Mode == 5 then
local hum = ft.Target:IsA("Model") and ft.Target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
local moveDir = hum and hum.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
local speed = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
local elapsed = math.max(0, t - ft.Start)
local interval = 0.075
local lowSpeedOffsets = {
Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
Vector3.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25),
Vector3.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25),
Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
}
local highSpeedOffsets = {
Vector3.new(0, 1.5, hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, -(hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16)),
Vector3.new(0, 1.5, hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16),
Vector3.new(0, 1.5, speed / 1.25),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, -speed / 1.25),
Vector3.new(0, 1.5, speed / 1.25),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
}
local offsets = speed < 50 and lowSpeedOffsets or highSpeedOffsets
local index = (math.floor(elapsed / interval) % #offsets) + 1
local extra = moveDir * math.min(speed, 100) / 1.25
local offset = offsets[index] + extra
local angle = math.rad(math.floor(elapsed / interval) * 100)
flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position + offset) * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0)
elseif ft.Mode == 7 then
local offsets = {
Vector3.new(0, 0, 4),
Vector3.new(0, 0, -2),
Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
Vector3.new(0, 0, -3),
Vector3.new(0, 0, 2),
Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
}
local interval = 0.04
local elapsed = math.max(0, t - ft.Start)
local index = (math.floor(elapsed / interval) % #offsets) + 1
flingcf = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsets[index])
else
local cv = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
if (ft.Mode == 3 or ft.Mode == 4) and cv.Magnitude < 80 then
flingcf = part.CFrame + cv * 0.05
else
flingcf = part.CFrame
end
end
flinged = false
else
flingcf, flinged = Util.PredictionFling(ft.Target)
end
if flinged then
table.remove(queue, 1)
return nil, CFrame.identity, true
end
return ft, flingcf, false
end
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot = function(RootPart, ft, flingcf)
local mode = ft.Mode or 1
local t = os.clock()
local jitter = Vector3.new(0, 0, math.random(0, 1) * 0.005)
if mode == 4 then
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(flingcf.Position + jitter + Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 40) * 0.15, 0, math.cos(t * 40) * 0.15)) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 15, 0)
RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
pcall(function() RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero end)
elseif mode == 2 then
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(flingcf.Position + jitter) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 10, 0)
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 25) * 26, -4, math.cos(t * 25) * 26)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
elseif mode == 3 and typeof(ft.Target) == "Instance" then
local nf = (math.floor(t * 120) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
local tp = Util.Fling.GetPart(ft.Target)
local at = tp and tp.Position or flingcf.Position
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + jitter + Vector3.new(0, nf * 0.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(t * 31, t * 47, 0)
RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -16384 * nf, 0), Vector3.one * 16384
elseif mode == 5 then
RootPart.CFrame = flingcf + jitter
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e8, 9e7)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
elseif mode == 6 then
local frame = math.floor(t * 120)
local flip = (frame % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
local sweep = Vector3.new(
math.sin(t * 90) * 1.6,
math.cos(t * 70) * 2,
math.sin(t * 110) * 1.6
)
RootPart.CFrame = flingcf * CFrame.Angles(t * 53, t * 71, t * 37) + sweep + jitter
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(flip * 9e8, flip * 9e8, -flip * 9e8)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, -9e8 * flip, 9e8)
elseif mode == 7 then
RootPart.CFrame = flingcf + jitter
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e8, 9e7)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
else
local df = (math.floor(t * 120) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
RootPart.CFrame = flingcf + jitter
RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -16384 * df, 0), Vector3.new(16384, 16384 * df, 16384)
end
end
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid = function(Humanoid, ft, lastspawn)
local nan = (ft and ft.Mode or Util.Fling.Method) == 4
if nan then
if os.clock() - lastspawn > 0.08 then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.new(0/0, 0/0, 0/0))
else
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.zero)
end
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall.Value)
else
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying.Value)
end
end
SaveData.Reanimator = SaveData.Reanimator or {}
Util.Fling.Queue = function(R, target, duration)
if typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Player") then target = target.Character end
if not target or target == Reanimate.Character or target == Player.Character then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
local fpart = Util.Fling.GetPart(target)
if not fpart or not fpart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or R._TempNotFling[target] then return false end
local fp = fpart.Position
if fp.X ~= fp.X or fp.Y ~= fp.Y or fp.Z ~= fp.Z or fp.Magnitude > 1e6 then return false end
local fh = target:IsA("Model") and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if fh and fh.Health <= 0 then return false end
R._TempNotFling[target] = true
task.delay(1, function() R._TempNotFling[target] = nil end)
end
for _, v in R.FlingTargets do
if v.Target == target then return false end
end
table.insert(R.FlingTargets, {Target = target, Duration = duration})
if typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Model") then
local h = Util.Instance("Highlight")
h.Adornee, h.FillColor, h.OutlineColor = target, Color3.new(1, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.FillTransparency, h.OutlineTransparency = 0.5, 0
h.Parent = target
TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(5), {FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1}):Play()
Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
end
return true
end
local LimbReanimator = {}
LimbReanimator.Name = "Limbs"
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode or 0
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity or 0
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode or 2
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10 = not not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay = not not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling = not not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling
LimbReanimator.Mode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode
if LimbReanimator.Mode >= 7 then LimbReanimator.Mode = 2 end
LimbReanimator.Velocity = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity
LimbReanimator.InitMode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode
LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10
LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled = not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay
LimbReanimator.FlingTargets = {}
LimbReanimator._TempNotFling = {}
LimbReanimator.BuiltinModeNames = {"RootPart in very void", "RootPart in void", "Keep RootPart Streamed", "CurrentAngle Style", "RootPart is Torso", "RootPart in sky", "RootPart in very sky"}
LimbReanimator.PluginModes = {}
function LimbReanimator.GetModeNames()
local names = table.clone(LimbReanimator.BuiltinModeNames)
for _,pm in LimbReanimator.PluginModes do
table.insert(names, pm.Name)
end
return names
end
function LimbReanimator.RegisterMode(def, file)
if type(def) ~= "table" then error("plugin must return a table") end
if def.Name == nil and #def > 0 then
for _,d in ipairs(def) do LimbReanimator.RegisterMode(d, file) end
return
end
if type(def.Name) ~= "string" or type(def.GetRootCFrame) ~= "function" then
error("plugin needs Name (string) and GetRootCFrame (function)")
end
table.insert(LimbReanimator.PluginModes, {Name = def.Name, GetRootCFrame = def.GetRootCFrame, File = file})
end
function LimbReanimator.ResolveSavedMode()
local saved = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbModeName
if type(saved) ~= "string" then return end
for i,pm in LimbReanimator.PluginModes do
if pm.Name == saved then
LimbReanimator.Mode = 6 + i
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = LimbReanimator.Mode
return
end
end
end

Util.UINotify("Just a useless option")
pcall(function()
Util.ShowPartHitbox(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart)
end)
end
function LimbReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
if not LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled then return end
if not target then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Player") then target = target.Character end
if not target then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
local fpart = Util.Fling.GetPart(target)
if not fpart or not fpart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
local fp = fpart.Position
if fp.X ~= fp.X or fp.Y ~= fp.Y or fp.Z ~= fp.Z or fp.Magnitude > 1e6 then return false end
if target:IsA("Model") then
local fh = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if fh and fh.Health <= 0 then return false end
end
end
for _,v in LimbReanimator.FlingTargets do
if v.Target == target then
return false
end
end
if target == Reanimate.Character then return false end
if target == Player.Character then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if LimbReanimator._TempNotFling[target] then return end
LimbReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = true
task.delay(1, function()
LimbReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = nil
end)
end
table.insert(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, {
Target = target,
Duration = duration
})
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if target:IsA("Model") then
local h = Util.Instance("Highlight")
h.Adornee = target
h.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.FillTransparency = 0.5
h.OutlineTransparency = 0
h.Parent = target
TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(5), {
FillTransparency = 1,
OutlineTransparency = 1
}):Play()
game.Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
end
end
return true
end
