assert(typeof(mode) == "number")
LimbReanimator.Mode = mode
end
function LimbReanimator.RunCompatCheck(overrides)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local STATUS_COMPATIBLE = "Compatible!"
local STATUS_PARTIAL = "Partially compatible: please check."
local STATUS_INCOMPATIBLE = "Not compatible: *NOT ACCURATE PLEASE CHECK IF SO.*"
local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
Character = nil,
AnimationWatchTime = 1,
VoiceQueryTimeout = 1.5,
MaxListedItems = 5,
Print = false,
}
local DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS = {}
for _, id in {
180435571, 180435792,
180426354,
125750702,
180436148,
180436334,
178130996,
182393478, 129967390, 129967478,
128777973, 128853357, 129423131, 129423030,
182435998, 182491037, 182491065,
182436842, 182491248, 182491277,
182436935, 182491368, 182491423,
} do
DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS[tostring(id)] = true
end
local R6_PARTS = table.freeze({ "Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg" })
local R15_PARTS = table.freeze({
"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "RightLowerArm",
"LeftHand", "RightHand", "LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "RightLowerLeg",
"LeftFoot", "RightFoot",
})
local SEVERITY_WEIGHT = { FAIL = 1, REVIEW = 2, PASS = 3 }
local SEVERITY_TAG = { PASS = "[PASS]  ", FAIL = "[FAIL]  ", REVIEW = "[REVIEW]" }
local function getEnv()
local ok, env = pcall(function()
return typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or getfenv()
end)
return if ok and type(env) == "table" then env else {}
end
local function capability(env, name)
local value = env[name]
return if typeof(value) == "function" then value else nil
end
local function read(instance, property)
local ok, value = pcall(function()
return instance[property]
end)
return if ok then value else nil
end
local function isA(instance, className)
local ok, result = pcall(function()
return instance:IsA(className)
end)
return ok and result == true
end
local function findClass(instance, className, recursive)
local ok, found = pcall(function()
return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(className, recursive)
end)
return if ok then found else nil
end
local function getService(name)
local ok, service = pcall(function()
return game:GetService(name)
end)
return if ok then service else nil
end
local function summarizeList(items, limit)
local count = #items
if count <= limit then
return table.concat(items, ", ")
end
return string.format("%s (+%d more)", table.concat(items, ", ", 1, limit), count - limit)
end
local function customAnimationId(animationId)
local id = string.match(tostring(animationId or ""), "%d+")
if id == nil or DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS[id] then
return nil
end
return id
end
local function formatReport(status, flags, counts, criticalFailures)
local sorted = table.clone(flags)
table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
local wa, wb = SEVERITY_WEIGHT[a.Severity], SEVERITY_WEIGHT[b.Severity]
if wa ~= wb then
return wa < wb
end
if a.Critical ~= b.Critical then
return a.Critical
end
return a.Index < b.Index
end)
local lines = table.create(#sorted * 2 + 4)
lines[#lines + 1] = "=== Limb Reanimation Compatibility Check ==="
lines[#lines + 1] = "Status: " .. status
lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
"Passed: %d | Failed: %d (critical: %d) | Manual review: %d",
counts.PASS,
counts.FAIL,
criticalFailures,
counts.REVIEW
)
for _, flag in sorted do
lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
"%s %s/%s%s - %s",
SEVERITY_TAG[flag.Severity],
flag.Category,
flag.Id,
if flag.Critical then " (critical)" else "",
flag.Message
)
if flag.Detail then
lines[#lines + 1] = "           " .. flag.Detail
end
end
return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
local cfg = table.clone(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
if type(overrides) == "table" then
for key, value in overrides do
cfg[key] = value
end
end
local env = getEnv()
local flags = {}
local counts = { PASS = 0, FAIL = 0, REVIEW = 0 }
local criticalFailures = 0
local function add(category, id, severity, critical, message, detail)
local index = #flags + 1
flags[index] = {
Index = index,
Category = category,
Id = id,
Severity = severity,
Critical = critical,
Message = message,
Detail = detail,
}
counts[severity] += 1
if severity == "FAIL" and critical then
criticalFailures += 1
end
end
local function pass(category, id, message, detail)
add(category, id, "PASS", false, message, detail)
end
local function fail(category, id, critical, message, detail)
add(category, id, "FAIL", critical, message, detail)
end
local function review(category, id, message, detail)
add(category, id, "REVIEW", false, message, detail)
end
local function section(category, fn)
local ok, err = pcall(fn)
if not ok then
review(category, "internal_error", "Check section errored; verify manually", tostring(err))
end
end
local limit = cfg.MaxListedItems
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character, humanoid
local targets = {}
section("Character", function()
if not player then
return
end
local candidate = cfg.Character or player.Character
if typeof(candidate) ~= "Instance" or not candidate:IsA("Model") then
return
end
character = candidate
humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
if child:IsA("BasePart") then
targets[#targets + 1] = { Name = child.Name, Part = child }
end
end
end)
section("Rig", function()
if not character then
review("Rig", "rig_type", "Rig type could not be checked", "No character is loaded. Spawn a character, then run the check again.")
return
end
local r15Found, r6Missing = {}, {}
for _, name in R15_PARTS do
if character:FindFirstChild(name) then
r15Found[#r15Found + 1] = name
end
end
for _, name in R6_PARTS do
local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then
r6Missing[#r6Missing + 1] = name
end
end
local rigType = humanoid and read(humanoid, "RigType")
local isR15 = (rigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) or #r15Found > 0
if isR15 then
fail("Rig", "rig_type", true, "R15 game: limb reanimation needs R6",
if #r15Found > 0 then "R15 parts found: " .. summarizeList(r15Found, limit) else "Humanoid.RigType is R15.")
elseif not humanoid then
fail("Rig", "rig_type", true, "No Humanoid: cannot confirm an R6 rig")
elseif #r6Missing > 0 then
fail("Rig", "rig_type", true, "Character is not a complete R6 rig", "Missing: " .. summarizeList(r6Missing, limit))
else
pass("Rig", "rig_type", "R6 rig detected")
end
end)
section("Animation", function()
local function scan(root, anims, toolAnims, systems)
local n = 0
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
n += 1
if n % 1500 == 0 then
task.wait()
end
if isA(d, "Animation") then
local id = customAnimationId(read(d, "AnimationId"))
if id then
local entry = string.format("%s/%s (%s)", d.Parent and d.Parent.Name or "?", d.Name, id)
if toolAnims and d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") then
toolAnims[#toolAnims + 1] = entry
else
anims[#anims + 1] = entry
end
end
elseif systems and (isA(d, "AnimationController") or isA(d, "KeyframeSequence")
or (isA(d, "Animator") and not (d.Parent and isA(d.Parent, "Humanoid")))) then
systems[#systems + 1] = d.ClassName .. "/" .. d.Name
end
end
end
local charAnims, toolAnims, systems, animScripts = {}, {}, {}, {}
if character then
scan(character, charAnims, toolAnims, systems)
for _, child in character:GetDescendants() do
if isA(child, "LuaSourceContainer") and child.Name ~= "Animate"
and string.find(string.lower(child.Name), "anim", 1, true) then
animScripts[#animScripts + 1] = child.Name
end
end
end
local starter = getService("StarterPlayer")
local starterChar = starter and starter:FindFirstChild("StarterCharacterScripts")
if starterChar then
scan(starterChar, charAnims, nil, nil)
end
local backpack = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if backpack then
scan(backpack, {}, toolAnims, nil)
end
local customTracks, seen = {}, {}
local function inspectTrack(track)
if seen[track] then
return
end
seen[track] = true
local label = tostring(read(track, "Name") or "track")
local anim = read(track, "Animation")
if typeof(anim) ~= "Instance" then
customTracks[#customTracks + 1] = label .. " (no Animation instance)"
return
end
local id = customAnimationId(read(anim, "AnimationId"))
if id then
customTracks[#customTracks + 1] = label .. " (" .. id .. ")"
end
end
if humanoid then
local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
local connection
local okSignal, signal = pcall(function()
return if animator then animator.AnimationPlayed else humanoid.AnimationPlayed
end)
if okSignal and signal then
connection = signal:Connect(inspectTrack)
end
local deadline = os.clock() + cfg.AnimationWatchTime
repeat
local okH, list = pcall(humanoid.GetPlayingAnimationTracks, humanoid)
if okH and type(list) == "table" then
for _, track in list do
inspectTrack(track)
end
end
if animator then
local okA, list2 = pcall(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks, animator)
if okA and type(list2) == "table" then
for _, track in list2 do
inspectTrack(track)
end
end
end
task.wait(0.1)
until os.clock() >= deadline
if connection then
connection:Disconnect()
end
end
local shipped = {}
for _, name in { "ReplicatedStorage", "ReplicatedFirst" } do
local service = getService(name)
if service then
scan(service, shipped, nil, nil)
end
end
local starterScripts = starter and starter:FindFirstChild("StarterPlayerScripts")
if starterScripts then
scan(starterScripts, shipped, nil, nil)
end
local playerScripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
if playerScripts then
scan(playerScripts, shipped, nil, nil)
end
if #charAnims > 0 or #customTracks > 0 then
local parts = {}
if #charAnims > 0 then
parts[#parts + 1] = "On character: " .. summarizeList(charAnims, limit)
end
if #customTracks > 0 then
parts[#parts + 1] = "Playing: " .. summarizeList(customTracks, limit)
end
fail("Animation", "game_animations", true, "Game makes its own animations", table.concat(parts, " | "))
else
pass("Animation", "game_animations", "No game-made animations on the character")
end
if #systems > 0 then
fail("Animation", "animation_systems", true, "Custom animation objects on the character", summarizeList(systems, limit))
end
if #animScripts > 0 then
review("Animation", "animation_scripts", "Animation-related scripts inside the character", summarizeList(animScripts, limit))
end
if #toolAnims > 0 then
review("Animation", "tool_animations", "Held/owned tools carry their own animations", summarizeList(toolAnims, limit))
end
if #shipped > 0 then
review("Animation", "shipped_animations", "Game ships its own animation assets to the client",
summarizeList(shipped, limit) .. ". It probably plays them on your character.")
end
end)
section("Voice", function()
if not player then
return
end
local others = {}
for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
if p ~= player then
others[#others + 1] = p
end
end
local voiceService = getService("VoiceChatService")
local results, pending = {}, 0
local function ask(userId)
pending += 1
task.spawn(function()
local ok, enabled = pcall(function()
return voiceService:IsVoiceEnabledForUserIdAsync(userId)
end)
if ok and type(enabled) == "boolean" then
results[userId] = enabled
end
pending -= 1
end)
end
if voiceService then
ask(player.UserId)
for i, p in others do
if i > 40 then
break
end
ask(p.UserId)
end
local deadline = os.clock() + cfg.VoiceQueryTimeout
while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
task.wait(0.05)
end
end
local strong, weak = {}, {}
for _, p in others do
local hasInput = findClass(p, "AudioDeviceInput", true) ~= nil
local char = p.Character
local hasEmitter = char ~= nil and findClass(char, "AudioEmitter", true) ~= nil
if results[p.UserId] == true or hasInput then
strong[#strong + 1] = p.Name
elseif hasEmitter then
weak[#weak + 1] = p.Name
end
end
local placeVoice = results[player.UserId] == true or #strong > 0
or findClass(player, "AudioDeviceInput", true) ~= nil
if #others == 0 then
pass("Voice", "voice_players", "No other players in the server",
if placeVoice then "Voice chat is available here. Run the check again if players join." else nil)
elseif #strong > 0 then
fail("Voice", "voice_players", true, "Other players are using voice chat",
summarizeList(strong, limit) .. ". Voice chat ruins limb reanimation.")
elseif #weak > 0 then
review("Voice", "voice_players", "Other players may be using voice chat", summarizeList(weak, limit))
elseif placeVoice then
review("Voice", "voice_players", "Voice chat is enabled and other players are present",
"Could not confirm whether any of them are using voice.")
else
pass("Voice", "voice_players", "Other players are present but no voice chat was detected")
end
end)
section("Face", function()
if not character then
review("Face", "dynamic_face", "Dynamic face could not be checked", "No character is loaded.")
return
end
local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
if not head then
review("Face", "dynamic_face", "Dynamic face could not be checked", "Head not found.")
return
end
local signs = {}
if findClass(head, "FaceControls", true) then
signs[#signs + 1] = "FaceControls"
end
if findClass(head, "Bone", true) then
signs[#signs + 1] = "Bones in head"
end
if findClass(head, "WrapTarget", true) then
signs[#signs + 1] = "WrapTarget"
end
if findClass(character, "FaceControls", true) and #signs == 0 then
signs[#signs + 1] = "FaceControls (on character)"
end
if #signs > 0 then
review("Face", "dynamic_face", "Dynamic face detected: incompatible, but it may still work",
table.concat(signs, ", "))
else
pass("Face", "dynamic_face", "No dynamic face")
end
end)
section("Environment", function()
local okActive, active = pcall(function()
return Reanimate.Character ~= nil
end)
if okActive and active then
review("Environment", "reanimation_active", "Reanimation is currently running",
"Results describe the live character; stop reanimating for a clean pre-flight check.")
end
if player then
pass("Environment", "client_context", "Running on the client with a LocalPlayer")
else
fail("Environment", "client_context", true, "LocalPlayer unavailable", "This checker must run on the client.")
return
end
if read(Players, "CharacterAutoLoads") ~= false then
pass("Environment", "auto_spawn", "Game respawns characters normally")
else
review("Environment", "auto_spawn", "Game controls character spawning (CharacterAutoLoads is off)",
"Reset-based init modes may not bring the character back.")
end
if Workspace.StreamingEnabled then
review("Environment", "streaming", "StreamingEnabled is on",
"Parts placed far from the character may stream out and lose replication.")
else
pass("Environment", "streaming", "StreamingEnabled is off")
end
if not character then
review("Environment", "character", "Character-based environment checks skipped", "No character is loaded.")
return
end
if character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
pass("Environment", "in_workspace", "Character is in Workspace")
else
fail("Environment", "in_workspace", true, "Character is not in Workspace", "It may be respawning or destroyed.")
return
end
if humanoid and (humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) then
review("Environment", "alive", "Humanoid is dead", "Wait for the respawn to finish, then run the check again.")
end
if #targets == 0 then
return
end
local anchored, grounded = {}, {}
for _, target in targets do
if read(target.Part, "Anchored") == true then
anchored[#anchored + 1] = target.Name
else
local ok, isGrounded = pcall(target.Part.IsGrounded, target.Part)
if ok and isGrounded == true then
grounded[#grounded + 1] = target.Name
end
end
end
if #anchored > 0 then
fail("Environment", "anchored", true, "Character parts are anchored", summarizeList(anchored, limit))
else
pass("Environment", "anchored", "No anchored character parts")
end
if #grounded > 0 then
fail("Environment", "grounded", true, "Character is welded to anchored geometry", summarizeList(grounded, limit))
else
pass("Environment", "grounded", "Character is not welded to anchored geometry")
end
local getHidden = capability(env, "gethiddenproperty")
if getHidden then
local ok, radius = pcall(getHidden, player, "SimulationRadius")
if ok and type(radius) == "number" and radius <= 0 then
fail("Environment", "simulation_radius", false, "SimulationRadius is zero or negative",
"The client may not simulate nearby parts.")
end
end
end)
local status
if criticalFailures > 0 then
status = STATUS_INCOMPATIBLE
elseif counts.FAIL > 0 or counts.REVIEW > 0 then
status = STATUS_PARTIAL
else
status = STATUS_COMPATIBLE
end
local summary = formatReport(status, flags, counts, criticalFailures)
if cfg.Print then
print(summary)
end
return {
Status = status,
Flags = flags,
Counts = counts,
CriticalFailures = criticalFailures,
Summary = summary,
}
end
function LimbReanimator.FormatCompatRich(report)
local COLORS = { PASS = "#55ff7f", FAIL = "#ff5555", REVIEW = "#ffd24d" }
local WEIGHT = { FAIL = 1, REVIEW = 2, PASS = 3 }
local function esc(s)
return (string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(tostring(s), "&", "&amp;"), "<", "&lt;"), ">", "&gt;"))
end
local statusColor = COLORS.REVIEW
if report.Status == "Compatible!" then
statusColor = COLORS.PASS
elseif report.Status == "Not compatible: *NOT ACCURATE PLEASE CHECK IF SO.*" then
statusColor = COLORS.FAIL
end
local sorted = table.clone(report.Flags)
table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
local wa, wb = WEIGHT[a.Severity], WEIGHT[b.Severity]
if wa ~= wb then return wa < wb end
if a.Critical ~= b.Critical then return a.Critical end
return a.Index < b.Index
end)
local lines = {
string.format('<font color="%s"><b>%s</b></font>', statusColor, esc(report.Status)),
string.format("Passed: %d | Failed: %d (critical: %d) | Review: %d",
report.Counts.PASS, report.Counts.FAIL, report.CriticalFailures, report.Counts.REVIEW),
"",
}
for _, flag in sorted do
lines[#lines + 1] = string.format('<font color="%s">[%s]</font> %s/%s%s - %s',
COLORS[flag.Severity], flag.Severity, esc(flag.Category), esc(flag.Id),
flag.Critical and " (critical)" or "", esc(flag.Message))
if flag.Detail then
lines[#lines + 1] = '    <font color="#aaaaaa">' .. esc(flag.Detail) .. "</font>"
end
end
return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
function LimbReanimator.DumpState()
local out = {}
local function add(fmt, ...)
local ok, line = pcall(string.format, fmt, ...)
out[#out + 1] = ok and line or tostring(fmt)
end
local function safe(f, ...)
local ok, a = pcall(f, ...)
if ok then return a end
return "?"
end
add("== Limb Reanimator state (t=%.1f) ==", os.clock())
add("Mode=%s Velocity=%s Streaming=%s Gravity=%s SeatSit=%s Noclip=%s", tostring(LimbReanimator.Mode), tostring(LimbReanimator.Velocity), tostring(workspace.StreamingEnabled), tostring(workspace.Gravity), tostring(Reanimate.SeatSit), tostring(Reanimate.Noclip))
add("Stopping=%s Starting=%s", tostring(Reanimate.Stopping), tostring(Reanimate.Starting))
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if not rc then
add("FAKE character: none")
else
local hum = rc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local root = rc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
add("FAKE character: inWorkspace=%s parent=%s", tostring(rc:IsDescendantOf(workspace)), tostring(rc.Parent))
if hum then
add("FAKE Humanoid: state=%s Sit=%s PlatformStand=%s WalkSpeed=%s JumpPower=%s UseJumpPower=%s Health=%s EvalStateMachine=%s MoveDirection=%s Floor=%s",
hum:GetState().Name, tostring(hum.Sit), tostring(hum.PlatformStand), tostring(hum.WalkSpeed), tostring(hum.JumpPower), tostring(hum.UseJumpPower), tostring(hum.Health), tostring(hum.EvaluateStateMachine), tostring(hum.MoveDirection), tostring(hum.FloorMaterial))
else
add("FAKE Humanoid: MISSING")
end
if root then
add("FAKE root: Anchored=%s IsGrounded=%s CanCollide=%s Pos=%s Vel=%s AssemblyMass=%s",
tostring(root.Anchored), tostring(safe(root.IsGrounded, root)), tostring(root.CanCollide), tostring(root.Position), tostring(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity), tostring(root.AssemblyMass))
add("FAKE seat weld present=%s", tostring(root:FindFirstChild("hell yeah!! :3") ~= nil))
local joints = safe(root.GetJoints, root)
if type(joints) == "table" then
for _, j in joints do
local p0, p1 = j:IsA("JointInstance") and j.Part0 or (j:IsA("WeldConstraint") and j.Part0) or nil, j:IsA("JointInstance") and j.Part1 or (j:IsA("WeldConstraint") and j.Part1) or nil
local outside = (p0 and not p0:IsDescendantOf(rc) and p0) or (p1 and not p1:IsDescendantOf(rc) and p1) or nil
if outside then
add("  EXTERNAL joint on fake root: %s (%s) -> %s Anchored=%s", j.Name, j.ClassName, outside:GetFullName(), tostring(outside.Anchored))
end
end
end
local connected = safe(root.GetConnectedParts, root, true)
if type(connected) == "table" then
for _, p in connected do
if p.Anchored then add("  ANCHORED part in fake assembly: %s", p:GetFullName()) end
end
end
else
add("FAKE root: MISSING")
end
for _, p in rc:GetDescendants() do
if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Anchored then add("  fake part anchored: %s", p:GetFullName()) end
end
end
local ch = Player.Character
local rh = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if rh then
add("REAL Humanoid: state=%s WalkSpeed=%s JumpPower=%s Health=%s root=%s anchored=%s grounded=%s", rh:GetState().Name, tostring(rh.WalkSpeed), tostring(rh.JumpPower), tostring(rh.Health), tostring(rh.RootPart), tostring(rh.RootPart and rh.RootPart.Anchored), tostring(rh.RootPart and safe(rh.RootPart.IsGrounded, rh.RootPart)))
else
add("REAL character: %s", ch and "no Humanoid" or "none")
end
add("Input: Move=%s Jump=%s focusedTextBox=%s MenuIsOpen=%s", tostring(Reanimate.Control.Move), tostring(Reanimate.Control.Jump), tostring(UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()), tostring(GuiService.MenuIsOpen))
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local fakeHum = rc and rc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
add("Camera: type=%s subjectIsFake=%s subject=%s", tostring(cam and cam.CameraType), tostring(cam and fakeHum ~= nil and cam.CameraSubject == fakeHum), tostring(cam and cam.CameraSubject))
return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
function LimbReanimator.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "as mentioned in the README, this only works for SOME games,\nbecause 'modern' games create the Animator automatically which breaks limb reanimation", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local modenames = LimbReanimator.GetModeNames()
local dmode = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "RootPart Mode", modenames, LimbReanimator.Mode + 1)
local dvel = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "RootPart Velocity", {"No Velocity", "Follow Character", "Fling-like"}, LimbReanimator.Velocity + 1)
local dinit = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "Init Mode", {"Reset Character", "CDSB + Reset", "CDSB + SSE + Kill"}, LimbReanimator.InitMode + 1)
dmode.Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.Mode = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbModeName = modenames[val]
end)
dvel.Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.Velocity = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity = val - 1
end)
dinit.Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.InitMode = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode = val - 1
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Show me how I look!", LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10).Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 = val
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10 = val
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Target Fling Enabled", LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled).Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled = val
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay = not val
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "vvv touch player = they lose ownership vvv", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "fling style is chosen with the 'Fling Method' dropdown on the main page\n(Default / Weak / Nooby's / NaN State / Fling 1 / Fling 2 / Fling 3)", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Compatibility Checker +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local checkBtn, checkBtnText = UI.CreateButton(parent, "Check Limb Compatibility", 16)
local checkResult = UI.CreateText(parent, "Spawn a character, then press the button to check game animations, voice chat players, dynamic faces, the game environment and R6/R15.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
local checking = false
checkBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
if checking then return end
checking = true
checkBtnText.Text = "Checking..."
local ok, result = pcall(function()
return LimbReanimator.FormatCompatRich(LimbReanimator.RunCompatCheck())
end)
pcall(function()
checkResult.Text = ok and result or ("Checker failed: " .. tostring(result):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
checkBtnText.Text = "Check Limb Compatibility"
end)
checking = false
end)
local dumpBtn = UI.CreateButton(parent, "Dump Fake Character State (console + clipboard)", 12)
dumpBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
local ok, report = pcall(LimbReanimator.DumpState)
report = ok and report or ("DumpState failed: " .. tostring(report))
print(report)
pcall(setclipboard, report)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb state dumped to the console (and clipboard if supported).")
end)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(dmode, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
dmode.Value = math.min(LimbReanimator.Mode + 1, #modenames)
dvel.Value = LimbReanimator.Velocity + 1
dinit.Value = LimbReanimator.InitMode + 1
end))
end
function LimbReanimator.Start()
table.clear(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets)
table.clear(LimbReanimator._TempNotFling)
local LimbNames = {"Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}
local rootposition = Vector3.new(
math.random(-65536, 65536),
math.random(-70000, -60000),
math.random(-65536, 65536)
)
local rootposition2 = Vector3.new(
math.random(-2048, 2048),
math.random(-500, -100) + FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
math.random(-2048, 2048)
)
local skyposition = Vector3.new(
math.random(-2048, 2048),
math.random(1000, 2000),
math.random(-2048, 2048)
)
local veryskyposition = Vector3.new(
math.random(-65536, 65536),
math.random(60000, 70000),
math.random(-65536, 65536)
)
local InitCFrame = nil
if Player.Character then
local h = Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h and h.RootPart then
local r = h.RootPart
InitCFrame = r.CFrame
if h:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end
end
local LimbMapping = loadstring(readfile("UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/d_limbmap.lua"))()
local FakeTools = {}
local function CreateFakeTool()
local FakeTool = Instance.new("Tool")
FakeTool.Name = "faketool"
local FakeToolHandle = Instance.new("Part")
FakeToolHandle.Name = "Handle"
FakeToolHandle.Transparency = 1
FakeToolHandle.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 1)
FakeToolHandle.CanCollide = false
FakeToolHandle.Massless = true
FakeToolHandle.Parent = FakeTool
FakeTool.Parent = Reanimate.Character
local RightGrip = Instance.new("Weld")
RightGrip.Name = "RightGrip"
RightGrip.Parent = FakeToolHandle
RightGrip.Part0 = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
RightGrip.Part1 = FakeToolHandle
RightGrip.C0 = RIGHTGRIP_C0
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(FakeTool, FakeTool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Grip"):Connect(function()
RightGrip.C1 = FakeTool.Grip
end))
RightGrip.C1 = FakeTool.Grip
return FakeTool
end
local BaseParts = {}
local UnknownMotor6Ds = {}
local Ragdoll = LimbReanimator.RagdollMode and true or false
local RagdollParts, RagdollByPart, RGWC, RagdollWarned = {}, {}, {}, {}
local RagdollZero = Vector3.zero
local function RagdollFinite(p)
return p.X == p.X and p.Y == p.Y and p.Z == p.Z and math.abs(p.X) < 1e7 and math.abs(p.Y) < 1e7 and math.abs(p.Z) < 1e7
end
local function RagdollFiniteCF(cf)
local x, y, z, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i = cf:GetComponents()
return math.abs(x) < 1e7 and math.abs(y) < 1e7 and math.abs(z) < 1e7 and math.abs(a) <= 1.01 and math.abs(b) <= 1.01 and math.abs(c) <= 1.01 and math.abs(d) <= 1.01 and math.abs(e) <= 1.01 and math.abs(f) <= 1.01 and math.abs(g) <= 1.01 and math.abs(h) <= 1.01 and math.abs(i) <= 1.01
end
local function RagdollJointPose(mv, rel)
local c0, c1 = mv.C0, mv.C1
return c0 * (c0:Inverse() * rel * c1).Rotation * c1:Inverse()
end
local function RagdollRelease(map, restore)
local rg = map.RG
if not rg then return end
map.RG, map.RT = nil, nil
if rg.Conn then
rg.Conn:Disconnect()
rg.Conn = nil
end
for _,o in {rg.AP, rg.AO, rg.DA, rg.BS, rg.A0, rg.A1, rg.PX} do
pcall(o.Destroy, o)
end
if RagdollByPart[rg.P1] == map then
RagdollByPart[rg.P1] = nil
RagdollParts[rg.P1] = nil
end
if restore and rg.Motor then
pcall(function() rg.Motor.Enabled = true end)
end
end
local function GameHasSocket(p0, p1)
local model = p1.Parent
if not model then return false end
for _,d in model:GetDescendants() do
if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and d.Name ~= "RagdollSocket" then
local a, b = d.Attachment0, d.Attachment1
local x, y = a and a.Parent, b and b.Parent
if (x == p0 and y == p1) or (x == p1 and y == p0) then return true end
end
end
return false
end
local RagdollRoot
local function RagdollFolder()
if not (RagdollRoot and RagdollRoot.Parent) then
RagdollRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
RagdollRoot.Name = "RGP" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
RagdollRoot.Parent = workspace
end
return RagdollRoot
end
local function RagdollClean()
if RagdollRoot then
pcall(RagdollRoot.Destroy, RagdollRoot)
RagdollRoot = nil
end
end
local function Ragdollize(map, v, kp0, kp1)
local p0, p1 = kp0 or v.Part0, kp1 or v.Part1
if not (p0 and p1) then return end
local hum = p1.Parent and p1.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
hum.RequiresNeck = false
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
end
local rg = map.RG
if rg and rg.P1 == p1 and rg.PX and rg.PX.Parent and rg.AP.Parent and rg.AO.Parent then
rg.Motor, rg.P0 = v, p0
else
if rg then RagdollRelease(map) end
rg = {P0 = p0, P1 = p1, Motor = v, Fresh = true}
local px = Instance.new("Part")
px.Name = "RagdollProxy"
px.Size = p1.Size
px.Transparency = 1
px.CanCollide, px.CanTouch, px.CanQuery = false, false, false
px.CFrame = p1.CFrame
px.Parent = RagdollFolder()
local da = Instance.new("Attachment")
da.Name = "RagdollDrive"
da.Parent = px
local stiff = LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness or 100
local ap = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
ap.Name = "RagdollAP"
ap.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
ap.Attachment0 = da
ap.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
ap.RigidityEnabled = false
ap.MaxForce, ap.MaxVelocity = math.huge, math.huge
ap.Responsiveness = stiff
ap.Position = px.Position
ap.Parent = px
local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
ao.Name = "RagdollAO"
ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
ao.Attachment0 = da
ao.RigidityEnabled = false
ao.MaxTorque, ao.MaxAngularVelocity = math.huge, math.huge
ao.Responsiveness = stiff
ao.CFrame = px.CFrame
ao.Parent = px
rg.PX, rg.DA, rg.AP, rg.AO = px, da, ap, ao
map.RG = rg
end
RagdollByPart[p1] = map
end
local function RagdollWorld(part)
local c = RGWC[part]
if c then return c end
local m = RagdollByPart[part]
if m and m.RT and m.RG then
c = RagdollWorld(m.RG.P0) * m.RT
else
c = part.CFrame
end
RGWC[part] = c
return c
end
local function RagdollSample(RootPart)
local rc = RootPart.CFrame
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local rg = map.RG
if rg then
rg.Act = nil
local px = rg.PX
if px and px.Parent and map.Reference and not rg.Fresh then
local pw
if rg.P0 == RootPart then
pw = rc
else
local pm = RagdollByPart[rg.P0]
local ppx = pm and pm.RG and pm.RG.PX
if ppx and ppx.Parent then pw = ppx.CFrame end
end
if pw then
local rel = pw:ToObjectSpace(px.CFrame)
if RagdollFiniteCF(rel) then
local mv = rg.Motor
if rg.P0 ~= RootPart and mv and mv.Parent then rel = RagdollJointPose(mv, rel) end
if RagdollFiniteCF(rel) then rg.Act = rel end
end
end
end
end
end
end
local function RagdollDrive(RootPart)
table.clear(RGWC)
RGWC[RootPart] = RootPart.CFrame
local now = os.clock()
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local rg = map.RG
if rg and map.Reference then
local p1 = rg.P1
if not (rg.PX.Parent and rg.AP.Parent and rg.AO.Parent) and p1.Parent and rg.Motor and now - (rg.Rebuilt or 0) > 0.25 then
local rp0, motor = rg.P0, rg.Motor
RagdollRelease(map)
pcall(Ragdollize, map, motor, rp0, p1)
rg = map.RG
if rg then rg.Rebuilt = now end
end
if rg and rg.PX.Parent and rg.AP.Parent and rg.AO.Parent then
local px = rg.PX
local w = RagdollWorld(p1)
local pos = w.Position
if RagdollFiniteCF(w) then
if rg.Fresh then
rg.Fresh = nil
px.CFrame = w
px.AssemblyLinearVelocity = RagdollZero
px.AssemblyAngularVelocity = RagdollZero
end
if map.RPart0 ~= "ROOT" and not (rg.BS and rg.BS.Parent and rg.A0.Parent) then
local pm = RagdollByPart[rg.P0]
local ppx = pm and pm.RG and pm.RG.PX
local mv = rg.Motor
if ppx and ppx.Parent and mv and mv.Parent then
for _,o in {rg.A0, rg.A1, rg.BS} do
pcall(o.Destroy, o)
end
local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Name, a1.Name = "RagdollA0", "RagdollA1"
a0.CFrame, a1.CFrame = mv.C0, mv.C1
a0.Parent, a1.Parent = ppx, px
local bs = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
bs.Name = "RagdollSocket"
bs.LimitsEnabled = false
bs.TwistLimitsEnabled = false
bs.Attachment0, bs.Attachment1 = a0, a1
bs.Parent = px
rg.A0, rg.A1, rg.BS = a0, a1, bs
end
end
local pcf = px.CFrame
if not RagdollFiniteCF(pcf) or (pcf.Position - pos).Magnitude > 8 then
px.CFrame = w
px.AssemblyLinearVelocity = RagdollZero
px.AssemblyAngularVelocity = RagdollZero
end
rg.AP.Position = pos
rg.AO.CFrame = w
end
end
end
end
end
local CharOnDesc = function(v)
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
if not table.find(BaseParts, v) then
table.insert(BaseParts, v)
v.CanCollide = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
end)
end
elseif v:IsA("Motor6D") then
repeat task.wait() until (not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or (v.Part0 and v.Part1)
if not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
if p0 and p1 then
p0, p1 = p0.Name, p1.Name
for _,map in LimbMapping do
if map.Part0 == p0 and map.Part1 == p1 then
map.Reference = v
if Ragdoll then pcall(Ragdollize, map, v) end
return
end
end
end
table.insert(UnknownMotor6Ds, v)
elseif v:IsA("Animator") then
task.defer(v.Destroy, v)
elseif v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
v.Enabled = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
if v.Enabled then v.Enabled = false end
end)
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Disabled"):Connect(function()
if not v.Disabled then v.Disabled = true end
end)
elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
if not FakeTools[v] then
FakeTools[v] = true
local fake = CreateFakeTool()
fake.Grip = v.Grip
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h ~= nil then
fake.Handle.Size = h.Size
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
if v.Parent == Player.Character then
fake.Grip = v.Grip
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h ~= nil then
fake.Handle.Size = h.Size
end
else
fake:Destroy()
FakeTools[v] = nil
end
end))
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, v.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v.ClassName == "StringValue" and v.Name == "toolanim" then
local w = Instance.new("StringValue")
w.Name = "toolanim"
w.Value = v.Value
w.Parent = fake
Debris:AddItem(v, 1)
Debris:AddItem(w, 1)
end
end))
fake.Handle.Touched:Connect(function(t)
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and t and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
h.CanTouch = true
pcall(firetouchinterest, h, t, 0)
end
end)
fake.Handle.TouchEnded:Connect(function(t)
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and t and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
h.CanTouch = true
pcall(firetouchinterest, h, t, 1)
end
end)
end
end
end
local lastspawn = 0
local OnLimbCharacter = function(character)
local camcfr = Camera.CFrame
RunService.PreRender:Once(function()
RunService.PreAnimation:Wait()
Camera.CFrame = camcfr
end)
lastspawn = os.clock()
table.clear(BaseParts)
table.clear(UnknownMotor6Ds)
table.clear(RagdollParts)
table.clear(RagdollByPart)
for _,map in LimbMapping do
map.Reference = nil
if map.RG then RagdollRelease(map) end
map.RG, map.RT = nil, nil
end
character.DescendantAdded:Connect(CharOnDesc)
for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
task.spawn(CharOnDesc, v)
end
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
local stupid = humanoid:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator")
if stupid then
stupid:Destroy()
end
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
while not stupid do
character.ChildAdded:Wait()
stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
end
stupid:Destroy()
end
end
local CharConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnLimbCharacter)
local gotRespawn = false
local respawnConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() gotRespawn = true end)
local respawnTimeout = 15
pcall(function() respawnTimeout = math.clamp((tonumber(Players.RespawnTime) or 5) + 10, 15, 40) end)
local respawnWaitStart = os.clock()
while not gotRespawn and os.clock() - respawnWaitStart < respawnTimeout do
task.wait()
end
respawnConn:Disconnect()
if not gotRespawn then
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator: the game did not respawn your character after the reset (waited " .. math.floor(os.clock() - respawnWaitStart) .. "s). Continuing in placeholder mode so you can still move and jump.")
local current = Player.Character
if current then
task.spawn(OnLimbCharacter, current)
end
end
Reanimate.CreateCharacter(InitCFrame)
local lastrep = 0
local LOPT = {
info = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
lk = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
limbs = {Head = true, Torso = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true},
vz = Vector3.zero,
refDirty = true,
refAt = 0,
}
local function lookup(parent, key, isClass)
local c = LOPT.lk[parent]
if not c then c = {} LOPT.lk[parent] = c end
local o = c[key]
if not o or o.Parent ~= parent then
if isClass then o = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(key) else o = parent:FindFirstChild(key) end
c[key] = o
end
return o
end
local function UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, flingtarget, flingcf)
if not RootPart:IsGrounded() then
if flingtarget then
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(RootPart, flingtarget, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(flingtarget.Target) or nil)
LOPT.refDirty = true
else
RootPart.CFrame = rootcf + Vector3.new(0, 0, math.random(0, 1) * 0.005)
RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = rootvel, Vector3.zero
local _rn = os.clock()
if LOPT.refDirty or _rn - LOPT.refAt > 0.5 then
LOPT.refDirty, LOPT.refAt = false, _rn
pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
end
end
end
local dorep = true
if LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 then
dorep = false
local b = os.clock()
local a = b - lastrep
if a >= 1 / 10 then
dorep = true
a %= 1 / 10
lastrep = b - a
end
end
for _,v in UnknownMotor6Ds do
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
end
if Ragdoll then RagdollSample(RootPart) end
local LimbPose, idcf = Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame, CFrame.identity
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local v = map.Reference
if v then
if map.RG then
if flingtarget then
map.RT = v.C0 * v.C1:Inverse()
pcall(Util.SetMotor6DTransform, v, CFrame.identity)
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
if dorep or not mcf then
local cf = LimbPose(map, v, ReanimCharacter, RootPart)
if cf ~= idcf then
map.CFrame = cf
mcf = cf
end
end
map.RT = mcf
local rg = map.RG
if dorep or not rg.Out then rg.Out = rg.Act or mcf end
if rg.Out and not RagdollFiniteCF(rg.Out) then rg.Out = mcf end
if rg.Out then pcall(Util.SetMotor6DOffset, v, rg.Out) end
end
elseif flingtarget then
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
if dorep or not mcf then
mcf = LimbPose(map, v, ReanimCharacter, RootPart)
map.CFrame = mcf
end
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, mcf)
end
end
end
if Ragdoll then RagdollDrive(RootPart) end
end
Reanimate.Starting = false
local rebuildWindowStart, rebuildCount, lastRebuild, rebuildGaveUp = 0, 0, 0, false
local function FrameStep()
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
do
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if rc and not rc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
local now = os.clock()
if now - rebuildWindowStart > 20 then
rebuildWindowStart, rebuildCount = now, 0
end
if rebuildCount < 3 and now - lastRebuild > 0.5 then
rebuildCount += 1
lastRebuild = now
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator: the fake character was removed from the workspace by something else, rebuilding it (" .. rebuildCount .. "/3).")
Reanimate.CreateCharacter()
elseif not rebuildGaveUp and rebuildCount >= 3 then
rebuildGaveUp = true
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator: the game keeps removing the fake character; not rebuilding it any more.")
end
end
end
local ReanimOkay = false
local Character, Humanoid, RootPart = Player.Character, nil, nil
if Character then
Humanoid = lookup(Character, "Humanoid", true)
if Humanoid then
if Humanoid.AutoRotate then Humanoid.AutoRotate = false end
if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < 1 then
Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end
if Humanoid.JumpPower < 1 then
Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
end
RootPart = Humanoid.RootPart
if RootPart and Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
ReanimOkay = LimbReanimator.FlingTargets[1] == nil
end
end
end
local rootcf = CFrame.new(LimbReanimator.Mode == 5 and skyposition or LimbReanimator.Mode == 6 and veryskyposition or rootposition)
local rootvel = Vector3.zero
local ltm = Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if ReanimCharacter then
local RCHumanoid = lookup(ReanimCharacter, "Humanoid", true)
local RCRootPart = lookup(ReanimCharacter, "HumanoidRootPart")
local RCTorso = lookup(ReanimCharacter, "Torso")
if Camera and Camera.CameraSubject ~= RCHumanoid then
Camera.CameraSubject = RCHumanoid
end
local nowc, fpb, vz, infoT = os.clock(), Reanimate.FirstPersonBody and true or false, LOPT.vz, LOPT.info
for _,v in BaseParts do
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
if not RagdollParts[v] then
if v.Velocity ~= vz then v.Velocity = vz end
if v.RotVelocity ~= vz then v.RotVelocity = vz end
end
local info = infoT[v]
if not info or nowc - info.at > 1 or info.fpb ~= fpb then
info = {at = nowc, fpb = fpb, tool = v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") ~= nil, head = false}
if fpb and v.Name ~= "Head" then
local lol = v:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
info.head = (lol and lol:IsA("Weld") and lol.Part1 and lol.Part1.Name == "Head") and true or false
end
infoT[v] = info
end
if not info.tool then
local lltm = ltm
if fpb and v.Name ~= "Head" and not info.head then
lltm = 0
end
if v.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= lltm then v.LocalTransparencyModifier = lltm end
end
end
local wantT = ReanimOkay and 1 or Reanimate.PlaceholderTransparency
local limbSet = LOPT.limbs
for _,v in ReanimCharacter:GetChildren() do
if limbSet[v.Name] and v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Transparency ~= wantT then
v.Transparency = wantT
end
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local t = os.clock()
if RCRootPart and RCTorso then
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 1 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(rootposition2)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 5 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(skyposition)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 6 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(veryskyposition)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 2 or workspace.StreamingEnabled then
rootcf = CFrame.new(RCRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 3 then
rootcf = RCRootPart.CFrame
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 4 then
rootcf = RCTorso.CFrame
end
if LimbReanimator.Velocity == 1 then
rootvel = RCRootPart.Velocity
elseif LimbReanimator.Velocity == 2 then
rootvel = Vector3.new(0, 16384, 0)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode >= 7 then
local pm = LimbReanimator.PluginModes[LimbReanimator.Mode - 6]
local usedplugin = false
if pm and not pm.Failed then
local ok, pcf, pvel = pcall(pm.GetRootCFrame, {
RootPart = RCRootPart,
Torso = RCTorso,
Character = ReanimCharacter,
Time = t,
FallenPartsDestroyHeight = FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
Streaming = workspace.StreamingEnabled,
})
if ok and typeof(pcf) == "CFrame" then
rootcf = pcf
if typeof(pvel) == "Vector3" then rootvel = pvel end
usedplugin = true
else
pm.Failed = true
Util.Notify("Plugin '" .. pm.Name .. "' failed and was disabled: " .. tostring(ok and "GetRootCFrame must return a CFrame" or pcf))
end
end
if not usedplugin then
rootcf = CFrame.new(RCRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
end
end
end
do
local q = LimbReanimator.FlingTargets
for qi = #q, 2, -1 do
local qt = q[qi] and q[qi].Target
if typeof(qt) == "Instance" then
local qp = Util.Fling.GetPart(qt)
local gone = (not qp) or (not qp:IsDescendantOf(workspace))
if not gone then
local pp = qp.Position
gone = pp.X ~= pp.X or pp.Y ~= pp.Y or pp.Z ~= pp.Z
end
if gone then table.remove(q, qi) end
end
end
end
local flingtarget, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and 0.5 or 2)
if flingtarget then
local fpos, frv = flingcf.Position, flingcf.RightVector
if fpos.X ~= fpos.X or fpos.Y ~= fpos.Y or fpos.Z ~= fpos.Z or fpos.Magnitude > 1e7 or frv.X ~= frv.X then
table.remove(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, 1)
flingtarget, flingcf = nil, CFrame.identity
end
end
UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, flingtarget, flingcf)
if flingtarget then
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid(Humanoid, flingtarget, lastspawn)
else
if Util.Fling.Method == 4 then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.zero)
end
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying.Value)
end
end
RunService.PreRender:Wait()
if Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then
Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter()
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, nil, CFrame.identity)
end
end
end
local stepFails, lastStepErr, lastStepErrTime = 0, nil, 0
while not Reanimate.Stopping do
local stepOk, stepErr = pcall(FrameStep)
if stepOk then
stepFails = 0
else
stepFails += 1
stepErr = tostring(stepErr)
if stepErr ~= lastStepErr or os.clock() - lastStepErrTime > 10 then
lastStepErr, lastStepErrTime = stepErr, os.clock()
warn("[Limb Reanimator] frame step failed (x" .. stepFails .. "): " .. stepErr)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator frame error (see console): " .. stepErr)
end
end
end
table.clear(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets)
table.clear(LimbReanimator._TempNotFling)
CharConn:Disconnect()
if Ragdoll then
for _,map in LimbMapping do RagdollRelease(map) end
RagdollClean()
end
if Player.Character then
local h = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
if h then
h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end
Reanimate.Stopping = false
Reanimate.DestroyCharacter()
end
do
SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness = SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness or 100
LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness = SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness
local RagdollReanimator = setmetatable({Name = "Ragdoll"}, {__index = LimbReanimator})
Reanimate.RagdollReanimator = RagdollReanimator
function RagdollReanimator.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "Ragdoll Reanimation: your real limbs are detached into BallSocket ragdoll limbs and physically driven to the reanimated pose.\nUses the Limb Reanimator settings below.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
LimbReanimator.Config(parent)
local sl = UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Ragdoll Stiffness", LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness, 10, 200, 1)
sl.Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = math.clamp(val, 10, 200)
LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness = val
SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness = val
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ how hard the ragdoll limbs are pulled to the pose (applies on the next Reanimate)", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
end
function RagdollReanimator.Start()
LimbReanimator.RagdollMode = true
local ok, err = pcall(LimbReanimator.Start)
LimbReanimator.RagdollMode = nil
if not ok then
warn("[Ragdoll Reanimator] failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Util.Notify, "Ragdoll Reanimator failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Reanimate.DestroyCharacter)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
end
end
end
local HatReanimator = {}

HatReanimator.FlingTargets = {}
HatReanimator._TempNotFling = {}
HatReanimator.BuiltinFlingNames = {"Disabled (RP)", "Classic Respawn", "Biggest Hat", "All Hats", "Use Tool Handle"}
HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods = {}
function HatReanimator.GetFlingNames()
local names = table.clone(HatReanimator.BuiltinFlingNames)
for _,fm in HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods do
table.insert(names, fm.Name)
end
return names
end
function HatReanimator.RegisterFlingMethod(def, file)
if type(def) ~= "table" then error("fling method must return a table") end
if def.Name == nil and #def > 0 then
for _,d in ipairs(def) do HatReanimator.RegisterFlingMethod(d, file) end
return
end
if type(def.Name) ~= "string" or type(def.Run) ~= "function" then
error("fling method needs Name (string) and Run (function)")
end
table.insert(HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods, {Name = def.Name, Run = def.Run, File = file})
end
function HatReanimator.ResolveSavedFling()
local saved = SaveData.Reanimator.HatsFlingMethodName
if type(saved) ~= "string" then return end
for i,fm in HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods do
if fm.Name == saved then
HatReanimator.FlingMethod = 3 + i
SaveData.Reanimator.HatsFlingMethod = HatReanimator.FlingMethod
return
end
end
end
function HatReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
if HatReanimator.FlingMethod == -1 then return end
if not target then return false end
for _,v in HatReanimator.FlingTargets do
if v.Target == target then
return false
end
end
if target == Reanimate.Character then return false end
if target == Player.Character then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] then return end
HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = true
task.delay(1, function()
HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = nil
end)
end
table.insert(HatReanimator.FlingTargets, {
Target = target,
Duration = duration
})
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if target:IsA("Model") then
local h = Util.Instance("Highlight")
h.Adornee = target
h.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.FillTransparency = 0.5
h.OutlineTransparency = 0
h.Parent = target
TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(5), {
FillTransparency = 1,
OutlineTransparency = 1
}):Play()
game.Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
end
end
return true
end

HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn = 0
function HatReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason)
local char = Player.Character
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn = os.clock()
HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = reason or "Force respawn!"
if not hum then return false end
pcall(function()
hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
hum.Health = 0
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end)
pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints)
pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
return true
end

local HatMeshDatabase, HatNameDatabase, HatKnownAccessoriesDatabase = loadstring(readfile("UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/d_hatsmap.lua"))()
local function GetTools()
local tools = {}
local character, backpack = Player.Character, Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if character then
for _,v in character:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("Tool") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
if backpack then
for _,v in backpack:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("Tool") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
return tools
end
local function GetHatMeshAndTexture(hat)
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle then
local mesh, tex = nil, nil
if handle:IsA("MeshPart") then
return handle.MeshId, handle.TextureID
elseif handle:IsA("BasePart") then
local sm = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
if sm then
return sm.MeshId, sm.TextureId
end
end
end
return nil, nil
end
local function AssetIdMatch(a, b)
a = a or ""
b = b or ""
if #b == 0 then return true end
if #a == 0 then return false end
if a:sub(1, 11) == "rbxasset://" then
a = a:match("rbxasset://(.+)")
elseif a:sub(1, 13) == "rbxassetid://" then
a = a:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)")
elseif a:sub(1, 4) == "http" then
a = a:match("id=(%d+)")
end
return a == b
end
local function ClassifyHat(hat)
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
local mesh, tex = GetHatMeshAndTexture(hat)
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and mesh and tex then
local mapdata = {
Name = hat.Name,
MeshId = mesh, TextureId = tex,
C0 = CFrame.identity,
C1 = CFrame.identity,
Scale = 1,
Limb = "HumanoidRootPart",
Group = "RIG",
Attachments = nil,
}
local originalsize = handle:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize")
if originalsize and originalsize:IsA("Vector3Value") then
originalsize = originalsize.Value
local m1 = math.max(handle.Size.X, handle.Size.Y, handle.Size.Z)
local m2 = math.max(originalsize.X, originalsize.Y, originalsize.Z)
if m2 > 0 then
mapdata.Scale = m1 / m2
end
else
originalsize = handle.Size
end
for _,data in HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride do
if data.MeshId and data.TextureId then
if AssetIdMatch(mesh, data.MeshId) and AssetIdMatch(tex, data.TextureId) then
return mapdata, "Unknown", 4
end
end
end
for _,data in HatKnownAccessoriesDatabase do
if AssetIdMatch(mesh, data.MeshId) and AssetIdMatch(tex, data.TextureId) then
mapdata.C0 = data.C0
mapdata.C1 = data.C1
mapdata.Limb = data.Limb
mapdata.Group = data.Group
mapdata.Attachments = data.Attachments
return mapdata, "Accessories", 0
end
end
for _,data in HatNameDatabase do
if hat.Name:lower() == data.Match:lower() then
mapdata.C1 = data.Offset
mapdata.Attachments = data.Attachments
return mapdata, data.For, 1
end
end
for _,data in HatMeshDatabase do
if AssetIdMatch(mesh, data.MeshId) and AssetIdMatch(tex, data.TextureId) then
mapdata.C1 = data.Offset
mapdata.Attachments = data.Attachments
return mapdata, data.For, 2
end
end
local assumption = originalsize
local m = math.min(assumption.X, assumption.Y, assumption.Z)
if m >= 0.25 then
assumption = Vector3.new(
math.round(assumption.X / m),
math.round(assumption.Y / m),
math.round(assumption.Z / m)
)
else
assumption = Vector3.zero
end
if assumption == Vector3.new(2, 2, 1) then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.identity
return mapdata, "Torso", 3
elseif assumption == Vector3.new(2, 1, 2) then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.Angles(1.57, 0, 0)
return mapdata, "Torso", 3
elseif assumption == Vector3.new(1, 2, 2) then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.Angles(0, 1.57, 0)
return mapdata, "Torso", 3
elseif assumption == Vector3.new(1, 2, 1) then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.identity
return mapdata, "ArmLeg", 3
elseif assumption == Vector3.new(1, 1, 2) then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.Angles(1.57, 0, 0)
return mapdata, "ArmLeg", 3
elseif assumption == Vector3.new(2, 1, 1) then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.57)
return mapdata, "ArmLeg", 3
elseif handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment") and assumption == Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) and m < 1.2 then
mapdata.C1 = CFrame.Angles(1.57, 0, 0)
return mapdata, "Block", 3
end
return mapdata, "Unknown", 4
end
return nil
end

local function ResetHatRefs()
table.clear(Hat2HatRefs)
for _,ref in HatRefs do
ref.Hat = nil
ref.Han = nil
end
end
local function CreatePlaceholder(hat)
local h = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then
local p = h:Clone()
p:BreakJoints()
p.Anchored = true
p.CanCollide = false
p.CanTouch = false
p.CanQuery = false
p.Transparency = 0.75
p.Name = "(C) Nooby's Uh Modded Reanimation " .. UhhhhhhVersion .. " :: HAT PLACEHOLDER"
for _,v in p:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
v:Destroy()
continue
end
local exist = pcall(function()
return v.LocalTransparencyModifier
end)
if exist then
p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
v.LocalTransparencyModifier = p.Transparency
end)
end
end
if h:GetAttribute("AttachHead") then
p:SetAttribute("AttachHead", true)
end
p.Parent = workspace
return p
end
end
local function RefHatToHatRefs(hat)
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
local mesh, tex = GetHatMeshAndTexture(hat)
if handle and mesh and tex then
for _,ref in HatRefs do
if not ref.Hat then
if ref.Name == hat.Name and ref.MeshId == mesh and ref.TextureId == tex then
ref.Hat = hat
ref.Han = handle
if ref.Map.Limb == "Head" then
handle:SetAttribute("AttachHead", true)
end
Hat2HatRefs[hat] = ref
if not ref.PH then
ref.PH = CreatePlaceholder(hat)
end
return
end
end
end

local HatMap = {}
local HatMapCopy = {}
local function RefreshHatMap(Character)
local summary = ""
summary ..= "[Hat Map Summary]\n"
summary ..= "Total hats found: " .. #CharHats .. "\n"
local hatfors = {
Head = {},
Torso = {},
LeftArm = {},
RightArm = {},
LeftLeg = {},
RightLeg = {},
ArmLeg = {},
Block = {},
Accessories = {},
Unknown = {},
}
for _,hat in CharHats do
local mapdata, usefor, level = ClassifyHat(hat)
if mapdata and hatfors[usefor] then
table.insert(hatfors[usefor], {hat, mapdata, level})
end
end
summary ..= "Classified "
for name,arr in hatfors do
table.sort(arr, function(a, b)
return a[3] < b[3]
end)
summary ..= #arr .. " " .. name .. ", "
end
summary = summary:sub(1, -3) .. ".\n"
summary ..= "Rig Building:\n"
local hatrig = {
Head = nil,
Torso = nil,
LeftArm = nil,
RightArm = nil,
LeftLeg = nil,
RightLeg = nil,
}
if #hatfors.Head > 0 then
summary ..= "  1 Head as Head (perfect match)\n"
hatrig.Head = table.remove(hatfors.Head, 1)
end
if #hatfors.Torso > 0 then
summary ..= "  1 Torso as Torso (perfect match)\n"
hatrig.Torso = table.remove(hatfors.Torso, 1)
end
if #hatfors.LeftArm > 0 then
summary ..= "  1 LeftArm as LeftArm (perfect match)\n"
hatrig.LeftArm = table.remove(hatfors.LeftArm, 1)
end
if #hatfors.RightArm > 0 then
summary ..= "  1 RightArm as RightArm (perfect match)\n"
hatrig.RightArm = table.remove(hatfors.RightArm, 1)
end
if #hatfors.LeftLeg > 0 then
summary ..= "  1 LeftLeg as LeftLeg (perfect match)\n"
hatrig.LeftLeg = table.remove(hatfors.LeftLeg, 1)
end
if #hatfors.RightLeg > 0 then
summary ..= "  1 RightLeg as RightLeg (perfect match)\n"
hatrig.RightLeg = table.remove(hatfors.RightLeg, 1)
end
local limbstobuild = {}
if not hatrig.LeftArm then
if #hatfors.RightArm > 0 then
hatrig.LeftArm = table.remove(hatfors.RightArm, 1)
summary ..= "  1 RightArm as LeftArm (hat reused)\n"
elseif #hatfors.LeftLeg > 0 then
hatrig.LeftArm = table.remove(hatfors.LeftLeg, 1)
summary ..= "  1 LeftLeg as LeftArm (hat reused)\n"
elseif #hatfors.RightLeg > 0 then
hatrig.LeftArm = table.remove(hatfors.RightLeg, 1)
summary ..= "  1 RightLeg as LeftArm (hat reused)\n"

local function addhat(limb, data)
if data and data[2] then
data = data[2]
if limb then
data.Limb = limb
end
local index = #HatMap
data.Index = index
table.insert(HatMap, data)
table.insert(HatRefs, {
Name = data.Name,
MeshId = data.MeshId, TextureId = data.TextureId,
Map = data,
Index = index,
PH = nil,
Hat = nil,
})
end
end
addhat("Head", hatrig.Head)
addhat("Torso", hatrig.Torso)
addhat("Left Arm", hatrig.LeftArm)
addhat("Right Arm", hatrig.RightArm)
addhat("Left Leg", hatrig.LeftLeg)
addhat("Right Leg", hatrig.RightLeg)
if #limbstobuild > 0 and #hatfors.Block > 0 then
local blocks = {}
local i = 0
while i < #limbstobuild * 2 and #hatfors.Block > 0 do
local name = limbstobuild[(i % #limbstobuild) + 1]
if not blocks[name] then
blocks[name] = {}
end
table.insert(blocks[name], table.remove(hatfors.Block, 1))
i += 1
end
for name,v in blocks do
if #v == 2 then
local a, b = v[1], v[2]
a[2].C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
b[2].C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
addhat(name, a)
addhat(name, b)
summary ..= "  2 Block as " .. name:gsub(" ", "") .. " (block build)\n"
elseif #v == 1 then
addhat(name, v[1])
summary ..= "  1 Block as " .. name:gsub(" ", "") .. " (block build)\n"
end
end
end
summary ..= "  " .. #hatfors.Accessories .. " known accessories\n"
for _,acc in hatfors.Accessories do
addhat(nil, acc)
end
table.clear(hatfors.Accessories)
local unused = 0
local function AttmentGet(name)
for _,data in ipairs(HatMap) do
if data.Attachments and data.Attachments[name] then
return {data.Limb, data.C0 * data.C1:Inverse() * data.Attachments[name]}
end
end
return Attachments[name]
end
for _,v in hatfors do
for _,w in v do
local hat = w[1]
local map = w[2]
local limb, c0 = unpack(AttmentGet("HatAttachment"))
local c1 = hat.AttachmentPoint
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle then
for _,x in handle:GetChildren() do
if x:IsA("Attachment") then
local att = AttmentGet(x.Name)
if att then
limb, c0, c1 = att[1], att[2], x.CFrame
break
end
end
end
end
map.C0 = c0
map.C1 = c1
map.Limb = limb
addhat(limb, w)
unused += 1
end
end
summary ..= "...which leaves " .. unused .. " unused."

local function GetHatMappedOverride(hatmapped)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if not ReanimCharacter then return end
local scale = ReanimCharacter:GetScale()
local hatscale = hatmapped.Scale
for _,data in HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride do
if not data.Disable then
if data.Group and hatmapped.Group == data.Group then
if data.Limb then
return {
C0 = data.C0 or data.Offset or CFrame.identity,
C1 = hatmapped.C1 * (data.C1 or CFrame.identity),
Limb = data.Limb, RepRootPart = data.RepRootPart,
Scale = hatscale,
}
else
return {
C0 = data.C0 or data.CFrame or CFrame.identity,
C1 = hatmapped.C1 * (data.C1 or CFrame.identity),
RepRootPart = data.RepRootPart,
Scale = hatscale,
}
end
end
if data.MeshId or data.TextureId or data.Name then
local oke = true
if data.MeshId then
oke = oke and AssetIdMatch(hatmapped.MeshId, data.MeshId)
end
if data.TextureId then
oke = oke and AssetIdMatch(hatmapped.TextureId, data.TextureId)
end
if data.Name then
oke = oke and hatmapped.Name == data.Name
end
if oke then
return {
C0 = data.C0, C1 = data.C1,
Offset = data.Offset or data.CFrame,
Limb = data.Limb, RepRootPart = data.RepRootPart,
Scale = hatscale,
}
end
end
if data.Index and hatmapped.Index == data.Index then
return {
C0 = data.C0 or data.CFrame or CFrame.identity,
C1 = hatmapped.C1 * (data.C1 or CFrame.identity),
RepRootPart = data.RepRootPart,
Scale = hatscale,
}
end
end
end
return hatmapped
end
local function GetHatMappedMeshAndTexture(mesh, tex, name)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if not ReanimCharacter then return end
local hatmapped = nil
for _,data in ipairs(HatMap) do
if (name and data.Name == name or not name) and data.MeshId == mesh and data.TextureId == tex then
hatmapped = data
break
end
end
if not hatmapped then return end
return GetHatMappedOverride(hatmapped)
end
local function GetHatMappedCFrame(hatmapped)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if not ReanimCharacter then return end
local scale = ReanimCharacter:GetScale()
if hatmapped then
local hatscale = hatmapped.Scale
if hatmapped.Limb then
local limb = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(hatmapped.Limb)
if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
if hatmapped.C0 and hatmapped.C1 then
return limb.CFrame * Util.ApplyAxis(Util.ScaleCFrame(hatmapped.C0, scale)) * Util.ScaleCFrame(hatmapped.C1, hatscale):Inverse(), limb.Velocity
end
if hatmapped.Offset then
return limb.CFrame * hatmapped.Offset, limb.Velocity
end
end
else
if hatmapped.C0 and hatmapped.C1 then
return hatmapped.C0 * Util.ScaleCFrame(hatmapped.C1, hatscale):Inverse(), Vector3.zero
end
end
end
return
end
local function GetHatCFrameMeshAndTexture(mesh, tex, name)
return GetHatMappedCFrame(GetHatMappedMeshAndTexture(mesh, tex, name))
end
local function GetHatMapped(hat)
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
local mesh, tex = GetHatMeshAndTexture(hat)
return GetHatMappedMeshAndTexture(mesh, tex, hat.Name)
end
local function GetHatCFrame(hat)
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
local mesh, tex = GetHatMeshAndTexture(hat)
return GetHatCFrameMeshAndTexture(mesh, tex, hat.Name)
end
local function GetAttachmentCFrame(name)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if not ReanimCharacter then return end
local scale = ReanimCharacter:GetScale()
local hatmapped = nil
for _,data in ipairs(HatMap) do
if data.Attachments and data.Attachments[name] then
hatmapped = data
break
end
end
if hatmapped then
local cf = GetHatCFrameMeshAndTexture(hatmapped.MeshId, hatmapped.TextureId)
local att = hatmapped.Attachments[name]
return cf * Util.ScaleCFrame(att, hatmapped.Scale)
end
if Attachments[name] then
local limb = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(Attachments[name][1])
if limb then
return limb.CFrame * Util.ScaleCFrame(Attachments[name][2], scale)
end
end
return
end

local function SetUACFrameNetless(handle, dt, newcf, tvel, fling, spin)
if dt <= 0 then return false end
if not (handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then return false end
local timing = os.clock()
local idlerv = Vector3.new(
math.sin(timing * 14), math.sin(timing * 15 + 1.0472), math.sin(timing * 16 + 2.0944)
)
local idleoff = idlerv * 0.001
local ylimit = FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 5
if newcf.Y < ylimit then
newcf += Vector3.new(0, ylimit - newcf.Y, 0)
end
local speedlimit = 16384
if fling then
speedlimit = math.huge
end
local netless = Reanimate.NetlessVelocity + (math.sin(timing * 0.5) + 1) / 2
local aligned = true
local lastcf = handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition")
local claimtime = handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime")
if typeof(lastcf) ~= "CFrame" then lastcf = handle.CFrame end
if not handle:IsGrounded() and IsNetworkOwner(handle) then
local newpos = newcf.Position
local lastpos = lastcf.Position
local vel = (newpos - lastpos) / dt
if vel.Magnitude < 0.12 then
newcf += idleoff
elseif vel.Magnitude > speedlimit then
vel = vel.Unit * speedlimit
newpos = lastpos + vel * dt
newcf = newcf.Rotation + newpos
aligned = false
end
local rvel = lastcf:ToObjectSpace(newcf)
local a, b = rvel:ToAxisAngle()
rvel = (a * b) / dt
lastcf = newcf
if claimtime then
if timing - claimtime < 5.67 then
handle.Massless = false
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = nil
else
handle.Massless = true
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end
if timing - claimtime < 0.51 then
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless, 0)
else
if fling then
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(16384, 16384, 16384)
else
if Reanimate.UsePatchmaLikeNetless then
vel = tvel
vel *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
if vel.Magnitude > netless then
vel = vel.Unit * netless
end
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X * 10, netless, vel.Z * 10)
else
vel += tvel
vel *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
if vel.Magnitude > netless then
vel = vel.Unit * netless
end
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, math.max(vel.Y, netless), vel.Z)
end
end
end
else
claimtime = timing
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless * 2, 0)
end
handle.CFrame = newcf
if spin then
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(16384, 16384, 16384)
else
if Reanimate.UseAngularVelocity then
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = rvel + idleoff
else
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = idleoff
end
end
else
claimtime = nil
lastcf = handle.CFrame
aligned = false
end
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", lastcf)
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime", claimtime)
return aligned
end
local CharOnDesc = function(v)
if v:IsA("BasePart") and not (v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") or v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")) then
if not table.find(BaseParts, v) then
table.insert(BaseParts, v)
end
elseif v:IsA("Animator") then
task.defer(function()
v:Destroy()
end)
elseif v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
v.Enabled = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
if v.Enabled then v.Enabled = false end
end)
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Disabled"):Connect(function()
if not v.Disabled then v.Disabled = true end
end)
elseif v:IsA("Accessory") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
local handle = v:WaitForChild("Handle", 10)
if handle then
if not table.find(CharHats, v) then
table.insert(CharHats, v)
local conn = nil
conn = v.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
if v.Parent ~= Player.Character then
local i = table.find(CharHats, v)
if i then table.remove(CharHats, i) end
end
end)
end
end
elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
if not table.find(CharTools, v) then
table.insert(CharTools, v)
local conn = nil
conn = v.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
if v.Parent ~= Player.Character then
local i = table.find(CharTools, v)
if i then table.remove(CharTools, i) end
end
end)
end
end
end
local currentping = 0
local function _counthats(hats)
local collidable = 0
local exists = 0
for _,hat in hats do
local handle = hat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
exists += 1
if handle.CanCollide then
collidable += 1
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_HasCollide", true)
end
handle.CanCollide = false
end
end
HatReanimator.Status.HatCollide = exists .. " hats, " .. collidable .. " has collide."
return collidable
end
local function calculatepartdestroytime(height, velocity, gravity)
return (velocity + math.sqrt(velocity * velocity + 2 * gravity * height)) / gravity
end

end,

local function hatcol_hrptpstab(torsooffset)
return function(dt, character, Humanoid, RootPosition, RootPart, readystate)
local rootcf = CFrame.new(RootPosition + Vector3.new(8, -8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi * 0.5, 0, 0)
if readystate > 0 then
RootPart.CFrame = rootcf
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 26, 0), Vector3.zero
else
RootPart.CFrame = rootcf + Vector3.new(0, 141, 0)
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 26, 0), Vector3.zero
end
if Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
if v.Name == "Root" then
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, rootcf:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(RootPosition + Vector3.new(0, 0.75, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi * 0.5, 0, 0) * torsooffset))
elseif v.Name == "Neck" then
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, torsooffset.Rotation:Inverse() * CFrame.new(math.random() * 0.05, 1.5, -10))
elseif v.Name:find("Shoulder") or v.Name:find("Hip") then
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, torsooffset.Rotation:Inverse() * CFrame.new(v.C0.X - v.C1.X, v.C0.Y - v.C1.Y, -0.5 + math.random() * 0.05))
else
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
end
end
end
else
local i = 1
for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
if v.Name == "RootJoint" then
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, rootcf:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(RootPosition + Vector3.new(0, -0.25, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi * 0.5, 0, 0) * torsooffset))
elseif v.Name == "Neck" then
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, torsooffset.Rotation:Inverse() * CFrame.new(math.random() * 0.05, 1.5, -20))
else
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, torsooffset.Rotation:Inverse() * CFrame.new(i * -3, math.random() * 0.05, -3))
i += 1
end
end
end
end
end
end

local function OnCharacter(character)
if HatReanimator.DontFireCharAddOnThisChar == character then return end
currentping = Player:GetNetworkPing()

for _,v in CharTools do table.insert(toolnames, v.Name) end
table.clear(BaseParts)
table.clear(CharHats)
table.clear(CharTools)
ResetHatRefs()
character.DescendantAdded:Connect(CharOnDesc)
for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
CharOnDesc(v)
end
HatReanimator.Status.ReanimState = "Respawned."
HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = "Respawn detected."
HatReanimator.Status.HatCollide = "Respawn detected."
HatReanimator.Status.RespawnFling = "Respawn detected."
local hatcols = HatReanimator.HatCollide
local perma = HatReanimator.Permadeath
HatReanimator.HasPermadeath, HatReanimator.HasHatCollide = perma, hatcols
local hatcolmeth = HatReanimator.HatCollideMethod
if not replicatesignal then perma = false end
if not hatcols then hatcolmeth = -1 end
if hatcols and RejectCharacterDeletionsDisabled then
hatcolmeth = -2
end
local selhatcol = HatCollideMethods[hatcolmeth]
CurrentCharacter = nil
local Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not Humanoid then return end
if hatcolmeth == 10 and Humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
hatcolmeth = 6
selhatcol = HatCollideMethods[hatcolmeth]
pcall(Util.UINotify, "r15 hat reanim is R15 only - using method 7 instead.")
end
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
local stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if stupid then
stupid:Destroy()
end
character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v:IsA("LocalScript") then
v.Disabled = true
task.defer(function()
v:Destroy()
end)
end
end)
end
if selhatcol.NoAnim then
local stupid = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("Animator")
if stupid then
stupid:Destroy()
end
end
if selhatcol.ColLimb then
Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)
end
local RootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
if not RootPart then return end
local RootPosition = Vector3.new(RootPart.Position.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, RootPart.Position.Z)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if ReanimCharacter then
local root = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
RootPosition = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, root.Position.Z)
end
end
if not workspace.StreamingEnabled and false then
local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi * 2 * math.random(), 0).LookVector * 300
while true do
local nearAPlayer = false
for _,v in Players:GetPlayers() do
if v.Character and v.Character.PrimaryPart then
if (RootPosition - v.Character.PrimaryPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 1000 then
nearAPlayer = true
end
end
end
if nearAPlayer then
RootPosition += dir
else
break
end
end
end
if not perma then
RootPosition += Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
if ReanimCharacter then
local root = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
if HatReanimator.RespawnPosition == 1 then
RootPosition = root.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 0, 6)
end
if HatReanimator.RespawnPosition == 2 then
local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1).Unit
if dir ~= dir or dir.Magnitude == 0 then
dir = Vector3.yAxis
end
RootPosition = root.Position + dir * math.random(8, 12)
end
if HatReanimator.RespawnPosition == 4 then
RootPosition = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
end
end
end
if HatReanimator.RespawnPosition == 3 then
RootPosition = RootPart.Position
end
if HatReanimator.RespawnPosition == 4 and not (ReanimCharacter and ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
RootPosition = RootPart.Position
end
end
if hatcols then
RootPosition = Vector3.new(RootPosition.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, RootPosition.Z)
end
if hatcols then
HatReanimator.Status.HatCollide = "Waiting for Permadeath."
else
HatReanimator.Status.HatCollide = "Disabled, nothing to do!"
end
local cdsbeffect = os.clock()
local cdsbtime = os.clock()
if perma then
HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = "Fired CDSB Signal."
cdsbeffect += Players.RespawnTime
end
HatReanimator.Status.RespawnFling = "Flinging targets..."
if Util.Fling.Method == 4 and HatReanimator.FlingTargets[1] then
task.wait(0.2)
end
while character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
local t = os.clock()
local flingtarget = HatReanimator.FlingTargets[1]
if HatReanimator.FlingMethod == -1 then
table.remove(HatReanimator.FlingTargets, 1)
flingtarget = nil
end
local flingcf = CFrame.identity
if flingtarget then
flingtarget, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(HatReanimator.FlingTargets, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and 1 or 2)
end
if flingtarget then
if not RootPart:IsGrounded() then
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(RootPart, flingtarget, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(flingtarget.Target) or nil)
end
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
if flingtarget.Mode == 4 then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.new(0/0, 0/0, 0/0))
end
elseif #HatReanimator.FlingTargets == 0 then
break
else
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 1000, 0)
RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
end
task.wait()
end
if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
return
end
pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
HatReanimator.Status.RespawnFling = "Done."

if perma then task.wait(1) end

tool.Parent = character

tool.Parent = backpack
end
end

if perma then
HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = "no."
else
HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = "Disabled, nothing to do."
end
if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
lgloop:Disconnect()
return
end
readystate = 1

if not selhatcol.ColLimb then
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
end
NumHats = #CharHats
selhatcol.State1(character, Humanoid, CharHats)

for _,hat in CharHats do

handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_HasCollide", false)
end
end
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
task.wait(selhatcol.Wait2 or 0.15)
