function ToolReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
if not ToolReanimator.FlingEnabled then return end
return Util.Fling.Queue(ToolReanimator, target, duration)
end
local function ReceiveOwns(h) return h.ReceiveAge == 0 end
function ToolReanimator.FlingStep(claimed, owns, t)
owns = owns or ReceiveOwns
local q, ft, flingcf, pick = ToolReanimator.FlingTargets
if q[1] then
if ToolReanimator.FlingEnabled then
local area = 0
for _, c in claimed do
local h = c.Handle
local a = h.Size.X * h.Size.Y * h.Size.Z
if a > area and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and owns(h) then pick, area = c, a end
end
end
if pick then
ft, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(q, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Reanimate.PhysicsRepRootPartFling or 2)
else
table.clear(q)
end
end
local last = ToolReanimator.FlingPick
if last and not (ft and last == pick) then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, last.Handle, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
last.Handle.CanCollide = ToolReanimator.Collide
end
if not ft then
ToolReanimator.FlingPick = nil
return nil
end
local h = pick.Handle
h.CanCollide, h.Massless = true, true
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(h, ft, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, h, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(ft.Target) or nil)
ToolReanimator.FlingPick = pick
return pick
end
function ToolReanimator.FlingReset()
table.clear(ToolReanimator.FlingTargets)
local p = ToolReanimator.FlingPick
ToolReanimator.FlingPick = nil
if p then pcall(sethiddenproperty, p.Handle, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil) end
end
function ToolReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason)
ToolReanimator.Status.Permadeath = reason or "Force respawn!"
return HatReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason)
end
function ToolReanimator.StartAlt()
local Status = ToolReanimator.Status
local claimed, pending, Registry = {}, {}, {}
local Stopped, Busy = false, false
local HandledChar, ParkConn, BringConn = nil, nil, nil
local Handling = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local CharConns = {}
local nextretry, nextredrop, nextcommit = 0, {}, 0
local MAX_TRIES, MAX_CYCLES = 6, 3
local OWN_GRACE, OWN_TIMEOUT = 2, 8
local PassError = nil
ToolReanimator.HasPermadeath = false
Status.Permadeath = "Not used by Corpse Claim"
-- Replication contract: tools are never reparented client-side to workspace (that left a local-only ghost copy while the server
--   destroyed its copy with the corpse, so only this client saw it). Tools stay inside the character, which is kept alive on the
--   server (pd, same as Original) when replicatesignal exists; handle joints are broken locally and on the server, so the
--   server-side handle is the same instance this client simulates and other players see it.
local Corpses = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local ClaimHum = nil
local function Detach(handle)
for _, j in handle:GetJoints() do
pcall(j.Destroy, j)
end
for _, v in handle:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("JointInstance") then v:Destroy() end
if v:IsA("Constraint") then v.Enabled = false end
end
return #handle:GetJoints() == 0
end
local function GetTools()
local tools = {}
local char = Player.Character
local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
for _, container in {char or false, backpack or false} do
if container then
for _, v in container:GetChildren() do
local handle = v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
end
return tools
end
-- "Free" = the handle is connected to nothing outside its own tool. Cached for 0.1s unless fresh is requested.
local function IsFree(c, fresh)
local now = os.clock()
if not fresh and c.FreeAt and now - c.FreeAt < 0.1 then return c.FreeVal end
local okp, parts = pcall(c.Handle.GetConnectedParts, c.Handle, true)
local free = okp
if okp then
for _, p in parts do
if p ~= c.Handle and not p:IsDescendantOf(c.Tool) then
free = false
break
end
end
end
c.FreeAt, c.FreeVal = now, free
return free
end
-- Local ownership only: the engine reports this client as the handle's simulator. Not server-authoritative.
local function Owns(handle)
if not handle.Parent then return false end
return handle.ReceiveAge == 0 and not handle:IsGrounded()
end
local function Valid(c)
return c.Tool:IsDescendantOf(game) and c.Handle:IsDescendantOf(game)
end
-- Detach is confirmed separately from ownership: the handle must be in the workspace and free of every outside joint.
local function Detached(c, fresh)
return c.Handle:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and IsFree(c, fresh)
end
-- Corpse detection/tracking: when a watched character dies, every registered tool still inside that body is dropped out of it
-- right away (before the body is removed on respawn) so the freed handles can be confirmed and tracked. Event driven, no polling.
local function WatchCorpse(character, hum)
if Corpses[character] then return end
Corpses[character] = true
table.insert(CharConns, hum.Died:Connect(function()
for _, list in {claimed, pending} do
for _, c in list do
if c.Tool.Parent == character then pcall(Detach, c.Handle) end
end
end
end))
end
local Holding, ParkRoot = false, nil
local function HasLivePending()
for _, c in pending do
if not c.Failed then return true end
end
return false
end
local function UpdateSummary()
local head = "[Corpse Claim, client-side] "
if #claimed + #pending == 0 then
ToolReanimator.Summary = head .. "No usable Tools found (a Tool needs a Handle part). Waiting..."
return
end
local lines = {head .. "Tools claimed: " .. #claimed .. "/" .. #LimbOrder .. (#pending > 0 and (", pending: " .. #pending) or "")}
for _, c in claimed do
table.insert(lines, c.Limb .. " <- " .. c.Tool.Name)
end
for _, c in pending do
local note
if c.Failed then
note = " (unconfirmed: " .. (c.FailReason or "no confirmation") .. ")"
elseif not c.Detached then
note = " (pending: waiting to detach)"
else
note = " (pending: waiting for local ownership)"
end
table.insert(lines, c.Limb .. " <- " .. c.Tool.Name .. note)
end
table.insert(lines, "Tools stay in the server-side body; others see them while this client owns them.")
ToolReanimator.Summary = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
local function ResolveState()
if Busy or PassError then return end
if #claimed + #pending == 0 then return end
if #pending == 0 then
Status.ReanimState = "Done."
elseif #claimed > 0 then
Status.ReanimState = "Done (" .. #claimed .. " claimed, " .. #pending .. " still pending confirmation)."
elseif HasLivePending() then
Status.ReanimState = "Waiting for tool ownership (character stays at the claim spot)"
else
Status.ReanimState = "Unconfirmed: tools did not detach / this client never got ownership. Nothing is claimed (see the summary)."
end
end
local function NextLimb()
for _, limb in LimbOrder do
local used = false
for _, c in claimed do
if c.Limb == limb then used = true break end
end
if not used then
for _, c in pending do
if c.Limb == limb then used = true break end
end
end
if not used then return limb end
end
end
local function Forget(c)
Registry[c.Tool] = nil
nextredrop[c] = nil
end
local function PruneList(list)
for i = #list, 1, -1 do
local c = list[i]
local tool = c.Tool
local gone = not tool:IsDescendantOf(game)
if not gone and c.Handle.Parent ~= tool then
local h = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then
c.Handle = h
c.Detached, c.Owned, c.FreeAt, c.DetachedAt = false, false, nil, nil
else
gone = true
end
end
if gone then
Forget(c)
table.remove(list, i)
end
end
end
local function Prune()
PruneList(claimed)
PruneList(pending)
end
-- Clears the hat-style drive state of a handle (claim timer, last position, glue, physical properties) so the next
-- claim starts clean and nothing stale is left on a handle we stop driving.
local function ResetDrive(c)
local h = c.Handle
pcall(function()
h:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime", nil)
h:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", nil)
h.CustomPhysicalProperties = c.OrigProps
h.Massless = c.OrigMassless == true
end)
c.RepRef, c.Aligned = nil, false
pcall(sethiddenproperty, h, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
end
-- Promotion is the ONLY way a tool becomes claimed: detach AND local (engine-reported) ownership, both checked fresh.
local function Promote(c, i, now)
table.remove(pending, i)
table.insert(claimed, c)
c.Detached, c.Owned, c.Failed, c.FailReason = true, true, false, nil
c.Tries, c.OwnLostAt, c.DetachedAt, c.ClaimedAt = 0, nil, nil, now
nextredrop[c] = nil
c.Handle.CanCollide = false
ResetDrive(c)
end
local function Demote(c, i, why)
table.remove(claimed, i)
table.insert(pending, c)
ResetDrive(c)
c.Detached, c.Owned, c.OwnLostAt, c.DetachedAt, c.Tries = false, false, nil, nil, 0
c.Cycles += 1
nextredrop[c] = nil
if c.Cycles > MAX_CYCLES then
c.Failed, c.FailReason = true, why or "ownership keeps changing"
end
end
local function Commit()
local now = os.clock()
for i = #pending, 1, -1 do
local c = pending[i]
if Valid(c) then
c.Detached = Detached(c, true)
c.Owned = c.Detached and Owns(c.Handle)
if c.Detached and c.Owned then
Promote(c, i, now)
else
if c.Detached then
c.DetachedAt = c.DetachedAt or now
if not c.Failed and now - c.DetachedAt > OWN_TIMEOUT then
c.Failed, c.FailReason = true, "detached but the engine never gave this client ownership"
end
else
c.DetachedAt = nil
end
end
else
Forget(c)
table.remove(pending, i)
end
end
end
-- Bounded retries with backoff: after MAX_TRIES the tool is marked failed (it stays pending and can still be promoted
-- later if ownership arrives, but it is no longer re-dropped).
local function DropTool(c, now, bounce)
if c.Failed or now < (nextredrop[c] or 0) then return end
if c.Tries >= MAX_TRIES then
c.Failed, c.FailReason = true, "still attached after " .. c.Tries .. " drops"
return
end
c.Tries += 1
nextredrop[c] = now + math.min(0.5 * 2 ^ (c.Tries - 1), 4)
pcall(Detach, c.Handle)
if replicatesignal and ClaimHum and ClaimHum.Parent then pcall(replicatesignal, ClaimHum.ServerBreakJoints) end
end
local function ClaimTools(char, list)
for _, tool in GetTools() do
local limb = NextLimb()
if not limb then break end
if not Registry[tool] then
local origRH, origEn = tool.RequiresHandle, tool.Enabled
pcall(function()
tool.Enabled = true
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = char
end)
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if tool.Parent == char and handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
local c = {
Tool = tool, Handle = handle, Limb = limb,
Detached = false, Owned = false, Failed = false,
Tries = 0, Cycles = 0,
OrigRH = origRH, OrigEnabled = origEn,
OrigCollide = handle.CanCollide, OrigTouch = handle.CanTouch, OrigMassless = handle.Massless,
OrigProps = handle.CustomPhysicalProperties,
}
Registry[tool] = c
table.insert(pending, c)
table.insert(list, c)
else
pcall(function()
tool.RequiresHandle = origRH
tool.Enabled = origEn
end)
end
end
end
return list
end
local function ParkPosition(RootPart)
local rp = ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition
local root = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local pos = RootPart.Position
if rp == 0 then
local base = root and root.Position or pos
pos = Vector3.new(base.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 12, base.Z)
elseif root and rp == 1 then
pos = root.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 0, 6)
elseif root and rp == 4 then
pos = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
end
return pos
end
local function ClaimPosition(RootPart)
local root = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
return (root and root.Position or RootPart.Position) + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)
end
local function Park(RootPart, claiming)
if ParkConn then ParkConn:Disconnect() end
local rp = ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition
local fixed = ParkPosition(RootPart)
if rp == 2 and Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1).Unit
if dir ~= dir or dir.Magnitude == 0 then dir = Vector3.yAxis end
fixed = Reanimate.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + dir * math.random(8, 12)
end
local follow = rp == 0 or rp == 1 or rp == 4
ParkConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not RootPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
local p = claiming and ClaimPosition(RootPart) or (follow and ParkPosition(RootPart) or fixed)
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end)
end
-- Pending tools that are already free are pulled to the claim spot (only while we are the simulator).
BringConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if #pending == 0 then return end
local root = ParkRoot
if not (root and root:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then return end
local p, now = ClaimPosition(root), os.clock()
for _, c in pending do
local h = c.Handle
if not c.Failed and (not c.Driven or now - c.Driven > 0.1) and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and h.ReceiveAge == 0 and IsFree(c) then
h.CanCollide = false
h.CFrame = CFrame.new(p)
h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 67, 0)
h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end
end)
-- Hat-style handle driving: the same alignment routine HatReanimator uses for its handles (SetUACFrameNetless: claim-time
-- settle phase, netless velocity, speed limit, aligned flag, same _Uhhhhhh_* handle attributes), a per-handle mapping that
-- honours HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride entries by tool Name, and the per-handle PhysicsRepRootRef from that mapping.
local function AlignHandle(handle, dt, newcf, tvel, fling, spin)
if dt <= 0 then return false end
if not (handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then return false end
local timing = os.clock()
local idlerv = Vector3.new(
math.sin(timing * 14), math.sin(timing * 15 + 1.0472), math.sin(timing * 16 + 2.0944)
)
local idleoff = idlerv * 0.001
local ylimit = FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 5
if newcf.Y < ylimit then
newcf += Vector3.new(0, ylimit - newcf.Y, 0)
end
local speedlimit = 16384
if fling then
speedlimit = math.huge
end
local netless = Reanimate.NetlessVelocity + (math.sin(timing * 0.5) + 1) / 2
local aligned = true
local lastcf = handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition")
local claimtime = handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime")
if typeof(lastcf) ~= "CFrame" then lastcf = handle.CFrame end
if not handle:IsGrounded() and handle.ReceiveAge == 0 then
local newpos = newcf.Position
local lastpos = lastcf.Position
local vel = (newpos - lastpos) / dt
if vel.Magnitude < 0.12 then
newcf += idleoff
elseif vel.Magnitude > speedlimit then
vel = vel.Unit * speedlimit
newpos = lastpos + vel * dt
newcf = newcf.Rotation + newpos
aligned = false
end
local rvel = lastcf:ToObjectSpace(newcf)
local a, b = rvel:ToAxisAngle()
rvel = (a * b) / dt
lastcf = newcf
if claimtime then
if timing - claimtime < 5.67 then
handle.Massless = false
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = nil
else
handle.Massless = true
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end
if timing - claimtime < 0.51 then
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless, 0)
else
if fling then
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(16384, 16384, 16384)
else
if Reanimate.UsePatchmaLikeNetless then
vel = tvel
vel *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
if vel.Magnitude > netless then
vel = vel.Unit * netless
end
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X * 10, netless, vel.Z * 10)
else
vel += tvel
vel *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
if vel.Magnitude > netless then
vel = vel.Unit * netless
end
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, math.max(vel.Y, netless), vel.Z)
end
end
end
else
claimtime = timing
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless * 2, 0)
end
handle.CFrame = newcf
if spin then
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(16384, 16384, 16384)
else
if Reanimate.UseAngularVelocity then
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = rvel + idleoff
else
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = idleoff
end
end
else
claimtime = nil
lastcf = handle.CFrame
aligned = false
end
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", lastcf)
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime", claimtime)
return aligned
end
local function ResolveMap(c, now)
if c.Map and now - c.MapAt < 1 then return c.Map end
local map = {Limb = c.Limb}
for _, data in HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride do
if not data.Disable and data.Name and not data.MeshId and not data.TextureId and not data.Group and not data.Index and data.Name == c.Tool.Name then
map = {
Limb = data.Limb or c.Limb,
C0 = data.C0, C1 = data.C1,
Offset = data.Offset or data.CFrame,
RepRootPart = data.RepRootPart,
}
break
end
end
c.Map, c.MapAt = map, now
return map
end
local function MappedCFrame(map, limb, scale)
if map.C0 and map.C1 then
return limb.CFrame * Util.ApplyAxis(Util.ScaleCFrame(map.C0, scale)) * Util.ScaleCFrame(map.C1, 1):Inverse(), limb.Velocity
end
if map.Offset then
return limb.CFrame * map.Offset, limb.Velocity
end
return limb.CFrame, limb.Velocity
end
local function SetRepRoot(c, part, now)
local want = nil
if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and Util.Fling.UseGlue() then want = part end
if c.RepRef ~= want or now - (c.RepRefAt or 0) > 0.5 then
c.RepRef, c.RepRefAt = want, now
pcall(sethiddenproperty, c.Handle, "PhysicsRepRootRef", want)
end
end
local function ClaimPass(character, hum, RootPart, initial)
if Busy then return end
Busy, Holding, PassError = true, false, nil
local function alive()
return character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not Stopped and not Reanimate.Stopping
end
Park(RootPart, true)
local list = {}
local ok, err = pcall(function()
repeat
if not alive() then return end
ClaimTools(character, list)
if #list == 0 then
if not initial then return end
task.wait(0.25)
end
until #list > 0
task.wait(0.25)
if not alive() then return end
ClaimTools(character, list)
do
Status.ReanimState = "Corpse Claim: arming " .. #list .. " tool(s)"
local armDeadline = os.clock() + 3
repeat
ClaimTools(character, list)
local ready = 0
for _, c in list do
if not Valid(c) then
ready += 1
else
if c.Tool.Parent ~= character then
pcall(function() c.Tool.Parent = character end)
end
c.Handle.CanTouch = false
if c.Tool.Parent == character and not IsFree(c, true) then ready += 1 end
end
end
if ready < #list then task.wait(0.1) end
until ready >= #list or os.clock() > armDeadline or not alive()
if not alive() then return end
Status.ReanimState = "Corpse Claim: detaching tools (client death + server joint break)"
if replicatesignal then pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints) end
pcall(function()
hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
if replicatesignal then
pcall(function() character:BreakJoints() end)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
Status.Permadeath = "Body kept alive on the server (tools stay replicated)."
else
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end)
Status.ReanimState = "Corpse Claim: waiting for the tools to detach"
local deadline = os.clock() + 6
local left
repeat
left = 0
local now = os.clock()
for _, c in list do
if Valid(c) then
c.Handle.CanTouch = false
if not Detached(c, true) then
DropTool(c, now, c.Tool.Parent == workspace)
if not c.Failed then left += 1 end
end
end
end
if left > 0 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
until left == 0 or os.clock() > deadline or not alive()
end
Commit()
Status.ReanimState = "Waiting for local ownership confirmation"
local ownDeadline = os.clock() + 4
local waiting
repeat
task.wait(0.1)
Commit()
waiting = 0
for _, c in list do
if not c.Owned and not c.Failed and Valid(c) then waiting += 1 end
end
until waiting == 0 or os.clock() > ownDeadline or not alive()
end)
Commit()
Busy = false
Holding = HasLivePending()
if alive() then
Park(RootPart, Holding)
end
if ok then
ResolveState()
else
PassError = tostring(err)
Status.ReanimState = "Error: " .. PassError
end
end
local function ClearAll()
for _, c in claimed do Forget(c) end
for _, c in pending do Forget(c) end
table.clear(claimed)
table.clear(pending)
Holding = false
end
local function OnCharacter(character)
if Stopped or HandledChar == character or Handling[character] then return end
Handling[character] = true
Status.ReanimState = "Respawned."
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not hum then Handling[character] = nil return end
ClaimHum = hum
WatchCorpse(character, hum)
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
local stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if stupid then stupid:Destroy() end
table.insert(CharConns, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v:IsA("LocalScript") then
v.Disabled = true
task.defer(function() v:Destroy() end)
end
end))
end
local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if animator then animator:Destroy() end
local RootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
if not RootPart then Handling[character] = nil return end
ParkRoot = RootPart
for _, v in character:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanTouch = false end
end
pcall(function() hum.EvaluateStateMachine = false end)
pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
while Busy and not Stopped and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do task.wait(0.1) end
if Stopped or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then Handling[character] = nil return end
HandledChar = character
Prune()
if #claimed > 0 or HasLivePending() then
-- previously claimed / still-pending tool state survives the respawn
Holding = HasLivePending()
Park(RootPart, Holding)
ResolveState()
Status.ReanimState = "Respawned. " .. Status.ReanimState
return
end
-- nothing claimed and nothing still worth waiting for: forget the failed leftovers and run a fresh claim pass
for _, c in pending do Forget(c) end
table.clear(pending)
ClaimPass(character, hum, RootPart, true)
end
table.insert(CharConns, Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(OnCharacter, c) end))
local InitCFrame = nil
local startChar = Player.Character
do
local h = startChar and startChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h and h.RootPart then InitCFrame = h.RootPart.CFrame end
end
Reanimate.CreateCharacter(InitCFrame)
Reanimate.Starting = false
if startChar and startChar:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
task.spawn(OnCharacter, startChar)
end
local nextsummary, stuckSince = 0, nil
while not Reanimate.Stopping do
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
if workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight == workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight then
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
end
if Util.FX.SimDue() then
pcall(function() Player.SimulationRadius = #Players:GetPlayers() * 1000 end)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Player, "SimulationRadius", #Players:GetPlayers() * 1000)
end
local Character = Player.Character
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
local ltm = Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
if Character and Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
if Character ~= HandledChar and os.clock() > nextretry then
nextretry = os.clock() + 2
task.spawn(OnCharacter, Character)
end
local hum = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local rchum = ReanimCharacter and ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local subject = rchum or hum
if Camera and subject and Camera.CameraSubject ~= subject then
Camera.CameraSubject = subject
end
for _, v in Character:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
if v.CanTouch then v.CanTouch = false end
if v.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= ltm then v.LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm end
end
end
end
Prune()
local usable = 0
for _, c in claimed do
if Owns(c.Handle) then usable += 1 end
end
if ToolReanimator.AutoForceRespawn and not Busy and #claimed + #pending > 0 and usable == 0 then
local now = os.clock()
stuckSince = stuckSince or now
if now - stuckSince > ToolReanimator.StuckTimeout and now - HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn > 5 then
stuckSince = nil
ClearAll()
ToolReanimator.ForceRespawn("No usable tool for " .. ToolReanimator.StuckTimeout .. "s. Force respawning!")
end
else
stuckSince = nil
end
local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local t = os.clock()
if ReanimCharacter and dt > 0 then
local scale = ReanimCharacter:GetScale()
local flung = ToolReanimator.FlingStep(claimed, Owns, t)
for i = #claimed, 1, -1 do
local c = claimed[i]
local handle = c.Handle
if c == flung then
c.RepRef = false
elseif not Valid(c) then
-- removed by Prune next frame
elseif not Detached(c) then
-- grip came back / tool left the workspace: back to pending (bounded), never driven while attached
Demote(c, i, "tool keeps getting re-attached")
elseif not Owns(handle) then
-- delayed replication / ownership change: stop driving, give it a grace period, then re-confirm from pending
c.OwnLostAt = c.OwnLostAt or t
if not handle:IsGrounded() then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, handle, "NetworkIsSleeping", false)
end
if t - c.OwnLostAt > OWN_GRACE then Demote(c, i, "ownership lost") end
else
c.OwnLostAt = nil
if c.ClaimedAt and c.Cycles > 0 and t - c.ClaimedAt > 30 then c.Cycles = 0 end
local map = ResolveMap(c, t)
local limb = c.LimbPart
if not limb or limb.Parent ~= ReanimCharacter or limb.Name ~= map.Limb then
limb = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(map.Limb)
c.LimbPart = limb
end
local lltm = ltm
if Reanimate.FirstPersonBody and map.Limb ~= "Head" then lltm = 0 end
if handle.CanCollide ~= ToolReanimator.Collide then handle.CanCollide = ToolReanimator.Collide end
if handle.CanTouch then handle.CanTouch = false end
if handle.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= lltm then handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = lltm end
if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
local tcf, tvel = MappedCFrame(map, limb, scale)
c.Aligned = AlignHandle(handle, dt, tcf, tvel, false, false)
c.Driven = t
SetRepRoot(c, map.RepRootPart, t)
end
end
end
if not Busy and #pending > 0 and t > nextcommit then
nextcommit = t + 0.1
Commit()
for _, c in pending do
if not c.Failed and not c.Detached and Valid(c) then
DropTool(c, t, c.Tool.Parent == workspace)
end
end
end
if t > nextsummary then
nextsummary = t + 0.5
local live = HasLivePending()
if not Busy and ParkRoot and live ~= Holding then
Holding = live
Park(ParkRoot, Holding)
end
UpdateSummary()
ResolveState()
end
end
RunService.PreRender:Wait()
if Reanimate.Character and Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then
Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter()
end
end
Stopped = true
if BringConn then BringConn:Disconnect() BringConn = nil end
if ParkConn then ParkConn:Disconnect() ParkConn = nil end
for _, conn in CharConns do conn:Disconnect() end
table.clear(CharConns)
local Character = Player.Character
local hum = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local rroot = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local ReturnCFrame = rroot and rroot.CFrame
for _, v in (Character and Character:GetDescendants() or {}) do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
v.CanTouch = true
v.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
end
end
local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
local function RestoreTool(c)
if c.Tool.Parent and c.Handle.Parent then
local h = c.Handle
ResetDrive(c)
pcall(function()
h.CanTouch = c.OrigTouch ~= false
h.CanCollide = c.OrigCollide ~= false
h.Massless = c.OrigMassless == true
h.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
h.AssemblyLinearVelocity, h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
c.Tool.RequiresHandle = c.OrigRH ~= false
c.Tool.Enabled = c.OrigEnabled ~= false
end)
if ReturnCFrame then pcall(function() h.CFrame = ReturnCFrame end) end
pcall(function() c.Tool.Parent = backpack or Character end)
end
end
ToolReanimator.FlingReset()
for _, c in claimed do RestoreTool(c) end
for _, c in pending do RestoreTool(c) end
if hum and hum.Parent then
pcall(function() hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true end)
pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true) end)
if hum.Health > 0 then
local hrp = hum.RootPart
if hrp and ReturnCFrame then
hrp.CFrame = ReturnCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity, hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end
pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
end
pcall(function() if Camera then Camera.CameraSubject = hum end end)
end
ClearAll()
table.clear(nextredrop)
ToolReanimator.HasPermadeath = false
ToolReanimator.Summary = "(no tools claimed yet...)"
Status.Permadeath = "(no status)"
Status.ReanimState = "(no status)"
Reanimate.Stopping = false
Reanimate.DestroyCharacter()
end
function ToolReanimator.Start()
if ToolReanimator.Method ~= 1 then return ToolReanimator.StartAlt() end
local Status = ToolReanimator.Status
local claimed = {}
local CurrentCharacter, HandledChar, Humanoid = nil, nil, nil
local Stopped = false
local nextretry = 0
local function GetTools()
local tools = {}
local char = Player.Character
local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
for _, container in {char or false, backpack or false} do
if container then
for _, v in container:GetChildren() do
local handle = v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
end
return tools
end
local function UpdateSummary()
if #claimed == 0 then
ToolReanimator.Summary = "No usable Tools found (a Tool needs a Handle part). Waiting..."
return
end
local lines = {"Tools claimed: " .. #claimed .. "/" .. #LimbOrder}
for _, c in claimed do
local owned = c.Handle.Parent and c.Handle.ReceiveAge == 0
table.insert(lines, c.Limb .. " <- " .. c.Tool.Name .. (owned and "" or " (not owned)"))
end
ToolReanimator.Summary = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
local function ClaimTools(char)
local list = {}
for _, tool in GetTools() do
if #list >= #LimbOrder then break end
pcall(function()
tool.Enabled = true
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = char
end)
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if tool.Parent == char and handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(list, {Tool = tool, Handle = handle, Limb = LimbOrder[#list + 1]})
end
end
return list
end
local function Detach(handle)
for _, j in handle:GetJoints() do
pcall(j.Destroy, j)
end
for _, v in handle:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("JointInstance") then v:Destroy() end
if v:IsA("Constraint") then v.Enabled = false end
end
return #handle:GetJoints() == 0
end
local function OnCharacter(character)
if Stopped or HandledChar == character then return end
HandledChar = character
table.clear(claimed)
CurrentCharacter = nil
Status.ReanimState = "Respawned."
Status.Permadeath = "Respawn detected."
local perma = ToolReanimator.Permadeath
if not replicatesignal then perma = false end
ToolReanimator.HasPermadeath = perma
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not hum then return end
Humanoid = hum
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
local stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if stupid then
stupid:Destroy()
end
character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v:IsA("LocalScript") then
v.Disabled = true
task.defer(function()
v:Destroy()
end)
end
end)
end
local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if animator then
animator:Destroy()
end
local RootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
if not RootPart then return end
local RootPosition = Vector3.new(RootPart.Position.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, RootPart.Position.Z)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
local root = ReanimCharacter and ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
RootPosition = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, root.Position.Z)
end
if not perma then
RootPosition += Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
if root then
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 1 then
RootPosition = root.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 0, 6)
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 2 then
local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1).Unit
if dir ~= dir or dir.Magnitude == 0 then
dir = Vector3.yAxis
end
RootPosition = root.Position + dir * math.random(8, 12)
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 4 then
RootPosition = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
end
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 3 then
RootPosition = RootPart.Position
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 4 and not root then
RootPosition = RootPart.Position
end
end
local function alive()
return character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not Stopped and not Reanimate.Stopping
end
Status.Permadeath = perma and "Waiting for tools." or "Disabled, nothing to do."
local bringconns = {}
local lgloop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(RootPosition) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end)
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if perma then task.wait(1) end
local list = {}
repeat
if not alive() then return end
list = ClaimTools(character)
if #list == 0 then task.wait(0.25) end
until #list > 0
Status.ReanimState = "Reanimate State: 1"
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
task.wait(0.25)
if not alive() then return end
Status.ReanimState = "Reanimate State: 2"
local claimarea = RootPart.CFrame.Position + RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 8
claimarea = Vector3.new(claimarea.X, math.max(FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 16, claimarea.Y + 4), claimarea.Z)
for _, c in list do
Detach(c.Handle)
table.insert(bringconns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local h = c.Handle
if h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and h.ReceiveAge == 0 then
h.CanCollide = false
h.CFrame = CFrame.new(claimarea)
h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 67, 0)
h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end))
end
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
task.wait()
if not alive() then return end
pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints)
hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
if perma then
pcall(function() character:BreakJoints() end)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
Status.Permadeath = "Executed dolteddown's pd."
else
hum.Health = 0
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
Status.ReanimState = "Reanimate State: 3"
local deadline = os.clock() + 3
local detached = false
repeat
detached = true
for _, c in list do
if not Detach(c.Handle) then detached = false end
end
if not detached then
pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints)
pcall(function() character:BreakJoints() end)
task.wait(0.1)
end
until detached or os.clock() > deadline or not alive()
if not alive() then return end
if not detached then
ToolReanimator.ForceRespawn("Tools stayed attached to the body. Force respawning!")
return
end
for _, b in bringconns do b:Disconnect() end
table.clear(bringconns)
for _, c in list do table.insert(claimed, c) end
CurrentCharacter = character
Status.ReanimState = "Done."
if perma then task.wait(1) end
end)
lgloop:Disconnect()
for _, b in bringconns do b:Disconnect() end
if not ok then
Status.ReanimState = "Error: " .. tostring(err)
end
end

else

local flung = ToolReanimator.FlingStep(ReanimOkay and claimed or {}, nil, t)
for _, c in (ReanimOkay and claimed or {}) do
local handle = c.Handle
local limb = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(c.Limb)
if c.Tool.Parent ~= Character then
pcall(function() c.Tool.Parent = Character end)
end
if c ~= flung and limb and handle.Parent and handle:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
handle.CanCollide = ToolReanimator.Collide
handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm
if #handle:GetJoints() > 0 then
Detach(handle)
end
if not handle:IsGrounded() and handle.ReceiveAge == 0 then
local cf = limb.CFrame
if cf.Y < ylimit then
cf += Vector3.new(0, ylimit - cf.Y, 0)
end
handle.Massless = true
handle.CFrame = cf + idle
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless, 0)
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end
end
if t > nextsummary then
nextsummary = t + 0.5
UpdateSummary()
end

end

local Direct = {FlingTargets = {}, _TempNotFling = {}, Busy = false}
local function directStop(home)
local ch = Player.Character
local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if root then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
if home then root.CFrame = home end
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end
if hum then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, hum, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.zero)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, hum, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running.Value)
pcall(hum.ChangeState, hum, Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
end
end
Util.AltDirectFling = function(target)
local ch = Player.Character
local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and root:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
return false, "no character to fling with"
end
if not Util.Fling.Queue(Direct, target) then
return false, "fling engine rejected the target (dead / already flinging / invalid)"
end
if Direct.Busy then return true end
Direct.Busy = true
task.spawn(function()
local q, home = Direct.FlingTargets, nil
pcall(function()
while q[1] do
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
local c = Player.Character
local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not (r and h and h.Health > 0 and r:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or Reanimate.Current or Reanimate.Character then
table.clear(q)
break
end
local ft, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(q, os.clock(), Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Reanimate.PhysicsRepRootPartFling or 2)
if ft then
home = home or r.CFrame
r.CanCollide = true
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(r, ft, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, r, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(ft.Target) or nil)
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid(h, ft, 0)
end
end
end)
table.clear(q)
pcall(directStop, home)
Direct.Busy = false
end)
return true
end
end
Util.AltRunFling = function(target)
local Reanimator = Reanimate.Current
if Reanimator then
if Reanimator.Fling then return Reanimator.Fling(target) end
return false, "no active reanimation"
end
if Reanimate.Character then return false, "no active reanimation" end
return Util.AltDirectFling(target)
end

local RS = SaveData.Reanimator
do
local poseCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame(map, v, RC, RootPart)
local e = poseCache[map]
if not e or e.RC ~= RC then
e = {RC = RC}
poseCache[map] = e
end
local n0, n1 = map.RPart0, map.RPart1
local p0
if n0 == "ROOT" then
p0 = RootPart
else
p0 = e.p0
if not p0 or p0.Parent ~= RC or p0.Name ~= n0 then
p0 = RC:FindFirstChild(n0)
e.p0 = p0
end
end
local p1 = e.p1
if not p1 or p1.Parent ~= RC or p1.Name ~= n1 then
p1 = RC:FindFirstChild(n1)
e.p1 = p1
end
if not (p0 and p1) then return CFrame.identity end
local t = map.Type
if t == 1 then
return p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
elseif t == 2 then
local mc0, mc1 = map.C0, map.C1
if e.c0Src ~= mc0 then
e.c0Src, e.c0 = mc0, CFrame.new(mc0)
end
if e.c1Src ~= mc1 then
e.c1Src, e.c1 = mc1, CFrame.new(mc1)
end
local transform = (p0.CFrame * e.c0):ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame * e.c1)
local offset = map.Offset
if offset then
if e.offSrc ~= offset then
e.offSrc, e.offInv = offset, offset:Inverse()
end
transform = offset * transform * e.offInv
end
local vc1 = v.C1
if e.vc1Src ~= vc1 then
e.vc1Src, e.vc1Inv = vc1, vc1:Inverse()
end
return v.C0 * transform * e.vc1Inv
end
return CFrame.identity
end
end
end

local flyAtt, flyLV, flyVel = nil, nil, Vector3.zero
local function flyCleanup()
if flyLV then
pcall(flyLV.Destroy, flyLV)
flyLV = nil
end
if flyAtt then
pcall(flyAtt.Destroy, flyAtt)
flyAtt = nil
end
flyVel = Vector3.zero
end
local wasWalk = false
RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
local ch = Reanimate.Character
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local root = hum and hum.RootPart
if not hum or not root then
flyCleanup()
return
end
if CM.WalkEnabled then
wasWalk = true
if hum.WalkSpeed ~= CM.WalkSpeed then
hum.WalkSpeed = CM.WalkSpeed
end
elseif wasWalk then
wasWalk = false
hum.WalkSpeed = 16
end
if not Reanimate.Fly then
if flyLV then flyCleanup() end
return
end
if not flyLV or flyLV.Parent ~= root then
flyCleanup()
flyAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
flyAtt.Name = Util.RandomString(12)
flyAtt.Parent = root
flyLV = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
flyLV.Name = Util.RandomString(12)
flyLV.Attachment0 = flyAtt
flyLV.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
flyLV.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
flyLV.MaxForce = math.huge
flyLV.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
flyLV.Parent = root
end
local mv = Reanimate.Control.Move
if mv.Magnitude > 1 then mv = mv.Unit end
local camcf = Reanimate.Camera:GetMovementCFrame()
local dir = camcf:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(mv.X, 0, mv.Z))
local up = 0
if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) or Reanimate.Control.Jump then up += 1 end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then up -= 1 end
end
local target = (dir + Vector3.new(0, up, 0)) * CM.FlySpeed
flyVel = flyVel:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
flyLV.VectorVelocity = flyVel
end)
end

local old = Util.ChatMod
if old and old.Disable then pcall(old.Disable) end
local CM = {Active = false, Conns = {}, Flags = {}, Cases = {}, CaseList = {}, Queue = {}, Seen = {}, SeenQ = {}, Strikes = {}, SayLog = {}, LastSay = -1e9, UI = {}}
local FX = Util.FX
local LEVELS = {0.85, 0.75, 0.65}
CM.LevelNames = {"Strict (85%+)", "Balanced (75%+)", "Sensitive (65%+)"}

local function cfg(k) local ok, v = pcall(function() return FX.Cfg[k] end) if ok then return v end end
local function notify(t) pcall(Util.UINotify, tostring(t)) end
local function rt(s) return (tostring(s):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")) end
CM.Esc = rt
local function set(s) local t = {} for w in s:gmatch("%S+") do t[w] = true end return t end
local function squeeze(w, keep)
	local out, prev, run = {}, nil, 0
	for c in w:gmatch(".") do
		if c == prev then run = run + 1 else prev, run = c, 1 end
		if run <= keep then out[#out + 1] = c end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
local function dd(w) return squeeze(w, 1) end
local function squeeze3(w)
	local out, i, n = {}, 1, #w
	while i <= n do
		local c, j = w:sub(i, i), i
		while j < n and w:sub(j + 1, j + 1) == c do j = j + 1 end
		local len = j - i + 1
		out[#out + 1] = c:rep(len >= 3 and 1 or len)
		i = j + 1
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
local function clamp(v, a, b) return v < a and a or (v > b and b or v) end

local INS = {idiot = .35, idiots = .35, stupid = .35, dumb = .35, dumbass = .5, moron = .4, morons = .4, loser = .35, losers = .35, trash = .3, garbage = .3, ugly = .35, fat = .3,

		SQ[(ph:gsub(" ", ""))] = {cat, v, selfh}
	end
end

-- ---------- pure analyser: text -> category, confidence (0-0.99), flags ----------
function CM.Analyze(raw, ctx)
	ctx = ctx or {}
	local R = {conf = 0, hits = {}}
	local low = tostring(raw or ""):lower()
	local s, n = low:gsub("\226\128[\139-\143]", "")
	local evad = n > 0
	s, n = s:gsub("\226\129\160", "") evad = evad or n > 0
	s, n = s:gsub("\239\187\191", "") evad = evad or n > 0
	local joke = s:find("\240\159\152\130", 1, true) or s:find("\240\159\164\163", 1, true) or s:find("\240\159\152\134", 1, true) or s:find("/j%f[%A]") or s:find("/s%f[%A]")
	local _, nq = s:gsub('"', "")
	local quote = nq >= 2 or s:find("\226\128\156", 1, true) ~= nil
	s = s:gsub("\226\128\153", ""):gsub("'", ""):gsub("[\128-\255]", " ")
	s = s:gsub("%S+", function(ch)
		local core = ch:gsub("[%._%-%*]+$", "")
		if #core >= 5 and #core % 2 == 1 then
			for i = 1, #core do
				local c = core:sub(i, i)
				if i % 2 == 1 then if not c:find("%a") then return end elseif not c:find("[%._%-%*]") then return end
			end
			evad = true
			return (core:gsub("[%._%-%*]", ""))
		end
	end)
	s = s:gsub("[^%w%s@$!%+#]", " ")
	local _, hn = s:gsub("#", "")
	R.hash = hn >= 4 and hn / math.max(#s, 1) >= 0.3
	local toks, alts, leeted = {}, {}, {}
	for t in s:gmatch("%S+") do
		t = t:gsub("^[!%+@#]+", ""):gsub("[!%+#@]+$", "")
		if t ~= "" then
			local lt, alt = t, nil
			if t:find("%a") and t:find("[%d@$!%+]") then
				lt = t:gsub("[%d@$!%+]", LEET)
				if t:find("1", 1, true) then alt = t:gsub("[%d@$!%+]", function(c) return c == "1" and "l" or LEET[c] end) end
			end
			toks[#toks + 1], alts[#toks] = lt, alt
			leeted[#toks] = lt ~= t
		end
	end
	if #toks == 0 then return R end
	-- spaced-out letters ("i d i o t", "f.u.c.k") become one extra token
	local ex, exl, run = {}, {}, {}
	local function flush() if #run >= 3 then ex[#ex + 1] = table.concat(run) end run = {} end
	for i = 1, #toks do if #toks[i] == 1 and toks[i]:find("%w") then run[#run + 1] = toks[i] else flush() end end
	flush()
	local ct = {}
	for i, t in ipairs(toks) do ct[i] = PRON[t] or squeeze3(t) end
	local flat = " " .. table.concat(ct, " "):gsub(" you self ", " yourself ") .. " "
	local mention
	local function getMention() if mention == nil then mention = (ctx.names and ctx.names(low)) or false end return mention end
	local function directed(i)
		if getMention() then return true end
		for j = math.max(1, i - 3), math.min(#ct, i + 3) do if ct[j] == "you" or ct[j] == "yourself" then return true end end
		return false
	end
	local function before(i, st, k) for j = math.max(1, i - k), i - 1 do if st[ct[j]] then return true end end return false end
	local sc = {Harassment = 0, Threat = 0, ["Sexual content"] = 0, ["Hate speech"] = 0}
	local function bump(cat, v, why) if v > sc[cat] then sc[cat] = v end R.hits[#R.hits + 1] = why end
	local function look(db, i)
		local e = db[dd(toks[i])]
		if e and #toks[i] >= e.len then return e, leeted[i] end
		if alts[i] then e = db[dd(alts[i])] if e and #alts[i] >= e.len then return e, true end end
	end
	local function lookEx(db) for _, t in ipairs(ex) do local e = db[dd(t)] if e and #t >= e.len then return e end end end
	local insN, sexN = 0, 0
	local selfHarm = false
	for i = 1, #toks do
		local e, lv = look(INSDB, i)
		if e then
			local w = e.w
			if directed(i) then w = w + .4 elseif before(i, SELF, 2) then w = w * .3 else w = w * .8 end
			if before(i, NEG, 2) then w = w - .45 end
			insN = insN + 1
			if lv then evad = true end
			bump("Harassment", w + (insN > 1 and math.min(.2, .1 * (insN - 1)) or 0), "insult:" .. e.word)
		end
		e, lv = look(SEXDB, i)
		if e then
			sexN = sexN + 1
			if lv then evad = true end
			bump("Sexual content", e.w + math.min(.3, .15 * (sexN - 1)) + (directed(i) and .25 or 0), "sexual:" .. e.word)
		end
		e, lv = look(HATEDB, i)
		if e then
			if lv then evad = true end
			bump("Hate speech", e.w, "slur")
		end
		for _, st in ipairs(STEMS) do
			local t = squeeze(toks[i], 2)
			if t:sub(1, #st[1]) == st[1] and t:sub(1, 8) ~= "retardan" then bump("Hate speech", st[2] + (st[3] and directed(i) and .25 or 0), "slur") if leeted[i] then evad = true end break end
		end
		if GROUPS[ct[i]] then
			for j = math.max(1, i - 4), math.min(#ct, i + 4) do
				if HV1[ct[j]] and j ~= i then bump("Hate speech", before(j, NEG, 2) and .2 or .9, "group:" .. ct[j]) break end
				if HV2[ct[j]] and j ~= i then bump("Hate speech", before(j, NEG, 2) and .2 or .8, "group:" .. ct[j]) break end
			end
		end
		if VERBS[ct[i]] and before(i, SUBJ, 3) then
			local hit = false
			for j = i + 1, math.min(#ct, i + 4) do if TGT[ct[j]] then hit = true break end end
			if hit or getMention() then
				local v = .75
				for _, w in ipairs(ct) do if REALCTX[w] then v = v + .2 break end end
				for _, w in ipairs(ct) do if GAMECTX[w] then v = v - .25 break end end
				bump("Threat", v, "threat:" .. ct[i])
			end
		end
		if DOXV[ct[i]] and directed(i) then bump("Threat", .85, "dox") end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(ex) do
		local q = SQ[t]
		if q then evad = true selfHarm = selfHarm or q[3] == true bump(q[1], q[2], "spaced-phrase") end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(ex) do
		local w = exSub(INSW, t)
		if w then evad = true bump("Harassment", INS[w] + ((getMention() or flat:find(" you ", 1, true)) and .4 or .1), "insult-spaced") end
		w = exSub(SEXW, t)
		if w then evad = true bump("Sexual content", SEX[w], "sexual-spaced") end
	end
	local e = lookEx(HATEDB) if e then evad = true bump("Hate speech", e.w, "slur-spaced") end
	for _, t in ipairs(ex) do
		for _, st in ipairs(STEMS) do if t:sub(1, #st[1]) == st[1] then evad = true bump("Hate speech", st[2], "slur-spaced") break end end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(HP) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Harassment", p[2], "phrase") end end
	for _, p in ipairs(TP) do if flat:find(p, 1, true) then selfHarm = true bump("Threat", .9, "selfharm") break end end
	for _, p in ipairs(TP2) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Threat", p[2], "threat-phrase") end end
	for _, p in ipairs(SP) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Sexual content", p[2], "solicit") end end
	for _, p in ipairs(HP2) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Hate speech", p[2], "hate-phrase") end end
	-- context: quotes / discussion, jokes, game talk, questions
	local hasQ, hasJ, hasG = quote, joke, false
	for _, t in ipairs(ct) do
		if QUOTE[t] then hasQ = true end
		if JOKE[t] then hasJ = true end
		if GAMECTX[t] then hasG = true end
	end
	local qmark = low:find("%?%s*$") and (ct[1] == "what" or ct[1] == "why" or ct[1] == "is" or ct[1] == "does" or ct[1] == "how" or ct[1] == "can" or ct[1] == "should" or ct[1] == "do")
	local best, bcat = 0, nil
	for cat, v in pairs(sc) do
		if v > 0 then
			if hasQ then v = v - ((cat == "Threat" and selfHarm) and .3 or .45) end
			if hasJ then v = v - (cat == "Harassment" and .2 or (cat == "Threat" and .15 or .1)) end
			if hasG and cat == "Harassment" and not directed(1) then v = v - .2 end
			if qmark and cat ~= "Threat" then v = v - .15 end
			if evad and v > .4 then v = v + .08 end
			if v > best then best, bcat = v, cat end
		end
	end
	R.cat, R.conf, R.evad = bcat, clamp(best, 0, .99), evad
	R.target = mention or nil
	return R
end

-- ---------- helpers ----------
local function clean(text)
	text = tostring(text or ""):gsub("&lt;", "<"):gsub("&gt;", ">"):gsub("&quot;", '"'):gsub("&apos;", "'"):gsub("&amp;", "&"):gsub("<[^>]+>", "")
	return (text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")):sub(1, 300)
end
local function say(text)
	local ok = false
	local TCS = game:GetService("TextChatService")
	if TCS.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
		local ch = TCS:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
		ch = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
		if ch then ok = pcall(function() ch:SendAsync(text) end) end
	else
		local ev = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
		local rq = ev and ev:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
		if rq then ok = pcall(function() rq:FireServer(text, "All") end) end
	end
	return ok
end
local function clip(t)
	local f = setclipboard or toclipboard
	if f then return pcall(f, t) end
	return false
end
local function names(speakerId)
	return function(lowerText)
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl.UserId ~= speakerId then
				local a, b = pl.Name:lower(), pl.DisplayName:lower()
				if (#a >= 4 and lowerText:find(a, 1, true)) or (#b >= 4 and lowerText:find(b, 1, true)) then return pl end
			end
		end
	end
end
function CM.List()
	local l = {}
	for _, f in pairs(CM.Flags) do l[#l + 1] = f end
	table.sort(l, function(a, b) return a.t > b.t end)
	return l
end
function CM.Pending()
	local c = 0
	for _, x in ipairs(CM.Queue) do if x.status == "queued" then c = c + 1 end end
	return c
end
function CM.Review()
	local c = 0
	for _, x in ipairs(CM.CaseList) do if x.status == "pending" then c = c + 1 end end
	return c
end
function CM.Cur()
	local f = CM.Sel and CM.Flags[CM.Sel]
	if f then return f end
	CM.Sel = nil
	if next(CM.Flags) then return nil, "no player is selected - tap Next Flagged Player" end
	return nil, "no players have been flagged yet"
end
function CM.Ordered()
	local l = {}
	for _, f in pairs(CM.Flags) do l[#l + 1] = f end
	table.sort(l, function(a, b) return (a.seq or 0) < (b.seq or 0) end)
	return l
end
function CM.Refresh()
	pcall(function()
		if CM.UI.AR then
			local on = cfg("AutoReport") == true
			CM.UI.AR.Text = on and ("Auto Report: <b>ON</b> - watching public chat. Violations at 85%+ become cases; nothing is sent until you confirm with Report With Jarvis." .. (CM.Review() > 0 and ("  <b>" .. CM.Review() .. " awaiting review.</b>") or "") .. (CM.Pending() > 0 and ("  <b>" .. CM.Pending() .. " queued.</b>") or ""))
				or "Auto Report: <b>OFF</b> - no automatic report assistance."
		end
		if CM.UI.Status then
			CM.UI.Status.Text = ("Monitoring: <b>%s</b> | Flagged: %d | Awaiting review: %d | Reports queued: %d"):format(CM.Active and "ON" or "OFF", #CM.List(), CM.Review(), CM.Pending())
		end
		if CM.UI.Show then CM.UI.Show() end
	end)
end

-- ---------- evidence / reporting: every submission needs the user's confirmation; states: pending -> queued -> submitting -> submitted | failed | manual | left | duplicate | dismissed | cancelled ----------
CM.Seq = CM.Seq or 0
local TERMINAL = {submitted = true, failed = true, dismissed = true, left = true, duplicate = true, cancelled = true}
CM.StatusText = {pending = "awaiting your confirmation", queued = "queued", submitting = "submitting", submitted = "submitted", failed = "failed (nothing sent)", manual = "finish it in the Roblox report menu", dismissed = "dismissed", left = "player left", duplicate = "already reported", cancelled = "cancelled"}
local function stamp() return os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") end
local function pct(v) return type(v) == "number" and (tostring(math.floor(v * 100 + .5)) .. "%") or "n/a" end
CM.Pct = pct
local function snap(list, cat)
	local out = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(list or {}) do
		if cat == nil or e.cat == nil or e.cat == cat then out[#out + 1] = {ts = e.ts, text = e.text, cat = e.cat, conf = e.conf} end
	end
	return out
end
local function newId() CM.Seq = CM.Seq + 1 return ("JV-%04d"):format(CM.Seq) end
local function activeFor(uid)
	for i = #CM.CaseList, 1, -1 do
		local c = CM.CaseList[i]
		if c.uid == uid and not TERMINAL[c.status] then return c end
	end
end
CM.ActiveFor = activeFor
CM.LastSubmit = CM.LastSubmit or -1e9
CM.Reported = CM.Reported or {}
CM.NextOK, CM.RateGap, CM.MaxTries = 0, 20, 3
local REASON = {["Harassment"] = "Bullying", ["Threat"] = "Bullying", ["Sexual content"] = "Swearing", ["Hate speech"] = "Bullying"}
local function evText(f, n)
	local out = {}
	for i = #f.ev, 1, -1 do
		if f.ev[i].cat == nil or f.ev[i].cat == f.cat then out[#out + 1] = f.ev[i] end
		if #out >= n then break end
	end
	return out
end
function CM.Ident(f)
	local pl = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(f.uid)
	local name = f.name
	if name == nil or name == "" then name = pl and pl.Name end
	if name == nil or name == "" then name = "User" .. tostring(f.uid) end
	local disp = f.display
	if disp == nil or disp == "" then disp = pl and pl.DisplayName end
	if disp == nil or disp == "" then disp = name end
	return tostring(name), tostring(disp)
end
local function trim()
	local i = 1
	while #CM.CaseList > 20 and i <= #CM.CaseList do
		local d = CM.CaseList[i]
		if TERMINAL[d.status] then
			table.remove(CM.CaseList, i)
			if CM.Cases[d.key] == d then CM.Cases[d.key] = nil end
		else
			i = i + 1
		end
	end
end
local function caseFor(f)
	if f.key and f.id then return f end
	local cat = tostring(f.cat or "Other")
	local key = tostring(f.uid) .. ":" .. cat
	local c = (not f.manual and activeFor(f.uid)) or CM.Cases[key]
	if not c then
		c = {key = key, id = newId(), uid = f.uid, cat = cat, conf = f.conf, status = "pending", tries = 0, t = os.clock(), stamp = stamp(), ev = snap(f.ev, cat)}
		CM.Cases[key] = c
		CM.CaseList[#CM.CaseList + 1] = c
		trim()
	end
	c.name, c.display = CM.Ident(f)
	if f.manual then c.manual = true end
	if f.conf and (c.conf == nil or (c.status == "pending" and f.conf > c.conf)) then c.conf = f.conf end
	if #c.ev == 0 and f.ev then c.ev = snap(f.ev, c.cat) end
	return c
end
CM.CaseFor = caseFor
function CM.CaseOf(f)
	if f.key and f.id then return f end
	return activeFor(f.uid) or CM.Cases[tostring(f.uid) .. ":" .. tostring(f.cat or "Other")]
end
local function reopen(c, f)
	c.status, c.tries, c.user, c.confirmUntil, c.t = "pending", 0, nil, nil, os.clock()
	c.id, c.stamp = newId(), stamp()
	if f and not f.key and f.ev and #f.ev > 0 then c.ev = snap(f.ev, c.cat) end
end
local function dequeue(c)
	for i = #CM.Queue, 1, -1 do if CM.Queue[i] == c then table.remove(CM.Queue, i) end end
end
local function enqueue(c, front)
	for _, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do
		if q == c then return true end
		if q.uid == c.uid and q.status == "queued" then return false, q end
	end
	if front then table.insert(CM.Queue, 1, c) else CM.Queue[#CM.Queue + 1] = c end
	return true
end
function CM.Evidence(f)
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local name, disp = CM.Ident(c)
	local out = {"Public chat evidence collected by Jarvis (visible chat only)",
		("Case: %s | Status: %s | Detected: %s"):format(tostring(c.id), tostring(c.status), tostring(c.stamp)),
		("Player: %s (@%s) UserId %s"):format(disp, name, tostring(c.uid)),
		("Category: %s | Confidence: %s"):format(tostring(c.cat), pct(c.conf))}
	for _, e in ipairs(c.ev) do out[#out + 1] = ("[%s] %s"):format(tostring(e.ts), tostring(e.text)) end
	if #c.ev == 0 then out[#out + 1] = "(no public chat lines were recorded for this case)" end
	return table.concat(out, "\n"), c
end
function CM.CopyEvidence(f)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local text, c = CM.Evidence(f)
	CM.LastEvidence = text
	if clip(text) then
		notify(("Evidence for %s (@%s) copied, case %s"):format(c.display, c.name, c.id))
		return true
	end
	notify(("Chat Moderation: this executor cannot copy to the clipboard. Read the evidence for %s (@%s) in the flagged-player details above."):format(c.display, c.name))
	return false
end
-- The Roblox menu is a supported, documented thing to open; the player-report screen is not. Jarvis opens the menu, verifies it, and guides the rest.
function CM.OpenReport(f, prefix)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local text, c = CM.Evidence(f)
	CM.LastEvidence = text
	CM.ReportTarget = {uid = c.uid, name = c.name, display = c.display, cat = c.cat, conf = c.conf, id = c.id}
	local copied = clip(text) and true or false
	local here = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(c.uid) ~= nil
	task.spawn(function()
		local okSet = pcall(function() GuiService:SetMenuIsOpen(true) end)
		local state = nil
		if okSet then
			state = false
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				local okR, v = pcall(function() return GuiService.MenuIsOpen end)
				if not okR then state = nil break end
				if v == true then state = true break end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
		local lead = state == true and "The Roblox menu is open (it is the system menu, not the report screen)." or "Jarvis could not confirm that the Roblox menu opened - open it yourself (Esc, or the Roblox icon on mobile)."
		notify((prefix and (prefix .. " ") or "") .. ("%s Then tap Report > choose %s (@%s) > pick the category (suggested: %s).%s%s Case %s."):format(lead, c.display, c.name, tostring(c.cat), copied and " Evidence copied." or " Evidence could not be copied - read it in the details above.", here and "" or " They already left, so Roblox may not list them.", c.id))
	end)
	return true
end
-- ---------- reporting queue: FIFO, one submission per rate-limit window ----------
function CM.Wait()
	return math.max(0, math.max(CM.LastSubmit + CM.RateGap, CM.NextOK) - os.clock())
end
local function attempt(c)
	local pl = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(c.uid)
	if not pl then return "left" end
	local parts = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(evText(c, 3)) do parts[#parts + 1] = "[" .. tostring(e.text) .. "]" end
	local msg = ("Reported by user via Jarvis after review: %s%s%s"):format(tostring(c.cat), c.manual and "" or (" (flagged " .. pct(c.conf) .. ")"), #parts > 0 and (". Recent public chat: " .. table.concat(parts, " ")) or "")
	msg = msg:sub(1, 280)
	local err
	for _, reason in ipairs({REASON[c.cat] or "Other", "Other"}) do
		local ok, e = pcall(function() Players:ReportAbuse(pl, reason, msg) end)
		if ok then return "sent" end
		err = tostring(e)
		local l = err:lower()
		if l:find("rate", 1, true) or l:find("too many", 1, true) or l:find("429", 1, true) or l:find("retry", 1, true) or l:find("cooldown", 1, true) or l:find("throttl", 1, true) then break end
	end
	local l = (err or ""):lower()
	local wait = tonumber(l:match("retry[^%d]*(%d+)") or l:match("wait[^%d]*(%d+)") or l:match("(%d+)%s*sec"))
	if l:find("rate", 1, true) or l:find("too many", 1, true) or l:find("429", 1, true) or l:find("retry", 1, true) or l:find("cooldown", 1, true) or l:find("throttl", 1, true) then return "retry", wait, err end
	if l:find("permission") or l:find("not allowed") or l:find("disabled") or l:find("cannot be called") or l:find("blocked") or l:find("capability") or l:find("security") or l:find("lacking") then return "blocked", nil, err end
	return "retry", wait, err
end
function CM.Process(c)
	local now = os.clock()
	if not c.user then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "pending")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) needs your confirmation first - nothing was sent"):format(c.display, c.name))
		return false, "pending"
	end
	if CM.Reported[c.uid] and now - CM.Reported[c.uid] < 1800 then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "duplicate")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) was already reported in the last 30 minutes, nothing was sent"):format(c.display, c.name))
		return false, "dup"
	end
	CM.SetStatus(c, "submitting")
	local okA, res, wait, err = pcall(attempt, c)
	if not okA then res, wait, err = "retry", nil, res end
	now = os.clock()
	if res == "sent" then
		CM.LastSubmit = now
		CM.Reported[c.uid] = now
		c.by = "jarvis"
		CM.SetStatus(c, "submitted")
		notify(("Report call for %s (@%s) completed without an error (case %s). Roblox gives scripts no confirmation, so Jarvis cannot verify it was accepted."):format(c.display, c.name, c.id))
		return true
	end
	c.tries = (c.tries or 0) + 1
	local short = (tostring(err or "unknown error"):gsub("%s+", " ")):sub(1, 90)
	if res == "retry" and c.tries < CM.MaxTries then
		local w = math.clamp(wait or 30 * c.tries, 1, 900)
		CM.NextOK = now + w
		CM.SetStatus(c, "queued")
		enqueue(c, true)
		notify(("Chat Moderation: report for %s (@%s) was not accepted (%s). It is queued and will retry in about %d seconds (attempt %d of %d)"):format(c.display, c.name, short, math.ceil(w), c.tries + 1, CM.MaxTries))
		CM.Pump()
		return false, "queued"
	end
	if res == "left" then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "left")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) left before the report could be sent, nothing was sent"):format(c.display, c.name))
		return false, "left"
	end
	if res == "blocked" then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "manual")
		CM.OpenReport(c, ("Roblox does not let scripts submit this report on this client (%s). Nothing was sent."):format(short))
		return false, "manual"
	end
	CM.SetStatus(c, "failed")
	CM.OpenReport(c, ("Report for %s (@%s) failed after %d attempts (%s). Nothing was sent."):format(c.display, c.name, c.tries, short))
	return false, "failed"
end
local function nextCase()
	for i, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do
		if q.status ~= "queued" or not q.user then table.remove(CM.Queue, i) return nextCase() end
		return q, i
	end
end
local function step()
	local c, i = nextCase()
	if not c then return false end
	local w = CM.Wait()
	if w > 0 then task.wait(math.min(w, 5) + 0.05) return true end
	table.remove(CM.Queue, i)
	local ok, err = pcall(CM.Process, c)
	if not ok then
		if c.status == "submitting" or c.status == "queued" then CM.SetStatus(c, "failed") end
		notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s (@%s) hit an internal error (%s). Use Report With Jarvis to retry."):format(tostring(c.display), tostring(c.name), tostring(err):sub(1, 60)))
	end
	return true
end
function CM.Pump()
	if CM.Pumping then return end
	CM.Pumping = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local errs = 0
		while true do
			local ok, more = pcall(step)
			if not ok then
				local c = CM.Queue[1]
				if not c then break end
				errs = errs + 1
				if errs >= 3 then
					table.remove(CM.Queue, 1)
					pcall(CM.SetStatus, c, "failed")
					notify(("Chat Moderation: the queued report for %s (@%s) failed internally (%s). Use Report With Jarvis to retry."):format(tostring(c.display), tostring(c.name), tostring(more):sub(1, 60)))
					errs = 0
				end
				task.wait(1)
			elseif not more then
				break
			end
		end
		CM.Pumping = false
		CM.Refresh()
	end)
end
function CM.Left(uid)
	for _, c in ipairs(CM.CaseList) do
		if c.uid == uid and (c.status == "queued" or c.status == "pending" or c.status == "manual") then
			CM.SetStatus(c, "left")
			notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) left the server, so case %s was closed. The evidence is still available under Copy Evidence."):format(tostring(c.display), tostring(c.name), tostring(c.id)))
		end
	end
end
function CM.Submit(f, confirmed)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false, "none" end
	if type(f.uid) ~= "number" then notify("Chat Moderation: this entry has no valid UserId, nothing was sent") return false, "invalid" end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local who = ("%s (@%s)"):format(c.display, c.name)
	if not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(c.uid) then
		if not TERMINAL[c.status] then CM.SetStatus(c, "left") end
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s has left the server, nothing was sent. Copy Evidence still works."):format(who))
		return false, "left"
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if c.status == "submitting" then notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s is already being submitted"):format(who)) return false, "queued" end
	if c.status == "queued" then
		c.user = true
		notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s is already queued and will be sent when the rate limit allows"):format(who))
		CM.Pump()
		return false, "queued"
	end
	if CM.Reported[c.uid] and now - CM.Reported[c.uid] < 1800 then notify(("Chat Moderation: you already reported %s in the last 30 minutes, nothing was sent"):format(who)) return false, "dup" end
	if TERMINAL[c.status] then reopen(c, f) end
	if not confirmed then
		if not (c.confirmUntil and now <= c.confirmUntil) then
			c.confirmUntil = now + 20
			notify(("Confirm report: %s | %s | %s confidence | %d chat line(s) | case %s. Press Report With Jarvis again within 20 seconds to submit, or Dismiss Case. Nothing has been sent yet."):format(who, tostring(c.cat), pct(c.conf), #c.ev, c.id))
			CM.Refresh()
			return false, "confirm"
		end
	end
	c.confirmUntil = nil
	c.user, c.tries = true, 0
	local ahead = false
	for _, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do if q.status == "queued" and q.user then ahead = true break end end
	if ahead or CM.Wait() > 0 then
		local okq, other = enqueue(c)
		if not okq then notify(("Chat Moderation: a report for %s is already queued"):format(who)) return false, "queued" end
		CM.SetStatus(c, "queued")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: report for %s is queued and will be sent when the rate limit allows (about %d seconds)"):format(who, math.ceil(CM.Wait())))
		CM.Pump()
		return false, "queued"
	end
	return CM.Process(c)
end
function CM.SetStatus(f, st)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	c.status, c.t = st, os.clock()
	if st ~= "queued" then dequeue(c) end
	CM.Refresh()
	return c
end
function CM.Dismiss(f)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local who = ("%s (@%s)"):format(c.display, c.name)
	if c.status == "submitting" then notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s is being submitted right now, it cannot be dismissed"):format(who)) return false end
	if c.status == "submitted" then notify(("Chat Moderation: case %s is already marked submitted"):format(c.id)) return false end
	if c.status == "dismissed" then notify(("Chat Moderation: case %s is already dismissed"):format(c.id)) return false end
	c.confirmUntil = nil
	CM.SetStatus(c, "dismissed")
	notify(("Case %s dismissed: %s. Nothing was sent."):format(c.id, who))
	return true
end
function CM.MarkSubmitted(f)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local who = ("%s (@%s)"):format(c.display, c.name)
	if c.status == "submitted" then notify(("Chat Moderation: case %s is already marked submitted"):format(c.id)) return false end
	if c.status == "submitting" then notify(("Chat Moderation: Jarvis is submitting the report for %s right now - wait for the result"):format(who)) return false end
	c.by, c.user, c.confirmUntil = "user", true, nil
	CM.Reported[c.uid] = os.clock()
	CM.SetStatus(c, "submitted")
	notify(("Case %s marked as submitted by you: %s. Roblox gives scripts no confirmation, so Jarvis cannot verify it."):format(c.id, who))
	return true
end
function CM.SendManual(f)
	local now = os.clock()
	local t = CM.PendingSay
	if not t and f then
		local _, disp = CM.Ident(f)
		t = "Jarvis: @" .. disp .. ", please keep the conversation respectful."
	end
	if not t then notify("Chat Moderation: no reminder is waiting and no player is selected") return false end
	if now - CM.LastSay < 10 then notify(("Chat Moderation: wait %d more seconds before sending another reminder"):format(math.ceil(10 - (now - CM.LastSay)))) return false end
	if say(t) then CM.PendingSay, CM.LastSay = nil, now notify("Reminder sent to public chat") return true end
	clip(t)
	notify("Chat is unavailable here; the reminder was copied instead")
	return false
end

-- ---------- per-message handling (also the unit-test entry point) ----------
local function remind(f)
	if cfg("CModOn") ~= true or cfg("CModSay") ~= true then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - CM.LastSay < 45 or (f.say and now - f.say < 300) then return end
	local log, kept = CM.SayLog, {}
	for _, t in ipairs(log) do if now - t < 600 then kept[#kept + 1] = t end end
	CM.SayLog = kept
	if #kept >= 5 then return end
	local recent = 0
	for _, t in ipairs(f.hist) do if now - t < 600 then recent = recent + 1 end end
	local text = recent >= 3 and "Jarvis: Reminder: Harassment and inappropriate language are not acceptable here."
		or (recent == 2 and ("Jarvis: @" .. f.display .. ", please keep the conversation respectful.") or "Jarvis: Please keep the chat respectful and appropriate for everyone.")
	f.say, CM.LastSay = now, now
	kept[#kept + 1] = now
	CM.LastReminder = text
	task.spawn(function()
		if not say(text) then CM.PendingSay = text notify("Jarvis could not send the chat reminder. Use Chat Moderation > Send Reminder Manually.") end
	end)
end
local function prompt(f, R)
	if cfg("AutoReport") ~= true or R.conf + 1e-6 < REPORT_MIN or not REPORTABLE[R.cat] then return end
	if not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(f.uid) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if CM.Reported[f.uid] and now - CM.Reported[f.uid] < 1800 then return end
	if activeFor(f.uid) then return end
	for _, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do if q.uid == f.uid then return end end
	local key = tostring(f.uid) .. ":" .. R.cat
	local old = CM.Cases[key]
	if old and TERMINAL[old.status] and old.status ~= "left" and now - old.t < 1800 then return end
	if old then
		for i = #CM.CaseList, 1, -1 do if CM.CaseList[i] == old then table.remove(CM.CaseList, i) end end
		CM.Cases[key] = nil
	end
	local name, disp = CM.Ident(f)
	local c = caseFor({uid = f.uid, name = name, display = disp, cat = R.cat, conf = R.conf, ev = f.ev})
	if not CM.Cur() then CM.Sel = f.uid end
	notify(("Auto Report: %s (@%s) flagged for %s (%d%% confidence), case %s. Nothing has been sent - select them under Chat Moderation and press Report With Jarvis to confirm."):format(disp, name, R.cat, math.floor(R.conf * 100 + .5), c.id))
end
function CM.Handle(uid, name, display, text, mid)
	local key = mid or (uid .. ":" .. tostring(text))
	if CM.Seen[key] then return end
	CM.Seen[key] = true
	local q = CM.SeenQ
	q[#q + 1] = key
	if #q > SEEN_MAX then CM.Seen[table.remove(q, 1)] = nil end
	text = clean(text)
	if #text < 2 or text:lower():sub(1, 7) == "jarvis:" then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local R = CM.Analyze(text, {names = names(uid)})
	local st = CM.Strikes[uid] or {}
	local kept = {}
	for _, x in ipairs(st) do if now - x.t < 180 then kept[#kept + 1] = x end end
	CM.Strikes[uid] = kept
	if R.hash and not R.cat then
		kept[#kept + 1] = {t = now, hash = true}
		local h = 0
		for _, x in ipairs(kept) do if x.hash and now - x.t < 90 then h = h + 1 end end
		if h >= 3 then R.cat, R.conf = "Filter bypass", .76 end
	end
	if not R.cat then return end
	if R.cat ~= "Filter bypass" then
		if R.conf >= .55 then
			local prior = 0
			for _, x in ipairs(kept) do if not x.hash then prior = prior + 1 end end
			R.conf = math.min(.99, R.conf + math.min(.2, .07 * prior))
			kept[#kept + 1] = {t = now, cat = R.cat}
		end
	end
	if R.conf + 1e-6 < LEVELS[clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg("CModConf")) or 2), 1, 3)] then return end
	local f = CM.Flags[uid]
	if not f then
		local c = 0
		for _ in pairs(CM.Flags) do c = c + 1 end
		if c >= FLAG_MAX then
			local l = CM.List()
			local drop
			for i = #l, 1, -1 do if not activeFor(l[i].uid) then drop = l[i] break end end
			drop = drop or l[#l]
			if drop then CM.Flags[drop.uid] = nil end
		end
		CM.FlagSeq = (CM.FlagSeq or 0) + 1
		f = {uid = uid, n = 0, ev = {}, hist = {}, seq = CM.FlagSeq}
		CM.Flags[uid] = f
	end
	f.name, f.display, f.t, f.n = name, display, now, f.n + 1
	if f.cat == nil or f.cat == R.cat then f.cat, f.conf = R.cat, math.max(f.conf or 0, R.conf)
	elseif R.conf > (f.conf or 0) then f.cat, f.conf = R.cat, R.conf end
	f.hist[#f.hist + 1] = now
	if #f.hist > 8 then table.remove(f.hist, 1) end
	local entry = {ts = os.date("%H:%M:%S"), text = text:sub(1, 160), cat = R.cat, conf = R.conf}
	f.ev[#f.ev + 1] = entry
	if #f.ev > EVID_MAX then table.remove(f.ev, 1) end
	local pc = activeFor(uid)
	if pc and pc.status == "pending" and pc.cat == R.cat then
		pc.ev[#pc.ev + 1] = {ts = entry.ts, text = entry.text, cat = entry.cat, conf = entry.conf}
		if #pc.ev > 8 then table.remove(pc.ev, 1) end
		pc.conf = math.max(pc.conf or 0, R.conf)
	end
	remind(f)
	prompt(f, R)
	CM.Refresh()
	return R
end

-- ---------- event wiring (single connection set, fully disconnected when both switches are off) ----------
local function onTextChat(m)
	local src = m.TextSource
	if not src or src.UserId == Player.UserId or m.Status == Enum.TextChatMessageStatus.Sending then return end
	local ch = m.TextChannel
	if not ch or ch.Name ~= "RBXGeneral" then return end
	local pl = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(src.UserId)
	if pl then pcall(CM.Handle, pl.UserId, pl.Name, pl.DisplayName, m.Text, m.MessageId) end
end
function CM.Enable()
	if CM.Active then return end
	CM.Active = true
	local cs = CM.Conns
	if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService then
		local function hook(pl)
			if pl == Player then return end
			cs[#cs + 1] = pl.Chatted:Connect(function(msg, rcpt) if rcpt == nil then CM.LegacySeq = (CM.LegacySeq or 0) + 1 pcall(CM.Handle, pl.UserId, pl.Name, pl.DisplayName, msg, "L" .. CM.LegacySeq) end end)
		end
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hook(pl) end
		cs[#cs + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)
	else
		cs[#cs + 1] = TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(onTextChat)
	end
	cs[#cs + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl) CM.Strikes[pl.UserId] = nil pcall(CM.Left, pl.UserId) end)
end
function CM.Disable()
	for _, c in ipairs(CM.Conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	CM.Conns, CM.Seen, CM.SeenQ, CM.Strikes, CM.Active = {}, {}, {}, {}, false
end
function CM.Sync()
	local want = cfg("CModOn") == true or cfg("AutoReport") == true
	if want then CM.Enable() else CM.Disable() end
	if cfg("AutoReport") == true then CM.Pump() end
	CM.Refresh()
end
function CM.Announce()
	if not CM.Active then return end
	local on = function(k) return cfg(k) == true and "ON" or "OFF" end
	local text = ("JARVIS: Chat moderation is active. Auto Report %s | Chat Monitoring %s | Public Reminders %s. Change them in Main > Performance."):format(on("AutoReport"), on("CModOn"), on("CModSay"))
	notify(text)
	pcall(function()
		local TCS = game:GetService("TextChatService")
		local ch = TCS.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService and TCS:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
		ch = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
		if ch then ch:DisplaySystemMessage(text) else StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {Text = text}) end
	end)
end
function CM.Clear()
	local nf, nq, keep = 0, 0, {}
	for _ in pairs(CM.Flags) do nf = nf + 1 end
	for _, c in ipairs(CM.CaseList) do
		if c.status == "queued" then c.status, nq = "cancelled", nq + 1 end
		if c.status == "submitting" then keep[#keep + 1] = c end
	end
	CM.Queue, CM.Flags, CM.Cases, CM.CaseList, CM.Sel = {}, {}, {}, keep, nil
	for _, c in ipairs(keep) do CM.Cases[c.key] = c end
	CM.Refresh()
	return nf, nq
end
return CM
end)()
