-- =====================================================================
-- TTS  (1: Edge neural en-GB male (Ryan) via your Worker; 2: keyless British male 'Brian'; 3: last resort, Google's keyless en-GB voice pitched down)
-- =====================================================================
local TTS = {gen = 0, speaking = false, sound = nil, onState = nil}
-- The real British-male Jarvis voice comes from the Cloud TTS Worker (jarvis_tts_worker.js).
-- Google's keyless Translate voice only has one female-sounding register, so when it is the fallback it is pitched down (Octave 1 = unchanged, 0.5 = one octave lower).
local FALLBACK_OCTAVE = 0.76
local BRIAN_OCTAVE = 0.93
local function hash(s)
local h1, h2 = 2166136261, 5381
for i = 1, #s do
local b = s:byte(i)
h1 = (bit32.bxor(h1, b) * 16777619) % 4294967296
h2 = (h2 * 33 + b) % 4294967296
end
return string.format("%08x%08x", h1, h2)
end
local function ensureDir()
local mf, isf = fn("makefolder"), fn("isfolder")
if mf and isf then
pcall(function()
if not isf(DIR) then mf(DIR) end
if not isf(TTS_DIR) then mf(TTS_DIR) end
end)
end
end
local function touch(key)
local idx = SaveData.JarvisTTSIdx
if type(idx) ~= "table" then idx = {} SaveData.JarvisTTSIdx = idx end
for i = #idx, 1, -1 do
if idx[i] == key then table.remove(idx, i) end
end
idx[#idx + 1] = key
while #idx > 40 do
local old = table.remove(idx, 1)
local d = fn("delfile")
if d then pcall(d, TTS_DIR .. "/" .. old .. ".mp3") end
end
end
local TTS_DEFAULT = "https://jarvis-tts.elliptmal.workers.dev"
local TTS_REPO = {"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elliot12-wq/Jarvis-tts/main/README.md", "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elliot12-wq/Jarvis-tts/main/wrangler.toml"}
local function endpoint()
local u = SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl
if type(u) == "string" and u:match("^https?://") then return (u:gsub("/+$", "")) end
return TTS.autoUrl or TTS_DEFAULT
end
local function validMp3(b) return type(b) == "string" and #b > 600 and (b:sub(1, 3) == "ID3" or b:byte(1) == 255) end
local function httpGet(url)
local rq = fn("request") or fn("http_request") or (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request) or nil
if not rq then return nil end
local ok, res = pcall(rq, {Url = url, Method = "GET", Headers = {["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0"}})
if ok and type(res) == "table" then
local st = res.StatusCode or res.Status
if st == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string" then return res.Body, st, nil, res.Headers end
return nil, st, type(res.Body) == "string" and res.Body or nil, res.Headers
end
return nil
end
local function discover()
local mu = SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl
if type(mu) == "string" and mu:match("^https?://") then return end
if TTS.discovering then
local t0 = os.clock()
while TTS.discovering and os.clock() - t0 < 8 do task.wait(0.05) end
return
end
TTS.discovering = true
TTS.dAt = os.clock()
for _, url in ipairs(TTS_REPO) do
local body = httpGet(url)
local found = type(body) == "string" and body:match("https://[%w%-%.]+%.workers%.dev")
if found then TTS.autoUrl = found break end
end
TTS.discovering = false
end
task.spawn(discover)
local function resolve(seg)
local isf, wf = fn("isfile"), fn("writefile")
if not (isf and wf) then return nil, "files" end
ensureDir()
if not endpoint() and (not TTS.dAt or os.clock() - TTS.dAt > 60) then discover() end
local ep = endpoint()
local srcs = {}
if ep then srcs[#srcs + 1] = {"gc", ep .. "/?t=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(seg)} end
srcs[#srcs + 1] = {"se", "https://api.streamelements.com/kappa/v2/speech?voice=Brian&text=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(seg)}
srcs[#srcs + 1] = {"gt", "https://translate.google.com/translate_tts?ie=UTF-8&client=tw-ob&tl=en-GB&q=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(seg:sub(1, 190))}
for _, s in ipairs(srcs) do
local key = hash(s[1] .. "|j6|" .. seg)
local path = TTS_DIR .. "/" .. key .. ".mp3"
if safe(isf, path) then touch(key) return path, s[1] end
local body, st, eb, hd = httpGet(s[2])
local eng
if s[1] == "gc" and type(hd) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(hd) do if tostring(k):lower() == "x-jarvis-engine" then eng = tostring(v):lower() end end end
local good = validMp3(body) or (eng == "edge" and type(body) == "string" and #body > 600)
if s[1] == "gc" and not good then
local extra = ""
if type(eb) == "string" and eb ~= "" then extra = ": " .. eb:sub(1, 90)
elseif type(body) == "string" then extra = " bad audio, " .. #body .. " bytes, starts " .. body:sub(1, 4):gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02x ", c:byte()) end) end
TTS.gcErr = tostring(st or "no response") .. extra
end
if good then
if s[1] == "gc" then
TTS.gcEngine = eng
if eng and eng ~= "edge" then key = key .. "_f" path = TTS_DIR .. "/" .. key .. ".mp3" end
end
if pcall(wf, path, body) then touch(key) return path, s[1] end
end
end
return nil, "net"
end
local function noteSource(tag)
local fb = tag == "gc" and TTS.gcEngine and TTS.gcEngine ~= "edge"
local tk = fb and "gcf" or tag
if TTS.lastTag == tk then return end
TTS.lastTag = tk
local m
if fb then m = "Voice: your server answered with its plain " .. TTS.gcEngine .. " fallback, not the Edge butler voice."
elseif tag == "gc" then m = "Voice: your Edge TTS voice server (British butler)."
else
local why = endpoint() and (" Your voice server failed: " .. tostring(TTS.gcErr or "no response") .. ".") or " No voice server is set; add one for the real butler voice."
if tag == "se" then m = "Voice: keyless British male (Brian)." .. why
else m = "Voice: last-resort pitched-down Google voice." .. why end
end
if Live.onVoiceSource then pcall(Live.onVoiceSource, m) end
end
local function splitSpeech(text, B, L)
B = B or 170 L = L or 190
local out, buf = {}, ""
for sent in text:gmatch("[^%.%!%?]+[%.%!%?]*%s*") do
sent = trim(sent)
if sent ~= "" then
if buf ~= "" and #buf + #sent + 1 > B then out[#out + 1] = buf buf = sent
else buf = (buf == "") and sent or (buf .. " " .. sent) end
end
end
if buf ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = buf end
local res = {}
for _, s in ipairs(out) do
while #s > L do
local cutAt = s:sub(1, L):match("^.*()%s") or L
res[#res + 1] = trim(s:sub(1, cutAt))
s = trim(s:sub(cutAt + 1))
end
if s ~= "" then res[#res + 1] = s end
end
while #res > 3 do table.remove(res) end
return res
end
local function ensureSound()
if TTS.sound and TTS.sound.Parent then return TTS.sound end
local s = Util.Instance("Sound", SoundService)
s.Name = "JarvisVoice"
s.Volume = 1
TTS.sound = s
return s
end
local function applyVoiceFx(s, tag)
local oct = (tag == "gt" and FALLBACK_OCTAVE) or (tag == "se" and BRIAN_OCTAVE) or 1
local deep = oct ~= 1
pcall(function()
local ps = s:FindFirstChild("JarvisPitch")
if not ps then
if not deep then return end
ps = Util.Instance("PitchShiftSoundEffect", s)
ps.Name = "JarvisPitch"
end
ps.Octave = oct
ps.Enabled = deep
end)
pcall(function()
local eq = s:FindFirstChild("JarvisEQ")
if not eq then
if not deep then return end
eq = Util.Instance("EqualizerSoundEffect", s)
eq.Name = "JarvisEQ"
end
if tag == "se" then eq.LowGain, eq.MidGain, eq.HighGain = 3, 0, -2 else eq.LowGain, eq.MidGain, eq.HighGain = 5, -1, -4 end
eq.Enabled = deep
end)
end
local function play(path, gen, tag)
local ga = fn("getcustomasset") or fn("getsynasset")
if not ga then return false, "assets" end
local ok, id = pcall(ga, path)
if not ok or not id then return false, "assets" end
local s = ensureSound()
s:Stop()
applyVoiceFx(s, tag)
s.SoundId = id
local t0 = os.clock()
while not s.IsLoaded and os.clock() - t0 < 6 and TTS.gen == gen do task.wait(0.05) end
if TTS.gen ~= gen then return true end
if not s.IsLoaded then return false, "load" end
s.TimePosition = 0
s:Play()
local done = false
local c = s.Ended:Connect(function() done = true end)
local limit = os.clock() + math.max(2, s.TimeLength) + 3
while not done and TTS.gen == gen and os.clock() < limit do task.wait(0.05) end
c:Disconnect()
return true
end
function TTS.Stop()
TTS.gen += 1
if TTS.sound then pcall(function() TTS.sound:Stop() end) end
if TTS.speaking then
TTS.speaking = false
if TTS.onState then pcall(TTS.onState, false) end
end
end
function TTS.Speak(text)
if SaveData.JarvisVoice == false then return end
local segs = endpoint() and splitSpeech(spoken(text), 300, 420) or splitSpeech(spoken(text))
if #segs == 0 then return end
TTS.Stop()
local gen = TTS.gen
TTS.speaking = true
if TTS.onState then pcall(TTS.onState, true) end
task.spawn(function()
local paths, tags = {}, {}
local function prep(i)
if i > #segs or paths[i] ~= nil then return end
paths[i] = false
task.spawn(function()
local p, why = resolve(segs[i])
if p then tags[i] = why noteSource(why) end
paths[i] = p or ("!" .. tostring(why))
end)
end
prep(1) prep(2)
local fail
for i = 1, #segs do
local t0 = os.clock()
while paths[i] == false and TTS.gen == gen and os.clock() - t0 < 14 do task.wait(0.05) end
if TTS.gen ~= gen then return end
local p = paths[i]
if type(p) ~= "string" or p:sub(1, 1) == "!" then fail = (type(p) == "string") and p or "!net" break end
prep(i + 1)
local ok, why = play(p, gen, tags[i])
if TTS.gen ~= gen then return end
if not ok then fail = "!" .. tostring(why) break end
end
if TTS.gen == gen then
TTS.speaking = false
if TTS.onState then pcall(TTS.onState, false) end
if fail and Live.onVoiceFail then Live.onVoiceFail(fail) end
end
end)
end

-- =====================================================================
-- LIVE SCRIPT AWARENESS
-- =====================================================================
local function S() return Util.Search end
local function alive(e)
local ok, r = pcall(function() return e.Obj:IsDescendantOf(UIMainFrame) end)
return ok and r == true
end
local function whereOf(e)
local page
local p = e.Parent
local g = 0
local titles = S() and S().Titles or {}
while p ~= nil and p ~= UIMainFrame and g < 40 do
local t = titles[p]
if t then page = t end
p = p.Parent
g += 1
end
local sec = e.Section
if page and sec and sec ~= page then return page .. " > " .. sec end
return sec or page or "Settings"
end
local function labelOf(e) return safe(e.GetName) or "" end
local function entries()
local list = {}
for _, e in ipairs(S() and S().Entries or {}) do
if alive(e) then list[#list + 1] = e end
end
return list
end
local function switchOn(e) return safe(function() return e.Lever.Value end) == true end
local function onSwitches()
local out = {}
for _, e in ipairs(entries()) do
if e.Kind == "switch" and switchOn(e) then out[#out + 1] = e end
end
return out
end
local HEAVY = {"particle", "glow", "sheen", "trail", "liquid", "glass", "bloom", "blur", "shadow", "dance", "hitbox", "monitor", "esp"}
local function snapshot(full)
local s = {}
local ps = safe(function() return Util.FX.Perf.Status() end)
s.fps = (ps and ps.FPS) or Live.fpsAvg
s.profile = ps and ps.Name or nil
s.manual = ps and ps.Mode == "manual"
s.mem = safe(function() return Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)
s.ping = safe(function() return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
local now, errs, warns = os.clock(), 0, 0
for _, l in ipairs(Logs) do
if now - l.t < 90 then if l.e then errs += 1 else warns += 1 end end
end
s.errs, s.warns = errs, warns
if full then
local on = onSwitches()
s.on = on
Live.onCount = #on
s.heavy = {}
for _, e in ipairs(on) do
local l = labelOf(e):lower()
for _, h in ipairs(HEAVY) do
if l:find(h, 1, true) then s.heavy[#s.heavy + 1] = e break end
end
end
local hum = lp and lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
s.char = {hp = math.floor(hum.Health), maxhp = math.floor(hum.MaxHealth), speed = math.floor(hum.WalkSpeed), state = tostring(hum:GetState()):gsub("Enum.HumanoidStateType.", "")}
end
s.players = #Players:GetPlayers()
s.status = safe(Util.GetModuleStatus)
end
return s
end
local function findByLabel(...)
local want = {...}
for _, e in ipairs(entries()) do
local l = labelOf(e):lower()
local okAll = true
for _, w in ipairs(want) do if not l:find(w, 1, true) then okAll = false break end end
if okAll then return e end
end
return nil
end
local function names(list, n)
local out = {}
for i, e in ipairs(list) do
if i > n then out[#out + 1] = "and " .. (#list - n) .. " more" break end
out[#out + 1] = labelOf(e)
end
return table.concat(out, ", ")
end
local ERRMAP = {
{"attempt to index nil", "a script tried to use something that doesn't exist yet - usually a game object that hasn't loaded or was removed"},
{"attempt to call a nil", "a function the script expected isn't available - often an executor feature or a module that failed to load"},
{"attempt to compare", "a value had an unexpected type during a comparison - usually harmless once the data loads"},
{"is not a valid member", "the game doesn't have an object the script looked for - likely a game-specific difference"},
{"infinite yield", "something is waiting for an object that never appears in this game"},
{"http 429", "a web service is rate-limiting requests - waiting a minute usually fixes it"},
{"http 403", "a web service refused the request - possibly blocked or needs authorisation"},
{"http 404", "a file or page wasn't found online - the link may have moved"},
{"httpservice", "a web request failed - check your connection or whether HTTP is allowed here"},
{"failed to load", "an asset couldn't be loaded - the asset may be unavailable or your connection is slow"},
{"loadstring", "a downloaded script couldn't be compiled - it may be corrupt or your executor blocks loadstring"},
{"timeout", "an operation took too long - usually a slow connection"},
}
local function explainLog(m)
local l = m:lower()
for _, p in ipairs(ERRMAP) do
if l:find(p[1], 1, true) then return p[2] end
end
return nil
end
local function diagnose()
local s = snapshot(true)
local parts = {}
local fps = s.fps
local verdict
if fps and fps >= 50 then verdict = "Frame rate looks healthy at about " .. math.floor(fps) .. " FPS."
elseif fps and fps >= 30 then verdict = "Frame rate is moderate at about " .. math.floor(fps) .. " FPS."
elseif fps then verdict = "Frame rate is low at about " .. math.floor(fps) .. " FPS."
else verdict = "I can't read the frame rate right now." end
parts[#parts + 1] = verdict
local causes = {}
if s.ping and s.ping > 200 then causes[#causes + 1] = "your connection to the server is slow (ping " .. math.floor(s.ping) .. " ms), which causes lag no setting here can fix" end
if s.mem and s.mem > 1800 then causes[#causes + 1] = "memory use is high at " .. math.floor(s.mem) .. " MB, which strains weaker devices" end
if #s.heavy > 0 then causes[#causes + 1] = #s.heavy .. " visual feature" .. (#s.heavy > 1 and "s are" or " is") .. " running (" .. names(s.heavy, 4) .. ")" end
if s.errs >= 5 then causes[#causes + 1] = s.errs .. " script errors in the last minute may be stalling things" end
if #causes == 0 then
parts[#parts + 1] = (fps and fps < 30) and "I don't see an obvious script-side cause, so the game itself or the device is the likely bottleneck." or "I don't see anything unusual in the script."
else
parts[#parts + 1] = "Likely causes: " .. table.concat(causes, "; ") .. "."
end
if s.profile then parts[#parts + 1] = "Performance profile: " .. tostring(s.profile) .. (s.manual and " (manual)." or " (auto).") end
if (fps and fps < 45) or #s.heavy > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "Say \"optimize\" and I'll propose what to switch off." end
return table.concat(parts, " ")
end
local pending, undoStack = nil, {}
local function pushUndo(label, f)
undoStack[#undoStack + 1] = {label = label, f = f}
if #undoStack > 10 then table.remove(undoStack, 1) end
end
local function setSwitch(e, want)
local lever = e.Lever
if lever.Value == want then return "same" end
local old = lever.Value
lever.Value = want
task.wait(0.15)
if lever.Value ~= want then return "failed" end
pushUndo(labelOf(e), function() lever.Value = old end)
return "ok"
end
local function optimizePlan()
local s = snapshot(true)
local plan = {}
local lo = findByLabel("low end ui mode")
if lo and lo.Kind == "switch" and not switchOn(lo) and ((s.fps and s.fps < 45) or (s.mem and s.mem > 1500) or #s.heavy > 0) then plan[#plan + 1] = {e = lo, want = true} end
for _, e in ipairs(s.heavy) do
local l = labelOf(e):lower()
if not l:find("fast", 1, true) and not l:find("monitor", 1, true) and #plan < 6 then plan[#plan + 1] = {e = e, want = false} end
end
return plan, s
end

-- =====================================================================
-- NATURAL LANGUAGE UNDERSTANDING
-- =====================================================================
local STOPW = setOf("the a an my me i please jarvis hey ok okay can could would will you your to for of it its this that these those now just some then so and with in at by is are be does did really kindly also maybe might should up down thanks thank want need like")
local VERBS = {
{"off", {"turn off", "switch off", "shut off", "power off", "turn it off", "disable", "deactivate", "disengage", "stop", "hide", "remove", "get rid of"}},
{"on", {"turn on", "switch on", "power on", "turn it on", "enable", "activate", "engage"}},
{"toggle", {"toggle", "flip"}},
{"set", {"set", "change", "adjust", "make", "switch to", "select", "choose", "put", "go with", "switch back to"}},
{"open", {"open", "go to", "take me to", "show me", "show", "bring up", "pull up", "navigate to", "navigate", "visit", "head to"}},
{"run", {"run", "press", "click on", "click", "tap", "hit", "execute", "perform", "trigger", "start", "begin", "launch", "fire", "use"}},
}
local GROUPS = {
{trig = {"visual effects", "visual effect", "visuals", "fancy effects", "eye candy", "graphical effects", "effects"}, any = {"particle", "glow", "sheen", "trail", "liquid", "glass", "bloom", "blur"}, multi = true},
{trig = {"lite mode", "light mode", "lightweight mode", "low end mode", "low spec mode", "potato mode", "performance mode", "lite", "lightweight"}, phrase = "low end ui mode", state = true},
{trig = {"normal mode", "full mode", "full quality", "high quality mode", "ultra mode"}, phrase = "low end ui mode", state = false},
{trig = {"settings", "options", "preferences", "configuration", "customize", "customise"}, any = {"settings", "customization", "options", "config"}},
}
local YES = setOf("yes yeah yep yup confirm confirmed proceed sure affirmative absolutely")
local NO = setOf("no nope cancel abort negative nah")
local function near(a, b)
if a == b then return 3 end
local la, lb = #a, #b
if la < 4 or lb < 4 then return 0 end
local m = math.min(la, lb)
if m >= 5 and a:sub(1, m) == b:sub(1, m) and math.abs(la - lb) <= 3 then return 2 end
if math.abs(la - lb) > 1 or la < 5 then return 0 end
local i = 1
while i <= la and i <= lb and a:byte(i) == b:byte(i) do i += 1 end
if la == lb then return (a:sub(i + 1) == b:sub(i + 1)) and 2 or 0
elseif la > lb then return (a:sub(i + 1) == b:sub(i)) and 2 or 0
else return (b:sub(i + 1) == a:sub(i)) and 2 or 0 end
end
local function stem(w)
if #w > 3 and w:sub(-1) == "s" and w:sub(-2) ~= "ss" then w = w:sub(1, -2) end
return w
end
local function toks(str)
local out, seen = {}, {}
for w in str:gmatch("%S+") do
w = stem(w:gsub("%.+$", ""))
if w ~= "" and not seen[w] then seen[w] = true out[#out + 1] = w end
end
return out
end
local function parse(t)
local verb
for _, grp in ipairs(VERBS) do
local ph = has(t, grp[2])
if ph then verb = grp[1] t = cut(t, ph) break end
end
local state
local number
do
local probe = t
if not verb then
if has(probe, {"off"}) then probe = cut(probe, "off") elseif has(probe, {"on"}) then probe = cut(probe, "on") end
end
number = tonumber(probe:match("%-?%d+%.?%d*"))
end
for gi, g in ipairs(GROUPS) do
local ph = has(t, g.trig)
if ph then
state = g.state
t = cut(t, ph) .. (g.phrase and (" " .. g.phrase) or (" zzg" .. gi))
break
end
end
if not verb then
if has(t, {"off"}) then verb = "off" t = cut(t, "off")
elseif has(t, {"on"}) then verb = "on" t = cut(t, "on") end
end
local slots = {}
for _, w in ipairs(toks(t)) do
if not STOPW[w] and not w:match("^%d") then
local gi = w:match("^zzg(%d+)$")
if gi then
local g = GROUPS[tonumber(gi)]
slots[#slots + 1] = {alts = g.any, group = g}
else
slots[#slots + 1] = {alts = {w}}
end
end
end
return verb, slots, number, state, t
end
local function kindOk(e, verb)
local k = e.Kind
if verb == "on" or verb == "off" or verb == "toggle" then return k == "switch" end
if verb == "set" then return k == "dropdown" or k == "input" or k == "switch" end
if verb == "open" then return k == "button" or k == "item" end
if verb == "run" then return k == "button" or k == "item" or k == "switch" end
return true
end
local function labelToks(e)
local l = labelOf(e)
local c = e._jl
if c and c.l == l then return c end
c = {l = l, n = norm(l), t = toks(norm(l))}
local ok, raw = pcall(function() return e.Obj.Text end)
c.navy = ok and type(raw) == "string" and (raw:find("&gt;%s*$") ~= nil or raw:find(">%s*$") ~= nil)
e._jl = c
return c
end
local function findEntries(slots, verb, list)
if #slots == 0 then return {} end
local joined = {}
for _, s in ipairs(slots) do joined[#joined + 1] = s.alts[1] end
local q = table.concat(joined, " ")
local out = {}
for _, e in ipairs(list) do
if kindOk(e, verb) then
local m = labelToks(e)
if m.n ~= "" then
local hit = 0
for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
local got = 0
for _, a in ipairs(s.alts) do
for _, lt in ipairs(m.t) do
local n = near(a, lt)
if n > got then got = n end
end
end
if got > 0 then hit += (got == 3) and 1 or 0.85 end
end
local cov = hit / #slots
local need = (#slots <= 2) and 1 or 0.6
if hit > 0 and cov >= need - 0.001 then
local sc = cov * 2 + ((m.n == q) and 1 or 0) + ((m.navy and verb == "open") and 0.3 or 0) - 0.04 * math.max(0, #m.t - hit)
out[#out + 1] = {e = e, score = sc, label = m.l}
end
end
end
end
table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
return out
end
local function closest(slots, list)
local out = {}
for _, e in ipairs(list) do
local m = labelToks(e)
local hit = 0
for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
for _, a in ipairs(s.alts) do
for _, lt in ipairs(m.t) do if near(a, lt) > 0 then hit += 1 end end
end
end
if hit > 0 then out[#out + 1] = {label = m.l, hit = hit} end
end
table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.hit > b.hit end)
local names2, seen = {}, {}
for _, o in ipairs(out) do
if not seen[o.label] and #names2 < 3 then seen[o.label] = true names2[#names2 + 1] = o.label end
end
return names2
end
local function fire(signal, ...)
local args = table.pack(...)
local fs = fn("firesignal")
if fs and pcall(fs, signal, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) then return true end
local gc = fn("getconnections")
if gc then
local ok, conns = pcall(gc, signal)
if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
local fired = false
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
if pcall(function() c:Fire(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) end) then fired = true end
end
return fired
end
end
return false
end
local RISKY = {"clear all", "delete", "reset", "kill all", "server hop", "rejoin", "run all", "respawn", "buy", "purchase", "uninstall", "wipe", "redownload", "reload", "format"}
local function isRisky(label)
local l = label:lower()
local list = RISKY
if S() and type(S().Risky) == "table" then list = S().Risky end
for _, w in ipairs(list) do if l:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end
for _, w in ipairs(RISKY) do if l:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end
return false
end
local OKW = {"Certainly.", "Right away.", "Done.", "Of course.", "Consider it done."}
local function onoff(v) return v and "on" or "off" end

-- ---------- execution of one UI entry ----------
local function applyEntry(e, verb, number, state, raw)
local label = labelOf(e)
local k = e.Kind
if k == "switch" then
local want
if verb == "on" or verb == "run" then want = true
elseif verb == "off" then want = false
elseif verb == "toggle" then want = not switchOn(e)
elseif verb == "set" then if state ~= nil then want = state else want = true end
else
return {text = label .. " is currently " .. onoff(switchOn(e)) .. ". Tell me to enable or disable it."}
end
local r = setSwitch(e, want)
if r == "same" then return {text = label .. " is already " .. onoff(want) .. "."} end
if r == "failed" then return {text = "I tried to switch " .. label .. " " .. onoff(want) .. ", but it didn't stay that way. The script may have reverted it."} end
return {text = pick(OKW) .. " " .. label .. " is now " .. onoff(want) .. "."}
elseif k == "button" or k == "item" then
if verb == "off" or verb == "on" or verb == "toggle" then
return {text = label .. " is a button, not a switch. Say \"run " .. label:lower() .. "\" to press it."}
end
local navy = labelToks(e).navy
local okF
if k == "item" and e.Use then okF = pcall(e.Use) else okF = fire(e.Button.Activated) end
if not okF then return {text = "I couldn't press " .. label .. ": your executor needs firesignal or getconnections for that."} end
if navy then return {text = "Opening " .. label:gsub("%s*>%s*$", "") .. ".", closeAfter = true} end
return {text = pick(OKW) .. " I pressed " .. label .. "."}
elseif k == "dropdown" then
local sel, opts = e.Select, e.Options
local n = #opts
if n == 0 then return {text = label .. " has no options."} end
local idx
local rt = " " .. norm(raw) .. " "
local bestLen = 0
for i, o in ipairs(opts) do
local on = norm(o)
if on ~= "" and rt:find(" " .. on .. " ", 1, true) and #on > bestLen then idx, bestLen = i, #on end
end
if not idx then return {text = label .. " is set to " .. tostring(opts[sel.Value]) .. ". Options: " .. table.concat((function() local c = {} for i2, o2 in ipairs(opts) do if i2 <= 8 then c[#c + 1] = tostring(o2) end end return c end)(), ", ") .. "."} end
local old = sel.Value
if old == idx then return {text = label .. " is already " .. tostring(opts[idx]) .. "."} end
sel.Value = idx
task.wait(0.15)
if sel.Value ~= idx then return {text = "I tried to set " .. label .. " to " .. tostring(opts[idx]) .. ", but it didn't hold."} end
pushUndo(label, function() sel.Value = old end)
return {text = pick(OKW) .. " " .. label .. " is now " .. tostring(opts[idx]) .. "."}
elseif k == "input" then
if e.Sub == "slider" then
local n = number
if not n then
local w = " " .. norm(raw) .. " "
if w:find(" max ", 1, true) or w:find(" maximum ", 1, true) then n = e.Max elseif w:find(" min ", 1, true) or w:find(" minimum ", 1, true) then n = e.Min end
end
if not n then return {text = label .. " is " .. tostring(e.Select.Value) .. " (range " .. tostring(e.Min) .. " to " .. tostring(e.Max) .. "). Tell me a number to set it."} end
if raw:find("%%") or norm(raw):find("percent", 1, true) then n = e.Min + (e.Max - e.Min) * n / 100 end
if e.Step and e.Step > 0 then n = e.Min + math.round((n - e.Min) / e.Step) * e.Step end
n = math.clamp(n, e.Min, e.Max)
local old = e.Select.Value
e.Select.Value = n
task.wait(0.15)
if math.abs(e.Select.Value - n) > 1e-6 then return {text = "I tried to set " .. label .. " to " .. tostring(n) .. ", but it didn't hold."} end
pushUndo(label, function() e.Select.Value = old end)
return {text = pick(OKW) .. " " .. label .. " is now " .. tostring(n) .. "."}
else
local val = raw:match("%f[%a][Tt][Oo]%s+(.+)$")
if not val then return {text = "Tell me what to put in " .. label .. ", for example: set " .. label:lower() .. " to something."} end
local old = e.Box.Text
e.Box.Text = trim(val)
if not fire(e.Box.FocusLost, true) then return {text = "I typed it into " .. label .. " but couldn't submit it: your executor needs firesignal or getconnections."} end
pushUndo(label, function() e.Box.Text = old fire(e.Box.FocusLost, true) end)
return {text = pick(OKW) .. " I entered that into " .. label .. "."}
end
end
return {text = "I don't know how to operate " .. label .. "."}
end

-- ---------- Uh Admin commands ----------
local CMD_RISKY = {"kill", "fling", "rejoin", "serverhop", "reset", "respawn", "crash", "reload", "shutdown", "exit", "destroy"}
local function findCmd(name)
local U = Util.UhCmd
if not U then return nil end
local key = name:lower()
if U.cmds[key] then return key, U.cmds[key] end
if U.aliases[key] then
local reg = U.aliases[key]
for k, v in pairs(U.cmds) do if v == reg then return k, reg end end
return key, reg
end
return nil
end
local function runCommand(name, args, why)
local U = Util.UhCmd
local list = {name}
for _, a in ipairs(args) do list[#list + 1] = a end
local ok, err = U.run(list)
if ok then return {text = pick(OKW) .. " I ran the command " .. name .. (#args > 0 and (" " .. table.concat(args, " ")) or "") .. "."} end
return {text = "The command " .. name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err or "unknown error") .. "."}
end

end

K.SYN = {}
for gi, g in ipairs(K.SYNG) do for _, w in ipairs(g) do K.SYN[w] = K.SYN[w] or {} K.SYN[w][gi] = true end end
K.FILL = setOf("thing things feature features option options setting settings button tab page menu section stuff one something command commands cmd cmds really bit little again")
K.QFILL = setOf("what where how who which when why do does is are can i find get access open use usage list show all any there tell explain describe info information about meaning purpose happen happens work works mean means feature features setting settings command commands cmd cmds tool tools thing things stuff one something tab page menu section button toggle switch option options anything")
K.NOTNAME = setOf("the a an and or to of in on at for with from by is are was be it its this that these those please now just some then so my your his her their our not no yes player players person people guy guys dude user users someone anyone everyone everybody else other others all random nearest closest nearby farthest furthest cursor crosshair mouse pointing looking named called username display name userid id team health hp speed tool away near far")
K.PLN = setOf("player players person people guy guys dude user users one someone")
K.ARGDOC = {player = "a player (name, display name, UserId, nearest, random or me)", pos = "a player or X,Y,Z coordinates", number = "a number", text = "text"}
K.WORDNUM = {one = 1, two = 2, three = 3, four = 4, five = 5, six = 6, seven = 7, eight = 8, nine = 9, ten = 10, twenty = 20, thirty = 30, fifty = 50, hundred = 100}
K.ORD = {["1"] = 1, first = 1, one = 1, ["2"] = 2, second = 2, two = 2, ["3"] = 3, third = 3, three = 3, ["4"] = 4, fourth = 4, four = 4}
K.VERBW = {}
for _, g in ipairs(VERBS) do for _, ph in ipairs(g[2]) do for w in ph:gmatch("%S+") do K.VERBW[w] = true end end end

-- ---------- fuzzy vocabulary ----------
function K.synMatch(a, b)
local ga, gb = K.SYN[a], K.SYN[b]
if not ga or not gb then return false end
for k in pairs(ga) do if gb[k] then return true end end
return false
end
function K.swapped(a, b)
if #a ~= #b then return false end
for i = 1, #a - 1 do
if a:sub(1, i - 1) .. a:sub(i + 1, i + 1) .. a:sub(i, i) .. a:sub(i + 2) == b then return true end
end
return false
end
function K.lev(a, b)
local la, lb = #a, #b
if la == 0 then return lb end
if lb == 0 then return la end
if math.abs(la - lb) > 2 then return 3 end
local prev, cur = {}, {}
for j = 0, lb do prev[j] = j end
for i = 1, la do
cur[0] = i
local ai = a:byte(i)
for j = 1, lb do
local cost = (ai == b:byte(j)) and 0 or 1
cur[j] = math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost)
end
prev, cur = cur, prev
end
return prev[lb]
end
-- similarity of two lowercase word stems: exact, stem, synonym, abbreviation (prefix), transposition, typo
function K.sim(a, b)
if a == b then return 1 end
local sa, sb = stem(a), stem(b)
if sa == sb then return 0.95 end
if K.synMatch(a, b) or K.synMatch(sa, sb) then return 0.85 end
local la, lb = #a, #b
local sh, lg = math.min(la, lb), math.max(la, lb)
if sh >= 3 and sh < lg and a:sub(1, sh) == b:sub(1, sh) then
local suf = (la > lb and a or b):sub(sh + 1)
if suf == "ing" or suf == "ed" or suf == "er" or suf == "es" then return 0.9 end
if sh / lg >= 0.4 then return (sh / lg >= 0.6) and 0.75 or 0.62 end
end
if lg >= 4 and K.swapped(a, b) then return 0.8 end
if lg >= 5 and math.abs(la - lb) <= 1 and K.lev(a, b) <= 1 then return 0.8 end
if lg >= 8 and math.abs(la - lb) <= 2 and K.lev(a, b) <= 2 then return 0.7 end
return 0
end
function K.camel(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("(%u)(%u%l)", "%1 %2")) end
function K.qt(str, extra)
local out, seen = {}, {}
for w in norm(K.camel(str)):gmatch("%S+") do
if not STOPW[w] and not (extra and extra[w]) and not w:match("^%-?%d") and not w:match("^zzg%d") then
local s = stem(w)
if not seen[s] then seen[s] = true out[#out + 1] = s end
end
end
return out
end
function K.sq(s) return (tostring(s or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")) end
function K.toks(raw)
local r = {}
for w in tostring(raw):gmatch("%S+") do r[#r + 1] = w end
return r
end
function K.prefix()
local rf = fn("readfile")
local p = rf and safe(rf, "UhhhhhhReanim/prefix.txt") or nil
p = type(p) == "string" and p:gsub("%s", "") or nil
if p and p ~= "" then return p end
return "."
end
function K.confirm(desc, f)
K.choice = nil
return confirmReply(desc, f)
end
function K.ask(prompt, opts)
pending = nil
K.choice = {t = os.clock(), opts = opts}
local lines = {}
for i, o in ipairs(opts) do lines[#lines + 1] = i .. ") " .. o.label end
return {text = prompt .. " " .. table.concat(lines, "  ") .. ". Which one?"}
end

-- ---------- PLAYER AWARENESS (live Roblox data only) ----------
function K.char(p) return p and p.Character end
function K.hum(p) local c = K.char(p) return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil end
function K.root(p) local c = K.char(p) return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c.PrimaryPart) or nil end
function K.dist(p)
local a, b = K.root(lp), K.root(p)
if a and b then return (a.Position - b.Position).Magnitude end
return nil
end
function K.others()
local out = {}
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p ~= lp then out[#out + 1] = p end end
return out
end
function K.pname(p)
if p.DisplayName ~= "" and p.DisplayName ~= p.Name then return p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")" end
return p.Name
end
function K.nearest(far)
local best, bd
for _, p in ipairs(K.others()) do
local d = K.dist(p)
if d and (not bd or (far and d > bd) or (not far and d < bd)) then best, bd = p, d end
end
return best, bd
end
function K.mouseTarget()
local m = safe(function() return lp:GetMouse() end)
local tgt = m and m.Target
local mdl = tgt and tgt:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
local pl = mdl and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mdl)
if pl and pl ~= lp then return pl end
return nil
end
function K.info(p)
local h = K.hum(p)
local c = K.char(p)
local tool = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
return {
p = p, name = p.Name, display = p.DisplayName, id = p.UserId, me = p == lp,
char = c ~= nil, hp = h and math.floor(h.Health) or nil, maxhp = h and math.floor(h.MaxHealth) or nil,
speed = h and math.floor(h.WalkSpeed) or nil, team = p.Team and p.Team.Name or nil,
age = p.AccountAge, tool = tool and tool.Name or nil, dist = (p ~= lp) and K.dist(p) or nil,
}
end
function K.nameScore(g, p)
local sn, sd = K.sq(p.Name), K.sq(p.DisplayName)
if g == sn then return 100 end
if g == sd then return 98 end
if #g >= 3 then
if sn:sub(1, #g) == g then return 80 + math.min(10, 10 * #g / math.max(#sn, 1)) end
if sd:sub(1, #g) == g then return 78 + math.min(10, 10 * #g / math.max(#sd, 1)) end
if #g >= 4 then
if sn:find(g, 1, true) then return 60 end
if sd:find(g, 1, true) then return 58 end
end
if #g >= 5 then
if math.abs(#sn - #g) <= 1 and K.lev(g, sn) <= 1 then return 50 end
if math.abs(#sd - #g) <= 1 and K.lev(g, sd) <= 1 then return 48 end
end
end
return 0
end
function K.isCmd(w)
local U = Util.UhCmd
return U ~= nil and (U.cmds[w] ~= nil or U.aliases[w] ~= nil)
end
-- resolves player references in a token list: names, display names, UserIds, me, nearest/farthest, random, all/others, "that player"/him/her/them, cursor target
-- strict = only definite references (used to decide whether a request is about players at all)
function K.targets(rtoks, used, strict, t)
local R = {list = {}, set = {}, special = nil, amb = nil, note = nil}
local n = #rtoks
local lows = {}
for i = 1, n do lows[i] = (rtoks[i]:lower():gsub("^[@%p]+", ""):gsub("%p+$", "")) end
local PLS = Players:GetPlayers()
local function add(p) if p and not R.set[p] then R.set[p] = true R.list[#R.list + 1] = p end end
local function skipNoun(i) if K.PLN[lows[i + 1] or ""] then used[i + 1] = true end end
local i = 1
while i <= n do
local w, nx = lows[i], lows[i + 1] or ""
local step = 1
if used[i] or w == "" then
elseif w == "me" or w == "myself" then
add(lp) used[i] = true R.self = true
elseif w == "everyone" or w == "everybody" or w == "others" or ((w == "all" or w == "every") and (K.PLN[nx] or nx == "else" or (not strict and i == n))) then
R.special = (w == "others" or nx == "else") and "others" or "all"
used[i] = true
if K.PLN[nx] or nx == "else" then used[i + 1] = true end
elseif w == "random" and (K.PLN[nx] or not strict) then
R.special = "random" used[i] = true skipNoun(i)
elseif w == "nearest" or w == "closest" or w == "nearby" or w == "farthest" or w == "furthest" then
used[i] = true skipNoun(i)
local np = K.nearest(w:sub(1, 3) == "far" or w:sub(1, 3) == "fur")
if np then add(np) else R.note = "I can't measure distances right now: no other character is loaded." end
elseif w == "him" or w == "her" or w == "them" or w == "himself" or w == "herself" or ((w == "that" or w == "this" or w == "same") and K.PLN[nx] and nx ~= "players" and nx ~= "people") then
used[i] = true skipNoun(i)
local lastp = K.last
if not (lastp and lastp.Parent == Players) then lastp = K.mouseTarget() end
if lastp then add(lastp) else R.note = "I don't know which player you mean yet. Tell me their name." end
elseif w:match("^%d%d%d%d%d+$") then
local id, hit = tonumber(w), nil
for _, p in ipairs(PLS) do if p.UserId == id then hit = p end end
if hit then add(hit) used[i] = true end
else
local best, bestN, bestPs, bestG = 0, 1, nil, nil
for len = math.min(3, n - i + 1), 1, -1 do
local parts, ok = {}, true
for k = i, i + len - 1 do
if used[k] or lows[k] == "" then ok = false break end
parts[#parts + 1] = lows[k]
end
if ok then
local g = K.sq(table.concat(parts))
local skip = g == "" or (len == 1 and (K.NOTNAME[g] or STOPW[g] or K.VERBW[g] or K.isCmd(g)))
if not skip then
local top, ps = 0, {}
for _, p in ipairs(PLS) do
local sc = K.nameScore(g, p)
if sc > top then top, ps = sc, {p} elseif sc == top and sc > 0 then ps[#ps + 1] = p end
end
if top > best and ((not strict and top > 0) or top >= 98 or (top >= 80 and #g >= 5)) then best, bestN, bestPs, bestG = top, len, ps, g end
end
end
end
if best > 0 then
for k = i, i + bestN - 1 do used[k] = true end
if #bestPs == 1 then add(bestPs[1]) else R.amb = R.amb or {from = i, to = i + bestN - 1, players = bestPs, text = bestG} end
step = bestN
end
end
i += step
end
if t and #R.list == 0 and not R.special and has(t, {"under my cursor", "i am looking at", "i m looking at", "pointing at", "i am pointing at", "i m pointing at", "my cursor", "my mouse", "my crosshair"}) then
local mt = K.mouseTarget()
if mt then add(mt) else R.note = "You aren't pointing at another player right now." end
end
return R
end
function K.hasOtherRef(rtoks, t)
local R = K.targets(rtoks, {}, true, t)
if R.amb or R.special then return true end
for _, p in ipairs(R.list) do if p ~= lp then return true end end
return false
end
function K.playersReply()
local ps = Players:GetPlayers()
local parts = {}
for i, p in ipairs(ps) do
if i > 12 then parts[#parts + 1] = "and " .. (#ps - 12) .. " more" break end
parts[#parts + 1] = K.pname(p) .. (p == lp and " (you)" or "")
end
return {text = #ps .. " player" .. (#ps == 1 and "" or "s") .. " in this server: " .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "."}
end
function K.playerReply(p, want)
local I = K.info(p)
local any = next(want) ~= nil
local out = {}
local who = K.pname(p) .. (I.me and " (you)" or "")
if not any then out[#out + 1] = who .. ", UserId " .. I.id
elseif want.name or want.id then out[#out + 1] = who .. ", UserId " .. I.id end
if not any or want.hp then out[#out + 1] = I.hp and (I.hp .. " of " .. I.maxhp .. " health") or "no character loaded right now" end
if not any or want.team then out[#out + 1] = I.team and ("on team " .. I.team) or "not on a team" end
if not any or want.age then out[#out + 1] = "account age " .. tostring(I.age) .. " days" end
if (not any or want.tool) and I.char then out[#out + 1] = I.tool and ("holding " .. I.tool) or "not holding anything" end
if (not any or want.speed) and I.speed then out[#out + 1] = "walk speed " .. I.speed end
if (not any or want.dist) and I.dist then out[#out + 1] = string.format("%d studs away", I.dist) end
if want.char then out[#out + 1] = I.char and "has a character" or "has no character right now" end
if p ~= lp then K.last = p end
return {text = (any and (K.pname(p) .. ": ") or "") .. table.concat(out, "; ") .. "."}
end

-- ---------- COMMAND AWARENESS (live registry) ----------
function K.argKind(name)
local l = name:lower()
if l:find("player", 1, true) or l:find("target", 1, true) or l:find("user", 1, true) or l:find("plr", 1, true) then
if l:find("x,y,z", 1, true) or l:find("x y z", 1, true) or l:find("/x", 1, true) then return "pos" end
return "player"
end
if l:find("%d") then return "number" end
for _, w in ipairs({"speed", "power", "height", "size", "number", "amount", "time", "second", "count", "level", "fov", "volume", "distance", "offset", "damping", "length", "multiplier", "strength", "rate", "value"}) do
if l:find(w, 1, true) then return "number" end
end
return "text"
end
function K.parseSpec(usage, set)
local spec = {}
local u = tostring(usage or ""):gsub("^%s*%S+", "", 1)
for open, inner in u:gmatch("([<%[%(])([^>%]%)]*)[>%]%)]") do
local nm = trim(inner)
local skip = nm == ""
if open == "(" then
local all, any = true, false
for w in nm:gmatch("[%w_]+") do any = true if not set[w:lower()] then all = false end end
if all and any then skip = true end
end
if not skip then spec[#spec + 1] = {name = nm, req = open ~= "[", kind = K.argKind(nm)} end
end
return spec
end
function K.index()
local U = Util.UhCmd
local CI = K.CI
if not U then return CI end
local nc, na = 0, 0
for _ in pairs(U.cmds) do nc += 1 end
for _ in pairs(U.aliases) do na += 1 end
local sig = nc .. ":" .. na
if CI.sig == sig then return CI end
CI.sig, CI.list, CI.byReg, CI.df, CI.N = sig, {}, {}, {}, 0
for primary, reg in pairs(U.cmds) do
local meta = type(reg) == "table" and type(reg[2]) == "table" and reg[2] or {}
local usage, desc = tostring(meta[1] or primary), tostring(meta[2] or "")
local names, set = {primary}, {[primary] = true}
for _, a in ipairs(reg.aliases or {}) do if not set[a] then set[a] = true names[#names + 1] = a end end
local c = {name = primary, names = names, set = set, usage = usage, desc = desc, reg = reg}
c.spec = K.parseSpec(usage, set)
c.toks = K.qt(desc)
c.danger = primary == "script" or primary == "httpget"
for _, a in ipairs(c.spec) do
local l = a.name:lower()
if l:find("source", 1, true) or l:find("code", 1, true) or l:find("url", 1, true) or l:find("link", 1, true) then c.danger = true end
end
local show = {}
for _, a in ipairs(c.spec) do show[#show + 1] = a.req and a.name:upper() or ("[" .. a.name .. "]") end
c.shown = primary .. (#show > 0 and (" " .. table.concat(show, " ")) or "")
CI.list[#CI.list + 1] = c
CI.byReg[reg] = c
local seen = {}
for _, w in ipairs(c.toks) do if not seen[w] then seen[w] = true CI.df[w] = (CI.df[w] or 0) + 1 end end
for _, nm in ipairs(names) do local s = stem(nm) if not seen[s] then seen[s] = true CI.df[s] = (CI.df[s] or 0) + 1 end end
end
CI.N = #CI.list
return CI
end
function K.idf(w)
local CI = K.CI
return math.log((CI.N + 1) / ((CI.df[w] or 0) + 1)) + 0.5
end
function K.score(c, Q)
local tot, norm2, nameHit = 0, 0, 0
for _, q in ipairs(Q) do
local w = K.idf(q)
norm2 += w
local best = 0
for _, nm in ipairs(c.names) do
local s = K.sim(q, nm)
if s > best then best = s end
if s > nameHit then nameHit = s end
end
for _, d in ipairs(c.toks) do
local s = K.sim(q, d) * 0.55
if s > best then best = s end
end
tot += best * w
end
if norm2 == 0 then return 0, 0 end
return tot / norm2, nameHit
end
function K.rank(Q)
local ci = K.index()
local out = {}
if #Q == 0 then return out end
for _, c in ipairs(ci.list) do
local s, nh = K.score(c, Q)
if s > 0.3 then out[#out + 1] = {c = c, s = s, nh = nh} end
end
table.sort(out, function(a, b) if a.s ~= b.s then return a.s > b.s end return a.c.name < b.c.name end)
return out
end
-- explicit command words in the utterance (registry names and aliases); verbs like "run"/"show" never count as an alias hit
function K.exact(rtoks)
local U = Util.UhCmd
local found, seen = {}, {}
if not U then return found end
for i, w0 in ipairs(rtoks) do
local w = (w0:lower():gsub("^%p+", ""):gsub("%p+$", ""))
if w ~= "" and (#w >= 3 or i == 1) and not STOPW[w] then
local reg = U.cmds[w] or U.aliases[w]
if reg and not (K.VERBW[w] and U.cmds[w] ~= reg) and not seen[reg] then
seen[reg] = true
found[#found + 1] = {i = i, reg = reg, w = w}
end
end
end
return found
end
function K.cmdInfo(c)
local s = c.name .. ": " .. (c.desc ~= "" and c.desc or "no description") .. ". Type " .. K.prefix() .. c.shown .. " in the command bar."
local al = {}
for _, a in ipairs(c.names) do if a ~= c.name then al[#al + 1] = a end end
if #al > 0 then s = s .. " Aliases: " .. table.concat(al, ", ") .. "."
else s = s .. " It has no aliases." end
for _, a in ipairs(c.spec) do s = s .. " " .. a.name .. (a.req and "" or " (optional)") .. " is " .. K.ARGDOC[a.kind] .. "." end
for _, w in ipairs(CMD_RISKY) do if c.name:find(w, 1, true) then s = s .. " This one can be disruptive, so I ask before running it." break end end
return s
end
function K.numbers(rtoks, used)
local nums, pos = {}, nil
for i = 1, #rtoks do
if not used[i] then
local w = (rtoks[i]:gsub("[;!?]+$", ""))
if w:match("^%-?%d+%.?%d*,%-?%d+%.?%d*,%-?%d+%.?%d*$") then pos = w used[i] = true
elseif w:match("^%-?%d+%.?%d*$") then nums[#nums + 1] = {i = i, v = w}
elseif K.WORDNUM[w:lower()] then nums[#nums + 1] = {i = i, v = tostring(K.WORDNUM[w:lower()])} end
end
end
return nums, pos
end
function K.askArg(c, rtoks, ctx, prompt)
pending = nil
K.choice = {t = os.clock(), free = function(txt)
local nt = {}
for _, w in ipairs(rtoks) do nt[#nt + 1] = w end
for _, w in ipairs(K.toks(txt)) do nt[#nt + 1] = w end
ctx.cmd = c
return K.cmdRun(nt, ctx)
end}
return {text = prompt}
end
-- extracts this command's arguments (players -> exact usernames, numbers, coordinates, free text) from the utterance
function K.buildArgs(c, rtoks, used, ctx)
local spec = c.spec
local n = #rtoks
local pargs = 0
for _, a in ipairs(spec) do if a.kind == "player" or a.kind == "pos" then pargs += 1 end end
local T = pargs > 0 and K.targets(rtoks, used, false, ctx.t) or nil
if T and T.amb then
local opts = {}
for _, p in ipairs(T.amb.players) do
if #opts < 4 then
opts[#opts + 1] = {label = K.pname(p), run = function()
local nt = {}
for i = 1, T.amb.from - 1 do nt[#nt + 1] = rtoks[i] end
nt[#nt + 1] = p.Name
for i = T.amb.to + 1, n do nt[#nt + 1] = rtoks[i] end
ctx.cmd = c
return K.cmdRun(nt, ctx)
end}
end
end
return {reply = K.ask("More than one player matches \"" .. T.amb.text .. "\".", opts)}
end
local nums, posStr = K.numbers(rtoks, used)
local needPos = false
for _, a in ipairs(spec) do if a.kind == "pos" then needPos = true end end
if needPos and not posStr and #nums >= 3 and nums[2].i == nums[1].i + 1 and nums[3].i == nums[2].i + 1 then
posStr = nums[1].v .. "," .. nums[2].v .. "," .. nums[3].v
table.remove(nums, 1) table.remove(nums, 1) table.remove(nums, 1)
end
local textVal
local hasNum, hasText = false, false
for _, a in ipairs(spec) do if a.kind == "number" then hasNum = true elseif a.kind == "text" then hasText = true end end
if hasText then
local q = ctx.raw and ctx.raw:match('"([^"]+)"') or nil
if q then textVal = q
else
local parts = {}
for i = (ctx.viaIdx or 0) + 1, n do
local w = rtoks[i]
local isNum = hasNum and w:match("^%-?%d+%.?%d*$")
if not used[i] and not isNum then parts[#parts + 1] = w end
end
if #parts > 0 then textVal = table.concat(parts, " ") end
end
end
local targets = {}
if T then
for _, p in ipairs(T.list) do targets[#targets + 1] = p end
if T.special == "all" or T.special == "others" then
targets = K.others()
if #targets == 0 then return {reply = {text = "There's nobody else in the server."}} end
elseif T.special == "random" then
local o = K.others()
if #o == 0 then return {reply = {text = "There's nobody else in the server."}} end
targets = {o[math.random(#o)]}
end
end
local tmpl, pi, ni, usedPos = {}, 1, 1, false
for _, a in ipairs(spec) do
local v
if a.kind == "player" or a.kind == "pos" then
if a.kind == "pos" and posStr then v = posStr usedPos = true
elseif pargs == 1 then v = (#targets > 0) and K.TGT or nil
else v = targets[pi] and targets[pi].Name pi += 1 end
elseif a.kind == "number" then
if nums[ni] then v = nums[ni].v ni += 1 end
else
v = textVal textVal = nil
end
if v == nil then
if a.req then
if a.kind == "player" or a.kind == "pos" then
local msg = (T and T.note) or ("Which player should I use for " .. c.name .. "? " .. K.playersReply().text)
return {reply = K.askArg(c, rtoks, ctx, msg)}
end
return {reply = K.askArg(c, rtoks, ctx, "What should I use for " .. a.name .. " with " .. c.name .. "?")}
end
break
end
tmpl[#tmpl + 1] = v
end
if #spec == 0 then
for _, x in ipairs(nums) do
if #tmpl < 3 and rtoks[x.i]:match("^%-?%d") then tmpl[#tmpl + 1] = x.v end
end
end
local A = {runs = {}, targets = targets, label = ""}
if pargs == 1 and not usedPos then
for k, p in ipairs(targets) do
if k > 25 then break end
local vals = {}
for _, v in ipairs(tmpl) do vals[#vals + 1] = (v == K.TGT) and p.Name or v end
A.runs[#A.runs + 1] = vals
end
local names = {}
for k, p in ipairs(targets) do if k <= 3 then names[#names + 1] = K.pname(p) end end
A.label = (#targets > 3) and (#targets .. " players") or table.concat(names, " and ")
else
A.runs[1] = tmpl
local names = {}
for _, p in ipairs(targets) do names[#names + 1] = K.pname(p) end
A.label = table.concat(names, " and ")
end
return A
end
function K.exec(c, A)
local last = A.targets and A.targets[#A.targets]
if last and last ~= lp then K.last = last end
local runs = A.runs
if #runs <= 1 then return runCommand(c.name, runs[1] or {}) end
local U = Util.UhCmd
for _, a in ipairs(runs) do
local list = {c.name}
for _, x in ipairs(a) do list[#list + 1] = x end
task.spawn(function() U.run(list) end)
task.wait(0.12)
end
return {text = pick(OKW) .. " I ran " .. c.name .. " on " .. A.label .. "."}
end
-- one resolved command request: extracts the arguments, asks for anything missing, confirms risky / multi-target / code-running commands, then runs the existing command
function K.cmdRun(rtoks, ctx)
local U = Util.UhCmd
local ci = K.index()
if not U then return nil end
local used = {}
for i, w in ipairs(rtoks) do
local l = (w:lower():gsub("%p+", ""))
if l == "jarvis" or l == "hey" or l == "ok" or l == "okay" or l == "please" or l == "command" or l == "cmd" then used[i] = true end
end
local c = ctx.cmd
if not c then
local found = K.exact(rtoks)
if #found > 1 then
local opts = {}
for _, f in ipairs(found) do
local d = ci.byReg[f.reg]
if d and #opts < 4 then opts[#opts + 1] = {label = d.name, run = function() ctx.cmd = d return K.cmdRun(rtoks, ctx) end} end
end
if #opts > 1 then return K.ask("That mentions more than one command.", opts) end
end
if found[1] then c = ci.byReg[found[1].reg] end
end
if not c then return nil end
ctx.viaIdx = nil
for i, w in ipairs(rtoks) do
local l = (w:lower():gsub("^%p+", ""):gsub("%p+$", ""))
if c.set[l] then used[i] = true ctx.viaIdx = ctx.viaIdx or i end
end
if ctx.verb == "off" and not c.name:find("^un") and not c.name:find("^no") then
local inv
for _, pre in ipairs({"un", "stop", "no"}) do
local r = U.cmds[pre .. c.name]
if r and ci.byReg[r] then inv = ci.byReg[r] break end
end
if not inv then return {text = "There's no command to turn off " .. c.name .. "."} end
c = inv
end
if c.danger and not ctx.explicit then
return {text = c.name .. " runs code you supply, so I only use it when you say it explicitly, for example \"command " .. c.name .. " ...\"."}
end
local A = K.buildArgs(c, rtoks, used, ctx)
if A.reply then return A.reply end
local risky = false
for _, w in ipairs(CMD_RISKY) do if c.name:find(w, 1, true) then risky = true end end
if risky or #A.runs > 1 or c.danger then
local shown = {}
for _, a in ipairs(A.runs[1] or {}) do shown[#shown + 1] = a end
local what = "That runs the Uh Admin command " .. c.name .. (A.label ~= "" and (" on " .. A.label) or (#shown > 0 and (" " .. table.concat(shown, " ")) or "")) .. ", which can be disruptive."
return K.confirm(what, function() return K.exec(c, A) end)
end
return K.exec(c, A)
end
function K.cmdFlow(rtoks, ctx, rest, number, state, exactOnly)
local U = Util.UhCmd
if not U then return nil end
if #K.exact(rtoks) > 0 then
local r = K.cmdRun(rtoks, ctx)
if r then return r end
end
if ctx.t and not ctx.isQ and U.cmds["goto"] and K.hasOtherRef(rtoks, ctx.t) and has(ctx.t, {"go to", "take me to", "teleport me to", "teleport to", "tp to", "tp me to", "warp to", "warp me to", "walk to", "head to"}) then
ctx.cmd = K.index().byReg[U.cmds["goto"]]
ctx.verb = nil
local r = K.cmdRun(rtoks, ctx)
ctx.cmd = nil
if r then return r end
end
if exactOnly or ctx.isQ then return nil end
return K.semFlow(ctx.raw, ctx.t, rest, ctx.verb, number, state, false, rtoks, ctx, true)
end

-- ---------- UI AWARENESS (real instances: Util.Search entries, Delta sidebar/tabs, Uh Admin bar and list) ----------
function K.kindWord(e)
if not e then return "navigation tab open" end
local k = e.Kind
if k == "switch" then return "switch toggle enable disable" end
if k == "button" then return "button press run" end
if k == "dropdown" then return "dropdown option select choose" end
if k == "input" then return e.Sub == "slider" and "slider value adjust" or "textbox input type" end
return "item"
end
K.TABSET = {Home = true, Executor = true, Scripthub = true, Music = true, Console = true, Settings = true, JarvisAI = true, ToggleUI = true}
function K.deltaGui()
local DG = K.DG
if DG.g and DG.g.Parent then return DG.g end
DG.g = nil
local roots = {}
local okh, h = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
if okh and h then roots[#roots + 1] = h end
local okc, cg = pcall(game.GetService, game, "CoreGui")
if okc and cg then roots[#roots + 1] = cg end
local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if pg then roots[#roots + 1] = pg end
for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
local ok, kids = pcall(function() return r:GetChildren() end)
if ok then
for _, g in ipairs(kids) do
if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then
local okf, hit = pcall(function() return g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true) and g:FindFirstChild("Scripthub", true) and g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true) end)
if okf and hit then DG.g = g return g end
end
end
end
end
return nil
end
function K.deltaDocs(out)
local g = K.deltaGui()
if not g then return end
local ok, all = pcall(function() return g:GetDescendants() end)
if not ok then return end
local seen = {}
for _, d in ipairs(all) do
if d:IsA("GuiButton") and K.TABSET[d.Name] and not seen[d.Name] and d:FindFirstAncestor("Sidebar") then
seen[d.Name] = true
local texts = {}
local frame = g:FindFirstChild(d.Name)
if frame then
local okd, ds = pcall(function() return frame:GetDescendants() end)
if okd then
for _, x in ipairs(ds) do
if #texts >= 40 then break end
if x:IsA("TextLabel") or x:IsA("TextButton") then
local tx = plain(x.Text)
if tx ~= "" and #tx <= 40 then texts[#texts + 1] = tx end
end
end
end
end
local nm = K.camel(d.Name)
local vis = d.Name == "ToggleUI"
local say = vis and "ToggleUI is the sidebar button that hides or shows the whole Delta interface."
or (nm .. " is a tab in the sidebar" .. (#texts > 0 and (". It contains: " .. table.concat(texts, ", "):sub(1, 200)) or "") .. ".")
out[#out + 1] = {kind = "nav", label = nm, name = d.Name, where = "Sidebar", desc = table.concat(texts, " "), say = say, vis = vis,
act = function() return fire(d.MouseButton1Click) or fire(d.Activated) end}
end
end
end
function K.adminDocs(out)
local UA = Util.UhAdmin
if not UA then return end
local ui = UA.UI or {}
if UA.OpenBar then
local ph = ui.CmdInput and safe(function() return ui.CmdInput.PlaceholderText end) or ""
out[#out + 1] = {kind = "nav", label = "Command bar", name = "cmdbar", where = "Uh Admin", vis = false, desc = "type admin commands run prefix enter autofill " .. tostring(ph or ""),
say = "The command bar is where you type Uh Admin commands (prefix " .. K.prefix() .. ", then the command name and its arguments). It autofills command names as you type.",
act = function() UA.OpenBar() return true end}
end
if UA.OpenList then
out[#out + 1] = {kind = "nav", label = "Command list", name = "cmdlist", where = "Uh Admin", vis = false, desc = "all commands usage description filter browse search",
say = "The command list shows every Uh Admin command with its usage and description, with a filter box to search it.",
act = function() UA.OpenList() return true end}
end
if Util.UhCmd and Util.UhCmd.cmds["chatlogs"] then
out[#out + 1] = {kind = "nav", label = "Chat logs", name = "chatlogs", where = "Uh Admin", vis = false, desc = "chat log messages history players said",
say = "Chat logs shows the messages players have sent in this server.",
act = function() return Util.UhCmd.run({"chatlogs"}) end}
end
end
function K.docs()
local DC = K.DC
if DC.list and os.clock() - DC.t < 3 then return DC.list end
local out = {}
for _, e in ipairs(entries()) do
local l = labelOf(e)
if l ~= "" then
local ds = e.GetDesc and safe(e.GetDesc) or ""
local xt = e.GetExtra and safe(e.GetExtra) or ""
out[#out + 1] = {kind = "ui", e = e, label = l, where = whereOf(e), desc = (tostring(ds or "") .. " " .. tostring(xt or "")):sub(1, 300)}
end
end
safe(K.deltaDocs, out)
safe(K.adminDocs, out)
for _, d in ipairs(out) do
d.lt = K.qt(d.label)
d.wt = K.qt((d.where or "") .. " " .. K.kindWord(d.e))
d.dt = K.qt(d.desc or "")
end
DC.list, DC.t = out, os.clock()
return out
end
function K.docScore(d, Q)
local tot, hits = 0, 0
for _, q in ipairs(Q) do
local best = 0
for _, x in ipairs(d.lt) do local s = K.sim(q, x) if s > best then best = s end end
for _, x in ipairs(d.wt) do local s = K.sim(q, x) * 0.5 if s > best then best = s end end
for _, x in ipairs(d.dt) do local s = K.sim(q, x) * 0.4 if s > best then best = s end end
tot += best
end
if #Q == 0 then return 0 end
local cov = 0
for _, x in ipairs(d.lt) do
for _, q in ipairs(Q) do if K.sim(q, x) >= 0.7 then cov += 1 break end end
end
cov = (#d.lt > 0) and (cov / #d.lt) or 0
return (tot / #Q) * (0.75 + 0.25 * cov)
end
function K.kindAllowed(d, verb)
if d.kind == "ui" then return not verb or kindOk(d.e, verb) end
if verb == "on" or verb == "off" or verb == "toggle" then return d.vis == true end
return true
end
function K.describeDoc(d)
if d.kind == "nav" then return d.say end
local e = d.e
local kw = e.Kind == "input" and (e.Sub == "slider" and "slider" or "text box") or (e.Kind == "switch" and "switch" or (e.Kind == "item" and "item" or e.Kind))
local s = d.label .. " is a " .. kw .. " in " .. d.where .. "."
if e.Kind == "switch" then s = s .. " It is currently " .. (switchOn(e) and "on" or "off") .. "."
elseif e.Kind == "dropdown" then
local v = safe(function() return tostring(e.Options[e.Select.Value]) end)
if v then s = s .. " It is set to " .. v .. "." end
elseif e.Sub == "slider" then
s = s .. " It is at " .. tostring(safe(function() return e.Select.Value end)) .. " (range " .. tostring(e.Min) .. " to " .. tostring(e.Max) .. ")."
end
local ds = trim(plain(d.desc or ""))
if ds ~= "" and #ds <= 140 and e.Kind ~= "switch" then s = s .. " " .. ds end
return s
end
function K.runDoc(d, verb, number, state, raw)
if d.kind == "nav" then
local okF = d.act and d.act()
if not okF then return {text = "I couldn't press " .. d.label .. ": your executor needs firesignal or getconnections for that."} end
return {text = d.vis and ("Toggling the interface via " .. d.label .. ".") or ("Opening " .. d.label .. "."), closeAfter = true}
end
local e = d.e
if isRisky(d.label) and (e.Kind == "button" or e.Kind == "item") then
return K.confirm("That presses " .. d.label .. ", which can be disruptive.", function() return applyEntry(e, verb or "open", number, state, raw) end)
end
return applyEntry(e, verb or ((e.Kind == "button" or e.Kind == "item") and "open" or nil), number, state, raw)
end
-- semantic fallback over live UI elements AND registry commands; asks instead of guessing when it is not confident
function K.semFlow(raw, t, rest, verb, number, state, isQ, rtoks, ctx, onlyCmd)
local usedP = {}
K.targets(rtoks, usedP, true, nil)
local skip = {}
for i, w in ipairs(rtoks) do if usedP[i] then skip[K.sq(w)] = true end end
local kept = {}
for w in rest:gmatch("%S+") do if not skip[K.sq(w)] then kept[#kept + 1] = w end end
local rq = table.concat(kept, " ")
local Q = K.qt(rq, K.FILL)
if #Q == 0 then Q = K.qt(rq) end
if #Q == 0 then return nil end
local cand = {}
if not isQ then
for _, r in ipairs(K.rank(Q)) do cand[#cand + 1] = {kind = "cmd", c = r.c, s = r.s, nh = r.nh, label = r.c.name} end
end
if not onlyCmd then
for _, d in ipairs(K.docs()) do
if K.kindAllowed(d, verb) then
local s = K.docScore(d, Q)
if s >= 0.45 then cand[#cand + 1] = {kind = "ui", d = d, s = s, label = d.label} end
end
end
end
table.sort(cand, function(a, b) return a.s > b.s end)
local top, second = cand[1], nil
if not top then return nil end
for i = 2, #cand do
if cand[i].label:lower() ~= top.label:lower() then second = cand[i] break end
end
local words = 0
for _ in t:gmatch("%S+") do words += 1 end
local function run(x)
if x.kind == "cmd" then
local c2 = {t = ctx.t, raw = ctx.raw, verb = verb, isQ = false, explicit = ctx.explicit, cmd = x.c}
return K.cmdRun(rtoks, c2)
end
return K.runDoc(x.d, verb, number, state, raw)
end
local ok = top.s >= 0.72 and (top.kind ~= "cmd" or top.nh >= 0.7 or top.s >= 0.85) and verb ~= nil
if ok and second and second.s >= top.s - 0.08 then ok = false end
if ok then return run(top) end
if top.s < 0.5 or (not verb and words > 4) then return nil end
local opts, seen = {}, {}
for _, x in ipairs(cand) do
local key = x.label:lower()
if not seen[key] and #opts < 3 and x.s >= 0.45 then
seen[key] = true
opts[#opts + 1] = {label = (x.kind == "cmd" and ("command " .. x.label) or x.label), run = function() return run(x) end}
end
end
if onlyCmd and #opts == 0 then return nil end
return K.ask("I'm not sure which one you mean.", opts)
end
function K.choiceReply(t, raw)
local ch = K.choice
if not ch then return nil end
if os.clock() - ch.t > 40 then K.choice = nil return nil end
local first = t:match("^(%a+)") or ""
if NO[t] or NO[first] or t == "never mind" or t == "do not" or t == "don t" then K.choice = nil return {text = "Understood. Cancelled."} end
if ch.free then
local nw = 0
for _ in t:gmatch("%S+") do nw += 1 end
K.choice = nil
if nw > 6 or #K.exact(K.toks(raw)) > 0 then return nil end
return ch.free(raw)
end
local idx = K.ORD[t] or K.ORD[first]
if not idx then
local rt = " " .. t .. " "
for i, o in ipairs(ch.opts) do
local on = norm(o.label)
if on ~= "" and (rt:find(" " .. on .. " ", 1, true) or t == on) then idx = i break end
end
end
K.choice = nil
if idx and ch.opts[idx] then return ch.opts[idx].run() end
return nil
end

-- ---------- QUESTIONS ABOUT THE SCRIPT, THE UI AND THE SERVER ----------
function K.topic(Q, limit)
local cmds, uis = {}, {}
for i, r in ipairs(K.rank(Q)) do if i <= limit and r.s >= 0.55 then cmds[#cmds + 1] = r.c end end
local sc = {}
for _, d in ipairs(K.docs()) do
local s = K.docScore(d, Q)
if s >= 0.55 then sc[#sc + 1] = {d = d, s = s} end
end
table.sort(sc, function(a, b) return a.s > b.s end)
for i, x in ipairs(sc) do if i <= 4 then uis[#uis + 1] = x.d end end
return cmds, uis
end
function K.know(raw, t, words, isQ, verb)
local ci = K.index()
local rtoks = K.toks(raw)
if has(t, {"who is in the server", "who s in the server", "who is here", "who s here", "who is online", "who is playing", "list players", "list the players", "player list", "players in the server", "who else is here", "show players", "how many players", "how many people", "who is in this server"}) then
return K.playersReply()
end
if has(t, {"how many commands", "number of commands", "how many admin commands"}) then
local na = 0
for _ in pairs(Util.UhCmd and Util.UhCmd.aliases or {}) do na += 1 end
return {text = "I know " .. #ci.list .. " Uh Admin commands and " .. na .. " aliases, read live from the command registry. Ask for \"commands for\" a topic, or say \"open command list\"."}
end
if words <= 9 and has(t, {"what is this script", "what is uh admin", "tell me about this script", "tell me about uh admin", "what can this script do", "what does this script do", "what features does this have", "script overview", "overview of the script", "what is this admin"}) then
local nSw, nBt, nOth, pages = 0, 0, 0, {}
for _, e in ipairs(entries()) do
if e.Kind == "switch" then nSw += 1 elseif e.Kind == "button" or e.Kind == "item" then nBt += 1 else nOth += 1 end
end
for _, d in ipairs(K.docs()) do if d.kind == "nav" and d.where == "Sidebar" then pages[#pages + 1] = d.label end end
local ms = safe(Util.GetModuleStatus)
local pf, np = fn("listfiles"), nil
if pf then local l = safe(pf, "UhhhhhhReanim/AdminPlugins") if type(l) == "table" then np = #l end end
return {text = ("This script is an Uh Admin command system with a settings UI. I currently see %d commands, %d switches, %d buttons and %d sliders, dropdowns or text boxes%s%s%s. Ask me about any of them, for example \"what does a command do\", \"where is the music thing\" or \"commands for reanimation\"."):format(#ci.list, nSw, nBt, nOth, #pages > 0 and (", plus the sidebar tabs " .. table.concat(pages, ", ")) or "", np and (", and " .. np .. " admin plugin file" .. (np == 1 and "" or "s")) or "", (ms and ms ~= "") and (". Modules: " .. plain(tostring(ms))) or "")}
end
local qlike = isQ or has(t, {"tell me about", "info on", "information on", "explain", "describe", "list"})
if not qlike then return nil end

-- command information: "what does bring do", "how do I use goto", "aliases of fly"
local found = K.exact(rtoks)
local what = has(t, {"what does", "what do", "what is", "what s", "what are", "explain", "describe", "tell me about", "how do i use", "how to use", "how does", "usage of", "usage", "meaning of", "info on", "information on", "what happens", "aliases", "alias"})
if found[1] and what and not has(t, {"setting", "switch", "toggle", "slider", "tab"}) then
local out = {}
for i, f in ipairs(found) do
local c = ci.byReg[f.reg]
if c and i <= 2 then out[#out + 1] = K.cmdInfo(c) end
end
if #out > 0 then return {text = table.concat(out, " ")} end
end

-- players: attributes, nearest/farthest, "tell me about <player>"
local ATTR = {health = "hp", hp = "hp", alive = "hp", dead = "hp", team = "team", userid = "id", id = "id", age = "age", distance = "dist", far = "dist", close = "dist", tool = "tool", holding = "tool", speed = "speed", walkspeed = "speed", name = "name", display = "name", username = "name", character = "char"}
local want, anyAttr = {}, false
for w in t:gmatch("%S+") do if ATTR[w] then want[ATTR[w]] = true anyAttr = true end end
local whoPh = has(t, {"who is", "who s", "tell me about", "info on", "information on", "about player", "nearest", "closest", "farthest", "furthest", "nearby", "describe"})
local factQ = has(t, {"what is", "what s", "how much", "how far", "how old", "who is", "who s", "tell me", "show me", "do i have", "does he have", "does she have", "what team", "which team", "is alive", "is dead"})
if ((anyAttr and factQ) or whoPh) and not (found[1] and what) then
local T = K.targets(rtoks, {}, false, t)
if T.amb then
local opts = {}
for _, p in ipairs(T.amb.players) do
if #opts < 4 then opts[#opts + 1] = {label = K.pname(p), run = function() return K.playerReply(p, want) end} end
end
return K.ask("More than one player matches \"" .. T.amb.text .. "\".", opts)
end
local list = T.list
if #list == 0 and T.special == "random" then local o = K.others() if #o > 0 then list = {o[math.random(#o)]} end end
if #list == 0 and T.special == "others" then return K.playersReply() end
if #list == 0 and anyAttr and (has(t, {"my", "i have", "am i", "do i"})) then list = {lp} end
if #list > 0 then
local parts = {}
for i, p in ipairs(list) do if i <= 3 then parts[#parts + 1] = K.playerReply(p, want).text end end
return {text = table.concat(parts, " ")}
end
if T.note then return {text = T.note} end
end

-- where / how do I find: UI elements, tabs and commands
local where = has(t, {"where is", "where are", "where s", "where can i find", "where do i find", "where to find", "how do i find", "how do i get to", "how do i open", "how do i access", "how can i open", "how can i access", "how to open", "how to access", "where do i", "where can i", "how do i get"})
local ptoks = norm(t)
local subj = K.qt(ptoks, K.QFILL)
local QF2 = setmetatable({admin = true, uh = true}, {__index = K.QFILL})
if where and #K.qt(ptoks, QF2) == 0 and has(t, {"command", "commands", "cmd", "cmds", "admin", "uh admin"}) then
return {text = "Uh Admin commands run from the command bar (type " .. K.prefix() .. " then the command name) and are all listed in the command list. Say \"open command bar\" or \"open command list\" and I'll bring it up."}
end
if #subj == 0 then return nil end

-- command lists for a topic: "commands for music", "which commands do X"
if has(t, {"commands for", "commands about", "commands related to", "commands that", "what commands", "which commands", "list commands", "list the commands", "any commands", "commands to", "list all commands", "are there commands"}) then
local cmds, uis = K.topic(subj, 8)
if #cmds == 0 and #uis == 0 then return {text = "I couldn't find any commands or controls matching that. Say \"open command list\" to browse them all."} end
local parts = {}
for _, c in ipairs(cmds) do parts[#parts + 1] = c.shown .. (c.desc ~= "" and (" (" .. c.desc:sub(1, 60) .. ")") or "") end
local ui = {}
for _, d in ipairs(uis) do ui[#ui + 1] = d.label .. " in " .. (d.where or "the UI") end
return {text = (#parts > 0 and ("Commands: " .. table.concat(parts, "; ") .. ". ") or "") .. (#ui > 0 and ("Related controls: " .. table.concat(ui, "; ") .. ".") or "")}
end

-- generic "what is X / where is X / how do I X" over live UI + commands
if where or what or isQ then
local cand = {}
for _, r in ipairs(K.rank(subj)) do cand[#cand + 1] = {kind = "cmd", c = r.c, s = r.s, nh = r.nh} end
for _, d in ipairs(K.docs()) do
local s = K.docScore(d, subj)
if s >= 0.5 then cand[#cand + 1] = {kind = "ui", d = d, s = s} end
end
table.sort(cand, function(a, b) return a.s > b.s end)
local top = cand[1]
if top and top.s >= 0.72 and (top.kind ~= "cmd" or top.nh >= 0.7 or top.s >= 0.85) then
if top.kind == "cmd" then
return {text = K.cmdInfo(top.c)}
end
local s = K.describeDoc(top.d)
if where and top.d.kind == "nav" then s = s .. " Say \"open " .. top.d.label:lower() .. "\" and I'll go there." end
if where and top.d.kind == "ui" then s = s .. " To go there, open " .. top.d.where .. " in the UI." end
return {text = s}
end
end
return nil
end

-- ---------- REPORT A PLAYER BY NAME: partial display name / username, asks which one when several match, then Jarvis asks the user for consent ----------
K.REPPRON = {him = true, her = true, them = true, ["that player"] = true, ["this player"] = true, ["that guy"] = true, ["that person"] = true, ["that user"] = true}
function K.reportReason(txt)
local s = norm(txt or "")
if s == "" then return "Other" end
local function any(list) for _, w in ipairs(list) do if s:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
if any({"username", "user name", "profile name"}) then return "Inappropriate Username" end
if any({"swear", "cuss", "profan", "bad word"}) then return "Swearing" end
if any({"bull", "harass", "toxic", "insult", "threat", "racis", "hate", "abus", "slur"}) then return "Bullying" end
if any({"scam", "steal", "stole"}) then return "Scamming" end
if any({"dating", "sexual", "sex", "nsfw", "inappropriate"}) then return "Dating" end
if any({"link", "advert", "promot", "spam"}) then return "Offsite Links" end
return "Other"
end
function K.reportScan(q, pool)
local g = K.sq(q)
local cand = {}
if g == "" then return cand end
for _, p in ipairs(pool or K.others()) do
if p ~= lp and p.Parent == Players then
local sc = K.nameScore(g, p)
if sc == 0 and #g >= 2 then
if K.sq(p.Name):sub(1, #g) == g or K.sq(p.DisplayName):sub(1, #g) == g then sc = 40 end
end
if sc > 0 then cand[#cand + 1] = {p = p, s = sc} end
end
end
table.sort(cand, function(a, b) if a.s ~= b.s then return a.s > b.s end return a.p.Name:lower() < b.p.Name:lower() end)
local exact = {}
for _, c in ipairs(cand) do if c.s >= 98 then exact[#exact + 1] = c end end
if #exact == 1 then return exact end
return cand
end
function K.reportAsk(p, reasonText)
local CM = Util.ChatMod
if not (CM and CM.Submit) then return {text = "Chat moderation isn't loaded, so I can't file reports right now."} end
if not (p and p.Parent == Players) then return {text = "That player has already left the server."} end
local fl = (reasonText == nil or reasonText == "") and CM.Flags and CM.Flags[p.UserId] or nil
local f
if fl then
f = {uid = p.UserId, name = p.Name, display = p.DisplayName, cat = fl.cat, conf = fl.conf, ev = fl.ev, manual = true}
else
f = {uid = p.UserId, name = p.Name, display = p.DisplayName, cat = K.reportReason(reasonText), ev = {}, manual = true}
end
local ok, how = CM.Submit(f, true)
local who = (select(2, CM.Ident(f))) .. " (@" .. (CM.Ident(f)) .. ")"
return {text = ok and ("The report call for %s completed without an error. Roblox gives scripts no confirmation, so Jarvis cannot verify acceptance."):format(who) or (how == "queued" and ("Report for %s is queued and will be sent automatically when the rate limit allows."):format(who) or ((how == "manual" or how == "failed") and ("Jarvis could not submit the report for %s directly. The evidence is prepared and the notification explains how to finish it in the Roblox report menu."):format(who) or ("Nothing was sent for %s. See the notification for details."):format(who))), closeAfter = true}
end
function K.reportFind(q, reasonText, pool)
local function rearm(list)
K.choice = {t = os.clock(), free = function(txt)
local idx
for w in norm(txt):gmatch("%S+") do
local n = tonumber(w)
if n and #w <= 2 and list[n] then idx = n break end
if K.ORD[w] and list[K.ORD[w]] then idx = K.ORD[w] break end
end
if idx then return K.reportAsk(list[idx], reasonText) end
return K.reportFind(txt, reasonText, list)
end}
end
if K.REPPRON[norm(q)] then
local lastp = K.last
if not (lastp and lastp.Parent == Players and lastp ~= lp) then lastp = K.mouseTarget() end
if lastp then return K.reportAsk(lastp, reasonText) end
return {text = "I don't know which player you mean yet. Tell me their display name or username."}
end
if #K.sq(q) < 2 then
rearm(pool or K.others())
return {text = "Who should I report? Tell me their display name or username, even just part of it."}
end
local cand = K.reportScan(q, pool)
if #cand == 0 then
if pool then rearm(pool) end
return {text = ("I can't find anyone matching \"%s\"%s. Try more of their display name or username."):format(plain(q), pool and " among those" or " in this server")}
end
if #cand == 1 then return K.reportAsk(cand[1].p, reasonText) end
local list, lines = {}, {}
for i, c in ipairs(cand) do
if i > 6 then break end
list[i] = c.p
lines[i] = ("%d) %s"):format(i, K.pname(c.p))
end
rearm(list)
return {text = ("I found %d players matching \"%s\": %s%s. Which one should I report? Say a number, or give me more of the name."):format(#cand, plain(q), table.concat(lines, "  "), #cand > #list and (" (and " .. (#cand - #list) .. " more)") or "")}
end
function K.reportCmd(t, words)
if words > 14 or not t:find("report", 1, true) then return nil end
local s = " " .. t .. " "
for _ = 1, 2 do
for _, f in ipairs({" please ", " can you ", " could you ", " would you ", " will you ", " i want to ", " i would like to ", " i d like to ", " id like to ", " i need to ", " i wanna ", " go ahead and ", " help me ", " lets ", " let s ", " you should ", " you can "}) do
s = (s:gsub(f, " "))
end
end
s = trim(s)
local rest = s:match("^reporting%s+(.+)$") or s:match("^report%s+(.+)$")
if not rest then
local v, r = s:match("^(%a+) a report%s*(.*)$")
if not r then v, r = s:match("^(%a+) report%s*(.*)$") end
if v and (v == "file" or v == "submit" or v == "make" or v == "send" or v == "create" or v == "put") then rest = r end
end
if not rest then return nil end
for _ = 1, 4 do
rest = rest:gsub("^on ", ""):gsub("^against ", ""):gsub("^about ", ""):gsub("^for ", ""):gsub("^the ", ""):gsub("^a ", ""):gsub("^an ", ""):gsub("^player ", ""):gsub("^user ", ""):gsub("^person ", ""):gsub("^guy ", ""):gsub("^account ", "")
end
rest = trim(rest)
local name, reasonText = rest, nil
local a, b = rest:find(" for ", 1, true)
if a then name, reasonText = rest:sub(1, a - 1), rest:sub(b + 1) end
local a2, b2 = rest:find(" because ", 1, true)
if a2 and (not a or a2 < a) then name, reasonText = rest:sub(1, a2 - 1), rest:sub(b2 + 1) end
name = trim(name)
if not reasonText and #K.reportScan(name) == 0 then
local head, last = name:match("^(.-)%s*(%S+)$")
if head and head ~= "" and K.reportReason(last) ~= "Other" then name, reasonText = trim(head), last end
end
return K.reportFind(name, reasonText)
end
local function process(raw)
local t = norm(raw)
t = cut(cut(cut(t, "hey jarvis"), "ok jarvis"), "jarvis")
if t == "" then return {text = "Yes? I'm here."} end
local chr = K.choiceReply(t, raw)
if chr then return chr end
if pending then
if os.clock() - pending.t > 25 then pending = nil
else
local first = t:match("^(%a+)") or ""
if YES[t] or YES[first] or t == "go ahead" or t == "do it" then local p = pending pending = nil return p.run() end
if NO[t] or NO[first] or t == "never mind" or t == "do not" or t == "don t" then pending = nil return {text = "Understood. Cancelled."} end
pending = nil
end
end
local words = 0
for _ in t:gmatch("%S+") do words += 1 end
if SIL[t] or t == "stop talking" or t == "stop speaking" or t == "be quiet" or t == "shut up" then TTS.Stop() return {text = "Quiet it is.", silent = true} end
if has(t, {"mute voice", "voice off", "mute yourself", "text only", "disable voice", "turn off voice", "turn off your voice"}) then
SaveData.JarvisVoice = false TTS.Stop() Live.syncVoiceBtn()
return {text = "Voice output is off. I'll reply in text.", silent = true}
end
if has(t, {"unmute", "voice on", "speak again", "talk again", "enable voice", "turn on voice", "turn on your voice", "speak to me", "talk to me"}) then
SaveData.JarvisVoice = true Live.syncVoiceBtn()
return {text = "Voice output is on."}
end
local url = raw:match("https?://[%w%-%._~:/%?#%[%]@!%$&'%(%)%*%+,;=%%]+")
if url and (t:find("voice") or t:find("server") or t:find("backend") or t:find("endpoint") or t:find("tts")) then
url = url:gsub("[%.,;]+$", "")
SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl = url
return {text = "Voice server saved. My next spoken reply will use it."}
end
if has(t, {"default voice", "clear voice server", "reset voice server", "remove voice server"}) then
SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl = nil
return {text = "Voice server cleared. I'll use the keyless British male voice until you set one."}
end
if has(t, {"voice status", "which voice", "what voice", "voice server", "voice backend"}) then
local ep = endpoint()
return {text = (SaveData.JarvisVoice == false and "Voice output is off. " or "Voice output is on. ") .. (ep and ("Using your Edge TTS voice server: " .. ep .. ".") or "No voice server is set, so I'm using the keyless British male voice (Brian), or a pitched-down Google voice if that is unreachable. Say \"set voice server\" followed by your Worker URL for the Edge British butler voice.")}
end
if has(t, {"mic status", "microphone status", "is my mic working", "is my microphone working", "mic not working", "microphone not working", "can you hear me"}) then
return {text = "I can't listen through the microphone any more. To talk to me, use your keyboard's text-to-speech instead, then send what it types."}
end
if t == "undo" or has(t, {"undo that", "revert that", "put it back", "take that back", "undo it"}) then
local u = table.remove(undoStack)
