if not u then return {text = "There's nothing I can undo."} end
local ok = pcall(u.f)
return {text = ok and ("Reverted " .. u.label .. ".") or ("I couldn't revert " .. u.label .. ".")}
end
if t == "close" or t == "dismiss" or t == "go away" or t == "close jarvis" or t == "hide jarvis" or has(t, {"that will be all", "that is all", "that s all", "thats all"}) then
return {text = "Very good.", closeAfter = true}
end
do local rq = K.reportCmd(t, words) if rq then return rq end end
if has(t, {"help", "what can you do", "what can i say", "what are your commands", "capabilities", "what are your capabilities", "how do you work"}) and words <= 8 then
local nSw, nBt, nOther = 0, 0, 0
for _, e in ipairs(entries()) do
if e.Kind == "switch" then nSw += 1 elseif e.Kind == "button" then nBt += 1 else nOther += 1 end
end
local nc = 0
if Util.UhCmd then for _ in pairs(Util.UhCmd.cmds) do nc += 1 end end
return {text = ("I can control %d switches, %d buttons and %d other controls in this script plus %d Uh Admin commands. Try: \"reanimate me\", \"enable the visual effects\", \"switch to lite mode\", \"open the settings\", \"set triangle size to 1.2\", \"what's running?\", \"why am I lagging?\", \"optimize my performance\", \"any errors?\", or \"undo\". Admin commands work in plain words too, with players by name, display name, UserId, \"nearest\" or \"him\": \"make bob fly\", \"bring the nearest player\", \"what does goto do?\". I also know the players here (\"who is in the server?\", \"how much health does bob have?\") and where things are (\"where is the music thing?\"). Anything else I'll answer conversationally."):format(nSw, nBt, nOther, nc)}
end

local verb, slots, number, state, rest = parse(t)
local first = t:match("^(%a+)") or ""
local isQ = QW[first] or raw:find("%?") ~= nil

if has(t, {"optimize", "optimise", "optimization", "speed up", "boost performance", "improve performance", "fix lag", "fix my lag", "reduce lag", "make it faster", "make this faster", "improve my fps", "boost my fps"}) then
local plan, s = optimizePlan()
if #plan == 0 then
return {text = "I can't find any further safe optimisations: no heavy visual features are running and Low End UI Mode " .. ((findByLabel("low end ui mode") and switchOn(findByLabel("low end ui mode"))) and "is already on" or "isn't needed right now") .. ". For more, you could try Anti Lag or Hide All Players manually."}
end
local desc = {}
for _, p in ipairs(plan) do desc[#desc + 1] = (p.want and "enable " or "disable ") .. labelOf(p.e) end
return confirmReply("I'd " .. table.concat(desc, ", ") .. ". Your other settings stay untouched, and I can undo it afterwards.", function()
local done, failed = {}, {}
local group = {}
for _, p in ipairs(plan) do
local r = setSwitch(p.e, p.want)
if r == "failed" then failed[#failed + 1] = labelOf(p.e) elseif r == "ok" then done[#done + 1] = labelOf(p.e) table.insert(group, table.remove(undoStack)) end
end
if #group > 0 then pushUndo("optimisation", function() for i = #group, 1, -1 do pcall(group[i].f) end end) end
local msg = #done > 0 and ("Applied: " .. table.concat(done, ", ") .. ".") or "Nothing needed changing."
if #failed > 0 then msg = msg .. " These didn't take effect: " .. table.concat(failed, ", ") .. "." end
return {text = msg}
end)
end
if (not verb or isQ) and has(t, {"lag", "laggy", "lagging", "slow", "stutter", "stuttering", "fps", "freezing", "choppy", "performance", "frame rate", "framerate", "ping", "memory usage", "ram"}) then
return {text = diagnose()}
end
if words <= 7 and has(t, {"what features are running", "what features are currently running", "which features are running", "what is running", "what s running", "whats running", "what is active", "what s active", "features running", "features active", "active features", "running features", "system status", "status report", "status", "report", "what s happening", "whats happening", "what is happening", "what are you monitoring", "what are you seeing"}) then
local s = snapshot(true)
local lines = {}
lines[#lines + 1] = (#s.on > 0) and (#s.on .. " feature" .. (#s.on > 1 and "s are" or " is") .. " switched on: " .. names(s.on, 10) .. ".") or "No optional switches are currently on."
lines[#lines + 1] = ("Performance: %d FPS%s%s."):format(math.floor(s.fps or 0), s.mem and (", " .. math.floor(s.mem) .. " MB") or "", s.ping and (", ping " .. math.floor(s.ping) .. " ms") or "")
if s.profile then lines[#lines + 1] = "Profile: " .. tostring(s.profile) .. "." end
if s.char then lines[#lines + 1] = ("Your character: %d of %d health, walk speed %d, state %s."):format(s.char.hp, s.char.maxhp, s.char.speed, tostring(s.char.state)) else lines[#lines + 1] = "You have no active character right now." end
lines[#lines + 1] = (s.errs + s.warns == 0) and "No recent errors." or (s.errs .. " error" .. (s.errs == 1 and "" or "s") .. " and " .. s.warns .. " warning" .. (s.warns == 1 and "" or "s") .. " in the last minute.")
if s.status and s.status ~= "" then lines[#lines + 1] = "Modules: " .. plain(tostring(s.status)) .. "." end
return {text = table.concat(lines, " ")}
end
if verb ~= "open" and has(t, {"error", "errors", "warning", "warnings", "exception", "crash", "crashed", "bug", "bugs"}) and (isQ or not verb) and words <= 9 then
if #Logs == 0 then return {text = "I haven't recorded any errors or warnings this session."} end
local out, seen = {}, {}
for i = #Logs, 1, -1 do
local l = Logs[i]
local key = l.m:sub(1, 60)
if not seen[key] and #out < 3 then
seen[key] = true
local why = explainLog(l.m)
out[#out + 1] = (l.e and "Error: " or "Warning: ") .. l.m:sub(1, 110) .. (why and (" - " .. why .. ".") or "")
end
end
return {text = "Most recent issues: " .. table.concat(out, " | ")}
end
if verb == "open" then
if has(t, {"command bar", "admin bar", "uh admin", "command line"}) and Util.UhAdmin and Util.UhAdmin.OpenBar then pcall(Util.UhAdmin.OpenBar) return {text = "Command bar opened.", closeAfter = true} end
if has(t, {"command list", "commands list", "all commands", "commands"}) and Util.UhAdmin and Util.UhAdmin.OpenList then pcall(Util.UhAdmin.OpenList) return {text = "Command list opened.", closeAfter = true} end
if has(t, {"chat", "text chat", "conversation", "history"}) and Util.OpenJarvisChat then Util.OpenJarvisChat() return {text = "Opening the chat window.", closeAfter = true} end
end

do local kr = K.know(raw, t, words, isQ, verb) if kr then return kr end end

-- ----- Uh Admin command: explicit "command X", any request that names another player, or a registry command named in the request -----
local list = entries()
local explicit = has(t, {"command", "cmd"}) ~= nil
local rtoks = K.toks(raw)
local cctx = {t = t, raw = raw, verb = verb, isQ = isQ, words = words, explicit = explicit}
local playerRef = K.hasOtherRef(rtoks, t)
if explicit or playerRef then
local r = K.cmdFlow(rtoks, cctx, rest, number, state)
if r then return r end
end

-- ----- multi-target group: "enable the visual effects" -----
for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
if s.group and s.group.multi and (verb == "on" or verb == "off" or verb == "toggle" or verb == "set" or verb == "run") then
local want
if verb == "off" then want = false elseif verb == "toggle" then want = nil elseif state ~= nil then want = state else want = true end
local hits = {}
for _, e in ipairs(list) do
if e.Kind == "switch" then
local m = labelToks(e)
local ok = false
for _, a in ipairs(s.alts) do for _, lt in ipairs(m.t) do if near(a, lt) > 0 then ok = true end end end
if ok and not m.n:find("fast", 1, true) and #hits < 8 then hits[#hits + 1] = e end
end
end
if #hits == 0 then return {text = "I couldn't find any matching effect switches in this build."} end
local changed, same, failed, group = {}, {}, {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(hits) do
local w = want
if w == nil then w = not switchOn(e) end
local r = setSwitch(e, w)
if r == "ok" then changed[#changed + 1] = labelOf(e) table.insert(group, table.remove(undoStack)) elseif r == "same" then same[#same + 1] = labelOf(e) else failed[#failed + 1] = labelOf(e) end
end
if #group > 0 then pushUndo("visual effects", function() for i = #group, 1, -1 do pcall(group[i].f) end end) end
local msg = {}
if #changed > 0 then msg[#msg + 1] = pick(OKW) .. " Switched " .. ((want == false) and "off" or (want and "on" or "")) .. " " .. names((function() local c = {} for _, n in ipairs(changed) do c[#c + 1] = {GetName = function() return n end} end return c end)(), 6) .. "." end
if #same > 0 then msg[#msg + 1] = #same .. " already " .. ((want == false) and "off" or "on") .. "." end
if #failed > 0 then msg[#msg + 1] = "These didn't change: " .. table.concat(failed, ", ") .. "." end
return {text = table.concat(msg, " ")}
end
end

-- ----- dropdown option phrases ("switch to hats reanimator") -----
if verb == "set" or (not verb and words <= 5) then
local rt = " " .. t .. " "
local bestE, bestLen
for _, e in ipairs(list) do
if e.Kind == "dropdown" and type(e.Options) == "table" then
local lt = labelToks(e)
for _, o in ipairs(e.Options) do
local on = norm(o)
local ntok = 0
for _ in on:gmatch("%S+") do ntok += 1 end
if on ~= "" and rt:find(" " .. on .. " ", 1, true) then
local labelHit = false
for _, w in ipairs(lt.t) do if rt:find(w, 1, true) then labelHit = true end end
if ntok >= 2 or labelHit then
if not bestLen or #on > bestLen then bestE, bestLen = e, #on end
end
end
end
end
end
if bestE then return applyEntry(bestE, "set", number, state, raw) end
end

local cands = findEntries(slots, verb, list)
if not verb and (isQ or (#cands > 0 and cands[1].score < 2.9)) then cands = {} end
if not (cands[1] and cands[1].score >= 1.9) and not (explicit or playerRef) then
local r = K.cmdFlow(rtoks, cctx, rest, number, state, true)
if r then return r end
end
if #cands > 0 then
local top = cands[1]
if cands[2] and top.e ~= cands[2].e and cands[2].score >= top.score - 0.05 and cands[2].label:lower() == top.label:lower() then
return {text = "I found more than one \"" .. top.label .. "\": " .. whereOf(top.e) .. " and " .. whereOf(cands[2].e) .. ". Which one did you mean?"}
end
local e = top.e
if isRisky(labelOf(e)) and (e.Kind == "button" or e.Kind == "item") then
return confirmReply("That presses " .. labelOf(e) .. ", which can be disruptive.", function() return applyEntry(e, verb, number, state, raw) end)
end
return applyEntry(e, verb, number, state, raw)
end

do local r = K.semFlow(raw, t, rest, verb, number, state, isQ, rtoks, cctx, false) if r then return r end end

if verb and not isQ then
local c = closest(slots, list)
local what = {}
for _, s in ipairs(slots) do what[#what + 1] = s.alts[1] end
local w = table.concat(what, " ")
if #c > 0 then return {text = "I couldn't find a control matching \"" .. w .. "\". The closest are: " .. table.concat(c, ", ") .. "."} end
if w ~= "" then return {text = "I couldn't find anything in this script matching \"" .. w .. "\". I won't guess."} end
end
return nil
end

-- =====================================================================
-- CONVERSATIONAL CORE (existing offline JARVIS modules, hosted off-screen)
-- =====================================================================
local P = {}
local function coreReady() return Util.Jarvis and Util.Jarvis.IsReady and Util.Jarvis.IsReady() end
local function warmCore()
if coreReady() or Live.warming or not (Util.Jarvis and Util.Jarvis.Mount) then return end
Live.warming = true
if not (P.hidden and P.hidden.Parent) then
P.hidden = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainFrame)
P.hidden.Visible = false
P.hidden.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 260)
P.hidden.BackgroundTransparency = 1
end
Util.Jarvis.Mount(P.hidden, {onClose = function() Live.Close() end}, function(ok, err)
Live.warming = false
Live.coreErr = (not ok) and err or nil
end)
end
local function askCore(text, cb)
if not coreReady() then
warmCore()
local t0 = os.clock()
while not coreReady() and Live.warming and os.clock() - t0 < 10 do task.wait(0.2) end
end
if not coreReady() or not (Util.Jarvis.H and Util.Jarvis.H.ask) then cb(nil) return end
Util.Jarvis.H.ask(text, function(res) cb(type(res) == "table" and type(res.text) == "string" and res.text or nil) end)
end

-- =====================================================================
-- UI
-- =====================================================================
local accents = {}
local lastAcc
local function G(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
return o
end
local Z = 62
local function frame(parent, props)
props = props or {}
if props.BackgroundTransparency == nil then props.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
props.BorderSizePixel = 0
props.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or Z
return G("Frame", parent, props)
end
local function label(parent, props, class)
props = props or {}
props.BackgroundTransparency = props.BackgroundTransparency or 1
props.BorderSizePixel = 0
props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.Code
props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 14
props.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or Z
if class == "TextButton" then props.AutoButtonColor = false props.Text = props.Text or "" end
return G(class or "TextLabel", parent, props)
end
local function corner(o, r) return G("UICorner", o, {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 8)}) end
local function stroke(o, th, tr)
local s = G("UIStroke", o, {Thickness = th or 1, Transparency = tr or 0.4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})
accents[#accents + 1] = {s, "Color"}
s.Color = accent()
return s
end
local function tint(o, prop) accents[#accents + 1] = {o, prop} o[prop] = accent() return o end
local function button(parent, text, w, cb)
local b = label(parent, {Text = text, TextSize = 11, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 32)}, "TextButton")
corner(b, UDim.new(0, 6))
stroke(b, 1, 0.5)
b.Activated:Connect(cb)
return b
end

local function addMsg(role, text)
if not P.scroll then return end
text = plain(text)
if text == "" then return end
local hex = accent():ToHex()
local who
if role == "you" then who = '<font transparency="0.45">YOU</font>  '
elseif role == "jarvis" then who = '<font color="#' .. hex .. '"><b>JARVIS</b></font>  '
else who = '<font transparency="0.55">SYS</font>  ' end
local l = label(P.scroll, {RichText = true, Text = who .. esc(text), TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = (P.msgN or 0) + 1})
P.msgN = (P.msgN or 0) + 1
P.msgs = P.msgs or {}
P.msgs[#P.msgs + 1] = l
while #P.msgs > MAX_MSG do
local old = table.remove(P.msgs, 1)
pcall(function() old:Destroy() end)
end
if not lowEnd() then
l.TextTransparency = 1
TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
end
task.defer(function()
pcall(function() P.scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, P.scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y)) end)
end)
end
function Live.syncVoiceBtn()
if P.voiceBtn then P.voiceBtn.Text = (SaveData.JarvisVoice == false) and "VOICE OFF" or "VOICE ON" end
end
function Live.state()
if Live.busy then return "thinking" end
if TTS.speaking then return "speaking" end
return "idle"
end

local function deliver(reply)
Live.busy = false
local text = reply.text or ""
addMsg("jarvis", text)
if not reply.silent then TTS.Speak(text) end
if reply.closeAfter then task.delay(1.1, function() Live.Close() end) end
end
function Live.Handle(raw, src)
raw = trim(raw)
if raw == "" then return end
if Live.busy then return end
addMsg("you", raw)
TTS.Stop()
Live.busy = true
Live.req = (Live.req or 0) + 1
local id = Live.req
local function done(r)
if Live.req ~= id or not Live.busy then return end
deliver(r)
end
task.delay(30, function() done({text = "That took longer than expected, so I stopped waiting."}) end)
task.spawn(function()
local ok, r = pcall(process, raw)
if not ok then done({text = "Something went wrong on my side: " .. tostring(r):match("^[^\n]*")}) return end
if r then done(r) return end
askCore(raw, function(text)
if text and trim(plain(text)) ~= "" then done({text = text})
else done({text = "My language core isn't available right now" .. (Live.coreErr and (" (" .. tostring(Live.coreErr):match("^[^\n]*") .. ")") or "") .. ". I can still run commands, report status and diagnose performance. Say \"help\" for examples."}) end
end)
end)
end
Live.onVoiceSource = function(m) addMsg("sys", m) end
Live.onVoiceFail = function(why)
if Live.warnedVoice == why then return end
Live.warnedVoice = why
local m = {["!files"] = "this executor has no file functions, so I can't cache or play speech", ["!assets"] = "this executor has no getcustomasset, so I can't play audio files", ["!net"] = "I couldn't reach Google's voice service (check your connection or your voice server URL)", ["!load"] = "the audio file wouldn't load"}
addMsg("sys", "Voice output failed: " .. (m[why] or "unknown error") .. ". I'll keep replying in text.")
end
-- proactive, throttled suggestions (event-driven: Perf listener + error ring)
local lastSuggest = 0
function Live.suggest(text)
if SaveData.JarvisProactive == false then return end
if os.clock() - lastSuggest < 150 then return end
lastSuggest = os.clock()
if P.root and P.root.Visible then addMsg("jarvis", text) else pcall(Util.Notify, "JARVIS: " .. text) end
end
pcall(function()
Util.FX.Perf.OnChange(function()
local ps = safe(function() return Util.FX.Perf.Status() end)
if ps and ps.FPS and ps.FPS < 24 then Live.suggest("Frame rate has dropped to " .. math.floor(ps.FPS) .. ". Say \"optimize\" and I'll propose what to switch off.") end
end)
end)
Live.onLog = function()
local now, n = os.clock(), 0
for _, l in ipairs(Logs) do if l.e and now - l.t < 10 then n += 1 end end
if n >= 6 then Live.suggest("I'm seeing a burst of script errors. Ask me \"any errors?\" for an explanation.") end
end

local function build()
if P.root then return true end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local root = G("Frame", UIMainFrame, {Name = "JarvisLive", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24),
BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.03, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 60, ClipsDescendants = true})
G("UISizeConstraint", root, {MinSize = Vector2.new(300, 260), MaxSize = Vector2.new(900, 520)})
G("UIGradient", root, {Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(16, 19, 30), Color3.fromRGB(5, 6, 10)), Rotation = 90})
corner(root, UDim.new(0, 14))
stroke(root, 1.5, 0.2)
P.root = root
P.scale = G("UIScale", root, {Scale = 1})
-- header
local head = frame(root, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28)})
label(head, {Text = "J.A.R.V.I.S", TextSize = 18, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(0, 108, 1, 0)})
label(head, {Text = "LIVE INTELLIGENCE", TextSize = 9, TextTransparency = 0.4, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 3), Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0)})
local bl = frame(head, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
G("UIListLayout", bl, {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
P.voiceBtn = button(bl, "VOICE ON", 70, function()
SaveData.JarvisVoice = (SaveData.JarvisVoice == false)
if SaveData.JarvisVoice == false then TTS.Stop() end
Live.syncVoiceBtn()
end)
P.voiceBtn.LayoutOrder = 1
local chat = button(bl, "CHAT", 50, function()
Live.Close()
if Util.OpenJarvisChat then Util.OpenJarvisChat() end
end)
chat.LayoutOrder = 2
local x = button(bl, "X", 28, function() Live.Close() end)
x.LayoutOrder = 3
Live.syncVoiceBtn()
-- body
P.body = frame(root, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -50)})
P.stage = frame(P.body, {})
P.right = frame(P.body, {})
-- reactive rings behind the triangle
P.rings = {}
for i = 1, 3 do
local r = frame(P.stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), ZIndex = Z - 1})
corner(r, UDim.new(1, 0))
P.rings[i] = {f = r, s = stroke(r, 1.5, 0.8)}
end
P.triHolder = frame(P.stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)})
local okT, tri = pcall(Util.FX.NewTriangle3D, P.triHolder, {Interactive = false, ZIndex = Z + 1, Dance = false})
if okT and tri then P.tri = tri
else label(P.triHolder, {Text = "▲", TextScaled = true, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}) end
-- waveform
P.barRow = frame(P.stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 14)})
P.bars = {}
for i = 1, 15 do
local b = frame(P.barRow, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4 + (i - 1) * 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15})
corner(b, UDim.new(1, 0))
tint(b, "BackgroundColor3")
P.bars[i] = b
end
P.stateLbl = label(P.stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 16), Text = "IDLE", TextSize = 12})
-- note directly underneath the triangle (replaces the old microphone button)
P.note = label(P.stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 52), Text = "to talk to Jarvis, use your keyboard's text-to-speech instead.", TextSize = 11, TextWrapped = true, TextTransparency = 0.2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center})
-- right column
P.intel = label(P.right, {RichText = true, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = ""})
P.chips = frame(P.right, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)})
local quick = {{"What's running?", "what's running"}, {"Why lag?", "why am I lagging"}, {"Optimize", "optimize my performance"}, {"Lite mode", "switch to lite mode"}}
P.chipBtns = {}
for i, q in ipairs(quick) do
local b = button(P.chips, q[1], 80, function() Live.Handle(q[2], "chip") end)
b.TextSize = 10
P.chipBtns[i] = b
end
P.scroll = G("ScrollingFrame", P.right, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ZIndex = Z})
corner(P.scroll, UDim.new(0, 8))
G("UIListLayout", P.scroll, {Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
G("UIPadding", P.scroll, {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)})
P.inRow = frame(P.right, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)})
local box = G("TextBox", P.inRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
PlaceholderText = "Type a command...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 134, 150), Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = Z})
corner(box, UDim.new(0, 8)) stroke(box, 1, 0.55)
G("UIPadding", box, {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)})
P.box = box
local function send()
local txt = box.Text
box.Text = ""
Live.Handle(txt, "text")
end
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then send() end end)
local sb = button(P.inRow, "SEND", 56, send)
sb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
sb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
sb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, 0)
-- layout
local function layout()
local W, H = P.body.AbsoluteSize.X, P.body.AbsoluteSize.Y
if W < 50 or H < 50 then return end
local sx, sy, sw, sh, rx, ry, rw, rh
if W >= 520 then
sw = math.clamp(math.floor(W * 0.38), 170, 300) sh = H sx, sy = 0, 0
rx, ry, rw, rh = sw + 10, 0, W - sw - 10, H
else
sw, sh, sx, sy = W, math.floor(H * 0.52), 0, 0
rx, ry, rw, rh = 0, sh + 6, W, H - sh - 6
end
P.stage.Position, P.stage.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy), UDim2.fromOffset(sw, sh)
P.right.Position, P.right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rx, ry), UDim2.fromOffset(rw, rh)
local ts = math.max(56, math.min(sw - 10, sh - 112))
local y0 = math.max(0, math.floor((sh - (ts + 110)) / 2))
local cx = sw / 2
P.ts, P.cx, P.cy = ts, cx, y0 + ts / 2
P.triHolder.Position, P.triHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, y0 + ts / 2), UDim2.fromOffset(ts, ts)
P.barRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, y0 + ts + 10)
P.stateLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, y0 + ts + 28)
P.note.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, y0 + ts + 68)
P.note.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(100, sw - 16), 52)
for _, r in ipairs(P.rings) do r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, y0 + ts / 2) end
local showChips = rh >= 150
P.chips.Visible = showChips
P.intel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
P.chips.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
local cw = math.floor((rw - 12) / 4)
for i, b in ipairs(P.chipBtns) do b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, 24) b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) * (cw + 4), 0) end
local top = showChips and 52 or 24
P.scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top)
P.scroll.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rw, math.max(30, rh - top - 36))
P.inRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, rh - 30)
P.inRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rw, 30)
end
P.layout = layout
P.body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout)
end)
if not ok then
warn("[JARVIS] Live panel failed to build: " .. tostring(err))
pcall(function() if P.root then P.root:Destroy() end end)
P.root = nil
return false, tostring(err)
end
return true
end

-- render loop: only connected while the panel is visible
local conn, accT, intelT, lowAcc = nil, 0, 0, 0
local lastState
local function step(dt)
if lowEnd() then
lowAcc += dt
if lowAcc < 1 / 20 then return end
dt, lowAcc = lowAcc, 0
end
Live.t += dt
Live.fpsAvg = Live.fpsAvg * 0.92 + (1 / math.max(dt, 1e-3)) * 0.08
local t = Live.t
local st = Live.state()
local en
if st == "speaking" then en = math.clamp(((TTS.sound and TTS.sound.PlaybackLoudness) or 0) / 350, 0.18, 1)
elseif st == "thinking" then en = 0.5 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 9)
else en = 0.07 + 0.03 * math.sin(t * 1.4) end
Live.en = Live.en + (en - Live.en) * (1 - math.exp(-10 * dt))
local e = Live.en
accT += dt
if accT > 0.12 then
accT = 0
local c = accent()
if not lastAcc or math.abs(c.R - lastAcc.R) + math.abs(c.G - lastAcc.G) + math.abs(c.B - lastAcc.B) > 0.01 then
lastAcc = c
for i = #accents, 1, -1 do
local a = accents[i]
if a[1].Parent then a[1][a[2]] = c else table.remove(accents, i) end
end
end
end
if P.tri then
P.tri.pulse = math.max(P.tri.pulse or 0, e * 0.7)
if st == "thinking" then P.tri.yawVel = math.max(P.tri.yawVel or 0, 6)
elseif st == "speaking" then P.tri.yawVel = math.max(P.tri.yawVel or 0, 2 + e * 5) end
end
local ts = P.ts or 100
local active = st ~= "idle"
for i, r in ipairs(P.rings) do
local ph = (t * 0.45 + i / 3) % 1
local sz = ts * (0.72 + 0.1 * i + (0.35 + e) * 0.3 * ph)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
r.s.Transparency = active and (0.4 + 0.6 * ph) or (0.88 + 0.12 * ph)
end
local bw = (P.barRow and 1) or 0
for i, b in ipairs(P.bars) do
local h = 3 + 11 * e * (0.3 + 0.7 * math.abs(math.sin(t * 6 + i * 0.7)))
b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, math.max(3, h))
end
if st ~= lastState then
lastState = st
P.stateLbl.Text = ({idle = "IDLE", thinking = "THINKING", speaking = "SPEAKING"})[st] or "IDLE"
end
intelT += dt
if intelT > 1 then
intelT = 0
local s = snapshot(false)
local function col(txtv, bad) return bad and ('<font color="#FF6B6B">' .. txtv .. "</font>") or txtv end
P.intel.Text = table.concat({
col("FPS " .. (s.fps and string.format("%d", s.fps) or "--"), s.fps and s.fps < 30),
col("MEM " .. (s.mem and string.format("%d", s.mem) or "--") .. "MB", s.mem and s.mem > 1800),
col("PING " .. (s.ping and string.format("%d", s.ping) or "--") .. "ms", s.ping and s.ping > 250),
"ON " .. Live.onCount,
col("ERR " .. s.errs, s.errs > 0)}, "  |  ")
end
end

function Live.IsOpen() return P.root ~= nil and P.root.Visible end
function Live.Open()
local ok, err = build()
if not ok then
pcall(Util.Notify, "JARVIS Live failed to build: " .. tostring(err))
if Util.OpenJarvisChat then Util.OpenJarvisChat() end
return
end
if P.root.Visible then return end
P.root.Visible = true
pcall(function() if P.tri then P.tri:SetActive(true) end end)
if P.layout then P.layout() task.defer(P.layout) end
conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(step)
accT, intelT, lastState = 1, 1, nil
Live.onCount = #onSwitches()
if not lowEnd() then
P.scale.Scale = 0.93
TweenService:Create(P.scale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end
warmCore()
if not Live.greeted then
Live.greeted = true
local h = tonumber(os.date("%H")) or 12
local per = (h >= 5 and h < 12) and "morning" or (h >= 12 and h < 17) and "afternoon" or "evening"
local name = lp and ((lp.DisplayName ~= "" and lp.DisplayName) or lp.Name) or "friend"
local g = ("Good %s, %s. Live Intelligence is online. Type a command below."):format(per, name)
addMsg("jarvis", g)
TTS.Speak(("Good %s, %s. At your service."):format(per, name))
end
end
function Live.Close()
if not P.root or not P.root.Visible then return end
TTS.Stop()
P.root.Visible = false
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
pcall(function() if P.tri then P.tri:SetActive(false) end end)
end
Live.Speak = TTS.Speak
Live.Process = process
Live.TTS = TTS

-- main-page settings (they register in Util.Search too, so JARVIS can drive them by voice)
function Live.BuildSettings(page)
local lever = UI.CreateSwitch(page, "Jarvis Voice (Google TTS)", SaveData.JarvisVoice ~= false)
lever.Changed:Connect(function(v)
SaveData.JarvisVoice = v
if not v then TTS.Stop() end
Live.syncVoiceBtn()
end)
local sw2 = UI.CreateSwitch(page, "Jarvis Proactive Suggestions", SaveData.JarvisProactive ~= false)
sw2.Changed:Connect(function(v) SaveData.JarvisProactive = v end)
local box = UI.CreateTextbox(page, "Jarvis voice server (Cloudflare Worker URL for the Edge butler voice)", "https://jarvis-tts.yourname.workers.dev", 12)
pcall(function() box.Text = SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl or "" end)
box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
local u = trim(box.Text)
if u == "" then SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl = nil
elseif u:match("^https?://") then SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl = u
else box.Text = SaveData.JarvisTTSUrl or "" pcall(Util.Notify, "JARVIS: the voice server must start with https://") end
end)
end
return Live
end)()

if ok then

else

AIStatus.Visible = true
end
end)
end

local NoobyHubPage = UI.CreatePage()
pcall(function() Util.Search.Titles[NoobyHubPage] = "Script Hub" end)

local UhhhhhhFire = UI.CreateText(CreditsPage, "", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
Util.ForceTextSize(UhhhhhhFire)
UI.CreateText(CreditsPage, "Reanimate by STEVE :D", 15, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
local UhhhhhhFiret = UI.CreateSlider(CreditsPage, "Transparency", 0.25, 0, 1, 0)
local UhhhhhhFirep = {}
for i=1, 64 do
table.insert(UhhhhhhFirep, {i / 64, 0.98 + math.random() * 0.04, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5})
end
local UhhhhhhFirea = {
"XX    XX XX      XX      XX      XX      XX      XX     ",
"XX    XX XX      XX      XX      XX      XX      XX     ",
"XX    XX XXXXXX  XXXXXX  XXXXXX  XXXXXX  XXXXXX  XXXXXX ",
"XX    XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX",
"XXX  XXX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX",
" XXXXXX  XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX XX   XX",
}
local UhhhhhhFirex = #UhhhhhhFirea[1]
local UhhhhhhFirey = #UhhhhhhFirea
do
local radius = 0.1
local ratio = (UhhhhhhFirey / UhhhhhhFirex) * 1.75
local r2, depth = radius * radius, 1 + radius / ratio
local rows, cols = UhhhhhhFirey, UhhhhhhFirex
local pq = {}
for i = 1, #UhhhhhhFirep do pq[i] = {0, 0, 0} end
local X1, Y1, SP = {}, {}, {}
for x = 1, cols do X1[x] = x / cols end
for y = 1, rows do
Y1[y] = y / rows
local row = {}
for x = 1, cols do row[x] = UhhhhhhFirea[y]:sub(x, x) == " " end
SP[y] = row
end
local cells, lines, lastText, fireAcc = {}, {}, nil, 0
-- same fire as before (identical per-cell result), but: no work while the Credits page is hidden, a particle that cannot reach a cell is skipped
-- before sqrt/pow, no per-frame table churn, and it runs at 30 fps (20 fps when the UI is stressed) instead of every render frame
Util.AddDecoStep(function(t, dt)
if not CreditsPage.Visible or not Util.IsGuiVisible(UhhhhhhFire) then return end
local FXg = Util.FX
fireAcc = fireAcc + (dt or 0)
if fireAcc < ((FXg.IsLowEnd() or (FXg.Gov and FXg.Gov.Stride > 1)) and 1 / 20 or 1 / 30) then return end
dt, fireAcc = fireAcc, 0
local tr = math.clamp(UhhhhhhFiret.Value, 0, 1)
local n = 0
for _, v in UhhhhhhFirep do
v[1] = v[1] + dt * v[2]
if v[1] >= 1 then
v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4] = 0, 0.98 + math.random() * 0.04, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5
end
n = n + 1
local q = pq[n]
q[1], q[2], q[3] = 1 - v[1], v[3] + v[4] * v[1] * 0.25, (1 - v[1]) * depth
end
for y = 1, rows do
local y1, sp = Y1[y], SP[y]
for x = 1, cols do
local ch
local isSp = sp[x]
if isSp and tr < 0.1 then
ch = " "
else
local bright, x1 = 0, X1[x]
for i = 1, n do
local q = pq[i]
local x3 = q[2] - x1
if x3 < radius and x3 > -radius then
local y3 = (q[3] - y1) * ratio
local d2 = x3 * x3 + y3 * y3
if d2 < r2 then
local a = (1 - math.sqrt(d2) / radius) * q[1]
bright = bright + (1.0 - bright) * (a ^ 1.5)
end
end
end
if isSp then bright = bright * tr end
if bright > 0.9 then ch = "Q"
elseif bright > 0.8 then ch = "W"
elseif bright > 0.7 then ch = "#"
elseif bright > 0.6 then ch = "S"
elseif bright > 0.5 then ch = "l"
elseif bright > 0.4 then ch = "v"
elseif bright > 0.3 then ch = "|"
elseif bright > 0.2 then ch = ";"
elseif bright > 0.1 then ch = "."
else ch = " " end
end
cells[x] = ch
end
lines[y] = table.concat(cells, "", 1, cols)
end
local s = table.concat(lines, "\n", 1, rows)
if s ~= lastText then lastText = s UhhhhhhFire.Text = s end
end)
end

local InitLogsText = (function()
local label = UI.CreateText(InitLogsPage, "Loading...", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
local MAXLEN = 24000
local parts, n = {"Loading..."}, 1
local dirty, queued, hasErr = false, false, false
local function join()
if n > 1 then
local str = table.concat(parts, "", 1, n)
if #str > MAXLEN then
str = str:sub(-MAXLEN)
local nl = str:find("\n", 1, true)
if nl then str = str:sub(nl) end
end
table.clear(parts)
parts[1], n = str, 1
end
return parts[1]
end
local flush
local function mark()
dirty = true
if not queued then
queued = true
task.delay(0.35, flush)
end
end
function flush()
queued = false
if not dirty then return end
if label.Parent == nil then return end
if Util.IsGuiVisible(label) then
dirty = false
label.Text = join()
else
queued = true
task.delay(0.75, flush)
end
end
local function add(str)
n += 1
parts[n] = tostring(str)
if not hasErr and parts[n]:find("ERROR", 1, true) then hasErr = true end
if n >= 256 then join() end
mark()
end
pcall(function() InitLogsPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() if dirty then flush() end end) end)
return setmetatable({}, {
__index = function(_, k)
if k == "Text" then return join() end
if k == "Add" then return add end
if k == "HasError" then return hasErr end
return label[k]
end,
__newindex = function(_, k, v)
if k == "Text" then
table.clear(parts)
parts[1], n = tostring(v), 1
hasErr = parts[1]:find("ERROR", 1, true) ~= nil
mark()
else
label[k] = v
end
end,
})
end)()
local function _contentgetgithubraw(path)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path)
local s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = "https://api.github.com/repos/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/contents/content/" .. path,
Headers = {
Accept = "application/vnd.github.VERSION.raw"
}
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
return resp.Body
end
if s and resp then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path .. " " .. resp.StatusCode)
elseif s then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path .. " NIL")
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path .. " ERR " .. resp)
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path)
s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/main/content/" .. path,
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
return resp.Body
end
if s and resp then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path .. " " .. resp.StatusCode)
elseif s then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path .. " NIL")
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path .. " ERR " .. resp)
end
return nil
end

local function normalize(p) return (tostring(p):gsub("\\", "/")) end
local function shortName(p) return normalize(p):match("([^/]+)$") or tostring(p) end
local function under(path, list)
local p = normalize(path):lower() .. "/"
for _, dir in ipairs(list) do
if p:find(dir .. "/", 1, true) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function shouldScan(path)
local ext = shortName(path):match("%.([%w_]+)$")
return ext ~= nil and cfg.Extensions[ext:lower()] == true
end

end

pcall(Util.UINotify, text)
end
local function status(prefix)
local text = string.format("%s | scanned this pass: %d | flagged: %d | deleted: %d", prefix, Stats.PassScanned, Stats.Flagged, Stats.Deleted)
if Stats.Errors > 0 or Stats.Skipped > 0 then
text = text .. string.format(" | errors: %d | skipped: %d", Stats.Errors, Stats.Skipped)
end
Security.StatusText = text
if Security.OnStatus then pcall(Security.OnStatus, text) end
end
local function reasonText(report, n)
local out = {}
for i = 1, math.min(n or 3, #report.reasons) do
local r = report.reasons[i]
out[i] = r.desc .. (r.line and (" (line " .. r.line .. ")") or "")
end
return table.concat(out, "; ")
end
local function slice(state, gen)
if not gen then return true end
local budget = cfg.SliceBudget
if Security._frame > cfg.MaxFrameTime then budget = budget * 0.5 end
if os.clock() - state.t0 >= budget then
task.wait()
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
state.t0 = os.clock()
end
return true
end
local function count(s, p)
local _, n = s:gsub(p, "")
return n
end
local function maskComments(content, state, gen)
local parts, np, i, last, n, tick = {}, 0, 1, 1, #content, 0
while true do
local s = content:find("[%-\"'`%[]", i)
if not s then break end
local c = content:byte(s)
if c == 45 then
if content:byte(s + 1) == 45 then
np += 1
parts[np] = content:sub(last, s - 1)
local lv = content:match("^%[(=*)%[", s + 2)
local e
if lv then
local _, ce = content:find("]" .. lv .. "]", s + 4 + #lv, true)
e = ce or n
else
local nl = content:find("\n", s + 2, true)
e = nl and nl - 1 or n
end
local body = content:sub(s, e)
if not state.banner and #body < 600 then
local lb = body:lower()
if lb:find(K("lur|aph"), 1, true) or lb:find(K("moon|sec"), 1, true) or lb:find(K("iron|brew"), 1, true) or lb:find("obfuscat", 1, true) then
state.banner = s
end
end
np += 1
parts[np] = (body:gsub("[^\n]", " "))
i = e + 1
last = i
else
i = s + 1
end
elseif c == 91 then
local lv = content:match("^%[(=*)%[", s)
if lv then
local _, ce = content:find("]" .. lv .. "]", s + 2 + #lv, true)
i = (ce or n) + 1
else
i = s + 1
end
else
local j = s + 1
local stop = c == 34 and "[\\\"\n]" or (c == 39 and "[\\'\n]" or "[\\`]")
while true do
local k = content:find(stop, j)
if not k then j = n + 1 break end
local ch = content:byte(k)
if ch == 92 then
j = k + 2
else
j = k + 1
break
end
end
i = j
end
tick += 1
if tick % 64 == 0 and not slice(state, gen) then return nil end
end
np += 1
parts[np] = content:sub(last)
return table.concat(parts)
end
local function hexRepl(h)
local b = tonumber(h, 16)
if b == 10 or b == 13 then return nil end
return string.char(b)
end
local function decRepl(d)
local b = tonumber(d)
if b > 255 or b == 10 or b == 13 then return nil end
return string.char(b)
end
local function foldRepl(_, w1, w2)
return ((w1 .. w2):gsub("[^\n]", ""))
end
local RUNDEC = "\\%d%d?%d?\\%d%d?%d?\\%d%d?%d?\\%d%d?%d?"
local RUNHEX = "\\x%x%x\\x%x%x\\x%x%x\\x%x%x"
local TINYP = "[\"'][^\"'\n][^\"'\n]?[\"']%s*%.%.%s*[\"']"
local ILP = string.rep("[il1]", 9)
local function prepare(content, state, gen)
local masked = maskComments(content, state, gen)
if not masked then return nil end
local n, out, no, pos = #masked, {}, 0, 1
while pos <= n do
local stop = pos + cfg.ChunkSize - 1
if stop >= n then
stop = n
else
local nl = masked:find("\n", stop, true)
if nl and nl - stop <= 2048 then
stop = nl
else
local br = masked:find("[%s,;%(%)]", stop)
if br and br - stop <= 256 then stop = br end
end
end
local blk = masked:sub(pos, stop)
if stop < n and blk:find("%.%.%s*$") then
local nl = masked:find("\n", stop + 1, true)
if nl and nl - stop <= 2048 then
stop = nl
blk = masked:sub(pos, stop)
end
end
blk = blk:gsub("\\\\", "\1\1")
state.escRuns += count(blk, RUNDEC) + count(blk, RUNHEX)
local x, d
blk, x = blk:gsub("\\x(%x%x)", hexRepl)
blk, d = blk:gsub("\\(%d%d?%d?)", decRepl)
state.esc += x + d
blk = blk:gsub("\1\1", "\\\\"):lower()
state.tiny += count(blk, TINYP)
blk = blk:gsub("([\"'`])(%s*)%.%.(%s*)([\"'`])", function(_, w1, w2) return foldRepl(nil, w1, w2) end)
state.hexid += count(blk, "_0x%x%x%x%x") + count(blk, ILP)
no += 1
out[no] = blk
pos = stop + 1
if pos <= n and not slice(state, gen) then return nil end
end
return table.concat(out)
end
local function add(state, id, cat, w, desc, abs, o)
local e = state.ev[id]
if e then
e.count += 1
if w > e.weight then
e.weight = w
e.desc = desc
end
return e
end
e = {id = id, cat = cat, weight = w, desc = desc, abs = abs, count = 1}
if o then
e.crit = o.crit
e.grp = o.grp
end
state.ev[id] = e
return e
end
local function isPrivate(ip)
if ip:find("^127%.") or ip:find("^10%.") or ip:find("^192%.168%.") or ip:find("^0%.") then return true end
local b = tonumber(ip:match("^172%.(%d+)%."))
return b ~= nil and b >= 16 and b <= 31
end
local function trusted(host)
for i = 1, #TRUSTED do
local t = TRUSTED[i]
if host == t or host:sub(-#t - 1) == "." .. t then return true end
end
return false
end
local B64P = string.rep("[%w%+/]", 160)
local NUMLIST = string.rep("%d+%s*,%s*", 20)
local function scanChunk(state, seg, base, zone)
local ev, fl = state.ev, state.flags
for i = 1, #RULES do
local r = RULES[i]
if not ev[r.id] then
local at
if r.any then
for j = 1, #r.any do
local a = seg:find(r.any[j], 1, true)
if a and (not at or a < at) then at = a end
end
elseif r.p then
at = seg:find(r.p)
else
at = seg:find(r.f, 1, true)
end
if at and at <= zone then add(state, r.id, r.cat, r.w, r.desc, base + at - 1, r) end
end
end
local init, cnt = 1, 0
while cnt < cfg.MaxLoaderChecks do
local s, e = seg:find(LS, init, true)
if not s or s > zone then break end
cnt += 1
init = e + 1
local abs = base + s - 1
fl.ls = fl.ls or abs
local w = seg:sub(e + 1, e + cfg.LoaderWindow)
if w:find(HG, 1, true) or w:find(GA, 1, true) or w:find(REQ) then
local host = w:match("https?://([%w%.%-_]+)")
local wt, d
if not host then
wt, d = 15, "downloads and runs code from a computed address"
elseif trusted(host) then
wt, d = 8, "downloads and runs code from " .. host
else
wt, d = 28, "downloads and runs code from unrecognized host " .. host
end
add(state, "remote_exec", "rce", wt, d, abs)
fl.remote = fl.remote or abs
end
local head = w:sub(1, 160)
for j = 1, #DECODERS do
if head:find(DECODERS[j], 1, true) then
add(state, "decode_exec", "rce", 45, "executes a string that was decoded at runtime", abs)
break
end
end
local bs, be, eq = w:find("^[%s%(]*%[(=*)%[")
if bs then
local ce = seg:find("]" .. eq .. "]", e + be + 1, true)
if ((ce and ce - e - be) or (#seg - e)) >= cfg.BlobMin then
add(state, "embedded_exec", "obf", 20, "runs a large string blob embedded in the script", abs)
end
end
end
for i = 1, #SPAWNERS do
local needle = SPAWNERS[i]
local ini, c = 1, 0
while c < 200 do
local s, e = seg:find(needle, ini, true)
if not s or s > zone then break end
c += 1
ini = e + 1
local win = seg:sub(e + 1, e + cfg.LineWindow)
local nl = win:find("\n", 1, true)
if nl then win = win:sub(1, nl - 1) end
local bs, be, eq = win:find("%[(=*)%[")
if bs then
local ce = seg:find("]" .. eq .. "]", e + be + 1, true)
if ((ce and ce - e - bs) or (#seg - e - bs)) >= cfg.BlobMin then
if win:sub(1, bs):find(LS, 1, true) then
add(state, "spawn_exec_blob", "rce", 95, "spawns a loader for a hidden long-string payload", base + s - 1)
else
add(state, "spawn_blob", "obf", 55, "hides a long-string payload right after " .. needle, base + s - 1)
end
break
end
end
end
end
if not ev.raw_ip then
local ini = 1
while true do
local s, e, ip = seg:find("https?://(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)", ini)
if not s or s > zone then break end
ini = e + 1
if not isPrivate(ip) then
add(state, "raw_ip", "net", 25, "talks to a bare IP address", base + s - 1)
break
end
end
end
if not fl.get and (seg:find(HG, 1, true) or seg:find(GA, 1, true) or seg:find(REQ)) then fl.get = base end
if not fl.send then
if seg:find(HP, 1, true) or seg:find(PA, 1, true) then
fl.send = base
else
local ini, c = 1, 0
while c < 100 do
local s, e = seg:find(REQ, ini)
if not s or s > zone then break end
c += 1
ini = e + 1
local m = seg:sub(e, e + 600):match("method[\"']?%s*[=:]%s*[\"'](%a+)")
if m == "post" or m == "put" or m == "patch" then
fl.send = base + s - 1
break
end
end
end
end
if not ev.autoexec_write then
local ini, c = 1, 0
while c < 20 do
local s, e = seg:find(AX, ini, true)
if not s or s > zone then break end
c += 1
ini = e + 1
local w = seg:sub(math.max(1, s - 300), s + 300)
if w:find(WF, 1, true) or w:find(AF, 1, true) then
add(state, "autoexec_write", "persist", 55, "writes a script into the executor autoexec folder", base + s - 1)
break
end
end
end
if not ev.bulk_delete then
local ini, c = 1, 0
while c < 20 do
local s, e = seg:find(LF, ini, true)
if not s or s > zone then break end
c += 1
ini = e + 1
local w = seg:sub(e + 1, e + 500)
if w:find(DF) or w:find(DD) then
add(state, "bulk_delete", "destr", 55, "deletes files in a loop over the file list", base + s - 1)
break
end
end
end
if not ev.wipe_workspace then
local s = seg:find(K("del|folder") .. "%s*%(%s*[\"']%.?/?[\"']%s*%)") or seg:find(K("del|folder") .. "%s*%(%s*[\"']workspace/?[\"']%s*%)")
if s and s <= zone then
add(state, "wipe_workspace", "destr", 95, "deletes the entire workspace folder", base + s - 1, {crit = true})
end
end
if not ev.byte_array then
local s = seg:find(NUMLIST)
if s and s <= zone then add(state, "byte_array", "obf", 20, "contains a large numeric byte array (encoded payload)", base + s - 1) end
end
if not fl.b64a and seg:find(B64A, 1, true) then fl.b64a = true end
if not fl.b64b then
local s = seg:find(B64P)
if s and s <= zone then fl.b64b = base + s - 1 end
end
end
local function scanView(view, state, gen)
local n, pos = #view, 1
while pos <= n do
local stop = pos + cfg.ChunkSize - 1
if stop >= n then
stop = n
else
local nl = view:find("\n", stop, true)
if nl and nl - stop <= cfg.ChunkOverlap // 2 then stop = nl end
end
scanChunk(state, view:sub(pos, math.min(n, stop + cfg.ChunkOverlap)), pos, stop - pos + 1)
pos = stop + 1
if pos <= n and not slice(state, gen) then return false end
end
return true
end
local function lineOfAbs(state, abs)
if not abs then return nil end
local nl = state.nl
if not nl then
nl = {}
local v, p, k = state.view, 1, 0
while true do
local s = v:find("\n", p, true)
if not s then break end
k += 1
nl[k] = s
p = s + 1
end
state.nl = nl
end
local lo, hi = 1, #nl + 1
while lo < hi do
local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
if nl[mid] < abs then lo = mid + 1 else hi = mid end
end
return lo
end
local function byWeight(a, b)
if a.weight ~= b.weight then return a.weight > b.weight end
return a.id < b.id
end
local function evaluate(state)
local ev, fl = state.ev, state.flags
if state.esc >= cfg.EscapeLimit and state.escRuns >= cfg.EscapeRuns then
add(state, "esc_dense", "obf", 30, "is packed with escape-sequence encoded strings")
end
if state.hexid >= cfg.HexIdentLimit then add(state, "obf_ident", "obf", 20, "uses machine-generated identifier names") end
if state.tiny >= cfg.TinyJoinLimit then add(state, "concat_build", "obf", 20, "assembles strings from many tiny fragments") end
if state.banner then add(state, "obfuscator", "obf", 25, "is hidden by a script obfuscator", state.banner) end
if fl.b64a and fl.b64b then add(state, "b64_payload", "obf", 20, "bundles a base64 decoder with a large encoded blob", fl.b64b) end
local list, best = {}, {}
for _, e in pairs(ev) do
if e.grp then
local b = best[e.grp]
if not b or e.weight > b.weight then best[e.grp] = e end
else
list[#list + 1] = e
end
end
for _, e in pairs(best) do list[#list + 1] = e end
local obfCount = 0
for id, wt in pairs(OBF) do
if ev[id] then obfCount += wt end
end
local function A(...)
for _, id in ipairs({...}) do
if ev[id] then return ev[id].abs end
end
end
local net = ev.webhook or ev.ip_logger or fl.send or fl.remote
local combos = {}
local function combo(id, w, desc, abs, crit)
combos[#combos + 1] = {id = "combo:" .. id, cat = "combo", weight = w, desc = desc, abs = abs, crit = crit, count = 1}
end
if ev.cookie_ref and net then
combo("cred_exfil", 50, "reads the login cookie and has a way to send it out", A("cookie_ref"), true)
end
if ev.webhook and (ev.ip_lookup or ev.hwid) then
combo("webhook_ident", 45, "posts IP / hardware identifiers to a webhook", A("webhook"))
end
if ev.auth_api and ev.csrf and (ev.cookie_ref or ev.cookie_hdr) then
combo("token_chain", 40, "auth API + CSRF + cookie: account-takeover chain", A("auth_api"))
end
if ev.stealer_words and (ev.webhook or fl.send) then
combo("stealer_send", 35, "stealer keywords together with outbound data sending", A("stealer_words"))
end
if fl.ls and obfCount >= 3 then
combo("obf_exec", 30, "hides code behind obfuscation and executes it", fl.ls)
if obfCount >= 6 then combo("obf_layers", 25, "several layered obfuscation techniques feed an execution call", fl.ls) end
end
if ev.remote_exec and (ev.paste_host or ev.raw_ip) then
combo("remote_untrusted", 25, "downloads and runs code from an editable paste or bare IP host", A("remote_exec"))
end
if ev.remote_exec and obfCount >= 2 then
combo("remote_obf", 30, "obfuscated remote loader", A("remote_exec"))
end
if ev.autoexec_write and (fl.ls or ev.remote_exec) then
combo("persist_loader", 30, "installs a loader that survives restarts", A("autoexec_write"))
end
local cats, crit = {}, false
for _, e in ipairs(list) do
local c = cats[e.cat]
if not c then
c = {top = 0, rest = 0}
cats[e.cat] = c
end
if e.weight > c.top then
c.rest += c.top
c.top = e.weight
else
c.rest += e.weight
end
if e.crit then
c.crit = true
crit = true
end
end
local total, ncat = 0, 0
for _, c in pairs(cats) do
local s = c.top + cfg.RestFactor * c.rest
if not c.crit and s > cfg.CategoryCap then s = cfg.CategoryCap end
if s >= 30 then ncat += 1 end
total += s
end
for _, c in ipairs(combos) do
total += c.weight
list[#list + 1] = c
if c.crit then crit = true end
end
table.sort(list, byWeight)
local verdict = "CLEAN"
if total >= cfg.MaliciousScore and (crit or #combos > 0 or ncat >= 2) then
verdict = "MALICIOUS"
elseif total >= cfg.SuspiciousScore then
verdict = "SUSPICIOUS"
end
local reasons = {}
for i, e in ipairs(list) do
reasons[i] = {id = e.id, cat = e.cat, weight = e.weight, desc = e.desc, line = lineOfAbs(state, e.abs), count = e.count, conf = math.min(0.99, 0.3 + e.weight / 150)}
end
local conf
if verdict == "CLEAN" then
conf = math.max(0.5, 1 - 0.5 * total / cfg.SuspiciousScore)
else
conf = 0.4 + 0.08 * math.min(#list, 5) + (#combos > 0 and 0.15 or 0) + (crit and 0.25 or 0)
conf = verdict == "MALICIOUS" and math.min(0.99, math.max(conf, 0.6)) or math.min(0.9, conf - 0.1)
end
local severity = "none"
if crit then
severity = "critical"
elseif verdict == "MALICIOUS" then
severity = "high"
elseif verdict == "SUSPICIOUS" then
severity = "medium"
elseif total >= cfg.LowScore then
severity = "low"
end
return {verdict = verdict, score = math.floor(total + 0.5), confidence = conf, severity = severity, reasons = reasons}
end
function Security.Analyze(content, gen)
if type(content) ~= "string" then error("Security.Analyze expects a string") end
local state = {ev = {}, flags = {}, esc = 0, escRuns = 0, hexid = 0, tiny = 0, t0 = os.clock()}
local view = prepare(content, state, gen)
if not view then return nil end
state.view = view
if not scanView(view, state, gen) then return nil end
return evaluate(state)
end
function Security.Enabled() return SaveData.SecurityScan ~= false end
function Security.AutoDelete() return SaveData.SecurityAutoDelete == true end
local qSeq = 0
local function quarantineName(path)
qSeq += 1
local safe = (normalize(path):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_"))
if #safe > 80 then safe = safe:sub(-80) end
return string.format("%s/%s.%d.%d.quarantined", cfg.QuarantineDir, safe, os.time(), qSeq)
end
local function deleteFile(path, content)
if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(delfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
return false, nil, "executor lacks the file functions needed for a safe quarantine"
end
pcall(makefolder, cfg.QuarantineDir)
if type(isfolder) == "function" then
local okF, isF = pcall(isfolder, cfg.QuarantineDir)
if not (okF and isF) then return false, nil, "quarantine folder is unavailable" end
end
local target
for _ = 1, 25 do
local t = quarantineName(path)
local okE, exists = pcall(isfile, t)
if okE and not exists then
target = t
break
end
end
if not target then return false, nil, "no free quarantine file name" end
local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, target, content)
if not okW then
pcall(delfile, target)
return false, nil, "quarantine write failed: " .. tostring(errW)
end
local okR, back = pcall(readfile, target)
if not (okR and back == content) then
pcall(delfile, target)
return false, nil, "quarantine copy failed verification"
end
local okO, now = pcall(readfile, path)
if not (okO and now == content) then return false, target, "file changed since the scan, kept in place" end
pcall(delfile, path)
local okG, still = pcall(isfile, path)
if not okG or still then return false, target, "delete did not remove the file" end
return true, target
end
local reported, byKey = {}, {}
local function respond(path, report, content, blocked)
local key = normalize(path) .. "|" .. report.verdict .. "|" .. report.score .. "|" .. #content
local first = not reported[key]
reported[key] = true
local why = reasonText(report)
local name = shortName(path)
local malicious = report.verdict == "MALICIOUS"
local deleted, qpath, dwhy = false, nil, nil
local prior = byKey[key]
if malicious and not (prior and prior.deleted) and Security.AutoDelete() and not under(path, cfg.ReportOnlyDirs) then
if report.confidence >= cfg.AutoDeleteMinConfidence then
deleted, qpath, dwhy = deleteFile(path, content)
else
dwhy = "confidence too low for auto-delete"
end
end
if qpath then Stats.Quarantined += 1 end
if first then
Stats.Flagged += 1
local ev, lines = {}, {}
for i = 1, math.min(8, #report.reasons) do
ev[i] = report.reasons[i]
if report.reasons[i].line then lines[#lines + 1] = report.reasons[i].line end
end
local finding = {path = path, verdict = report.verdict, score = report.score, why = why, deleted = deleted, time = os.time(), confidence = report.confidence, severity = report.severity, evidence = ev, lines = lines, quarantined = qpath, note = dwhy}
byKey[key] = finding
table.insert(Security.Findings, finding)
if #Security.Findings > cfg.MaxFindings then table.remove(Security.Findings, 1) end
elseif prior then
if deleted then prior.deleted = true end
if qpath then prior.quarantined = qpath end
if dwhy then prior.note = dwhy end
end
if deleted then
Stats.Deleted += 1
log("DELETED " .. path .. " [score " .. report.score .. "]: " .. why .. " (copy kept in " .. tostring(qpath) .. ")")
notify("Auto-deleted " .. name .. ": " .. why)
else
if dwhy and malicious then log("KEPT " .. path .. ": " .. dwhy) end
if first then
log(report.verdict .. " " .. path .. string.format(" [score %d, confidence %.2f, %s]: ", report.score, report.confidence, report.severity) .. why)
if malicious then
notify((blocked and "Blocked malicious module " or "Malicious file found: ") .. name .. ": " .. why)
elseif blocked then
notify("Suspicious module needs review: " .. name .. " (details in Init Logs)")
else
notify("Suspicious file: " .. name .. " (details in Init Logs)")
end
end
end
if first and malicious and Security.OnMalicious then
pcall(Security.OnMalicious, path, report)
end
return deleted
end
local function keep(list, item)
table.insert(list, item)
if #list > cfg.MaxLogged then table.remove(list, 1) end
end
local noted = {}
local function noteError(path, what, err)
Stats.Errors += 1
local key = tostring(path) .. "|" .. what
if noted[key] then return end
noted[key] = true
keep(Security.Errors, {path = path, what = what, err = tostring(err), time = os.time()})
log("ERROR " .. what .. ": " .. tostring(path) .. " (" .. tostring(err) .. ")")
end
local function noteSkip(path, reason)
local key = tostring(path) .. "|skip|" .. reason
if noted[key] then return end
noted[key] = true
Stats.Skipped += 1
keep(Security.Skipped, {path = path, reason = reason, time = os.time()})
log("SKIPPED " .. tostring(path) .. ": " .. reason)
end
function Security.GateModule(path, content)
if not Security.Enabled() or type(content) ~= "string" then return nil end
if #content > cfg.GateMaxBytes then
local msg = "module is larger than " .. cfg.GateMaxBytes .. " bytes and cannot be scanned"
noteSkip(path, msg)
if cfg.BlockOversize then return msg end
return nil
end
local ok, report = pcall(Security.Analyze, content)
if not ok or type(report) ~= "table" then
Stats.Errors += 1
local msg = "security scan failed: " .. tostring(report)
log("ERROR " .. tostring(path) .. ": " .. msg)
report = {verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", score = cfg.SuspiciousScore, confidence = 0.2, severity = "medium", reasons = {{id = "scan_error", cat = "error", weight = 0, desc = msg, conf = 0}}}
respond(path, report, content, true)
if cfg.BlockOnScanError then return msg end
return nil
end
if report.verdict == "CLEAN" then return nil end
respond(path, report, content, true)
if report.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then return reasonText(report) end
if report.verdict == "SUSPICIOUS" and cfg.SuspiciousPolicy == "block" then return reasonText(report) end
return nil
end
local function waitFrameHealthy(gen)
local waited = 0
while Security._frame > cfg.MaxFrameTime and waited < 5 and Security._gen == gen do
task.wait(0.25)
waited += 0.25
end
end
local function fingerprint(content)
local n = #content
local h = n
local step = math.max(1, n // 48)
for i = 1, n, step do
local a, b, c, d = content:byte(i, i + 3)
h = (h * 31 + (a or 0) * 7 + (b or 0) * 5 + (c or 0) * 3 + (d or 0)) % 2147483647
end
local t = content:sub(-16)
for i = 1, #t do h = (h * 31 + t:byte(i)) % 2147483647 end
return n .. ":" .. h
end
local function scanFile(path, gen)
local ok, content = pcall(readfile, path)
if not ok or type(content) ~= "string" then
noteError(path, "unreadable file", ok and ("readfile returned " .. type(content)) or content)
return
end
local size = #content
if size == 0 then
Stats.Scanned += 1
Stats.PassScanned += 1
return
end
if size > cfg.MaxFileBytes then
noteSkip(path, "larger than " .. cfg.MaxFileBytes .. " bytes (" .. size .. ")")
return
end
local key, fp = normalize(path):lower(), fingerprint(content)
local cached, report = Security._cache[key], nil
if cached and cached.fp == fp and Stats.Passes - cached.pass < cfg.CacheFullRescanEvery then
report = cached.report
else
local okA, res = pcall(Security.Analyze, content, gen)
if not okA then
noteError(path, "scan failed", res)
return
end
if not res then return end
report = res
Security._cache[key] = {fp = fp, report = report, pass = Stats.Passes}
end
Stats.Scanned += 1
Stats.PassScanned += 1
if report.verdict ~= "CLEAN" then respond(path, report, content, false) end
end
local function runPass(gen)
local queue, head, tail, seen, nfiles, capped = {}, 1, 0, {}, 0, false
for _, root in ipairs(cfg.Roots) do
seen[normalize(root):lower()] = true
tail += 1
queue[tail] = {dir = true, path = root, depth = 0}
end
while head <= tail do
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
local item = queue[head]
queue[head] = false
head += 1
if item.dir then
local listable = true
if item.path ~= "" then
local okI, isF = pcall(isfolder, item.path)
listable = not (okI and not isF)
end
if listable then
local ok, list = pcall(listfiles, item.path)
if ok and type(list) == "table" then
for i, p in ipairs(list) do
local key = normalize(p):lower()
if not seen[key] then
seen[key] = true
if not under(p, cfg.SkipDirs) then
local okf, isdir = pcall(isfolder, p)
if okf and isdir then
if item.depth < cfg.MaxDepth then
tail += 1
queue[tail] = {dir = true, path = p, depth = item.depth + 1}
else
noteSkip(p, "folder deeper than " .. cfg.MaxDepth .. " levels")
end
elseif shouldScan(p) then
if nfiles < cfg.MaxFiles then
nfiles += 1
tail += 1
queue[tail] = {path = p}
elseif not capped then
capped = true
noteSkip(item.path, "file limit " .. cfg.MaxFiles .. " reached; remaining files not queued")
end
end
end
end
if i % 40 == 0 then task.wait() end
end
else
noteError(item.path, "cannot list folder", ok and "listfiles returned " .. type(list) or list)
end
end
task.wait(cfg.ListDelay)
else
waitFrameHealthy(gen)
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
status("Security: scanning " .. shortName(item.path))
local okS, errS = pcall(scanFile, item.path, gen)
if not okS then noteError(item.path, "scan crashed", errS) end
task.wait(cfg.FileDelay)
end
end
return true
end
local function loop(gen)
while Security._gen == gen do
Stats.PassScanned = 0
if not runPass(gen) then return end
if Security._gen ~= gen then return end
Stats.Passes += 1
if Stats.Passes == 1 then
log("First full scan finished: " .. Stats.PassScanned .. " files checked, " .. Stats.Flagged .. " flagged.")
end
status("Security: idle (pass " .. Stats.Passes .. " done)")
Security._scanNow = false
Security._idle = true
local waited = 0
while Security._gen == gen and not Security._scanNow and waited < cfg.PassDelay do
task.wait(1)
waited += 1
end
if Security._gen == gen then Security._idle = false end
end
end
function Security.Start()
if not Security.Enabled() or Security._running then return end
Security._running = true
Security._gen += 1
local gen = Security._gen
Security._conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
Security._frame = Security._frame * 0.9 + dt * 0.1
end)
status("Security: starting")
task.spawn(function()
local ok, err = pcall(loop, gen)
if not ok then noteError("Security.loop", "background scan crashed", err) end
end)
end
function Security.Stop()
Security._gen += 1
Security._running = false
Security._idle = false
if Security._conn then
Security._conn:Disconnect()
Security._conn = nil
end
status("Security: background scan is OFF")
end
function Security.ScanNow()
if not Security._running then
notify("Turn on Background Malware Scan first")
elseif Security._idle then
Security._cache = {}
Security._scanNow = true
notify("Starting a new security scan")
else
notify("A security scan is already running")
end
end
return Security
end)
if built and type(sec) == "table" then
Util.Security = sec
else
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Security module failed to load: " .. tostring(sec))
end
end

for _, m in queue do

seen[m] = true

if not ready then error("assets unavailable", 0) end

if name and name:sub(-5) ~= ".anim" and name:sub(-6) ~= ".anims" then
AssetGetContentId(name)
task.wait()
end
end
end)
fails = ok and 0 or fails + 1
if fails >= 3 then return end
task.wait(slow and 0.5 or 0.2)
end
end
end)

local function DoModuleReload(force)
IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded = false
Util.PreloadRun = (Util.PreloadRun or 0) + 1
Util.PreloadIds = nil
Util.ModuleProgress = {Done = 0, Total = 7}
Util.StaleBuiltins = {}
do
local cur = MovementStyles[MovementStyleIndex]

Util.MovesetPickedByUser = false
end
InitLogsText.Text = "Init Logs -- This is where you check what happened."
ClearModules()
table.clear(UserModulesListor)
Util.UINotify("Checking hashes...", 0.05)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Checking SHA1 hashes...")
local filesofbuiltins = {"v_moveset1.lua", "v_moveset2.lua", "v_moveset3.lua", "v_dance1.lua", "v_dance2.lua", "d_limbmap.lua", "d_hatsmap.lua"}

local filesofbuiltins_d = {"d_limbmap.lua", "d_hatsmap.lua"}
SaveData.ContentHash = SaveData.ContentHash or {}
local hashFresh = force == false and type(SaveData.ContentHashAt) == "number" and next(SaveData.ContentHash) ~= nil
and math.abs(os.time() - SaveData.ContentHashAt) < 600
if hashFresh then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] SHA1 hashes were checked recently, skipping the repo request.")
elseif force ~= "SKIPHASH" then
xpcall(function()
local s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = "https://api.github.com/repos/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/contents/content/",
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
s, resp = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, resp.Body)
if s and resp then
SaveData.ContentHashAt = os.time()
for _,file in resp do
if file.name and file.sha then
if SaveData.ContentHash[file.name] ~= file.sha then
SaveData.ContentHash[file.name] = file.sha
if table.find(filesofbuiltins, file.name) then
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/" .. file.name
if isfile(path) then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] BuiltinModules/" .. file.name .. " has been updated on the repo.")
Util.StaleBuiltins[file.name] = true
end
else
local path = AssetGetPathFromFilename(file.name)
if isfile(path) then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Downloaded Asset " .. file.name .. " removed because outdated.")
delfile(path)
end
end
end
end
end
end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Checked all SHA1 hashes...")
end, function()
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] SHA1 hashes check failed!")
end)
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] Chill. We are just reloading user modules.")
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Checked all SHA1 hashes...")
end
local wasold = false
if SaveData.VanillaModuleCache then
wasold = true
SaveData.VanillaModuleCache = nil
end
local loadMode = tonumber(SaveData.ModuleLoadMode)
if loadMode ~= 2 and loadMode ~= 3 and loadMode ~= 4 and loadMode ~= 5 then loadMode = 1 end
local SLOW_STEP_DELAY = 0.35
local function SlowPause()
if loadMode == 4 then
task.wait(SLOW_STEP_DELAY)
end
end
local lowTier = ((type(_G) == "table" and type(_G.UHDevProfile) == "table" and tonumber(_G.UHDevProfile.Tier)) or 3) <= 2
local FRAME_BUDGET, sliceT = lowTier and 0.003 or 0.006, os.clock()
local function FetchContent(x, tries)
for a = 1, tries do
local content = _contentgetgithubraw(x)
if type(content) == "string" and content ~= "" then return content end
if a < tries then task.wait(0.6 * a) end
end
return nil
end
local function Breathe()
if os.clock() - sliceT >= FRAME_BUDGET then
task.wait()
sliceT = os.clock()
end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Module load mode: " .. ({"Default", "Splitted (2 at a time)", "Instant", "Slow (1 at a time, paced)", "Pre-load (assets cached ahead of time)"})[loadMode])
if loadMode == 4 then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Slow mode: one module at a time with a short pause between each, this takes longer.")
end
local function RunPhase(items, work, apply)
local rawApply = apply
local function bump()
local P = Util.ModuleProgress
if P then P.Done = P.Done + 1 end
end
apply = function(i, x, data)
if rawApply then
local okA, errA = pcall(rawApply, i, x, data)
if not okA then InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Load step failed: " .. tostring(errA)) end
end
bump()
end
if loadMode == 4 then
for i, x in items do
local ok, data = pcall(work, i, x)
if not ok then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Slow load: reading step failed: " .. tostring(data))
data = nil
bump()
else
SlowPause()
end
if ok and apply then
local okA, errA = pcall(apply, i, x, data)
if not okA then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Slow load: load step failed: " .. tostring(errA))
end
SlowPause()
end
end
return
end
if loadMode == 1 or loadMode == 5 then
for i, x in items do
local okW, data = pcall(work, i, x)
if not okW then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Load step failed, skipping this file: " .. tostring(data))
bump()
elseif apply then
task.wait()
apply(i, x, data)
end
end
return
end
local size = (loadMode == 2 or lowTier) and 2 or math.max(1, #items)
local i = 1
while i <= #items do
local last = math.min(i + size - 1, #items)
local results, pending = {}, last - i + 1
for k = i, last do
task.spawn(function()
local ok, res = pcall(work, k, items[k])
results[k] = (ok and res) or ""
pending -= 1
end)
end
while pending > 0 do
task.wait()
end
if apply then
sliceT = os.clock()
for k = i, last do
if k > i then Breathe() end
apply(k, items[k], results[k])
results[k] = nil
end
end
if loadMode == 2 then
task.wait()
end
i = last + 1
end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loading maps...")
RunPhase(filesofbuiltins_d, function(i, x)
Util.UINotify("Loading maps...", 0.15 + (i / #filesofbuiltins_d) * 0.15)
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/" .. x
local exist = false
local s, a = pcall(isfile, path)
if s and a then exist = true end
if force == "ALL" then exist = false end
if Util.StaleBuiltins[x] then exist = false end
if exist then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] " .. x .. " already downloaded :D")
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Downloading MAP " .. x .. "...")
local content = FetchContent(x, 3)
if content then
pcall(writefile, path, content)
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to load MAP " .. x .. ": Download failed.")
SaveData.ContentHash[x] = nil
end
end
end)
Util.MapsReady = Util.MapsPresent()
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loading builtin (also called vanilla) modules...")
RunPhase(filesofbuiltins_m, function(i, x)
Util.UINotify("Loading modules...", 0.325 + (i / #filesofbuiltins_m) * 0.475)
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/" .. x
local exist = false
local s, a = pcall(isfile, path)
if s and a then exist = true end
if wasold then exist = false end
if force == "ALL" then exist = false end
if Util.StaleBuiltins[x] then exist = false end
local data = ""
if exist then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Reading local VANILLA " .. x .. "...")
local okR, localData = pcall(readfile, path)
if okR and type(localData) == "string" and localData ~= "" then
data = localData
else
exist = false
end
end
if not exist then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Downloading VANILLA " .. x .. "...")
local content = FetchContent(x, 3)
if content then
pcall(writefile, path, content)
data = content
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to load VANILLA " .. x .. ": Download failed.")
if SaveData.ContentHash then SaveData.ContentHash[x] = nil end

end
return data
end, function(i, x, data)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loadstringing VANILLA " .. x .. "...")
local function attempt(src)
if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then return false, "file is empty" end
local func, comperr = loadstring(src, "Uhhhhhh :: VANILLA " .. x)
if not func then return false, "COMPILE FAILED: " .. tostring(comperr) end
local okF, list = pcall(func)
if not okF then return false, tostring(list) end
if type(list) ~= "table" then return false, "file returned " .. typeof(list) .. " instead of a module list" end
local names, logging = AddModules(list)
InitLogsText.Add(logging)
return true
end
local ok, why = attempt(data)
if not ok then

end

local function LoadExtensionFolder(folder, label, register)
local okl, files = pcall(listfiles, folder)
if not okl or type(files) ~= "table" then return 0 end
local loaded = 0
for _,path in files do
local okF, isF = pcall(isfile, path)
if okF and isF and path:lower():match("%.lua$") then
local x = path:match("[^/\\]+$") or path
xpcall(function()
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Reading " .. label .. " " .. x .. "...")
local data = readfile(path)
local blocked = Util.Security and Util.Security.GateModule(path, data)
if blocked then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[SECURITY] Blocked " .. label .. " " .. x .. " from loading: " .. blocked)
return
end
local func, comperr = loadstring(data, "Uhhhhhh :: " .. label .. " :: " .. x)
if not func then error("COMPILE FAILED: " .. tostring(comperr)) end
register(func(), x)
loaded += 1
end, function(msg)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to load " .. label .. " " .. x .. ": " .. tostring(msg))
end)
SlowPause()
Breathe()
end
end
return loaded
end

local CRM = {}
function CRM.LowEnd()
local ok, v = pcall(function() return FX.IsLowEnd() end)
return (ok and v == true) or (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled)
end
function CRM.Tick(hz, fn)
local acc, step = 0, 1 / hz
return RS_.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc += dt
if acc >= step then
local d = acc
acc = 0
pcall(fn, d)
end
end)
end
function CRM.Trim() pcall(collectgarbage, "step", 64) end
local function Hook(kind, R, def)
local S = SaveData.Reanimator
local key = "Custom" .. kind .. "Enabled"
S[key] = not not S[key]
local origStart, origConfig = R.Start, R.Config
R.Start = function(...)
local on, st, conn = S[key], nil, nil
if on then
if def.Begin then
local okb, r = pcall(def.Begin, R, S, CRM)
st = okb and r or nil
end
if def.Tick then conn = CRM.Tick(def.TickRate or 1, function(dt) def.Tick(R, S, st, dt) end) end
end
local ok, err = pcall(origStart, ...)
if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
if on and def.End then pcall(def.End, R, S, st, CRM) end
if not ok then error(err, 0) end
end
R.Config = function(parent, ...)
origConfig(parent, ...)
pcall(function()
UI.CreateText(parent, def.Description or def.Name, 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Use " .. def.Name, S[key]).Changed:Connect(function(v) S[key] = v end)
end)
end
end

do
local haveNooby = false
for _,pm in LimbReanimator.PluginModes do
if pm.Name == "Nooby's style" then haveNooby = true break end
end
if not haveNooby then
local okn, errn = pcall(function()
LimbReanimator.RegisterMode((function()
local STREAM_DEPTH = 16
local DEEP_DEPTH = 64
local FLOOR_MARGIN = 32
local DEFAULT_FPDH = -500
local SMOOTH_TIME_XZ = 0.20
local SMOOTH_TIME_Y = 0.40
local STREAM_LEASH = 8
local DEEP_LEASH = 48
local TELEPORT_DIST = 200
local MAX_DT = 0.1
local DEFAULT_DT = 1 / 60
local MAX_COORD = 1e8
local MAX_VEL = 1e5
local MAX_FAILS = 30
local OMEGA_XZ = 2 / SMOOTH_TIME_XZ
local OMEGA_Y = 2 / SMOOTH_TIME_Y
local sqrt, min, max = math.sqrt, math.min, math.max
local ready = false
local sx, sy, sz = 0, 0, 0
local vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
local lastT = nil
local fails = 0
local function finite(n)
return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n > -MAX_COORD and n < MAX_COORD
end
local function readPosition(part)
return part.Position
end
local function samplePart(part)
if typeof(part) ~= "Instance" or part.Parent == nil then return nil end
local ok, pos = pcall(readPosition, part)
if not ok or typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
local x, y, z = pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z
if finite(x) and finite(y) and finite(z) then return x, y, z end
return nil
end
local function damp(cur, target, vel, omega, dt)
local x = omega * dt
local e = 1 / (1 + x + 0.48 * x * x + 0.235 * x * x * x)
local change = cur - target
local temp = (vel + omega * change) * dt
return target + (change + temp) * e, (vel - omega * temp) * e
end
local function step(ctx)
local fpdh = ctx.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
if not finite(fpdh) then fpdh = DEFAULT_FPDH end
local floorY = fpdh + FLOOR_MARGIN
local px, py, pz = samplePart(ctx.RootPart)
if px == nil then px, py, pz = samplePart(ctx.Torso) end
local t = ctx.Time
local dt = DEFAULT_DT
if finite(t) and lastT ~= nil and t >= lastT then
dt = min(t - lastT, MAX_DT)
end
if finite(t) then lastT = t end
if px ~= nil then
local streaming = ctx.Streaming == true
local tx, tz = px, pz
local ty = max(py - (streaming and STREAM_DEPTH or DEEP_DEPTH), floorY)
local dx, dy, dz = tx - sx, ty - sy, tz - sz
local dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
local stateOk = finite(sx) and finite(sy) and finite(sz)
and finite(vx) and finite(vy) and finite(vz)
if not ready or dist > TELEPORT_DIST or not stateOk then
sx, sy, sz = tx, ty, tz
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
ready = true
else
sx, vx = damp(sx, tx, vx, OMEGA_XZ, dt)
sz, vz = damp(sz, tz, vz, OMEGA_XZ, dt)
sy, vy = damp(sy, ty, vy, OMEGA_Y, dt)
local leash = streaming and STREAM_LEASH or DEEP_LEASH
dx, dy, dz = tx - sx, ty - sy, tz - sz
local rem = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
if rem > leash then
local k = (rem - leash) / rem
sx, sy, sz = sx + dx * k, sy + dy * k, sz + dz * k
end
if vx > MAX_VEL or vx < -MAX_VEL or vy > MAX_VEL or vy < -MAX_VEL or vz > MAX_VEL or vz < -MAX_VEL then
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
end
end
if sy < floorY then
sy = floorY
if vy < 0 then vy = 0 end
end
elseif not ready then
sx, sy, sz = 0, floorY, 0
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
ready = true
else
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
end
return CFrame.new(sx, sy, sz)
end
return {
Name = "Nooby's style",
GetRootCFrame = function(ctx)
local ok, cf = pcall(step, ctx)
if ok and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
fails = 0
return cf
end
fails = fails + 1
if fails > MAX_FAILS then
error("Nooby's style failed repeatedly: " .. tostring(cf), 0)
end
if ready and finite(sx) and finite(sy) and finite(sz) then
return CFrame.new(sx, sy, sz)
end
return CFrame.new(0, DEFAULT_FPDH + FLOOR_MARGIN, 0)
end,
}
end)(), "built-in")
end)
if not okn then InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to register built-in Nooby's style: " .. tostring(errn)) end
end
end
pcall(LimbReanimator.ResolveSavedMode)
pcall(HatReanimator.ResolveSavedFling)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loaded " .. #LimbReanimator.PluginModes .. " RootPart plugin(s), " .. #HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods .. " fling method(s).")
if Util.RefreshReanimatorConfig then pcall(Util.RefreshReanimatorConfig) end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Refreshing Dance keybinds...")
pcall(RefreshKeybinds)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loaded " .. (#MovementStyles + #DanceableDances) .. " modules - " .. #MovementStyles .. " Movesets, " .. #DanceableDances .. " Dances.")
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Init complete!")
Util.UINotify("Init complete" .. (InitLogsText.HasError and " with errors" or ""))
pcall(function() local b = Util.Jarvis and Util.Jarvis.butler if b then b.onInit(InitLogsText.Text) end end)
if Util.ModuleProgress then Util.ModuleProgress.Done = Util.ModuleProgress.Total end
Util.StaleBuiltins = {}

end

local function ForceModuleReload(force)
local rank = force == "ALL" and 3 or force == "SKIPHASH" and 2 or 1
if ReloadBusy then
local covered = ReloadRank >= rank
while ReloadBusy do task.wait(0.1) end
if covered then return end
end
ReloadBusy, ReloadRank = true, rank
local okR, errR = pcall(DoModuleReload, force)
ReloadBusy = false
if not okR then
local P = Util.ModuleProgress
if P then P.Done = P.Total end
IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded = true
pcall(function() InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Module load aborted: " .. tostring(errR)) end)
error(errR, 0)
end
end

local function jarvisShow(text, hold)
local c = (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {}
local mode = c.NotifMode or 1
if mode == 4 then return false end
local ok = false
if mode ~= 3 and Util.UINotify then
local msg = "JARVIS: " .. text
ok = pcall(Util.UINotify, msg, 1, true)
if ok then
task.spawn(function()
local t0, step = os.clock(), math.max(1, (tonumber(c.NotifDuration) or 4) - 1)
while true do
task.wait(step)
if os.clock() - t0 >= hold - 1 then break end
pcall(Util.UINotify, msg, 1, true)
end
end)
end
end
if mode ~= 2 or not ok then
if pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "JARVIS", Text = text, Duration = hold}) end) then ok = true end
end
return ok
end
