local order, pos, last = {}, 0, nil
local function nextQuote()
local n = #Q
if pos >= #order then
for i = 1, n do order[i] = i end
for i = n, 2, -1 do
local j = math.random(i)
order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
end
if n > 1 and order[1] == last then order[1], order[n] = order[n], order[1] end
pos = 0
end
pos = pos + 1
last = order[pos]
return Q[last]
end
local function notifOff() return ((Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {}).NotifMode == 4 end
local function idle()
return IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded and not (Util.IntroRunning or (Util.FX and Util.FX.IntroActive)) and os.clock() >= JQ.busyUntil
end
local function loop(gen)
while JQ.Gen == gen do
task.wait(JQ.Min + math.random() * (JQ.Max - JQ.Min))
while JQ.Gen == gen and not notifOff() and not idle() do task.wait(5) end
if JQ.Gen ~= gen then return end
if not notifOff() then
local text = nextQuote()
local hold = math.clamp(#text / 14 + 3, 6, 15)
pcall(jarvisShow, text, hold)
JQ.busyUntil = os.clock() + hold + 1
end
end
end
function JQ.Set(v)
v = v and true or false
if v == JQ.Enabled then return end
JQ.Enabled, JQ.Gen = v, JQ.Gen + 1
local t = JQ.Thread
JQ.Thread = nil
if t then pcall(task.cancel, t) end
if v then JQ.Thread = task.spawn(loop, JQ.Gen) end
end

local function post(path, body)
if type(req) ~= "function" then return nil, 0 end
local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = BASE .. path, Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)})
if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return nil, 0 end
local ok2, d = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body or "{}")
return ok2 and d or nil, res.StatusCode
end
local function resolve(q)
q = trim(q):lower()
if q == "" then return nil end
for _, e in ipairs(cache) do
if tostring(e[1]) == q or e[2]:lower() == q or e[3]:lower() == q then return e end
end
for _, e in ipairs(cache) do
if e[2]:lower():find(q, 1, true) == 1 or e[3]:lower():find(q, 1, true) == 1 then return e end
end
end
local function joinEntry(e)
local jid, pid = tostring(e[5]), tonumber(e[4])
if jid ~= "" and jid == game.JobId then
local tp = Players:FindFirstChild(tostring(e[2]))
local tr = tp and tp.Character and tp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not tr then notify("They are in your server but their character isn't loaded") return end
local cs, moved = {LP.Character}, false
pcall(function() cs[2] = Reanimate.Character end)
for _, c in ipairs(cs) do
local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if r then pcall(function() r.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3) end) moved = true end
end
notify(moved and ("Teleported to " .. tostring(e[2])) or "Your character isn't loaded")
return
end
if not pid or jid == "" then notify("That player has no joinable server") return end
if pid ~= game.PlaceId then
local link = "https://www.roblox.com/games/start?placeId=" .. pid .. "&gameId=" .. jid .. "&gameInstanceId=" .. jid
local copied = type(setclipboard) == "function" and pcall(setclipboard, link)
local opened = pcall(function() game:GetService("GuiService"):OpenBrowserWindow(link) end)
local gname = tostring(e[6] or "")
if gname == "" then gname = "another game" end
if copied and opened then
notify(tostring(e[2]) .. " is in " .. gname .. " - join link copied and opened in your browser")
elseif copied then
notify(tostring(e[2]) .. " is in " .. gname .. " - join link copied, paste it in your browser")
elseif opened then
notify(tostring(e[2]) .. " is in " .. gname .. " - opened in your browser")
else
notify(tostring(e[2]) .. " is in " .. gname .. " - couldn't copy / open, link: " .. link)
end
return
end
notify("Joining " .. tostring(e[2]) .. "...")

end

local banArm, banFor, lastActAt = 0, nil, 0

if not isMod() then notify("Moderator access required") return end

notify("Tap Ban again within 4s to confirm")
return
end
if os.clock() - lastActAt < 1.6 then notify("Slow down a little") return end
lastActAt = os.clock()
local d = post("/act", {u = LP.UserId, n = LP.Name, t = kind, x = x})
notify(d and d.ok and (kind .. " sent") or (d and ERR[d.err]) or "Request failed")

nextAt = 0
end

local function killSelf()
local cs = {LP.Character}
pcall(function() cs[2] = Reanimate.Character end)
for _, c in ipairs(cs) do
local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h then pcall(function() h.Health = 0 end) end
end
end
local function handle(ev)
acks[#acks + 1] = ev.id
local key = tostring(ev.id) .. ":" .. tostring(ev.t)
if seen[key] then return end
seen[key] = true
local who = tostring(ev.f)
notify(who .. " used " .. tostring(ev.k) .. " on you")
if ev.k == "kill" then killSelf()
elseif ev.k == "deanimate" then pcall(Util.ModDeanimate)
elseif ev.k == "kick" then task.delay(1.5, function() pcall(function() LP:Kick("Removed by " .. tostring(ev.r) .. " (" .. who .. ")") end) end) end
end
local function presence(tag, label, m)
local s = 0
if m then s = (tostring(m[1]) == game.JobId) and 2 or 1 end
if m and tostring(m[2]):lower() == LP.Name:lower() then s = 0 end
local prev = mstate[tag]
mstate[tag] = s
if s > 0 and s ~= prev and not (prev == 2 and s == 1) then
local nm = tostring(m[2])
if s == 2 then
alert(label .. " " .. nm .. (prev == nil and " is in YOUR server" or " joined YOUR server"))
else
alert(label .. " " .. nm .. " is online (different server)")
end
end
end
local lastGood = 0
local function dedupe(l)
local out, idx = {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(l) do
local k = tostring(e[1])
if idx[k] then
out[idx[k]] = e
else
out[#out + 1] = e
idx[k] = #out
end
end
return out
end
task.spawn(function()
local bootAt = os.clock()
while genv.__UH_LIVE_TOKEN == myToken do
task.wait(1)
local okTick, errTick = pcall(function()
local open = pageOpen()
if open and not wasOpen then nextAt = 0; if needRender then needRender = false; render() end end
wasOpen = open
local now = os.clock()
if now < nextAt then
if fails > 0 and lastGood > 0 then
status.Text = "Backend unreachable - list is " .. math.floor(now - lastGood) .. "s old (retrying)"
end
return
end
if not gameReady and now - bootAt < 4 then return end
local function sync()
return post("/sync", {u = LP.UserId, n = LP.Name, d = LP.DisplayName, p = game.PlaceId, j = game.JobId, g = gameName, v = ver, w = open and 1 or 0, a = acks})
end
local d, st = sync()
local base = (burstUntil > os.clock() and BURST) or (open and OPEN) or IDLE
if not d or st ~= 200 then
fails += 1
status.Text = (st == 429) and "Backend rate-limited (retrying)" or "Backend unreachable (retrying)"
local delay = math.min(MAXBACK, 4 * 2 ^ math.min(fails - 1, 3)) + math.random()
if st == 429 then delay = math.max(delay, 20) end
nextAt = os.clock() + delay
return
end
fails, joined, acks = 0, true, {}
lastGood = os.clock()
if d.ban then pcall(function() LP:Kick("Banned by moderator") end) return end
if d.r ~= role then
role = d.r
roleLbl.Text = role and ("Role: " .. role) or "Role: none"
showMod(isMod())
if open then render() else needRender = true end
end

MainPage.Interactable = true

busy = false

local okPM, errPM = pcall(function()
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local reg = RegisterTextLabel or function() end
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local L, R = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local N = 40
local function themeCol() return (UITextColor and UITextColor.Value) or WHITE end
local function fmtMB(v) if v >= 1024 then return string.format("%.2f GB", v / 1024) end return string.format("%.0f MB", v) end
local function readMem()
local ok, v = pcall(Stats.GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, Stats)
if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v end
end
local function readLua()
local ok, v = pcall(collectgarbage, "count")
if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v / 1024 end
end
local cpuItem
local function readCpuMs()
if not cpuItem or not cpuItem.Parent then
local ps = Stats:FindFirstChild("PerformanceStats")
cpuItem = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("CPU")
if not cpuItem then return nil end
end
local ok, s = pcall(cpuItem.GetValueString, cpuItem)
if not ok or type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
local num, unit = s:match("([%d%.]+)%s*(%a+)")
num = tonumber(num)
if num and unit == "ms" then return num end
end
local hw
local function safe(f, ...) local ok, v = pcall(f, ...) if ok then return v end end
local function clean(s) if type(s) == "string" then return (s:gsub("[<>&]", ""):sub(1, 48)) end end
local function readHW()
if hw then return hw end
hw = {}
hw.platform = safe(function() return (tostring(game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetPlatform()):gsub("^Enum%.Platform%.", "")) end)
hw.exec = clean(safe(function() return (identifyexecutor()) end))
local ts = safe(function() return settings():GetService("TaskScheduler") end)
if ts then
hw.pool = safe(function() local v = ts.ThreadPoolSize return type(v) == "number" and v > 0 and v or nil end)
hw.poolCfg = safe(function() return (tostring(ts.ThreadPoolConfig):gsub("^Enum%.ThreadPoolConfig%.", "")) end)
end
local dev = (FX and FX.Device) or _G.UHDevProfile
if type(dev) == "table" and type(dev.RAM) == "number" then hw.ram, hw.ramConf = dev.RAM, dev.Confidence end
local env = type(genv) == "table" and genv or _G
local function scan(t, d)
for k, v in pairs(t) do
local ks = type(k) == "string" and k:lower() or ""
if type(v) == "table" then
if d < 2 then scan(v, d + 1) end
elseif type(v) == "string" and #v > 2 and (ks:find("cpu", 1, true) or ks:find("processor", 1, true)) and (ks:find("name", 1, true) or ks:find("model", 1, true) or ks:find("brand", 1, true) or ks == "cpu" or ks == "processor") then
hw.cpuName = hw.cpuName or clean(v)
elseif type(v) == "number" and v >= 1 and v <= 256 and v % 1 == 0 then
if ks:find("thread", 1, true) or ks:find("logical", 1, true) then hw.threads = hw.threads or v
elseif ks:find("core", 1, true) and not ks:find("score", 1, true) then hw.cores = hw.cores or v end
end
end
end
for _, n in ipairs({"getdeviceinfo", "getsysteminfo", "getcpuinfo", "getprocessorinfo"}) do
local fn = env[n] or _G[n]
if type(fn) == "function" then
local r = safe(fn)
if type(r) == "table" then scan(r, 0)
elseif type(r) == "string" and #r > 2 and n:find("cpu", 1, true) then hw.cpuName = hw.cpuName or clean(r) end
end
end
return hw
end
local function hwText()
local h = readHW()
local thr = {}
if h.threads then thr[#thr + 1] = h.threads .. " logical threads (executor)" end
if h.cores then thr[#thr + 1] = h.cores .. " cores (executor)" end
if h.pool then thr[#thr + 1] = "Roblox scheduler pool " .. h.pool .. (h.poolCfg and (" [" .. h.poolCfg .. "]") or "") end
return "<b>Hardware</b> (read locally)\n"
.. "CPU: " .. (h.cpuName or "name not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "Threads: " .. (#thr > 0 and table.concat(thr, ", ") or "not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "RAM: " .. (h.ram and string.format("%.1f GB (%s confidence)", h.ram, tostring(h.ramConf or "?")) or "not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "Platform: " .. (h.platform or "?") .. "  |  Executor: " .. (h.exec or "?")
end

t.RichText = true
t.Interactable = false
reg(t)
return t
end

local barsA, barsB, lines, strokes = {}, {}, {}, {}
local function tile(bars, titleTxt)

f.BackgroundTransparency = 1

end

local mVal, mDet, mScale = tile(barsB, "<b>Memory</b> (Roblox)")

local function tint()
local c = themeCol()
local c2 = c:Lerp(WHITE, 0.45)
for i = 1, N do barsA[i].BackgroundColor3 = c; barsB[i].BackgroundColor3 = c2 end
for _, s in ipairs(strokes) do s.Color = c end

end
tint()
pcall(function() Util.LinkDestroyI2C(box, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(tint)) end)
local ftH, memH = table.create(N, 0), table.create(N, 0)
local w, pkAvg, pkWorst, pkMem, pkLua = 1, 0, 0, 0, 0
local cpuMode, lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct, pkCpu, hwDone = false, 0, 0, 0, false
local function draw(bars, hist, top)
for i = 1, N do
bars[i].Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -1, math.clamp(hist[(w + i - 2) % N + 1] / top, 0, 1), 0)
end
end
local function sample(avgMs, fps, worst)
if avgMs > pkAvg then pkAvg = avgMs end
if worst > pkWorst then pkWorst = worst end
local cpuMs, cpuPct
if cpuMode then
cpuMs = readCpuMs()
if cpuMs then
cpuPct = math.clamp(cpuMs / avgMs * 100, 0, 100)
lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct = cpuMs, cpuPct
if cpuPct > pkCpu then pkCpu = cpuPct end
else
cpuMs, cpuPct = lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct
end
end
local m, l = readMem(), readLua()
ftH[w], memH[w] = cpuMode and cpuPct or avgMs, m or 0
if m and m > pkMem then pkMem = m end
if l and l > pkLua then pkLua = l end
w = w % N + 1
if not MainPage.Visible then return end
local topF, topM = cpuMode and 100 or 33.4, 1
for i = 1, N do
if not cpuMode and ftH[i] > topF then topF = ftH[i] end
if memH[i] > topM then topM = memH[i] end
end
topM = topM * 1.15
draw(barsA, ftH, topF)
draw(barsB, memH, topM)
local h = readHW()
local pct = m and h.ram and (h.ramConf == "exact" or h.ramConf == "high") and m / (h.ram * 1024) * 100
mScale.Text = "max " .. fmtMB(topM)
if cpuMode then
fScale.Text = "max 100%"
fVal.Text = string.format("%d%%  %.1f ms", math.floor(cpuPct + 0.5), cpuMs)
fDet.Text = string.format("Peak %d%%  |  Frame %.1f ms  %d FPS\nSystem-wide CPU %%: not exposed", math.floor(pkCpu + 0.5), avgMs, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
else
fScale.Text = string.format("max %d ms", math.ceil(topF))
fVal.Text = string.format("%.1f ms  %d FPS", avgMs, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
fDet.Text = string.format("Peak avg %.1f ms  |  Worst %.1f ms\nCPU %%: not exposed by Roblox", pkAvg, pkWorst)
end
mVal.Text = m and (fmtMB(m) .. (pct and string.format("  (%d%%)", math.floor(pct + 0.5)) or "")) or "unavailable"
mDet.Text = (m and ("Peak " .. fmtMB(pkMem)) or "Peak n/a") .. "  |  Device RAM " .. (h.ram and string.format("%.1f GB", h.ram) or "n/a") .. "\n"
.. (l and string.format("Lua heap %.1f MB  |  Peak %.1f MB", l, pkLua) or "Lua heap: unavailable")
end
local opened, paused, conn, interval = false, false, nil, 1
local t, fsum, n, mx = 0, 0, 0, 0
local function setStatus() status.Text = paused and "PAUSED" or string.format("LIVE  %ds", interval) end
local function stop() if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end end
local function start()
if conn or not opened or paused then return end
interval = 1
pcall(function() if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then interval = 2 end end)
local c = readCpuMs()
if (c ~= nil) ~= cpuMode then
cpuMode = c ~= nil
for i = 1, N do ftH[i] = 0 end
end
if c then lastCpuMs = c end
fTitle.Text = cpuMode and "<b>CPU</b> frame load" or "<b>Frame time</b> (CPU n/a)"
t, fsum, n, mx = math.max(0, interval - 0.2), 0, 0, 0
conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
t += dt; fsum += dt; n += 1
if dt > mx then mx = dt end
if t >= interval then
local a, c, m = fsum / n * 1000, n / fsum, mx * 1000
t, fsum, n, mx = 0, 0, 0, 0
sample(a, c, m)
end
end)
end
setStatus()

opened = not opened
if opened and not hwDone then hwDone = true hwLabel.Text = hwText() end
boxCont.Visible = opened
btnText.Text = opened and "Hide Performance Monitor" or "Performance Monitor &gt;"
if opened then start() else stop() end
setStatus()
end)
pbtn.Activated:Connect(function()
paused = not paused
ptext.Text = paused and "Resume" or "Pause"
if paused then stop() else start() end
setStatus()
end)

k.LayoutOrder = k.LayoutOrder + 2
end
end
btnCont.LayoutOrder, boxCont.LayoutOrder = base + 1, base + 2
end
end)

xpcall(function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local FX = Util.FX
local W = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local C = {
card = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22), text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250), mute = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 164),
blue = Color3.fromRGB(56, 140, 255), cyan = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 200), purple = Color3.fromRGB(128, 84, 235),
pink = Color3.fromRGB(240, 80, 150), green = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 120), amber = Color3.fromRGB(250, 170, 60),
}
local BOLD, MED = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Enum.Font.GothamMedium
local LEFT, RIGHT, CENTER = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local function new(class, props, parent)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end
local function calm()
return (FX.Settings and FX.Settings.Transitions == false) or (FX.IsLowEnd and FX.IsLowEnd()) or false
end
local function tw(o, t, props, style, dir)
if calm() then
for k, v in pairs(props) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
return
end
t = t / math.max(0.2, (FX.Cfg and FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed) or 1)
local ok, tn = pcall(function()
return TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
end)
if ok and tn then
tn:Play()
return tn
end
end
local function corner(o, r)
return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 14)}, o)
end
local function stroke(o, tr, col)
return new("UIStroke", {Color = col or W, Transparency = tr or 0.84, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)
end
local function rim(st)
if not (FX.IsLowEnd and FX.IsLowEnd()) then
new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 38, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.32, 0.68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, 0.68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08)})}, st)
end
return st
end
local function label(parent, text, size, color, font, xa, extra)
local l = new("TextLabel", {
BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = text, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = color or C.text,
Font = font or MED, TextXAlignment = xa or LEFT, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
}, parent)
if extra then
for k, v in pairs(extra) do l[k] = v end
end
return l
end
local function note(t)
pcall(function() Util.UINotify(t) end)
end
local function feel(b, base, hover, lift)
lift = lift or 1.025
local rest = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and 1 or lift
local sc = new("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, b)
b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
tw(b, 0.2, {BackgroundTransparency = hover})
tw(sc, 0.35, {Scale = lift}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
tw(b, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = base})
tw(sc, 0.3, {Scale = 1})
end)
b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tw(sc, 0.08, {Scale = 0.94}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad) end)
b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tw(sc, 0.5, {Scale = rest}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
local function glass(parent, pos, size, color, tr, r)
local f = new("Frame", {
BackgroundColor3 = color or C.card, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Position = pos or UDim2.new(), Size = size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
}, parent)
corner(f, UDim.new(0, r or 16))
rim(stroke(f, 0.78))
if not calm() then new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(176, 176, 190))}, f) end
return f
end
local function tile(parent, pos, size, title, sub, tint, cb)
local b = new("TextButton", {
AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = tint, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Position = pos, Size = size,
}, parent)
corner(b, UDim.new(0, 14))
rim(stroke(b, 0.76, tint:Lerp(W, 0.45)))
local t1 = label(b, title, 13, W, BOLD, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -15), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)})
local t2 = label(b, sub or "", 10, C.text, MED, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 2), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 13), TextTransparency = 0.3})
feel(b, 0.5, 0.35)
b.Activated:Connect(function()
if cb then task.spawn(cb) end
end)
return b, t1, t2
end
local thumbs = {}
local function loadAvatar(img, uid)
if thumbs[uid] then
img.Image = thumbs[uid]
return
end
task.spawn(function()
local ok, url = pcall(function()
return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(uid, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
end)
if ok and url then
thumbs[uid] = url
if img.Parent then img.Image = url end
end
end)
end
local function rootOf(plr)
local ch = plr.Character
if plr == Player then
local ok, rc = pcall(function() return Reanimate and Reanimate.Character end)
if ok and rc and rc.Parent then ch = rc end
end
return ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso") or ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
end
local rowReg = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function rowOf(page, h)
local r = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), LayoutOrder = #page:GetChildren()}, page)
local holder = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -6)}, r)
local reg = rowReg[page]
if not reg then reg = {} rowReg[page] = reg end
reg[#reg + 1] = holder
return holder, r
end
local Nav = {Closers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
Util.Nav = Nav
local function press(btn)
if not btn then return false end
if type(firesignal) == "function" and pcall(firesignal, btn.Activated) then return true end
if type(getconnections) == "function" then
local ok = pcall(function()
for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(btn.Activated)) do
if c.Fire then c:Fire() elseif c.Function then c.Function() end
end
end)
if ok then return true end
end
return false
end
function Nav.TopPage()
local best
for _, p in ipairs(Util.AllPages or {}) do
if p ~= MainPage and p.Parent and p.Visible and math.abs(p.Position.X.Offset) < 2 and p.Position.X.Scale == 0.5 then
if not best or p.ZIndex >= best.ZIndex then best = p end
end
end
return best
end
function Nav.Open(p)
p.Interactable = false
p.Visible = true
MainPage.Interactable = false
local goal = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
if calm() then
p.Position = goal
p.Interactable = true
return
end
local t = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = goal})
t:Play()
t.Completed:Connect(function() p.Interactable = true end)
pcall(Nav.Stagger, p)
end
function Nav.Close(p)
p.Interactable = false
MainPage.Interactable = false
local away = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
local function done()
MainPage.Interactable = true
p.Visible = false
end
if calm() then
p.Position = away
done()
return
end
local t = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = away})
t:Play()
t.Completed:Connect(done)
end
function Nav.Stagger(page)
if calm() then return end
local reg = rowReg[page]
if not reg then return end
for i, h in ipairs(reg) do
if i > 12 then break end
if h.Parent then
local sc = h:FindFirstChild("PopScale") or new("UIScale", {Name = "PopScale"}, h)
sc.Scale = 0.92
h.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
task.delay(0.045 * (i - 1), function()
if not h.Parent then return end
tw(sc, 0.55, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
tw(h, 0.5, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)})
end)
end
end
end
function Nav.CloseTop()
local p = Nav.TopPage()
if not p then return false end
local c = Nav.Closers[p]
if c then
c()
return true
end
local back = Util.BackBtns and Util.BackBtns[p]
if back then return press(back) end
return false
end
local function newPage()
local p = UI.CreatePage()
p.ZIndex = 1
p.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
p.Interactable = false
p.Visible = false
UI.CreateButton(p, "&lt; Back", 20).Activated:Connect(function() Nav.Close(p) end)
Nav.Closers[p] = function() Nav.Close(p) end
return p
end
local function toggleMusic()
local snd = UISound.Music
if snd.IsPlaying then
pcall(function() snd:Pause() end)
elseif snd.IsPaused then
pcall(function() snd:Resume() end)
else
pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
end
end
local fpsVal = 60
do
local acc, n = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc += dt
n += 1
if acc >= 0.5 then
fpsVal = math.floor(n / acc + 0.5)
acc, n = 0, 0
end
end)
end
local friends, friendBusy = {}, {}
local function queueFriend(plr, after)
if plr == Player or friends[plr.UserId] ~= nil or friendBusy[plr.UserId] then return end
friendBusy[plr.UserId] = true
task.spawn(function()
local ok, res = pcall(function() return Player:IsFriendsWith(plr.UserId) end)
friends[plr.UserId] = ok and res == true
friendBusy[plr.UserId] = nil
if after then after() end
end)
end
local function friendsHere(after)
local out = {}
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= Player then
queueFriend(plr, after)
if friends[plr.UserId] then out[#out + 1] = plr end
end
end
return out
end
local function fmtTime(s)
s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
if s >= 3600 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", s // 3600, (s % 3600) // 60) end
return string.format("%dm %02ds", s // 60, s % 60)
end

local function setSpectate(plr)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local hum
if plr then
hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
else
local ok, rc = pcall(function() return Reanimate and Reanimate.Character end)

local function rebuild()
for _, r in ipairs(rows) do r:Destroy() end
rows = {}
local q = string.lower(search.Text or "")
local list = Players:GetPlayers()
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
if a == Player then return true end
if b == Player then return false end
return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
end)
local shown = 0
local myRoot = rootOf(Player)
for _, plr in ipairs(list) do
queueFriend(plr, function() refresh() end)
local okQ = q == "" or plr.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil or plr.DisplayName:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
local okF = true
if filter == "Friends" then
okF = friends[plr.UserId] == true
elseif filter == "Nearby" then
local r = rootOf(plr)
okF = plr ~= Player and r ~= nil and myRoot ~= nil and (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 150
end
if okQ and okF then
shown += 1
local sel = selected == plr
local b = new("TextButton", {AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = C.card, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), LayoutOrder = shown}, listFrame)

stroke(b, sel and 0.5 or 0.88)
local av = new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundColor3 = W, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), Image = ""}, b)
corner(av, UDim.new(1, 0))
loadAvatar(av, plr.UserId)
label(b, plr.DisplayName .. (plr == Player and "  (you)" or ""), 13, C.text, BOLD, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 16)})
label(b, "@" .. plr.Name, 10, C.mute, MED, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 21), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 13)})
if friends[plr.UserId] then
label(b, "Friend", 10, C.green, BOLD, RIGHT, {Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 1, 0)})
end
feel(b, sel and 0.2 or 0.45, 0.3)
b.Activated:Connect(function()
selected = plr
specSpec = false
specT1.Text = "Spectate"

refresh()
end)

end
end

end

end
end

function Nav.CurrentKey()
local p = Nav.TopPage()
if not p then return "Menu" end
if p == cards then return "Home" end
if p == pp then return "Players" end
if Util.NavLast == "Music &gt;" then return "Music" end
if Util.NavLast == "Customization &gt;" then return "Settings" end
return "Menu"
end

local same = Nav.CurrentKey() == key and key ~= "Cmds"

if not same then
local fn = Nav.Targets[key]
if fn then fn() end
end
end)
task.wait(0.25)
Nav.Busy = false
end)
end

local GetMarketList_cache = {}
local function GetMarketList()
local aitemus, file2name, file2aitemu = GetMarketList_cache.aitemus, GetMarketList_cache.file2name, GetMarketList_cache.file2aitemu
if not aitemus or not file2name or not file2aitemu then
local marketteresult = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh-Store/main/list.txt")
marketteresult = string.split(marketteresult, "\n")
aitemus = {}
local aitemu = {}
for _,a in marketteresult do
if #a > 3 then
local k, v = string.split(a, " = ")
k, v = table.remove(k, 1), table.concat(string.split(table.concat(k, " = "), "\\n"), "\n")
if k == "name" then
aitemu.Name = v
continue
end
if k == "user" then
aitemu.User = v
continue
end
if k == "desc" then
aitemu.Description = v
continue
end
if k == "cost" then
aitemu.Cost = v
continue
end
if k == "file" then
aitemu.Source = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh-Store/main/" .. v
aitemu.File = string.gsub(v, "/", ".")
continue
end
end
if next(aitemu) == nil then
continue
end
table.insert(aitemus, aitemu)
aitemu = {}
end
if next(aitemu) ~= nil then
table.insert(aitemus, aitemu)
end
file2name, file2aitemu = {}, {}
for _,aitemu in aitemus do
if aitemu.Name and aitemu.File then
file2name[aitemu.File] = aitemu.Name
file2aitemu[aitemu.File] = aitemu
end
end
end
GetMarketList_cache.aitemus, GetMarketList_cache.file2name, GetMarketList_cache.file2aitemu = aitemus, file2name, file2aitemu
return aitemus, file2name, file2aitemu
end

Util.NoobyStore = (function()
local REPO, ROOT, NAME = "Elliot12-wq/nooby-s-unoffical-store-", "UhhhhhhReanim/NoobyStore/", "Nooby's unofficial store"
local NS, lastList = {Busy = false}, nil
local INFO = {}
local function esc(t) return (tostring(t):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;")) end
local function applyInfo(a)
local info = INFO[a.File]
if not info and type(SaveData.NoobyInfo) == "table" then info = SaveData.NoobyInfo[a.File] end
if type(info) ~= "table" or #info == 0 then return end
INFO[a.File] = info
a.Base = a.Base or a.Description
local parts, kinds, seen = {}, {}, {}
for _, m in info do
local ty = tostring(m.Type or "Module")
parts[#parts + 1] = ty .. ": " .. esc(m.Name or "Unnamed") .. ((m.Description or "") ~= "" and ("\n" .. esc(m.Description)) or "")
if not seen[ty] then seen[ty] = true kinds[#kinds + 1] = ty end
end
a.Name = esc(info[1].Name or "Unnamed") .. (#info > 1 and (" +" .. (#info - 1) .. " more") or "")
a.User = ((info[1].Author or "") ~= "" and esc(info[1].Author) or NAME) .. " - " .. table.concat(kinds, " + ")
a.Description = table.concat(parts, "\n\n") .. (a.Needs and ("\n\n" .. a.Needs) or "") .. "\n\n" .. a.Base
end
local function field(w, key)
local _, v = w:match("%f[%w_]" .. key .. "%s*=%s*([\"'])(.-)%1")
if not v then _, v = w:match("%f[%w_]" .. key .. "%s*=%s*%[(=*)%[(.-)%]%1%]") end
if v then v = v:gsub("\\n", "\n"):gsub("\\([\"'])", "%1") end
return v
end
local function scanModules(src)
local found = {}
for pos, kind in src:gmatch("()ModuleType%s*=%s*[\"'](%u+)[\"']") do
if kind == "MOVESET" or kind == "DANCE" then
local w = src:sub(pos, pos + 4000)
found[#found + 1] = {Type = kind == "DANCE" and "Dance" or "Moveset", Name = field(w, "Name") or "Unnamed", Description = field(w, "Description") or "", Author = field(w, "Author") or field(w, "Creator") or field(w, "User") or ""}
end
end
return found
end
local ASSET = {anim = true, anims = true, mp3 = true, png = true, rbxm = true, rbxms = true, jpg = true, jpeg = true}
local function assetNames(src)
local names, seen = {}, {}
for n in src:gmatch("[\"']([^\"'\r\n\\/@:]+%.%w+)[\"']") do
local ext = n:match("%.(%w+)$"):lower()
if ASSET[ext] and #n < 120 and not seen[n:lower()] then
seen[n:lower()] = true
names[#names + 1] = n
end
end
return names
end
local function findAsset(name, from)
local c = NS.Index and NS.Index[name:lower()]
if not c then return nil end
local dir = (from or ""):match("^(.*)/[^/]*$") or ""
for _, x in c do
if (x.Path:match("^(.*)/[^/]*$") or "") == dir then return x end
end
return c[1]
end
function NS.List()
local HS, list = game:GetService("HttpService"), nil
for _, ref in {"main", "HEAD"} do
local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. REPO .. "/git/trees/" .. ref .. "?recursive=1")
local okJ, data = false, nil
if ok then okJ, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, body) end
if okJ and type(data) == "table" and type(data.tree) == "table" then
list = {}
local index = {}
for _, node in data.tree do
local low = type(node.path) == "string" and node.path:lower() or ""
local ext = low:match("%.(%w+)$")
if node.type == "blob" and ext then
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. REPO .. "/" .. ref .. "/" .. EnsureUrlEncode(node.path)
if ASSET[ext] then
local leaf = low:match("([^/]+)$")
index[leaf] = index[leaf] or {}
table.insert(index[leaf], {Path = node.path, Url = url})
elseif ext == "lua" or ext == "txt" then
local entry = {
Path = node.path,
Size = node.size or 0,
Name = (node.path:match("([^/]+)$"):gsub("%.%w+$", "")),
User = NAME,
Description = node.path .. "\nSize: " .. math.max(1, math.floor((node.size or 0) / 1024)) .. " KB\nFrom " .. NAME,
Cost = (node.size or 0) >= 1048576 and string.format("%.1f MB", node.size / 1048576) or (node.size or 0) >= 1024 and string.format("%d KB", math.floor(node.size / 1024)) or math.max(1, node.size or 0) .. " B",
Source = url,
File = (node.path:gsub("/", ".")),
}
applyInfo(entry)
table.insert(list, entry)
end
end
end
NS.Index = index
break
end
end
if not list then
pcall(Util.UINotify, NAME .. ": could not load the list" .. (lastList and ", showing the last one" or ""))
return lastList or {}
end
table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.File:lower() < b.File:lower() end)
lastList = list
return list
end

a.Needs = (#have > 0 and ("Files it needs (from this store): " .. table.concat(have, ", ")) or "") .. (#miss > 0 and ((#have > 0 and "\n" or "") .. "Not in this store: " .. table.concat(miss, ", ")) or "")
if a.Needs == "" then a.Needs = nil end

done(not ok and (tostring(err):gsub("^[^\n]-:%d+: ", "")) or nil)

local function keep(name, data)
if type(data) ~= "string" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false end
name = (tostring(name):match("([^/]+)$") or "file"):gsub('[<>:"|?*]', "_")
pcall(makefolder, ROOT:sub(1, -2))
local base, ext = name:match("^(.+)(%.[^%.]+)$")
if not base then base, ext = name, "" end
local p, n = ROOT .. name, 1
while isfile(p) do
local okR, old = pcall(readfile, p)
if okR and old == data then return true end
n += 1
p = ROOT .. base .. " (" .. n .. ")" .. ext
end
return (pcall(writefile, p, data))
end
function NS.Has(a)
return isfile("UhhhhhhReanim/Modules/" .. a.File)
end
function NS.Install(a, path, label)

NS.Busy = true

task.wait(0.2)

local okR, data = pcall(readfile, w.target)
if okR and keep(w.name, data) then saved += 1 end
end
label.Text = "Loading modules..."
local okL = pcall(ForceModuleReload, false)
local picked, pickedDance
for _, nm in UserModulesListor[a.File] or {} do
for _, m in MovementStyles do
if not picked and m.Name == nm then picked = m end
end
for _, d in DanceableDances do
if not pickedDance and d.Name == nm then pickedDance = d end
end
end
if picked then
if picked.Hash then SaveData.MovesetHash = picked.Hash end
Util.MovesetPickedByUser = true
MovementStyleIndex = table.find(MovementStyles, picked)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Moveset: " .. picked.Name)
elseif pickedDance then
pcall(Util.Notify, "Dance: " .. pickedDance.Name)
end
pcall(Util.Notify, "Saved " .. saved .. " file(s) to NoobyStore. " .. (okL and "Modules reloaded - reload again later if you add or change files by hand." or "Reload modules now to apply them, or later from the Modules page."))
label.Text = "You already have this"
end)
if not ok then
local msg = (tostring(err):gsub("^[^\n]-:%d+: ", ""))
label.Text = "Install failed: " .. msg:sub(1, 60)
pcall(Util.UINotify, NAME .. ": install failed (" .. msg:sub(1, 80) .. ")")
end
NS.Busy = false
end

task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()
local LOW_FPS, LOW_SECS = 25, 3
local HIGH_FPS, HIGH_SECS = 40, 8
local WINDOW, WARMUP, COOLDOWN, TICK = 1, 6, 15, 0.25
local flagtable = {
{ name = "DFIntDebugFRMQualityLevelOverride", value = "1" },
{ name = "DFFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled", value = "True" },
{ name = "DFIntTextureQualityOverride", value = "0" },
{ name = "FIntRenderGrassDetailStrands", value = "0" },
}
local function same(a, b) return tostring(a):lower() == tostring(b):lower() end
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
local state = genv.UhAutoFPSState
if type(state) ~= "table" then
state = { changed = {}, noticedUnsupported = false }
genv.UhAutoFPSState = state
end
if state.conn then pcall(function() state.conn:Disconnect() end) state.conn = nil end
if genv.UhAutoFPS == false then return end
local function ShowNotification(msg)
pcall(Util.UINotify, msg)
end
local function readRender()
local ok, v = pcall(function() return settings().Rendering.QualityLevel end)
if ok then return v end
return nil
end
local N = 256
local ring, head, count, sum = table.create(N, 0), 1, 0, 0
local function push(dt)
if count == N then sum = sum - ring[head] head = head % N + 1 count = count - 1 end
ring[(head + count - 1) % N + 1] = dt
count = count + 1
sum = sum + dt
while count > 1 and sum > WINDOW do sum = sum - ring[head] head = head % N + 1 count = count - 1 end
end
local function apply(fps)
local changed, readable = state.changed, false
if type(getfflag) == "function" and type(setfflag) == "function" then
for _, f in ipairs(flagtable) do
local ok, orig = pcall(getfflag, f.name)
if ok and orig ~= nil and tostring(orig) ~= "" then
readable = true
if not same(orig, f.value) and pcall(setfflag, f.name, f.value) then
local ok2, cur = pcall(getfflag, f.name)
if ok2 and same(cur, f.value) then
changed[#changed + 1] = { kind = "flag", name = f.name, orig = tostring(orig), set = f.value }
else
pcall(setfflag, f.name, tostring(orig))
end
end
end
end
end
if #changed == 0 then
local cur = readRender()
if cur ~= nil then
readable = true
if cur ~= Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 then
pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
if readRender() == Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 then
changed[#changed + 1] = { kind = "render", orig = cur, set = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 }
end
end
end
end
if #changed > 0 then
ShowNotification(("Low FPS (%d): graphics quality level 1 enabled (%s)"):format(math.floor(fps + 0.5), changed[1].kind == "flag" and "FFlag" or "graphics setting"))
elseif not readable and not state.noticedUnsupported then
state.noticedUnsupported = true
ShowNotification(("Low FPS (%d): no supported quality control available, nothing changed"):format(math.floor(fps + 0.5)))
end
end
local function restore(fps)
local changed, reverted = state.changed, 0
for i = #changed, 1, -1 do
local c, done = changed[i], false
if c.kind == "flag" then
local ok, cur = pcall(getfflag, c.name)
if ok and not same(cur, c.set) then
done = true
elseif ok and pcall(setfflag, c.name, c.orig) then
local ok2, now = pcall(getfflag, c.name)
if ok2 and same(now, c.orig) then done = true reverted = reverted + 1 end
end
else
local cur = readRender()
if cur ~= nil and cur ~= c.set then
done = true
elseif cur ~= nil then
pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = c.orig end)
if readRender() == c.orig then done = true reverted = reverted + 1 end
end
end
if done then table.remove(changed, i) end
end
if #changed == 0 and reverted > 0 then
ShowNotification(("FPS recovered (%d): original graphics settings restored"):format(math.floor(fps + 0.5)))
end
end
local acc, started, lowSince, highSince, lastSwitch = 0, os.clock(), nil, nil, -math.huge
state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if genv.UhAutoFPS == false then return end
if dt > 1 then dt = 1 end
if dt > 0 then push(dt) end
acc = acc + dt
if acc < TICK then return end
acc = 0
local now = os.clock()
if now - started < WARMUP or sum < WINDOW * 0.5 then return end
local fps = count / sum
if #state.changed == 0 then
highSince = nil
if fps < LOW_FPS then
lowSince = lowSince or now
if now - lowSince >= LOW_SECS and now - lastSwitch >= COOLDOWN then
lowSince, lastSwitch = nil, now
apply(fps)
count, sum = 0, 0
end
else
lowSince = nil
end
else
lowSince = nil
if fps > HIGH_FPS then
highSince = highSince or now
if now - highSince >= HIGH_SECS and now - lastSwitch >= COOLDOWN then
highSince, lastSwitch = nil, now
restore(fps)
count, sum = 0, 0
end
else
highSince = nil
end
end
end)
end)
end)
